The minister confirmed the rules apply, placed monitoring and safety duties on the operator, said costs are not expected to be disproportionate, and declined to commission a study, saying it will monitor implementation and discuss with the sector if problems arise.
I of course monitor the implementation of the new rules and my ministry is in contact with organisations in the field about it.
Ik volg de uitvoering van de nieuwe regels uiteraard en mijn ministerie heeft daarover ook contact met organisaties in het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Farmalobby wil dekking tegen claims over vaccins’

An MP asks the health minister whether pharmaceutical companies should be shielded from liability claims for COVID-19 vaccines, and whether EU liability rules still apply and what precedents and contract terms exist. The minister replies that EU product liability rules fully apply and citizens' rights are unaffected, but that member states may indemnify manufacturers under strict conditions in contracts that are confidential.
However, the agreements do contain arrangements for member states to indemnify pharmaceutical companies against third-party claims.
Wel worden in de overeenkomsten afspraken gemaakt over een vrijwaring door de Lidstaten van de farmaceutische bedrijven ten aanzien van claims van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het afschalen van het bron- en contactonderzoek voor covid-19 door de GGD’en in opdracht van het ministerie van VWS

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether the health ministry cut the basic capacity for COVID-19 contact tracing from 850 to 550 FTE in a June 2020 service agreement with the GGD's, and whether financial considerations drove this. Minister De Jonge denied any scaling-down plan or cost motive, stated the state bears all scaling costs, and attached the service agreement.
No, this is incorrect. Between VWS and GGD GHOR, financial agreements were made on scaling up the national capacity in line with the scaling plan from late May.
Nee, dit is onjuist. Tussen VWS en GGD GHOR zijn financiële afspraken gemaakt over de opschaling van de landelijke capaciteit conform het opschalingsplan van eind mei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Ergernis en chaos bij werving GGD'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how a blank cheque for the GGD fits with years of budget cuts, whether recruitment criteria for contact tracers and outsourcing to commercial agencies are acceptable, and whether central coordination is planned. The minister said GGDs are adequately funded with federal covering of extra COVID costs, that regional criteria follow a national job profile, that outsourcing is understandable given the crisis, and that central coordination via GGD GHOR Nederland is already in place without guaranteeing capacity at all times.
I am therefore committed to resolving all emerging bottlenecks as quickly as possible together with the GGDs.
Ik zet mij er dan ook voor in om alle knelpunten die opspelen zo snel mogelijk samen met de GGD’en op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht van weer dreigende tekorten aan beschermingsmiddelen

MPs asked whether a shortage of protective equipment such as gloves and protective gowns was looming in hospitals, including reports of staff using rain jackets, and whether supplies would be sufficient in a possible second wave. The minister replied that the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen has stockpiled ample supplies (21 million isolation gowns and 118 million gloves ready for delivery), that hospitals can order from it, and that signals of shortages are being checked, while noting the global market remains volatile.
Signals about possible shortages are therefore explicitly being checked.
Signalen over mogelijke tekorten worden daarom nadrukkelijk nagetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over test- en ventilatiebeleid bij corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the accessibility of COVID-19 test sites, the closure of the Breda test site, and ventilation checks in nursing homes. The minister referred to a letter on testing for most questions, explained that the Breda site closes for locational and football reasons while a new one opens, and said a central ventilation team check would add no value while Actiz surveys members.
Actiz is currently conducting a survey among its members and will inform me about it.
Actiz voert op dit moment een inventarisatie onder de leden uit en zal mij daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over gebrek aan vergoeding van taperingstrips door CZ bij suïcidaliteit

MP Van Gerven asked why insurer CZ refuses to reimburse compounded tapering strips for a patient who became suicidal during a protocolled antidepressant taper, and whether such patients are entitled to tailored care. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said reimbursement depends on rational pharmacotherapy criteria applied first by insurers, and noted that insurers' pharmacists work under accountable medical advisers and that insurers will reimburse taper medication case by case.
It is not for me to assess an individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om een individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over de financiële belangen van testlabs van medisch-microbiologen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether testing capacity in the large labs was underused in early 2020, whether financial interests of medical-microbiology labs drove testing choices, and whether the OMT was steered toward them. The Minister denied that financial interests shaped advice, attributed the early restrictive testing policy to material shortages and validation constraints, and declined to comment on OMT steering because he has no seat on it.
I do not sit on the OMT and can therefore make no statements about steering within the OMT.
Ik heb geen zitting in het OMT en ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken over sturing binnen het OMT doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over over de verdubbeling van de prijzen voor persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen door het Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen (LCH)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the doubling of prices for personal protective equipment by the national LCH consortium, why the August letter did not mention this, and whether domestic production should be prioritised. The minister confirmed the price increase on three products, justified it as necessary to avoid market distortion and dependence on the LCH, and described domestic production contracts and a planned strategic stockpile.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de brandweer een woonzorgcentrum moest koelen vanwege de hitte

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether it is unacceptable that frail elderly residents of a care home had to stay in overheated rooms, requiring fire service cooling, and whether the Inspectorate (IGJ) would intervene and whether the Heat Plan is binding. The minister answered that the rules already guarantee a comfortable living climate, that providers are responsible, that the IGJ received no complaints and sees no reason to investigate, and that the Heat Plan is only a communication plan, with the topic to be raised in regular consultations.
The inspectorate has received no reports about the heat in the care home. There is no reason for the inspectorate to conduct further investigation.
Over de warmte in het woonzorgcentrum heeft de inspectie geen meldingen gehad. Er is voor de inspectie geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de goedkeuring van Remdesivir in Europa

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the European approval of remdesivir, including weak mortality benefit, side-effect data, researcher ties to Gilead, pricing and profits during the pandemic. The minister answered that EMA and CBG assessed efficacy and safety, that a conditional marketing authorisation was granted, that the price should be reasonable but market pricing is not for the minister to judge, and that the company's stock value is not a matter for government.

It is the task of the European Medicines Agency (EMA) and the Dutch College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) to carry out an independent, substantive assessment of a medicine's efficacy and safety before it may be placed on the European or Dutch market.

Het is de taak van de European Medicines Agency (EMA) en het Nederlandse College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) om een onafhankelijke, inhoudelijke beoordeling van de werkzaamheid en veiligheid van een geneesmiddel te doen alvorens een geneesmiddel op de Europese, dan wel Nederlandse markt mag worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Goedkope sigaretten nog volop verkrijgbaar'

MP Van Gerven asked why cheap cigarettes remained available after a 1 euro excise increase, why retailers could sell old-price stock, and why no minimum price exists. The state secretary answered that EU excise rules let manufacturers set retail prices and forbid minimum prices, that wholesalers may supply old-price stock only for two months, and that a further increase toward 10 euros by 2023 is planned after a cross-border evaluation.
Within the National Prevention Agreement, the cabinet has taken various measures to discourage tobacco use.
Het kabinet heeft in het kader van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord verschillende maatregelen op het terrein van tabaksontmoediging genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kankerverwekkende stof ontdekt in partijen paracetamol’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of a carcinogenic impurity (para-chloroaniline) in paracetamol batches, the divergent EMA and EFSA risk assessments, the supply chain, and whether the supplier identity should be disclosed. The Minister replied that CBG and IGJ found no batches exceeding the ICH limit, that the regulatory norms are sound, and that supplier disclosure is withheld under confidentiality rules applied in line with EU guidance.
The CBG does not provide data on the basis of joint agreements. It is up to the manufacturer itself to make this data public.
Het CBG verstrekt geen gegevens op basis van gezamenlijke afspraken. Het is aan de fabrikant zelf om deze gegevens openbaar te maken.
Àntwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Groot alarm bij de bloedbank: alweer een zak vol zwarte deeltjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of black particles in donated plasma at Sanquin and the manufacturer Haemonetics, including why the 2011 incidents and later foreign warnings led to no further action. The minister answered that the IGJ was informed in 2011, the defective centrifuge bowls were recalled, the Dutch equipment was judged lower risk, and the IGJ is now in talks with Sanquin and Haemonetics and has requested the confidential report.
The IGJ has asked Haemonetics additional questions and requested the report.
De IGJ heeft bij Haemonetics aanvullende vragen gesteld en het rapport opgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Oud-topman RIVM: 'We moeten meer testen, anders blijft het een smeulende veenbrand''

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister how he views a former RIVM chief's call for more COVID-19 testing, including testing of asymptomatic people, and why the OMT downplays asymptomatic spread. The answer was given by reference to a separate letter on OMT advice and COVID-19 measures, without substantive answers in this document.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z13783) have been answered by letter 'Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 504).

De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z13783 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «Adviezen OMT en maatregelen COVID-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 504 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Testen, testen, testen, maar hoe?

An SP MP asked the health minister whether COVID-19 testing policy, which mainly tests symptomatic people, should change to catch asymptomatic and presymptomatic infections, and about related measures. The minister answered that asymptomatic testing can help in specific cases, announced testing of returning travellers and a trial of the contact-tracing app, and said the government will respond to local outbreaks with various measures.
I have asked the OMT to advise me from what point asymptomatic testing of close contacts in contact tracing has sufficient added value.
Ik heb aan het OMT gevraagd mij te adviseren vanaf welk moment het asymptomatisch testen bij nauwe contacten uit het bron- en contact onderzoek voldoende toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van beleidskeuzes bij de bestrijding van de coronapandemie in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about expected infection and death levels under the Dutch mitigation policy, the basis for policy choices, and whether a hard lockdown would be better. The minister answered that infection levels are being monitored through serological studies, that policy aims at controlling the virus rather than herd immunity, and that the measures prevented about 90% of expected ICU admissions, but he did not give mortality projections for the policy options.
Calculations made concern the number of ICU and hospital admissions. Mortality is a derivative of these calculations.
Berekeningen die worden gemaakt betreffen het aantal IC- en ziekenhuisopnames. Sterfte is een afgeleide van deze berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiering voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek voor vaccinontwikkeling

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked why COVID-19 vaccine research funding through ZonMw starts late, whether the budget is too small, who assesses proposals, and whether private vaccine development could inflate prices or deny supply to the Netherlands. Minister De Jonge answered that funding was raised to 40 million euro for the ZonMw programme and 67.5 million euro overall, that assessment follows published procedures, and that he does not share concerns about price inflation or supply refusal.
The RIVM delivered this scan in the first week of May.
Het RIVM heeft deze scan de eerste week van mei opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Zorgen om luchtvervuiling in Brabant en Limburg: 'Wat als er een tweede golf komt en het aantal doden hier weer hoger ligt?''

MPs Futselaar and Van Gerven asked the ministers whether residents of Brabant and Limburg have grounds for concern about COVID-19 resurgence linked to air pollution from livestock farming, and what steps will be taken on research and reducing pollution. The minister answered that RIVM is still scoping research on the air quality and COVID-19 link, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord and other measures address air pollution, and that mink farms with infections will be culled while a voluntary exit scheme is being considered.
Once these have been mapped out, my colleagues at I&W and VWS and I will decide whether and, if so, which studies we want to commission from RIVM.
Nadat deze in kaart zijn gebracht zullen mijn collega’s van I&W en VWS en ikzelf besluiten of en zo ja, welke onderzoeken we willen uitzetten bij het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Patiënten de dupe van medicijnwisseling'

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about patients harmed by forced drug switching, the CBG list of drugs not to be switched, the cost savings from switching, the stalled agreement with parties, drug shortages, purchasing by insurers, and national procurement. The minister answered that switching is handled case by case, a CBG list is coming this year, savings are substantial, shortages are a global problem addressed by a five-month stock and temporary measures, and no conclusion on centralised purchasing has been reached.
I have asked the College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) to draw up a list of medicines that should preferably not be switched.
Ik heb het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) gevraagd een lijst op te stellen van geneesmiddelen die bij voorkeur niet gewisseld zouden mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Ploumen en Ellemeet over de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

Three MPs asked the Minister of Health how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance relates to the COVID-19 pool and ACT, whether it undermines global access, and how prices and pharmaceutical deals would be controlled. The minister answered that the initiatives are complementary, that the Alliance includes solidarity with low- and middle-income countries, and that price and supply agreements are being pursued, but gave no firm commitments on joining the pool or conditioning public funding.
I believe several paths must be pursued to make a safe and effective COVID-19 vaccine available as quickly as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat er verschillende paden bewandeld moeten worden om zo snel mogelijk een veilig en effectief vaccin tegen COVID-19 beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat producent coronamedicijn Sanquin mogelijk in de problemen komt

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that Sanquin's plasma products subsidiary SPP may be in trouble, its role in COVID-19 treatment, its finances, state ownership, and possible foreign partners. The minister replies that SPP is not in trouble but seeks a strategic partner, that the state will not take a majority stake, and that Dutch supply of plasma medicines must be guaranteed whatever the outcome.
I am examining what is needed for this, including the role of SPP in it.
Ik onderzoek wat hiervoor nodig is, inclusief de rol van SPP hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Met boeven vangt men boeven, Big Tobacco leert de douane het smokkelvak’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Customs training by a tobacco manufacturer breaches the WHO FCTC and whether the industry actively smuggles tobacco. The government replied that such contact falls within Article 5.3 limits, that seized cigarettes are mostly illicit whites or counterfeits, and that the training was given by Japan Tobacco International, with no documents shared.
The information shared during the meeting was in the form of a presentation. The tobacco manufacturer did not share this information as a document or in any other form.
De informatie die is gedeeld tijdens de bijeenkomst is gedaan in de vorm van een presentatie. De tabaksfabrikant heeft deze informatie niet gedeeld in de vorm van een document of in een andere vorm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bestelling van 300 miljoen vaccins bij AstraZeneca

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the 300 million AstraZeneca vaccine deal amounts to vaccine nationalism, how the doses and prices are set, who advised on it, and asked about AstraZeneca's past legal cases. The minister rejected vaccine nationalism, said the deal is open to all EU states, withheld price and R&D cost details to protect negotiations, and declined to comment on the past cases.
The negotiation result was not made public because this could harm the alliance's negotiating position and that of the European Joint Negotiation Team in talks with other pharmaceutical companies.

Het onderhandelingsresultaat is niet openbaar gemaakt omdat dit de onderhandelingspositie van de alliantie en in het vervolg van het Europese Joint Negotiation Team in gesprekken met andere farmaceutische bedrijven kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Niemand wees Marjolein door’ en vergoeding fysiotherapie bij coronapatiënten die niet in het ziekenhuis zijn opgenomen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report that COVID-19 patients not hospitalised cannot get physiotherapy under the chronic-condition indication, and about how multidisciplinary rehabilitation should be funded. The minister confirmed that non-hospitalised patients must pay for physiotherapy themselves unless covered by supplementary insurance, said the Zorginstituut and NZa are advising on the benefit and funding, and promised to inform parliament after the summer recess.
In early May I asked the Zorginstituut Nederland to advise me promptly on measures regarding the entitlement to paramedical care.
Ik heb begin mei het Zorginstituut Nederland gevraagd om mij op korte termijn te adviseren over maatregelen ten aanzien van de aanspraak voor paramedische zorg

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brief van een wetenschapper uit Milaan dat meer concrete kennis door meer systematisch onderzoek nodig is om ons door de CoV crisis te loodsen'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the government responds to a Milan scientist's letter calling for more systematic research on COVID-19, including transmission, immunity and severity. The minister agreed research is needed, cited ongoing Dutch and EU studies and provided preliminary figures, but did not answer question 6 on timing.
I have therefore forwarded this letter to the RIVM with the request to look at his proposal.
Ik heb deze brief dan ook aan het RIVM doorgestuurd met het verzoek om te kijken naar zijn voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Geen goedkeuring: zorgverzekeraar betaalt noodhospitaal niet'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether an insurer's refusal to pay for a COVID-19 emergency hospital in Limburg (Maastricht UMC+) and the financing of extra capacity in Rotterdam was justified, and who should pay the roughly 4.5 million euro bill. The Minister had sympathy for the proactive preparation, said no formal reimbursement request had yet been filed, and deferred the financing question to ongoing regional talks rather than resolving it.
I am awaiting the further outcomes of these discussions.
Ik wacht de verdere uitkomsten van deze gesprekken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘SKB blaast fusie met Slingeland af’

SP MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the SKB hospital in Winterswijk called off its merger with Slingeland (Santiz), including the reasons, the IGJ's role, the new Doetinchem building, and the regional care plan. The minister answered that no final defusion decision has been taken, that a mediator will be appointed to restore stability and start a regional dialogue, that the IGJ has placed Santiz under heightened supervision, and that he has no role in the building plans or in the decision on defusion.
It is up to the Santiz board of directors to give clarity on how they have concretely given and will give shape to the new building. I have no role in this.
Het is aan de raad van bestuur van Santiz om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij concreet invulling hebben gegeven en gaan geven aan de nieuwbouw. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over ‘sluip’marketing van de tabaksindustrie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about tobacco industry 'sneak' marketing: payments to retailers and festivals for prominent or exclusive product display, influencer videos featuring a tobacco brand, NVWA capacity and fines. The State Secretary answered that such payments violate the advertising ban, that the NVWA enforces case by case and has fined festivals, that capacity is being expanded by 6.5 then 7.5 FTE, and that the fine regime is adequate.
In the letter of 11 May I indicated that I consider supervision of the new rules of the National Prevention Agreement important for achieving the agreement's goals.
479 ) aan uw Kamer heb ik aangegeven dat ik het toezicht op de nieuwe regels van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord van belang acht voor het behalen van de doelen uit het akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over het rapport over de financialisering van big pharma (nieuwe versie)

Two SP MPs asked the minister for Medical Care about an SOMO report on the financialisation of big pharma, including shareholder payouts, debt-financed buybacks, the role of public money in COVID-19 vaccine development, and access conditions. The minister answered that transparency on R&D costs and pricing is important, that the government negotiates hard on prices and will remain transparent on public vaccine investments, and that it will insist on broad access, but did not accept the characterisation of the business model as unacceptable or unsustainable.
I will remain transparent about the Dutch government's investment strategy and within European cooperation.
Ik zal transparant blijven over de investeringsstrategie van de Nederlandse overheid en in Europees samenwerkingsverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de gevolgen van nieuwe Europese wetgeving voor de beschikbaarheid van  medische hulpmiddelen en medische hulpmiddelen voor invitro diagnostiek

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about shortages from the EU Medical Devices Regulation and the in-vitro diagnostics regulation, including whether in-house tests should be restricted and whether the rules should be paused. The minister answered that the MDR postponement was due to the Covid crisis rather than shortage signals, that the IVDR applies from May 2022 with an in-house exemption conditional on no equivalent market product, and that no change to EU legislation is currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to advocate changing the legislation in Europe.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om aanpassing in wetgeving in Europa te bepleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verbijstering van politici over de totstandkoming van Windpark Spui in Piershil/Nieuw-Beijerland

MPs asked about the impact of the Windpark Spui wind farm on local residents, including noise nuisance, compensation, health effects, minimum distance norms and foreign ownership of subsidised turbines. The minister replied that provincial authorities are competent, that noise norms are met, that no scientific basis exists for 'turbine syndrome', and that further research on low-frequency noise is awaited, without committing to new national measures.
Because the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority for wind farm Spui, I am not directly involved in this wind farm.
Omdat de provincie Zuid-Holland bevoegd gezag is voor windpark Spui, ben ik niet direct betrokken bij dit windpark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bijgesteld advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan ‘Capaciteitsplan 2011-2024’ en de opleidingscapaciteit van tandartsen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a revised Capacity Body advice on medical and dental training places, prompted by new CBS population projections, should be adopted, including keeping medical intake at 2900 and raising dental training capacity from 240 to 359. The minister answered that the revised advice will be taken into account in the government's response to the Capacity Plan, to be sent to parliament before summer, and did not commit to specific numbers now.
We will take the revised advice of the Capacity Body into account in our response to the Capacity Plan.
Wij zullen het bijgestelde advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan bij onze reactie op het Capaciteitsplan betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ministerie hield zorgen over Omgevingswet achter’

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of Interior held back an internal quick scan warning that the Environment and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) could not be implemented smoothly by January 2021, and whether the scan would be published. The minister declined to share the quick scan, summarised its conclusions and recommendations, and said the implementation date would be postponed.
I am not willing to share the Quick scan with your House.
Ik ben niet bereid de Quick scan met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Test op antistoffen, dat is nu essentieel’ en ‘onderzoek relatie corona en vuile lucht’.

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper op-ed on antibody testing and the mechanics of immunity after a mild COVID-19 infection, a proposal to test a representative sample, and a possible link between air pollution and COVID-19 severity. The minister answered that research on antibodies and immunity is still ongoing, that an expert task force will advise on testing strategy, that the Pienter-Covid study already tests a broader population sample, and referred the air pollution question to earlier answers.
The task force will among other things assess whether and for which persons it is desirable for an antibody test to be deployed on a large scale.
De taskforce zal onder andere beoordelen of en voor welke personen het wenselijk is dat een test op antistoffen op grote schaal ingezet gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten ondanks het bestaan van een medische noodzaak

An SP MP asked why health insurers refuse to reimburse removal of breast implants for a patient despite three medical specialists confirming medical necessity, and whether the patient is entitled to reimbursement. The minister replied that assessing individual reimbursement is the insurer's task under the Health Insurance Act, that the patient can complain to the SKGZ, and that the patient apparently had the removal at a non-contracted private clinic, so full reimbursement was not provided.
It is primarily the task of health insurers to determine which care may be counted as insured care.
Het is primair de taak van zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen welke zorg tot verzekerde zorg gerekend mag worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van fysiotherapeuten over een effectief noodplan voor fysiotherapiepraktijken dat per direct voorziet in financiële ondersteuning

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care nine questions about letters and press statements from physiotherapists and dental professionals warning of bankruptcy, asking why they are excluded from existing COVID-19 support and when compensation will be clear. The answers were not given in this document; the minister referred to the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219) instead.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care (2020Z06224) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 219).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06224 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 219 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het uitbreiden van de testcapaciteit (ingezonden 7 april 2020).

Two SP MPs asked the minister about unused laboratory testing capacity, how far testing could be scaled up using companies, scientists and biotech parks, whether vendor lock-in limits testing, and whether the government would use military coordination, compulsory licences or relax procurement rules. The reply is a Kamerbrief reference stating the written questions were answered in a separate COVID-19 update letter, without substantive answers in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Van Gerven (both SP) to the Minister for Medical Care have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06299 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de immorele marketing door een medicijnfabrikant die is veroordeeld door de rechter

Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about a court ruling that drug maker Boehringer Ingelheim's reimbursement-scheme letters to doctors were misleading marketing, whether doctors relied on industry-influenced studies, whether guideline committees are industry-influenced, and whether oversight of marketing is adequate. The minister answered that the ruling concerned a specific case, that the IGJ is examining the scheme and has sufficient powers, and that guideline oversight is the IGJ's task.
I have brought this to the attention of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ).
Ik heb dit onder de aandacht gebracht van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de open brief aan de Raad van Bestuur van Treant voor het behoud van acute zorg in het Bethesda Ziekenhuis in Hoogeveen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether she would support reconsidering the closure of the emergency department at Bethesda Hospital in Hoogeveen, especially during the COVID-19 crisis, and urged the hospital board to pause irreversible steps. The Minister replied that the regional care plan was agreed earlier, that the transition was even accelerated to 30 March for crisis preparedness, and that reconsideration is not appropriate, while promising to monitor developments.
Reconsidering the decision to close the emergency department of Bethesda Hospital is therefore not on the table.
Een heroverweging van het besluit om de SEH van het Bethesda Ziekenhuis te sluiten is dan ook niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over fysiotherapeuten die in actie komen tegen bemoeienis van de zorgverzekeraar

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about physiotherapists protesting against insurer interference, contracting refusals, care avoidance due to costs, the behandelindex, NZa cost research and reinstating the first twenty physiotherapy treatments in the basic package. The Minister replies that contracts are preferred but a provider's choice, that avoidance has halved to 8% and compensation measures exist, that the behandelindex stays for now, that no new NZa cost study will be commissioned, and that reinstating the twenty treatments would cost roughly 100 million euros per year as a rough estimate.

During the General Consultation of 12 September on co-payments in healthcare, I committed to commissioning research into the (effectiveness of) measures municipalities and health insurers take to counter undesired care avoidance for financial reasons among vulnerable groups.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 12 september jl. over Eigen Bijdragen in de zorg heb ik toegezegd een onderzoek uit te zetten naar de (effectiviteit van) maatregelen die gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars nemen om ongewenste zorgmijding vanwege financiële redenen onder kwetsbare groepen tegen te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Van Gerven en Marijnissen over het opkopen van een Duits bedrijf dat aan een coronavaccin werkt door de Amerikaanse president Trump om een vaccin uitsluitend voor Amerikanen te ver

MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care how she would respond to reports that President Trump sought to buy a German COVID-19 vaccine developer for exclusive US access, and how to ensure affordable, universal access to any Dutch-funded vaccine or therapy, including whether to block private sale, suspend patents and set price limits. The minister replied that CureVac denied any such offer, that the medical need should guide access, that the existing patent law and compulsory licensing options are sufficient for now, and that she supports international price negotiations and will oppose excessive prices.
It is also not my intention in this crisis to develop a vaccine publicly and, if successful, to have distribution to the world population handled by a public organisation.

Het is ook in deze crisis niet mijn voornemen om publiekelijk een vaccin te ontwikkelen en bij een eventueel succes de distributie vanuit een publieke organisatie naar de wereldbevolking te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het artikel ‘Overleg over mogelijk tekort aan medicijnen’

SP MPs asked the minister whether the planned Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen was being postponed after pharma firms warned that low drug prices risk shortages during the coronavirus crisis, and about shortage prevention measures. The minister said options including room under the price law are being examined, that no corona-related shortages have yet been signalled, and that a further letter will follow next week.
I expect to be able to provide more insight on this next week, and I will inform you separately by letter.
Ik verwacht hier volgende week meer inzicht in te kunnen geven, ik zal u daarover separaat per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Reporter Radio kritisch over rookstophulp’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Reporter Radio report criticising smoking-cessation help, including coach quality, prescribing of medication without seeing patients, and the Kwaliteitsregister. The State Secretary largely acknowledges the problems, says a quality register improvement and a visiegroep review of coach criteria are underway, and calls prescribing without a doctor unacceptable, but defers insurer pricing questions to ongoing negotiations.
I find it unacceptable that medicines are prescribed without a doctor ever having seen the person.
Ik vind het onacceptabel dat medicijnen worden voorgeschreven zonder dat een arts de persoon ooit heeft gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een door de industrie gesponsord onderzoek naar implantaten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether industry-withheld study results on heart stents undermine informed choice, why cardiac surgeons and cardiologists diverge on the guideline, and how conflicts of interest in guideline-writing are prevented. The minister said manufacturers should not withhold unfavourable results, pointed to the EU MDR registration duties, noted the professional societies are in dialogue while patient care is safeguarded through heart-team meetings, rejected a precautionary principle citing no IGJ signals, and pointed to the voluntary Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen on conflicts of interest.
I therefore do not consider it desirable that manufacturers withhold research results, whether unfavourable or not.
Ik vind het dan ook niet wenselijk dat fabrikanten onderzoeksresultaten, onwelgevallig of niet, achterhouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ploumen over het bericht in het programma Argos dat onbevoegd personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten in de operatiekamers van ziekenhuizen meehelpen bij operaties

MPs Van Gerven and Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care about a Argos report that unqualified staff of medical device manufacturers assist in operating theatres. The minister answered that no specific rules apply, that existing general frameworks govern this, that the IGJ has received no reports of unauthorised involvement, and that no new specific guidelines are needed, though the IGJ will raise the issue with hospitals and a self-regulatory body will review practice.

The inspectorate has no reports of unauthorised involvement of staff of medical device manufacturers in operations, and no indications that this presence in practice prevents surgeons and other care providers from fulfilling their responsibility for good and safe care.

De inspectie heeft geen meldingen van ongeoorloofde betrokkenheid van personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten bij operaties en ook geen aanwijzingen dat deze aanwezigheid er in de praktijk toe leidt dat operateurs en andere zorgverleners hun verantwoordelijkheid voor goede en veilige zorg niet kunnen invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over complicaties door onprofessionele behandelingen

MP Van Gerven asked the minister about complications from cosmetic treatments by unqualified practitioners, the role of the cosmetic doctors' meldpunt and NVPC, IGJ oversight, and measures against unqualified practice. The minister said reports should go to the IGJ, that IGJ oversight of cosmetic clinics has been intensified, and that a quality framework and competence requirements are being developed.
For that, it is crucial that cases be reported to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ), so that the IGJ can take targeted action.
Daarvoor is het cruciaal dat voorkomende gevallen gemeld worden bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ), zodat de IGJ gericht actie kan ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de aangifte tegen bekkenbodemmatjesfabrikant Johnson & Johnson

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether the Public Prosecution Service should be asked to investigate Johnson & Johnson's Ethicon over pelvic floor mesh, following a Californian ruling, and what the Californian case and Australian expert testimony mean for Dutch use of such implants. The minister declines to involve the prosecutor, notes that vaginal implants are now allowed only in strictly regulated research settings, shares the view that the mesh rollout was over-rushed, and explains how patients can claim liability through general civil law.
The Public Prosecution Service itself decides whether a criminal complaint should lead to a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie bepaalt zelf of een aangifte tot een strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nieuw onderzoek naar fysiotherapie voor COPD-patiënten

The MP asks the minister for a reaction to a new study finding worse symptoms, more medication use and hospital admissions when COPD patients receive fewer physiotherapy sessions, and whether the session cap should be dropped. The minister says the study is only available as an abstract, calls on the researchers to submit the full report to the Zorginstituut, and states that any revision of the benefit is for the Zorginstituut to decide.
I therefore call on the researchers to send the full research results to the Zorginstituut for assessment.
Ik roep de onderzoekers daarom op de volledige onderzoekresultaten ter beoordeling aan het Zorginstituut te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de loting voor SMA-patiënten voor een behandeling met Spinraza

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the lottery used by UMC Utrecht to set the order in which older SMA patients start Spinraza treatment, and why this was not disclosed earlier. The minister explains the lottery was chosen because no medical or scientific criteria could rank patients, that the order is set under notary supervision, and that the centre is working to speed up intake but cannot give a date for the last patient.
At the time of answering earlier written parliamentary questions on the conditional admission of Spinraza, nothing was yet known about how the order of patient intake would be determined.

Antwoord 3 Ten tijde van de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke Kamervragen 4 over de voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza was er nog niets bekend over de wijze waarop de volgorde van instroom van patiënten zou worden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vileine truc om verbod op mentholsigaretten te omzeilen: menthol-inlegkaarten’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether menthol insert cards that turn tobacco minty can circumvent the upcoming menthol ban, and whether such products fall under the Tobacco Act and NVWA supervision. The State Secretary agreed it looks like an attempt to circumvent the ban, said the products fall outside current law, and committed to an inventory of such accessories with a view to banning them.
I intend to have an inventory carried out of the nature and scale of such accessories.
Ik ben voornemens een inventarisatie te laten uitvoeren naar de aard en de omvang van dergelijke «accessoires».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Huisartsenposten ’s nachts dicht in Voorhout en Alphen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about plans to close the night-time GP posts in Voorhout and Alphen aan den Rijn and move the Leiden post to Leiderdorp, asking about consultation, travel times and access. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are primarily responsible for the organisation, that the decision is not yet final, that consultation with residents and municipalities will follow and that IGJ and NZa are monitoring, while declining to commit to keeping the posts open.
The decision to close the GP posts in Alphen aan den Rijn and Voorhout at night is therefore not for me, but for them.
Het besluit om de huisartsenposten in Alphen aan den Rijn en Voorhout in de nacht te sluiten is dus niet aan mij, maar aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het toenemen van de wachttijden voor levensreddende middelen

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Medical Care about rising waiting times for life-saving drugs in the Dutch 'sluis' (gate) procedure, including Yescarta, and whether dwanglicenties or the German model should be used. The minister disputes the 410-day average, citing 340 days for completed procedures and 280 days for ongoing ones, explains the sluis criteria and the difficulty of compelling early submission, and says a commission is reviewing compulsory licensing with a reply to follow.
I cannot force a company to submit a reimbursement request in the Netherlands directly after registration.
Ik kan een bedrijf niet dwingen om direct na registratie ook in Nederland een vergoedingsvraag in te dienen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de aanhoudende klachten rond windturbines en de onduidelijkheid over de geldende regels, de inspraak en de participatie bij het voornemen tot plaatsing van windturbines

An SP MP asked the Minister about recurring complaints from residents near wind turbines, noise and health concerns, the adequacy of the noise standards, cumulative noise, public participation and profit distribution. The government answered that existing noise and shadow standards are sufficient, that no further research or precautionary tightening is planned, and that participation and local ownership are handled through existing procedures and the Klimaatakkoord.

I therefore see no reason to conduct additional research into the complaints about wind turbines, nor to apply the precautionary principle in the spatial assessment of where wind turbines may be built.

Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te doen naar de klachten rond windturbines, noch om bij de ruimtelijke afweging waar windturbines gebouwd kunnen worden het voorzorgsbeginsel toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Brandweer ingezet voor reanimatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that firefighters were deployed for a cardiac arrest in Ter Apel, asking how often ambulances are unavailable and whether closing the Stadskanaal emergency department affects ambulance availability. The minister replied that the response followed protocol, that firefighters were used because a station was nearby, that no substitute services are routinely deployed, and that extra ambulance capacity is being added as part of a regional care plan.
There is therefore no question of services being deployed as replacements; the civilian responders of HartslagNu are a valuable addition to acute care.
Er is dus geen sprake van diensten die ter vervanging worden ingezet, de burgerhulpverleners van HartslagNu zijn een waardevolle aanvulling op de acute zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Dik –Faber over het standpunt van het Zorginstituut Nederland over de hooggebergtebehandeling voor patiënten met ernstig astma

MPs Van Gerven and Dik-Faber asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's decision to drop reimbursement of high-altitude treatment for severe asthma, including its handling of the REFRAST study, insurer authorisation delays, and whether a follow-up study and stakeholder talks will be held. The Minister defers to the Zorginstituut procedure, says it will evaluate how suited its methods are to small patient groups, notes insurers have contracted the Davos clinic for 2020, and will inform the House after talks with stakeholders.
I stand behind this procedure as I also indicated during the committee debate.
Ik sta achter deze procedure zoals ik dat ook tijdens het AO heb aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de mogelijke institutionele vooringenomenheid bij het niet vergoeden van afbouwmedicatie

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the refusal to reimburse tapering medication shows institutional bias, citing a Wob-obtained document and comparing it to the childcare benefits scandal. The minister denies any institutional bias, states that the Zorginstituut has taken no official position, that reimbursement decisions rest with insurers subject to independent appeal, and that insurers will reimburse tapering medication case by case under the multidisciplinary guideline.
I am of the opinion that there is no institutional bias regarding the reimbursement of compounded tapering medication.
Ik ben van mening dat er geen sprake is van institutionele vooringenomenheid rond de vergoeding van magistraal bereide afbouwmedicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘VGZ zet succesproject huisartsen op pauze’

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he accepts insurer VGZ pausing a successful GP pilot ('Positieve Gezondheid') because it reduces hospital referrals and revenue, and how this fits national care policy. The minister says the pilot continues for 2020, further expansion will be discussed regionally, and the decision is for regional parties to agree, without the government directly overriding the insurer.
Agreements on continuing and expanding the project must be made between the care providers and health insurers involved and must fit the broader regional picture.
Afspraken over de voortzetting en uitbreiding van het project moeten tussen de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars worden gemaakt en moet passen in het bredere plaatje in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen in Kamer over interne onrust Gezondheidsraad’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of intimidation, a poor work culture and internal unrest at the secretariat of the Health Council, including a staff survey and a reorganisation that many staff reject. The minister answered that the reorganisation is needed to speed up advice, that the works council's challenge was dismissed by the Enterprise Chamber, and that he will closely monitor implementation while stating the advice remains of high quality.
I will actively monitor, follow progress and steer implementation where necessary.
Ik zal actief meekijken, de voortgang volgen en waar nodig meesturen op implementatie van de verandering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het op medische noodzaak ontvangen van vaccins die niet zijn opgenomen in het Geneesmiddelenvergoedingssysteem omdat de fabrikant geen vergoedingsdossier heeft ingediend

An SP MP asked why people with no functioning spleen must pay themselves for medically necessary vaccines not covered by the reimbursement system because the manufacturer never filed a reimbursement dossier. The Minister finds this undesirable, will ask the manufacturer to file a dossier, is consulting the Zorginstituut and RIVM on a broader solution, and expects to inform parliament in the second half of 2020.
I find it undesirable that people whose spleen has been removed and who depend on such a vaccination do not receive reimbursement for it.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat bij mensen waarvan de milt is verwijderd en die aangewezen zijn op een dergelijke vaccinatie, deze niet vergoed krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuis Winterswijk verliest intensive care, kinderafdeling en verlosafdeling’

MPs Van Gerven and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Winterswijk hospital would lose intensive care, paediatrics and obstetrics, and whether closures were planned without proper consultation. The Minister said the hospital board must follow the consultation steps of the draft AMvB on acute care before deciding, that acute obstetrics cannot close under the 45-minute accessibility norm, and that the board has paused the decision and set up a regional group.
I have informed the Board of Directors that closing acute obstetrics in Winterswijk is ruled out for as long as these conditions are not met.
Ik heb de Raad van Bestuur ervan op de hoogte gesteld dat het uitgesloten is dat de acute verloskunde in Winterswijk kan sluiten, zolang er niet aan deze voorwaarden voldaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Boete voor uitdelen tabaksbonus aan winkeliers’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary for health about NVWA findings that tobacco manufacturers pay sales bonuses to specialist tobacco shops, and whether the NVWA should be able to compel cooperation and act against such deals, including with supermarkets. The state secretary called the bonuses unlawful under the advertising ban, said a pending bill would give administrative bodies power to impose orders under penalty, and committed to further NVWA investigations in 2020 with results to be reported.
It is of great importance that cooperation is given to investigations by the NVWA.
Het is van groot belang dat medewerking wordt verleend aan onderzoeken van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de sluiting van residentiële bedden bij Oosterpoort

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why residential youth-care beds at Oosterpoort are being closed amid municipal budget cuts, and how youths are protected from falling through the cracks. The minister replied that the closure was a joint regional decision, that municipalities have arranged alternative family-based care, and that municipalities are responsible for youth care provision.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a statutory youth-care obligation.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een wettelijke jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘LangeLand Ziekenhuis krijgt steun van DSW’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that insurer DSW supports LangeLand Hospital and that Menzis would not, and whether insurers should keep a hospital open and how that fits with regional care. The minister answered that Menzis still has a contract with the hospital for 2020 and denies the reports, that regional care planning is for providers and insurers, and that government involvement with financially troubled providers is limited to exceptional cases.
Health insurers have a duty of care and the Dutch Healthcare Authority supervises this.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit ziet hierop toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Internationale deskundigen in Nederland bij elkaar over sjoemelsigaretten’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health for the full list of participants, agenda, findings and minutes of an expert meeting at RIVM on filter-ventilated cigarettes. The state secretary declined to name experts, withheld the agenda as a meeting-confidentiality matter, and deferred substance to a report due before the FCTC COP9 conference.
Names of experts are not released so that these people can do their work without interference from the tobacco industry.
Namen van experts worden niet vrijgegeven om deze mensen zonder inmenging van de tabaksindustrie hun werk te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het gebrek aan volledige dekking fysiotherapie in verzekeringen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister why no insurer offers unlimited physiotherapy cover in 2020, whether medical selection effectively excludes full cover, and how ME/CVS and rheumatism patients needing physiotherapy can be helped. The Minister rejected the premise that the situation is undesirable, pointed to a range of supplementary policies with physiotherapy cover and the Zorginstituut's ongoing advisory work, and said the answer was delayed by the need for external information.
I do not share that view. We have an extensive and solidarity-based basic package in the Netherlands.
Ik deel die mening niet. We hebben in Nederland een uitgebreid en solidair basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘DSW wil fusie Reinier de Graaf en Haga terugdraaien’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care to respond to reports that insurer DSW wants to reverse the merger of Reinier de Graaf and Haga hospitals, and about the consequences of a further legal merger. The minister said insurers may voice views but cannot formally block a merger, that the Reinier Haga Group stopped its study into a legal merger after the medical staff withdrew trust, and that no legal merger will proceed.
The research into the precise medical, financial and organisational consequences has not been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de precieze gevolgen op medisch, financieel en organisatorisch is niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Oorzaak gezocht bij capaciteitsproblematiek ziekenhuizen: Stijging sterfte rond geboorte baby’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether capacity problems in hospitals are behind a recent stagnation in perinatal mortality and whether acute maternity care is under pressure. The minister rejected a demonstrable link to capacity, pointed to low birth weight and preterm birth as the main risks, and committed to further action and a RIVM study reported in autumn 2020.
As I indicated in my letter to parliament of 25 November, the figures and Perined's interpretation show that the risks lie mainly with low birth weight and/or preterm babies.

Zoals ik in mijn Kamerbrief van 25 november jl. heb aangegeven, blijkt uit de cijfers en de duiding van Perined dat de risico's vooral zitten bij een laag geboortegewicht en/of te vroeggeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuis rijzen de pan uit’

An SP MP asked the minister whether hospital parking fees of up to 30 euros per day are acceptable, whether the government will ensure patients know about discounts, and whether parking should be capped or profit-free. The minister answered that parking tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, that VWS has asked the sector to inform patients better, and that he is not planning to cap tariffs or agree profit limits.
Parking policy and tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities.
Het parkeerbeleid en de tarieven zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van glycopyrroniumbromide (Sialanar®)

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sharp price increase of Sialanar, a registered glycopyrronium bromide drink, whether pharmacies may still supply compounded versions, and whether the manufacturer should be held accountable. The Minister answered that collegial supply of compounded drinks is allowed only where patients medically cannot use Sialanar, that the price difference reflects registration costs, and that he will monitor pricing but will not restrict registration of compounded products.
I think it is a good thing when a preparation is registered; a registered product is preferred.
Ik vind het een goede zaak als een bereiding geregistreerd wordt, een geregistreerd product heeft de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Laboratoriumtest: Mogelijk kankerverwekkende minerale olieresten in babymelk van Neolac, Hero Baby en Nutrilon’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers whether test results showing possibly carcinogenic mineral oil residues in baby formula from Neolac, Hero Baby and Nutrilon warranted recall, NVWA removal from shelves, company proof of safety and statutory maximum limits. Minister Bruins answered that the NVWA is investigating and companies must trace the contamination source, that EFSA cannot yet make a solid risk assessment, that recall and shelf removal are not warranted for now, and that Dutch efforts for EU maximum limits are ongoing.
In this case there are so many uncertainties about the reliability of the method and its conclusions that an order to recall products is not appropriate.
In dit geval zijn er zoveel onzekerheden over de betrouwbaarheid van de methode en de conclusies daaruit, dat een aanwijzing om producten terug te roepen niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Operatienormen: dat moet beter!’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how to respond to a report that several hospitals narrowly missed surgical volume norms, and whether such norms reflect care quality, whether reimbursement or hospital comparisons need changing, and what role the Inspectorate and the minister have. The minister answered that volume norms are a valid quality measure, that norms are averaged over three years so hospitals are not penalised for short-term dips, that the existing reimbursement system does not block good care, and that the Inspectorate will address cooperation and training where care is at risk.
There is no question of hospitals not complying with the relevant norms.
Er is geen sprake van dat ziekenhuizen zich niet houden aan de betreffende normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Dik-Faber en Van den Berg over het werkbezoek aan het Emma Kinderziekenhuis

MPs asked the minister about problems chronically ill young people face when transitioning to adult care, including loss of parental involvement, financial burdens and DBC billing limits, and about a transition unit and AVG care billing. The minister acknowledged transition challenges, said care providers and insurers should make tailored agreements and that NZa is handling AVG billing, but did not commit to a new transition unit pilot or funding.
I will make inquiries about this in the relevant consultations, such as the regular consultation with the Dutch Federation of University Medical Centres (NFU).
Ik zal hiernaar in de daarvoor in aanmerking komende overleggen, zoals in het reguliere overleg met de de Nederlandse Federatie van Universitair Medische Centra (NFU), navraag doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de wachtkamer van de zorg: overvolle Twentse hospices

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the health minister about hospices in Twente functioning as waiting rooms for nursing homes, terminally ill people dying at home for lack of hospice beds, hospital transfers to hospices, the decline of care homes, and the financing of bed capacity. Minister De Jonge said hospices should not serve as a general care function for older people, that dying people should be able to reach hospices where preferred, and that he is consulting the hospice sector and palliative networks and will send a letter on nursing home building needs in December.

I am in discussion with the hospice industry association, VPTZ Nederland, and the palliative care networks to see how better regional coordination can ensure people do not go to a hospice too late or too early.

Ik ben in gesprek met de brancheorganisatie van hospices, VPTZ Nederland, en de netwerken palliatieve zorg om te bezien hoe betere afstemming in de regio ervoor kan zorgen dat mensen niet te laat of te vroeg naar een hospice gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de brandbrief van werkgevers en vakbonden in de apothekersbranche

MP Van Gerven asks the Minister for Medical Care about a joint letter from pharmacy employers and unions on wages and market-based financing, including insurer claims on volume growth, vitamin D switching, and whether a subscription tariff should be introduced. The Minister says wage bargaining is for social partners and insurers, declines to compare insurer tariffs or assess tariff cuts, notes some vitamin D prescribing concerns and promises talks with parties, and sees no reason to change pharmacy funding.
However, I am not a party to the negotiations on tariffs between health insurers and (collectives of) pharmacies and do not wish to intervene in the private-law negotiations.
Ik ben echter geen partij in de onderhandelingen over tarieven tussen zorgverzekeraars en (collectieven van) apotheken en wil niet treden in de privaatrechtelijke onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ruime meerderheid van Q-koortspatiënten ontevreden over zorg’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report showing most Q-fever patients are dissatisfied with care, with large impacts on health and work. The minister acknowledges the suffering, points to existing research funding, screening, an updated QVS guideline and a single point of contact via Q-support, but offers no new binding measures beyond ongoing reviews.
To improve care for patients with chronic Q-fever, I have, in addition to stimulating more research, instructed the detection of patients with undiscovered chronic Q-fever.

Om de zorg voor patiënten met chronische Q-koorts te verbeteren heb ik, naast het stimuleren van meer onderzoek, opdracht gegeven om patiënten met een nog niet ontdekte chronische Q-koorts op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat antidepressiva vaak off-label wordt voorgeschreven

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that antidepressants are often prescribed off-label, about informed consent, under-reporting of side effects, effectiveness, tapering and advertising. The minister replies that off-label prescribing is permitted under guidelines and informed-consent duties, that the RIVM has documented the issues, and promises a round table on tapering and to raise prescribing and tapering with professional groups, but rejects a full advertising ban and an opiate-style action plan.
I will therefore ask the relevant professional groups to pay special attention to the need for responsible prescribing and tapering of antidepressants.
Ik zal daarom aan de betrokken beroepsgroepen speciale aandacht vragen voor de noodzaak van het verantwoord voorschrijven en afbouwen van antidepressiva.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van Fampyra

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the price of Fampyra rose 64% from October 2019, whether the pricing process was flawed, and what counts as a reasonable price. The minister answered that the price is in line with earlier pricing, stays under the Wgp maximum, and that no further price measures are warranted, so the price rise does not affect patient access or co-payments.
Because I see no reason for further price regulation of Fampyra, I also see no reason to investigate production costs and profit margins.
Omdat ik geen aanleiding zie voor nadere prijsregulering van Fampyra (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik ook geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar productiekosten en winstmarges.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het actief tegenwerken van het Zorginstituut Nederland, de NVvP en zorgverzekeraars van vergoedingen van taperingstrips

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about alleged obstruction by the Zorginstituut, the NVvP and health insurers regarding reimbursement of tapering strips for antidepressant withdrawal. The Minister answers that the Zorginstituut's internal remarks are not official positions, that insurers decide reimbursement under the rational pharmacotherapy criteria, and that he sees no reason to doubt the Zorginstituut's independence.
I have no reason to doubt the independence of the Zorginstituut.
Ik heb geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid van het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het inspectierapport over het onderzoek naar - en de toepassing van de cryoballon Arctic Front in het Erasmus Medisch Centrum in de periode 2005-2007

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the inspectorate report gives a 2001 CE-marking date for the Arctic Front cryoballoon when press and a witness say July 2005, whether the device was used only at Erasmus MC, whether patients were informed, and whether the Manusama and German studies undermine the inspectorate's conclusions. The minister acknowledged the 2005 date (the 2001 date referred to an earlier device), said the inspectorate's conclusions are unaffected, and agreed that informed consent would have been preferable under the WMO for a study-like use.
I have no information on this other than what is stated in the inspectorate report.
Ik heb hierover geen andere informatie dan in het inspectierapport staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de negatieve gebruikservaringen met Amfexa

MP Van Gerven asks the Minister of Medical Care about patients' negative experiences after being forced to switch from compounded dexamphetamine to Amfexa, whether medical necessity for compounding applies, and whether 2.5 mg doses should remain available. The Minister says switching between same-active-ingredient drugs is generally unproblematic, that individual cases must be judged by the prescriber or pharmacist, that compounding is allowed only for medical (not financial) reasons, and that reimbursement is for the insurer to assess.
I cannot do that. As mentioned above, it is for the prescribing physician or dispensing pharmacist to judge whether a registered medicine can be used in individual cases.

Ik kan dat niet doen. Zoals hierboven vermeld, is het aan de voorschrijvend arts of afleverende apotheker om te oordelen of al dan niet met een geregistreerd geneesmiddel kan worden uitgekomen in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care for a progress update on conditional reimbursement of Spinraza for SMA, a possible start date for treatment, whether financial negotiations are delaying it, and a message for affected patients. The minister says preparations continue, the target is starting the first patients by 1 January 2020, a covenant is expected in November, and he will inform parliament once Spinraza is formally proposed.
Once the covenant is completed and Spinraza is proposed as a definitive candidate for conditional admission, I will inform you further in line with the standard procedure.
Zodra het convenant is afgerond en Spinraza als definitieve kandidaat wordt aangedragen voor Voorwaardelijke Toelating zal ik u conform de standaardprocedure nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de oud-bestuurders van PrivaZorg ruim 14 miljoen zorggeld uit de zorginstelling hebben gesluisd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Health Minister and the State Secretary of Finance about reports that former PrivaZorg directors siphoned over 14 million euro of care funds through a complex corporate structure, and whether the IGJ, NZa, Tax Service and prosecutors should have acted earlier. The minister answered that the IGJ found no proven unlawful conduct within current legal frameworks, that the agencies lack sufficient powers over governance and integrity, and that new legislation on integrity, supervision and dividend conditions is being prepared.

The IGJ and NZa have previously indicated that they still have insufficient powers to investigate integrity and professional business operations, conflicts of interest, siphoning off care funds and setting up complex inefficient corporate structures.

De IGJ en de NZa hebben eerder aangegeven dat ze nog onvoldoende bevoegdheden hebben om onderzoek te doen naar integere en professionele bedrijfsvoering, belangenverstrengeling, wegsluizen van zorggelden en het optuigen van complexe ondoelmatige bedrijfsstructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over misleidende reclame van e-sigaretten

The MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary about misleading advertising for e-cigarettes, online sales without age checks, flavours appealing to youth, and whether plain packaging and warnings should be introduced sooner. The state secretary answered that plain packaging for e-cigarettes is planned for 2022, that the NVWA supervises advertising and age verification, and that further studies and measures are underway.
That is why the prevention accord includes that plain packaging for e-cigarettes will be introduced in 2022.
Daarom is in het preventieakkoord opgenomen dat in 2022 neutrale verpakkingen voor e-sigaretten worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'De elektrische wegwerppeuk: nieuw gevaar voor longen en milieu'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about disposable e-cigarettes: whether flavour bans are possible, whether these products are legal and properly registered, where they must be disposed of as e-waste, and whether online sellers check age. The State Secretary answers that disposable e-cigarettes are permitted under the Tobacco Act, that flavour bans are possible under the EU directive but only Hungary has used this, that waste must go to collection points, and that enforcement of online age checks is complex and a test-purchase method is being developed.
Enforcement of age verification by sellers is complex, because a test purchase must be carried out to establish a violation.
Het toezicht op de naleving van de leeftijdsverificatie door verkopers is complex, omdat voor het constateren van een overtreding er een testkoop uitgevoerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Jaarlijks 220 doden door het slikken van zware pijnstillers’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that 220 people die yearly from strong painkillers such as oxycodone, and whether advertising bans, litigation risks, support for victims and enforcement against manufacturers are needed. The minister says the figure includes other substances, points to planned measures on information, prescribing guidelines, research and early detection, and holds that existing advertising rules are sufficient for now.
I therefore announced measures in February of this year to reduce problematic use of these medicines.
Ik heb dan ook in februari van dit jaar maatregelen aangekondigd om het problematisch gebruik van deze middelen terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het VGZ-contracteerbeleid 2020 en verder met betrekking tot de antistollingszorg door trombosediensten

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about insurer VGZ's plan to tender anticoagulation (trombosezorg) together with first-line diagnostics in combined regional lots, and about quality, safety and inspection concerns raised with the IGJ. The Minister confirms the facts, says regional cooperation is needed and that VGZ must meet quality criteria and its care duty, and says the IGJ is examining the report and the NZa oversees the insurer's duty of care, without committing to halting the tender.
The IGJ has taken this report up as a signal for review.
De IGJ heeft deze melding als signaal in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de minister de fabrikant Leadiant ter verantwoording heeft geroepen vanwege het 500 maal zo duur maken van het geneesmiddel CDCA

An SP MP asked whether the minister's open letter urging pharma companies to be transparent about drug pricing was aimed at Leadiant, which raised the price of the drug CDCA 500-fold, and what concrete steps would follow. The minister confirmed the talks concern Leadiant, asks it for a transparent price explanation, and says further steps are possible if it refuses, while pledging continued engagement with industry and international agenda-setting.
Should the company not be willing to do so, I will consider follow-up steps of various kinds.
Mocht het bedrijf hier niet toe bereid zijn dan zal ik mij beraden op vervolgstappen van diverse aard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de rookcultuur bij Defensie

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretaries of Defence and of Health about reports of a smoking culture within the armed forces, including smoking rates, the exclusion of tobacco prevention from the 'Duurzaam Gezond Inzetbaar' policy, the closure of the smoking-cessation clinic, and very cheap cigarettes at the Brunssum NATO base. The government replied that smoking in vehicles and workplaces is banned, that smoking behaviour is a personal choice so no study is planned, that cessation support has been moved to Defence health centres, and that the low Brunssum prices follow from NATO status-of-forces rules, with illegal resale to be addressed by the Royal Marechaussee if signals arise.
Research into the smoking behaviour of military personnel is therefore not something I consider necessary.
Onderzoek naar het rookgedrag van militairen vind ik daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat gemeenten bedden in de specialistische jeugdzorg gaan schrappen zonder alternatieve opvang

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about municipalities in Noord-Brabant planning to cut EUR 10 million from specialised youth care in 2020 without alternative provision, and about guaranteeing capacity rather than provider revenue. The minister answers that municipalities hold the statutory duty to provide youth care and ensure continuity, that he endorses home-first care while accepting that institutional placement is sometimes the best option, and that the national support team is examining how to reach agreement between providers and municipalities.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a statutory duty to provide youth care.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een wettelijke jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ Verzekeraars mogen ouders wél informeren over tandartsbezoek kind‘

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care whether insurers may inform parents when children miss dental visits, how to raise the 600,000 children who never visit a dentist, and whether adult dental care should return to the basic package. The minister welcomes the Dutch data protection authority's clarification that such letters are permitted, commits to talks with insurers and a round table on children's oral health, but rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic package on cost grounds.
I am glad that the Dutch Data Protection Authority provided clarity in such a short time on whether health insurers may write to parents of children who do not go to the dentist.

Ik ben blij dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) op zo’n korte termijn duidelijkheid heeft gegeven op de vraag of zorgverzekeraars gericht ouders van kinderen mogen aanschrijven als deze niet naar de tandarts gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten dreigen in ziekenhuiszorg’
