An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports of waiting lists and overcrowding in hospital care, the financing of hospital transformation, flu-season preparedness and whether performance-based funding hinders 'the right care in the right place'. The minister acknowledges waiting times as a recurring concern, points to supervisory monitoring, the transformation fund and regional flu plans, and rejects the claim that performance-based funding is an obstacle, while promising further analysis of insurer contracts and a later NZa update.
The supervisory authorities closely monitor the quality and accessibility of care.
De toezichthouders houden de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid van zorg nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het lager vaststellen van de maximumprijzen voor ggz-zorg door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit

An SP MP asks the State Secretary whether the NZa's lower 2020 maximum mental health tariffs will reduce income, pressure quality and staffing, and ignore staffing norms and temporary staff costs. The State Secretary answers that the tariffs rest on thorough cost research, that most providers can keep their 2018 revenue, that the NZa's approach to staffing is sound, and that the NZa only opposes blanket discounts by insurers.
I am of the opinion that the maximum tariffs set for 2020 are based on a carefully conducted cost study.
Ik ben van mening dat de vastgestelde maximumtarieven voor 2020 zijn gebaseerd op een zorgvuldig uitgevoerd kostenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over slechte nazorg bij letselschade

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a patient harmed in hospital Isala who was not allowed to speak with the treating doctor or learn that doctor's identity after medical injury. The minister said openness and conversation are essential, the hospital board acknowledged liability and invited the patient again, and the minister considers existing rules (Wkkgz, GOMA, WGBO) sufficient so no new legislation is needed.
This patient too was reportedly invited several times to a conversation with Isala and the treating doctor, but would have declined every personal contact.
Ook deze patiënt zou volgens het bestuur meerdere keren zijn uitgenodigd voor een gesprek met Isala en de behandelend arts, maar zou elk persoonlijk contact af hebben gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de opkomst van zorgbeveiligers en het hardnekkige fenomeen separatie in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the rise of security guards in mental health care, the persistence of seclusion, the lack of data on their use and costs, and whether the Dolhuys manifesto goal of seclusion-free care for 2020 is met. The State Secretary says data on security guards and costs are unavailable, that seclusion is ultimum remedium and will be reduced via the Wvggz from 2020, and that transparency on coercive measures will be built into regulations, while leaving staffing, quality and bed capacity largely to providers and insurers.
To make data on the use of coercive measures per mental health institution public, it is necessary that this data be collected, processed and exchanged in a uniform and systematic way.

Om de gegevens over de toepassing van dwangmaatregelen per GGZ-instelling openbaar te kunnen maken, is het nodig dat deze gegevens op uniforme en systematische wijze worden verzameld, bewerkt en uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het chronisch vermoeidheidssyndroom (ME/CVS)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Health Council's advice on ME/CVS, including graded exercise therapy, research funding, ICD classification, UWV registration, municipal awareness and specialist care. The Minister largely deferred to professionals and ongoing research, while committing to a ZonMw action plan, informing municipalities, and talking with the NFU.
In line with this, I will ensure that municipalities are also pointed to the advice under the Social Support Act and asked to take it into account when carrying out their tasks.

Ik zal er in aansluiting hierop voor zorgen dat de gemeenten ook in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning wordt gewezen op het advies en gevraagd worden hiermee rekening te houden bij het uitvoeren van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Cordaan die verstandelijk beperkte cliënten een zwijgcontract liet tekenen

An MP asked the ministers why care organisation Cordaan had intellectually disabled clients sign silence contracts about abuse, when the abuse was reported late to the Inspectorate and perpetrators left with payments. The minister called silence clauses unacceptable, said the Inspectorate was not aware of the contracts until recently, and announced a law banning such clauses to go to consultation by end of year.
I find concluding such a contract between victims and a care organisation completely unacceptable.
Ik vind het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen slachtoffers en een zorgorganisatie volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de patiëntenstop voor VGZ verzekerden vanaf 1 juli bij het Ikazia Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the July 2019 patient stop at Ikazia Hospital for VGZ-insured patients with a budget ceiling, and whether this undermines patient choice and the health system. The minister answered that it follows an agreement between hospital and insurer, that communication to patients must be clear, that the NZa monitors VGZ's duty of care, and that he will not intervene but follows the situation.
I will not go further into the reasoning of the hospital and the health insurer.
Ik ga verder niet in op de redenering van het ziekenhuis en zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over de podcast 'Met 30 jaar zorg-ervaring terug naar school door de wet BIG 2'

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Minister of Medical Care about a podcast claiming the BIG-II bill would strip nurses of tasks and pay, and whether it is a cost-saving measure. The minister denies that the bill removes any nurse tasks or powers, calls the transitional arrangement a quality measure, and says the bill will not be pursued in its current form while Rinnooy Kan explores alternatives.
In view of all recent developments, I do not see the current bill on the nurse-practitioner role working in this form.
Gelet op alle recente ontwikkelingen zie ik het huidige wetsvoorstel rondom de regieverpleegkundige in deze vorm niet vliegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het overleg met betrekking tot de overgangsregeling BIG II

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether a consultation on the BIG II transitional regulation for nurses would take place on 10 September 2019, whether the action committee of nurses was excluded, and whether it would be invited. The minister replied that the meeting was postponed on parties' request while an explorer, Rinnooy Kan, talks with stakeholders, including the action committee.
He will also enter into discussion with the BIG II action committee.
Hij zal ook met het actiecomité BIG II in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het vergoeden van stamceltherapie bij MS-patiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether stem cell therapy (aHSCT) for MS patients should be made conditionally accessible while research runs, and whether aftercare for patients treated abroad is reimbursed. The Minister said the neurologists' research proposal is reasonable, pointed to existing research funding schemes instead of conditional access, and explained that aHSCT and its integral aftercare are not reimbursed from the basic package because effectiveness is not yet established.
At present the researchers have not yet been able to establish whether the aHSCT treatment is effective care, and for that reason the treatment is currently not reimbursed from the basic package.
Op dit moment hebben de onderzoekers nog niet kunnen vaststellen of de behandeling aHSCT effectieve zorg is en om die reden wordt deze behandeling op dit moment niet vergoed uit het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Novartis gemanipuleerde data gebruikte

MPs asked the minister how the government views reports that Novartis subsidiary AveXis submitted manipulated data for Zolgensma, whether this should affect approval or pricing, and whether Europe should impose sanctions. The minister called such non-transparency very serious, noted the EMA review is still ongoing and can take the signals into account, and said he would scrutinise the price if the Zorginstituut advises negotiation.
I cannot anticipate possible consequences and/or measures from the European Union towards AveXis.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op eventuele gevolgen en/of maatregelen vanuit de Europese Unie richting AveXis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit dat een 0% groei van de ziekenhuiszorg in 2022 onrealistisch is

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the 0% growth target for hospital care in 2022, which the NZa chair called unrealistic, will cause waiting lists and quality problems, and whether a realistic budget will be proposed. The minister replies that the growth target is necessary, that the agreements with the sector are binding, that quality is monitored by supervisors, and that no concrete budget change or guarantee is given.
It is therefore not a noble but a necessary aim.
Het is daarmee niet een nobel, maar een noodzakelijk streven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Overheid treedt niet op tegen illegale nicotinebom Juul'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that the Juul e-cigarette, which exceeds Dutch nicotine limits and is marketed to young people, is sold in the Netherlands without enforcement, and what would improve supervision. The State Secretary said such sales are unacceptable, that the NVWA is enforcing, several fines were issued and some shops stopped selling, and that supervision will continue.
The NVWA supervises and takes action against companies offering products on the Dutch market that do not meet the requirements.
De NVWA houdt toezicht en treedt op tegen de bedrijven die producten die niet aan de eisen voldoen, aanbieden op de Nederlandse markt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van Priadel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sharp price increase of Priadel (lithium), its co-payment burden on bipolar patients, and whether Essential Pharma's monopolising practices can be stopped. The Minister says the increase is lawful under the Wgp but undesirable, is in talks with the company which must provide a cost justification by September 2019, and sees no further legal options beyond existing price and competition rules.
I have indicated that I would like to see a cost justification of the price of Priadel.
Ik heb aangegeven graag een kostenonderbouwing te zien van de prijs van Priadel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘Zorg ontvangt tientallen miljoenen van de industrie’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how to interpret reported rises in industry sponsorship of the medical sector, whether the transparency register should be mandatory and lower reporting thresholds introduced, and how to make doctors and institutions more careful about industry ties. The minister attributed the rise mainly to more companies registering, particularly medical device suppliers, said mandatory registration is not warranted now but that the evaluation may lead to changes, and said responsibility lies with doctors and institutions under existing codes and the legal ban on gift-giving, declining to implement a motion to remove exceptions to that ban.
If the results of the evaluation give cause for it, I will consider changes to the conditions for listing in the Transparency Register Healthcare or other measures.
Als de resultaten van de evaluatie daar aanleiding toe geven zal ik wijzigingen in de voorwaarden voor vermelding in het Transparantieregister Zorg of andere maatregelen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het plaspillentekort

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the shortage of the 1 mg bumetanide tablet and whether low Dutch prices caused it, and what advice patients should get. The minister said the reports were incomplete: the shortage came from a packaging delay, not production or price, though a link to low prices cannot be fully excluded, and referred to a pending study on larger stockpiles due end September.
I expect the results of this study at the end of September.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Dringend gezocht: nieuwe medicijnen’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that new antibiotics are urgently needed, whether the government shares the UN warnings, whether incentives for industry and mandatory contributions are warranted, and what the scale of resistance in the Netherlands is. The minister answers that the government shares the concern, cites the Noordwijk conference, a 4.5 million euro fund and 5 million euro for GARDP, states that new incentives are still under discussion, rejects mandatory industry contributions, and promises an update on the ABR programme in early 2020.
No, there are sufficient (European) initiatives in the field of antibiotic resistance research.
Nee, er zijn voldoende (Europese) initiatieven op het gebied van antibioticaresistentie-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘St. Antonius stopt met bevallingen in Nieuwegein, moeders moeten uitwijken naar Utrecht’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about St. Antonius hospital's decision to permanently close acute obstetrics in Nieuwegein, questioning the staffing rationale, impact on pregnant women, travel times, and consultation. The minister answers that the status quo does not change for patients, the decision is driven by staffing and efficiency, the 45-minute norm is still met, and he has asked the hospital to follow proper consultation before closure.
The ROAZ, the NZa and the IGJ were not informed of the proposed decision to close permanently; I have told St Antonius that I do not consider this good practice.
Het ROAZ, de NZa en IGJ zijn niet geïnformeerd over het voorgenomen besluit om definitief te sluiten; ik heb het St Antonius laten weten dat ik dit geen goede gang van zaken vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de voortgang van het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet en de Aanvullingswet Grondeigendom

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the progress of the Digital Environment Act system (DSO), the BIT advice and follow-up, the exception to the offer obligation for self-realisation, and powers to compel land owners to build or be expropriated. The Minister replied that the DSO basic level is due end 2019, that BIT advice has been fully followed and a further BIT update will be requested end 2019, that a building obligation is legally limited and a study is pending, and that a residence obligation study has been commissioned.
I expect the results of this study at the end of August and will of course inform your House after the summer recess.
Ik verwacht eind augustus de resultaten van dit onderzoek en zal uw Kamer daarover uiteraard informeren na het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Nieuwbouw bij De Boerderij in Reek van de baan, GGZ verplaatst autismezorg naar Huize Padua 'Dit is een ramp voor de bewoners’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary about GGZ Oost-Brabant's decision to relocate autism care residents from De Boerderij in Reek to Huize Padua, questioning consultation, alternatives and the reasons for the move. The State Secretary acknowledged the impact, said the move is a considered decision by the care provider not expected soon, that the provider consulted residents and alternatives, and that he cannot intervene in such a decision.
Do you consider it acceptable that the residents of De Boerderij must move to Huize Padua, with all the consequences, purely for real estate reasons?
Vindt u het acceptabel dat de bewoners van De Boerderij moeten verhuizen naar Huize Padua, met alle gevolgen van dien, puur en alleen vanwege vastgoedoverwegingen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over medische crowdfundingsacties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the rapid growth of medical crowdfunding in the Netherlands, the need for better oversight and fee transparency, the effectiveness of treatments promoted, and ethical concerns about profiting from illness. The minister said he had no information on the growth comparison, that existing consumer protection rules by ACM and AFM are adequate, and that patients should discuss treatment effectiveness and risks with their doctor.
The State Secretary of EZK and I see no reason at this time to tighten supervision of crowdfunding, because we consider the existing regulatory framework adequate.
De Staatssecretaris van EZK en ik zien op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanscherpingen van het toezicht op crowdfunding, omdat wij het bestaande regelgevend kader op dit moment toereikend achten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Personeel spoedeisende hulp LUMC: patiëntenzorg in gevaar’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about staff warnings that emergency care at LUMC is endangered by overcrowding and staff shortages, and about the impact of closing the Bronovo emergency department. The minister refers to an earlier letter to parliament, states the Inspectorate sees no unacceptable risks for now, reports an external investigation commission at LUMC, and sees no reason to keep Bronovo open.
The Inspectorate has informed me that they have no reason to assume that there are currently unacceptable risks.
De Inspectie heeft mij laten weten dat zij geen aanleiding hebben om te veronderstellen dat er op dit moment sprake is van onaanvaardbare risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de petitie ‘De glucosesensor is geen gadget, maar bittere noodzaak’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a petition for reimbursement of the Freestyle Libre glucose sensor, including claimed cost savings, quality-of-life effects, and the Zorginstituut's distinction between flash and real-time monitoring. The minister said he sympathises with the initiative, declined to confirm the cost figures, referred to the Zorginstituut's assessments, and expects a Zorginstituut position on wider reimbursement by end 2019.
I therefore cannot confirm your assumptions.
Ik kan uw aannames daarom niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how his June 2019 pledge to start Spinraza treatment for SMA patients as soon as possible fits with the first treatments possibly not starting until 1 January 2020, and what he would do to start treatment within the month. The Minister says preparations are on a gradual timetable with the UMC Utrecht treatment capacity as the critical path, and that starting this month is not feasible.
After the summer recess I will send the House of Representatives a progress letter on the state of preparations for the conditional admission pathway for Spinraza.
Na het zomerreces zal ik de Tweede Kamer een voortgangsbrief toesturen over de stand van zaken van de voorbereiding van het voorwaardelijke toelatingstraject Spinraza.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tandarts onbetaalbaar voor ruim half miljoen mensen in Nederland’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked about reports that dental care is unaffordable for over half a million people, and about access for adults and undocumented migrants. The Minister rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic insurance package, cites personal responsibility, and declines to change the reimbursement scheme for undocumented migrants.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Overheid hanteert te ruime gifnormen voor sigaretten, extra risico volksgezondheid'

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health why the government's tobacco emission limits seem loosely applied, with lab tests suggesting about 40% of brands exceed limits, and questioned the ISO standards, their paywalled cost, and tobacco industry influence. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA must apply the prescribed ISO methods and tolerances, that only one violation has been found and fined, and that he is pursuing an alternative test method at EU level.
I am focusing on persuading other Member States and the European Commission to amend the prescribed measurement methods in the TPD.
Ik richt mij op het overtuigen van andere Lidstaten en de Europese Commissie om zo de voorgeschreven meetmethoden in de TPD aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het rapport ‘Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether taxpayers pay twice for drugs developed with public funding, given the SOMO report 'Overpriced', and asked about ROM investments, transparency, conditions on public funding, and alternative models such as a national drug research fund. The government acknowledged the report, said R&D is only one element of drug prices, argued that its own funding overview cannot be meaningfully summed, and said it will review conditions on revolving funds while ruling out a national drug research fund.
The report 'Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding' focuses in particular on revolving funds that impose no concrete conditions.
Het rapport «Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding» zoomt met name in op revolverende fondsen die geen concrete voorwaarden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de nieuwe LDL-cholesterol-richtlijn

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks the minister about the new LDL-cholesterol guideline, its scientific basis, alleged pharmaceutical industry influence on guideline committees, and how such guidelines are produced. Minister Bruins largely refers to earlier answers, says medical treatment should rest on transparent medical grounds, states that existing rules on gifts and transparency apply, and commits only to inviting the NHG to give its view.
I do not have additional instruments to guarantee that there is no contact at all between the pharmaceutical industry and members of guideline committees.
Ik beschik niet over aanvullende instrumenten om te garanderen dat er in het geheel geen contact is tussen de farmaceutische industrie en leden van richtlijncommissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 slachtoffers van Q-koorts krijgen nog geen geld’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why over 200 Q-fever victims have not yet received the financial allowance, including the grounds for rejection and the objections filed, and whether the scheme will be applied generously and extended as the Chamber requested. The Minister confirmed the rejections (mostly failing diagnostic or 2007–2011 exposure criteria), said the policy rule is being revised following adopted motions with details to follow, and deferred the extension question to that forthcoming letter.
I will inform the Chamber about this soon.
Binnenkort zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Van Gerven over het overschrijden van de 15-minutennorm bij ambulancespoedritten naar Woerdense Verlaat

An SP MP asked whether A1 ambulance emergency response times to Woerdense Verlaat stably exceed the 15-minute norm, and why the neighbouring RAV Utrecht does not help improve them. The minister answered that the norm applies regionally, reported average response times of about 18 minutes in 2018, admitted an incorrect government information page, and pointed to existing burenhulp agreements and municipal civil-aid initiatives.
This does not mean that A1 trips to Woerdense Verlaat systematically exceed the 15-minute norm.
Dit betekent niet dat bij A1-ritten naar Woerdense Verlaat stelselmatig de 15-minutennorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over de zaak Tuitjenhorn

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about the Tuitjenhorn case, including the Inspectorate's court challenge over a documentary, the naming of inspectors, its handling of the Council of State ruling, and whether GPs can practise without fear of orders. The Minister defended the Inspectorate, noting it accepted the ruling, apologised, and that an independent commission found its conduct largely sound.
The inspectorate accepted the Council of State's ruling of 1 June 2016 and has drawn lessons from it.
De inspectie heeft de uitspraak van de Raad van State van 1 juni 2016 aanvaard en heeft hier lering uit getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat drogisten en huisartsen gaan samenwerken om mensen met kleine kwalen beter te helpen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a pilot in which drugstores and GPs cooperate on minor ailments, raising concerns about financial conflicts of interest and increased self-medication. The minister defended the pilot as jointly run by the drugstore association and an insurer with monitoring by NIVEL, denied conflicts of interest, and said no increase in self-care medicine use is expected.

I am of the view that, given the expertise in the advisory group and the monitoring by NIVEL, sound research can be carried out into the cooperation between GP, drugstore and pharmacist regarding minor ailments.

Ik ben van mening dat door de expertise in de klankbordgroep en de monitoring van het NIVEL, er gedegen onderzoek kan worden gedaan naar de samenwerking tussen huisarts, drogist en apotheker op het gebied van kleine kwalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de miljoenenschikking van farmaceuten Bayer en Johnson & Johnson van Amerikaanse claims over het bloedverdunningsmiddel rivaroxaban (Xarelto)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the US settlement by Bayer and Johnson & Johnson over bleeding claims for rivaroxaban (Xarelto), and about Dutch use, risks, cost and evidence on DOACs. The minister answered that the Dutch situation differs from the US, that extra risk measures and monitoring are in place, that no new research is needed, and that a reversal agent has been recommended for EU approval.
This claim is entirely the responsibility of Bayer and Johnson & Johnson.
Deze stelling is geheel voor rekening van Bayer en Johnson & Johnson.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Antirookclub zet longartsen buiten de deur’

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the state secretary for Health about the reported split between the Alliantie Nederland Rookvrij and the Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd, including subsidy questions and the rejected proposals for a smoking addiction fund and licensing system. The state secretary declined to comment on the internal decisions of the organisations and KWF, said the proposals were discussed in the National Prevention Agreement but lacked sufficient support, and did not answer the questions in substance.
I am not responsible for the subsidy policy of KWF Kankerbestrijding.
Ik ga niet over het subsidiebeleid van KWF Kankerbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘UMC overtrad wet bij onderzoek galwegkanker’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Amsterdam UMC broke the law in a gallbladder cancer study and mishandled other trials, including whether the IGJ should investigate further and why inspection results on the Strider study were not published. The Minister regretted late patient notification, said no new IGJ investigation is needed as improvements are underway, and explained that Article 29 of the WMO legally prevents publication of the inspection report, to change under the EU Clinical Trial Regulation expected in 2020.
This is legally not possible under Article 29 of the Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act (WMO).
Dit is wettelijk niet mogelijk op grond van artikel 29 van de Wet medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek met mensen (WMO)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Treant en de toekomst van de ziekenhuiszorg in Drenthe en Zuidoost Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant hospital group's financial position, an alleged 10-year survival guarantee, the closure of ER and acute maternity services in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, and the plan's broad support. The Minister replied that the kernteam plan is not a decision, that no survival guarantee was given, Treant remains responsible for its finances, and consultation with stakeholders will follow.
No survival guarantee has been given. The Treant Zorggroep remains itself responsible for its (financial) business operations.
Er is geen bestaansgarantie afgegeven. De Treant Zorggroep blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor haar (financiële) bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het tekort aan bedden bij de kinderafdeling van het AmsterdamUMC

SP MPs asked the health minister about a shortage of paediatric intensive care beds at AmsterdamUMC after the VUmc child ICU closed, and whether the merger reduced capacity. The minister replied that concentration at AMC was planned, bed numbers rose to 10 operational with a target of 16, and staffing shortages and sick leave persist while the IGJ maintains its usual oversight.
The Amsterdam UMC has informed me that, like many hospitals in the Netherlands, it faces a staffing shortage in the paediatric ICU.
Het Amsterdam UMC heeft mij laten weten dat het, net als veel ziekenhuizen in Nederland, kampt met een personeelstekort op de kinder-IC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe China de WHO misbruikt voor zijn eigen agenda’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about WHO's inclusion of a traditional medicine chapter in ICD-11 and whether it benefits China's commercial or political agenda. The minister replied that the chapter is an optional registration tool with no diagnostic role, that the Netherlands took no independent position, and that adoption will be decided at the 2019 World Health Assembly.
I have no overview of the input of the individual countries.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de inbreng van de individuele landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Aantal buitenlandse tandartsen in Nederland neemt fors toe’

An SP MP asked the Health and Education ministers about reports that foreign dentists are increasingly working in the Netherlands, and whether enough Dutch dentists are being trained. The minister answered that about 14% of registered dentists have a non-Dutch nationality, roughly doubling since 2009, that the government does not actively recruit abroad, and that the cost of expanding training places will be reported in the Voorjaarsnota.

The Minister of OCW and I will inform the House with the Voorjaarsnota about the costs of following the advice of the Capacity Body on the required number of training places in Dentistry and Oral Health Sciences.

De Minister van OCW en ik zullen de Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota informeren over wat de kosten zijn van het opvolgen van het advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan over het benodigde aantal opleidingsplaatsen Tandheelkunde en Mondzorgkunde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Raan en Van Gerven over het bericht dat EU-voorzitter Roemenië zich laat sponsoren door Coca-Cola

MPs from PvdD and SP asked whether Coca-Cola's sponsorship of the Romanian EU presidency, and similar Dutch presidency sponsorships, create conflicts of interest and undermine the EU's health and sugar policy. The minister answered that sponsorship is a logistical matter for each presidency, that Coca-Cola's sponsorship is separate from EU negotiations on food rules, that no intervention was planned, and that the Dutch sponsorship policy will be considered for the 2029 presidency.
Sponsorships are a way to facilitate an EU presidency logistically.
Sponsorschappen zijn een manier om een EU-voorzitterschap logistiek te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het recht krijgen na een medische misser

An SP MP asks the health minister whether large financial disputes after medical errors, exceeding the 25,000 euro limit, cause serious problems, whether outdated cases show where the system fails, how many care providers use foreign insurers, and whether litigation costs deter victims from pursuing claims. The minister replies that the 25,000 euro threshold is intended for simpler cases, that the GOMA code and the Wkkgz have improved patient positions with an evaluation planned, that about 95% of liability is insured domestically with the rest abroad for unknown reasons, and that instead of compensating legal costs the answer lies in better patient handling by providers.
The Wkkgz will be evaluated next year.
Het komende jaar zal de Wkkgz worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Geen plek voor nieuwe poli in Arnhem-Zuid’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Rijnstate hospital's plan to move the Arnhem-Zuid outpatient clinic to Elst, its reasons, whether the municipality and residents were consulted, and whether competition played a role. The minister answered that the plans are not yet decided, that the hospital and insurers bear first responsibility for such choices, that the hospital consults stakeholders and will decide by year end, and that the municipality is responsible for informing its council.
When making choices about the internal organisation of care and its location, the hospital's Executive Board and the health insurers are primarily responsible.
Bij het maken van keuzes rondom de (interne) organisatie van zorgaanbod en de locatie daarvan zijn de Raad van Bestuur van het ziekenhuis en de zorgverzekeraars als eerste verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Parkeren bij ziekenhuizen weer duurder’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about rising hospital parking fees, whether parking should be free or at most cost-covering for patients, and whether the government will negotiate with VNG and hospital associations. The minister replied that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to the expanded patient transport scheme, and said he will urge hospitals to inform patients about discounts and remind VNG and hospital associations of the recurring questions, but will not steer national parking tariffs.
Parking policy and tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities themselves.
Het parkeerbeleid en de tarieven zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht antidepressiva onder vuur

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about reports linking SSRI antidepressants (notably Seroxat) to aggression and suicide risk, the GSK collective claim, prescription levels including for children, and a total advertising ban. The minister acknowledges documented side effects, points to ongoing EMA pharmacovigilance monitoring, defends prescribing under guidelines, and says advertising to professionals is adequately regulated.
Given the attention the professional groups pay to carefully handling antidepressants, I currently see no task for me in this.
Gezien de aandacht die de beroepsgroepen besteden aan het zorgvuldig omgaan met antidepressiva, acht ik vooralsnog hierbij geen taak voor mij weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Overheid stimuleert roken: ondernemers kunnen sigaretten aftrekken van belasting’

An SP MP asked whether business owners being able to deduct tobacco costs from tax, and the government's preventive stance on smoking, are consistent, and about the economic case for a smoke-free society. The government answered that tax law is in principle value-neutral, that tobacco costs for owners are non-deductible or limited as mixed costs, that no data exist on how often tobacco deductions are claimed, and that the existing tax rules can coexist with prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van Gerven en Ploumen over de ambulancezorg in de gemeente Gennep

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Gennep ambulance post, response times against the 15-minute norm, the role of insurers VGZ and CZ, cross-border mutual aid, and whether regional mayors must be consulted before closures. The Minister said the norm applies regionally, insurers did not fund the Gennep post directly, mutual-aid arrangements were tightened, and a national action plan and an AMvB on acute care availability are in progress, but no binding consultation duty for ambulance post closures.
This norm relates to the level of the (safety) region and not to the level of individual municipalities.
Deze norm heeft betrekking op het niveau van de (veiligheids)regio en niet op het niveau van individuele gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZiN-Rapport over de mondgezondheid van kinderen biedt onvoldoende basis voor beleidskeuzen’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether a TNO oral-health study of children is representative and whether the Zorginstituut may rely on it, given claims by the Ivoren Kruis dental association that it is not. The minister rejects the criticism, saying the study was representative, that children without dental visits were included, and that monitoring is under discussion with stakeholders.

I therefore am of the view, together with TNO and the Zorginstituut, that the report is sufficiently representative to draw conclusions about the oral health of young people in the Netherlands in general.

Ik ben dan ook van oordeel, met TNO en het Zorginstituut, dat het rapport voldoende representatief is om conclusies te trekken ten aanzien van de mondgezondheid van jeugdigen in Nederland in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ‘Voorlopig advies Capaciteitsorgaan tandartsen en mondhygiënisten’

An MP asks the ministers how they respond to the Capacity Body's provisional advice to raise annual dentist training intake to 311 students, and whether they will adopt it. The minister replies that the full analysis is still pending later in 2019 and that the costs of implementing the advice will be reported in the spring budget memorandum, without yet committing to the increase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet vergoeden van een uitname van siliconenprotheses op basis van siliconenincompatibiliteit door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis Achmea

MP Van Gerven asked the minister why insurer Zilveren Kruis Achmea refused to reimburse removal of a silicone breast implant for a patient whose specialist considered it indicated, and whether the Zorginstituut standpoint entitles such patients to reimbursement. The minister answered that the insurer's refusal was consistent with the Zorginstituut conditions, since no prior treatments were documented, and that the patient can turn to the SKGZ dispute body.
Zorginstituut Nederland stated in its standpoint of 31 May 2018 in which situations there is a medical necessity for removing (explantation) a breast implant
Zorginstituut Nederland heeft in zijn standpunt van 31 mei 2018 uitgesproken in welke situaties sprake is van een medische noodzaak voor het verwijderen (explantatie) van een borstimplantaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de last van het lijden en het krijgen van je recht na een medische misser

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a 2005 birth injury case, the Inspectorate's handling of it, the slow court procedures, and whether a no-fault compensation fund or a central liability body should replace the current insurer-driven system. The minister said the case was not reported as a calamity, declined to re-examine or meet the families, defended the existing complaint and arbitration routes, and rejected a no-fault system and a central body.
The Dijklanderziekenhuis has stated that it has not yet received information that a procedure has been brought before the European Court.
Het Dijklanderziekenhuis heeft laten weten nog geen informatie ontvangen te hebben dat er een procedure bij het Europese Hof aanhangig is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Apothekers doen aan verborgen export van pillen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that pharmacists export medicines abroad while shortages exist in the Netherlands, and about pharmacist income and a possible national purchasing body. The minister said export of shortage drugs is undesirable and prohibited under agreements, that no hard evidence yet shows it, that the IGJ is investigating a report and is examining oddities, and declined a separate independent study, a national purchasing organisation and gave partial answers on income and a supply obligation.
If there is concrete information showing that this does happen, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) would like to receive it so that it can investigate.
Als er concrete informatie is waaruit blijkt dat dit wel gebeurt, dan ontvangt de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) deze informatie graag zodat zij dit kan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Undercover in de wereld van het nieuwe roken’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report on Philip Morris staff promoting the IQOS heated-tobacco device in tobacco shops, whether this promotion is illegal, and when the amended Tobacco Act with health warnings will be sent to parliament. The State Secretary said explaining tobacco products is not prohibited, that advertising will be restricted from 2021 under the prevention agreement, and that the bill will be introduced as soon as possible.
Explaining a (tobacco) product is not prohibited.
Het uitleg geven over een (tabaks)product is niet verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het nieuws dat een farmaceut een diagnosemiddel voor prostaatkanker plots driemaal zo duur maakt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a sudden threefold price rise for gallium, a prostate cancer diagnostic agent, and related questions on hospital budgets, supplier dependence, radiopharmaceuticals and the Pallas reactor. The minister called the price rise remarkable and in need of explanation from the supplier, saw no signs of hospital financial problems, and largely pointed to hospitals, insurers and the existing pricing framework rather than committing to new state measures.
Hospitals make agreements with health insurers about budgets and volumes.
Ziekenhuizen maken met zorgverzekeraars afspraken over budget en volumes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de sluiting van nachtapotheken in Zeeland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about closing night pharmacies in Goes and Terneuzen, leaving Vlissingen as the only one for Zeeland, and the effects on patients' access, prices and the end of the state subsidy. The Minister answered that the arrangement was agreed regionally, that prices will fall and that no patient will be left without necessary medication, without committing to a new national measure.
For Zeeland residents and tourists it no longer matters at which location they collect their medication; after 1 April 2019 the out-of-hours surcharge is identical everywhere.
Het maakt voor Zeeuwen en toeristen niet meer uit op welke locatie zij hun medicatie op halen, na 1 april 2019 is overal de ANZ toeslag identiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de behandeling met gesuperviseerde oefentherapie bij COPD/emfyseempatiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether new limits on supervised exercise therapy for COPD, which penalise patients without exacerbations and add bureaucracy, should be changed. The Minister defended the new GOLD-based caps as evidence-based on Zorginstituut advice, pointed to a KNGF guide and talks with professional bodies, and declined to change the benefit.
I therefore do not intend to change anything about the benefit.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens iets aan de aanspraak te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de zesvoudige prijsstijging van kankermedicijn veroorzaakt door Novartis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the sixfold price increase of the cancer drug Lutathera by Novartis, including the company's acquisition of the raw-material supplier and the conduct of a Erasmus MC researcher. The minister condemned the price as excessive and unjustified, said Novartis must offer a reasonable price, and noted competition-law routes while giving no guarantees and committing only to further talks with Novartis.
I have therefore held discussions with delegations of Novartis.
Ik heb daarom gesprekken gevoerd met delegaties van Novartis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de mogelijke sluiting van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether he accepts the Haaglanden Medisch Centrum board's possible closure of the Bronovo and Antoniushove hospitals, and how patient interests, IGJ/NZa oversight, public participation, staffing and the board's motives are addressed. The minister answers that the board and insurers are primarily responsible for the process, that the IGJ and NZa are involved, that a draft ROAZ decree would require broad consultation, and that no decision has yet been taken.
In the process, the hospital board and the health insurers play an important role, but they are not the only ones.
In het proces spelen het bestuur van het ziekenhuis en de zorgverzekeraars weliswaar een belangrijke rol, maar zij zijn niet de enige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het tandartsentekort in Limburg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the warned shortage of dentists in Limburg, including its causes, regional comparisons, waiting lists and the timing of a Capaciteitsorgaan study. The minister said signals are concerning, attributed the shortage to an aging dentist population and unattractiveness of peripheral areas, reported no current access complaints, pointed to task redistribution and the pending study, and promised to inform parliament.
The Capaciteitsorgaan will present the first interim results at the end of January 2019.
Het Capaciteitsorgaan komt eind januari 2019 met de eerste tussentijdse resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Meer patiënten gaan eigen bijdrage medicijnen betalen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that more patients will pay the medicine co-payment, the risk that manufacturers stop compensation schemes after the 250 euro cap, the number of patients affected, ADHD medicines in the same cost cluster, and whether manufacturers may raise prices. The Minister acknowledges the risks, says the effects will be monitored by the SFK with a first report in early 2020, gives the estimate of about 40,000 beneficiaries, and says the cap keeps price and prescribing incentives in place.
For this, the Stichting Farmaceutische Kengetallen (SFK) will look at the effect on medicine prices, the amount and height of co-payments and the reimbursement schemes.
Daarvoor zal de Stichting Farmaceutische Kengetallen (SFK) kijken naar het effect op de geneesmiddelenprijzen, de hoeveelheid en hoogte van de bijbetalingen en de terugbetaalregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verborgen deals van topartsen met de hulpmiddelenindustrie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about undisclosed consultancy deals between senior doctors and the medical device industry, including whether such contracts should be banned and whether the Transparency Register and the Code of Conduct work. The Minister replies that the gift ban exceptions should be kept, that the Code's secrecy-clause rule would be breached if such clauses exist, and points to EU regulation tightening notified bodies.
I do not believe the statutory exceptions to the gift ban should be abolished.
Ik ben niet van mening de wettelijke uitzonderingen op het verbod op gunstbetoon afgeschaft moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over tekortschietend ziekenvervoer

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how she judges reports of late and overlong patient transport by taxi, whether clear rules exist under the Zorgverzekeringswet, whether solo transport is available, and whether a minimum per-kilometre rate should be set. The Minister agrees punctual transport matters, says the Bzv contains no timeliness rules and insurers set terms in contracts, notes Menzis's commitments and the pending Zorginstituut analysis, and refuses a minimum rate, pointing to insurers' duty of care and the NZa complaints desk.
The Besluit zorgverzekering (Bzv) provides that insured persons may have transport reimbursed if they fall within one of five listed groups.
In het Besluit zorgverzekering (hierna: Bzv) is opgenomen dat verzekerden vervoer vergoed kunnen krijgen als zij onder een van de vijf genoemde groepen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Geleijnse over taperingstrips en blunder met niet bestaand onderzoek

MPs Van Gerven and Geleijnse asked the health minister about tapering strips for psychiatric drug withdrawal, a Follow the Money report alleging misleading information from Zilveren Kruis Achmea, and insurer coverage rules. The minister denied being misinformed, said the insurer's conduct is its own responsibility, and stated that insurers may reimburse only rational pharmacotherapy under the basic package.
It is up to the health insurer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de tegemoetkoming Q-koortspatiënten en screening

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the implementation of the Q-fever compensation scheme, whether applications exceeded expectations and reduced per-person amounts, the administrative cost of about 1 million euro, the status of screening for vulnerable people in affected areas, and additional research funding. The minister answered that implementation was not delayed, over 1,550 applications had been received, the 15,000 euro maximum was a cautious gesture rather than damages, 1 million euro covers administration, screening details are in a separate letter with procedures still under discussion, and research funding will run through ZonMw.
As already indicated in the answers to the supplementary budget, there is no delay in setting up the implementation of the compensation scheme.
Zoals reeds aangegeven in de antwoorden bij de suppletoire begroting, is er geen sprake van vertraging bij de inrichting van de uitvoering van de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het Signalement Mondzorg 2018

An SP MP asked the minister to respond to the 2018 Dental Care Signal, which found stagnation or deterioration in oral health among young people and rising erosive tooth wear, and asked about social inequalities, evaluation of initiatives and why this monitor is being discontinued. The minister acknowledged the findings, said talks with the field will be organised by the Zorginstituut, and argued the monitor is no longer needed since the 1995 benefit change has been sufficiently evaluated.
The Zorginstituut therefore sees no reason to continue this specific monitor.
Het Zorginstituut ziet daarom geen reden meer om deze specifieke monitor voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijs van Orkambi

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the government would compel Vertex to disclose the price of Orkambi, and about the consequences of disclosure, cooperation with other countries, the link between drug prices and premiums, and whether transparency would lower costs. The Minister said the original list price is public but a confidential financial arrangement covers the actual price, that transparency is preferred but manufacturers insist on confidentiality, and that expensive drugs are a driver of rising care costs.
Although the supplier is free to be transparent about these agreements, given the confidentiality agreements I cannot force the manufacturer to make the agreements public.
Hoewel het de leverancier vrij staat transparant te zijn over deze afspraken kan ik, gegeven de afspraken over vertrouwelijkheid, de fabrikant niet dwingen de afspraken openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘St Jansdal: pas op met budgetpolis Zilveren Kruis’

MP Van Gerven asked why Zilveren Kruis excluded St Jansdal hospital for budget-policy holders in Lelystad and Harderwijk after the IJsselmeer hospitals went bankrupt, and whether affected patients can be helped. The minister replied that Zilveren Kruis has agreed to fully reimburse care at St Jansdal for 2018 and has added St Jansdal to its 2019 selected hospitals, so no one is affected.
Zilveren Kruis will inform insured persons in Lelystad with a Basis Budget policy about this by letter.
Zilveren Kruis zal verzekerden in Lelystad met een Basis Budget polis hierover per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'MST dreigt budget te overschrijden en zet deel verzekerden in de wacht'

An SP MP asks the health minister how a hospital (MST) placing some insured patients on a waiting list after exceeding its budget ceiling affects patient safety, referrals, and whether the government will investigate budget caps. The minister answers that the insurer and hospital share responsibility, urgent and oncology care continue, the IGJ sees no safety signals, and no separate investigation is planned.
No. In recent years insurers and care providers have more often disagreed about reaching a budget ceiling.
Nee. In de afgelopen jaren hebben zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders vaker meningsverschillen gehad rondom het bereiken van een budgetplafond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Zorgen om homeopathisch alternatief voor vaccineren’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports of homeopathic practitioners promoting homeopathy as a vaccination alternative, the Advertising Code Committee's complaints, and whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) can enforce against misleading claims. The State Secretary said such claims are unacceptable, outlined the IGJ's existing enforcement powers (fines, orders, penalty payments), and announced a expert team to rebut misleading vaccine information and talks with the IGJ on whether it needs more tools.
As I indicated in my letter of 19 November 2018, I will talk with the IGJ to see whether it needs more tools to address incorrect information about vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 19 november 2018 heb aangegeven ga ik met de IGJ in gesprek om te bezien of zij meer handvatten nodig hebben om onjuiste informatie over vaccineren aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Verloskundigen: er is vaak geen plek in ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the minister whether midwives' reports of frequently having no hospital bed for births are a concern, how many hospital maternity units closed or stopped offering 24/7 care, and how the problem will be solved. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the regional acute care bodies should improve coordination, cites staffing investments and states no concrete new national measure beyond existing programmes.
I have no insight into which hospitals have recently announced an admission stop.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welke ziekenhuizen de afgelopen tijd een opnamestop hebben afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over zorgondernemer, de heer Winter

SP MPs asked the health minister about the bankruptcies of hospitals run by entrepreneur Loek Winter, including calls for NZa investigation of financial constructions, conflicts of interest, WNT compliance and property profits. The minister answered that curators will investigate, that the IGJ and NZa will be asked to examine financial constructions with a letter promised by end of November, and that other questions await separate studies or are left to the curator.
Yes, as promised I will ask the IGJ and the NZa to investigate the financial constructions at the hospitals.
Ja, zoals toegezegd zal ik de IGJ en de NZa vragen om onderzoek te doen naar de financiële constructies bij de ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verkoop van alcohol aan minderjarigen

MP Van Gerven asks how online alcohol sales to minors by bol.com, Albert Heijn and Gall&Gall can be controlled, who is responsible, what penalties apply, and how the NVWA supervises online sales. The state secretary answers that enforcement lies with municipalities, that suppliers are responsible under the DHW with fines up to €2,720, that enforcement is practically hard, and that a legal amendment is being explored.
I am therefore exploring an amendment to the DHW to improve compliance with the age limit for sales via home-delivery channels and to make effective supervision possible.

Daarom ben ik bezig met het verkennen van een wetswijziging van de DHW om de naleving van de leeftijdsgrens bij verkoop via thuisbezorgkanalen te verbeteren en effectief toezicht hierop mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Gerven over het onderzoek ‘Aanwijzingen voor herkomst onbekend deel plastic soep’ uitgevoerd door het Burgercollectief Dreumelse Waard

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about a citizen-collective study tracing orange plastic waste along the Maas to the Over de Maas project, and whether polluters should pay and verondiepingsprojecten be investigated. The State Secretary acknowledged the plastic likely came from the project, said the initiator cleaned up the banks, and promised a review of the rules and supervision by the regulators, with evaluation results due end of November.
I will ask the supervisory bodies Rijkswaterstaat, the water boards and the ILT to what extent there are problems with plastics and, if so, how they act against it under the duty of care.
Ik zal aan de toezichthouders Rijkswaterstaat, de waterschappen en de ILT vragen in welke mate er problemen met plastics zijn en zo ja hoe zij hiertegen op grond van de zorgplicht optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat farmaceuten belasting ontwijken via Nederland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms such as Abbott, Johnson & Johnson, Merck and Pfizer use the Netherlands to avoid tax and whether the government will investigate this. The State Secretary of Finance answered that he cannot discuss individual companies' tax affairs, pointed to the government's anti-avoidance measures (CFC rule, conditional withholding tax, EU directives) and said no separate investigation into pharmaceutical firms is planned, though the effects of the policy will be monitored.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat volgens de artsen van het Slotervaart de patiënt wel in levensgevaar was

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care to respond to a doctor's claim that two patients at MC Slotervaart were in life-threatening danger, and why the minister had not disclosed this during the suspension. The minister replied that the hospital and inspectorate found no life-threatening situation, that a risky but not life-threatening situation occurred, and that the inspectorate visited the hospital promptly after the signals reached him.
These reports reached me during my first round in the parliamentary debate.
Deze berichten zijn mij tijdens mijn eerste termijn van het Kamerdebat ter ore gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichtgeving dat de overheid in 2016 al wist van mogelijke uitbraak meningokokkenziekte

MP Van Gerven asked why the government waited a year after signs in autumn 2016 to purchase meningococcal vaccines, and about deaths, costs, supplier dependence, RIVM independence and lessons learned. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that a combination of epidemiological trends, severity of the disease and limited vaccine supply drove the decision, that the Mexican flu evaluation did not change the process, and that the vaccination programme is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het dreigende faillissement van het MC Slotervaart en de IJsselmeerziekenhuizen in Lelystad, Emmeloord en Dronten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the imminent bankruptcy of MC Slotervaart and the IJsselmeer hospitals, including whether owners drained funds and whether the state should intervene. The minister answered that curators will investigate causes and any unlawful withdrawals, that the government is working for accessible care and a possible restart, and that bankruptcy is not a duty for insurers to prevent, while committing to a legal notification requirement for acute care closures.
It is up to the curators of both hospitals to investigate the causes behind the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de curatoren van beide ziekenhuizen om de oorzaken achter het faillissement te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Verliest Delfzijl na ziekenhuis ook huisartsenpost? Stemming onder huisartsen geeft de doorslag.’

MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that the Delfzijl GP out-of-hours post might close after the hospital, and whether residents should have a say in such decisions. The minister answered that the revised plan keeps the Delfzijl post open, that acute care provision is for providers and insurers to arrange, that a national study on GP shortages is underway, and that a draft AMvB on informing regional stakeholders is being prepared.
I consider it important that residents are well informed about changes in the care provision in the region.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat inwoners goed worden geïnformeerd over de wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de apotheker de keuze van de arts voor een bepaald medicijn negeert

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether pharmacists overriding doctors' prescriptions marked 'medical necessity' is acceptable, how this relates to a 2013 motion, whether insurers misuse preferential policy, and what will ensure doctors decide on medication. The minister acknowledged no shared understanding of 'medical necessity', announced consultation and further research, rejected the misuse claim, and promised a stakeholder meeting on 31 October.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het kankergeneesmiddel nivolumab niet langer vergoed wordt na negatief advies

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why insurers no longer reimburse nivolumab after a negative BOM oncology committee verdict for a new melanoma indication, and whether patients remain covered until end 2019. The Minister answered that nivolumab stays reimbursed for proven-effective indications, that the new melanoma indication is not proven effective and is therefore not covered, that insurers and the profession judge effectiveness, and that the Zorginstituut advises in sluis procedures.
For medicines within medical care, it is up to health insurers to determine whether care meets the state of science and practice and is therefore part of the basic package.
Voor geneesmiddelen binnen de geneeskundige zorg is het aan de zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen of zorg voldoet aan de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk en daarmee onderdeel is van het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘MammaPrint niet in basispakket’

MPs Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care why the Zorginstituut concluded that the MammaPrint test does not qualify for the basic health insurance package, despite a 2016 MINDACT trial that the questioners say shows a good survival chance for patients spared chemotherapy, and why this conclusion diverges from clinical guidelines worldwide. The Minister answered that the Zorginstituut judged the trial's randomised comparison with the standard test, found a clinically relevant chemotherapy benefit cannot be excluded, and that the Dutch standard test remains decisive, so the MammaPrint will not be reimbursed.
The Zorginstituut's position that the MammaPrint has no proven added value over the standard test is decisive, and therefore the MammaPrint does not belong in the basic package.
Het standpunt van het Zorginstituut dat de MammaPrint geen bewezen meerwaarde heeft op de standaardtest, is doorslaggevend en daarom behoort de MammaPrint niet tot basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een school een blaastest invoert voor dronken leerlingen

Two SP MPs asked the government about a school introducing voluntary breath tests for intoxicated pupils and about alcohol use among minors at school and local events. The state secretary said the school's voluntary test is its own choice, enforcement of the age limit lies with municipalities, and prevention and a national prevention accord are being pursued.
Supervision and enforcement of the 18-year age limit for alcohol sales is assigned to municipalities.
Het toezicht en de handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens van 18 jaar bij de verkoop van alcohol is belegd bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het tragische verhaal van S.Z.

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth (IGJ) would investigate the death of a young woman, S.Z., and the role of GGZ Altrecht, and what lessons could be drawn. The state secretary replied that two investigations are underway, with IGJ reviewing both and possibly launching further inquiry, but declined to discuss individual cases in parliament.
At the same time, I want to be careful about discussing individual cases in your House.
Tegelijkertijd wil ik er voor waken om individuele casuïstiek in uw Kamer te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Sluiting kinder- en kraamafdeling Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal is definitief’

An SP MP asks the health minister how the definitive closure of the children's and maternity wards in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal was decided, questioning the roles of the minister, insurers, municipalities, midwives and the inspectorate, and whether access, choice and safety are at stake. The minister replies that the decision was made by hospital group Treant after assessing options, that insurers and the NZa see no breach of the duty of care, and that the IGJ is satisfied with the stakeholders' commitments, so no intervention is planned.
For me, the quality and safety of care and the duty of care must be guaranteed above all.
Voor mij staat voorop dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg en de zorgplicht moeten zijn geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Nieuwe ouders moeten vaak kraamverzorgende delen door fors personeelstekort’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that new parents must often share a midwife-care nurse (kraamverzorgende) due to staff shortages, and whether the minimum 24 hours of postnatal care is being met. The Minister replies that no signals show the minimum is missed, that a shortage is a seasonal summer issue, and that a personnel planning study and a new collective agreement are being pursued.
There are no signals that young families are not receiving the minimum number of hours of postnatal care described in the national indication protocol.
Er zijn geen signalen dat jonge gezinnen niet het minimum aantal uren kraamzorg krijgen zoals omschreven in het Landelijk indicatieprotocol Kraamzorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Flash Glucose Monitoring

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why Flash Glucose Monitoring is not reimbursed for all diabetes patients, including those with HbA1c below 64 mmol, children aged 4 to 18 only, and the cost and scope of extending coverage. The minister refers to the Zorginstituut's standpoint, states that insured care must meet package criteria, notes that a Rondetafel working group's results are not yet available, and gives only rough cost estimates.
As the legally designated package manager, the Zorginstituut assesses where necessary whether care forms meet the package criteria.
Als wettelijk toegewezen pakketbeheerder toetst het Zorginstituut indien nodig of zorgvormen aan de pakketcriteria voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een fout in de herberekening van de eigen bijdrage

An SP MP asked the health minister about a 27-year-old care resident whose income was miscalculated by UWV, leaving him with less pocket money than the minimum, and asked how common such cases are and whether the 2,500 euro threshold for requesting a recalculation should change. The minister explained the two-year income basis, reported 5,576 approved reference-year changes in 2016, and refused to change the threshold, citing administrative burden.
The administrative burden of a reference-year change must be weighed against its effect on the current personal contribution.
De administratieve lasten van een peiljaarverlegging dienen op te wegen tegen het effect op de lopende eigen bijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het beleid van pappen en nathouden van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd bij inspecties in thuiszorginstellingen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Health Minister whether the Inspectorate's practice of 'papping en nathouden' (giving new home-care providers repeated chances to correct failings) is acceptable after a Consumentenbond study, and whether structural causes such as staff shortages lie behind the failings. The minister replied that the Inspectorate works with providers' capacity to improve, follows up with re-inspections, escalates when needed, that staff shortages are a sector-wide issue addressed by an action programme, and that the Inspectorate will increase oversight of home care and a notification duty for new providers is being legislated.
Therefore the IGJ will, this year and in the coming years too, exercise more supervision over home care.
Daarom gaat de IGJ nog dit jaar – en ook komende jaren – meer toezicht houden op de thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken'

SP MPs asked the minister about Menzis ending collective health insurance contracts for low-income residents in about 30 municipalities, affecting roughly 41,000 insured. The minister replied that municipalities and insurers are primarily responsible, that contracts are extended to 2020 in most municipalities, and that insured people remain covered and can use other arrangements.
Primarily it is the responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Bestuursvoorzitter Ton Ruikes weg bij ZGT’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the chair of Ziekenhuisgroep Twente is leaving involuntarily, whether this relates to financial mismanagement (a EUR 9.5 million overstatement), the causes of the hospital group's financial trouble, and whether the departing chair receives a golden handshake. The minister answered that the board and supervisory council are responsible, that the hospital is in a recovery plan, and that the Wet normering topinkomens applies and is enforced by CIBG.
Deliberation and decision-making on whether to continue a board member's employment is for the Supervisory Board and the person concerned.
Afweging en besluitvorming over het al dan niet continueren van het dienstverband van een bestuurder is aan de Raad van Toezicht en betrokkene zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de gemeente Bergen op Zoom intensieve contacten onderhoudt met tabaksfabrikant Philip Morris

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health whether the municipality of Bergen op Zoom's contacts with Philip Morris (lobbying, job-finding for vacant premises, alleged covert advertising) conflict with the government's WHO Framework Convention guidance on tobacco industry contacts, and who checks municipal compliance. The state secretary answered that the guidance still applies, that the municipality explained its contacts as job-retention efforts, that it published contact documents, and that municipalities are responsible for their own compliance, with a new letter to municipalities planned.
The municipal council can check how the mayor and aldermen handle this.
De Gemeenteraad kan controleren hoe het College van burgemeester en wethouders hiermee omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over Tzorg dat gedurende de zomerperiode het aantal uren huishoudelijke verzorging halveert

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that Tzorg halved home-help hours in the summer period in Breda, whether other providers did the same, and whether municipalities should reclaim unpaid funds. The minister answered that reducing support unilaterally is not allowed, that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo 2015, that he sees no reason for national investigation, and that the matter is for municipalities and the municipal council to oversee.
It is primarily for the municipal council to supervise the municipal executive on the adequate implementation of the law and municipal policy.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren op de adequate uitvoering van de wet en het gemeentelijk beleid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) door de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) gedwongen wordt de magistrale bereiding van het middel CDCA (chenodeoxy

An SP MP asks the Minister how the inspectorate (IGJ) handled the halt of compounded CDCA at Amsterdam UMC, the Belgian price comparison, the manufacturer Leadiant's pricing, and whether CDCA should move into the basic package. The Minister explains that the inspectorate acted on a enforcement request from Leadiant after tests found unknown impurities, says the inspection investigation is not finished, condemns Leadiant's pricing as socially unacceptable and plans a meeting with the company, and states that CDCA reimbursement is expected to be advised on in autumn 2018.
After consultation with the inspectorate, Amsterdam UMC stopped the compounding and supply of CDCA.
Na overleg met de inspectie is het Amsterdam UMC daarop gestopt met de bereiding en terhandstelling van CDCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de brandbrief van de FNV over de ambulancezorg

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about a FNV union letter on staff shortages in ambulance care, whether talks with regional acute care boards included unions, and why unions were not involved in a medium-care ambulance pilot. The minister answers that the pilot was not a sector-wide application, that regional ambulance services consulted their works councils, and refers to a separate letter sent to the FNV for the remaining questions.
Because it concerns a pilot and not a sector-wide application, the trade unions were not involved in carrying out this pilot.
Omdat het een pilot betreft én het niet om een sectorbrede aanvraag gaat, zijn de vakbonden niet betrokken bij de uitvoer van deze pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht 'Te weinig personeel bij zorgcentra van Liante'

SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether Zorggroep Liante asking relatives of nursing home residents to fill staffing gaps is acceptable, who is liable if something goes wrong, and how to prevent such shortages in future summers. The Minister replied that relatives would only do non-care support tasks during temporary overload, that the care organisation remains fully responsible under the Wkkgz, and listed sector programmes to address the labour shortage, though he did not confirm the shortage was larger than before.
The care institution is always ultimately responsible for the stay of and care for the residents living in the care institution.
De zorginstelling is altijd eindverantwoordelijk voor het verblijf van en de zorg voor de bewoners die in de zorginstelling verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de capaciteit in de mondzorg

An MP asked why the Capacity Body is being asked to study dental-care capacity again, when earlier reports already showed training capacity must rise, and whether the delay is a stalling tactic. The minister answered that the new study addresses quality doubts and the need to model task reallocation, starts in September 2018, and that the ministers will decide afterward, while declining to raise training places now.
There is no question of a 'delaying tactic' in the further study by the Capacity Body.
Er is bij het nader onderzoek door het Capaciteitsorgaan geen sprake van «vertragingstechniek».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dalende deelname van vrouwen aan baarmoederhalskankerscreening

The SP MP Van Gerven asks the state secretary about falling participation in cervical cancer screening, the estimated lives saved by full participation, and whether the RIVM's neutral information is appropriate. The state secretary attributes the drop partly to rollout effects, stresses women's free informed choice, promises a 2019 evaluation and study into barriers, and declines to extend the deductible waiver.
However, I consider it paramount that women make a well-considered choice about whether to participate in the population screening based on good information.
Ik vind echter voorop staan dat vrouwen op basis van goede informatie een weloverwogen keuze maken over het al dan niet deelnemen aan het bevolkingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZGT hangt aan het infuus bij de bank

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about ZiekenhuisGroep Twente's financial trouble, insurers' 20 million euro reclaim, the Supervisory Board approving accounts the auditor did not fully endorse, and whether accountability or further investigation is warranted.
