The Minister answered that the hospital bears responsibility for its finances, insurers' claims reflect agreed prepayment arrangements, the Supervisory Board assessed the matter and found no further steps needed, and he sees no reason for a further investigation.
I do not have an overview of the hospitals that exceeded their agreed budget or turnover ceilings in 2017 and as a result must repay amounts to health insurers.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de ziekenhuizen die over 2017 hun afgesproken budget- of omzetplafonds hebben overschreden en als gevolg hiervan een bedrag moeten terugbetalen aan de zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘De innige samenwerking tussen douane en tabaksindustrie’

An MP asked whether contacts between Customs and the tobacco industry, including joint discussion of smuggling detection methods, minutes kept by industry representatives, and possible hospitality at multi-day 'intelligence days', were acceptable, and why a 2011 memorandum and press release were removed from the government website. The State Secretary answered that contacts are limited to implementation matters under the 2015 protocol, that minutes will now be kept and published by Customs, that no signs of hospitality have been found, and that the removal followed the government's two-year archiving rule with the material still available in the web archive.
I have asked Customs to also always take responsibility for keeping minutes in future and to actively make them public.
Ik heb de Douane gevraagd om in de toekomst ook altijd zelf zorg te dragen voor verslaglegging en dat actief openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Minder gevallen baarmoederhalskanker voorkomen door afname vaccinaties’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that falling vaccination rates, including HPV vaccination, will prevent fewer cases of cervical cancer, and asked what measures are planned. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, opposed mandatory vaccination, pointed to existing measures and a forthcoming plan of action, and promised further information in autumn.
As I have already promised, I will inform the House in the autumn about my plan of action regarding the declining vaccination rate.
Zoals ik reeds heb toegezegd, zal ik de Tweede Kamer in het najaar informeren over mijn plan van aanpak ten aanzien van de dalende vaccinatiegraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een verslaggever van Zembla wordt aangehouden bij een lezing over een fout van het UMC Utrecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether a Zembla journalist's exclusion and arrest at a UMC Utrecht lecture on a medical error, and the hospital's earlier attempt to have a patient sign a silence agreement, were acceptable, and asked about the handling of the case and the hospital's progress on openness. The minister declined to comment on the journalist dispute, said the hospital's exclusion of one journalist is not structural, opposed silence agreements, and described the hospital's improvement measures as positive.
I refrain from commenting on both the journalist's statements and the hospital's statements.
Ik onthoud me van commentaar op zowel de verklaringen van de journalist als de verklaringen van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Sanquin een koper zoekt voor Sanquin Plasma Products (SPP)

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about reports that Sanquin is seeking a buyer for its loss-making subsidiary Sanquin Plasma Products, asking about production problems, finances, the risk of bankruptcy, safeguards for the public plasma supply, and interested parties. Minister Bruins answered that production issues are being handled under CBG risk-limiting measures, SPP closed 2017 positively, a strategic partner is sought for market consolidation, the supply is secured in a convenant, and talks with interested parties are confidential.
Since this involves a dialogue between market parties, I want to respect the confidentiality of the talks.
Aangezien het hier een dialoog tussen marktpartijen betreft wil ik de vertrouwelijkheid van de gesprekken respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Binnen vijf jaar nieuw ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about Treant's draft regional plan to concentrate acute and complex care in a new intervention centre, the 93 job losses and whether emergency, maternity and paediatric services will stay in all three hospitals. The Minister answers that hospital care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, that the draft is not yet decided, and that a decision on maternity and paediatrics has been published with a separate letter to parliament.
As you know, the organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
Zoals u weet is de organisatie van de zorg in de regio primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende verdwijning van de klinische verloskunde uit het Bethesda Ziekenhuis Hoogeveen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant's plan to close the clinical obstetrics department at Bethesda Hospital Hoogeveen due to a shortage of paediatricians, and whether the Minister would intervene. The Minister answered that the decision is a proposal referred to in a separate letter, that the responsibilities of parties are set out there, and that nationally there is no paediatrician shortage, with a regional study agreed.
Treant's intended decision has triggered many reactions.
Het voorgenomen besluit van Treant heeft veel reacties opgeroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tandartsentekort dreigt door wegblijven buitenlandse tandartsen’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that a language test for foreign-trained dentists is worsening a dentist shortage, whether the government will expand training places, and why a Panteia capacity report was not sent to parliament. The minister says the language requirement is justified, that no shortage signals exist from the inspectorate or regulator, that the final report will be sent before the summer recess, and that no additional study was started.
It is customary to send only the final report to the House.
Het is gebruikelijk slechts het eindrapport aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Zorgondernemers kunnen keer op keer failliet gaan: geen haan die er naar kraait’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether a care entrepreneur who repeatedly went bankrupt could simply found a new care company, and whether the Wtza and inspectorate powers are adequate to address this. The minister said the bankruptcy-related case is under investigation so he will not comment on it, that curators can pursue personal liability and director bans, and that the new notification obligation under the Wtza plus existing inspection and fraud-coordination tools provide sufficient instruments, while noting some enforcement gaps.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate at this stage to pass judgment on this individual case.
Ik vind het daarom niet gepast om in dit stadium uitspraak te doen over deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Menzis ziekenhuizen financiert op basis van prestatiebekostiging

SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about Menzis paying ten hospitals for cardiac procedures based on outcomes, and whether this risks patient selection, cutting complex care, and undermining collaboration. The minister defends the outcome-based contracts as rewarding quality, says safeguards against risk selection exist with monitoring by the Dutch Heart Registry, and gives no commitments beyond periodic information and monitoring.
For this reason I am making additional agreements with the NHR on how it can inform me periodically.
Daarom maak ik met de NHR aanvullende afspraken over de wijze waarop zij mij periodiek kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over jachtincidenten en het houden van een jachtdag tijdens een hardloopwedstrijd op Ameland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about hunting incidents and a hunting day held on the same day and place as a running race on Ameland, asking for overviews of accidents, a reporting duty, and possible bans. The State Secretary said the hunting day is a long-standing faunabeheer arrangement that the wildlife management unit and race organisers coordinate, that no central accident register exists, and that no reporting duty or statutory ban is currently warranted.
No central registers of hunting accidents are kept.
Er worden geen centrale registers bijgehouden van jachtongelukken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat onethische verdienmodellen van de farmaceutische industrie de prijzen voor geneesmiddelen opdrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the minister whether the price increases of four medicines bought by Essential Pharmaceuticals, which push patients into co-payments, are unethical and what can be done. The state secretary answered that price increases are legal, that the company refused to lower prices or disclose cost structures, that a maximum price has been set only for Camcolit, and that no means exist to recover costs from the manufacturer.
I cannot enforce this transparency, but it is very regrettable that Essential Pharmaceuticals has so far given no justification for the price increase
Ik kan deze transparantie niet afdwingen, maar het is zeer te betreuren dat Essential Pharmaceuticals tot op heden geen onderbouwing geeft van de prijsverhoging

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veertig Nederlanders de Amerikaanse fabrikant van Bekkenbodem- en liesbreukmatjes Johnson en Johnson voor de rechter dagen wegens blijvende schad

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the reported lawsuit by about forty patients against Johnson & Johnson over pelvic floor mesh harm, and about related issues such as compensation, implant removal, information provision and market approval. The state secretary answered that the problem is regrettable, pointed to new EU medical device rules and the Wkkgz complaints regime, rejected a dedicated compensation fund, and said existing care and reporting rules already apply.
I cannot assess whether there is a case of inadequate measures here.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of er in dit geval sprake is van inadequate maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten in Zuid-Holland korten op het pgb

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the State Secretary about reports that municipalities in South Holland cut personal budgets (pgb) for parents of seriously ill children. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Youth Act, that the ministry has checked their approach, that the region has committed to better motivation of decisions, and that a further study of pgb trends will follow.
Municipalities are responsible for the implementation of the Youth Act.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Jeugdwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de waarschuwing van 120 huisartsen voor de dreigende fusie tussen het Havenziekenhuis in Rotterdam met het IJssellandziekenhuis in Capelle aan den IJssel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether converting Havenziekenhuis Rotterdam into a polyclinic after a merger with IJsselland Ziekenhuis would reduce access to care for elderly patients, and whether the state should intervene. The minister replied that the polyclinic care continues, nearby hospitals remain accessible, the NZa and ACM will assess any merger, and the state sees no reason to intervene since care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers.
The organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of the care providers and health insurers involved.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het conflict tussen de directie en radiologen in het Zuyderlandziekenhuis in Heerlen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the conflict between the board and radiologists at Zuyderland hospital, its impact on care quality, and conflicts of interest from radiologists owning shares in a private clinic. The state secretary answered that the IGZ has no signals of compromised care quality, that the hospital is not the employer of the radiologists, and that the governance code addresses conflicts of interest, while rejecting the premise that market forces prioritise competition over care.
If the IGZ receives signals that the quality and safety of care are at stake, it will act on them directly.
Indien de IGZ signalen bereiken dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid van zorg in het geding zijn zal zij hier direct naar handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat ook Nederlandse bedrijven vlees van Braziliaanse vleessjoemelaars afnemen

An SP MP asked the Health and Economic Affairs state secretaries whether rotten meat from Brazilian firms JBS and BRF reached Dutch shops or restaurants, and what the NVWA was doing. The government replied that the NVWA found no sign of contaminated meat on the Dutch market, has rejected many shipments and intensified inspections, and will not recall products, while noting a possible import ban is among the options.
I do not have access to the administration of individual companies.
Ik heb geen inzage in de administratie van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de harde kritiek op de overgehevelde jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about harsh criticism of the decentralised youth care, including deteriorating care, rising crisis placements, regional procurement withdrawals and whether decentralisation has failed. The State Secretary rejected claims of deteriorating care, pointed to regional cooperation efforts, a pending Hospers report on crisis placements, a planned bill to enforce standard arrangements, and said a first evaluation would come in early 2018.
The bill amending the Youth Act and the Social Support Act 2015 to reduce implementation burdens, which makes this possible, goes into consultation in May 2017.

Het wetsvoorstel «wijziging van de Jeugdwet en de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 in verband met het verminderen van de uitvoeringslasten» dat dit mogelijk maakt, gaat in mei 2017 in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uit de hand gelopen pachtprijzen bij geliberaliseerde pacht en het eindeloos trage overleg over de kwestie

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rising lease prices for liberalised short-term farmland leases (managed by the Bureau Beheer Landbouwgronden and other state bodies), whether the government steers land toward short leases, and why the lease reform consultation drags on. The State Secretary largely defends the current market-based approach, says no rule forces other landlords' lease choices, promises a policy response after the mediator reports, and rejects temporary price measures for now.
I do not want to anticipate the revision of the lease system.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op de herziening van het pachtstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over bescherming van natuurgebied ’t Merske

SP MPs asked the state secretary about chicken barns planned on the Belgian side of the Mark near natural area 't Merske, including nitrogen emissions, water quality, EU Water Framework Directive effects, and buffer zones. The government replied that the province of Noord-Brabant and Brabantse Delta water board are primarily responsible, that they raised concerns with Flemish authorities leading to extra permit conditions and an agreement to inform each other earlier, and that the buffer zone motion does not apply since the area is not a Natura 2000 site.
The natural area 't Merkske is not a Natura 2000 area. Therefore the Smaling motion (parliamentary document 31 038, no. H) does not apply to this natural area.
Het natuurgebied ’t Merkske is geen Natura2000-gebied. Derhalve is de motie Smaling (Kamerstuk 31 038, nr. H ) niet van toepassing op dit natuurgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht ’11.000 handtekeningen tegen Wildlife Crime’

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about wildlife crime in the Netherlands following a broadcast and a petition, including its scale, enforcement levels, transit controls and inter-departmental coordination. The State Secretary said data on the scale of wildlife crime is lacking, that enforcement is adequately organised, that customs uses risk-based controls, and that existing training and cooperation arrangements are in place, without committing to a new programme.
I do not have figures on which animals are illegally killed or removed from nature in the Netherlands each year, or in what numbers.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welke dieren in welke aantallen jaarlijks illegaal worden omgebracht in Nederland of uit de natuur worden weggehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de fusie van ziekenhuizen in Hoogeveen en Emmen leidt tot ernstige verschraling van de zorg in Hoogeveen

MPs Voortman and Van Gerven asked whether Treant's plan to end intensive care at Bethesda Hoogeveen and Refaja Stadskanaal, keeping it only in Emmen, and related changes to emergency and obstetric care were acceptable, and what the minister would do to prevent hospitals in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal being stripped. The minister said the organisation of care is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, that emergency and obstetric care remain in place, and that she expects Treant to engage in real dialogue with the region, while declining to judge the decision itself.
The accessibility and availability of care provision is the primary responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het zorgaanbod is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die nog altijd de restitutietarieven voor niet-gecontracteerde geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz) niet bekend hebben gemaakt

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why insurers Menzis, VGZ and De Friesland had not yet published restitution tariffs for non-contracted mental health care, and whether this discouraged care and warranted enforcement. Minister Schippers attributed the delay to late NZa tariff decisions after an insurers' appeal, said the tariffs were now published, that continuity of care was not at risk, and that current rules were adequate.
The health insurers have informed me that, due to the late publication of the NZa tariffs, they were able to publish their list of maximum reimbursements for non-contracted care later than planned.

De zorgverzekeraars hebben mij laten weten dat zij door de late bekendmaking van de NZa-tarieven hun lijst met maximale vergoedingen voor niet-gecontracteerde zorg later dan gepland hebben kunnen publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de veiligheid in operatiekamers onder druk staat door een tekort aan operatieassistenten en verpleegkundigen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that operating-theatre safety is under pressure from shortages of surgical assistants and nurses, including whether non-qualified nurses perform theatre tasks, nurse sick leave, training capacity cuts and the rise of agency work. The Minister answered that staffing and safety are primarily the employers' responsibility, that the Capacity Body sees national supply as just sufficient and advises expanding training, and that she will monitor employers' efforts and act if needed.
Ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care provided in a hospital are the board members and internal supervisory directors.
Eindverantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg in een ziekenhuis zijn de bestuurders en interne toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen arme patiënten gratis overgebleven medicijnen geven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that GPs give leftover medicines free to patients who cannot afford care, and about conflicting evidence on care avoidance caused by the deductible. The Minister says the GP survey does not establish frequency, opposes handing out medicines outside the pharmacy, and argues non-financial reasons also explain care avoidance while listing existing compensation measures.
I consider it undesirable that people avoid necessary care for financial reasons.
Ik vind het ongewenst als mensen vanwege financiële redenen noodzakelijke zorg mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de door een farmaceutisch bedrijf opgezette website ‘Dokter Jaap’ dat huisartsen benadert om erectiepillen voor te schrijven

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether the website 'Dokter Jaap', set up with Eli Lilly, which approaches GPs to prescribe erectile dysfunction pills to men who left their data, is lawful and acceptable, including its unsecured email handling of health data. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ is investigating the website and its parties, that GDPR-style consent rules and medical confidentiality apply and the AP may investigate, and that she has no information on GP approaches or other similar websites.
The IGZ has informed me that it is investigating the website and the working methods of the parties involved.
De IGZ heeft mij laten weten dat zij de website en de werkwijze van de betrokken partijen onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars steeds vaker op de stoel van de arts gaan zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister whether insurers overriding specialists' referrals for rehabilitation care, and demanding medical data, breaches the insurers' duty of care and amounts to risk selection. The minister answered that insurers may check entitlement and refuse prior approval on care grounds, that complaints can go to the NZa, and that she would not intervene directly, while the NZa is responsible for enforcing the duty of care.
If a patient believes they are unjustly kept waiting, or a procedure lasts 'months' without the insurer intervening, they can report this to the NZa.
Mocht een patiënt van mening zijn dat hij onterecht moet wachten, of een procedure duurt «maandenlang» zonder dat de zorgverzekeraar ingrijpt, dan kan hij dat melden bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘Een tragische gebeurtenis in Tergooi’ van de onderzoekscommissie Meurs

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Meurs commission report on the death of a 21-year-old patient at Tergooi hospital, including whether the settlement agreement amounted to an unacceptable gag clause, whether the hospital board and IGZ bear responsibility, and whether calamity definitions and the ban on restrictive settlements should change. The minister acknowledged the agreement contained undesirable confidentiality terms, said the board is responsible for it, reported fines and a disciplinary complaint, defended the current calamity-reporting policy, and promised a letter on settlements in Q1 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tienduizenden spiraaltjes worden teruggeroepen

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the recall of tens of thousands of Mirena contraceptive coils, covering when and how the defect was found, prevention, which women are affected, and where to report problems. The minister answered that the recall was agreed with the IGZ and CBG, that at most 200 coils from the batch may be faulty, that the fabricator issued professional notices and advised echo checks for unchecked insertions, and that reporting points are available.
It cannot be said how many of the 200 possibly incorrectly assembled coils were dispensed in the Netherlands.
Het is niet te zeggen hoeveel van de 200 mogelijk verkeerd geassembleerde spiralen er in Nederland uitgegeven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how the Council of State ruling that the NZa rightly refused to disclose per-provider DIS claims data affects transparency, whether prices count as confidential business information, and whether the law should change. The Minister answered that the ruling does not stop the goal of price transparency, that the NZa is preparing a traject for public access to hospital tariffs in 2017, and that no legislative change is needed.
The ruling on DIS data on declared care products per provider does nothing to diminish the importance of increasing insight for patients and insured persons into hospital tariffs.
De uitspraak over DIS-gegevens over gedeclareerde zorgproducten per zorgaanbieder doet niets af aan het belang om voor patiënten en verzekerden inzicht in de ziekenhuistarieven te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de uitzending van Zembla waaruit blijkt dat cliënten onvoldoende gewezen worden op de risico’s bij Lasik-oogchirurgie

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister, after a Zembla broadcast, whether patients receive inadequate warnings about Lasik risks and whether clinics misleadingly market the surgery, and whether the inspectorate should intervene. The minister answered that providers must inform patients under the WGBO, that she sees no reason yet for re-evaluation or closures, and that the inspectorate will act only on signals of acute danger.
Based on this broadcast, it is insufficiently clear to me whether patients have been adequately informed.
Het is voor mij op basis van deze uitzending onvoldoende duidelijk of patiënten voldoende zijn geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat artsen vaker kiezen voor pillen van farmaceuten waarvan zij sponsorgeld ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports that doctors prescribe more expensive drugs from pharma companies that sponsor them, and whether sponsorship, visits and the Transparency Register explain this and should be restricted. The minister answered that the data cannot show extra spending or causation, leaves follow-up research to insurers, and rejects an immediate ban on sponsorship and doctor visits.
The research does not indicate how much extra money has been spent as a result.
Het onderzoek geeft niet aan hoeveel extra geld hierdoor is uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat bij het UMC Utrecht ruim anderhalf jaar lang procedurefouten zijn gemaakt bij het IVF-laboratorium

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports of over a year and a half of procedural errors at the UMC Utrecht IVF laboratory, possibly leading to 26 women being inseminated with another man's sperm, and about the inspectorate's role, support for affected couples and oversight. The minister answered that a SIRE investigation is underway, the IGZ will assess the report, affected couples have been informed and offered support, and inspection frequency and IVF laboratory checks were described.

The inspectorate's research report, which will among other things address the actions taken by both the UMC Utrecht and the IGZ to safeguard quality and patient safety requirements, is expected to be completed in March and I will then send it to your House.

Het onderzoeksrapport van de inspectie, dat onder meer in zal gaan op de acties die door zowel het UMC Utrecht als de IGZ zijn genomen om de kwaliteit en eisen voor patiëntveiligheid te borgen, wordt naar verwachting in maart afgerond en zal ik vervolgens aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen dit jaar al 304 keer melding hebben gedaan van het verlies van privacygevoelige informatie

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister how she views reports that hospitals filed 304 data-leak notifications this year and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) has been sufficiently strict in supervising them, including questions on sanctions, naming hospitals and the role of the Inspectorate. The minister answered that the AP is an independent supervisor responsible for enforcement and publication decisions, that she has no reason to think the AP neglects its role, and that the Inspectorate intervenes when patient safety is at stake, while promising a patient-data security action plan.
This is a matter for the AP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onzichtbare samenwerking van het ministerie van VWS met The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus en IQ healthcare

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the origins, costs and reporting of VWS cooperation with The Commonwealth Fund, Celsus and IQ Healthcare, including congress visits, fellowships and an ambtenaar holding a professorship. The Minister described how the Commonwealth Fund ties began in 2006, gave yearly cost tables, argued that congress visits comply with conduct rules, and declined to answer some questions on loyalty and staffing or to meet the one-week deadline.
Data on other costs associated with the cooperation with the Commonwealth Fund are not tracked separately and therefore cannot be provided.
Gegevens over overige kosten die gemoeid zijn met de samenwerking met het Commonwealth Fund worden niet apart bijgehouden en kunnen dus niet worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het inzichtelijk maken van de bij zorgverzekeraars gedeclareerde zorg in relatie tot de zorguitgaven

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister whether transparency on declared care should extend beyond the deductible, whether it serves parliament's oversight role, whether DIS data can be published in anonymised form, and how this relates to NZa pricing transparency. The minister answered that price transparency serves patients and parliament's oversight, that declared care does not equal insurers' administrative costs, that anonymised aggregated DIS data is not contrary to the Wob, and that the NZa is working towards stepwise publication of price data.
Insight into declared care has significant added value at an aggregate level for tracking developments in care expenditure, among other things for the oversight role of your House.

Inzicht in gedeclareerde zorg heeft op geaggregeerd niveau een belangrijke meerwaarde om ontwikkelingen in de zorguitgaven te kunnen volgen, onder meer met het oog op de controlerende taak van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over lip filler behandeling bij meisjes onder de 18 door ‘cosmetisch’ artsen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health about cosmetic lip filler treatment of girls under 18 and related oversight of cosmetic clinics and doctors, including complaints from plastic surgeons and the training standards dispute. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ has no reports of fillers given to under-18s, is examining the broadcast cases and calling clinics to account, and is working on quality norms and a cosmetic-doctor training curriculum with the professional bodies.
The use of mystery guests must not be deployed lightly when minors are involved, also called 'lure youngsters' in this context.
Antwoord 5 De inzet van mystery guests moet niet lichtvaardig ingezet worden, als het om een minderjarigen gaat, in dit verband ook wel «lokjongeren» genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe zorgverzekering voor ouderen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about a new VGZ insurance product for older people developed with the Nationaal Ouderenfonds and ANBO, including subsidies, commissions, advisers' fees, solidarity concerns and transparency of intermediary payments. The minister answered that it is a collective arrangement on existing policies rather than a new insurer, that the organisations receive no commission from VGZ, and that transparency of intermediary remuneration should improve.
I have no insight into the subsidies these older-persons organisations receive from other governments.
Ik heb geen zicht op de subsidies die deze ouderenorganisaties van andere overheden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over reclame van zorgverzekeraars die zich via direct mailings richt op mensen met een hoog inkomen of opleidingsniveau

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Promovendum (part of VGZ) targets higher-educated and higher-income people through direct mailings, which they argued amounts to risk selection, and what criteria and costs apply. The minister answered that the mailings are legal, that Promovendum now omits the 'higher educated' target label, that the NZa will be asked to examine the practice, and that the requested client data is commercially confidential.
This is commercially confidential information that I do not have in my possession.
Dit is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die ik niet in bezit heb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het commerciële tv-programma "een nieuw begin"?

SP MPs asked the Health and Culture ministers about the commercial TV programme 'een nieuw begin', which allegedly pressed participants into unnecessary cosmetic and dental treatments, and whether clinics and the Inspectorate had acted. The minister called it a worrying signal, said patient consent and information duties apply, noted the Inspectorate had no complaints about the programme and was investigating CDC Tandzorg on unrelated complaints, and said RTL and producers bear responsibility and will be reviewed.
The Inspectorate cannot make any statements about the nature of the ongoing investigation.
Over de aard van het lopende onderzoek kan de Inspectie geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de uitzending van Rambam met als onderwerp dokteronline.nl

SP MPs asked the health minister about a broadcast on dokteronline.com, a Curaçao-based site selling prescription medicines without a doctor visit, and whether her 2010 warning about online sales still stands and what concrete measures she has taken. The minister confirmed the warning, listed the 2011 law changes, notice-and-takedown agreements, the EU logo scheme and campaigns, and said the Inspectorate can act only against Dutch-based practitioners, so it is contacting Curaçao and foreign authorities.
As far as the IGZ is aware, Dokteronline.com no longer has any BIG-registered doctors or pharmacists working from the Netherlands.
Zover bekend bij de IGZ, zijn er bij Dokteronline.com geen artsen of apothekers meer werkzaam die BIG-geregistreerd zijn en vanuit Nederland werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ prostaatkankerzorg wil concentreren in Rotterdam en Nijmegen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether health insurer CZ's plan to concentrate prostate cancer care in Rotterdam and Nijmegen was desirable, and about the wider concentration of care and quality norms. The minister answered that concentration can improve quality, that insurers make their own purchasing policy, that the Zorginstituut has no coordinating role, and that she sees no reason to address CZ.
The Zorginstituut currently has no task, and therefore no powers, to coordinate such a concentration.
Het Zorginstituut heeft op dit moment geen taak, en dus ook geen bevoegdheden, om een dergelijke concentratie te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over hormoonverstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked whether the government should follow France by banning BPA in packaging and DEHP in neonatal and maternity medical devices, and whether a national biomonitoring system for hormone-disrupting substances should be set up. The minister answered that a ban is not appropriate because safer alternatives are not proven, that exposure of vulnerable groups is being reduced through talks with stakeholders, and that the RIVM participates in the European HBM4EU biomonitoring project.
A ban does not deserve to be followed, because manufacturers would then be forced to use alternatives in their products whose safety has not been well investigated.
Een verbod verdient geen navolging, omdat fabrikanten dan worden gedwongen alternatieven te gebruiken in hun producten, waarvan de veiligheid niet goed is onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de schier eindeloze nasleep van de calamiteit in mei 2007 in het Universitair Medisch Centrum Groningen (UMC Groningen), waarbij Jelmer Mulder buitengewoon ernstige en onherste

MP Leijten and Van Gerven ask the ministers about the long-running legal dispute after the 2007 UMC Groningen calamity that left baby Jelmer Mulder with severe brain damage, questioning the IGZ's handling, the hospital's conduct in court, and whether the minister can direct the hospital to settle. The minister replies that the IGZ report cannot be published, that the IGZ has apologised and offered compensation, that civil liability is for the civil court, and that the IGZ cannot use its Wkkgz instruction power to force settlement of a civil claim.
The IGZ report of 14 July 2011, as well as the IGZ report of 6 December 2010 withdrawn by the IGZ, is not public.
Het rapport van de IGZ van 14 juli 2011, evenals het door de IGZ ingetrokken rapport d.d. 6 december 2010, is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het te vaak urgent uitrukken van ambulances door een nieuw triagesysteem

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about a survey claiming a new triage system leads to too many urgent ambulance dispatches, with possible harm and accident risks, and about insurers' duty of care. The minister acknowledged signals of unnecessary urgent rides but reported no evidence of patient harm, said accident data are not registered nationally and that a limited study and evaluations are pending, and promised to decide on changes after those evaluations.
Accidents involving ambulances are currently not registered nationally.
Ongevallen met ambulances worden op dit moment niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de relatie tussen The Commonwealth Fund, The Harkness Fellowship, onderzoeksprogramma Celsus, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc en haar ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the links between the Commonwealth Fund, the Harkness Fellowship, the Celsus programme, IQ healthcare, Radboud umc and the ministry, including whether the ministry's funding and staff involvement compromise independence. The minister replied that the ministry's participation is a shared-cost survey and fellowship arrangement, that selection is run by an independent committee, and that there is no risk of influence on outcomes.
I have no insight into the financing and bookkeeping of IQ Healthcare.
Ik heb geen zicht op financiering en boekhouding van IQ Healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er namens de Stichting Rookpreventie Jeugd aangifte is gedaan tegen vier tabaksfabrikanten die actief zijn in Nederland

An SP MP asked the government to respond to a report that criminal complaints were filed against four tobacco manufacturers, and about laser-perforated filters and TNCO measurement gaps versus real consumer exposure. The State Secretary said the Openbaar Ministerie assesses the complaint, the NVWA is the competent supervisor and will keep enforcing the ISO method until a new one is adopted, and he will raise validated methods at EU level.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess the complaint.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om de aangifte te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het melden en onafhankelijk onderzoeken van calamiteiten bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister why a maternal death at the Diakonessenhuis was not reported as a calamity and whether the external investigator's conduct and the IGZ's handling were sound. The minister acknowledged the failure, said the IGZ found the first investigation not carefully conducted and ordered a new one, but refused to publish the final IGZ report, declined to re-examine other cases, and promised a circular on calamity reporting.
Until then, the IGZ does not make individual calamity reports and reports public for the time being.
Totdat hiervan sprake is maakt de IGZ afzonderlijke calamiteitenmeldingen en -rapportages vooralsnog niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het verstrekken van viskweeksubsidies die concurreren met bestaande economische activiteiten en het manipuleren van een LEI-rapport

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about internal ministry emails showing directed edits to a LEI report, subsidies for fish farming that may compete with existing firms, and a subsidy for the Claresse fish. The State Secretary answered that the emails are internal, the LEI has an integrity inquiry pending, subsidy conditions were not tailored to one firm, and that no recovery was pursued without fully explaining why beyond the earlier answers.
I am awaiting the outcome of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slachtoffers van Q-koorts

An MP asks the government whether it will compensate Q-fever victims, cites the sector's responsibility, asks for death and chronic illness figures, and questions a planned 5,000-goat stable in Maasdriel. The minister refuses individual compensation, points to the Q-support foundation, gives case figures and dispersion and emission data, and defers liability questions to the courts and the municipality.
This case is before the court. Your question on liability cannot be answered by us.
Deze zaak is onder de rechter. Uw vraag over aansprakelijkheid kan niet door ons worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de patiëntenstop van het Nij Smellinghe

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the patient admission stop at Nij Smellinghe hospital, its effect on waiting times and travel costs, insurer responsibility, and patient choice under restitution policies. The minister answered that the hospital has not stopped all work, that insurers bear duty of care enforced by the NZa, and that restitution rules are being tightened from 2017.
The NZa supervises that insurers, for insured persons unwilling to wait longer than these standard times, mediate in finding other care providers who can deliver care within the set standard times.

De NZa ziet er op toe dat zorgverzekeraars, voor die verzekerden die niet langer willen wachten dan deze normtijden, bemiddelen bij het vinden van andere zorgaanbieders die wel binnen de gestelde normtijden zorg kunnen verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de belasting van huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about GP workload, administrative burden, burnout, practice size norms and training capacity after a Leiden GP quit filling in insurer checklists. The Minister replied that bureaucracy has been reduced through the 'Het Roer Gaat Om' process, that she has no data on GPs leaving practice, and that she sees no need for further measures, while promising a monitor and a capacity forecast.
I do not know how many GPs leave their work early, or for what reason.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel huisartsen vroegtijdig stoppen met hun werk en met welke reden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZBC’s ontduiken verbod winstuitkering’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether standalone treatment centres evade the ban on profit distribution and good-governance rules through BV structures and direct contracting, and whether investigations or new rules would follow. The minister replied that outsourcing is permitted, that the IGZ and NZa supervise compliance and can intervene case by case, and that she sees no need for her own investigation or for banning outsourcing to subsidiaries.
Supervision of compliance with the profit-making ban rests with the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Het toezicht op de naleving van het verbod op winstoogmerk is neergelegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onterechte suggestie dat fysiotherapie van mensen in de aanvullende verzekering vergoed is

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether insurers forcing physiotherapists to treat patients less than covered, via the behandelindex, is acceptable and whether it breaches the insurer's duty of care. Minister Schippers answered that treatment numbers are for the professional to judge, that the behandelindex is a benchmark used as mirror information (with some insurers linking it to contracts in exceptional cases), and promised to raise its use with stakeholders.
It cannot be the case that a care provider stops a necessary treatment for financial motives.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat een zorgverlener uit financiële motieven een noodzakelijke behandeling stopzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van vaccinaties bij kinderen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister why a nine-year-old disabled boy's vaccination was not reimbursed when it had to take place away from the planned location, and whether exceptions exist. The minister acknowledged poor communication in that case, said vaccination is always free with alternative locations or home visits, and estimated such exceptions occur only a few dozen times a year.
I have taken note of the report and regrettably must note that communication in this situation did not go well.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de melding en moet helaas constateren dat de communicatie in deze situatie niet goed is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de noodkreet over de nieuwe contracteerronde fysiotherapie

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a physiotherapists' distress call on the 2017 contracting round, including opaque use of the treatment index, quality-measurement conditions, benchmarks, below-cost tariffs, and third-party access to patient records. Minister Schippers answered at length, largely deferring to private insurer-provider negotiations, noting NZa oversight, transparency rules, and ongoing working-group and monitoring initiatives, while committing to follow-up but not to new binding action.
The contract terms form part of a contract between two private parties, to which the NZa does not automatically have access.
De contractvoorwaarden maken onderdeel uit van een contract tussen twee private partijen, hier heeft de NZa niet zonder meer inzage in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat een ruzie tussen verschillende trombosediensten de patiënten zou duperen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that a dispute between thrombosis services endangers patients, and about the safety, evidence and prescribing of newer anticoagulants (NOACs) versus traditional ones. The Minister denied any signals of patient harm or calamities, reported that the Medicines Evaluation Board judges the NOACs' benefit-risk balance positive, and said further research and monitoring are under way.
I currently have no signals that patient safety or the quality of care is at stake.
Ik heb nu geen signalen dat de patiëntveiligheid of de kwaliteit van zorg in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het nog steeds couperen van paardenstaarten ondanks het verbod sinds 2001

An SP MP asked why horses with docked tails still appear at national exhibitions despite the 2001 ban, and asked about inspection, enforcement, and whether the KVTH breed association can exclude docked horses in its rules. The state secretary answered that enforcement responsibility and proof of veterinary necessity apply, that the KVTH may exclude docked horses in its rules, and that the matter is in progress via earlier answers.
I refer you to my answer to the question earlier asked by member Wassenberg, question 4.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn antwoord op de eerder door het lid Wassenberg gestelde vraag 4
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Het kabinet verrekent zich met toestroom Wlz’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether the government would respond to a report by Bureau HHM showing possible shifts into the Wlz long-term care scheme, with 5% more older clients and 13% more disabled clients, and whether this implies extra budget. The state secretary answered that the figures are theoretical maximum shifts, that actual uptake is being monitored by CBS, that the NZa advises on budget adequacy, and that no extra budget is needed based on this report.
Within that perspective the research mapped what the maximum shifts are in theory.
Het onderzoek heeft binnen dat perspectief in kaart gebracht wat theoretisch gezien de maximale verschuivingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het twittergedrag van het ministerie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why the ministry tweeted five corrective 'facts' after a Buitenhof broadcast on health costs, questioning the sourcing, selected years and the claim that patients get more care for their premium. The minister defended the tweets as correcting incorrect information, gave the requested figures and sources, and said the ministry aims for adequate and correct information.
The ministry considers itself called upon to communicate facts when incorrect information is circulating, and not to enter into discussion for reasons of purity.
Het ministerie acht zich geroepen om als er niet-correcte informatie rondgaat feiten te communiceren, en om uit oogpunt van zuiverheid niet in discussie te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het schildkliergeneesmiddel Thyrax niet per september weer beschikbaar is, maar pas in het tweede kwartaal van 2017

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether the government would act against manufacturer Aspen after the thyroid drug Thyrax was delayed until Q2 2017, including whether to compensate patients and tighten the supply obligation. The minister said the government will neither recover nor compensate patient costs, pointed to existing enforcement and her pharmaceutical vision, and declined to introduce a supply obligation, arguing the IGZ investigation covered only the earlier shortage.
The recent Aspen announcement about being unable to supply Thyrax for longer has no influence on the conclusions of that investigation.
Het recente bericht van Aspen over het nog langer niet kunnen leveren van Thyrax heeft op de conclusies van dat onderzoek geen invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het door apothekers zelf bereiden en doorleveren van geneesmiddelen indien die niet in Nederland worden geproduceerd

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the new IGZ circular allowing pharmacists to supply their own preparations to other pharmacies when manufacturers stop production, and about shortages, price increases and industry influence. The minister defended the circular as a narrow, case-by-case non-enforcement framework, noted alternatives exist for Thyrax, said the circular does not address prices, and explained the IGZ consulted stakeholders.
For that reason the IGZ does not enforce when the restrictive conditions described in the circular are met.
Om die reden treedt de IGZ niet-handhavend op wanneer aan de in de circulaire beschreven restrictieve voorwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de brandbrief van de gemeente Den Helder over het verdwijnen van cardiologie uit het Gemini Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a letter from Den Helder municipality opposing the concentration of complex cardiology care in Alkmaar, which they feared would dismantle Gemini Hospital, and asked about insurer VGZ's role, the risk of hospital mergers and whether a merger ban should be imposed. The minister replied that only complex multi-day cardiology is concentrated, that location decisions are for providers and insurers supervised by the IGZ and NZa, that VGZ will evaluate the profile, and that a general merger ban is not desirable, pointing instead to existing merger and competition tests.
A general merger ban is therefore not desirable.
Een algeheel fusieverbod is daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een van corruptie en valsheid in geschrifte verdachte ziekenhuisdirecteur

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about reports that a hospital director responsible for building the Prinses Máxima Centrum was arrested on suspicion of corruption and forgery at his previous hospital, and whether the Centre's supervisory board checked his background. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and gave no details, that the Centre's own review found no irregularities in the tender, and that the Centre did check with his former employer and saw no reason to revise the appointment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Curator: ‘Wmo klopt gewoon niet’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about a curator's claim that the Wmo does not work, the bankruptcies of Thuiszorg Noord-Holland and Stichting ZorgBedrijf, care-worker pay, and tariffs. The state secretary answered that the curator explained his views, that continuity of care and working conditions were secured through takeovers, that causes await the bankruptcy report, and that he has no overview of other home-care bankruptcies; he referred to a draft decree on a realistic price and to earlier agreements with unions and VNG.
For the answer to your question about the precise reasons for the bankruptcy, the bankruptcy report must be awaited.
Voor het antwoord op uw vraag naar de precieze redenen van het faillissement moet het faillissementsverslag worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Sionsberg in Dokkum wankelt door ruzie met zorgverzekeraar De Friesland-Achmea

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that hospital De Sionsberg in Dokkum is at risk after insurer De Friesland-Achmea terminated its contract, and whether the insurer is meeting its duty of care amid rising waiting lists. The minister said she has urged the parties to find a solution, asked the NZa and IGZ to examine the insurer's duty of care and care quality, and stated that good accessible care in Dokkum must be guaranteed, though she declined to judge whether a breach of contract occurred.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ruim een half miljoen hartpatiënten problemen hebben omdat ze goedkopere medicijnen slikken

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she responds to reports that over half a million heart patients have problems from switching to cheaper medicines, whether the ministry knew of NIVEL research on this, and what the hidden costs and health risks of preferential drug policy are. The minister argues the survey shows mainly information gaps, says no research on costs or health risks of preferential policy exists and sees no need for it, and states switching generics is desirable for affordability while pointing to prescribers and pharmacists for patient guidance.
I see no reason at this moment to conduct research specifically into preferential policy.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om onderzoek specifiek naar preferentiebeleid te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat tientallen ouderen die in een huis van Florence wonen verplicht moeten verhuizen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that dozens of elderly residents of a Florence care home must move, including sixteen forced to relocate, and about related job losses and care-allocation choices. The state secretary replied that the move reflects a shift towards care at home and that the relocations are a matter for the care provider and the zorgkantoor, with the IGZ monitoring quality and safety rather than placement decisions.
It is up to the care provider to make decisions in this regard and up to the IGZ to supervise them.
Het is aan de zorgaanbieder om daarin beslissingen te nemen en aan de IGZ om daarop toezicht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het mogelijke faillissement van thuiszorgorganisatie Solace ATC Thuiszorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Solace ATC, its debts, municipal cuts to care hours, transfer of clients and staff, and possible director liability. The State Secretary answered that the bankruptcy curator is responsible for investigating causes, has selected Tzorg as successor provider, and that such questions fall to the curator and courts, so he will not start his own investigation.
It is for the judge to assess whether the board members and supervisors involved are held personally liable for the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de betrokken bestuurders en toezichthouders persoonlijk aansprakelijk gesteld worden voor het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de budgetten van wijkverpleging nu al uitgeput zijn

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that home-nursing (wijkverpleging) budgets were already exhausted, including claims that insurers were deliberately limiting contracting and clawing back funds. The state secretary said there were no indications the national budget was insufficient, pointed to extra funding and insurers' duty of care, and referred contracting disputes to negotiation and the new dispute body.
I have no insight into data at the level of individual care providers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in gegevens op het niveau van zorgaanbieders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet kunnen krijgen van een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) via de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) bij een persoonlijk faillissement van één van de ouders

Two SP MPs asked why a 14-year-old's personal budget (pgb) was refused and whether the SVB-managed scheme and the care office meet their duty of care when a parent is bankrupt, and whether the rule is still needed and how many similar cases exist. The State Secretary says a suitable solution was found with the mother, that the rule on bankruptcy stays as a safeguard, that the NZa supervises the care office, and that no broader investigation is needed.
The care office, given the specific circumstances and from the standpoint of its duty of care, has now reached a solution that, as I understand it, is suitable for all parties.
Het zorgkantoor is, gelet op de specifieke omstandigheden en vanuit het oogpunt van de zorgplicht, inmiddels met een, naar ik heb vernomen, voor alle partijen passende oplossing gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Nederlanders schrikbarend lang stilzitten

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Social Affairs ministers about reports that Dutch people, especially young people, sit for very long periods and move too little, and whether sitting should be treated as a health threat. Minister Schippers answered that sitting time is linked to health risks, that causes are not well studied, and that existing programmes (Gezonde School, Alles is Gezondheid, Arbo rules) and a pending Health Council advice will be used, without committing to a new sitting norm.
I expect this overview by the end of 2016.
Ik verwacht dit overzicht voor eind 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuisbestuurders een calamiteitenrapport herschrijven voordat het naar de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) gaat

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about reports that hospital boards rewrite incident reports before they go to the Health Inspectorate (IGZ), and how the inspectorate's risk-based oversight and incident handling work. The Minister replied that boards are responsible for investigating calamities, that the IGZ intervenes when reports conceal causes, and that it does not keep a list of rewritten reports, while rejecting a culture of concealment and offering no new 24-hour investigation team.
When the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) finds that board members conceal the main causes of a calamity in an incident report to prevent reputational damage, it intervenes.

Wanneer de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) erachter komt dat bestuurders hoofdoorzaken van een calamiteit in een calamiteitenrapport verhullen om reputatieschade te voorkomen, dan grijpt zij in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Selectiecriteria geven duidelijkheid over deelname aan ketenzorg

SP MPs asked the Health Minister about criteria for chronic-care programme participation, the VGZ insurer's handling of primary care contracting, and whether insurers abuse market power. The minister answered that inclusion/exclusion criteria were agreed jointly to improve clarity, add no administrative burden, and that disputes can go to an independent dispute body while the NZa and ACM handle complaints.
It is for the ACM to handle individual complaints reported to them.
Het is aan de ACM om individuele klachten die bij hen gemeld worden, te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht «EU raadt beperkt gebruik glyfosaat aan in speeltuinen»

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether glyphosate use in playgrounds and recreation or sports fields should be banned or accompanied by protective measures, given the WHO classification as probably carcinogenic. The government answered that professional use on hard surfaces outside agriculture has been banned, that Green Deals aim to phase out pesticides on sports and recreation fields, and that the regulator considers glyphosate use on playgrounds safe for children, so no ban is planned.
The Ctgb has further informed me that the use of glyphosate on sports fields and in playgrounds has been assessed as safe for children.
Het Ctgb heeft mij daarnaast laten weten dat het gebruik van glyfosaat op sportvelden en in speeltuinen als veilig voor kinderen is beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de facelift met draadjes verboden moet worden

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the government would ban threadlifts after plastic surgeons warned that the procedure is misleading, often done by untrained doctors in non-sterile settings, and uses materials linked to banned fillers. The minister replied that the IGZ has received no complaints, that the claims are not substantiated enough to act on, and that a ban would need concrete evidence, while promising to act if complaints or calamities arise.
If calamities occur or the NVPC believes based on research that threadlifts unnecessarily harm patients' health, they can report this to the IGZ.
Als zich calamiteiten voordoen of de NVPC meent op basis van onderzoek dat draadlifts onnodig schadelijke gevolgen hebben voor de gezondheid van patiënten, dan kunnen zij dit melden bij de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar het mijden van zorg vanwege eigen bijdragen Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo) flink vertraagd is

Two SP MPs asked why the CBS study on whether people avoid Wmo care because of co-payments was delayed and whether the research will answer that question. The Staatssecretaris explained the delay (data not yet ready for tables, final results expected November 2016), said supplementary qualitative research on avoidance has been commissioned, and declined to suspend co-payments before the results are in.
Additional research has been commissioned into undesired avoidance of care and co-payments.
Er is aanvullend onderzoek uitgezet naar ongewenste zorgmijding en eigen bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht Meander MC laat verzekerden VGZ langer wachten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital Meander MC making insured patients of insurer VGZ wait longer after exceeding a contracted budget ceiling. The minister says the hospital and insurer disagree, that acute care remains available to all, and that the parties should resolve the dispute, with the independent dispute body available if needed.
I regret that these citizens are being harmed by a dispute between a hospital and an insurer.
Ik betreur het dat deze burgers gedupeerd worden door een geschil tussen een ziekenhuis en een verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet openbaar maken van het Thyrax rapport door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why the Inspectorate has not yet published its report on the Thyrax shortage, who objected to publication, and how often publication of inspection reports is contested. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate intends to publish, that a concerned party has objected and the objection is being weighed under the Wob, and that sixteen objections were raised in 2016 so far.
The inspectorate intends to make this report public.
De inspectie is voornemens dit rapport openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de fusie tussen Achterhoekse ziekenhuizen accordeert.

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the NZa's approval of the merger of two Achterhoek hospitals, including effects on care, staff, patients, the reasons for merging, the future of the Winterswijk hospital, choice for patients, and the number of merger approvals and rejections. The minister answered that the competition authority ACM must assess the merger under competition law, that the NZa found continuity of crucial care safeguarded, that the Winterswijk hospital remains sensitive for emergency and acute obstetric care, and that she leaves merger decisions to the independent regulators.
Should the merger go ahead definitively, it is up to the board to provide clarity on how they intend to give substance to the merger and what the consequences are.
Mocht de fusie definitief doorgaan, dan is het aan het bestuur om duidelijkheid te geven over hoe zij invulling willen geven aan de fusie en wat de gevolgen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat drie kankerpatiënten onder verdachte omstandigheden zijn overleden na behandeling in een alternatieve kankerkliniek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that three cancer patients died after treatment at a German alternative cancer clinic, including whether Dutch patients were affected, whether the clinic should be closed, how oversight of alternative healers works, and whether insurers reimburse such treatment. The minister answered that the German authorities are investigating with Dutch support, that the Dutch inspectorate has contacted patients, that the clinic has halted operations, and that foreign oversight and insurance coverage fall outside her direct responsibility.
While this German investigation is ongoing, I cannot inform you further about the content of the case.
Lopende dit Duitse onderzoek kan ik u niet nader over de inhoud van de zaak informeren.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgkosten juist zullen stijgen door het openbaar maken van tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether publishing hospital tariffs would raise care costs, whether published prices reflect real costs and quality, and whether patients can meaningfully choose providers. Minister Schippers replied that she supports transparency on costs and quality, argues price transparency is unlikely to raise prices, promises to report on an October expert meeting, and defends the current performance-based payment system.
The Ministry of Health is organising a meeting with experts on this subject in October.
Het Ministerie van VWS organiseert in oktober een bijeenkomst met experts op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat veel palliatieve zorg in ziekenhuizen niet wordt vergoed door fouten in de bekostigingssystematiek

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether hospitals are not reimbursed for palliative care due to flaws in the DBC funding system, and why some hospitals have stopped providing it. The minister replied that palliative care can be reimbursed through a palliative care team with a different specialist opening the palliative DBC, that the NZa is running an inventory with results due in January 2017 and changes for 2018, and that the current DBC system functions with problems addressed where they exist.
The NZa has concluded that there are currently bottlenecks in the funding of palliative care throughout the entire chain.
De NZa heeft geconcludeerd dat er momenteel in de bekostiging van palliatieve zorg in de gehele keten knelpunten zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de ophanden zijnde sluiting van het Psycho Trauma Centrum (PTC) van Rivierduinen in Leiden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the Psycho Trauma Centre at Rivierduinen in Leiden, its reasons, alternatives for patients, waiting lists, job losses and worker participation. The minister answered that psychotrauma treatment remains available but shifts to outpatient care for patients, that the provider decides organisation and content, and that individual arrangements are made for current patients.
How this is given organisational or care-content shape is not up to me.
Hoe daar organisatorisch of zorginhoudelijk invulling aan wordt gegeven, is niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht “Twee miljoen voor in opspraak geraakte oud-Achmea-bestuurder”

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about severance and salary payments to former Achmea board members, one linked to a fraud case, and whether public money is involved. The minister replied that the pay complied with WNT rules, that the members were not responsible for care activities, that a court has ordered the conditional severance paid, and that individual pay judgements are left to the institutions.
The Cabinet wants socially acceptable incomes for care executives and for executives of health insurers.
Het Kabinet wil maatschappelijk acceptabele inkomens voor zorgbestuurders en bestuurders van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ‘grote schade door hagel Zuid-Oost Brabant’

MP Van Gerven asked about the government's response to hail and storm damage in south-east Brabant, including coordination with insurers, asbestos clean-up, solar panel schemes, declaring a disaster area, and hardship cases. The Secretary of State answered that a national working group with the province, municipalities, insurers and ministries is addressing the damage, refers to earlier letters for progress, notes that the disaster compensation law does not apply, and says hardship cases are handled case by case.
Although this situation is far-reaching for the entrepreneurs involved, the Disaster Damage Compensation Act does not apply.
Hoewel deze situatie ingrijpend is voor betrokken ondernemers, is de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de contracten van bestuurders

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether board members of Amstelring, a care provider under intensified inspection, with a 111% employment factor comply with the WNT pay cap and whether this is acceptable. The state secretary answered that no WNT breach occurred since actual pay stays under the maximum, that the accountant checks the hours arrangement, and that CIBG monitors compliance and will enforce where needed.
In this case there is no violation of the WNT.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van overtreding van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht "Top slechte verpleeghuizen verdient meer dan de norm"

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why directors of poorly rated nursing homes earn above the Balkenende norm, and how this fits with claims that high pay attracts the best managers. The State Secretary replied that supervisory boards must set appropriate pay within the WNT limits, that transitional rules apply, and that he supports self-reflection and accreditation for care governors.
Within the limits set by the WNT, it is up to the internal supervisors to determine what an appropriate remuneration is for the director(s) concerned.
Binnen de grenzen die de WNT stelt, is het aan de interne toezichthouders om te bepalen wat een passende beloning voor de betrokken bestuurder(s) is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over ongekend hoge declaraties van een zorginstelling

An MP asked the state secretary whether a care provider's billing for a terminal patient's home care, which the family calculated at very high hourly rates, was justified. The government replied that the family misread five-minute billing units as minutes, that the rates are within the contractual and NZa maximum tariffs, and that the billings are considered justified.

Based on the data supplied for assessing this case by the health insurer, the Netherlands Care Authority (NZa) and the care institution itself, it can be concluded that the institution's billing behaviour is justified.

Op basis van de gegevens die voor beoordeling van deze casus zijn aangeleverd door de zorgverzekeraar, Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de zorginstelling zelf, kan worden geconcludeerd dat het declaratiegedrag van de zorginstelling gerechtvaardigd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat twee apen geëuthanaseerd zullen worden na afloop van de dierproef

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether two research monkeys at Radboud University face euthanasia after an animal experiment and whether they could be rehomed, and raised related questions on water restriction, rehoming costs and the rationale for ape research. The State Secretary replied that no decision has been taken, rehoming is for the licence holder to decide, the NCad advice and a Code of Practice on rehoming are being implemented, and funding for rehoming and alternatives is being arranged.
The decision on whether a former laboratory animal is eligible for rehoming or adoption is taken by the licence-holding institution.
De beslissing of een voormalig proefdier in aanmerking komt voor herplaatsing/adoptie wordt genomen door de vergunninghoudende instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het nieuwe bevolkingsonderzoek 108 kankergevallen voorkomt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that the new cervical cancer screening would prevent 108 cancer cases, and about the discrepancy with earlier figures, the reliability of self-sampling, cost effects, and conflicts of interest of a researcher (Meijer) involved in the screening. The Minister explained the differing figures stem from different sources and modelling assumptions, pointed to ongoing cost-effectiveness and IMPROVE studies, declined to comment on the integrity committee's conclusions (leaving that to VUmc), and said the Health Inspectorate sees no reason for an investigation into conflicts of interest but will examine whether patient material was used without proper consent.
I leave the judgment on this to the Scientific Integrity Committee of VU-VUMC.
Ik laat het oordeel hierover aan de Wetenschappelijke Commissie Integriteit van VU-VUMC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de farmaceutische industrie artsen betaalt via een sluiproute

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms pay doctors via commercial education bureaus outside the Transparantieregister Zorg, and what should be done. Minister Schippers answered that such payments should be reported where the company knows of or influences the doctor's engagement, that self-regulation through the CGR code is relied upon, and that she sees no reason yet to make participation legally mandatory.
I do not have the data to make such an estimate.
Ik beschik niet over de gegevens om een dergelijke inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het oordeel van de IGZ inzake het mensgebonden onderzoek bij psychiatrische patiënten bij GGZ NHN

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the Health Inspectorate's (IGZ) handling of a human-subject drug study with psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, including whether the report and whistleblower treatment would be made public and whether violations were reported to the prosecutor. The minister declined to release the report because affected parties must first be consulted, said the case was passed to the Public Prosecution Service, and stated that the IGZ found no direct patient harm while acknowledging shortcomings.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Voorkomen van infecties in ziekenhuizen kan echt nog beter’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister how she will respond to an IGZ report finding that hospitals still fall short on infection prevention and to a TV report on dirty hospital conditions, and whether the IGZ should take stronger action. The minister acknowledges the shortcomings, says hospitals bear primary responsibility, states the IGZ will continue supervision and follow up, and points to a network-based antibiotic resistance policy with a 50% reduction target.
The IGZ will continue its supervision of the visited hospitals until they have improved sufficiently.
De IGZ zal haar toezicht bij de bezochte ziekenhuizen voortzetten tot zij voldoende verbeterd zijn.
