Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over nader onderzoek naar het verband tussen het gebruik van bepaalde medicijnen en agressie

Two MPs from the SP asked the Justice and Health ministers about research into links between antidepressant or benzodiazepine use and aggression, the Public Prosecution Service's stance on such research, and whether suspects should be tested for medication. The minister replied that pharmacovigilance via Lareb and the CBG already handles side-effect reporting, that no legal basis for mandatory blood tests of suspects should be created, and pointed to ZonMw research funding.
At present there is no legal basis for taking blood samples from suspects after a (violent) offence to determine whether medication has been used.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke grondslag om na een (gewelds)delict bloedmonsters af te nemen bij verdachten om te achterhalen of er sprake is van gebruik van geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat artsen en zorginstellingen meer sponsorgeld krijgen van de farmaceutische industrie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that pharmaceutical sponsorship of doctors and care institutions rose 36% per the Transparency Register, and whether this threatens independent prescribing and patient organisations. The Minister answered that self-regulation applies, the increase reflects more reporting obligations, safeguards exist for patient organisations, and the Inspectorate will examine high payments for unlawful benefits.
It is up to the IGZ to determine whether there is unlawful benefit.
Het is aan de IGZ om te bepalen of hier sprake is van ongeoorloofd gunstbetoon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het in opdracht van de Amerikaanse farmaceutische industrie uitgevoerde onderzoek naar de machtsverhoudingen binnen het Nederlandse zorgstelsel

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about an Erasmus University study commissioned by AmCham's pharmaceutical arm on power relations in the Dutch healthcare system, including who paid, whether it was appropriate given industry influence, and the conduct of officials and the NPCF at an AmCham forum. The minister answered that parties may freely contract such research within legal limits, that the payment is a matter between the parties, that the study's conclusions are not endorsed as a formal policy position, and that regulators (NZa, ACM) must assess individual cases.
I am not aware of what was paid for the research. That is part of the agreement between the parties themselves.
Het is mij niet bekend wat is betaald voor het onderzoek. Dat is onderdeel van de overeenkomst tussen partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat behandelaars in de ggz volgens onderzoek “heel flexibel” om zouden gaan met declaratieregels

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a study reporting that mental health practitioners handle declaration rules very flexibly, and about the role of care consultants. The minister answered that the NZa-commissioned study does not accuse the sector, that the NZa will discuss the findings with insurers and practitioners, and that the role of care consultants was not part of the study's scope.
The study was carried out on the initiative and commission of the NZa.
Het onderzoek is uitgevoerd op initiatief en in opdracht van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het faillissement van het centrum voor verslavingszorg Victas en de overname ervan door ggz-instelling Arkin

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of addiction care centre Victas, its building costs, the responsibility of its boards, and its takeover by Arkin. The minister answered that the curator is investigating the causes and any mismanagement, that the competition and regulatory authorities cleared the takeover, and that she cannot judge the board's conduct before the investigation concludes.
It is for the curator to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy. The final bankruptcy report will therefore have to be awaited.
Het is aan de curator om de oorzaken van het faillissement te onderzoeken. Het definitieve faillissementsverslag zal dus moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima Medisch Centrum verzwijgt calamiteit voor inspectie’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a hospital (MMC) that did not report a surgical calamity to the inspectorate, whether the patient will be compensated, whether the surgeon still operates, and how many disciplinary cases followed patient or family reports. The minister called the non-reporting regrettable, said the hospital remains legally responsible and has apologised, noted the disciplinary college issued the surgeon a warning, and reported 28 disciplinary cases since 2011, only two initiated by patients.

Regardless of whether the hospital works with employees or contracted staff, the hospital remains, as a care provider under the Healthcare Quality, Complaints and Disputes Act, ultimately responsible for the quality and safety of care and legally obliged to report a calamity to the IGZ.

Ongeacht of het ziekenhuis werkt met medewerkers in loondienst of medewerkers die in opdracht werken, het ziekenhuis blijft, als zorgaanbieder in de zin van de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg (Wkkgz), eindverantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geboden zorg en in geval van een calamiteit wettelijk verplicht om dit bij de IGZ te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over Het bericht 'Steekproef Consumentenbond: zorgdossiers zijn rommeltje'

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how she would respond to a Consumentenbond mystery-shopper survey finding that many hospital medical records were incomplete, inaccurate or misdirected, and what oversight bodies would do. The minister said she takes the findings seriously, will raise record-keeping quality with hospital associations, and that the IGZ and AP oversee the issue, though the IGZ could not draw firm conclusions from the small sample.
I consider the findings of the sample an important signal for the sector.
Ik vind de bevindingen van de steekproef een belangrijk signaal voor het veld.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Vogelmarkten moeten stoppen’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about bird markets, zoonotic disease risks, illegal trade in protected birds and animal welfare, following a media report and petition calling for bird markets to be stopped. The State Secretary defended the current regime (health checks, registration with the NVWA, CITES rules), gave limited data, and declined a ban but promised to ask the NVWA to pay closer attention to illegal trade and welfare at such events.
However, I will ask the NVWA to pay explicit attention at such events to both possible illegal trade and welfare aspects.
Wel zal ik de NVWA vragen om bij dergelijke evenementen nadrukkelijk aandacht te besteden aan zowel eventuele illegale handel als welzijnsaspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het megalomane project van Daelzicht

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about Daelzicht's abandoned theme-park project, its spending of over 1 million euros on planning, possible liability of board members, the myOwn care robot, staff complaints and the supervisory role of the Raad van Toezicht and the IGZ. The state secretary answered that the decisions rest with the institution and its supervisory board, that the IGZ monitors care quality without signs of risk so far, that board liability requires judicial findings, and that an independent investigation is not considered necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voortdurende crisis bij Daelzicht

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the ongoing crisis at care organisation Daelzicht, including the management team's loss of confidence in the Board, alleged intimidation by the Board, and whether oversight should be tightened. The State Secretary answered that the dispute is primarily between the Supervisory Board, the Board and the works council, that the Board will step down on 1 June 2016 with an interim board member appointed, and that the Inspectorate for Healthcare sees no current grounds for enforcement but is monitoring developments closely.
The Healthcare Inspectorate oversees that the quality and safety of the care provided by Daelzicht is in order.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg ziet erop toe dat de kwaliteit en de veiligheid van de zorg die door Dealzicht wordt geleverd op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe zorgondernemer Loek Winter een imperium opbouwde en 21,6 miljoen staatssteun lospeuterde’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a report on hospital entrepreneur Loek Winter and EUR 21.6 million in state aid for the IJsselmeer hospitals taken over by MC Groep. The minister answered that the WNT compliance case is under investigation by CIBG, defended private participation and the 2009 rescue package, and declined to detail contract terms between hospitals and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'Uitgelegde kippen vaak als oud vuil behandeld'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that spent laying hens are mistreated during catching and transport, asking whether the government condemns the abuses, how it will prevent them, and whether inspectors and training can be required. The State Secretary condemns the abuses, points to existing EU transport rules and NVWA supervision, awaits an NVWA chain analysis, and refers several questions to answers given to a parallel PvdD question, while promising to ask the sector to add a mandatory welfare course and to consider accelerating it.
The NVWA supervises compliance with this legislation and has insight into violations.
De NVWA houdt toezicht op de naleving van deze wet- en regelgeving en heeft inzicht in overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zes miljoen varkens sterven nog voor de slacht

SP MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a report claiming six million pigs die before slaughter, the withholding of Rendac mortality figures, killing of piglets on farms, piglet mortality and whether Rendac can detect live animals in carcass containers. The State Secretary answered that the Wageningen report will be sent to parliament after a decision, that Rendac is not obliged to publish mortality figures and that its publication is being considered, and referred to a separate letter on animal welfare for several questions.
Once a decision has been taken, I will send this decision, together with the advice of the expert group and the Wageningen UR report, to your House.
Zodra besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden zal ik dit besluit, vergezeld van het advies van de expertgroep en het rapport van Wageningen UR, aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verontrustende bijwerkingen van de sterilisatiemethode Essure

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about serious complaints from women following Essure sterilisation, the NVOG's stance, pre-market approval and post-market monitoring, reporting figures, patient information, compensation and whether randomised trials should be required. The Minister answered that the IGZ is registering complaints and a RIVM inventory is underway, that informing patients is the treating doctor's duty, that manufacturers bear liability and the burden of proof for product defects is not shifted, and that EU rules on monitoring are being pursued.
The RIVM has been commissioned by the Inspectorate to inventory these complaints for side effects, after which they will be clinically interpreted.
Het RIVM heeft van de Inspectie opdracht gekregen deze klachten te inventariseren op bijwerkingen, waarna deze klinisch zullen worden geduid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the Taskforce Naleving Leeftijdsgrens Tabak, an industry-funded tobacco age-compliance taskforce, including VWS's role, information sharing, FCTC Article 5.3 concerns, and the NIX18 campaign's stakeholders. The State Secretary answered that VWS is not involved in the taskforce's activities, that contacts fall under FCTC Article 5.3 for technical implementation reasons with documents published, and that an independent Bureau Nuchter study will report by summer.
The Ministry of VWS is in no way involved in the activities of this Taskforce.
Het Ministerie van VWS is op geen enkele wijze betrokken bij de activiteiten van deze Taskforce.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verloren cassatie waar de diensten van een magnetiseur als gelijkwaardig werden betiteld aan die van BIG-geregistreerde psychologen en psychiaters

An SP MP asked the Health and Finance ministers about a Supreme Court ruling that treated a magnetiser's services as equivalent to those of BIG-registered psychologists and psychiatrists for VAT exemption, and about alleged fraud and the revenue loss. The State Secretary replied that the ruling forces a broader application of the medical VAT exemption under fiscal neutrality, that the policy decision was updated, that about 28 million euro structural annual loss results (52 million total exemption cost), that the Tax Service does not intervene in individual court cases, and that reopening is only possible in exceptional circumstances.
The cabinet does not interfere in these cases and does not pronounce on them.
Het kabinet mengt zich niet in deze zaken en doet daar ook geen uitspraak over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘BLHB wil prijstoetsing geliberaliseerde pacht’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dutch landlords' and tenants' association BLHB's proposal to introduce price review for liberalised farmland leases, and about related concerns on price rises, soil fertility, lease duration and government landlord conduct. The State Secretary declined to act for now, pending the stakeholder talks on the Spelderholt deal, agreed to have LEI model the BLHB proposal, and gave the average lease price table.
I want to give the parties the opportunity to finish this consultation before I consider proposals.
Ik wil de partijen de gelegenheid geven dit overleg af te ronden voordat ik voorstellen in overweging neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat zwanen massaal worden afgeschoten in het Groene Hart

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass shooting of swans in the Groene Hart, including the justification for provincial permits, whether the permits are dubious, measures against the hunt, and legal options against mistreatment shown on television. The State Secretary replied that about 1100 swans were killed this winter, in line with the average, that provinces are responsible for permits under the Flora- and faunawet and he will not intervene, that the courts remain open, and that enforcement bodies oversee permit conditions while a possible criminal investigation is being considered and cannot be discussed.
Under the Flora- and faunawet, it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve fauna management plans and grant permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht Martha Flora start in Haarlem met Zorgbalans

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the opening of Martha Flora's luxury care homes in Haarlem, the relocation of former residents of Parkzicht, and the role of insurer CZ's investment arm. The secretary said residents keep their legal right to care, that the high private costs are a matter of personal choice and that CZ's participation is acceptable as long as it is transparent, but did not provide investor return figures.
Private parties investing in (clustered) housing are not obliged to make their returns public.
Private partijen die investeren in (geclusterde) woningen zijn niet gehouden om hun rendementen publiek te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gerven en Leijten over het feitelijk niet verkrijgbaar zijn van het generieke dimethylfumaraat voor de behandeling van MS en andere zaken omtrent dure geneesmiddelen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about unavailability of generic dimethylfumarate for MS, seeding trials, Fampyra and Amfexa pricing, and ADHD medication. The minister answered that compounded supply is not available, opposed seeding trials, described the Fampyra and Amfexa positions, and rejected the view that ADHD diagnosis is questionable.
I am not in favour of seeding trials.
Ik ben geen voorstander van seeding trials.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het tekort aan crisisbedden bij GGZ-instelling Reinier van Arkel vanwege de bezuinigingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a reported shortage of crisis beds at GGZ provider Reinier van Arkel caused by budget cuts, the chair's departure, executive pay, bed reduction and street confusion. Minister Schippers denied a structural shortage, pointed to NZa findings and yearly growth room, said she has no view on the chair's motives, and deferred the bed-reduction and ambulatory questions to a separate monitor letter.
I have no insight into the reasons why executives of care institutions decide to step down.
Ik heb geen zicht op de motieven waarom bestuurders van zorginstellingen besluiten op te stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door Tergooi Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the IGZ's assessment of a settlement agreement between Tergooi Hospital and the relatives of a deceased patient could be sent to Parliament before a scheduled committee meeting. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found it a voluntary civil settlement that does not breach the duty to report calamities, but considers gag clauses and waivers of further legal recourse undesirable, and she will examine whether the Wkkgz can be amended to address them.
I will therefore examine whether it is possible to regulate this through a provision in the Wkkgz so that care providers can be held to account by the inspectorate in such cases.
Ik zal dan ook bezien of het mogelijk is dit via een bepaling in de Wkkgz te regelen opdat zorgaanbieders daar in een voorkomend geval door de inspectie op aangesproken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht de omstreden KNO-arts weer laat opereren

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the UMC Utrecht was right to let a suspended ENT surgeon, linked to two fatal incidents, resume patient care and surgery while the Inspectorate's investigation was ongoing, and why the Inspectorate's results were not awaited. Minister Schippers answered that re-integration is the hospital board's responsibility, that the IGZ will assess the conditions and the investigation remains open, and that she cannot comment substantively on the ongoing inquiry.
Although I understand that questions are repeatedly asked about this case, I cannot respond substantively while the inspectorate's investigation is ongoing.
Hoewel ik begrijp dat over deze casus telkens vragen worden gesteld, kan ik lopende het onderzoek van de inspectie daar inhoudelijk niet op reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de bezetting van de gemeentehuizen van Hollands Kroon en Bronckhorst door actievoerende thuiszorgmedewerkers die strijden voor hun baan

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the occupation of municipal offices by care workers protesting the TSN bankruptcy was a good action, and why the Bronckhorst and Hollands Kroon mayors evicted them, and what the government thought of municipalities leaving workers uncertain. The state secretary answered that demonstration is a right, that mayors decide on order and consequences, that he will not judge the mayors' decisions, and that continuity of care and decent employment conditions were secured.
It is up to the mayor to set rules and restrictions to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de burgemeester om ter handhaving van de openbare orde en veiligheid voorschriften en beperkingen te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Toename aantal alcoholintoxicaties in 2015’

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about a reported 27% rise in alcohol poisonings among minors in 2015, whether the trend is expected to fall, the causes, and whether municipal enforcement of the age limit is failing. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, said the cause remains uncertain, pointed to a positive overall trend, and said the Drank- en Horecawet is under evaluation with the enforcement findings due in autumn and a government response in early 2017.
Incidentally, I am currently evaluating the Alcohol and Catering Act (DHW).
Overigens evalueer ik op dit moment de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet melden van een calamiteit en het mogelijk betalen van zwijggeld aan nabestaande(n) door het Tergooi Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a hospital's failure to report a calamity to the Inspectorate, reports of hush money paid to relatives, and the Inspectorate's reluctance to give aggregate figures on unreported calamities. The Minister said the Inspectorate has started enforcement against the hospital, will publish more reliable aggregate data after reviewing its disclosure policy, and is assessing whether the settlement agreement is permissible.
After the broadcast, the Inspectorate asked the hospital's board to provide this agreement to it.
De IGZ heeft na de uitzending de raad van bestuur gevraagd deze overeenkomst aan haar te overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how health care costs have shifted to citizens, including the split of BKZ costs between citizens and businesses, the treatment of self-employed workers, the Zvw transition and tax credits. The minister said costs paid from general funds cannot be split between citizens and businesses, defended treating self-employed as households in some statistics, promised further calculations for some questions later and listed the tax credits.
These figures can be provided, but more time is needed. If desired, I can deliver them before the summer.
Deze cijfers zijn wel te geven, maar daarvoor is meer tijd nodig. Desgewenst kan ik die voor de zomer leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nieuwe calamiteiten binnen het Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about Zembla reports of new calamities at UMC Utrecht, including craniosynostosis operations against guidelines, threatening letters to sources, and failure to report incidents. The Minister answered that an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing with an external commission, expected to conclude in summer 2016, and declined to pre-judge findings or order enforcement.
The IGZ investigation will be completed mid-year, after which I will inform you of the outcomes.
Het onderzoek van de IGZ zal halverwege dit jaar gereed zijn, waarna ik u informeer over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over stijging van kapitaallasten van ziekenhuizen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the rise in capital costs of hospitals, requesting a breakdown into depreciation, rent and financing costs, and questioned the Plexus/BKB findings on the abolition of the building regime. The minister provided CBS figures, defended the Plexus/BKB estimate as a reasonable but uncertain assessment, and explained that the Waarborgfonds guarantee lowers interest costs by about 1 to 2 percent, while no comparison with ordinary businesses is available.
A comparison with the business sector is not possible due to the lack of insight into the average interest rates that ordinary businesses pay for their financing.
Vergelijking met het bedrijfsleven is niet mogelijk wegens het ontbreken van inzicht in de gemiddelde rentetarieven die «reguliere bedrijven» betalen voor hun financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Onderzoek baarmoederhalskanker mogelijk veel duurder. Veel meer vrouwen met hpv besmet dan gedacht’

MPs Van Gerven and Bruins Slot asked whether a Jeroen Bosch Hospital study showing higher HPV infection would raise the costs of the new cervical cancer screening, affect patients' own-risk payments, and whether the IMPROVE study and cost-effectiveness analysis were sound. The minister said the findings were not new, that costs are uncertain but patients would pay less overall, that the cost-effectiveness results are expected this year, and that the new screening's start is based on the Health Council's advice.
The tender request from the RIVM, containing the research assignment, is attached.
Het offerteverzoek van het RIVM, met daarin de onderzoeksopdracht, is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het ‘Rapport van het inspectiebezoek aan Martha Flora in Gouda op 28 september 2015’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about the IGZ inspection report on Martha Flora Gouda, which found care risks and unmet norms, and about the cost and oversight of the care homes. The state secretary said the provider must submit an improvement plan by 7 April 2016, the IGZ sees no reason for intensified supervision yet, the IGZ will be asked to attach the plan to its final judgment, and pricing and business model questions are for the provider or clients.
I will ask the IGZ to attach the results report (anonymised where necessary given privacy requirements) as an annex to its final judgment.
Ik zal de IGZ verzoeken om het resultaatverslag (waar nodig gelet op privacy-eisen geanonimiseerd) als bijlage bij haar eindoordeel te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de berichten dat Nederland en Europa een grote rol spelen in de illegale dierenhandel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands and Europe play a major role in illegal wildlife trade, including enforcement capacity, penalties, international cooperation and aid to African countries. The government replied that Dutch enforcement capacity is sufficient, penalties are substantial, and it is pursuing CITES, EU and aid-based measures, while rejecting claims of inadequate capacity.
In my view the Netherlands' efforts in this area are good and I am making sufficient resources available for them.
Naar mijn oordeel is de inzet van Nederland op dit terrein goed en maak ik daar voldoende middelen voor vrij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het feit dat bij de hengstenkeuring van de KVTH bijna alleen maar paarden met gecoupeerde staarten meedoen, terwijl couperen sinds 2001 verboden is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why almost all stallions at the KVTH stallion inspection had docked tails despite the 2001 ban on docking, and what action would be taken against the KVTH. The State Secretary answered that the 2002 CBb ruling limits the exhibition ban for legally docked foreign animals, that enforcement under administrative law will be pursued and effectiveness studied, but no commitment was made to a reporting duty for vets or a ban on transport.
In view of this, I intend to enforce the exhibition ban under administrative law in the coming period.
Gelet hierop ben ik voornemens de komende periode bestuursrechtelijk te gaan handhaven op het tentoonstellingsverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de plannen voor een megastal met grootschalige embryowinning in Wichmond en de gevolgen daarvan voor hormoonemissies naar het milieu

An MP asked the government about hormone emissions from the planned Wichmond cattle farm with embryo harvesting, including whether an environmental impact assessment and permits should block it. The state secretaries answered that no hormone-specific study or specific emission rules exist for the farm, that no MER is required for the first two phases, and that the municipality and province hold the relevant planning and permit powers.
For phase 3, it is up to the municipality to assess whether the final farm fits within the zoning plan.
Voor fase 3 is het aan de gemeente ter beoordeling of het uiteindelijke bedrijf inpasbaar is in het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Grote verschillen in nierzorg tussen ziekenhuizen’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a Nieuwsuur report showing large differences between hospitals in kidney care, including referrals for transplant, dialysis duration incentives, home dialysis decline and the transplant waiting list. Minister Schippers answered that the profession and existing quality instruments (HKZ certification, Renine, Zorginzicht.nl) address the differences, denied that the waiting list is artificially kept small, and gave no new concrete measures beyond earlier initiatives.
This concerns a matter for the profession itself, and the profession has addressed the relevant Boards of Directors.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid van de beroepsgroep zelf en de beroepsgroep heeft de betreffende Raden van Bestuur aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie jarenlang te makkelijk nieuwe bestrijdingsmiddelen heeft toegelaten

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's lax approval of pesticides, flagged by the European Ombudsman, endangers health and environment and what the Netherlands will do about it, including holding producers liable. The State Secretary answered that there is no reason to believe safety is at risk, that the Ctgb assessed the confirmatory data positively, that the Commission has accepted the Ombudsman's recommendations, and that no further tightening of authorisation policy is currently needed.
I consider this ruling a reason to tighten the current procedures.
Ik vind deze uitspraak aanleiding om de huidige procedures aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht Erasmus MC Rotterdam gaat botox-lessen geven

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views academic hospitals such as Erasmus MC offering training in cosmetic procedures like botox, whether a cosmetic-doctor title should be protected, and whether cosmetic surgery should be discouraged rather than trained for. The minister supports quality and qualified providers, describes the training modules and their participant numbers, says a protected title is welcome but is for the CGS to assess, and declines to actively discourage cosmetic surgery.
At Erasmus MC, the dermatology training devotes attention to aesthetic treatment only in its extracurricular components.
In het Erasmus MC wordt in de opleiding dermatologie enkel in de extracurriculaire onderdelen aandacht besteed aan behandeling gericht op esthetiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over een nieuw megalomaan project in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Health about a proposed large recreation-style park by care organisation Daelzicht, questioning its use of care funds, governance, and the parallels with Philadelphia and Meavita. The State Secretary answered that Daelzicht has decided to abandon the plan, and largely declined to assess the governance and investment questions, referring to that decision.
Daelzicht has decided to stop the plan for Belevingspark Heel and has stated that it considers peace within the organisation and its surroundings important.
Daelzicht heeft besloten te stoppen met het plan voor Belevingspark Heel en heeft meegedeeld de rust binnen de organisatie en in de omgeving belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Krijgt vermeende subsidiefraude in vissector toch een strafrechtelijk staartje’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about alleged subsidy fraud in the fisheries sector (the Van Rijsingen fish-farming subsidy), high error rates in EU fisheries subsidies, recovery of funds, conflicts of interest and the Topteam Agri & Food. The State Secretary answered that no evidence of fraud was found, that recovery follows legal principles and EU rules, that the Auditdienst Rijk and Algemene Rekenkamer oversee the process, and that the Topteam members are appointed in a personal capacity with safeguards against conflicts of interest.
I have no indications that there is fraud here.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er hier sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over uitbreiding van nertsenhouderijen en bont

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked why Zeeland provincial authorities allowed mink farm expansion despite the Fur Farming Ban, how enforcement works, and how consumers can identify real versus synthetic fur labelling. The State Secretary answered that municipalities cannot refuse permits on this ground, the ban prohibits starting or expanding mink farming regardless of permits, enforcement is initiated by municipalities and cassation is pending, and that EU labelling changes are unlikely while the Commission is reluctant.
The Fur Farming Ban Act prevents starting or expanding a mink farm even with an environmental permit obtained.
De Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij verhindert het starten of uitbreiden van een nertsenhouderij met de eventueel verkregen omgevingsvergunning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voor zorgbestuurders perverse prikkel tot fuseren vanwege salarissen hoger dan de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the WNT salary cap creates an incentive for hospital boards to merge, and whether the cap should be tightened for executives running several hospitals. The minister answered that gelieerde instellingen' pay is aggregated under the cap, that existing merger safeguards (governance code, zorgspecifieke fusietoets) are sufficient, and that the cumulation question is under review as part of the WNT evaluation.
The cabinet is currently considering, following the WNT law evaluation, whether tightening of the WNT is necessary based on the evaluation.
Het kabinet bekijkt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie WNT of aanscherping van de WNT nodig is op basis van de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over experimenten op psychiatrische patiënten van GGZ Noord-Holland-Noord (GGZ NHN)

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about experiments on psychiatric patients at GGZ NHN, a whistleblower's treatment, the governance code breach, and whether the IGZ and CCMO are examining the research under the WMO. The Minister answered that the governance code was breached but the institution has since complied, that the IGZ investigation is near completion with a report expected in Q1 2016, and that the follow-up study was judged non-WMO by the CCMO.
The IGZ expects to be able to finalise the report at the end of the first quarter of 2016.
De IGZ verwacht het rapport eind eerste kwartaal 2016 te kunnen vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ook huisartsen werken mee aan dubieuze bloedtests’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether she was troubled that lab prick-posts cooperate with a commercial firm offering dubious preventive blood tests, and asked about quality, pricing, unregulated lab diagnostics and professional criticism. The Minister said consumers may choose such tests if quality is assured, noted the lab had cut ties with the firm, found current regulation and IGZ oversight sufficient, and promised further talks with stakeholders on conditions for adequate diagnostics.
I will discuss the matter further with the parties involved to draw up conditions for adequate diagnostics.
Ik zal met betrokken partijen nader in gesprek gaan om randvoorwaarden voor adequate diagnostiek op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Gerven over over giftige bontkragen op kinderjassen

MPs Thieme and Van Gerven asked whether fur collars on children's jackets, found to contain formaldehyde and ethoxylates above guideline levels, should be recalled and banned, and whether fur labelling should be improved. The minister replied that the NVWA and RIVM judge exposure acceptable, that no national ban or recall is warranted for now, and that EU consultation on formaldehyde and labelling efforts are ongoing.
The NVWA concludes that the actual amount of toxic substances that can be released from the product is at a scientifically acceptable level.
De NVWA concludeert dat de feitelijke hoeveelheid giftige stoffen die uit het product kunnen vrijkomen onder het wetenschappelijk gezien acceptabele niveau liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van een morfinepomp

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a health insurer's refusal to reimburse a morphine pump and about the general reimbursement of prescribed aids. The minister said the insurer admitted miscommunication, tightened procedures, and that insurers must provide adequate aids under their duty of care, with the NZa supervising, while deferring a broader medical-necessity review to a letter in June.
In the insurer's view, two things went wrong.
Naar oordeel van de zorgverzekeraar zijn er twee zaken niet goed gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen kiezen voor een verhoogd eigen risico

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that more people choose a higher voluntary deductible and about NZa findings that such polices and budget policies may enable risk selection and undermine solidarity. Minister Schippers answered that the 2016 uptake figures are not yet known, that voluntary deductibles are a legitimate consumer choice, and that she awaits the NZa follow-up study before deciding whether to act.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the NZa's supplementary study.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het aanvullende onderzoek van de NZa af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over misleiding bij voedselproducten door supermarkten

An MP asked the ministers whether supermarkets misleading consumers on food labels (e.g. diluted juice priced above full juice) is known, what sanctions apply, and what instruments exist to enforce labelling rules. The minister answered that the NVWA assesses case by case, warnings and fines are available, no fines were recently issued for juice labelling, and a plan of action on labelling is promised for spring 2016.
Furthermore, I have committed to come up with an action plan in spring 2016 on the basis of this research and the NVWA's experience regarding food labelling.
Daarnaast heb ik u toegezegd op basis van dit onderzoek en de ervaringen van de NVWA voor wat betreft etikettering van voedingsmiddelen in het voorjaar van 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verdwijnen van 300 banen bij het Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) mede vanwege 239 miljoen kostende nieuwbouw

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about 300 job losses at Medisch Spectrum Twente linked to a 239 million euro new building, including whether the financing used swaps and why capital costs in healthcare rose after the building regime was abolished. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own building decisions, declined detailed knowledge of the plans, said data on capital costs were not available, and said no public rate norm applies to bank lending to care institutions.
It is up to hospitals themselves to make decisions about any necessary new buildings and the trade-offs made in that process, such as the organisation of the institution.
Het is aan ziekenhuizen zelf om beslissingen te nemen over eventueel noodzakelijke nieuwbouw en de afwegingen die daarbij worden gemaakt over bijvoorbeeld de inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over grote prijsverschillen voor zorg tussen gemeenten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that people cannot pay Wmo co-payments and forgo care, and about large price differences between municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said co-payments must not exceed municipal cost prices, pointed to municipalities' duty to provide individual case-based tailoring, and said data on people ending care is not collected but a CBS study is underway.
Neither I nor the municipalities register whether clients drop out of or forgo support.
Door mij noch gemeenten wordt geregistreerd of cliënten afhaken of afzien van ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de top van TSN Thuiszorg zich achter de schermen ontdaan heeft van aansprakelijkheid bij faillissement

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Health about reports that TSN Thuiszorg's parent company ADG secretly shed liability for a bankruptcy, shifting risks to staff and creditors, including a renamed entity and withdrawn guarantee. The State Secretary largely confirmed the facts from commercial register documents, said he cannot judge intent or legal compliance (a matter for the courts), called such conduct morally reprehensible if intended, and pointed to existing law and corporate responsibility.
I do not know what the intention of the parent company ADG dienstengroep SE was
Ik weet niet wat de bedoeling van het moederbedrijf ADG dienstengroep SE is geweest
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Inzet ID-scanners bij leeftijdscontrole tabak in strijd met Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens’

SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health whether using ID scanners for tobacco age checks breaches the Dutch data protection act, and what the government will do about it and about poor compliance with the age limit. The State Secretary replied that the Data Protection Authority says such scanners are not automatically unlawful, depending on the data scanned and how they are used, that retailers must follow the law but the government will not prescribe a system, and that the DPA alone decides enforcement priorities, while the NVWA has intensified supervision and he will report on compliance mid-year.
Under the EU privacy directive and the Dutch Data Protection Act (Wbp), the Data Protection Authority is the independent supervisor of the Wbp.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is krachtens de EU-privacyrichtlijn en de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (Wbp) de onafhankelijke toezichthouder op de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over hoe de kosten van het huidige zorgstelsel ongezien naar de burger verschoven

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether a Follow the Money report showed that healthcare costs had shifted unseen onto citizens since 2004 and whether the minister's claims about premiums were misleading. The minister replied that the increase largely reflects omitting the healthcare allowance, that the 50/50 burden-sharing rule keeps employer shares roughly constant, and that a CBS misclassification will be corrected while the minister's earlier claims stand.
The CBS, among other things, counts self-employed persons as businesses in the cited flow charts.
Het CBS rekent onder andere in de genoemde stroomschema's zelfstandigen tot bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de grote onzekerheid voor thuiszorgmedewerkers en cliënten na thuiszorgwissel in Amstelveen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about job and care insecurity for home-care workers and clients after Amstelveen's home-care tender, including transfer conditions, a 20% bonus for reduced care hours, and whether intervention is planned. The state secretary answered that the municipality set conditions requiring client-carer continuity and the cao VVT, that the bonus compensates providers for lost hours, and declined to intervene, deferring to the municipal council.
No. The municipal council is actively involved in the subject of domestic help.
Nee. De gemeenteraad is actief betrokken bij het onderwerp hulp bij het huishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het al dan niet vergoeden van dimethylfumaraat bij de behandeling van MS

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurer Zilveren Kruis Achmea stopped reimbursing the cheap compounded dimethylfumarate for MS, leaving only the expensive branded Tecfidera covered, and whether this breaches earlier agreements. The minister answered that the insurer stopped reimbursing only supplied compounded preparations, not in-pharmacy preparations, that registered Tecfidera remains reimbursed, and that she is examining European rules on pricing and new active substances.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea has stated that it no longer reimburses the supplied preparations of dimethylfumarate.
Zilveren Kruis Achmea heeft aangegeven dat zij de doorgeleverde bereidingen van dimethylfumuraat niet meer vergoedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de voorwaardelijke toelating van fampridine (Fampyra) in het basispakket

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why fampridine (Fampyra) was placed under conditional reimbursement despite a negative Zorginstituut advice, why the cheaper pharmacy preparation was not chosen, and how this relates to Tecfidera and earlier motions on high-priced medicines. The minister answered that Fampyra was selected through the new top-down conditional admission route, that a lower negotiated price (about EUR 151 per 4 weeks) was agreed, and that the case is not adaptive licensing, while acknowledging undesirably high prices are a concern.
The medicine Fampyra was selected in consultation with the Zorginstituut on the basis of the top-down procedure.
Het geneesmiddel Fampyra is in overleg met het Zorginstituut geselecteerd op basis van de top-down procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toekomst van de ambulancezorg en het definitieve rapport “Ordening ambulancezorg” van Zorgconsultancybureau SiRM

The MPs Leijten and Van Gerven (SP) asked why the SiRM report on ambulance care was dated 29 September 2015 but only sent to parliament in December, why it was not sent separately, who commissioned and guided it, whether earlier drafts and meeting minutes exist, and why the government opposes a public variant and did not examine labour market effects. Minister Schippers answered that the report was sent in December to avoid delay, that the commissioning and drafts were handled internally with no written minutes, and that the government sees no need for a public variant because quality is already regulated, while the options studied do not change the basic structure of ambulance care.
No written minutes were drawn up of that meeting.
Van dat overleg is geen schriftelijk verslag opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) in Amsterdam

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about a reported unsafe training climate and a concealed medical incident at the AMC's ENT department, including what was done after the RGS critical visitation report, whether patient safety is at risk, why the inspectorate was not alerted, and whether the investigation covers the working climate. The minister answered that a safe climate is an important condition but does not by itself mean acute patient risk, that measures have been taken, that the inspectorate found no reason to close the department, that the hospital board was not obliged to report but the inspectorate will discuss it, and that the inspectorate's investigation covers only the incident, with the outcome to follow.
The investigation into the report to the inspectorate is ongoing and I will inform your House of the outcome soon.
Het onderzoek naar de melding bij de inspectie loopt en ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het kwaliteitsonderzoek telefonische informatieverstrekking zorgverzekeraars

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers Zilveren Kruis/Achmea, VGZ and CZ went to court against the NZa's critical study of phone information provision, and about the NZa's outsourcing of the research to TNS NIPO. The minister answered that insurers will discuss the method with the NZa, that the NZa is reviewing how to conduct such studies after the court ruling, and that the NZa outsourced 24 studies in 2014 and 46 in 2015, spending about 1.6% and 2.8% of its budget on third-party research.
The NZa is currently considering how best to shape similar studies to the one in this case.
Momenteel beziet de NZa hoe zij het beste vorm kan geven aan soortgelijke onderzoeken als in deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over de onderhandelingen van zeven Westfriese gemeenten over de thuiszorg

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether thuiszorg provider Zorgkompas made national agreements not to take over TSN Thuiszorg staff in a bankruptcy, whether this amounts to a cartel, and how staff rights and conditions would be protected, including via municipal contracts and compensation. The state secretary replied that no national agreements exist, that providers set their own personnel policy within the law, that talks on a possible takeover are ongoing, and that he refers to earlier letters on fair employment conditions and the 2015 care agreement, without committing to new measures such as compensation.

Based on the information Zorgkompas provided to me, I can inform you that Zorgkompas has made no national agreements about whether or not to take on TSN Thuiszorg staff after a bankruptcy of TSN Thuiszorg.

Op grond van de door Zorgkompas aan mij verstrekte informatie kan ik u melden dat Zorgkompas geen landelijke afspraken heeft gemaakt over het al dan niet in dienst treden van medewerkers van TSN Thuiszorg na een faillissement van TSN Thuiszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Van Gerven over de uitbreiding van nertsenhouders

MPs Van Dekken and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mink farms expanding after the Fur Farming Ban was suspended and about video showing mink being thrown and kicked into a gas chamber, including inspection frequency and a promised independent-offence measure. The government said it is still consulting the Public Prosecution Service, that inspections are unannounced but mink-killing dates are reported in advance, that cameras cannot be mandated, and that a policy response on a standalone ban will follow soon.
At present I am still consulting the Public Prosecution Service about the consequences of this ruling for enforcement.
Op dit moment ben ik nog in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie over de gevolgen van deze uitspraak voor de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het verzwijgen van een medische calamiteit door het AMC

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why AMC did not report a medical incident to the Health Inspectorate, whether it was a calamity or a complication, and how the hospital handled complaints and the parents. The Minister answered that the IGZ is investigating whether AMC met its reporting duty and cannot comment during the inquiry, and refused to release the full file because of privacy and Wob balancing.

No. Regarding the full file and the still to be drawn up (final) report on the event, the IGZ is legally required under the Wob to weigh the public interest in disclosure against the interest in protecting patients' privacy and preventing disproportionate harm to all involved.

Nee. Ten aanzien van het volledige dossier en nog op te stellen (eind)rapportage van de gebeurtenis is de IGZ op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob), wettelijk gehouden een afweging te maken tussen het publieke belang bij openbaarmaking enerzijds, en het belang van eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van patiënten/cliënten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over 175.000 Nederlanders die hun schildkliermedicijn Thyrax Duotab tijdelijk niet kunnen ontvangen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about a shortage of the thyroid drug Thyrax Duotab affecting 175,000 patients, including side effects of switching drugs, the manufacturer's conduct, and whether pharmaceutical supply policy should change. The minister said the IGZ is investigating the manufacturer, that alternatives are available and Euthyrox may be imported, and that no change to drug policy is planned, though the minister will talk to the industry association and intensify the drug-shortage working group.
To answer whether the manufacturer can be blamed for socially irresponsible conduct, I want to await the IGZ investigation and not anticipate its results.

Voor de beantwoording van de vraag of de fabrikant maatschappelijk onverantwoord gedrag kan worden verweten wil ik het onderzoek van de IGZ afwachten en niet nu al vooruitlopen op de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Transitie doet administratieve lasten met 30 procent groeien’

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about reports that the social domain transition raised administrative burdens by 30 percent, and whether municipal policy freedom and fragmented approaches cause this. The state secretary acknowledged the burden problems and pointed to joint action with municipalities and providers, including an action agenda and a joint implementation organisation, while declining to provide data on external hiring costs and saying there is no representative research on the burden increase.
I do not have representative research on the administrative burden resulting from the transition.
Ik beschik niet over een representatief onderzoek over de administratieve lasten als gevolg van de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘De kindermaag gamet lekker mee’

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health how the government responds to research showing that advergames promoting snacks increase children's snacking, and whether the government will ban such disguised marketing. The State Secretary says he takes the findings seriously, relies on the industry's self-regulatory codes, sees no need for legislation yet, and will commission research on compliance and discuss the issue with the food industry.
At present I am having research carried out into the food industry's compliance on social media, the internet and games, among other things.
Momenteel laat ik wel onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de voedingsindustrie op onder andere social media, internet en games.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een beveiligingsbedrijf zorgtaken en behandeling in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning en jeugdzorg wil gaan leveren

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that security company G4S would provide Wmo and youth care tasks in Hollandse Kroon, including its qualifications, staffing, use of remote care and transition impact on clients. The state secretary replied that the municipality had ended the tender talks with G4S, that it would not explain its reasons citing the Aanbestedingswet, and that continuity of care and legal safeguards would be ensured through the procurement process.
Referring to the Aanbestedingswet and the handling of talks between G4S Zorg en Welzijn and the municipality, the municipality makes no statements about the reasons for ending the talks.

De gemeente doet onder verwijzing naar het gestelde in de Aanbestedingswet en de afwikkeling van gesprekken tussen G4S Zorg en Welzijn en de gemeente, geen uitspraken over de beweegredenen voor het beëindigen van de gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de VNG een pilot ‘reguleren mengvormen winkel/horeca’ start

An MP asked whether the VNG pilot allowing shop-catering hybrids, which would tolerate breaches of specific Drank- en Horecawet articles, is lawful and whether the state would act against it. The state secretary said the law leaves no room for such tolerance, that he expects the VNG to adjust the pilot, sent a letter to the VNG, and will address participating municipalities if experiments go beyond legal limits.
I then stated that the Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) leaves no room for the pilot in which prohibitions under the DHW are tolerated.
Ik heb toen gemeld dat de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) geen ruimte biedt voor de pilot waarbij verboden uit de DHW worden gedoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over Gelderland megastallenland

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the growth of mega-stables in Gelderland, the number of applications, monitoring, and a promised law letting authorities cap stable sizes on public health grounds. The State Secretary reported rising numbers of large stables, said that permit applications are handled by provinces and municipalities and that the central government does not track them, declined to monitor numbers structurally, and promised to inform the House in early 2016 on the proposed animal numbers law.
Applications for permits to build new stables are submitted under spatial planning, environmental and nature legislation for which municipalities and provinces are the competent authority.

Aanvragen voor vergunningen voor de bouw van nieuwe stallen worden ingediend in het kader van de wetgeving op het vlak van ruimtelijke ordening, milieu en natuur waarvoor gemeenten en provincies het bevoegd gezag zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Inspectie verzwijgt misstanden. Rapport over grove fouten Helders verzorgingshuis geheimgehouden’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the health inspectorate IGZ concealed serious failures at care home De Golfstroom, why its calamity report was not published, and whether it would send the report to parliament. The State Secretary denied concealment, pointed to published inspection reports, said the calamity report is withheld to protect individual privacy under the open government act, and gave no commitment to send it.
On 17 February 2015 and 7 November 2015 the inspectorate actively published the reports it drew up following its inspection of the quality of care.

De inspectie heeft op 17 februari 2015 en op 7 november 2015 de door haar opgestelde rapporten naar aanleiding van het inspectieonderzoek naar de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening actief openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stelling ‘Een patiënt heeft het recht zelf te beslissen waar hij/zij de laatste levensfase wil verblijven’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a case where a terminally ill man could not die at a hospice or at home due to an indication problem with the CIZ, and about how often this occurs. The State Secretary answered that such cases are rare, that the Wlz indication rules were clarified so CIZ can issue the palliative terminal care profile for people who want to die at home, and that CIZ staff were reminded of the rules.

The policy rules have now been clarified, so there should be no misunderstanding about the possibility that the CIZ can issue an indication decision for the protected living profile with intensive palliative terminal care for people who want to die at home.

De beleidsregels zijn inmiddels verduidelijkt, zodat er geen misverstanden hoeven te ontstaan over de mogelijkheid dat het CIZ bij mensen die thuis willen overlijden een indicatiebesluit voor het zorgprofiel beschermd wonen met intensieve palliatief terminale zorg kan afgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de chaos voor consumenten die zorgpolis zoeken

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers disagree on the savings from restricting free choice of doctors, how selective contracting on 'top care' quality labels affects consumers, and whether budget policies are cross-subsidised. The Minister replied that the measure was one part of the framework agreements, replaced by the 'Kwaliteit loont' package, and that selective contracting can lower premiums without endangering the duty of care.
With the lapse of this measure the framework agreements came under pressure, and with them the €1 billion in returns.
Met het vervallen van deze maatregel stonden de hoofdlijnenakkoorden onder druk en daarmee de opbrengsten van € 1 mld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het bericht dat in Enschede een zorggroep een loonoffer vraagt van duizend personeelsleden

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about care group Manna in Enschede requesting a voluntary wage sacrifice from about a thousand staff to cover a 2015 deficit, and how this relates to a court ruling that financial problems may not be shifted onto employees. The state secretary called the request remarkable but said institutions set their own personnel policy within legal and collective agreement frameworks, that the cases differ, and that no information is held on other organisations; he pointed to a new joint approach with unions and VNG for long-term care.
However, institutions determine their own vision, conduct and personnel policy.
Instellingen bepalen echter hun eigen visie, handelen en personeelbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to distinguish 'smart' declaring from upcoding in mental health care, and about the role of consultants such as P5COM, including whether the NZa checks their role. Minister Schippers answered that correct declaring is required, that she does not comment on consultants or ongoing NZa investigations, and that she sees no direct link between consultants and upcoding oversight.
The NZa does not make announcements about ongoing investigations.
De NZa doet geen mededelingen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Gerven over het onderschatte gevaar van koolmonoxide

MPs Bashir and Van Gerven asked the ministers about the underestimated carbon monoxide danger identified by the Safety Board, including modern boilers being involved, mandatory inspections, detector testing, and public information. The minister replied that a cabinet position would be sent in spring 2016, acknowledged that modern appliances are involved in many incidents, rejected mandatory inspections for now, and defended existing rules while deferring most concrete measures to the forthcoming cabinet position.
The minister of VWS and I are currently working on a cabinet position that will respond to the report.
Momenteel werken de minster van VWS en ik aan een kabinetsstandpunt waarin een reactie op het rapport wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Gapend gat tussen ziekenhuis en thuis’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports of a gap between hospital and home care, including whether elderly patients stay in hospital too long and whether the funding ceiling for first-line stays is too low. The state secretary said he added EUR 20 million to the 2015 subsidy ceiling, denied a structural flaw in the system, described a new practical support team, and said the funding timing was coincidental.
No, no data on this is kept nationally.
Nee, hier worden landelijk geen gegevens over bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Krijgt vermeende subsidiefraude in vissector toch een strafrechtelijk staartje’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about alleged subsidy fraud in the fisheries sector, whether subsidies were recovered, why no criminal complaint was filed, the error rate in EU fisheries subsidies, recovery policy, OLAF findings, and sustainability conditions. The State Secretary answered that recovery was not pursued in the specific case for reasons of legal certainty, no criminal indications were found, error rates were revised to 22.2%, and remedial measures were deemed sufficient by the European Commission.
I have no indications that there are criminal offences here.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er hier sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over upcoding in de ggz-sector en de rol van adviesbureaus

SP MPs asked the health minister about consultancy firm P5COM advising mental health providers, whether this involves upcoding, and whether advice spending and NZa oversight of advisory firms are appropriate. The minister answered that upcoding is illegal and that there is no indication of it in the press report, that engaging advisers is a matter for providers themselves, and that the NZa has not investigated advisory firms since its remit covers insurers and providers only.
When asked, the NZa states it has not conducted any investigation into this.
Desgevraagd geeft de NZa aan hier geen onderzoek naar te hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Maasstad pluist oud pand na op pillen en dossiers’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the discovery of patient-related forms and medication left in the former Clara hospital building, and whether the hospital handled records and privacy responsibly. The minister answered that the forms were older and had been scanned, that patient files are complete, that the hospital's own SIRE analysis found the situation was preventable, and that the privacy regulator closed its inquiry after the hospital said no medical data remained.
In hindsight, the situation at issue could have been prevented, as the hospital's own investigation also states.
Achteraf bezien was de situatie waar het hier om gaat te voorkomen geweest, zo stelt ook het eigen onderzoek van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman de bezuinigingen op de thuiszorg in Enschede onderzoekt

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that the National Ombudsman was investigating Enschede's home-care cuts, whether many clients never had a kitchen-table assessment, the number of Wmo complaints received, and whether 'clean and liveable home' is an acceptable standard. The secretary replied that no regular Ombudsman investigation exists yet (an internal municipal review is ongoing and Ombudsman staff will hold a surgery in January 2016), that Enschede conducted assessments and handled 170 objections, that the Ombudsman received 242 Wmo complaints across 111 municipalities, and that municipalities may keep the 'clean and liveable' terminology.
Based on the information the Ombudsman receives during this surgery, he will assess whether to carry out an investigation.
Op basis van de informatie die de No tijdens dit spreekuur krijgt, zal hij beoordelen of hij een onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het boek De Kraak van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the book on the Slotervaart hospital, covering the consultant's role, the heroin production contract with Di-AcetylM BV, dividends, board members' side activities, and oversight by regulators. The minister answered most questions, denying conflicts of interest and mostly deferring on the involvement of other bodies, while declining to give details of some hospital decisions for reasons of possible criminal risk and a confidentiality clause.
It is not for me to give an explanation of their functioning in the history of the Slotervaart hospital.
Het is niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op hun functioneren in de geschiedenis van het Slotervaartziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat thuiszorgorganisatie TSN loonsverlaging moet terugdraaien voor 4300 thuiszorgmedewerkers

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health whether a court ruling ordering TSN home care to reverse pay cuts for 4,300 workers shows that legal action should not be needed to secure decent wages, and what the government will do to prevent repeated litigation and restore basic home-care tariffs. The State Secretary said statutory guarantees function in practice, avoiding court is preferable, and an AMvB under WMO article 2.6.6 is being prepared to ensure careful procurement and reasonable tariffs, though he declined to comment on the ruling's implications for other providers beyond the specific case.
To that end, following the agreed joint approach with FNV, CNV and ActiZ, I intend to prepare an AMvB under article 2.6.6 of the WMO.
Daartoe heb ik naar aanleiding van de afgesproken gezamenlijke aanpak met FNV, CNV en ActiZ ben ik voornemens een AMvB op artikel 2.6.6 van de WMO voor te bereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht “Misstanden in de varkenshouderij”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a report by Varkens in Nood listing 120 abuses in Dutch pig farming, covering sick animals, enrichment materials, farrowing crates and water quality. The State Secretary responded that policy is being pursued through sector agreements and NVWA enforcement, that the NVWA finds sick animals are generally treated, that enrichment material shortages are declining, and that a stricter water-quality enforcement approach will be introduced from 2017.
In a few cases the NVWA sees that the treatment or housing is not appropriate to the condition.
In enkele gevallen ziet de NVWA dat de behandeling of huisvesting niet passend is bij de aandoening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar CZ de bonuscultuur introduceert in de operatiekamer

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer CZ's plan to reward Catharina Hospital cardiology quality (a bonus culture) is a stunt, whether the contract can be shared, and whether such pay-for-quality contracts should be banned. The minister answered that the bonus goes to hospital budget tied to measured outcomes, declined to share the private contract citing commercial confidentiality, and rejected a ban while supporting quality-based contracting.
These are agreements between private parties and they contain commercially sensitive information.
Dit zijn afspraken tussen private partijen en deze bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over misstanden in de nertsenhouderij en massale uitbreidingen door nertsenhouders

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about footage of injured mink, inspection and enforcement at mink farms, and reported mass expansions of mink farms. The State Secretary declined to explain the footage without knowing its origin, said inspections and warnings were carried out by the NVWA, confirmed some expansions via municipal permits while noting the ban had been suspended by court, and promised further examination of the matter.
Because it is unclear how, where and when the footage you refer to was obtained, I cannot interpret it further in relation to the current situation in the Dutch mink farming sector.
Omdat het onduidelijk is hoe, waar en wanneer de door u aangeduide beelden verkregen zijn, kan ik deze niet nader duiden in relatie tot de huidige situatie in de Nederlandse nertsenhouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag Wmo-indicaties stelt via een digitaal rekenprogramma

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Den Haag's use of a digital calculation program to assess Wmo care needs, instead of personal interviews, complies with the law, covering privacy, access, costs, staffing and whether the minister will intervene. The State Secretary answered that the digital procedure for simple requests does not fully meet Wmo 2015 requirements, that Den Haag is adjusting it by early 2016, and that he sees no reason to intervene since use of a supporting program is not in itself unlawful.
It is up to municipalities to make these choices.
Het is aan gemeenten om hier keuzes in te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen zich voorbereiden op het uitkeren van winst

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about hospitals converting to BVs ahead of allowing profit distribution, and about risks to premium money, public bailout funds, and investor returns. The minister replied that hospitals may choose their legal form, profit distribution stays banned until the bill passes, and the bill contains safeguards such as Inspectorate and NZa pre-checks.
I have now received the advice of the Council of State. I am currently examining what consequences this advice has for the bill and will then inform your House and the Senate.

Ik heb het advies van de Raad van State inmiddels ontvangen. Momenteel ben ik aan het bekijken welke gevolgen dit advies heeft voor het wetsvoorstel en zal vervolgens uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de reactie op de verzwegen misstanden bij Universitair Medisch Centrum Utrecht (UMCU) en de handelswijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether an ENT surgeon remains active during the Inspectorate's investigation, whether the department should be closed, and whether the Inspectorate can independently investigate its own conduct and the review period from 2009. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ investigates without closing the department, the hospital has relieved the doctors of patient care, the hospital will review deaths from 2011, and the IGZ will set the terms of an external commission.
The broader investigation is carried out by the IGZ, which is assisted by a commission.
Het bredere onderzoek wordt door de IGZ uitgevoerd, daarbij laat de IGZ zich bijstaan door een commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht Renteswap kost Zwols Isala-ziekenhuis minstens 25 miljoen euro

MP Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that an interest rate swap cost Isala hospital at least 25 million euros, and about supervision by the hospital's board and supervisory board. The minister said the hospital took an open position, that she will legally anchor a ban on risky derivatives in the WTZi, that she cannot judge the earlier decisions with today's knowledge, and that financial oversight of hospitals lies primarily with their boards and supervisory boards.
For the healthcare sector I want to legally anchor the principles of the derivatives policy framework through a provision in the WTZi 2.
Voor de zorgsector wil ik de uitgangspunten van het beleidskader derivaten wettelijk verankeren door middel van een voorziening in de WTZi 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het verlieslijdend Zorgsaam haar oud-bestuurders tonnen betaalt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about reports that loss-making Zorgsaam paid severance of several tonnes to ousted board members, questioning its morality, supervision of the supervisory board, and the reasoning behind amounts exceeding the Scheidsgerecht ruling. The minister said the WNT caps severance at 75,000 euro and institutions decide within legal bounds, a CIBG investigation into possible violations is ongoing, and she will address internal supervision professionalisation in a governance progress report.
The CIBG already has an investigation underway into a possible violation regarding severance payments at this healthcare institution.
Het CIBG heeft al een onderzoek lopen naar een mogelijke overtreding met betrekking tot ontslagvergoedingen bij deze zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een onnatuurlijke dood in zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the minister why the Inspectorate for Healthcare (IGZ) does not investigate unnatural deaths in care institutions, and whether external chairs and external expertise are appointed for calamity investigations, including why only elderly and disability care sectors got stricter rules and whether the Bartiméus family was pressured into signing a communication line. The state secretary answered that stricter rules apply to those two sectors from 1 October 2015, that IGZ reviews all calamity investigations and does not count follow-up investigations, and that pressure on the Bartiméus family would be regrettable though the family did not sign.
However, the IGZ currently does not register how often, within its calamity investigations, it does or does not instruct institutions to conduct their own follow-up investigations.
De IGZ registreert op dit moment echter niet hoe vaak zij binnen haar onderzoek naar calamiteiten, instellingen (g)een opdracht geeft om eigen (vervolg)onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

The MPs asked whether psycho-oncology centres such as the Helen Dowling Institute, as specialist mental health providers, should be funded as part of the somatic DBC/DOT system, what happens to psychological care after a somatic treatment ends, whether partners and children are covered, and whether the centres' continued existence falls under insurers' duty of care. The minister answered that a national working group report sets out actions for psychosocial care, that care stays within medical specialist care while the somatic trajectory continues and the GP is responsible afterwards, that family support falls under the insured entitlement, and that insurers must buy sufficient care but choose providers themselves.
Soon I will consult with the parties involved about who will take which action and when it should be completed.
Binnenkort overleg ik met betrokken partijen wie welke actie gaat oppakken en wanneer dat gereed moet komen.
