Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het opnieuw sluiten van verzorgingshuizen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why an 88-year-old resident and other elderly people must move because the Olde Heem care home is closing, whether this is acceptable, and whether the government will intervene to keep four homes open. State Secretary Van Rijn replied that closures through renovation and new building are normal, stressed intensive consultation with residents and relatives, declined to intervene because responsibility lies with the care group, corporations and municipalities, and said no national register of closures exists, citing care trends toward staying at home.
No national list is kept of care homes that close.
Er wordt landelijk geen lijst bijgehouden van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over medische claims over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the NVWA's January 2015 finding that Souvenaid is not medical dietary food, the warning to Nutricia, and enforcement after the deadline expired. The minister confirmed the finding and warning, said a September 2015 re-inspection found the product still sold as medical dietary food, and said the NVWA's standard intervention policy is being applied, with Nutricia able to respond.
The NVWA then started its intervention policy and is following it consistently and carefully.
De NVWA is vervolgens gestart met haar interventiebeleid en doorloopt deze consequent en zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over over selectieve zorginkoop en de gevolgen daarvan voor zorgaanbieders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about selective health-care procurement by Zilveren Kruis Achmea, including its termination of a shoemaker's contract and the fairness of the power balance with providers. The minister defended selective procurement as an important instrument, referred the contested contract dispute to the courts and to a planned complaints committee, and said the NZa and ACM oversee market power.
For the next contracting period a complaints committee will be established where care providers can go with complaints about the procurement procedure.
Voor de volgende contracteerperiode wordt een geschillencommissie in het leven geroepen waar zorgaanbieders met klachten over de inkoopprocedure terecht kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over patiëntenstops in de thuiszorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about patient intake stops in home care (wijkverpleging) where providers lack funding, asking why the government's promise that no one should be deprived of care is being broken and how the stops will be lifted. The state secretary answered that the insurers' duty of care is decisive, that insurers will contract additional care where needed, and that no additional budget is automatically provided, while stating the aim that no one is deprived of care.
Health insurers, however, have a duty of care for their insured persons.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben echter zorgplicht voor hun verzekerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Vijfsterren verpleeghuis in Bavel’

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether a five-star nursing home in Bavel, where a place costs about EUR 8,000 per month and mainly pgb holders will live, amounts to two-tier care that undermines regular care and access for those without money. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the Wlz guarantees equal rights to care, that clients may pay for extra services themselves, that providers need no Wtzi licence for Wlz care to pgb holders, and that the zorgkantoor is responsible for matching clients; he saw no tiering or capacity shortage and deferred housing shortages to corporations and municipalities.
The Wlz establishes an equal right to responsible and good-quality care for everyone who is entitled to Wlz care.
In de Wlz is een gelijk recht op verantwoorde en kwalitatief goede zorg vastgelegd voor iedereen die op de Wlz is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kraamafdeling Vlietland moet open blijven’

An SP MP asks the Health Minister how she views the planned closure of the Vlietland hospital maternity ward after its merger with Sint Franciscus Gasthuis, and whether closure is acceptable given accessibility for Vlaardingen and Schiedam residents. The minister replies that the hospital board is responsible for the arrangements, that accessibility and quality norms are the test, that she sees no scientific proof that scale enlargement improves care, and that she leaves regional planning to the insurers and local parties, without committing to a national plan.
It is not for me to decide whether a department in a hospital must remain open.
Het is niet aan mij om te bepalen of een afdeling in een ziekenhuis open moet blijven.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vergoeding in de basisverzekering van rifaximine (Xifaxan) voor de behandeling van chronische hepatische encefalopathie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether rifaximin should be reimbursed under basic insurance for preventing hepatic encephalopathy, and whether the Zorginstituut's negative advice on cost-effectiveness, using a 50,000 euro per QALY threshold, was justified. The Minister answered that the advice rested on an insufficiently documented cost-effectiveness analysis from the manufacturer, that the Zorginstituut could make no reliable assessment, and that she will not reverse the decision unless a new dossier is submitted.
I therefore maintain my decision not to include this medicine.
Ik blijf daarom bij mijn besluit om dit geneesmiddel niet op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over zorginstellingen die weigeren inzage te geven in het declaratiegedrag van bestuurders

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked why care institutions refuse to disclose board members' expense claims and whether the minister will oblige them by law to make declarations transparent. The minister regrets the lack of transparency, says governance is the sector's own responsibility, and points to the upcoming revision of the sector-wide governance code and a survey of expense rules at university medical centres.
Good governance and the associated integrity policy are the responsibility of care providers themselves.
Goed bestuur en het daarbij behorende integriteitsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal rechtszaken over zorg fors is gestegen

MPs Van Gerven and Van Nispen asked why lawsuits over municipal Wmo care decisions keep rising, whether the government will intervene, and whether higher court fees and cuts to legal aid endanger citizens' access to justice. The Secretary of State answered that the rise partly stems from the new Wmo 2015 and that municipalities should improve careful implementation, with the government able to use supervisory powers only in cases of structural non-compliance, while declining to register social costs and promising a decision on legal aid after a commission report.
It is up to municipalities to learn from these rulings where necessary and improve policy implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om – waar nog nodig – lering te trekken uit deze uitspraken en de beleidsuitvoering te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over bemiddelingsbureaus in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rates and services of intermediary agencies in care, the scope of the planned study, whether agency staff acting as representatives of budget holders is undesirable, and whether contracts can be bought out without penalty. The State Secretary said the study is being tendered and has priority, that agency representatives may fail the 'gewaarborgde hulp' standard, that a 'black list' is being explored, and that contract matters are civil and outside government involvement.
The study was promised to the House of Representatives and has priority for me.
Het onderzoek is toegezegd aan de Tweede Kamer en heeft prioriteit voor mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten gaat de mist in met bonus’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Natuurmonumenten paid its director a bonus in breach of sector rules, omitted it from the annual report, and about the director's salary and raise. The State Secretary replied that the association's employment terms are its own matter and declined to assess the specifics, while stating the questions were answered adequately.
It is therefore not for me to give my judgment on specific parts of the employment terms about which you have asked questions.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om mijn oordeel te geven over specifieke onderdelen van de arbeidsvoorwaarden, waarover u vragen heeft gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een nieuw systeem voor een veiliger patiëntendossier

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how she views Amsterdam GPs' alternative to the national LSP patient-data exchange, whether a pilot giving three care institutions LSP access falls within existing patient consent, and whether the privacy regulator was involved. The minister answered that oversight of systems rests with the CBP, that she cannot guarantee GPs' contracting freedom, and that the pilot relies on existing consent and no separate CBP review is required.
It is for the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens to supervise this and take enforcement action.
Het is aan het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens daar toezicht op te houden en handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about marketing of Souvenaid as a medical dietary product for early Alzheimer's, its price, online sales, and NVWA enforcement, including whether labelling has been corrected. The minister answered that NVWA found Souvenaid does not meet the definition of medical dietary food, issued a warning to Nutricia, and that further steps depend on the company's response, while several questions were deferred to the NVWA or left without substantive detail.
The NVWA then established that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of dietary food for medical use.
De NVWA heeft vervolgens vastgesteld dat Souvenaid niet aan de definitie voor dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik voldoet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat gemeenten in Gelderland 1,1 miljoen euro willen investeren in een ondersteuningsbureau dat de inkoop van jeugdzorg en uitvoering van de Wet maats

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about seven Gelderland municipalities investing 1.1 million euro in a regional procurement support bureau for youth care and Wmo, questioning overhead costs and whether residents get the care they need. The state secretary replied that the investment is about 1% of the 108 million euro budget, that municipalities are responsible for organising execution, and that statutory safeguards and supervisory powers exist, though no national data on transaction costs are available.
The way municipalities organise the implementation of the Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act is the responsibility of the municipalities.
De wijze waarop gemeenten de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet organiseren, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat te veel uitgaven aan pgb-gelden (persoonsgebonden budget) ten koste gaat van intramurale zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether a reported overrun on personal budget (pgb) funding is causing cuts to institutional care, and why Achmea Zorgkantoren reported a shortfall while the government expected no pgb shortages. The State Secretary answered that regional shortfalls are expected to be resolved by reallocating funds among care offices, that the NZa will issue an updated advice in October, and that the national budget is sufficient, while answering several figure-based questions only partly.
I have therefore asked the care offices to actively consult with each other on reallocating the available funds.
Ik heb de zorgkantoren daarom gevraagd om actief met elkaar in overleg te gaan over de herverdeling van de beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Geen tijd meer voor gewone darmpatiënt’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports of longer waiting lists for bowel surgery at academic centres, possibly caused by bowel cancer screening, and a delayed operation for a patient. The minister said the causes are unclear, stressed that providers must refer patients and insurers must meet their care duty, and pointed to new specialist training places and existing waiting-time norms.
It is the duty of the care provider to deliver responsible care.
Het is de plicht van de zorgverlener om verantwoorde zorg te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat TNO bezuinigt op onderzoek naar maatschappelijke thema’s

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reported cuts at TNO affecting research on societal themes such as work and health, the effect of VAT rules, and which research would stop. The minister answered that the cuts stem from earlier coalition agreement targets, that TNO will keep quality of work and health knowledge, that a preliminary allocation is still being negotiated, and that the Beschikking will be finalised by the cabinet later.
The national government will carefully monitor over the coming year whether the desired quality is still being provided.
De rijksoverheid zal het komende jaar zorgvuldig monitoren of de gewenste kwaliteit nog steeds wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over "de (h)erkenning van endometriose"

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether endometriosis is grounds for UWV to refuse sickness benefit or disability assessment, and why Netherlands has not formally recognised it as an illness. The government answered that a diagnosis alone does not determine entitlement; the insurance physician assesses functional limitations, guided by an international ESHRE guideline, and that recognising diseases is the task of professional bodies, not the state.
Recognising illnesses is not a government task.
Het erkennen van ziekten is geen overheidstaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) die geen onderzoek doet bij een niet-natuurlijk overlijden in zorginstellingen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the health inspectorate IGZ does not investigate non-natural deaths in care institutions, how often such deaths go uninvestigated, and whether the IGZ can rely on institutions' own inquiries, which may be shaped by reputational concerns. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ will widen family involvement and use an external chair for inquiries in elderly and disability care, that the IGZ does not register many of the figures asked for, and that the IGZ assesses institutions' calamity reports while the public prosecutor handles possible crimes.
The IGZ does not register this, so I cannot answer this question.
De IGZ registreert dit niet, dus ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over bestuurders van academische ziekenhuizen die massaal de declaratieregels aan hun laars lappen

Two SP MPs asked the minister about academic hospital board members who allegedly ignore expense rules, with luxury and private spending charged to care funds. The minister regrets the reports, asked the hospital federations to remind members of frugality, says individual cases and enforcement fall to the supervisory boards, and points to a planned NFU inventory of expense rules.
I cannot go into the individual cases. The information for that is lacking. It is also not my task; it is a task of the Supervisory Board.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de individuele casuïstiek. Daarvoor ontbreekt informatie. Het is ook niet mijn taak, het is een taak van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een bestuurder voor twee weken werk ruim één ton vangt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether a UMC Maastricht board member received over one hundred thousand euros for about 15 days of work, whether the dismissal was timed across New Year to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether this reflects good governance and internal conflict. The minister replied that the severance was for the whole six-plus-year employment, that WNT norms cannot be evaded by postponing payment, that the supervisor CIBG will examine the case, and that she has no insight into the reasons for the departure.
The supervisor on compliance with the WNT in healthcare, the CIBG, will investigate this case.
De toezichthouder op de naleving van de WNT in de zorg, het CIBG, zal deze casus onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgbehoevende kinderen van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd worden

SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports that disabled children were being shunted from the CIZ to municipalities and denied Wlz care and day treatment. The secretary answered that five of eight Wlz applications were rejected on the access criteria, one was transferred to a municipality under the Jeugdwet, two remain under review, and he will work with VNG and the CIZ on clearer boundaries.
Only the CIZ is authorised to assess access to the Wlz, which guarantees an objective, expert and uniform indication process.
Uitsluitend het CIZ is bevoegd om de toegang tot de Wlz te beoordelen, waardoor een objectieve, deskundige en uniforme indicatiestelling is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten gaat de mist in met bonus’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Natuurmonumenten paid its director a bonus contrary to sector rules, omitted it from the annual report, and raised salaries, and whether the government would hold the organisation to account. The State Secretary answered that Natuurmonumenten is a private association whose remuneration is its own matter, that sector standards apply, and that ministry subsidies concern specific activities separate from director pay.
The employment conditions of the directors and other employees of Natuurmonumenten are a matter for the association itself.
De arbeidsvoorwaarden van de directie en overige medewerkers van Natuurmonumenten betreft een aangelegenheid van de vereniging zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over onmenselijk beleid door de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015(Wmo 2015)

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about municipalities cutting or refusing home help under the Wmo 2015, including a terminally ill man in Waalwijk, and asked whether the government would intervene and why rulings keep being needed. The state secretary answered that municipal councils are primarily responsible for overseeing municipal implementation, that the government will only intervene in cases of systematic non-compliance, that individual assessments are required, and that he has already written to aldermen and will keep monitoring.

Only when facts show a municipality deviates from the law more than incidentally and the municipal council fails to take its responsibility, do I have the option, under conditions, to use the powers under Article 2.6.8 of the Wmo 2015 and the generic supervision revitalisation act.

Pas als uit de feiten blijkt dat een gemeente meer dan incidenteel afwijkt van de wet en de gemeenteraad haar verantwoordelijkheid daarin niet neemt, heb ik onder voorwaarden de mogelijkheid om van de bevoegdheden in het kader van artikel 2.6.8 van de Wmo 2015 en de Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de problemen met de Wmo in Berkelland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary about Berkelland municipality cutting home help for a 96-year-old man, the large number of objections filed, and who pays for handling them. The state secretary replied that municipalities must provide tailored support under the Wmo 2015, that Berkelland is contacting affected residents and reviewing cases, and that handling objections is a municipal cost, not a national review matter.
Berkelland municipality held a conversation with all residents who previously received level 1 home help in the first half of 2015.
De gemeente Berkelland heeft met alle inwoners die in het verleden de voorziening huishoudelijke hulp niveau 1 kregen in de eerste helft van 2015 een gesprek gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet volledig vergoeden van palliatieve zorg

SP MPs asked whether insurer Achmea/Zilveren Kruis may refuse to reimburse professional presence during rest or sleep in the dying phase and whether guidance and aftercare for relatives falls under home-nursing coverage. The State Secretary says the insurer has clarified that all palliative terminal care, including rest-time presence and aftercare for relatives, is covered and declarable, and that the insurer has a duty of care without a cap on hours.
Enquiries with Zilveren Kruis show that the above statement is a misinterpretation of the home-nursing purchasing policy.
Navraag bij Zilveren Kruis leert dat bovengenoemde uitspraak een verkeerde interpretatie van het inkoopbeleid wijkverpleging is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tabakslobby toch weer bij Van Rijn aan tafel’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about a reported June 2015 meeting with tobacco retailers shortly before a debate on tobacco policy, including whether minutes were kept, the scope of contacts with the tobacco lobby, and whether such contacts should be minimised and recorded. The State Secretary answered that a meeting on 17 June 2015 with alcohol and tobacco sellers addressed youth age-check compliance and that no minutes were made, but the outcome was reported to Parliament; he stated that the ministry had no official meetings with the tobacco industry in the past year and that contacts are kept restrained and transparent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de toegenomen problemen met zorgverzekeraars die weigeren bereide of merkmedicijnen te vergoeden

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurers refusing to reimburse compounded and brand-name medicines, including inconsistent coverage, the Competition Act's effect on coordinated benefit decisions, and forced switching to biosimilars. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for applying the basic package, that talks with ZN, Zorginstituut and ACM are ongoing with a solution promised before the end of summer, and that prescribing decisions rest with the treating physician, while largely declining to address the specific cases and motions raised.
I am in discussion with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland and the ACM about a possible solution to this.
Ik ben met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN), Zorginstituut Nederland en de ACM in overleg over een mogelijke oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het per direct opstappen van de bestuursvoorzitter van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sudden resignation of the chair of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital board, insurer CZ's role, and whether the supervisory board and regulators failed. The minister answered that the supervisory board is responsible for board appointments and dismissals, that insurers may voice quality concerns, that the IGZ had acted, and that she sees no need to change the system.
I currently have no insight into the conditions under which this board member's employment contract was terminated.
Ik heb op dit moment geen inzicht in de voorwaarden waaronder de arbeidsovereenkomst van deze bestuurder is beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het mogelijk onbewust aangaan van een budgetpolis en de niet te voorziene gevolgen daarvan

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether budget health insurance policies, which restrict hospital choice, are really cheaper, since insured people paid more in co-payments on average. Minister Schippers answered that most budget-policy holders had no co-payments, that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care, and that Achmea informed budget-policy holders and offered switching, with 97% choosing not to switch.
Health insurers are obliged to properly inform their insured about which care is contracted for a policy.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn verplicht om hun verzekerden goed te informeren over welke zorgaanbod gecontracteerd is voor een polis
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financieringsproblemen bij specialistische psychische hulp voor mensen met kanker

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why specialised psychological care for cancer patients depends on fundraising, and whether patients with adjustment disorders are excluded from insured care. The Minister said she is not against private funding but will not intervene in provider operations or insurer tariffs, has asked insurers to promote peer centres and will report before the budget debate, and maintains that adjustment disorders stay outside the insured package.
As Minister, I do not concern myself with the business operations of individual care providers.
Ik ga als Minister niet over de bedrijfsvoering van individuele zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de onvolledigheid van het Transparantieregister Zorg

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the Transparantieregister Zorg, a largely voluntary register of payments from pharmaceutical firms to doctors and hospitals, gives a complete picture, and whether it should be enforced by the inspectorate. Minister Schippers answered that the register is adequate within its chosen framework, that self-regulation works, that the IGZ already has enforcement powers, and that no new law is needed.
I am of the view that, within the framework chosen for the register, the Transparantieregister gives a good picture of the financial relationships doctors have with pharmaceutical companies.
Ik ben van mening dat, binnen de kaders die voor het register gekozen zijn, het Transparantieregister een goed beeld geeft van de financiële relaties die artsen hebben met farmaceutische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de NVWA

MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about the NVWA's requirement of a transport document per horse for travel to Germany, whether a three-month document or a Germany-wide memorandum could reduce bureaucracy, and about a bakery cat ban. The government answered that EU rules require health certification per animal, that a Benelux memorandum exists but Germany is not yet covered (talks with the German riding federation are underway), and that the cat must be removed under EU hygiene rules.
With Germany it has so far not been possible to conclude such an agreement, which means that all horses crossing the border into Germany must be certified.
Met Duitsland is het tot op heden niet gelukt om zo'n overeenkomst te sluiten, wat betekent dat alle paarden die de grens overgaan naar Duitsland gecertificeerd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over toenemende goodwillpraktijken bij huisartsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about rising goodwill payments by young GPs taking over practices, the scale of the problem, insurers' contract clauses and possible legal measures. The Minister opposes goodwill, says its scale is unknown, notes only one insurer has a clause, and promises further analysis and a letter after the summer.
At present I am analysing what options there are to prevent goodwill. After the summer I will inform you again on this subject by letter.
Op dit moment analyseer ik welke mogelijkheden er zijn om goodwill te voorkomen. Na de zomer zal ik u per brief opnieuw over dit onderwerp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een Europese berisping van Nederlandse nertsenhouders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about EU criticism that Dutch mink farmers' killing practices lack a notification system and proper controls, and about inspection, sanctions and the gassing method. The government acknowledged the missing notification system, said it is being set up with regulatory changes due in 2015, and described past inspections, possible administrative sanctions and planned controls from 2016, while not sanctioning farmers for past non-notification.
The NVWA is currently setting up a notification system.
De NVWA richt momenteel een meldingssysteem in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over zieke rashonden en het Fairfok-keurmerk

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs why the Fairfok plan of the Dutch kennel club would succeed where earlier agreements failed, and about guarantees, inbreeding, DNA testing, breed standards and enforcement of the animal welfare breeding ban. The State Secretary answered that the plan is ambitious and broadly supported, that targets are reducing sick dogs to 25% by 2019 and 10% by 2024, that no guarantee of health can be given, and that enforcement of article 3.4 has started.

How far guarantees about the absence of hereditary conditions can be given when buying a Fairfok puppy will have to become clear in the elaboration of the Fairfok project plan by the Raad van Beheer and the other organisations involved.

In hoeverre garanties over afwezigheid van erfelijke aandoeningen bij aankoop van een Fairfok-pup kunnen worden gegeven, zal in de uitwerking van het projectplan «Fairfok» door Raad van Beheer en de andere betrokken organisaties moeten gaan blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat AstraZeneca Hartpatiënten Nederland dreigt met een proces

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views AstraZeneca's threatened legal action against the patient organisation Hartpatiënten Nederland over its warnings about Onglyza, and about patients' right to information and the drug's safety. The minister answers that legal threats are unconstructive while dialogue continues, that patient groups may state views if well-founded, notes the CBG is reviewing the FDA safety analysis, and declines further action.
I do not find it constructive for the dialogue when legal proceedings are threatened at the same time.
Ik vind het voor de dialoog daarbij niet constructief wanneer er gelijktijdig met juridische procedures wordt gedreigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het onder druk zetten van de cliëntenraad voor het programma ‘Anita wordt opgenomen’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the management of GGZ-Centraal pressured the client council into allowing the filming of the TV programme 'Anita wordt opgenomen', and about patient consent, possible damage claims, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister said pressure on the client council would be regrettable if proven, that the matter is for the supervisory board and the Landelijke Commissie van Vertrouwenslieden, that the IGZ would handle a new signal, and that medezeggenschap rules will be tightened.
It is not for me to assess whether the care provider exerted pressure on the client council to end the advisory process and whether (high) damage claims were discussed.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of de zorgaanbieder daarbij druk heeft uitgeoefend op de cliëntenraad om het adviestraject te beëindigen en of er daarbij gesproken is over (hoge) schadeclaims.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir ,Van Gerven en Schouw over een einde aan de kraambox voor zeugen en enige andere samenhangende vragen

MPs Bashir, Van Gerven and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ending farrowing crates for sows, the Pro Dromi alternative, funding for its research, nesting material and inspections, and the EU welfare guidelines, covering 16 questions. The State Secretary answered that Pro Dromi is promising but needs further optimisation before wider rollout, declined to make it mandatory to preserve innovation, pointed to existing funding routes, and said nesting material is largely exempt due to manure systems.
I will discuss with the Dutch pig producers' organisation (POV) and the entrepreneurs involved which bottlenecks exist in practical implementation.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de Producentenorganisatie Varkenshouderij (POV) en de betrokken ondernemers om na te gaan welke knelpunten er zijn bij de praktijkimplementatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Kleine ziekenhuizen: Grote Financiële nood’

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about a BDO report showing financial strain at small hospitals, including the 'stress test' results, the role of the macro-control instrument and the availability allowance. The Minister answered that hospitals must manage their finances themselves, that small hospitals are less resilient but can remain viable, that the availability allowance criteria will be revised and that the macro-control instrument is a last resort, with a letter to follow.
I have informed your House about the macro-control instrument in my letter of 31 March 2015.
Over het macrobeheersinstrument heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd met brief van 31 maart 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voorgenomen sluiting van de enige nachtapotheek in de regio De Langstraat

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the planned closure of the only night pharmacy in De Langstraat, its effect on 45-minute access norms, the HAP/SEH merger and regional plans. The minister replied that insurers are responsible for contracting out-of-hours pharmaceutical care, that emergency medication remains available via Tilburg and Den Bosch pharmacies and GPs, that no statutory distance norm exists, and that the regional plans were abandoned by insurers in 2014.
Whether insurers comply with their duty of care is for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over materiële controles door zorgverzekeraars bij huisartsen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether Achmea's statistically triggered material audits of GP practices, including detailed checks that may breach medical confidentiality, are justified, and raised related issues such as terminal-care limits and a contractual gag clause. The Minister replied that audits follow a statutory stepwise procedure with privacy safeguards, that the insurer had communicated poorly in one case, and that she will ask the NZa to review insurers' contracting models and will look into the gag clause.
Health insurers themselves determine how they carry out material audits within the applicable laws and regulations.
Zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf hoe zij binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving de materiële controles uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van het openbaar maken van het calamiteitenrapport van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over de casus Tuitjenhorn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the IGZ calamity report on the Tuitjenhorn case, which concerns euthanasia practice, was not yet made public and whether it could clarify matters before the evaluation commission reports. Minister Schippers answered that the report will be sent to parliament together with the commission's report on 31 March 2015, with some passages redacted for privacy, and that publication was delayed to avoid obstructing the independent investigation.
In line with the previously announced intention, the Minister of Security and Justice and I will send the IGZ calamity report to your House together with the commission's report.

Conform het eerder aan uw Kamer gemelde voornemen, zullen de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik het calamiteitenrapport van de IGZ, gezamenlijk met het rapport van de commissie, aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over berichtgeving omtrent het schandaal bij AquaPurga in Den Bosch

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, health risks, subsidies, and liability at manure processor AquaPurga following press reports. The government answered that it cannot disclose individual inspection or bankruptcy information, found no known health risks to residents, and stated that liability for workplace health damage lies between employer and employee, with courts deciding if they disagree.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make the results of an inspection at an individual company public.
Inspectie SZW maakt de resultaten van een inspectie bij een individueel bedrijf niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de praktijken van het AOT Instituut en de heer Barry W.

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the Minister of Health about the unproven addiction treatments at AOT Instituut and whether the IGZ and advertising rules can act against them. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ has no basis under current law to intervene unless harm is proven, that insurers set their own supplementary packages, and that a planned quality law (Wkkgz) would let the IGZ act on excesses.
The IGZ can only act against irresponsible treatment methods if there is a demonstrable link between the harm caused and the (alternative) treatment.
De IGZ kan alleen dan optreden tegen onverantwoorde behandelwijzen, als er sprake is van een aantoonbare relatie tussen ontstane schade en de (alternatieve) behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck gelanceerd’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the launch of the Persoonlijke Gezondheidscheck, a preventive health check, raising concerns about false reassurance, legality under the population screening law, commercial interests, unequal access and unnecessary care. The minister answered that the check is lawful in its current form, that its effects on health gains are not yet known and will be monitored, and that the Health Council is advising on health check criteria.
Whether large-scale application of such an instrument actually yields health gains, we do not yet know.
Of grootschalig toepassen van een dergelijk instrument ook daadwerkelijk gezondheidswinst oplevert, weten we nog niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het uitblijven van onderzoek naar effectiviteit en veiligheid van nieuwe antistollingsmiddelen

Two SP MPs asked why, more than two years after the introduction of NOACs (new anticoagulants), no independent safety, effectiveness and cost-effectiveness research has been completed, and raised conflict-of-interest concerns about the lead researcher. The minister replied that a pilot was run, a more demanding methodology is being developed by ZonMw and the researchers, Lareb monitors side effects, and that current evidence gives no reason to change the conclusion that the drugs are appropriately used.
It is not the case that research into the effectiveness and safety has failed to materialise.
Het is niet zo dat het onderzoek naar de effectiviteit en veiligheid uitgebleven is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht ‘Drankje tegen Alzheimer Souvenaid te snel op de markt’

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether Souvenaid was marketed too early, whether industry influence (Nutricia, Deltaplan Dementie) compromises research independence, and about dementia prevalence figures. Minister Schippers answered that the NVWA concluded Souvenaid does not meet the medical dietary food definition and enforcement has started, that ZonMw's conflict-of-interest codes and transparency register provide sufficient safeguards, and that prevalence estimates broadly align with international studies.
The NVWA investigation has been completed. The NVWA concluded that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of food for special medical purposes.
Het onderzoek van de NVWA is afgerond. De NVWA heeft geconcludeerd dat Souvenaid niet voldoet aan de definitie van dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over “patiënten met een armenpolis die steeds vaker bij moeten betalen na een behandeling in het ziekenhuis”

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about patients with budget health insurance policies who are increasingly billed by hospitals after treatment, asking about scale, costs, insurer information duties and contracting obligations. The minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders, that data is being requested from insurers and an NVZ survey found affected patients at 73% of hospitals, that a hospital portal is being developed, and that reintroducing a contracting obligation is undesirable.
I have no data on the number of people who use the option of installment payments linked to bills not reimbursed by the health insurer because the care was not contracted.

Ik heb geen gegevens over het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen, dat samenhangt met rekeningen die niet vergoed worden door de zorgverzekeraar omdat er geen sprake is van gecontracteerde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slechte score op voedselveiligheid van visbedrijven

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about the poor food safety scores of fish processing firms, the NVWA's inspection frequency and capacity, the classification of Foppen as 'red' despite earlier praise from the Safety Board, and why inspection reports are published later for processors than auctions. Minister Schippers acknowledged the share of 'green' firms is too low, defended the inspection system and its risk-based frequency, declined to disclose individual firm inspection results, and committed to adding inspectors and publishing reports from 2015-2016.
I do not inform the House about the individual inspection results.
Ik informeer de Kamer niet over de individuele inspectieresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over collectieve zorgverzekeringen waarbij chronisch zieken geen baat hebben (opnieuw en nu met de nagezonden bijlage)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about chronically ill people not benefiting from municipal collective health insurance, the loss of compensation schemes, and the removal of long-term physiotherapy for rheumatism from the basic package. The minister rejected the premise, said municipalities have been expanding collective schemes and bear responsibility for support, and maintained that evidence for long-term physiotherapy is insufficient while remaining open to a study.
Due to the multitude of factors, it is not feasible to give a clear picture of the costs and their development.
Door de veelheid van factoren is het niet doenlijk om een duidelijk beeld van de kosten en de ontwikkeling daarin te schetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het niet vergoed krijgen van medisch noodzakelijke plastische chirurgie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about medically necessary plastic surgery no longer covered in basic insurance, citing cases such as a teenager with Poland syndrome and an older woman with drooping eyelids. The minister replied that the 2005 restrictions aim to prevent cosmetic procedures being billed as necessary, that she has no plans to widen coverage now, and that specialists must first show they use care appropriately.
I currently have no plans to expand coverage of plastic surgery in health insurance or to loosen the existing limited coverage.
Ik heb momenteel geen plannen om de vergoeding van plastische chirurgie in de zorgverzekering uit te breiden of de bestaande beperkte vergoeding te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that this year's flu vaccine offers little protection, whether the mismatch was foreseeable, and whether the vaccination should be evaluated or cancelled. The minister answered that the strain selection is made months in advance and a mismatch could not be ruled out, declined to quantify extra cases or deaths and the extra costs, and rejected a new evaluation and cancellation as unwarranted, while noting planned effectiveness research.
Direct, reliable information on the number of deaths from flu is not available.
Directe, betrouwbare informatie over het aantal sterfgevallen door griep is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het feit dat de griepprik dit jaar amper bescherming biedt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible conflict of interest of committee member Wilschut, who has paid ties to Sanofi Pasteur, and about the membership of a new Gezondheidsraad committee on antivirals. The minister answered that disclosed interests do not automatically constitute a conflict, that the Gezondheidsraad's conflict-of-interest procedures were followed, that the new committee is not yet installed and its composition will be published, and that no new antiviral stock will be bought before the Kamer can form a view unless circumstances require otherwise.
I do think it is important that full transparency is practised in this regard.
Ik vind het wel belangrijk dat hierover volledige transparantie betracht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over veertig keer zo duur worden van een geneesmiddel na nieuwe registratie

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the re-registration of MabCampath (leukaemia drug) as Lemtrada for multiple sclerosis, raising the price from about 15 to 618 euro per milligram, and whether such price increases should be curbed and the drug excluded. The minister called the price difference discutable and said pricing reform, EU and competition aspects are being examined, with the Zorginstituut's assessment awaited before deciding on reimbursement and any financial arrangement.
I disapprove if manufacturers were to choose to pursue disproportionately high profit margins over taking their social responsibility to contribute to patient care at acceptable prices.
Ik keur het af indien fabrikanten zouden kiezen voor het nastreven van onevenredig hoge winstmarges boven het nemen van hun maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het explosief stijgend aantal mensen dat het eigen risico niet meer kan betalen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the sharp rise in people unable to pay their mandatory deductible (eigen risico), including payment arrangements with insurers, reactions to reported avoidance of necessary care, and whether the deductible should be phased out. The minister said she lacks data on the total rise in payment arrangements, pointed to planned research on care avoidance and a Vektis analysis, and ruled out abolishing or reducing the deductible for now.
I have no insight into the increase in the number of people using the option to pay the deductible in instalments.
Ik heb geen inzage in de stijging van het aantal mensen dat gebruik maakt van de mogelijkheid tot gespreid betalen van het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de klantenwerving van zorgverzekeraars

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurer Promovendum approaching people unsolicited, about inducements such as free months, gifts and referral payments used to attract customers to health insurers, and whether these target profitable groups (risk selection). The Minister answered that insurers may set their own marketing strategy within legal limits, that she asked the NZa to examine indirect risk selection, and that she would act if the NZa finds problems, while leaving cost data and some questions to the insurers and the NZa.
If the research shows that there is risk selection with certain policies, I will take the necessary measures.
Als uit het onderzoek naar voren komt dat er sprake is van risicoselectie bij bepaalde polissen, dan zal ik de nodige maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van zorginstelling Pyxis zelf hun persoonsgebonden budget aan Agis Zorgkantoor moeten terugbetalen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether former clients of care provider Pyxis should be forced to repay their personal budgets to Agis Zorgkantoor, and what the government will do about the fraud-related situation and the SVB's readiness to detect pgb fraud. The state secretary said an investigation is ongoing, repayment claims are suspended, talks on support for good-faith budget holders are underway, and the new trekkingsrecht system improves monitoring, while declining to comment on the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigation, I cannot respond substantively to the situation.
Vanwege het lopende onderzoek kan ik niet inhoudelijk op de situatie reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) van ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about reports that the intensive care unit at Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen would be scaled down, including internal intensivist emails, possible links to a concept plan, insurer Achmea's role, staff consequences and consistency with the Minister's stance on small regional hospitals. The Minister answered that the IC is not being closed, that the internal note is only a discussion document, that patients are transferred to Emmen only when medically necessary or after 72 hours of ventilation, and that the board, insurers and supervisory bodies bear the responsibility.
The inspectorate supervises the quality of care delivered and checks whether the preconditions for care are present.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit van geleverde zorg en toetst of de randvoorwaarden voor geleverde zorg aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de dreigende sluiting van de intensive care (IC) in Ziekenhuis Bethesda te Hoogeveen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the planned closure of intensive care units at Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal hospitals was known in advance, whether the board chair's assurances were credible, and whether limited special care with remote intensivist consultation is responsible. The minister answered that the document is an internal discussion note without decision status, no closure is decided, the board remains responsible, the supervisory board should be involved in any decision, and quality oversight lies with the IGZ and NZa.

Once the new guideline is established, organisation-wide policy on IC care will be set so that it meets all requirements for responsible care as well as the Treant Zorggroep multi-year policy framework.

Zodra de nieuwe richtlijn is vastgesteld zal het organisatiebreed beleid ten aanzien van de IC-zorg vastgesteld worden, zodanig dat het zowel voldoet aan alle eisen die er aan verantwoorde zorg gesteld worden als aan het meerjarenbeleidskader van de Treant Zorggroep
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over het faillissement van Thebe

MPs asked whether Brabant municipalities stopping household help for some clients on 1 January 2015 conflicts with a court ruling and the duty of care, and whether the State Secretary would intervene in the bankruptcy of Thebe. The State Secretary answered that municipalities must assess clients individually, that a categorical termination is not allowed, that he has informed all Wmo aldermen, and that the court and curator handle the bankruptcy, so he declined to comment on Thebe's finances.
A categorical termination of an ongoing provision is not permitted under the law.
Een categoriale stopzetting van een lopende voorziening is niet toegestaan op grond van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven toekomen over onderhoud van otter- en dassentunnels

An MP asked the government about badger and otter tunnels left flooded or unmaintained, the cost of construction and maintenance, otter deaths in fyke nets and on roads, and responsibility after decentralisation. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat has tightened maintenance for its tunnels, that most tunnels are managed by provinces and municipalities over which the minister has no responsibility, and that the government is appealing and implementing a court ruling on otter road hazards.
I bear no responsibility for the maintenance of these.
Voor het onderhoud hiervan draag ik geen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de berichtgeving over foute buitenlandse tandartsen die hun praktijken in Nederland voortzetten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Health Minister about reports that foreign dentists barred from practising in their home countries continued working in the Netherlands, and about registration checks, language requirements and the BIG register. Minister Schippers answered that the CIBG now checks for foreign restrictions via information exchange and a pilot, that language testing is being studied within the EU directive implementation, and that the CIBG does not itself check deregistered persons' practice, while rejecting a dentist shortage argument.
The CIBG does not check whether persons who have been struck off the BIG register actually stop practising in the Netherlands or abroad.
Het CIBG controleert niet of personen die zijn doorgehaald in het BIG-register ook daadwerkelijk hun beroep in Nederland of daarbuiten niet meer uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de reactie van de minister op de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie met betrekking tot het afschaffen van de vrije artsenkeuze

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister whether her claim that abolishing free choice of doctor complies with the EU Court of Justice ruling and the patient rights directive was accurate, and about the legal basis and savings of the measure. The minister rejects accusations of misrepresentation, argues the amended Article 13 Zvw fits the directive and Council of State advice, and provides the savings justification of about 1 billion euro.
There is no question of distorting facts regarding rulings of the European Court of Justice.
Er is geen sprake van het verdraaien van feiten inzake uitspraken van het Europees Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het verband tussen de toename van het aantal spoedritten en inzet van de traumahelikopter en het gebruikte uitvraagsysteem

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether the rising number of emergency ambulance and trauma helicopter dispatches is linked to the AMPDS/ProQA or NTS dispatch systems, and about related data and staff effects. The minister answered that the systems were introduced only gradually since 2011-2014, so no link can yet be analysed, that data on dispatches and MMT deployments are provided, and that the cause of the growth is still being investigated.
I do not yet have a good understanding of the causes of the growth in the number of emergency rides. I am having research carried out into this.
Ik heb op dit moment nog geen goed inzicht in de oorzaken van de groei van het aantal spoedritten. Ik laat hier onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van rapid responders en brambulances

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the rising use of rapid responders in ambulance dispatch and about a 'brambulance' pilot in Rotterdam-Rijnmond, including liability and effectiveness. The Minister defends rapid responders as speeding patient care, rejects further research and the claim that they are used merely to meet response times, and promises an evaluation of the pilot by early 2015.
Once the evaluation is ready, the safety region will make it public so that interested parties can take note of it.
Zodra de evaluatie gereed is, zal deze door de veiligheidsregio openbaar worden gemaakt zodat geïnteresseerden hier kennis van kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de op 1 oktober 2014 geopende CareToGo op het centraal station van Den Haag

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about CareToGo, a privately run walk-in clinic at The Hague central station, raising concerns about paid care, prescribing, data sharing, the doctor-patient relationship and costs. Minister Schippers answered that the clinic is a permitted new entrant outside the basic insurance package, that it does not affect costs or gatekeeping, and that it is privately financed, with no insurers or pharma firms involved.
CareToGo has informed me that no health insurers or pharmaceutical companies are behind CareToGo.
CareToGo heeft mij bericht dat er geen zorgverzekeraars of farmaceutische bedrijven achter CareToGo te zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Vrouw-Moeder-Kind-centrum in het Atrium ziekenhuis in Heerlen er niet komt

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister whether the planned women-mother-child centre at Atrium hospital in Heerlen has been cancelled and whether the Heerlen-Sittard hospital merger should be abandoned. The minister denies the centre is cancelled, says the merger is on track for 1 January 2015, and states that hospital boards and the NZA/regulators are responsible for the details.
I do not recognise or know the confidential documents. It is up to the boards of Atrium and Orbis to prepare the further implementation of the centre.
Ik herken en ken de vertrouwelijk stukken niet. Het is aan de Raden van Bestuur van Atrium en Orbis om de verdere invulling van het centrum voor te bereiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over twee urgente patiënten in een huisartsenpraktijk die de afgelopen week niet opgenomen konden worden in een verzorgings/verpleeghuis terwijl kamers leeg staan

Two SP MPs asked why two urgent patients could not be admitted to a care or nursing home while beds were reportedly empty, and whether doorzettingsmacht for GPs was possible. The State Secretary replied that providers hold crisis capacity and a 24-hour solution is required, that one patient chose to wait and the other died, and that a check on the number of wait-listed urgent cases would be reported in November.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het aankopen van miljoenen griepkuren door de overheid tussen 2005 en 2009, terwijl de werkzaamheid ervan niet vaststond

An MP asked the Health Minister about the government's purchase of 5 million flu antivirals (oseltamivir and zanamivir) between 2005 and 2009 despite unproven efficacy, including the failure to re-examine efficacy and the withholding of trial data. The minister replied that purchases followed a 2004 Health Council advice, that no repeat purchases occurred, that safety is monitored by registration authorities, and that a new Health Council advice has been requested.
Following the possibility that there are new scientific insights that could lead to policy adjustment, I have requested a new advice from the Health Council.
Naar aanleiding van de mogelijkheid dat er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten zijn die tot aanpassing van beleid zouden kunnen leiden heb ik een nieuw advies aan de GR gevraagd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis in Woerden met het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis in Nieuwegein

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the planned merger of the Zuwe Hofpoort hospital in Woerden with St. Antonius in Nieuwegein, including petition signatures, staffing, emergency care, and the basis for claims that bigger hospitals are more efficient. The Minister said the merger was pre-approved by the competition authority, that the NZa would check consultation with works councils and medical staff, and that she could not predict the future, offering largely non-committal answers without releasing requested studies.
This merger was already approved earlier by the ACM under the Competition Act. However, since the merger has not yet taken place in practice, the parties must still notify it to the NZa.

Deze fusie is al eerder op grond van de Mededingingswet door de ACM goedgekeurd. Echter, omdat de fusie in de praktijk nog niet heeft plaatsgevonden moet deze alsnog door partijen worden gemeld bij de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over over huisartsenorganisaties die tegen het verplicht stellen van een screeningsinstrument voor de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) zijn

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether insurers making a GGZ screening instrument mandatory in 2015 contracts, opposed by GP organisations, undermines professional autonomy and the GP's gatekeeper role. The minister answered that the instrument only advises, professional autonomy is preserved, the tool was developed by the field, and she sees the insurers' conduct as desirable, declining to take action against insurers.
I am of the opinion that this is desirable conduct.
Ik ben van mening dat hier sprake is van gewenst gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de nieuwe zorgverzekeraar Anno12

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether the new insurer Anno12, which requires members to buy a 850 euro certificate for a premium discount, risks risk selection against low-income and sick insured persons. The minister answered that the discount is permitted under the Zvw, that acceptance duty and the ban on premium differentiation are respected, and that the NZa monitors the insurer.
I therefore consider it important that the NZa monitors compliance with the Zvw and closely follows developments regarding the constructions offered.
Ik vind het daarom van belang dat de NZa toeziet op naleving van de Zvw en ontwikkelingen rondom aangeboden constructies nauwlettend volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about declining bird populations linked to imidacloprid, suspension of its authorisation, liability of the producer, water-utility costs, CTGB staffing and risk assessment procedures. The government answered that EFSA reassessments are pending, the producer has a duty to report new information, CTGB has toxicologists and conducts structural consultation, and cumulative effects cannot yet be assessed; several questions were referred to a separate Kamerbrief.
The CTGB has the general power to amend or withdraw the authorisation of a crop protection product if it no longer meets the authorisation requirements.
Het Ctgb heeft in algemene zin de bevoegdheid om de toelating van een gewasbeschermingsmiddel te wijzigen of in te trekken als het middel niet meer voldoet aan de toelatingseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verspilde miljoenen vissubsidies in de Peel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about millions in fish-farming subsidies in the Peel, including a tilapia project by entrepreneur Van Rijsingen, weak subsidy controls, a possible bankruptcy-causing unfair competition, and whether fraud prosecution is warranted. The State Secretary answers that the matter is set out in a separate letter to parliament, reports that the RVO refers suspected fraud to the Public Prosecution Service, cites a court ruling on the bankruptcies, and refers many questions to that separate letter.
Once I have indications that criminal offences have occurred, I will certainly not hesitate to bring the matter to the attention of the Public Prosecution Service.
Op het moment dat ik aanwijzingen heb dat er sprake is van strafbare feiten, zal ik vanzelfsprekend niet aarzelen om de zaak onder de aandacht te brengen van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het uitblijven van onafhankelijk onderzoek naar een overlijden in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why no independent investigation has been opened into the death of a patient at a Lelystad mental health facility after a judo throw and delayed resuscitation, and whether the IGZ is waiting for the prosecutor's criminal inquiry. The minister replies that the criminal investigation is running independently, that the IGZ has ordered a calamity inquiry led by an independent chair to be delivered in October, and that it will also conduct its own follow-up investigation; the action programme on involuntary care does not cover this case.
Given the seriousness of the incident, the IGZ has judged that a joint inquiry by Triade and GGZ-Flevoland under an independent chair is warranted.
Gelet op de ernst van het voorval heeft de IGZ geoordeeld dat een gezamenlijk onderzoek door Triade en de GGZ-Flevoland onder leiding van een onafhankelijke voorzitter is aangewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de financiële steun van Reinier Haga Groep aan het LangeLand Ziekenhuis en de mogelijke overname

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the ACM exemption allowing Reinier Haga Groep to financially support LangeLand Hospital, its possible takeover, job losses, service impacts, and an adviser's reported fee. Minister Schippers answered that the exemption was granted due to payment problems, that no integration steps may be taken until final ACM approval, and that details of the takeover and its consequences are the board's responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen overname van ggz-instelling Antes door de Parnassia Groep

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the planned takeover of Antes by Parnassia Groep, creating a very large mental health provider, and its effects on patients, staff, continuity of care, competition and bed reduction. The minister largely deferred to the NZa and ACM, said continuity and stakeholder involvement are covered by the mandatory merger assessment, and stated that the merger must not harm addiction care in Rijnmond.
It is not for me to judge this. That is reserved for the Dutch Healthcare Authority and the Authority for Consumers and Markets.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover te oordelen. Dat is voorbehouden aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit en de Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over de milieueffectenanalyse van de Raamovereenkomst Verpakkingen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the environmental impact analysis of the packaging framework agreement, supported by the KIDV funded by industry, can be considered independent, given industry ties and the KIDV director's prior role in drafting the agreement. The state secretary replied that he formulated the assignment himself, the KIDV only supports and tenders the research, an advisory group with NGOs will be set up, the board is balanced between industry and government, and he will cover part of the costs.
Following the request by Ms Cegerek during the committee meeting of 18 June, an advisory sounding-board group will also be established.
Naar aanleiding van het verzoek van mevrouw Cegerek tijdens het AO van 18 juni jl. zal er ook een klankbordgroep opgericht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het statiegeldsysteem van Aldi en Lidl

The SP MPs asked whether the Stichting Afvalfonds Verpakkingen may use waste-management levies to compensate supermarket chains Aldi and Lidl for ending their own deposit systems, and whether deposit packaging reduces litter. The state secretary answered that levies are used only for the declared purposes under the AVV, that no compensation is currently in play since no national deposit abolition has been decided, and that the deposit system is one of several litter-reduction instruments.
The board of the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen adopts the budget and ultimately checks the final settlement.
Het bestuur van het Afvalfonds Verpakkingen stelt de begroting vast en controleert uiteindelijk de eindafrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het afkopen van het eigen risico bij het Iza Cura Rotterdampakket

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health whether buying back the statutory deductible under the Iza Cura Rotterdam package for low-income people is acceptable, and how premiums relate to expected costs. The minister answered that such supplementary insurance falls outside the Health Insurance Act and is the insurer's responsibility, that buyback is legal and a consumer choice, and that the NZa monitors the market while no change to the deductible is planned.
Profit figures for collective arrangements are not known.
Winstcijfers van collectiviteiten zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het opvolgen van een rechterlijke uitspraak inzake een klokkenluider

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government would take a position on, and speed up the resolution of, a whistleblower's compensation case following a 2005 court ruling that found his reputation had been harmed. The State Secretary replied that the claim is still under negotiation and a related objection procedure, that the government sent the requested documents in 2013 and offers full inspection of the original file, and that talks can resume quickly.
With a decision on the objection of 13 October 2008, the aforementioned ruling of the Breda District Court of 2 May 2007 has already been complied with.
Met een beslissing op bezwaarschrift van 13 oktober 2008 is reeds gevolg gegeven aan de genoemde uitspraak van de Rechtbank Breda van 2 mei 2007.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het verzwijgen van details over de medicijndeal en risico’s inzake gebruik NOAC’s

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health about secrecy over the financial arrangement with NOAC manufacturers, a civil servant's conduct, and safety data on dabigatran and other NOACs. The minister denied the newspaper's account, explained that confidentiality of prices was a manufacturer condition accepted to secure savings, and said the EMA and CBG are reviewing the safety findings without committing to a new blood-level monitoring requirement.
I ultimately agreed to this, while repeatedly indicating in contacts with both parties that I wanted to maintain as much transparency as possible beyond the financial details.

Hiermee heb ik uiteindelijk ingestemd, waarbij ik herhaaldelijk in de contacten met beide partijen heb aangegeven buiten de financiële gegevens een zo groot mogelijke transparantie te willen betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Siderius en Van Gerven over sluikreclame op scholen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether food companies' so-called educational visits to schools (such as Ronald McDonald Shows and Blue Band lesson packs) amount to disguised advertising and should be banned. The Secretary of State answered that the Reclamecode voor Voedingsmiddelen permits such campaigns only with approval from a recognised authority, promised tightened rules by end 2014 and a letter in spring 2015, but rejected a statutory ban.
I expect the intended tightening to be in place by the end of this year. In spring 2015 I will inform you about this and give you my response.
Ik verwacht dat de beoogde aanscherpingen uiterlijk aan het einde van dit jaar tot stand zijn gekomen. In het voorjaar van 2015 zal ik u hierover informeren en u mijn reactie hierop geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over salmonella en gezondheidsrisico’s bij de firma Foppen naar aanleiding van WOB stukken NVWA van Omroep Gelderland

An SP MP asked the government about NVWA enforcement at salmonella- and listeria-linked fish firm Foppen, including why warnings rather than fines or recalls were used, the traceability failures in the 2012 outbreak, and prosecution. The State Secretary and Minister replied that NVWA intervention follows a predetermined risk-based scale, that fines were imposed for recall and traceability failures, and that the Public Prosecution Service found insufficient grounds for criminal prosecution.
The inspection report can only be made public after an extensive procedure in which the company Foppen is asked for its views.
Het inspectierapport is alleen openbaar te maken na een uitvoerige procedure, waarbij het bedrijf Foppen om een zienswijze wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat Lidl en Aldi afgekocht zijn

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether industry offered Lidl and Aldi compensation to stop collecting PET bottles, whether this lobbying aimed to abolish the deposit system, and whether competition law applies. The state secretary answered that compensation, if any, would come from the packaging industry's own fund (StAV), that the deposit system is not being abolished now, that parliament's review is planned for June 2015, and that competition-law assessment is for the companies themselves.
Making arrangements about offering compensation for possible financial disadvantages that Aldi and Lidl may suffer, I see as a private matter in which the government has no role.

Afspraken maken over het aanbieden van een compensatie voor de mogelijke financiële nadelen die Aldi en Lidl kunnen ondervinden, zie ik als een private aangelegenheid, waar de overheid geen rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de IKON-uitzending de Wachtkamer ‘Vechten voor hoop’

MPs Keijzer, Dik-Faber and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a broadcast on coma patients and whether care depends on age and insurer. The minister said no current figures exist for all coma patients, that care follows scientific insight, that the Zorginstituut judged early intensive neurorehabilitation not insured for adults in 2009, and that the institute will re-examine it and may talk to the Zorgen na Coma foundation.
No figures are available on the total number of coma patients, only on the group eligible for early intensive neurorehabilitation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totale aantal comapatiënten, wel over de groep patiënten die in aanmerking komt voor vroege intensieve neurorevalidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Kwaliteitsvisie Spoedeisende Zorg van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (concentratie van spoedzorg)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about the Zorgverzekeraars Nederland quality vision on concentrating emergency care, its possible conflict with competition law flagged by the ACM, and the secrecy of the plans. The Minister replied that the ACM acted on its own supervisory initiative, that the plans are transparent and that insurers decide when to share them, and that she sees no need to assess the plans herself, refusing a national hospital network debate.
My approval is not required for this.
Mijn goedkeuring is hiervoor niet nodig.

Vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat geld bestemd voor zorg spoorloos verdween (ingezonden 16 mei 2014).

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that about EUR 5.4 million of care funding vanished at Thuiszorg Diakonie, and about the timing of detection, director pay, subcontractors and enforcement capacity. The state secretary condemned the alleged fraud, stated that an ongoing (preliminary) investigation must establish the facts, described the insurer's and inspectorate's earlier steps, and pointed to new anti-fraud funding and the NZa study.
Whether there is fraud at Thuiszorg Diakonie will ultimately have to be established by the preliminary investigation that has been started.
Of van fraude sprake is bij Thuiszorg Diakonie zal uiteindelijk het daarnaar gestarte (voor)onderzoek moeten uitwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stroperige gang van zaken bij een overlijden in het buitenland

The MP asked why repatriating a deceased Dutch national from Germany took a week, forcing a closed-coffin funeral, and what could be done to speed up such cases. The Minister of Foreign Affairs replied that the ministry was not involved in this case, that release of bodies is a matter for local authorities and national procedures, and that EU coordination offers no prospect of change.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in the repatriation of the body of Mr. K.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen betrokkenheid gehad bij de repatriëring van het lichaam van de heer K.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de privacy van patiënten slecht gewaarborgd is

An MP asked the health minister about media reports that patient privacy is poorly protected, including insurer staff unaware of the privacy arrangement, the SBG benchmark database, and the DIS diagnosis database. The minister replied that insurers must respect the privacy regulation, that SBG and DIS use pseudonymisation and controls that the CBP accepted, and that the data collection is lawful and worth continuing.
Insurers have meanwhile reminded the relevant staff once more of the existence of the privacy arrangement.
Inmiddels hebben zorgverzekeraars de medewerkers waar dit relevant voor is nogmaals gewezen op het bestaan van de privacyregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de aanstelling van de heer Plukker als interim-voorzitter van de raad van bestuur van het Radboudumc
