MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about the appointment of F. Plukker as interim chair of the Radboudumc board, his remuneration, caps on hours and pay, and transparency of interim executives' pay. The minister answered that the WNT sets the legal framework, that supervisory boards decide pay independently, and that enforcement under the WNT is ex post, so she has no intention to intervene in the details.
It is not for the Minister of VWS to negotiate the employment contract of executives together with a supervisory board.
Het is niet aan de Minister van VWS om samen met een Raad van Toezicht het arbeidscontract van bestuurders uit te onderhandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de winststijging van Achmea Zorg tot 159 miljoen euro in het eerste halfjaar van 2014

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether it is acceptable that health insurer Achmea's profits and reserves keep rising, and whether reserves should be capped or skimmed to lower premiums. Minister Schippers answered that the reserves are needed for solvency under Solvency II and the transfers from the AWBZ, that she will not claw back reserves or set maximum solvency limits, and that insurers themselves decide how to use surplus reserves.
I am not willing to do so. Firstly, it is not for me to determine which part of the reserves can be labelled as superfluous, and secondly I also have no legal powers to claw back reserves.

Ik ben daartoe niet bereid. In de eerste plaats is het niet aan mij om te bepalen welk deel van de reserves als overbodig kunnen worden betiteld en in de tweede plaats heb ik ook geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om reserves af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de uitbraak van het ebolavirus in West-Afrika

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the spread of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa, Dutch involvement, risks to Dutch public health, screening of travellers, and the differing travel advice of the US and the Netherlands. The government answered that the risk in the Netherlands is low, that it follows WHO, RIVM and LCR advice, that entry screening is not recommended, and that it has provided funding and tightened travel advice for some affected countries.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs therefore has no view of the exact number of Dutch nationals in these countries.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft daarom geen zicht op het exacte aantal Nederlanders in deze landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ziekenhuizen in Sittard-Geleen en Heerlen en de mogelijke concentratie van klinische verloskunde in Heerlen

An SP MP asked the minister about the Sittard-Geleen and Heerlen hospital merger, financial problems, the proposed concentration of obstetrics in Heerlen, staffing, quality, accessibility and home births. The minister replied that finances are positive, the merger is planned for 1 January 2015, obstetrics concentration is a hospital decision, quality and accessibility norms are currently met, and she declines to intervene.
No, I am not willing to do so.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bijwerkingen van de Nuvaring

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reported side effects of the Nuvaring contraceptive, including allegedly withheld data, a US settlement, and whether the product should still be used given higher thrombosis risk. The Minister replied that the CBG found no withheld information, that the relative thrombosis risk is higher than second-generation pills but absolute risk remains low, and that the package leaflet was recently revised.
I asked the College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) to inform me about this.
Ik heb het College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) gevraagd mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vondst van de tijgermug bij diverse bandenbedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about tiger mosquitoes found at several tyre companies despite a covenant, and whether legal regulation, prosecution or stricter import rules should follow. The Minister said the cause is being investigated by the NVWA, that the covenant is enforceable via the Environmental Management Act duty of care, and that voluntary agreements are preferred over statutory rules, while also answering questions on the Asian bush mosquito, communication to Lelystad residents and company locations.
It is still unclear why tiger mosquitoes were found at several locations despite measures taken.
Het is nog onduidelijk waarom er op meerdere locaties ondanks genomen maatregelen tijgermuggen zijn aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende teloorgang van het St. Jans Gasthuis in Weert door het beleid van CZ, VGZ en andere zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked whether health insurers CZ, VGZ and others plan to stop contracting stroke, childbirth and hip operation care at St. Jans Gasthuis in Weert, and whether they should publish their hospital plans. The minister replied that the joint insurer trajectory has ended, that each insurer decides its own purchasing policy, that the IGZ sees no quality problems, and that ZN's criteria are public.
It is the responsibility of individual health insurers to weigh up, based on price and quality data among other things, decisions on care purchasing.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van individuele zorgverzekeraars om op basis van onder andere prijs- en kwaliteitsgegevens afwegingen te maken bij de zorginkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de onrust die is ontstaan in Zeeland rondom de plannen van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ)

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about planned cuts to ADRZ hospital services on Walcheren, including access to the CEAN report, the CZ regional vision, staffing, referral practices and links to private clinics. The minister answered that she has not seen the CEAN report or CZ's vision, that capacity decisions on Walcheren are not yet final, that acute care is considered guaranteed, and that hospital organisation is a matter for the parties involved.
I do not have CZ's Regiovisie and it is not for me to make it public.
Ik heb de Regiovisie van CZ niet en het is ook niet aan mij om die openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bezuiniging op de sportmedische zorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why subsidies for preventive sports medicine and injury prevention were reported to be cut by 40% in 2015 and ended in 2016, and what the consequences would be. The Minister replied that subsidy to the Vereniging voor Sportgeneeskunde ends in 2016 following recognition of sports medicine as a medical specialty, that injury-prevention funding will be redirected rather than eliminated, and that she expects no increase in social costs or deterioration in care.
I am ending project funding to the Dutch Association of Sports Medicine (VSG) from 2016 because sports medicine was recognised as a medical specialty earlier this year.
Ik beëindig de projectfinanciering aan de Vereniging van Sportgeneeskunde (VSG) met ingang van 2016 vanwege de erkenning van de sportgeneeskunde als geneeskundig specialisme eerder dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over rotte-eierenlucht bij Deurne

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked about H2S (rotten-egg) gas near Deurne, the expert panel's findings on health risks, pyrite and fertiliser causes, and whether fertiliser levels should be reviewed. The government answered that exposure effects are temporary, that more regional and local pyrite knowledge is needed, and that the nitrate action programme and a manure-fermentation evaluation are under way, with results promised for early 2015.
A policy evaluation on manure fermentation is under way, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and I will send you the results in the first quarter of 2015.
Ten aanzien van mestvergisting is een beleidsevaluatie gaande, waarvan de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en ik u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 de resultaten zullen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat dieren gedood worden als gevolg van de vondst van het verboden antibioticum furazolidon op diverse kalverhouderijen

Two MPs (SP) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the discovery of the banned antibiotic furazolidon on calf farms, the health risk, the investigation capacity, testing and culling of animals, and liability. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA and Public Prosecution Service are investigating, that no consumer health risk is expected, that the EU rules require culling of positive animals, and that she will discuss private liability with industry.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het voortbestaan van het onafhankelijke Geneesmiddelenbulletin

MP Van Gerven asked whether the minister commissioned Significant to evaluate the independent Geneesmiddelenbulletin and whether its existence is at stake. The minister confirmed the evaluation concerns the effectiveness of ministry subsidy in achieving policy goals, not the bulletin's right to exist, and promised a separate letter after the summer recess.
The achieved result is leading here, and not the right to exist of, in this case, the Geneesmiddelenbulletin.
Het bereikte resultaat is hierbij leidend, en niet het bestaansrecht van, in dit geval, het Geneesmiddelenbulletin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het onderzoek naar het verband tussen medicijngebruik en agressie

MPs Van Nispen and Van Gerven asked whether the government will do more research into a possible link between certain medicines, such as antidepressants, and aggression, including taking blood samples from suspects after violent offences. Minister Opstelten answers that the existing drug safety system (CBG, Lareb) already monitors side effects, that the evidence on aggression is mixed and hard to establish in individual cases, that no registration of medicine-linked violence exists, and that there is no legal basis for blood testing of suspects for prescribed medication, which he considers undesirable.
I also do not consider it desirable to create such a legal basis.
Ik acht het ook niet wenselijk om een dergelijke grondslag te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a motion calling for an animal-keeping ban as a standalone sanction had not yet been implemented and whether a bill would be sent before summer 2014. The minister replied that the ban as a special condition was extended in 2012, that the evaluation will be brought forward to 2015 and a framework for a standalone measure is being sought, while stating that OM data on such bans cannot be generated and that seizure of new animals is only possible if they were also mistreated.
I am willing to bring forward the planned evaluation of the aforementioned law of 30 August 2012 to 2015.
Ik ben bereid de voorgenomen evaluatie van de eerder genoemde wet van 30 augustus 2012 ... te vervroegen naar 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de handelwijze van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary how he assesses staff complaints to the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) about De Zorggroep, including inadequate supervision of dementia patients and understaffing, and why the IGZ only talks to the board rather than investigating independently. The State Secretary calls the complaints worrying, says the inspectorate treats confidential reports seriously, will discuss the issues with the board and monitor closely, points to past intensified supervision and the publicly available reports, and notes IGZ capacity has grown and the 2013 annual report shows improved handling of reports.
In the short term there will be a conversation with the board of directors to discuss this report, but also other reports.
Op korte termijn is er een gesprek met de raad van bestuur om over deze melding, maar ook over andere meldingen, verder te praten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het voorschrijven van groeihormonen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether hospital-driven switching of growth hormones for non-medical reasons (budget pressure) is acceptable, and whether national central procurement should be considered. The Minister replied that prescribing is the prescriber's responsibility under treatment guidelines, that the IGZ supervises prescribing, that switching must not reduce treatment quality, that budget is sufficient macro-level, and that central procurement does not fit the Dutch care system.
I am of the view that switching medicines must not lead to a loss of treatment quality.
Ik ben van mening dat het switchen van geneesmiddelen niet mag leiden tot kwaliteitsverlies van een behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Siderius over de heffingskortingen die in mindering zijn gebracht op de AWBZ-premie

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary for a year-by-year breakdown from 1999 of AWBZ premium revenue, how much was spent on tax credits and recovered via the BIKK, and how this compares with care expenditure. The state secretary provided a table of these figures, cautioning that the 2001 break in series (deductions no longer reducing premiums) makes direct comparison misleading, and said the answer to the final question on timing could not be met.
Unfortunately, despite our efforts, that has not succeeded.
Dat is ondanks onze inspanningen helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht ‘vergunningen veehouderij gebaseerd op rekenfouten’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that livestock odour permits rest on calculation errors, including the legal consequences, the province of Noord-Brabant's requests, health effects, and whether the odour law and maximum odour loads should be tightened. The government says the V-Stacks model works in most situations, that existing permits are unaffected, and that a targeted model adjustment and guidance for municipalities will follow, but it declines to tighten the law now and leaves cumulative odour checks to municipalities.
I will ensure a solution for the short term.
Ik zal zorgen voor een oplossing voor de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers soms euthanasiemiddelen weigeren te leveren

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the Health Minister how she views reports that pharmacists sometimes refuse to supply euthanasia drugs, how often this happens, and whether pharmacists should have a formal role in the Euthanasia Act. The minister answered that pharmacists have an independent responsibility for safe dispensing but no duty to participate, that early contact with doctors is advisable, that no figures are kept, and that she sees no reason to amend the Euthanasia Act.
At present I see no reason to amend the Euthanasia Act.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de Euthanasiewet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over Aalt Dijkhuizen als boegbeeld van de topsector Agri&Food

MPs Van Gerven and Smaling asked why former Wageningen UR executive Aalt Dijkhuizen was chosen as figurehead of the Agri&Food top sector, given his public opposition to organic farming, and how the biological sector's share of funding and the 2013 amendment were implemented. The minister answered that he was chosen for his sector knowledge and networks, that his remarks were personal, that the sector's budget and amendment implementation are described in earlier letters, and that no second figurehead is needed.
Mr Dijkhuizen's statements were made in a personal capacity, and he indicated that he is absolutely not an opponent of the organic sector.
De uitspraken van de heer Dijkhuizen zijn op persoonlijke titel gemaakt, waarbij hij heeft aangegeven dat hij absoluut geen tegenstander van de biologische sector is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de resultaten van de zorgverzekeringsactiviteiten van verzekeraar ASR

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about ASR's 2013 health insurance premium income, the unreported results of its health insurance activities, and whether profits or dividends from basic insurance premiums flow to its non-health business, plus transparency and Solvency figures. The Minister confirmed €579m premium income, said the health results will be published by DNB in Q3 and that ASR will be asked to disclose them explicitly, denied profits are transferred, and rejected extra accountability rules for profit-making insurers.
I will ask ASR to explicitly report the results of its health insurance activities in its annual figures publication in future, as other insurance groups offering non-health insurance do.

Ik zal ASR vragen om in de toekomst, net als andere verzekeringsgroepen die naast zorgverzekeringen andere vormen van verzekeringen aanbieden, haar cijfers ten aanzien van resultaten van de zorgverzekeringsactiviteiten in haar publicatie van de jaarcijfers expliciet te vermelden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie dat je bij zaken als opvangcentra voor verkrachte vrouwen kan afvragen of dat een taak is voor de overheid

An MP asked whether the state secretary's remark that funding shelters for raped women may not be a government task, comparable to beekeeping in Malawi, reflected cabinet policy. The government replied that the remark was not meant to question state responsibility, that municipalities are responsible for victim shelter under the Wmo, and that no consultation with the health ministry had taken place.
Under the Social Support Act, municipalities are responsible for arranging shelter for victims of domestic violence who need it.
Op grond van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning hebben de gemeenten de verantwoordelijkheid om opvang te regelen voor slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld, die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat UEFA-bobo’s geen taks betalen

An SP MP asked why UEFA and its officials would pay no tax if the Netherlands hosts Euro 2020 matches, and what the costs and conditions are. The minister replied that the tax guarantees fit existing Dutch tax rules, grant no special exemption, and only allow UEFA to use standard exemption schemes if conditions are met, with no costs expected and no change to tax law needed.
So it is not the case that UEFA is exempt from paying taxes upon award of the bid.
Het is dus niet zo dat de UEFA bij toewijzing van het bid is vrijgesteld van het betalen van belastingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat op Den Haag Centraal Station een inloopkliniek opent

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CareToGo walk-in clinic at The Hague Central Station, its 35 euro consult fee, two-tier care concerns, effects on GP relationships and referrals, insurance coverage, GP qualifications and who authorised it. The minister answered that the NZa requires CareToGo to follow its tariff rules (the 35 euro fee is not allowed), that the coverage request is pending, that GPs are registered, and that no formal experiment or permission was needed.
Following the launch of this initiative, the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa) contacted CareToGo and told them they must remain within the regulations the NZa sets.

De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) heeft naar aanleiding van de start van dit initiatief contact opgenomen met CareToGo en hen aangegeven dat zij moeten blijven binnen de regelgeving die de NZa vaststelt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ruim 300.000 Nederlanders niet veilig omgaan met vrij verkrijgbare pijnstillers, zoals diclofenac, ibuprofen en naproxen

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how to respond to reports that over 300,000 Dutch people use over-the-counter NSAIDs such as diclofenac, ibuprofen and naproxen unsafely, including overdosing and long-term use, and whether sales should be restricted to pharmacists. The Minister answered that drug classification is for the CBG, that risks are addressed through leaflets and ongoing monitoring, and that no national registry of complications exists, while rejecting the need to restrict sales to pharmacies.
No national registrations are available of the number of complications or deaths resulting from (improper) use of NSAIDs.
Er zijn geen landelijke registraties beschikbaar van het aantal complicaties of overlijden als gevolg van (oneigenlijk) gebruik van NSAID's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een neparts een gezonde vrouw laat opereren

An MP asked the health minister how she reacts to reports that a bogus doctor operated on a healthy woman and whether the inspectorate (IGZ) failed to act on earlier complaints. The minister says the matter is under criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, explains the inspectorate's earlier handling of complaints and inspections, and says she cannot comment further while the investigation runs.
While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make statements about this case.
Lopende het onderzoek kan ik over deze zaak geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over de bouw van cavernen in De Duitse Dollard

SP MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked whether brine from salt caverns in Jemgum (Germany) could be used by Frisia Zout BV instead of dumping it, and whether this would be more environmentally friendly than mining salt under the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that the German brine appears technically suitable but transport costs make it commercially unviable for now, that environmental effects of the dumping are considered negligible, and that Frisia's Wadden Sea permit application is still under review.
I do not consider it self-evident that salt extraction under the Wadden Sea can take place.
Ik vind het niet vanzelfsprekend dat zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) vijf zorgverzekeraars van Achmea een boete oplegt vanwege een slordige administratie

An SP MP asked the health minister about the NZa fining five Achmea insurers for sloppy administration, questioning the amount, possible intent, profiteering and risk selection. The minister answered that the NZa found 36 reporting errors due to weak internal controls, found no intent or profit, and that other insurers showed no similar problems.
The NZa attributes the errors made to deficient internal control.
De NZa wijt de gemaakte fouten aan een gebrekkige interne beheersing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over de heffingskortingen die in mindering zijn gebracht op de AWBZ-premie

The SP MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether the BIKK compensates for lost AWBZ premium revenue caused by the tax-credit system, and requested detailed 1999-2013 figures on premium income, reserves and the BIKK. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that the BIKK fully compensates the switch from deductions to tax credits each year, that premium income was not squeezed by the system, and supplied a table of hypothetical figures while noting these overstate what would have occurred under the old system.
The BIKK compensates the effect of the conversion from deductions to tax credits.
De BIKK compenseert het effect van de omzetting van aftrekposten naar heffingskortingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de eerste praktijk een huisarts een vermogen kost

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that taking over a GP practice can cost a new doctor 100,000 to 150,000 euros in goodwill, and whether this drives consolidation and raises care costs. The minister says she has no data on the scale of goodwill payments, opposes charging goodwill, notes insurers already forbid it in contracts, and says a 2006 change did not create a legal ban.
I am not aware of the scale on which goodwill is currently being requested, or whether institutions and chains are particularly willing to pay money, and what amounts would be involved.
Het is mij niet bekend op welke schaal op dit moment goodwill wordt gevraagd, of met name instellingen en ketens bereid zijn geld te betalen en om welke bedragen het dan zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ongeveer 80 procent van de ouders nooit een cursus EHBO bij kinderen heeft gevolgd

An SP MP asked the health minister about a report that about 80 percent of parents never took a child first-aid course, whether the share is too low, and whether first-aid courses should be publicly funded and offered through the consultation bureau. The minister said the figure is unknown, that courses are a voluntary private choice, that she sees no need for cost-effectiveness research, and that she will only seek more awareness via consultation bureaus, not regulation.
I will consult with the consultation bureau to see what the possibilities are here.
Ik zal in overleg met het consultatiebureau kijken wat hier voor de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over het bericht dat er in de regio Hoogeveen onrust is ontstaan over het afschalen van de Intensive Care (IC) in het Bethesda Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about reported unrest in Hoogeveen over possible downscaling of the intensive care unit at Bethesda Hospital, including the status of a regional advisory report, planned concentrations, and insurer involvement. The minister said the plans are a draft under discussion with stakeholders, declined to publish the report as a regional plan under the responsibility of the parties involved, and said her statutory role applies only if 45-minute ambulance access or care safety is at risk.
Moreover, the regional plans are the responsibility of the parties involved, and it is not for me to send them to the House of Representatives.
Bovendien zijn de regioplannen de verantwoordelijkheid van partijen en is het niet aan mij deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het betalen van het eigen risico bij ongevraagde hulpverlening

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health why the mandatory deductible (eigen risico) is charged for unsolicited care such as bemoeizorg or compulsory admission, and whether this is fair when the care later proves unjustified. The Minister replies that all Zvw-covered care, including involuntary care, falls under the mandatory deductible to keep public support for insurance, and that complaints can go to the SKGZ, but does not address the individual cases.
If the insured person disagrees, he can file a complaint with the Foundation for Complaints and Disputes Health Insurance (SKGZ).
Indien de verzekerde het hier niet mee eens is kan hij een klacht indienen bij de Stichting Klachten en Geschillen Zorgverzekeringen (SKGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Achmea gigantische winst maakt op de zorgverzekering

An SP MP asked the minister about Achmea's reported profits on health insurance, whether the figures were obscured by incidental results, whether premium money flowed to dividends, and whether Achmea should be split. The minister took the report as noted, explained the 298 million incidental result as releases of prior-year provisions, denied dividends from basic-insurance premiums, rejected the proposed split, and declined to redirect insurers' profits to avert care cuts.
Achmea has informed me that there are no dividend payments from premiums collected for the basic insurance.
Achmea heeft mij laten weten dat er geen sprake is van dividenduitkeringen afkomstig uit de voor de basisverzekering opgebrachte premies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat vrijwel alle zorgverzekeraars een onvoldoende scoren voor het bestrijden van fraude

An SP MP asked the minister how she responds to reports that most health insurers fail on fraud control, why insurers still do not take it seriously, whether a pass from the NZa was removed from the PInCet draft, and whether pay-per-service billing structurally invites fraud. The minister acknowledged 2012 control shortcomings at eight of eleven insurers, pointed to insurer improvement actions overseen by the NZa, rejected the view that the system itself drives fraud, and gave the number of boete cases without detailing amounts.
The NZa has taken a number of enforcement measures, including directions.
De NZa heeft een aantal handhavingmaatregelen getroffen waaronder aanwijzingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de rechter een streep zet door de overname van het Langeland Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views a court ruling blocking Fundis's takeover of the Langeland hospital, whether hospitals are being left to fail, and whether insurers should be stripped of their role and municipalities given control. The minister says the court ruling is for the judiciary, that hospital finances are the hospitals' own responsibility, that insurers are responsible for procuring care and she does not intend to take over steering, and that acute-care concentration plans are still being discussed.
I have no substantive view on a decision of our judiciary.
Ik heb geen inhoudelijk oordeel over een beslissing van onze rechterlijke macht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het personeel van Ambulance Amsterdam gesteund door Abvakabo vanmiddag een petitie indient waarin het vertrek wordt geëist van de directie

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about staff unrest at Ambulance Amsterdam, including complaints about workload, equipment and hygiene and the use of rapid responders. The minister answered that operational management is the responsibility of the RAV, that the Inspectorate has intensified its supervision, and that no specific signals on outdated equipment were received.
Responsibility for operational management lies with the Regional Ambulance Service (RAV); I do not deal with that.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de bedrijfsvoering ligt bij de Regionale Ambulancevoorziening (RAV), ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het rapport ambulancepersoneel aan het woord

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a survey report on ambulance staff, covering workload, retirement at 67, aggression, bureaucracy, centralisation of control rooms and privatisation. The minister acknowledged staff commitment, pointed to existing CAO measures, an anti-aggression action plan and a planned national control room organisation, and rejected further privatisation and the 67-year pension concern as sector-specific beyond new policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat arbodienstverlener Zorg van de Zaak Netwerk het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis overneemt

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the reported takeover of Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis Beverwijk by occupational health provider Zorg van de Zaak Netwerk, including risks of preferential treatment for client employees and commercialisation. The minister answered that the deal is a private initiative within the existing system, that non-medical selection is prohibited and monitored by the NZa, and that doctor co-ownership is acceptable, while not knowing some specifics.
Selection on non-medical criteria is not permitted. The Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis is, like all other hospitals in the Netherlands, supervised by the NZa.
Selectie op basis van niet-medische criteria is niet toegestaan. Het Rode Kruis Ziekenhuis wordt – net als alle andere ziekenhuizen in Nederland – gecontroleerd door de NZa.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars het aantal spoedeisende hulpen boven het Noordzeekanaal willen terugbrengen naar drie en het aantal ziekenhuizen dat in Noord-Holland beroer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about insurers' plans to reduce emergency departments north of the Noordzeekanaal to three and stroke care in Noord-Holland to six hospitals, and about the lack of public disclosure and consultation. The minister answered that the plans are still draft regional scenarios under discussion, that the 45-minute access norm will be safeguarded through the regional acute care consultation, and that insurers are fulfilling their statutory role.
These plans are currently still in draft form and are being discussed with the parties in the region.
Deze plannen zijn op dit moment nog in concept en worden besproken met de partijen uit de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Tongeren over het ontgassen door de binnenvaart

MPs Van Gerven and Van Tongeren asked the state secretary about timing of an international ban on degassing by inland shipping, the legal room for a unilateral ban or municipal measures, risk zones around residential areas, the basis for calling emissions incidental, enforcement compliance, and RIVM emission estimates. The state secretary committed to pursuing a degassing ban via the CDNI treaty and to informing parliament, while stating that municipalities have little legal room and that a unilateral national ban is possible but less preferred.
I will inform the House, as I promised you at the General Consultation on 12 December 2013, when an (international) ban on degassing by inland vessels will take effect.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren, zoals ik u bij het Algemeen Overleg op 12 december 2013 toegezegd heb, wanneer een (internationaal) verbod op ontgassen door binnenvaartschepen van kracht zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de medicijncheck in slechts 10% van de gevallen plaats heeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that the medication check for elderly patients takes place in only 10% of cases, and about whether insurers should be required to ensure full implementation. The Minister acknowledged the value of periodic medication review but said full compliance with the guideline (1.2 million reviews a year) is not currently feasible, that implementation will be phased in, that supervision by the IGZ will tighten from 2015, and that the government will not generically exempt these reviews from the deductible.
The IGZ will in any case tighten its supervision from 1 January 2015.
De IGZ zal in ieder geval vanaf 1 januari 2015 het toezicht verscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de website My Tomorrows geneesmiddelen aanbiedt die zich nog in het onderzoeksstadium bevinden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the commercial firm My Tomorrows, which mediates access to unregistered experimental medicines, is lawful, whether it poses risks to patients, and whether patients should get such drugs free or fund a public fund. The Minister answered that My Tomorrows only mediates within existing named-patient and compassionate-use rules overseen by the IGZ and CBG, that risks are weighed case by case, and that she sees no basis for mandatory industry-funded fund or state intervention.
For both procedures, cost is not part of the procedure. For that reason, data on this are not known to me.
Voor beide procedures geldt dat het kostenaspect geen onderdeel uitmaakt van de procedure. Gegevens daarover zijn om die reden niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulpposten in Sittard-Geleen en Weert mogelijk dicht gaan

An MP asks the Minister of Health about reports that emergency departments in Sittard-Geleen and Weert may close, and whether this is acceptable given the population served. The Minister replies that the plans are still draft regional scenarios by insurers, that the government's role is limited to the 45-minute ambulance access norm and to the continuity of critical care rather than any specific hospital, and declines to send the regional plans to the House.
Moreover, the regional plans are the responsibility of the parties, and it is not for me to send them to the House of Representatives.
Bovendien zijn de regioplannen de verantwoordelijkheid van partijen en is het niet aan mij deze aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de sector geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) verbolgen is over het inkoopbeleid van zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would respond to GGZ mental health providers' complaints about insurers' contracting practices, including unilateral digital contracts, unclear and burdensome conditions, and restrictions on the lead treating professional role. The Minister answered that transition problems are expected, pointed to NZa and Q-Consult research, said insurers may impose conditions with a quality rationale, and promised to monitor developments and report back.
As indicated in my letter of 23 January, the parties jointly evaluate the purchasing and selling process for 2014 and examine what they can learn from it for 2015.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief van 23 januari evalueren partijen gezamenlijk het in- en verkoopproces voor 2014 en gaan zij na wat zij daarvan kunnen leren voor het jaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Raak over de verandering in de wijze van bekostiging van de waterschapslasten

MPs Van Gerven and Van Raak asked the ministers whether the shift of water board charges from agriculture to households is real, and whether the Delfland-inspired tariff differentiation and cost-allocation changes are consistent with the principle that charges are paid in proportion to benefit. The minister confirmed the shift is linked to water boards' growing urban role, that the 2012 amendment widening tariff differentiation was used by seven boards with provincial approval, and provided a table of cost shares for 2010 and 2013.

It is indeed the case that the water boards' task performance has changed substantially over the past decades and that they have taken more measures that serve the interests of urban areas and therefore of households.

Het is inderdaad zo dat de taakuitoefening van de waterschappen de laatste decennia ingrijpend is veranderd en dat zij meer maatregelen zijn gaan treffen die in het belang van het stedelijk gebied en daarmee van de huishoudens zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de spoedeisende hulpposten in Bronovo en ’t Lange Land in Zoetermeer mogelijk dicht gaan

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency departments at Bronovo and 't Lange Land in Zoetermeer may close, citing ambulance staff concerns about longer response times and lower quality. The minister replied that the plans are still at concept stage under insurer-led regional planning, that zorgverzekeraars must keep the 45-minute ambulance access norm, and declined to commit to stopping the plans.
See my answer to question 1, in which I outline the role of the health insurer and the other parties involved.
Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1 waarin ik de rol van de zorgverzekeraar en de andere betrokken partijen in deze schets.
Antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over het handelen van topambtenaren inzake de problemen op de longchirurgie/intensive care afdelingen van het VUmc (VUmedisch centrum)

MP Van Gerven asks whether senior civil servant Harry Paul misused his position to help his brother, a surgeon at VUmc, and whether the IGZ inspectorate was influenced or should re-examine its handling of the Van Tongeren death and whether VUmc should be asked to commission an external investigation. The minister denies misuse or improper influence, states the IGZ followed its guidelines in accepting VUmc's internal investigation, sees no need for further inquiry, and leaves follow-up with the family to VUmc.
The IGZ's policy is aimed at healthcare institutions first conducting adequate investigation of a report themselves and drawing lessons from it.
Het beleid van de IGZ is er op gericht dat zorginstellingen in eerste instantie zelf adequaat onderzoek doen naar een melding en daar lering uit trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgbeoordelingswebsites alles klakkeloos plaatsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether physician rating websites such as ZorgkaartNederland post reviews uncritically, allowing self-rating, malicious reviews and unverifiable content, and whether this undermines patient choice and transparency. The Minister replied that the sites apply editorial codes and checks, that self-reviews are removed, that negative reviews are inherent but limited in effect, and that the sites contribute to transparency, so no action is planned against them.
I see no reason to question the right to exist of these websites.
Ik zie geen reden om het bestaansrecht van deze websites ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat geneesmiddelen van fabrikant Ranbaxy in opspraak zijn, maar in Nederland nog steeds als preferent middel worden voorgeschreven

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that Ranbaxy medicines, though under scrutiny in the US, were still prescribed as preferred drugs in the Netherlands, and about the adequacy of inspections and data integrity. The minister replied that the IGZ took a precautionary measure only on products made from Ranbaxy's Toansa plant, that no health risk was established, that prior European inspections found no grounds for action, and that no full guarantee against falsified test data can be given, while rejecting a new investigation into IGZ and CBG oversight.
I do not think an investigation is necessary because I have no doubts about the way the IGZ and CBG work.
Ik vind onderzoek niet nodig omdat ik niet twijfel aan de werkwijze van IGZ en CBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidreducerend asfalt

Two SP MPs asked the minister about quieter road surfaces: whether savings would fund noise relief for households above noise limits, whether wet-road noise and aging effects are modelled, and the design and reporting of trial programmes. The minister answered that the new PERS surface is still in early development with cost-effectiveness under study until 2018, that noise models use annual averages without a wet-road correction judged not to underestimate exposure, and that results will be reported to parliament then.
Cost-effectiveness is one of the topics in the research now started.
Kosteneffectiviteit is een van de onderwerpen in het nu gestarte onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat patiënten die het slachtoffer zijn geworden van schade door medisch handelen met lege handen staan na het faillissement van een ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether patients harmed by medical care are left empty-handed after the Ruwaard van Putten hospital went bankrupt, and whether insurer MediRisk must process their claims. The Minister declined to give a substantive view because a court ruling had been issued but was not yet final, said 11 claims had been filed after the bankruptcy and that the details of the complaints are unknown to her, and said it is up to private parties to bear responsibility for care.
I therefore do not consider it appropriate to give a substantive judgment on this matter.
Ik vind het derhalve niet opportuun om een inhoudelijk oordeel te geven over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de enige nachtapotheker in Alphen aan den Rijn op 2 februari gaat sluiten

An SP MP asked the health minister whether residents of Alphen aan den Rijn should travel to Leiden after the only night pharmacy closes, whether insurers Achmea and Zorg & Zekerheid are failing their duty of care, and what the government will do to prevent closure. The minister replied that night-time pharmacy access is the responsibility of pharmacists and insurers, supervised by the NZa and IGZ, that emergency medication can be delivered or given by GPs, and that no specific government role is foreseen.
Within the healthcare system, no specific role for the government is foreseen here.
Binnen het zorgstelsel is hier geen specifieke rol voor de overheid voorzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars risicoselectie toepassen op buitenlandse werknemers die in Nederland actief zijn door ze een polis zonder eigen risico aan te bi

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether insurers' supplementary policies that cover the own risk for foreign seasonal workers amount to risk selection and should be closed off by law. Minister Schippers answers that the constructions are lawful, limited in size (under 2% of insured), grounded in collection risk, and that she sees no need to ban them, though she has asked the NZa to pay extra attention in its market scan.
At the time I agreed with the NZa that they would monitor developments regarding the reinsurance.
Ik heb destijds met de NZa afgesproken dat zij de ontwikkelingen rondom het herverzekeren zouden volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat patiënten met schildklierproblemen van geneesmiddel moeten wisselen door het preferentiebeleid van verzekeraars ondanks dat de NHG-richtlijn en de KNMP-richt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that patients with thyroid problems must switch levothyroxine brands due to insurers' preferential policy despite NHG and KNMP guidelines, asking about the risks, costs and whether insurers may override guidelines. The Minister replied that to her knowledge no preferential policy exists for levothyroxine, that any switching has other causes, and that insurers' websites show whether a preferential policy applies.
Contrary to what is stated in the blog cited by Mr Van Gerven, no preferential policy is pursued for levothyroxine by health insurers as far as I am aware.
In tegenstelling tot wat wordt aangegeven in het door de heer Van Gerven aangehaalde blog, wordt er geen preferentiebeleid gevoerd voor Levotyroxine door zorgverzekeraars voor zover mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar De Friesland studenten probeert te lokken door ze een gratis schoonmaakster aan te bieden

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister to respond to reports that insurer De Friesland offered students a free cleaning service to attract them, and questioned whether such marketing costs were properly booked and whether care money was being used appropriately. The minister replied that insurers decide their own marketing strategy and budgets, that the matter falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care and cost declarations, and that 2013 profit figures will only be available later.
This falls outside my responsibility as minister.
Dit valt buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid als minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ‘plain packaging’ als effect heeft dat sigaretten minder aantrekkelijk worden gevonden, en rokers meer geneigd zijn te stoppen

MP Van Gerven asked whether reports that plain tobacco packaging makes smokers more inclined to quit, and studies linking attractive packs to children, should lead the government to adopt plain packaging in the Netherlands and to restrict tobacco sales to specialist shops. The State Secretary replied that early Australian evidence is promising but needs longer-term study, that large combined health warnings will be introduced under the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and that plain packaging and sales restrictions will be evaluated, with the Chamber to be informed before the summer recess.
My aim is to inform the House about this before the summer recess.
Mijn streven is de Tweede Kamer hier voor het Zomerreces over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Gerven over het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) dat jonge werkloze medische specialisten met behoud van uitkering aan het werk zet

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that young unemployed medical specialists work unpaid at the AMC while keeping their benefits, and how many are underpaid, whether this is minimum-wage evasion or fraud, and how underpayment will be ended. The State Secretary answered that pay must meet legal and CAO obligations, that the number of unpaid specialists is unknown, that no complaints have reached the inspectorates so no investigation is under way, and that the government sees no underpayment under the specialists' terms of employment.
It is unknown how many medical specialists work unpaid. This is not registered.
Het is onbekend hoeveel medisch specialisten onbetaald werken. Dit wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat onverzekerde Oost-Europeanen ziekenhuizen miljoenen kosten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the government responds to reports that uninsured Eastern Europeans leave hospitals with millions in unpaid bills, asked for figures by year and nationality, and asked what is being done to reduce uninsurance. Minister Schippers said uninsured residents must insure or pay, that the CVZ does not record nationality so figures are unavailable, that hospitals (NVZ, NFU) were asked to map the losses, and that enforcement and information efforts exist but detection of short-stay EU nationals without a citizen service number is not feasible.
I will also ask them whether and to what extent it is possible to break these down further by nationality.
Tevens zal ik aan hen vragen of en in welke mate het mogelijk is deze verder uit te splitsen naar nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er vanaf 1 januari 2014 in Lelystad ’s nachts geen apotheker meer geopend is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the closure of Lelystad's night pharmacy, and patients having to travel to Almere for emergency medicine, was acceptable and whether insurers and pharmacists were meeting their duty to provide 24-hour pharmaceutical care. The minister answered that emergency medicine remains available via insurers' contracting duties and home delivery, that compliance is for the NZa and IGZ to assess, and that no concrete maximum travel distance exists.
Whether health insurers comply with their duty of care is for the specific supervisor, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa), to assess.
Of zorgverzekeraars zich aan hun zorgplicht houden staat ter beoordeling van de specifieke toezichthouder de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over het project «modernisering zuiveringsheffing

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked about industrial firms leaving public wastewater treatment, the scope and composition of the 'modernisering zuiveringsheffing' project, and monitoring and transparency of private treatment plants. Minister Schultz answered most questions on substance, citing ongoing study by Royal Haskoning DHV, while declining to change self-regulation or the household cost allocation, which she said falls outside the project.
The research is being carried out on behalf of IenM by Royal Haskoning DHV.
Het onderzoek wordt in opdracht van IenM uitgevoerd door Royal Haskoning DHV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Diaconessenhuis in Meppel zich in de toekomst mogelijk zal beperken tot de planbare zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel may limit itself to planned care, closing or relocating departments, and whether insurer Achmea pressured it. The Minister answered that the hospital's profile (basic specialist care, merged HAP/SEH, reduced OR use) is being developed in 2014, that no department closures are currently planned, and that the NZa and ACM oversee the fusion and insurer-provider negotiations.
The Diaconessenhuis has informed me that the profile, see my answer to question 1, is leading and that there is currently no question of closing departments.
Het Diaconessenhuis heeft mij laten weten dat het profiel, zie mijn antwoord op vraag 1, leidend is en er op dit moment geen sprake van sluiting van afdelingen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over gecoupeerde paardenstaarten binnen de geledingen van de Koninklijke Vereniging “Het Nederlandse Trekpaard en De Haflinger”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about docked horse tails within the KVTH horse breed association, including whether judging rewards docked horses and whether breeding officials sell docked horses. The government said the association made no substantive commitment on judging, will be invited for talks and asked to set a date after which docked horses are excluded from shows, and that the recognition of studbooks does not depend on tail status.
While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek kan ik daarover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat MC Zuiderzee BV nu de enige aandeelhouder is van het Slotervaartziekenhuis

SP MPs asked the health minister about the takeover of Slotervaart Hospital by MC Groep, including the transfer of pharmacy and oncology neurosurgery to the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek, pressure from insurers and creditors, the role of the court-appointed administrator, and whether the IGZ is monitoring care quality. The minister answered that the takeover is a commercial matter, the IGZ has found no care risks, and she defends shareholder participation in healthcare, while promising a central shareholders register.
The amount is not known to me.
Het bedrag is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over beleggingen in tabaksaandelen door pensioenfondsen en banken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health and the Finance Minister whether Dutch pension funds (notably ABP) and state-owned banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) investing in tobacco shares conflicts with FCTC article 5.3 and related recommendations, and whether the government would intervene. The government answered that pension funds and banks are responsible for their own investment policy, that the FCTC recommendations are not binding, that tobacco investment is legal and not excluded by law, and that it sees no reason to instruct ABP, while pointing to existing CSR transparency policy for state holdings.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess the specific investments of individual funds.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ontgassen van binnenvaartschepen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a CE Delft report claiming higher emissions from degassing inland vessels than RIVM estimated, enforcement arrangements and sanction figures, and whether a reporting duty or revised RIVM protocol is needed. The Secretary explained the methodological differences, listed the enforcing bodies and 2012-2013 enforcement results, and committed to asking RIVM to examine the new data and to a ban on degassing via the CDNI treaty revision.
This yielded the following results: 2012: 38 warnings and 14 official reports; 2013: 6 warnings and 17 official reports.
Dit gaf het volgende resultaat 2012: 38 waarschuwingen en 14 processen-verbaal; 2013: 6 waarschuwingen en 17 processen-verbaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over munitiestortplaats Engelsmanplaat (Waddenzee)

Two MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a WWII munitions dump near the Engelsmanplaat in the Wadden Sea, including whether it is monitored and who is responsible. The government answered that the dump lies under about 10 metres of sand, is covered by regular Rijkswaterstaat bed and water-quality surveys, and that the Ministry of Defence's EOD handles explosives clearance.
Rijkswaterstaat includes this area in the regular six-yearly depth measurements of the Wadden Sea region.
Rijkswaterstaat neemt dit gebied in het kader van de reguliere 6-jaarlijkse dieptemetingen van het Waddenzeegebied mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Nuvaring een verhoogde kans op trombose geeft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that the Nuvaring contraceptive ring raises thrombosis risk, including embolism reports, promotion by manufacturer MSD, and possible market withdrawal. The Minister answered that the risk matches other third and fourth generation pills, that the product information is being tightened following a PRAC advice, that existing inspection of pharmaceutical marketing is adequate, and that the decision on market withdrawal rests with the CBG.
It is the task of the Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG) to weigh this information and decide whether additional measures are needed on the basis of that information.
Het is de taak van het College ter beoordeling van geneesmiddelen (CBG) om deze informatie te wegen en te beslissen of er op basis van die informatie aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de afdeling klinische verloskunde uit Hengelo dreigt te verdwijnen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health whether the obstetric department in Hengelo will close, whether insurer Menzis had a role, and what will be done to prevent closure and further loss of specialist care in Twente. The Minister says the closure plan from the regional hospitals (ZGT and MST) is not yet decided, that IGZ and NZa oversee quality and access, that no hospital location in the region is sensitive to the 45-minute norm, and that she will not intervene directly beyond oversight.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over bacteriën zonder vijand

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the ministers about carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) in the food chain, monitoring, zero-tolerance policy, the role of intensive livestock farming and incentives for new antibiotics. The minister answered that food monitoring since 2011 found no CRE, that RIVM was asked for an integrated advice within three months, and that pull incentives such as patent extension will be explored with the European Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tijgermug en de Aziatische bosmug

An MP from the SP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers about tiger mosquito imports via used tyres and Lucky bamboo, the VACO covenant, and the Asian bush mosquito. The minister replied that the policy targets the highest-risk pathways, that self-regulation via a covenant is used for tyre importers, and that the Asian bush mosquito is not a relevant disease vector in practice and cannot feasibly be eradicated.
My policy focuses on the greatest risks of introduction and spread of tiger mosquitoes in the Netherlands.
Mijn beleid richt zich op de grootste risico’s van introductie en verspreiding van tijgermuggen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde

SP MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about risks, oversight, and remediation options for the Oosterschelde munitions dump, following an EenVandaag report. The minister replied that TNO studies found spontaneous explosion practically nil and no proven environmental harm, that monitoring continues with added measures in 2014, and that remediation (estimated at €7 million in 2004) was not pursued because risks are low.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dump will be measured monthly.
In 2014 zal de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks worden gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de acute zorgpost in Oldenzaal mogelijk sluit

An SP MP asked the Minister whether the planned closure of the daytime acute care post in Oldenzaal, which would force residents to travel to Enschede, was acceptable and whether it was linked to the loss of a 1.5 million euro availability subsidy. The Minister answered that the decision is the responsibility of the hospital and regional parties, that the location is not critical under the 45-minute norm, and that the NZa and Inspectie will assess accessibility and quality.
It is not my responsibility to make a decision about the future of this location.
Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om een besluit te nemen over de toekomst van deze locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handhaven van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch food authority NVWA and the Dienst Regelingen enforce the fur-farming ban, and why a municipality reported that enforcement was being held back pending court challenges. The state secretary answered that enforcement is ongoing, with 17 inspections and one proces-verbaal, denied that municipalities were told not to enforce, and said unlawful expansions are checked against the 15 January 2013 baseline.
The quotation you cite does not give a correct account of the NVWA's enforcement policy.
Het door u opgevoerde citaat geeft geen correcte weergave van het handhavingsbeleid van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat logopedisten, fysio- en ergotherapeuten fors gekort worden op hun tarieven

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health why insurers are cutting tariffs for speech therapists, physiotherapists and occupational therapists, whether the rates are reasonable, and whether contracting power and a ban on collective refusal to sign are acceptable. Minister Schippers replied that insurers are free to negotiate tariffs under the NZa maximums and competition rules, declined to publish per-insurer rates, and promised a joint ACM/NZa review of cooperation barriers.
Firstly, I do not have such data; insurers each make their own agreements on tariffs with care providers.
Ten eerste beschik ik niet over dergelijke gegevens, zorgverzekeraars maken ieder voor zich afspraken over tarieven met zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars niet overtuigd zijn van de effectiviteit van protonentherapie

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurers doubting proton therapy's effectiveness, whether four centres are justified, and why insurers may contract only one. The minister replied that proton therapy's benefit lies in reduced damage to healthy tissue, that CVZ-listed indications are covered but individually selected, that four licence applicants is the cap but licensing does not guarantee four centres, and that insurers may contract selectively.
Granting a licence does not, however, mean that four proton centres will certainly be realised.
Vergunningverlening betekent overigens niet dat er met zekerheid ook vier protonencentra zullen worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er 27 fatale gevallen zijn gemeld bij het Lareb die mogelijk verband houden met het gebruik van de Diane-35-pil

An SP MP asked the health minister about 27 reported deaths possibly linked to Diane-35, whether prescribing and reporting were adequate, the role of the CBG and Inspectorate, and whether the drug should be withdrawn or reimbursement stopped. The minister answered that the drug's risks were weighed at registration, that the EMA review found the balance positive with extra monitoring, that doctors should report more, and that the Inspectorate acts against online sellers and misleading advertising.
I am not authorised to take measures regarding individual medicines. That authority rests with the European medicines authorities.
Ik ben niet bevoegd maatregelen nemen terzake van individuele geneesmiddelen. Die bevoegdheid berust bij de Europese geneesmiddelenautoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een jong gezin 800 euro parkeerkosten maakte na de te vroege geboorte van een kind, omdat de parkeerkosten bij het VUmc (VUmedisch centrum) en bij het OLVG (

An SP MP asked the Health Minister to react to reports that a young family paid 800 euro in hospital parking fees after a premature birth, whether hospital parking profits fund patient care, and whether a national cap or discount scheme should apply. The minister said hospitals and municipalities should set parking policy themselves, declined a national rule or investigation, but will ask the OLVG board to review this case.
I have no overview of all parking tariffs, the costs of parking facilities, the profit or loss on parking facilities, or how profitability is recorded in the overall budget.

Ik heb geen overzicht van alle parkeertarieven, de kosten van parkeervoorzieningen, de winst of verlies op parkeervoorzieningen en de wijze waarop de winstgevendheid wordt verwerkt in de totale begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Stortplaatsen Apeldoorn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about soil contamination around former landfills in Apeldoorn, drinking water risks, nationwide prevalence and oversight of aftercare. The State Secretary answered that the provinces, as competent authorities, judge the sites harmless, that no drinking water threat exists, and that no current national overview is available since responsibility is decentralised.
Due to the decentralisation of responsibility for former landfills, the Ministry has no current nationwide data on the status of their remediation.

Vanwege de decentralisatie van de verantwoordelijkheid voor NAVOS-stortplaatsen zijn bij het Ministerie geen actuele gegevens op landelijk niveau beschikbaar over de huidige stand van zaken rond de aanpak van deze stortplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over een lagere watertemperatuur bij drinkwaterinstallaties, in relatie tot energiebesparing bij gebouwverwarming en warmtapwaterbereiding

MPs Jansen and Van Gerven asked whether warm tap water may be set at 50 degrees where certified copper-silver ionisation systems are installed, and whether lower temperatures could enable energy savings from waste heat and solar heat. The minister answered that such lower temperatures are permitted only via pilots under expert supervision and strict legal restrictions, and that the potential savings are limited to specific situations.

If the results are satisfactory, agreement can be given from a public health perspective to lowering the hot tap water temperature and/or flushing frequency at all locations where the system concerned is installed.

Indien de resultaten bevredigend zijn, kan uit oogpunt van de volksgezondheid akkoord worden gegaan met verlaging van de warm tapwatertemperatuur en/of spoelfrequentie op alle locaties waar het betreffende systeem is geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de snelheidsverhoging langs snelwegen voor de gezondheid van burgers

MP Van Gerven asks whether raising motorway speed limits worsens air quality and health near roads, and whether the limit should be reversed. The minister replies that the effect is limited, that the government stays within legal air quality norms, and that it will not restore the old speed limit.
No. I remain within the legally established norms, which are partly based on the health effects.
Nee. Ik blijf binnen de wettelijk vastgestelde normen, die mede zijn gebaseerd op de effecten voor de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ontnemen van het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ wegens gecoupeerde paardenstaarten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Royal Dutch Heavy Horse and Haflinger association keeping its royal title despite members widely docking horses' tails, and about possible evasion via France, breeding-register recognition, and calls to revoke the title. The government answered that the association meets the criteria for the title and studie register recognition, that tail docking is banned by law but not a register condition, and that EU harmonisation will be pushed.
No. See my answer to question 4.
Nee. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 4.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis en het Zuwe Hofpoort Ziekenhuis een voorgenomen fusie hebben aangemeld bij de Autoriteit Consument & Markt

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the proposed merger of St. Antonius and Zuwe Hofpoort hospitals notified to the competition authority, probing financial pressure, closure risks for emergency and other departments, staff and stakeholder views, and compliance with a pending merger-review bill. The minister declined to judge the individual merger, pointed to the ACM as competent authority, said she would write to both hospitals urging conduct in the spirit of the bill, and promised to forward any stakeholder views and publish the ACM and advisory opinions once issued.
It is for them to pass a judgment on this. I do not make statements on individual cases.
Het is aan hen hierover een oordeel uit te spreken. Ik doe geen uitspraak over individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport de afgelopen vier jaar bijna een ton heeft geschonken aan het Apollo netwerk

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that ministry officials, including the director of medicines, take part in the Apollo network alongside pharmaceutical companies, that the ministry has paid about a million euros to it, and whether all exchanges and the conditional-reimbursement report can be made public. The minister defends officials' participation as necessary for practical policy knowledge, reports the ministry's annual contributions (about 20,000 to 24,200 euros a year since 2010), declines to disclose the cost of the contractor Accenture and withholds the network's internal exchanges under agreed confidentiality, while saying it is not a stated aim to publish more.
The Apollo network agreed not to go public except with any completed reports of the network.
In het Apollo netwerk is afgesproken om niet naar buiten te treden behoudens met eventuele afgeronde rapporten van het netwerk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het aanprijzen van body scans

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister how she views a Prescan advertisement for a total body scan, whether such advertising should be allowed given the Dutch ban on these scans, and whether the scans cause unnecessary care costs and conflict with medical ethics. The minister answered that she awaits a Gezondheidsraad advisory report due in 2014 before taking a position, that the Dutch screening law does not cover examinations performed abroad, and that she could not provide data on costs or health gains.
As soon as I receive the advice from the Health Council, I will send a position to your House and include the issue of advertising in it.
Zodra ik advies van de Gezondheidsraad ontvang, zal ik een standpunt naar uw Kamer sturen en het punt van reclame daarbij meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tabakslobby in Nederland

An SP MP asked three ministers about tobacco industry lobbying, the use of industry-funded research and Philip Morris-commissioned STAR reports, and conflicts of interest. The government answered that industry-commissioned studies are reviewed on usefulness, that the STAR reports were confidential but the latest was published, and that it does not track professors' tobacco-industry ties beyond disclosed side positions.
I am not free to provide these reports to the House without the consent of the commissioning party.
Het staat mij niet vrij deze rapporten zonder toestemming van de opdrachtgever aan de Kamer te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verstrekking van medisch noodzakelijke merkmedicijnen door een groep van apotheken

An SP MP asked the minister of Health whether Spanhoff/BENU pharmacies' conditions for dispensing medically necessary brand-name medicines, their refusal to home-deliver or stock brand-name products, and alleged handling of prescriptions by non-pharmacists are lawful and whether she will intervene. The minister declined to assess the pharmacy group's conditions, referring to the regulators (NZa, IGZ) and the SKGZ complaints body, and said there is no VWS role, while noting that the email in question is nearly eighteen months old and not necessarily current.
No, there is no role for VWS here, but for the specific supervisory bodies.
Nee, hier is geen rol voor VWS weggelegd maar voor de specifieke toezichthouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Den Haag en tabak’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries of Health, Economic Affairs and Finance whether the government had consulted the tobacco industry before setting its position on the EU Tobacco Products Directive, and whether this conflicted with the FCTC treaty and earlier statements. The government replied that industry contact is limited to technical implementation matters, that the industry was only consulted on the directive after the BNC fiche was sent to parliament, and that no FCTC violation occurred.
VWS deliberately chose not to consult the tobacco industry and health organisations while the government position was being drafted.
VWS heeft er bewust voor gekozen om, ten tijde van het opstellen van het regeringsstandpunt, niet met de tabaksindustrie en de gezondheidsorganisaties in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over reclame voor e-sigaretten

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about Flavor Vapes e-cigarette advertising showing a mother blowing smoke over a pram, whether such marketing should be banned, whether e-cigarettes should fall under the Medicines Act, and whether the answers would come before the plenary debate. The state secretary said the suggestion of risk-free use is worrying, that a general administrative order under the Warenwet with criteria on marketing is being prepared using NVWA and RIVM advice due in October, that the evidence on e-cigarettes as a gateway or cessation aid is still insufficient, and that e-cigarettes are for now treated as consumer goods under the Warenwet, with EU rules pending; he answered yes to timing.
I am preparing an AMVB under the Warenwet setting criteria for certain aspects of the e-cigarette, such as safety and quality, labelling and advertising.
Ik bereid een AMVB onder de Warenwet voor waarin criteria worden gesteld aan bepaalde aspecten van de e-sigaret, zoals veiligheid en kwaliteit, etikettering en reclames.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over kasteelheren die natuurorganisaties 40.000 hectare natuur afhandig willen maken

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about proposals by large landowners to take 40,000 hectares of nature from nature organisations, and whether nature is a public good and whether tendering should be reintroduced. The state secretary said the matter is primarily between the VGG and nature managers, that nature is a shared public responsibility, that no evidence shows private management is less efficient, and that equal treatment of private nature managers is the government's starting point; she also said no tendering is used yet and provinces decide how to proceed.

This wish of the Association for Equal Rights of Landowners is primarily a matter between the VGG and the land-managing organisations, because the government cannot intervene in private property relations.

Deze wens van de Vereniging Gelijkberechtiging Grondbezitters is primair een zaak tussen de VGG en de terreinbeherende organisaties, omdat de overheid niet kan treden in private eigendomsverhoudingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het sluiten van de huisartsenpost en het stoppen met kindergeneeskunde en geboortezorg bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the closure of emergency care, paediatrics and maternity care at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the possible relocation of the GP out-of-hours post were acceptable, and how access for patients would be guaranteed. The minister answered that the GP post location is a matter for the doctors, that the hospital cited lack of an IC facility for its decisions, that the Health Inspectorate supervises care quality, and that an extra ambulance is temporarily deployed until a review of drive times is completed.
If at any point it turns out that the preconditions for providing responsible care are not present, the IGZ intervenes.
Als op enig moment blijkt dat de randvoorwaarden om verantwoorde zorg te leveren niet aanwezig zijn grijpt de IGZ in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ex-baas van Sanquin salaris krijgt doorbetaald

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports that Sanquin's former chair continues to receive salary until March 2014 while the organisation cuts costs and jobs, and whether the minister's earlier statement that he had no bonus or premium entitlement still holds. The minister answered that the payments come from accrued leave and the life-course scheme available to all staff, that the 12,000 euro concerns mandatory employer social charges and pension premiums rather than bonuses, and that the cost-cutting reorganisation is driven by declining blood use.
In Sanquin's annual accounts, the salary, social charges and pension premiums of the board members are specified.
In de jaarrekening van Sanquin worden salaris, sociale lasten en pensioenpremie van de bestuurders gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over langere ambulanceritten vanuit Spijkenisse
