Two SP MPs asked the health minister about longer ambulance drive times from Spijkenisse after the emergency department of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital was scaled down, and whether the Inspectorate and GPs are adequately involved. The minister replied that RIVM calculations show the Spijkenisse ED is not crucial for the 45-minute norm, that an extra ambulance is being deployed temporarily, that the insurer and the Inspectorate are responsible for continuity and quality of care, and that GP concerns are handled in regional consultation.
The health insurer, under its duty of care, is responsible for the continuity of critical care and therefore for accessibility.
De zorgverzekeraar is vanuit zijn zorgplicht verantwoordelijk voor de continuïteit van cruciale zorg en daarmee voor de bereikbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over eigen betalingen door het preferentiebeleid van Achmea

An MP asked the minister whether an 80-year-old patient had to pay herself for the brand-name drug Plavix under Achmea's preferential policy, despite a claimed medical need, and whether Achmea and the pharmacist acted unlawfully. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, referred the dispute to the SKGZ complaints body, found little evidence of problems across insurers, and said Achmea reported the prescriber judged no medical necessity.
I will not go into the individual case presented because this is apparently a dispute over benefits.
Ik zal niet ingaan op de voorgelegde individuele casus omdat hier kennelijk sprake is van een verstrekkingsgeschil.
Antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers verdienen aan geneesmiddelen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether pharmacists receive larger discounts on medicines from wholesalers than they pass on to health insurers, and what should be done. The Minister said she lacks the contracts and discount data to answer, did not know the basis of the press report, and pointed to a sector publication showing falling pharmacy incomes in 2012 and 2013 and noted that insurers' premiums fell.

I cannot answer these questions because I do not have the agreements between pharmacists and pharmaceutical wholesalers, nor the contracts between pharmacists and health insurers containing discount arrangements and their clawback.

Ik kan deze vragen niet beantwoorden omdat ik niet beschik over de afspraken tussen apotheekhoudenden en farmaceutische groothandels en ook niet over de contracten tussen apotheekhoudenden en zorgverzekeraars met afspraken over kortingen en het afromen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de sluiting van een huisartsenpost in Woerden

MP Van Gerven asked the minister whether the Woerden out-of-hours GP post is closing, why, and whether other GP posts face closure. The minister replied that the post stays open evenings and weekends, only the night service moves to Leidsche Rijn for centrality and safety reasons, and that she is aware of no other closures.
There is no question of closing a GP post, as is evident from my answer to question 1.
Er is geen sprake van sluiting van een huisartsenpost, zoals uit mijn antwoord op vraag 1 blijkt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de massaontslagen in de zorg

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary of health about mass layoffs across care providers ahead of planned cuts, questioning their consistency with government policy and how quality and workers would be protected. The state secretary replied that employers must respond to changing care demand and that layoff decisions are for employers subject to the preventive dismissal review, while stating the government's aim is sustainable care and that quality oversight remains unchanged.
It is the responsibility of employers to take account of numerous environmental factors and to act on them as well as possible.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van werkgevers om met talloze omgevingsfactoren rekening te houden en daar zo goed mogelijk naar te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handelen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg bij een arts met een alcoholprobleem

MP Van Gerven asks how the Inspectorate for Health Care handled reports about a solo GP with an alcohol problem, whether the doctor should continue practising, whether colleagues raised alarms, and how the Inspectorate treats reports of addiction among healthcare workers. The minister answers that the Inspectorate received two reports in 2012, found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has reopened an investigation after new complaints, and will develop norms and an enforcement framework for alcohol and drug misuse, including a power to suspend practitioners provisionally.
The Inspectorate's policy is always to act when a practitioner's conduct, as a result of alcohol or drug misuse, leads to demonstrable patient safety risks.
Het beleid van de IGZ is om altijd op te treden wanneer het handelen van een beroepsbeoefenaar als gevolg van drank- of drugsmisbruik tot aantoonbare patiëntonveiligheid leidt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘De macht van de tabakslobby, hoe de industrie de winkelier voor haar karretje spant’

An SP MP asked the government for its reaction to a press article on tobacco industry lobbying, including the moral judgement on covertly funded anti-tobacco-prevention campaigns and the FSIT fund linked to the NSO retailers' association, and whether other similar fundraising organisations exist and what will be done to prevent them. The state secretary answered that retailer organisations may freely represent their sector's interests, that other similar bodies may exist, and that they must comply with existing rules such as the tobacco advertising ban, without committing to new action.
It is not for the cabinet to prevent such organisations, which seek to represent the interests of a sector, from being established.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te voorkomen dat dergelijke organisaties, die de belangen van een sector willen vertegenwoordigen, worden opgericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat huisartsen zich ernstige zorgen maken over de ontstane situatie na het faillissement van het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about GP concerns over acute care gaps after the bankruptcy of the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, the ambulance response times, the sale process and alleged backroom arrangements with insurers and the competition authority. The minister largely deflected: she said acute care coordination belongs to the regional forum, insurers and the NZa/IGZ are responsible, the sale was a curators' decision, and she had no role in the arrangements.
I will not go into what was or was not discussed by others at Saint Paul de Vence.
Ik ga niet in op wat er al dan niet in Saint Paul de Vence door anderen is besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de CVA-zorg in het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis acuut is gestopt

An SP MP asked the health minister whether CVA (stroke) care at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital was stopped because the Inspectorate no longer considered it responsible, where stroke patients will go, and whether the new owners and insurers should be held to account for dismantling the care and treating staff badly. The minister answered that the hospital board, in consultation with chain partners, decided to stop acute neurology care because staffing and quality criteria could not be guaranteed, that this was not an Inspectorate decision, that other regional hospitals provide the care, and that no evidence of misuse of bankruptcy law was found.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for the quality of care provided.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis behouden blijft

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister of Health about the rescue of LangeLand Hospital in Zoetermeer, covering its future profile, staffing, specialist shareholding, insurer and Vierstroom roles, Vebego's involvement, and comparison with the Ruwaard van Putten bankruptcy. The minister answered that essential emergency and maternity care will remain, that specialist participation is viewed positively, and that the Inspectorate was informed but not involved in the decisions, leaving most details to the hospital and regulators.
The inspectorate was not involved in the decision-making on the structure or the choice of acquiring partner.
De inspectie is niet betrokken geweest bij de besluitvorming over de constructie of de keuze voor een overnamepartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat nieuwe bloedverdunners dodelijke maag-darmbloedingen kunnen veroorzaken

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that new anticoagulants (NOACs) raise the risk of fatal gastrointestinal bleeding, and whether the drugs should be withdrawn. The minister answered that professional guidelines advise caution, that Lareb and the CBG continue to monitor reports (239 reports, 11 deaths, with unclear causality), and that a Dutch study on the indication atrial fibrillation has been started.
This research has already been initiated in cooperation with ZonMw and the relevant professional associations.
Dit onderzoek is al ingezet in samenwerking met ZonMw en de betrokken beroepsverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde verdwijnt in Sittard-Geleen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the planned closure of the obstetrics ward in Sittard-Geleen and its concentration in Heerlen, including accessibility, staff consultation, and the role of insurers. The minister answered that she has no objection as long as quality and accessibility norms are met, and that the hospitals' strategic plan, staff consultation and any new travel-time calculations will be checked by the IGZ and NZa.
As long as the concentration plans meet the quality and accessibility standards, I see no reason to prevent this.
Zolang met de concentratieplannen wordt voldaan aan de normen voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid zie ik geen reden dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Slotervaartziekenhuis in grote financiële problemen verkeert

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that Slotervaart Hospital faces serious financial problems, including bank credit cuts, debt recall risk, alleged misuse of funds by a former chair, and ministerial contacts. The minister replied that she has no signals of acute financial problems, that hospital governance and financing are the hospital's own responsibility, that the IGZ examined governance, and that she sees no role in a possible bankruptcy because the hospital is not indispensable for crucial care.
It is up to the hospital and to ING Bank themselves to answer these questions.
Het is aan het ziekenhuis en aan de ING Bank zelf om antwoord te geven op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar VGZ de druk op artsen wil opvoeren om vaker te kiezen voor goedkopere medicijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views health insurer VGZ's plan to pressure doctors into prescribing cheaper medicines, whether patients with medical need may lose coverage for brand-name drugs, and whether pharmaceutical marketing to doctors should be curbed. The minister replied that VGZ's preferential policy is legitimate, that brand-name drugs remain covered when medically necessary, and that existing marketing rules and self-regulation are sufficient, so no new measures are announced.
No, that is not the case. Inquiries with VGZ show that since the start of its preferential policy in 2008 it has always covered more expensive brand-name medicines when there is medical necessity.

Nee, daar is geen sprake van. Uit navraag bij VGZ blijkt dat zij vanaf het begin van het preferentiebeleid, in 2008, altijd het beleid heeft gehanteerd duurdere merkmedicijnen te vergoeden als er sprake is van medische noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nazorglocaties bodemverontreiniging

An MP asked the state secretary how many aftercare locations with residual soil contamination exist, who is responsible for aftercare, how provinces prioritise it given limited staff, and who guarantees the funding. The state secretary said there is no national overview, that competent authorities are responsible, that a survey will be sent in November, and that funding has been provided through 2014 with reservations planned for 2015 onward.
I have no overview of the number of aftercare locations in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal nazorglocaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat er twijfels zijn over de dood van een bewoner in een zorginstelling

An SP MP asked the state secretary about media reports doubting the death of a resident in a care institution, including whether the Inspectorate had imposed enhanced supervision, how long the Inspectorate took to visit, prior complaints, and whether staff were heard. The state secretary answered that the institution remains responsible for safety, no enhanced supervision has been imposed yet, an independent external investigation is underway with the family's agreement, and the institution is in contact with the family.
At present the external investigation by independent investigators into the report is ongoing. Based on the outcomes of this investigation, the IGZ will determine further steps.
Op dit moment loopt het externe onderzoek door onafhankelijke onderzoekers naar de melding. Op grond van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de IGZ verdere stappen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de ouderenzorg slecht voorbereid is op een hittegolf

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health whether elderly care is poorly prepared for heatwaves, why many care institutions lack cooling and heat protocols, and whether inspection and the GGD monitor this. The state secretary rejected the generalisation, said heat protocols are not mandatory but care providers must deliver good care including heat measures supervised by the IGZ, and declined to commission a survey of protocol compliance.
I have asked the inspectorate to inform me directly if it appears that institutions do not have this policy in order.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd mij direct te informeren indien blijkt dat instellingen dit beleid niet op orde hebben.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een tandarts die in Duitsland uit zijn ambt is gezet in Den Haag een spoor van

An SP MP asked the health and justice ministers about a dentist removed from practice in Germany who was still registered in the Netherlands and allegedly caused harm and billing fraud. The minister replied that foreign restrictions were not in force at registration, that the IGZ has imposed a ban on practising, and that the OM declined a criminal investigation into billing fraud.
It is not known how many people have been harmed by this dentist's irresponsible medical treatment.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel mensen gedupeerd zijn door onverantwoord medisch handelen van deze tandarts.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het beschadigen en weghalen van een beverburcht door het waterschap

An SP MP asked whether the water board Peel en Maasvallei violated the Flora- and faunawet by destroying beaver dams without a permit, and what the consequences and safeguards are. The State Secretary answered that the water board acted carefully and in line with the law, that lowering and removing the dams was unavoidable to prevent flooding, and that no further consequences or new measures were planned.
The water board Peel en Maasvallei has acted in accordance with the Flora- and faunawet.
Het waterschap Peel en Maasvallei heeft conform de Flora- en faunawet gehandeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over de brand bij chemiebedrijf ELD in Oosterhou

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice for a timeline of the June 2013 fire at chemical company ELD in Oosterhout, the GRIP escalation, prior inspections, emergency plans, public communication and the failure to sound sirens. The minister answered in detail, giving a timeline and communication record, but said the investigation into compliance was still ongoing and that communication is a local responsibility.
The investigation is still ongoing, so it is still unclear whether the company complied with all regulations at the time the fire broke out.
Op dit moment loopt het onderzoek nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is of het bedrijf op het moment van uitbreken van de brand aan alle voorschriften voldeed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Paulus Jansen over asbestsanering in Emmen

MPs Van Gerven and Paulus Jansen asked the government about asbestos remediation at the Visserhoek flat in Emmen, including whether the housing corporation, contractor, inspection body and municipality acted improperly. The state secretary answered that certified firms did the work, that no legal violation was found by the Inspectie SZW, that municipal supervision lies with the provinces, and that the wider sector is responsible for safe work.
Interadministrative supervision of municipalities is vested in the provinces under the Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht.
Het interbestuurlijk toezicht op gemeenten is middels de Wet Revitalisering Generiek Toezicht neergelegd bij de provincies.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de exorbitante ontslagvergoedingen aan bestuurders in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about large severance payments to former healthcare executives, including a EUR 200,000 payout at Medisch Centrum Haaglanden and EUR 650,000 at UMC Radboud. The minister said the Wnt pay cap took effect on 1 January 2013 with a EUR 75,000 norm for severance, that the earlier cases predate it, and that the government will tighten the Wnt as set out in the coalition agreement, while rejecting the demand for retroactive clawback as legally unworkable.
The intentions regarding tightening the WNT are included in the coalition agreement.
De voornemens ten aanzien van de aanscherping van de WNT zijn in het regeerakkoord opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven zijn gesteld over de stijging van de waterschapslasten bij het waterschap Brabantse Delta

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why water board Brabantse Delta plans cost increases of up to 5% a year, how this fits earlier promises of no net tariff rises and the Bestuursakkoord Water, and about the board's governance. The minister replied that the increases stem from task transfers and long-running EU-driven measures, that the water board's leadership is responsible for tariff decisions, and that the Bestuursakkoord Water sets a collective goal of moderate increases; the minister also said the long-term organisation of water governance will be examined together with partners.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Achmea Health Center adverteert met tien kilo afvallen in tien weken

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether Achmea Health Center's advertising of a ten-kilo, ten-week weight-loss programme is misleading, and about the financial ties and discounts between insurer Achmea and AHC. Minister Schippers replied that insurers may pursue such side activities, saw no reason to label the programme unhealthy or misleading, and saw no problem with the ownership link, the 20% discount for Achmea insured, or the advertising costs.
Insurers are free to pursue this kind of side activity and promote it publicly.
Het staat verzekeraars vrij dit soort nevenactiviteiten te ontplooien en publiekelijk aan te prijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het belastingtarief voor alternatieve genezers

Van Gerven (SP) asks how alternative healers such as magnetisers can be VAT-exempt like psychologists under EU and Dutch law, given no equivalent training or effectiveness proof, and whether the law should be tightened. The state secretary answers that the exemption is limited to GZ-psychologists from 2013, that the court's reading is too broad so cassation was filed, and that EU case law requires equal treatment of competing services.
In my view this is too broad an interpretation of the term 'services of a psychologist' in the exemption provision. I have therefore lodged cassation against this ruling.
Dit is naar mijn oordeel een te ruime uitleg van het begrip «diensten van een psycholoog» als bedoeld in de vrijstellingsbepaling. Daarom heb ik dan ook cassatie ingesteld tegen deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Orde van Medisch Specialisten vindt dat patiënten moeten meebetalen aan een second opinion

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether the second opinion should remain covered in the basic insurance package and whether patients should co-pay, after the Medical Specialists' Association suggested patients pay. The minister declined to commit before a decision in spring 2014, said suggestions from parties are being collected and tested by the CVZ, and gave no figures on savings or outcomes.
I do not want to anticipate that decision-making, because I want to base my decision on all advice and suggestions available at that time.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op die besluitvorming, omdat ik mijn beslissing wil baseren op alle adviezen en suggesties die op dat moment voorliggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een opgestapt lid van het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) forse kritiek uit op ‘de perversies van het  systeem’

An MP asked the health minister to respond to criticism by a departed CBG (medicines assessment board) member of the system's perversions, conflicts of interest with industry, and the lack of transparency. The minister answered that the board is independent, defended the rules on member interests and lengthy tenure, said attempted industry influence was reported only once, and promised to look into that incident and report to parliament.
Attempts at influence by pharmaceutical companies must be reported to the chair.
Pogingen tot beïnvloeding door farmaceutische bedrijven moeten worden gemeld bij de voorzitter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid van Gerven over huisartsen in Gemert-Bakel die zich zorgen maken over de gezondheid van de bevolking Gemert-Bakel

An SP MP asked the state secretary about health risks, odour, emissions and antibiotic-resistance concerns raised by GP's regarding a large biogas digester near a residential area in Gemert-Bakel. The government answered that siting and permitting are decentralised to the local authority, which must consult the municipal health service, and that national intervention is not possible for siting or odour.
The competent authority can refuse the permit if the expected odour nuisance cannot be sufficiently limited by measures or conditions.
Het bevoegd gezag kan de vergunning weigeren als de te verwachten stankoverlast in onvoldoende mate kan worden beperkt door maatregelen of voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen inspringen op cardiologische groeimarkt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether hospitals expanding into cardiology, and the rising number of ICD implantations, reflect financially driven overtreatment and what the government will do about it. The minister denied that financial motives drive ICD placement, cited a broader indication and more replacements as causes, and pointed to insurers' selective purchasing and a planned national study rather than new rules.
The suggestion in your questions that centres place implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs) for financial motives is not something I recognise.
De suggestie die in uw vragen gewekt wordt, dat centra implanteerbare cardioverter defibrillatoren (ICD's) zouden plaatsen omwille van financiële motieven, herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bashir over vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the composition of a hazardous-goods train that derailed at Wetteren in Belgium, whether rules were broken, whether emergency services are informed in advance, and whether tank wagons and safety norms are adequate. The government answered that no rules were broken, emergency services are not notified per train but have category-level data via OVGS, tank wagons met Dutch norms at departure, and it will raise safety improvements internationally only if the Belgian investigation finds grounds.
If not, are you willing to make such advance information provision mandatory?
Zo nee, bent u bereid dergelijke informatievoorziening vooraf te gaan verplichten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende sluiting van de Spoedeisende Hulp en de Intensive Care in het Diaconessenhuis te Meppel

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency department and intensive care unit of the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel might close, and whether this was linked to the Isala/Noorderboog merger. The minister answered that the hospital board says no closure is planned and no dismissals will occur, while acknowledging ongoing talks with insurers about acute care and deferring any future reorganisation to the regional insurers and ROAZ.
As indicated in answers 2, 3 and 4, according to the Board of Directors there is currently no question of the SEH and IC of the Diaconessenhuis disappearing.
Zoals in vraag 2, 3 en 4 aangegeven is er op dit moment volgens de Raad van Bestuur geen sprake van het verdwijnen van de SEH en IC van het Diaconessenhuis.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Frankrijk de Diane-35 en generieke vormen van de markt heeft gehaald ondanks de uitspraak van het Europese Pharmacovigilance Risk Assessment Committee (PRAC)

An SP MP asked the Health Minister why France withdrew Diane-35 and generics despite the EMA PRAC recommending they stay available under conditions, and whether the Netherlands would follow or push for a ban. The minister replied that national risk assessments are independent, that the EU emergency procedure is not yet concluded, that the CBG represents the Netherlands and the CMDh recommended keeping the drug on the market, and that she will not pre-empt the European decision.
Leaving aside that I am not competent to withdraw marketing authorisations – the Netherlands deliberately left the authorisation and withdrawal of medicines to the independent CBG

Nog daargelaten dat ik niet bevoegd ben om handelsvergunningen in te trekken – in Nederland is er bewust voor gekozen om de toelating en het uit de handel nemen van geneesmiddelen over te laten aan het onafhankelijke CBG
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ulenbelt over nieuwe technieken voor asbestverwijdering

MPs Van Gerven and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how the new Foamshield asbestos-containment technique was assessed, whether workers and residents will be protected, who supervises the trial, and what the products and costs are. The government answered that the work meets existing Arbo rules, that exposure will stay below limit values, that Inspectie SZW will inspect alongside local bodies, and that the certification body Ascert is still studying whether the technique can be validated.
Yes, I am aware of the planned application in Zeist of a new technique, under the name Foamshield.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de voorgenomen toepassing in Zeist van een nieuwe techniek, onder de naam Foamshield.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat Nutricia claimt dat het drankje Souvenaid belangrijke voedingsstoffen bevat die zouden helpen bij mensen met beginnende Alzheimer

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the health minister how she views Nutricia's claims that the drink Souvenaid helps early-stage Alzheimer patients, whether it should have been assessed by the CBG as a medicine, and about industry ties to Alzheimer research under the Deltaplan Dementie. The minister answered that medical claims on food require CBG assessment, that the Deltaplan is a public-private partnership with scientific committees safeguarding independence, and that ZonMw will run open calls with external review.
A claim that a product has a positive medicinal effect in early-stage Alzheimer must be regarded as a medical claim.
Een claim dat een product een positief geneeskrachtig effect heeft bij beginnende Alzheimer, moet worden gezien als een medische claim.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het sterftecijfer te hoog is bij het hartcentrum van het Haga Ziekenhuis

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reports of above-average cardiac surgery mortality at the Haga Hospital heart centre, the referral halt by MCH, the IGZ's role, and whether patient safety is guaranteed. Minister Schippers answered that the IGZ found no evidence of deliberate misreporting, that the hospital itself took improvement measures and halted operations, and that the IGZ sees no need for further enforcement, while declining to publish the internal report and deferring referral policy to the hospital.
The IGZ therefore sees no reason to take further measures.
De IGZ ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over salmonellabesmetting in zalm

An MP asked the government why contaminated smoked salmon was not traced and withdrawn in time during the 2012 salmonella outbreak, including inspection history, traceability rules and NVWA staffing. The minister answered that the NVWA's internal evaluation has led to procedural improvements, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid and the Openbaar Ministerie are investigating so detailed answers are withheld, and that the NVWA's response timeline and inspection record are described in general terms.
Because the Dutch Safety Board (OvV) is investigating this case, VWS is not carrying out its own evaluation.
Omdat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OvV) onderzoek doet naar deze zaak voert VWS geen eigen evaluatie uit.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat anticonceptiepillen van de derde en vierde generatie door effectieve marketing van de farmaceutische industrie op de markt werden gehouden

An MP asked the health minister how marketing by the pharmaceutical industry may have kept third- and fourth-generation contraceptive pills on the market, including industry-sponsored studies, misleading websites and textbook claims. The minister answered that self-regulation and Inspectie oversight apply, that the websites are being assessed for advertising breaches, and that a conversation with the GP profession will follow.
The inspectorate is currently assessing the named websites and will enforce where necessary.
De inspectie beoordeelt momenteel de genoemde websites en treedt indien nodig handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Integraal Kankercentum Zuid de ex-directeur 160.000 euro moet betalen

Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about a court-ordered EUR 160,000 severance payment to the former director of the Integraal Kankercentrum Zuid, the dismissal circumstances, the ministry's role including funding threats, and the merger and cancer registry. The minister said she has no formal position on the dismissal, which is the supervisory board's responsibility, and described the funding changes and the merger process.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie van het Scheper Ziekenhuis in Emmen en Ziekenhuis Bethesda in Hoogeveen met het Refaja ziekenhuis in Stadskanaal

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether she endorses the proposed merger of Scheper Hospital, Bethesda Hospital and Refaja Hospital, and whether service provision will suffer, given concerns from municipal councils, medical staff and GPs. The minister answered that the competition authority (ACM) already approved the merger, that she is neutral on mergers, and that the forthcoming stricter care-specific merger test (not yet in force) will require stakeholder involvement, but she gave no commitment to block or alter the merger.
Until the bill regulating the tightened care-specific merger review has force of law, it is reserved to the ACM to rule on mergers from a competition-law perspective.

Totdat het wetsvoorstel waarin de aanscherpingen van zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden geregeld kracht van wet heeft, is het voorbehouden aan de ACM om zich uit te spreken over fusies vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk perspectief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van waterbedrijven

Member Van Gerven (SP) asked whether the government would act against privatisation of water utilities, citing price rises in Paços de Ferreira, Portugal, and an EU concessions directive. The government answered that privatisation is a sovereign national choice under EU treaty rules, that Portugal's MoU was agreed with the Troika and is monitored by it, and that transparency and universal access should be preserved, without committing to halt privatisation.
The cabinet regards the way the drinking water sector is organised in other member states as a national sovereign competence.
Het kabinet beschouwt de wijze van inrichting van de drinkwatersector in andere lidstaten als een nationale soevereine bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van drinkwaterbedrijven

An SP MP asks the government to reconcile the Finance Minister's statement that privatising utilities including water can benefit society with the Infrastructure Minister's assurance that Dutch drinking water stays public, and whether the EU concession directive should exclude water. The government answers that its line on Dutch drinking water is unchanged, that member states keep sovereignty over ownership and organisation of water services, and that the Drinkwaterwet will not be amended.
The Netherlands' position is shared by the Council of the European Union.
Het standpunt van Nederland wordt gedeeld door de Raad van de Europese Unie
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de weigering om de bouwvergunning te vernietigen die de gemeente Landerd heeft afgegeven voor de bouw van een grote geitenstal

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks why the minister refused to ask the Crown to annul the Landerd municipal building permit for a large goat barn during the Q-fever context, despite the provincial building freeze, and questions the legal basis and discretion involved. The minister answers that the permit was lawfully granted, that no conflict with law or the general interest was shown, and that the Crown's annulment discretion was not triggered, while declining to comment on the wisdom of the freeze or the municipal inquiry's conclusions.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de farmaceut Johnson & Johnson heeft geprobeerd negatieve onderzoeksresultaten van het Erasmus MC over het antibraakmiddel domperidon
te beïnvloeden

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views reports that Johnson & Johnson tried to influence negative Erasmus MC research on the anti-nausea drug domperidone, whether university drug research should be free of industry influence, and whether alternatives exist. The minister condemned such conduct if it occurred, said researchers must be free to publish, noted the company and researcher deny pressure, said she is not competent to withdraw domperidon and will await the EU re-assessment.
Researchers must be given the room to publish research results in complete freedom, without influence from the commissioning party or financier.
Onderzoekers dienen de ruimte te krijgen om de onderzoeksresultaten in alle vrijheid te publiceren zonder beïnvloeding van de opdrachtgever c.q. de financier.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er een zelfbenoemde genezer actief is die beweert kanker te kunnen genezen

MP Van Gerven asked whether the government would act against a self-declared healer claiming to cure cancer, including IGZ intervention, tax checks, prosecution under unfair trade rules, and amending the Wet BIG. Minister Schippers said the claims are unacceptable, IGZ can only act once harm is shown, no criminal grounds exist yet, the ACM will be informed, and the Wcz amendment will let IGZ act against harmful alternative providers.
I will bring the broadcast about the Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing to the attention of the ACM.
Ik zal de uitzending over het Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing onder de aandacht brengen van het ACM.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over de vertrekbonus van een ex-topman van het UMC St Radboud

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a large departure bonus and salary paid to the former head of UMC St Radboud, and about related advisory fees and cuts. The minister answered that the contract predated the WNT pay-cap law, that the board had lawfully honoured it, that nothing unlawful occurred so there is no basis for recovery, and that she cannot intervene in the hospital's staffing decisions.
From my responsibility I cannot intervene in the responsibility of the supervisory board in this matter.
Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid kan ik niet treden in de verantwoordelijkheid van de RvT in dezen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Gerven over het bericht  “met vaststellen van nieuwe blootstellingsnormen voor asbest per 1 juli 2013 de bestaande voorzorgsmaatregelen onvoldoende bescherming bieden”

Two SP MPs asked whether new asbestos exposure limits effective 1 July 2013 would leave existing precautions insufficiently protective, and questioned the sector's safety awareness, respirator adequacy, and inspection compliance. The minister acknowledged that current methods will need adjustment, postponed the new limits to 1 January 2014, committed to a TNO study and an Inspectorate report around summer, and reported high rates of enforcement at asbestos removal sites.
Because I attach importance to a careful implementation, I have decided in response to postpone the introduction of the new limit values until 1 January 2014.
Omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige uitwerking heb ik naar aanleiding daarvan besloten de invoering van de nieuwe grenswaarden uit te stellen tot 1 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat domperidon de kans op hartfalen verhoogt en in verband wordt gebracht met fatale bijwerkingen

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that domperidone raises the risk of heart failure and fatal side effects, and why it remains sold without a prescription. The minister replied that the CBG (medicines regulator) has repeatedly reviewed and tightened warnings, that the drug is now pharmacy-only with a pharmacist safety check, that 11 fatal cases are reported to Lareb without confirmed causation, and that the CBG rather than the minister decides on the dispensing status, so she will not ask for a change pending the EU review.
The CBG is the body in the Netherlands that deals with medicines, not the Minister of VWS.
Het CBG is de instantie die in Nederland over geneesmiddelen gaat, niet de minister van VWS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven inzake de benoeming van de heer Meijdam in de gebiedscommissie Amstel, Gooi en Vecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether she shares the Commissie Schoon Schip conclusion that a KNSF-site report near Muiden was kept secret under Meijdam's responsibility, and why earlier advice to publish under the Wob was not followed. The minister deferred to the province of Noord-Holland for judgement on the commission's conclusions, noted the commission's findings without adopting them, and stated that appointments to advisory bodies rest on expertise and no explicit conflict-of-interest exclusion exists beyond the advisory body's own safeguards.
I note that it is an independent responsibility of the provincial government of Noord-Holland to form its own judgement on the commission's conclusions.
Ik stel vast dat het een eigenstandige verantwoordelijkheid van het provinciaal bestuur van Noord-Holland betreft om zich een oordeel te vormen over de conclusies van de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat verzekeringsmaatschappijen discrimineren op basis van ziekteverleden of genetische aanleg

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that insurers discriminate on prior illness or genetic predisposition, and about compliance with the Council of Europe Biomedicine Convention and the Wet op de medische keuringen. The minister largely defended the current risk-selection framework, refused to commission new data or a uniform scientific standard, and said the government is considering whether ratifying the Convention is desirable.
I do not have such data. Nor am I intending to commission such a study.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens. Ik ben ook niet voornemens om een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren

Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het signaal dat groepen patiënten die kanker hebben en patiënten die groeihormonen gebruiken hun medicijnen bij het ziekenhuis moeten halen in plaats van bij de apotheek

An SP MP asked the minister of Health about reports that cancer patients and growth-hormone patients must collect their medicines at hospitals instead of pharmacies after the transfer of drug funding to hospital budgets, and about travel burden, cost savings and whether the policy will be reversed. The minister answered that hospitals organise distribution, that home delivery is available, that data on affected patients are not held, that it is too early to judge cost savings, and that there is no reason to reverse the transfer, while acknowledging some identified problems.
I do not have figures on the number of patients who have to travel as a result of the transfer of medicines to the hospital budget.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over aantallen patiënten die moeten reizen als gevolg van de overheveling van medicijnen naar het ziekenhuisbudget.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over illegale lozing door zeeschepen

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked the ministers about illegal night-time oil discharges by sea-going vessels, enforcement and detection chances, fines compared with Belgium and France, and port reception facilities. The minister acknowledged night-time discharges are harder to detect and that enforcement is difficult, promised further study of detection and fines, and said EU-level tightening of waste discharge obligations is preferred.

I of course also have the ambition to further reduce illegal discharges and will examine the report's conclusions and recommendations on increasing the chance of detection for feasibility and effectiveness.

Ik heb uiteraard ook de ambitie om de illegale lozingen verder terug te dringen en ga de conclusies en aanbevelingen uit het rapport inzake het verhogen van de pakkans onderzoeken op uitvoerbaarheid en effectiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het Osteoporose Medisch Centrum via de huisarts een DEXA-scan aanbiedt

SP MPs asked the health minister about a Tros Radar report that the Osteoporose Medisch Centrum offers DEXA scans via GPs, raising questions about medical necessity, patient privacy, fees, GP payments, inspection complaints, ownership and possible action. The minister said the report was unclear about who made the offer, referred the matter to the Inspectie for investigation, stated that screening permit rules apply, and said a Gezondheidsraad advisory request on health checks may cover the case.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) will investigate whether what was shown complies with applicable legislation.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) zal onderzoeken of hetgeen getoond is in overeenstemming met vigerende wetgeving is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat medicijnen bij de dienstapotheek in Roermond contant moeten worden afgerekend

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that patients at the Roermond on-call pharmacy must pay cash because it has no contract with insurer CZ, and about the consequences, distance to alternatives, and remedies. The minister answered that insurers must provide adequate care and that on-call pharmacies cannot refuse acute patients, but declined to intervene in contract negotiations and promised only to report on external scouts' findings.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in the contract negotiations between health insurers and care providers.
Antwoord 6 Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om op te treden in de contractonder-handelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een lijst met duizend medische zaken van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) is uitg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister how a list of about a thousand medical incidents leaked from the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) to RTL, how privacy-sensitive data is secured, and whether openness will be increased. The minister admitted an unintentional leak, gave no guarantee it will not recur, and committed to measures and to more transparency about reported incidents, though details were deferred to an ongoing improvement process.
A guarantee that this will never happen again, I cannot give.
Een garantie dat dit nooit meer zal gebeuren, kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix geen beschikbaarheidstoeslag ontvangt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's initial rejection of a hospital availability allowance for Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix in Winterswijk, which they said threatened its survival and the 45-minute acute care norm. The minister said the hospital has appealed, that the hospital is important for the region, that the decision rests with the NZa and regional bodies, and that she has no figures showing financial trouble.
I do not have figures on the basis of which I could conclude that the hospital will run into financial problems in the long term without an SEH availability allowance.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op basis waarvan ik de conclusie zou kunnen trekken dat het ziekenhuis op den duur in financiële problemen komt zonder een beschikbaarheidbijdrage SEH.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Keijzer over het bericht dat orgaandonoren geconfronteerd worden met inkomstenverlies en medische kosten

Two MPs asked the health minister about reports that living organ donors bear income loss and medical costs, citing a scar claim refused by an insurer, an out-of-pocket echo, and a self-employed donor's compensation gap. The minister answered that medical costs necessary for care are covered by insurance within 13 weeks (and by the donor's insurance thereafter), that a subsidy scheme compensates self-employed donors' income loss for up to 13 weeks, and that a dedicated arrangement for rare complications is not feasible within the current social security system.
It is not for me to judge in an individual case whether medically necessary care is involved.
Het is niet aan mij om in een individuele casus te oordelen of hier sprake is van medisch noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven inzake de benoeming van de heer Meijdam door de provincie Noord-Holland in de gebiedscommissie Amstel, Gooi en Vecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether the appointment of Mr Meijdam to the Amstel, Gooi en Vecht area committee by the province of Noord-Holland was wise, given earlier secrecy about a report on the KNSF site and his resignation from another provincial post, and whether the appointment would be reversed. The minister confirmed the appointment, said the province saw no obstacles and that the reasons for appointing former officials are for the province and the person concerned, and declined to reverse it.
The reasons for (former) officials to sit on a committee on behalf of the province are a matter for the province concerned and the (former) official concerned.
De redenen voor (voormalig) bestuurders om namens de provincie zitting te hebben in een commissie is een zaak van de betreffende provincie en de betreffende (voormalig) bestuurder.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over screening op vasa praevia

An MP asked the health minister about vasa praevia screening, including incidence, preventive caesareans, and whether routine screening should be added to the structural ultrasound. The minister answered that incidence is uncertain, that only one death was recorded in the 2010 perinatal audit, that screening is limited to high-risk groups following NVOG and RCOG practice, and that there is no reason to ask the Centraal Orgaan for renewed advice.
All things considered, I see no reason to ask the Centraal Orgaan for advice again at this time.
Alles afwegend zie ik geen reden om het Centraal Orgaan op dit moment opnieuw om advies te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Medtronic illegale betalingen aan artsen deed

An SP MP asked the health minister about press reports that Medtronic made illegal payments to doctors in Belgium, and whether similar practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister found no basis to conclude such practices occur in the Netherlands, left enforcement to the sector's self-regulation codes, and said she will push for a reciprocal code by summer.
I consider it the sector's own responsibility to ensure that contacts between them proceed in a proper manner.
Ik vind het een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de sector om te zorgen dat de onderlinge contacten op een nette manier verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over misstanden bij Pleyade

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Social Affairs about understaffing, neglect and union access at care provider Pleyade, including a staff diary sent to the Inspectorate. The government answered that the Inspectorate monitors the institution, that the care provider is primarily responsible for staffing and quality, and that the Inspectorate will revisit and gather information, without committing to new extra inspections.
Following the diary, the IGZ requested information from Altenova. Once the IGZ has received the information it will visit Altenova again.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van het dagboek informatie opgevraagd bij Altenova. Als de IGZ de informatie heeft ontvangen zal zij Altenova nogmaals bezoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen gaat overleggen met de Franse geneesmiddelentoezichthouder en 26 andere toezichthouders

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CBG consulting with the French regulator and 26 other regulators over third and fourth generation contraceptive pills, whether this aimed at removing them from the basic insurance package, and why 62 of 586 Lareb reports concerned thrombosis. The minister answered that the consultation is a standard EU procedure triggered by France, not aimed at insurance coverage, that a re-assessment of these drugs has been started, and that all reports are being examined.
The CBG's consultation with the other member states is therefore not aimed at removing the third and fourth generation contraceptive pill from the basic package.
Het overleg van het CBG met de andere lidstaten is er dus niet op gericht om de derde en vierde generatie anticonceptiepil uit het basispakket te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Belgische Clinica Aesthetica via Groupon reclame maakt voor cosmetische chirurgie

An SP MP asked the health minister about a Belgian clinic advertising cosmetic surgery via Groupon, and whether such discount deals risk impulse purchases, disadvantage lower-income groups, and whether 16-18 year olds should decide alone, and whether an advertising ban should be introduced. The minister answered that Dutch rules rely on the sector's Leidraad and the WGBO, that she is investigating cosmetic-sector risks and will inform parliament in spring, but that adults bear their own responsibility and an advertising ban will be considered in that ongoing study.
In the spring I will inform the House about my proposals for measures to counter the risks in the cosmetic sector.
In het voorjaar zal ik de Kamer informeren over mijn voorstellen voor maatregelen om de risico's in de cosmetische sector tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Veronica Magazine een facelift verloot onder kopers van de DVD ‘De Verbouwing’

An MP asked the health minister whether a Veronica Magazine promotion raffling a facelift among buyers of a DVD and offering 500 free consultations was acceptable, and what she would do to prevent such cosmetic-surgery promotions. The minister replied that such promotions are not banned, the sector's own publicity norms apply, the plastic surgeon was warned by his professional association and has stopped the publicity, and she is examining the cosmetic sector for possible measures.

I am currently examining the cosmetic sector to possibly take measures against the imbalance that has arisen between the possibilities, the risks and the legal safeguards attached to cosmetic procedures.

Ik onderzoek momenteel de cosmetische sector om eventueel maatregelen te kunnen nemen tegen de disbalans die is ontstaan tussen de mogelijkheden, de risico's en de wettelijke waarborgen die aan cosmetische ingrepen zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat verschillende apotheken in Hengelo, Borne en Hof van Twente nog geen contract hebben met Achmea

MP Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that several pharmacies in Hengelo, Borne and Hof van Twente lacked contracts with Achmea, forcing patients to pay cash, and about patient choice and continuity. The minister replied that insurers and providers may freely decide on contracts, that Achmea reports contracts with 1976 of 1981 pharmacies and that the reported contracts continue into 2013, that patients keep access but may face different reimbursement, and that consumers can complain to the Ombudsman and Disputes Commission, with the NZa supervising the insurer's duty of care.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in the contract negotiations between health insurers and care providers.
Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om op te treden in de contractonderhandelingen tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de voorgenomen fusie tussen de Isala Klinieken in Zwolle, het St Jansdal Ziekenhuis in Harderwijk en de Noorderboog in Meppel

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the planned merger of Isala Klinieken, St Jansdal and Noorderboog hospitals was motivated by capital costs, a Achmea-linked move, closure of obstetric care, and bed-size concerns. The minister replied that the hospitals deny cost-cutting motives, that the planned merger is for the hospitals to decide, and that the new merger-test bill will require justification and stakeholder involvement, without announcing a merger stop.
I am not seeking to stop mergers. I also have no powers over this.
Het gaat mij er niet om om fusies te stoppen. Ik heb daarover ook geen bevoegdheden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over het bericht dat concentratie van zorg niet noodzakelijk is om babysterfte terug te dringen

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether concentration of obstetric care is needed to reduce infant mortality, citing reports that night-time births are not more dangerous, and asked about staffing, costs, hospital executive pay and consultation of midwives. The minister declined to reverse the concentration in Meppel and Dokkum, argued that 24/7 obstetric care in every hospital is not necessary, and promised a letter to parliament on consulting midwives.
However, it is not for me to decide on the concentration of care, as long as these decisions are taken within the preconditions for quality and accessibility of care.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te besluiten over concentratie van zorg, zolang deze besluiten worden genomen binnen de randvoorwaarden voor kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid van zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verlenging van de Praktijkproef Bovengronds aanwenden van mest

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the trial of surface application of manure (Praktijkproef Bovengronds aanwenden van mest) has not been extended as a parliamentary motion requested, given the new manure season. The State Secretary replied that extension was not appropriate after evaluation, but that a new research proposal received in February 2013 is being assessed by the Technical Commission Bodem and a decision is expected in early March.
I expect to be able to make a decision on the request of the two associations in early March, based on the TCB's response.
Ik verwacht begin maart op basis van de reactie van de TCB een besluit te kunnen nemen op het verzoek van de twee verenigingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over ouderen die letterlijk in de kou zitten

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about elderly residents at a care home being kept cold, the home's large reserves despite not funding repairs, and whether the inspectorate checks temperature. The state secretary answered that a technical pump fault caused the cold, a replacement was installed, maintenance is ongoing, temperature is not a separate inspection criterion, and the inspectorate will raise it during a planned visit.
Temperature is not a separate criterion that the inspectorate checks.
Temperatuur is geen apart criterium waar de inspectie op toeziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de vertrekkend bestuursvoorzitter van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum een zeer royale ontslagregeling heeft getroffen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about reports that the outgoing Erasmus MC board chair negotiated a generous severance package, including continued salary to 2015, a personal allowance, a mobile phone, laptop and first-class NS season ticket. The minister answered that the arrangement's basis under the CAO is incorrect since the chair was not covered by the CAO, that such a generous arrangement is too generous, but that the WNT cannot yet normalise professor pay.
In my view that is an incorrect reference.
Mijns inziens is dat een onterechte verwijzing.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de ontwikkelingen bij het Integraal Kankercentrum Zuid IKZ en het Integraal Kankercentrum Nederland IKNL

An SP MP asks the health minister about the dismissal of the IKZ director by its supervisory board, a possible board-member conflict of interest under the governance code, and the merger with IKNL; the minister declines to judge the dismissal as an internal matter, says a board member became interim board chair before an interim appointment was made, and states she has no governance-code bill in preparation.
The dismissal of the IKZ director is an internal matter; I do not deal with it.
Het ontslag van de directeur van het IKZ is een interne aangelegenheid, ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de heer van der V. op interim-basis toetreedt tot de raad van bestuur van het Kennemergasthuis

Two MPs asked the government whether the interim appointment of Mr. van der V. to the Kennemergasthuis board, his pay, and the related merger and reorganisation were acceptable and whether he falls under the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister said the supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and pay, that the WNT applies to interim directors after six months, and declined to disclose individual income or comment on the reorganisation and the merger.
The supervisory boards are responsible for appointing directors, including in the case of the Kennemergasthuis.
De Raden van Toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van bestuurders, ook in het geval van het Kennemergasthuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en de Vereniging van Zorgaanbieders voor Zorgcommunicatie (VZVZ)

MPs Van Gerven and Voortman asked the minister about the ties between Nictiz and VZVZ, including whether Mr Velzel negotiated a company car with chauffeur as a secondary employment condition. The minister replied that the work is done under a consultancy contract and that she has no insight into that contract, so she cannot provide the information requested.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de charitatieve kledinginzameling

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities profit from tendering textile collection, which harms charities, and how collection and municipal rules work. The state secretary said he lacks an overview of municipal practice because municipalities are autonomous, defended the legal definition of textile waste, and said he finds it inappropriate to charge fees that cover other municipal costs, with the Interior Ministry to consult VNG.
Therefore I have no overview of collection methods, tenders, costs and revenues.
Daarom heb ik geen overzicht van inzamelmethoden, aanbestedingen, kosten en inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Voortman over de verwevenheid van Nictiz en VZVZ

Two MPs asked the health minister about the relationship between VZVZ and Nictiz, their funding, and whether VZVZ is a front for the ministry pushing the EPD/LSP. The minister answered that both are legally independent private organisations, that VZVZ is a self-run initiative of care providers funded partly by insurers, and that the government has no knowledge of a consultant contract's terms.
I have no insight into this contract and therefore do not have the information you requested.
Ik heb geen inzicht in dit contract en beschik dan ook niet over de door u gevraagde informatie.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat medicijnen bij de Benu Apotheek in Borger contant moeten worden afgerekend

MP Van Gerven asked the minister whether Benu pharmacies forcing DSW-insured patients to pay cash for medicines, and related contract disputes with insurers, were acceptable, and where affected patients could go. Minister Schippers answered that the cash-payment arrangement ended on 11 January 2013 after agreement with DSW, that DSW offers restitution policies where cash payment can be required, and that she does not find it unacceptable.
Meanwhile, patients can again claim directly.
Inmiddels kunnen de patiënten weer rechtstreeks declareren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Vlietland Ziekenhuis in Vlaardingen de parkeertarieven verhoogt om de kosten van patiëntenzorg mede te kunnen financieren

An SP MP asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that Vlietland Hospital raises parking fees to help finance patient care, and whether other hospitals do the same. The minister answered that parking policy is a matter for the hospital itself, that she has no information on other hospitals, and that she sees no reason for action.
I am of the opinion that the government should not concern itself with a hospital's parking policy.
Ik ben van mening dat de overheid zich niet moet bezighouden met het parkeerbeleid van een ziekenhuis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat twee Brabantse ziekenhuizen een fusie melden bij de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit (NMa)

An SP MP asked the health minister about a merger notification by two Brabant hospitals to the competition authority NMa, including concentration of obstetric care, accessibility, finances, and whether the NMa should pause approvals pending the parliamentary fusion-test bill. The minister answered that concentration of births is defended on quality grounds, the 45-minute norm is safeguarded, and she cannot or will not pause NMa decisions since only the NMa may assess mergers under current law.
I did not commission the specific studies and therefore cannot provide them to you.
De specifieke onderzoeken heb ik niet laten uitvoeren en kan ik u dus niet doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het CBG is gezwicht om een vaginaal antischimmelmiddel op de vrije markt te brengen

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the CBG yielded to pressure in moving a vaginal antifungal from prescription-only to pharmacy-and-drugstore sale, and what studies underpinned the change. The minister answered that the CBG decides independently on scientific grounds, that the leaflet lists all alarm symptoms, and that post-market monitoring of the product will continue.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de derde generatie anticonceptiepil in Frankrijk niet meer wordt vergoed

An SP MP asked the Health Minister how the Netherlands views France's decision to stop reimbursing third-generation contraceptive pills over a doubled thrombosis risk, and whether the Dutch reimbursement should end too. The minister replied that each country sets its own reimbursement, that second-generation pills are preferred but third-generation pills remain available for individual cases, and that there is no new evidence warranting ending reimbursement.
So I see no reason to stop reimbursing the third-generation contraceptive pill.
Ik zie dus geen reden om de derde generatie anticonceptiepil niet meer te vergoeden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat grootverpakkingen paracetamol uit de schappen verdwijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister about the CBG's decision to cap pack sizes of paracetamol 500 mg for pharmacy and drugstore sale, whether paracetamol should be restricted further given overdose and suicide attempt trends, and whether general-sale status should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the CBG, not the minister, decides on classification, supported the pack-size cap as risk minimisation, and saw no scientific basis for further restrictions.
It is not for me to decide on this. That is the task of the CBG.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover besluiten te nemen. Dit is de taak van het CBG.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de medicijncheck

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about reported medication-related hospital admissions among older people, survey figures on pharmacist and GP medication checks, and whether an annual medication check should be mandatory in the basic health insurance package. The minister said the cited figures were not based on a government study, found the savings estimate unrealistic, and noted that periodic medication review already falls under pharmaceutical care that insurers and professionals can arrange, so no mandatory inclusion is planned.

As I also indicated in answering questions 7 and 8, periodic medication review already forms part of the entitlement to pharmaceutical care, and insurers and doctors/pharmacists can make further arrangements about it.

Zoals ik ook in de beantwoording van vraag 7 en 8 heb aangegeven, maakt de periodieke medicatiebeoordeling al onderdeel uit van de aanspraak op farmaceutische zorg en kunnen verzekeraars en artsen/apothekers hier nadere afspraken over maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het contracteerbeleid van zorgverzekeraars bij logopedisten

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister why insurers offer speech therapists tariffs 6.5 to 13% below the NZa maximum, questioning the NZa's inaction and insurers' market power. The minister answered that maximum tariffs leave insurers free to contract lower, that the NZa has found no grounds for intervention, and that the matter is for competition oversight rather than a norm income for therapists.
The NZa has no indications that corrective action against insurers is needed because they would be impeding competition by abusing their presumed purchasing power.
De NZa heeft geen indicaties dat er corrigerend tegen verzekeraars moet worden opgetreden omdat zij de concurrentie zouden belemmeren door misbruik te maken van hun veronderstelde inkoopmacht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over onderzoek naar Q-koorts in Herpen

MP Van Gerven asked about the status of a Q-fever foundation with ten million euros for research, and whether the minister would support a population study in Herpen proposed by provincial health authorities. The minister referred to an earlier letter on the foundation, said experts advised against general screening but a targeted study in Herpen could be funded as an incidental project subject to ethical conditions.
Because the Q-fever foundation is still being set up and there is a broadly shared wish to start this research quickly, I will finance this as an incidental project
Omdat de stichting inzake Q-koorts nog in oprichting is en er een breed gedragen wens is om snel met dit onderzoek te starten, zal ik dit als een incidenteel project financieren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur weer aan het werk zou zijn (geweest) in Duitsland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how the government responded to reports that the disciplined neurologist Jansen Steur was working in Germany, what steps were taken with German authorities, and how similar cases could be prevented across the EU. The minister said the IGZ contacted the Bezirksregierung Arnsberg about documents submitted in 2006, pointed to the cover letter for most substantive answers, and outlined existing tools such as restrictive measures in the BIG register and cross-border cooperation through HPCB.

I will explicitly point the competent authorities in the EU Member States to the list of measures under the BIG Act on the BIG register website and draw their attention to the amendments to the BIG Act since July 2012.

Ik zal de bevoegde autoriteiten in de lidstaten van de EU uitdrukkelijk wijzen op de lijst met maatregelen Wet BIG op de website van het BIG-register en hen daarbij wijzen op de wijzigingen van de Wet BIG sinds juli 2012.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het nieuws dat dokter Jansen Steur een verklaring van geen bezwaar zou hebben gekregen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether a German hospital's claim that neurologist Jansen Steur obtained a Dutch certificate of good conduct in 2006 is accurate, and how the minister views her remark that the hospital should have googled him. The minister referred to the accompanying letter for the origin of the certificate and the IGZ's handling, and argued that the 2006 certificate was not relevant to a 2011 application and that employers should check non-national sources and request recent certificates.
I refer you to paragraph 4 of the accompanying letter.
Ik verwijs u naar paragraaf 4 van de begeleidende brief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de wijze waarop de provincie Overijssel voornemens is de EHS te realiseren

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether Overijssel's plan to realise a reduced Ecological Main Structure and drop robust connecting zones breaches the coalition agreement, and what sanctions exist. The government replies that the province is following the agreed herijking procedure, that a robust EHS plus is being defined jointly with provinces by spring 2013, and that it will not order the province to act now, while promising agreements on timing, monitoring and financing.
This is not at issue. At the meeting of 23 November, my predecessor agreed with the provincial executives for rural areas to start a joint process to shape the robust EHS.

Dit is niet aan de orde. In het overleg van 23 november jl. is door mijn voorganger met de gedeputeerden landelijk gebied de afspraak gemaakt om een gezamenlijk traject te starten om de robuuste EHS vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de teelt van gansaanlokkende gewassen rondom Schiphol

The SP MP Van Gerven asks why the state, through BBL, owns farmland near Schiphol where goose-attracting crops such as sugar beet, potatoes and maize are grown, and whether lease and sale conditions, a convenant and hunting oversight can reduce bird strike risk. The state secretary answers that these crops are not clearly goose-attracting, that a lease condition on grain stubble ploughing has been introduced, and that no binding ban on crops or hunting-safety monitoring is planned beyond existing arrangements.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de onafhankelijkheid van visserijonderzoek

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether commercial fishing vessels and crews are used for government-commissioned fisheries research, when this is done, and how the independence of such research is safeguarded. The government answered that commercial vessels are mainly used for contract research and discard studies, that independent observers and cross-checks are used, and that Rijksrederij vessels are preferred where possible.
Independence and reliability of the research outcomes have the highest priority.
Onafhankelijkheid en betrouwbaarheid van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek hebben de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about deaths linked to errors at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital and the regulator's response. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admissions stop, transfer of cardiac patients, supervision, a ban on cardiologists providing care) and that the hospital and Inspectorate are investigating patient files, while withholding timing and detailed results pending the ongoing investigations.
Taking into account the privacy of the patients involved and medical confidentiality, I will inform your House in due course about the results of this investigation.
Met inachtneming van de privacy van de betrokken patiënten en het medisch beroepsgeheim zal ik uw Kamer ter gelegener tijd informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de mogelijk onveilige situatie in het Ruwaard van Putten Ziekenhuis

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked Minister Schippers about possibly unsafe conditions at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital, including why the Inspectorate did not intervene earlier and whether patient safety and ambulance access are guaranteed. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has taken several steps (admission stop, transfers, six-month enhanced supervision, a ban on the cardiology group) and that it is examining safety across all departments, while defending the timing of its interventions and the ambulance arrangements.
Since 15 November, the Ruwaard van Putten hospital as a whole has been under enhanced supervision by the IGZ.
Het Ruwaard van Putten ziekenhuis staat sinds 15 november jl. in zijn geheel onder verscherpt toezicht van de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jacobi over de toepassing van de subsidieregeling schaapskuddes

MPs Van Gerven and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the sheep-flock subsidy scheme, including late publication, eligibility safeguards against intensive livestock farms, excluded rare breeds, and delayed payments under the ferry allowance scheme. The state secretary defended the eligibility criteria and the one-off nature of the scheme, said the ferry allowance payments would follow the planned schedule, and gave no individual accommodation.
The subsidy scheme is however limited to flocks of sheep being herded with rare Dutch breeds.
De subsidieregeling is echter beperkt tot gescheperde schaapskuddes met zeldzame Nederlandse rassen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitwisseling van gegevens van veroordeelde artsen tussen Nederland en België

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about data exchange between the Netherlands and Belgium on disciplined doctors and whether Dutch inspectorate sanctions are passed to Belgian authorities. The minister agreed exchange needs improving, said talks with Belgium aim at mutual recognition of sanctions, and described existing exchange and public BIG-register disclosure, but gave no concrete new commitment.

With Belgium I want to make clear agreements on taking over disciplinary and criminal measures against healthcare providers, so that situations as described in your enclosed newspaper article are kept to a minimum.

Met België wil ik over het overnemen van de tucht – en strafmaatregelen van zorgverleners duidelijke afspraken maken, zodat situaties als beschreven in uw bijgevoegde krantenartikel tot een minimum beperkt blijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het beleid bij IGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked how the IGZ enforces the duty of hospitals to report calamities on time, including fines, reporting quality, protection of whistleblowers and the safety culture. Minister Schippers answered that fines are possible but only three warnings and no fines have been issued, and she described the IGZ's enforcement framework and the pending bill on splitting large organisations.
The IGZ has to date not imposed any administrative fine for failing to report a calamity without delay.
De IGZ heeft tot op heden geen bestuurlijke boete opgelegd voor het niet onverwijld melden van een calamiteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het geruzie in het VUmc

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about reports of a possible conspiracy and patient-safety dangers at the VUmc hospital, including how many complaints the Inspectorate has received and what consequences follow. The minister replied that the Inspectorate is investigating the reports, will decide on follow-up actions based on that inquiry, and will refer possible crimes to the Public Prosecution Service, while declining to give complaint numbers yet.
The report in question is currently being investigated by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
De betreffende melding wordt momenteel door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het geruzie in het VUmc en de gevolgen daarvan en het wederom niet melden van een sterfgeval

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about infighting among specialists at VUmc, the IGZ's handling of an external review, and an unreported patient death during surgery.
