The minister answered that the IGZ asked VUmc to finish its own review first, that the death is being investigated by VUmc at the IGZ's request, and that the inspectorate sees no immediate need for further measures while monitoring under heightened supervision.
The inspectorate asked the hospital to complete its own investigation.
De inspectie heeft het ziekenhuis verzocht het eigen onderzoek af te ronden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraars

The SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether insurers' preferential drug policy has gone too far, endangering drug supply and encroaching on doctors' prescribing, and whether a uniform national scheme should replace it. The minister rejected the claim of excessive insurer power, said the insurers' duty of care is judged by the NZa and that complaints about drugs are few, and refused to abolish apothecary discounts and bonuses.
I do not have the requested information on the number of cases in which the drug dispensed is not the one the doctor marked with 'MN' (medical necessity) on the prescription.

Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde informatie met betrekking tot het aantal gevallen waarin niet het geneesmiddel wordt verstrekt dat de dokter met «MN» (medische noodzaak) op het recept heeft aangegeven.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat apothekers afwijken van medicijnrichtlijnen

An SP MP asked the health minister how to respond to a broadcast showing pharmacists deviating from prescriptions by dispensing generic medicines, and whether this harms patients, insurers' preferential-drug policy, and patient access. The minister argued generics are equivalent, that prescribers can block substitution by stating medical necessity, that pharmacists must consult patient and doctor, and that no further research or measures were needed.
No, that is not known to me. The mere fact that a medicine is generic does not detract from its effect and quality. Further research does not seem warranted.
Nee, dat is mij niet bekend. Het enkele feit dat een geneesmiddel generiek is, doet niets af aan de werking en de kwaliteit van het middel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de vertraging van het convenant gevaccineerd vlees

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the government will not contribute to a fund covering market losses for vaccinated livestock, and about the handling of vaccination and culling policy. The State Secretary refuses a direct financial contribution, citing the policy of not compensating consequential damage, but commits to work on removing EU and OIE trade restrictions on vaccinated animals and to pursue DIVA vaccines.
My decision is by no means a no to the use of vaccination, but it is a no to the intended role of the government in covering the consequential damage.
Mijn besluit is dus geenszins een nee tegen de inzet van vaccinatie, maar wel tegen de beoogde rol voor de overheid bij het afdekken van de gevolgschade.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de situatie bij Altenova

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the dispute at care centre Altenova, including whether union AbvaKabo was refused access, how many staff the intensification funds (EUR 1.6 million) created, and how care offices supervise spending. The state secretary answered that access is only by appointment, that about 20 FTE were funded, and that care offices supervise spending as part of regular contracting.
Agreements have been made with the care offices on supervising the efficient use of the extra funds.
Met de zorgkantoren zijn afspraken gemaakt over het toezicht op de doelmatige aanwending van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een ziekenhuis een onrendabele arts mag ontslaan

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister how often doctors are dismissed for being unprofitable, whether specialist incomes make profitability difficult, and how to prevent market forces in hospital care from crowding out patient interests. Minister Schippers said she has no data on dismissals or specialist profitability, will send her response to the specialist income reports later, and maintains that financial and quality interests can reinforce each other under the agreed hospital funding framework.
I do not have information on the number of doctors dismissed because of unprofitable care provision.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over het aantal artsen dat is ontslagen vanwege onrendabele zorgverlening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de pilot tot legaliseren van recreatiepark Patersven in Zundert

An SP MP asked the minister about the status and evaluation of the pilot to legalise the Patersven recreation park in Zundert, and about the consequences for owners' expectations and planning damage claims. The minister replied that the municipality ended the process in December 2011, that evaluation and legalisation decisions are the municipality's responsibility, that owners keep their existing legal status, and that the national government collects no data on other cases.
It is for the municipality to decide whether the pilot project is evaluated or not.
Het is derhalve aan de gemeente om te bepalen of het pilotproject al dan niet wordt geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat het LangeLand Ziekenhuis overgenomen wordt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the takeover of LangeLand Ziekenhuis by Loek Winter, its financial problems, staff dismissals and risks to care quality. The minister answered that the hospital boards chose the buyer, that the Inspectorate monitors care quality, and that the takeover would be reviewed by the NMa and NZa.
I have no role in this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Jan Vos en Schouw over geweld in de Braziliaanse sojateelt

MPs Van Gerven, Jan Vos and Schouw asked the government about violence against indigenous peoples and smallholders linked to Brazilian soy farming, and what Dutch action, embassy contact, bank financing and investigation follow-up exists. The minister answered that the Dutch embassy raises indigenous rights with Brazil and supports CIMI, that the Dutch soy sustainability initiatives are supported, that the embassy has no knowledge of a river-dredging study, and that one Dutch bank has a code of conduct and it will report on prosecutor investigations involving Dutch financiers.
Yes, insofar as this concerns Dutch banks and financiers.
Ja, voor zover dit Nederlandse banken en financiers betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Bashir en Van Tongeren inzake publieke functies voorzitter Raad voor de Leefomgeving

MPs Van Gerven and Bashir asked whether the chair of the Raad voor de Leefomgeving en Infrastructuur, Meijdam, should step down given questions about his integrity and an appearance of conflict of interest, while also chairing the Meijdam committee on the OV-chipkaart. The minister answered that transparency safeguards were agreed (code on conflicts of interest, disclosure of ancillary positions, ending his lobbying activities) and saw no reason for further measures.

Thirdly, I made agreements with the chair of the Rli well before his appointment that he would cease his activities as a lobbyist for building companies and developers regarding plots and positions, after completion of ongoing assignments.

Ten derde heb ik met de voorzitter van de Rli al ruim vóór zijn aantreden afspraken gemaakt dat hij zijn activiteiten als belangenbehartiger voor plots en posities van bouwbedrijven en ontwikkelaars zou staken, na afronding van lopende opdrachten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Van Gerven over het gebruik van DNA uit ziekenhuizen voor opsporingsdoeleinden in strafzaken

MPs Leijten, Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether draft legislation would let justice examine hospital-held DNA for criminal investigations, and whether this breaches purpose limitation and deters patient participation in research. The minister confirmed that draft texts of a Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal were circulated for pre-consultation, that they are not government-approved, and that the dilemmas will be for the new cabinet to decide, referring to an earlier letter.
The draft texts have therefore not yet been approved by me or by the cabinet.
De concept-teksten zijn dus nog niet door mij of het kabinet geaccordeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat klinische verloskunde in Meppel verdwijnt

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the closure of clinical obstetrics in Meppel, questioning whether the board's decision was careful, whether the 45-minute norm and quality conditions can be met within two months, and whether staff were consulted. The minister replied that a renewed careful process involving local stakeholders and mediation was followed, that care stays local where possible, and that she sees no reason to intervene or meet staff.
After the initially hastily taken decision, a new and careful process was started to speak and consult with all local stakeholders.
Na de aanvankelijk te snel genomen beslissing is een nieuw en zorgvuldig proces gestart om met alle lokale betrokkenen te spreken en te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidsoverlast langs de HSL-Zuid bij Breda

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether she endorsed a student report finding that noise standards along the HSL-Zuid near Breda are exceeded at several locations and that noise screens underperform. The state secretary rejected the conclusions as based on measurements not meeting Dutch rules and wrong legal assumptions, but committed to honour the tracébesluit noise limits and to decide on additional measures after pending TNO measurements and pilot effect studies.
Yes, I will of course keep my commitment.
Ja, ik zal mijn toezegging vanzelfsprekend nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de invoering van een no-claim door Bewuzt/VGZ

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about VGZ/Bewuzt introducing a no-claim bonus on supplementary insurance, questioning consistency with the 2006 abolition of the basic-insurance no-claim and its effect on chronically ill people. The minister answered that supplementary insurance falls outside her responsibility, that the NZa has no substantive supervisory role there, and that enough choice exists for chronic patients.
As indicated in my reply to question 1, the supplementary insurance falls outside my responsibility.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn reactie op vraag 1 ligt de aanvullende verzekering buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van het Bethesdaziekenhuis in Hoogeveen

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the future of Bethesda hospital in Hoogeveen, including a KPMG/Plexus report, a possible merger with Refaja, and the role of insurers. The minister said the hospital group decides on the report's publication and the merger is for the NMa to assess, while stating that accessibility and quality should stay central.
No, it is up to KPMG/Plexus and the hospital group itself to decide whether the report is made public.
Nee, het is aan KPMG/Plexus en de ziekenhuisgroep zelf om te besluiten of het rapport openbaar gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over zorgverzekeraars die prijsverschillen van geneesmiddelen ten laste brengen van het eigen risico

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether insurer Agis charging €189.08 of the deductible for a medicine priced at €48.15 was justified, and whether insurers' divergent drug price agreements are opaque and wasteful. The minister replied that the price was a contractual agreement that had not yet been revised after a lower advisory price, that prices are visible on insurer websites and in declarations, and that no further investigation was needed.
Achmea is considering adjusting its sales prices more than twice a year in future, so that the agreed prices better match the advisory prices.
Achmea overweegt voor de toekomst hun verkoopprijzen meer dan twee keer per jaar aan te passen, zodat de afgesproken prijzen meer in overeenstemming zijn met de adviesprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de olieramp op Sint Eustatius

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the oil spill at NuStar's Statia terminal, including applicable rules, who pays for cleanup and enforcement, and whether the facility would be permitted under current rules. The government answered that the spill was limited, that NuStar is liable for costs, that a permit under the island ordinance is expected in spring 2013, and that relocating the storage is a matter for the island executive.
This question falls outside the scope of my competence and is an autonomous competence of the executive board of Sint Eustatius.
Deze vraag valt buiten de reikwijdte van mijn bevoegdheid en is een autonome bevoegdheid van het bestuurscollege van Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over handhaving van de Visserijwet 1963

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether police and green BOAs can check compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963 and whether the designation decree should be changed, and about staffing for fisheries poaching enforcement. The state secretary answered that existing powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure and Article 55 of the Act are sufficient, so no new designation is needed, and gave staffing figures.
I therefore am of the view that enforcement officers, including BOAs and police officers, have sufficient powers to carry out checks on compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat opsporingsambtenaren, waaronder BOA's en politieagenten, voldoende bevoegdheden hebben om controle uit te voeren op naleving van de Visserijwet 1963.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over een klokkenluider in het VUmc wiens positie in het geding is

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether the VUmc board may demote whistleblower Professor Postmus for contacting the supervisory board and the IGZ about patient safety, and asked for a reason he cannot return as head of the Lung Diseases department. The minister declined to judge the labour dispute, pointing to the hospital's own whistleblower rules, the IGZ's enhanced supervision, the pending court case and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, while promising answers before the court date.
As I have also written in answer to parliamentary questions from members Voortman and Van Gent, it is not for me to make statements about a labour law dispute.
Zoals ik ook eerder in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Voortman en Van Gent 4 heb geschreven, is het niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over een arbeidsrechtelijk conflict.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen voor ruim een half miljard euro aan zorggeld hebben opgepot

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether hospitals building reserves of over half a billion euro with public care money is an efficient use of funds, and how that can be checked. Minister Schippers replied that adequate reserves are necessary and desirable, that hospital solvency has risen but most have not yet reached the sector's 20% target, and that no investigation is needed for now.
Currently, as I outlined above, there is certainly no situation of excessive solvency among Dutch hospitals.
Momenteel is er, zoals ik hierboven schetste, zeker geen situatie van een te grote solvabiliteit bij de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de veiligheidsrisico’s in het VUmc

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether an independent inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc was needed, whether patient safety is guaranteed given board turmoil, whether the supervisory council and board are adequate, and about an IGZ internal draft document and the IGZ's expertise. The minister declined an external inquiry, noted the IGZ's enhanced supervision and the hospital's own external review, and said the IGZ acted adequately.
I currently see no reason for an external inquiry into avoidable deaths at VUmc.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar vermijdbare sterfte bij het VUmc.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een rapport van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over Quress Cytotron Centre

An SP MP asked the health minister whether an Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) report on Quress Cytotron Centre exists, why a Wob request to make it public was filed, and whether the report will be sent to parliament. The minister confirmed the report exists, said no objection to publication exists apart from a minor privacy aspect, and sent the report to parliament.
Subject to a single privacy aspect, there is no objection to publishing the report, and I am therefore hereby sending it to your House.
Met inachtneming van een enkel privacyaspect bestaat geen bezwaar tegen openbaarmaking van het rapport en ik zend het dan ook hierbij aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen dreigen te raken door speculatie met derivaten

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about reports that hospitals face losses from interest rate derivatives (swaps), including whether this warrants concern, the risks involved, and whether an in-depth investigation is needed given the Vestia parallels. Minister Schippers answered that the negative value is not a debt, that the risk depends on prolonged low variable rates, and that the sector's WFZ survey results will be awaited before further steps are taken.

In the answer (dated 5 October 2012) to written questions from Mr Groot and Ms Wolbert, I indicated that I wish to await the results of a survey by the WFZ among its participating members before taking any further steps.

In antwoord (dd 5 oktober 2012) op schriftelijke vragen van de heer Groot en mevrouw Wolbert heb ik aangegeven de resultaten van een uitvraag van het WFZ onder de aangesloten WFZ-deelnemers te willen afwachten alvorens eventuele vervolgstappen te zetten.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over vergoeding van fingolimod bij patiënten met MS

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why some insurers reportedly do not reimburse fingolimod for MS patients and whether the CVZ advice allows that. The minister answers that reimbursement is restricted to second-line therapy under the regulation, that insurers apply the conditions, that she will ask the CVZ to review whether the conditions should be adjusted, and that the answers were late.
I will ask them to involve various relevant stakeholders in this.
Ik zal hen vragen om verschillende relevante veldpartijen hierbij te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de mensonterende omstandigheden bij verpleeghuis Sint Jacob, onderdeel van Osira Amstelring

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about degrading conditions at nursing home Sint Jacob (Osira Amstelring), including staff shortages, unqualified staff, falls, lack of showers, unspent funds, nurse departures and whether managers should be sanctioned. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate sees ongoing improvement efforts, that extra funds are being deployed through approved plans, and that the board retains the cliëntenraad's confidence, so no sanctions are proposed.
If there is acute danger to residents, the IGZ will take immediate measures and inform me of this.
Als er sprake is van acute onveiligheid voor de bewoners, dan zal de IGZ direct maatregelen nemen en mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over miljoenen subsidies voor een gigastal in Horst aan de Maas en het informeren van de Kamer daarover

An MP asks the state secretary why public innovation subsidies went to the Nieuw Gemengd Bedrijf livestock complex in Horst aan de Maas despite plans to limit farm size, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The secretary answers that the subsidies were general schemes open to all entrepreneurs, that they date from before a motion on farm size, that the Chamber was informed through the budget and published subsidy lists, and that municipal and provincial matters fall to those authorities.
I indicated in the broadcast that the Chamber is informed in general terms, through the budget cycle in the budget and annual report of the ministry, about subsidy schemes.
Ik heb in de uitzending aangegeven dat de Kamer in algemene zin via de begrotingscyclus in de begroting en het jaarverslag van het ministerie van EL&I geïnformeerd wordt over subsidieregelingen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de fusie tussen Thuiszorg Rotterdam en Espria en ADG

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary about a possible merger of Thuiszorg Rotterdam with Espria and ADG, concerning market dominance, consultation of staff and clients, financial and personnel effects, and top-management pay. The state secretary replied that only a letter of intent exists, no merger notification has been received by the NMa, and that market share data and merger decisions are for the organisations and the competition authority, with the WNT applying once enacted.
I do not have this information. This is commercially sensitive information of the institutions themselves.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over de dreigende sluiting van twee Groningse ziekenhuizen en de riante vertrekregeling van een directeur

SP MPs asked the health minister about the threatened closure of two Groningen hospitals based on a confidential report, the public access to that report, and a generous severance package for a former hospital director, including who is liable. The minister said the closure plans are not confirmed, that a public version of the report will follow, that remuneration decisions are the supervisory board's responsibility, and that she has no power to intervene.
I have no means to intervene in this. This is a responsibility of the Supervisory Board.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheden om hierop in te grijpen. Dit is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het correct uitvoeren van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary how municipalities must implement the Wmo for household care, including quality and staffing standards, basic tariffs, indexation and macrobudget figures. The state secretary answered that municipalities must meet the compensation duty, that wage grading is a matter for social partners, that tariff levels depend on local conditions, and that the handbook on tariffs and tendering was expected in autumn 2012.
Municipalities are responsible for setting quality requirements (including requirements for the staff deployed) for the household care they wish to procure.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het stellen van kwaliteitseisen (waaronder eisen aan het in te zetten personeel) aan de door hen gewenste huishoudelijke verzorging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over een fusie tussen de ziekenhuizen in Bergen op Zoom en Roosendaal en de concentratie van afdelingen

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a planned merger of the Bergen op Zoom and Roosendaal hospitals, including the concentration of maternity and acute care in Bergen op Zoom, and whether a moratorium on mergers applies. The minister replied that until the pending bill on care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may block mergers, that the internal concentration of departments is for the hospitals themselves, and that the hospitals have consulted their councils and staff and will implement planned measures with conditions to be checked by the IGZ.
Until the bill tightening the rules for care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may decide whether to block mergers.
Totdat het wetsvoorstel, waarmee de regels voor zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden aangescherpt, van kracht is, is het uitsluitend aan de NMa om fusies al dan niet tegen te houden.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handelwijze van Achmea en apothekers bij het verstrekken van incontinentiemateriaal aan patiënten (ingezonden 9 augustus 20

An SP MP asked the health minister about insurer Achmea and pharmacies' handling of incontinence supplies, including pressure on patients to disclose private circumstances and co-payments for preferred products. The minister said she cannot judge the negotiations between parties, that patients should not be pressured and privacy law applies, and that a patient may pay the extra cost of a more expensive product.
It is of course not acceptable that patients are approached in this way.
Het valt natuurlijk niet goed te praten dat patiënten op deze wijze worden benaderd.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over het contract van de GGZ-bestuurder van Mondriaan

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about reports that the Mondriaan GGZ board chair had a 111% employment contract, and whether the BBZ pay code allows such contracts for executives. The minister answered that the 111% figure was an incorrect representation under the BBZ, which sets 100% as the maximum for a full-time contract, but that actual pay stays within BBZ scales, and that no 111% contracts were found in the 2010 annual reports.
In this case a part-time factor of 111% could therefore not have been justified.
In dit geval had er dus geen deeltijdfactor van 111% 2 kunnen worden verantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het uitkleden van de ziekenhuiszorg in Noord-Holland

SP MPs asked the health minister about the downgrading of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, including loss of maternity care, ambulance response times, and whether mergers should be reversed or subjected to a moratorium pending patient and staff participation. The minister replied that the hospital keeps acute, maternity and planned care, that the merger is legally assessed by the NMa, that no moratorium can be imposed due to EU rules, and that stakeholder involvement is handled by the institutions themselves.
It is the responsibility of healthcare institutions themselves to ensure that stakeholders, including at least clients and staff, are involved in a planned concentration of care.

Het is een verantwoordelijkheid van zorginstellingen zelf om, in geval van een voorgenomen concentratie van zorg, ervoor te zorgen dat de belanghebbenden, waaronder in ieder geval cliënten en personeel, worden betrokken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over broodmaaltijdvergoedingen in de intramurale AWBZ zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked whether residents of De Elsendonck care home receive a meal allowance too small to buy two bread meals a day, forcing them to shop for food, and about related laundry and price-labelling issues. The state secretary replied that bread meals are an AWBZ entitlement the provider must cover, that the allowance is voluntary and based on a LOC guideline, that no further investigation is needed, and that the provider's practices are being monitored through residents' councils.
I do not consider further investigation necessary.
Ik acht een nader onderzoek niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven inzake een conflict op het eiland Texel tussen een erfpachter en Staatsbosbeheer

An SP MP asks whether the state forest manager Staatsbosbeheer could have prevented the eviction of the W. family from their Texel farm and whether mediation, as in an earlier Baarn case, could be used. The state secretary answers that a long-running commercial dispute was handled through repeated negotiations and eight court cases that ruled largely in Staatsbosbeheer's favour, so mediation is not appropriate, and that the case stands alone.
In a total of 8 proceedings the court has issued clear rulings in which Staatsbosbeheer's claims were almost entirely upheld.
In inmiddels 8 procedures heeft de rechter duidelijke uitspraken gedaan waarin de Staatsbosbeheer-claims nagenoeg voor 100% zijn gehonoreerd.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de onbetrouwbaarheid van de Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio (HSMR) als indicator van kwaliteit van zorg

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about the reliability of the Hospital Standardized Mortality Ratio as a quality indicator, citing a critical study, perverse incentives and the risk of patient refusal. The minister maintained that HSMR publication serves as a signal and incentive for quality improvement, acknowledged its limits for one-to-one comparison, and placed responsibility for publication, data quality and sanctions largely on hospitals, insurers and other parties.
However, publication is not my responsibility but that of the Dutch hospitals themselves.
Publicatie is echter niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid, maar die van de Nederlandse ziekenhuizen zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over privé-afkickklinieken die verslaafden misleiden

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about private rehab clinics abroad that allegedly mislead addicts and charge insurers and patients very high bills, and how oversight, licensing and executive pay might be addressed. The minister answered that the reports seem to concern one clinic in South Africa, that the IGZ cannot supervise foreign clinics, that the NZa is monitoring and a legal dispute is ongoing, and that no licensing requirement is planned.
I have no insight into the amounts being claimed from health insurers in this matter and therefore do not know whether they can be described as exorbitant.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedragen die bij zorgverzekeraars in deze worden gedeclareerd en weet dus ook niet of deze als exorbitant kunnen worden bestempeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten aan over medicatiebeoordeling bij ouderen

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about the new pricing and contracting of medication reviews for elderly patients, including the KBO and KNMP findings that few insurers contract them, and the removal of heartburn drugs from the basic package. The minister answered that the new system only started on 1 January 2012 and is too recent to draw conclusions, that patients bear responsibility for buying such drugs, and that the NZa quick scan and Zichtbare Zorg reports will follow.
The new tariff system and the new service descriptions, preceded by years of preparation and extensively discussed with the House of Representatives, were only introduced on 1 January 2012.

Het nieuwe tariefsysteem en de nieuwe prestatiebeschrijvingen, waaraan jarenlange voorbereiding vooraf is gegaan en waarover met de Tweede Kamer uitgebreid is gewisseld, is pas sinds 1 januari 2012 ingevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten en zorgverzekeraar CZ

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about insurer CZ capping treatment revenue (omzetplafonds) for independent psychotherapists, restricting patient access and freedom of choice. The minister answered that such caps fall within agreed insurer procurement policy, that no contract breach occurs since caps change only with provider consent, and that the NZa supervises insurers' duty of care, while the way insurers communicate is outside her responsibility.
Insurers are free to agree revenue caps with budgeted institutions, non-budgeted institutions and independent providers alike, as long as the insurer can meet its duty of care.

Het staat zorgverzekeraars vrij om omzetplafonds af te spreken met zowel gebudgetteerde instellingen als met niet gebudgetteerde instellingen als met vrijgevestigde zorgaanbieders, zolang de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de financiële problemen van het ziekenhuis in Spijkenisse

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the financial trouble at the Ruwaard van Putten hospital in Spijkenisse, including links to hospital discount penalties, insurer debts, insurer influence on hospital boards, and bank ties. The minister replied that continuity of care is the responsibility of insurers and providers, that insurers must guarantee emergency care within 45 minutes, and that the government will not support a hospital heading for bankruptcy.
I am not aware of which insurers the RPZ has debts with.
Het is mij niet bekend bij welke verzekeraars het RPZ schulden heeft.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hazekamp, Van Gerven, Grashoff en Graus over de voortgang van de bouw van megastallen ondanks het nadrukkelijk verzoek van de Tweede Kamer voor een moratorium op de bouw van deze

Five MPs asked the state secretary why construction of mega-stables continues despite a Chamber request for a moratorium, including a municipality's decision to proceed with a Horst aan de Maas project after a health risk assessment. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the Witveldweg zoning procedure started before the motion so it is not a new application, reiterated restrictive policy, and said a legislative cap on animal numbers would be left to a next cabinet.
There is therefore no question of new applications as referred to in the motion by the members Grashoff and Van Veldhoven.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van nieuwe aanvragen als bedoeld in de motie van de leden Grashoff en Van Veldhoven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over legbatterijeieren die ondanks verbod nog steeds in Nederland verkocht worden (sts ELI)

An SP MP asked the state secretary about battery-cage eggs still sold in the Netherlands despite the EU ban, including EU and Italian figures, import controls, use in processed foods, a sales ban and labelling. The state secretary confirmed roughly 45 million hens remain in battery cages in the EU, said import restrictions conflict with WTO rules, ruled out a national sales ban and mandatory discouraging labels, and pointed to retailer purchasing rules requiring free-range eggs.
As previously stated, under WTO rules it is not permitted to distinguish between 'like' products based on production method.
Zoals eerder aangegeven is het volgens de regels van de WTO niet toegestaan onderscheid te maken tussen «soortgelijke» producten op basis van de productiemethode.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het declareren van psychische zorg door niet-geregistreerde hulpverleners

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister about mental health care billed for services by unregistered practitioners through Europsyche, including the failure of insurers to check claims, and whether DBC financing and 'verlengde arm' constructions should be abolished. The minister said NZa and IGZ investigations are ongoing, insurers bear responsibility for checking claims, she has doubts about the verlengde arm constructie and has asked CVZ for advice, but rejected abolishing DBC financing and declined to confirm criminal investigations.

Following earlier reports about Europsyche, I asked the NZa and IGZ to investigate further the extent to which Europsyche and comparable care providers comply with all legal frameworks and to inform me about it.

Naar aanleiding van eerdere berichtgeving over Europsyche heb ik de NZa en IGZ gevraagd nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de mate waarin Europsyche en andere vergelijkbare zorgaanbieders in hun functioneren voldoen aan alle wettelijke kaders en mij daarover te informeren.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de handelwijze van zorgverzekeraar Achmea om het aanleveren van patiëntengegevens door fysiotherapeuten aan derden te verplichten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether insurer Achmea's requirement that physiotherapists supply patient data to commercial firms for CQ-index measurement, under threat of tariff cuts, breaches medical confidentiality and privacy. The minister replied that contracting is a private matter, that the CQ-measure collects patient experiences with patient consent rather than medical data, and that the CBP handles such notifications without substantive review.
Insurers are private-law bodies. Contracting and any conditions an insurer or care provider wishes to include in those contracts are for the parties themselves.
Verzekeraars zijn privaatrechtelijke instanties. Contractering en eventuele voorwaarden die een verzekeraar of zorgaanbieder in die contracten wil opnemen zijn aan de partijen zelf.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars belang hebben bij het in de schulden laten zitten van verzekerden

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether health insurers profit from insured persons with premium arrears, whether the debt-collection regime is fair, and whether insurers are sufficiently punished for negligence. Minister Schippers answered that the compensation is conditional and not profit, that the regime works and includes protections, that insurers should strengthen prevention with municipalities, and that NZa oversight of insurers will be tightened.
As a result of the recommendation in the evaluation report, I have since held talks with the NZa about tightening supervision of compliance with the debt-collection protocol.
Ik heb inmiddels, als uitvloeisel van de aanbeveling uit het evaluatierapport, gesprekken gevoerd met de NZa over een verscherping van het toezicht op de naleving van het incassoprotocol.
Antwoord vragen  Leijten en Van Gerven over extra zorgkosten, veroorzaakt door aanbieders van zorg die niet voldoet aan de stand van wetenschap en praktijk

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about unscientific medical checks such as full body scans and preventive vascular scans, their cost to health care, and whether the Wet op het Bevolkingsonderzoek should block them. The minister answered that such scans are not allowed in the Netherlands without a licence, that she will ask the Gezondheidsraad for advice on allowing them at patients' own request and expense, and that she will commission research on added costs while stressing self-determination and quality standards.
At the consultation on the national health policy note on 5 March I promised to have this investigated.
Ik heb tijdens het notaoverleg over de Landelijke nota gezondheidsbeleid «Gezondheid dichtbij» op 5 maart toegezegd om dit te laten uitzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat alsnog sluiting dreigt van de spoedeisende verloskunde in ziekenhuis De Sionsberg

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the closure of the acute obstetrics unit at De Sionsberg hospital would raise maternal and infant mortality and why the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) is cooperating. The minister replied that the IGZ acts in the interest of safe care, that the hospital's care plan is under review against quality and accessibility norms, and that she rejects political interference in the inspectorate's quality judgement.
It is the task of the IGZ to assess the preconditions for providing responsible care for risks to the patient.
Het is de taak van de IGZ om de randvoorwaarden voor het leveren van verantwoorde zorg te beoordelen op risico's voor de patiënt.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over fraude met implantaten door tandartsen

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Health whether dentists profited from undisclosed implant discounts and whether the NZa and industry codes were adequate. The minister said no economic offence was clearly established, the NZa sees no reason for a new investigation, rejected a new study into beneficiaries, and relies on self-regulation through the Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen while promising to press professional bodies to sign it.
It is for the NZa to assess whether the applicable rules are being complied with.
Het is aan de NZa om te beoordelen of de geldende regels worden nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de zorgen van jonge huisartsen over de toekomst van het vak

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how she responds to young GPs' concerns that her policy (NZa advice, abolishing name-based registration, productivity incentives) undermines general practice and gatekeeping. The minister rejects the criticism, says she will receive the young GPs' representatives, denies abolishing registration, and maintains her policy strengthens the first line.
For this reason, a representative of the young GPs action group will also be received at the ministry to discuss their ideas.
Mede om die reden zal een vertegenwoordiging van de actiegroep Jonge Huisartsen ook worden ontvangen op het ministerie om in gesprek te gaan over hun ideeën.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over inadequate zorg na de sluiting van de afdeling immunologie van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AzM)

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether patients were receiving adequate care after the Maastricht AzM closed its immunology department, and whether the AzM had kept its promise on follow-up care for a specific case. The minister declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, reported that the inspectorate found new patients were being taken over by Utrecht and Nijmegen but that about 250 top-referent patients still awaited transfer, and said the inspectorate continues to monitor the process.
First, for reasons of patient privacy I cannot and will not go into the specific case in substance.
Vooropgesteld kan en wil ik vanwege de privacy van de patiënt niet inhoudelijk op een specifieke casus ingaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de vernietiging van vaccins tegen de Mexicaanse griep door een blunder van het Nederlands Vaccininstituut

An SP MP asked the minister why roughly 1.2 million H1N1 vaccine doses were discarded after an error by the Netherlands Vaccine Institute, whether the Chamber was fully informed, and what lessons were drawn. The minister said the doses had no remaining market value, that the handling broke procedures but had no external effects warranting notification to the Chamber, and that the employee was disciplined.
Notifying the Chamber does not seem appropriate in such a case.
Melding aan de Tweede Kamer ligt in zo'n geval niet voor de hand.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de dreigende ontmanteling van het Gemini Ziekenhuis in Den Helder

An SP MP asked the health minister about the threatened dismantling of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, the role of consultancy KPMG/Plexus, consultant fees, and whether scaling up hospitals should be reversed. The minister replied that the hospital's future profile keeps 24/7 acute, maternity, planned, chronic and outpatient care, that the study was commissioned internally by the hospital so cost and content are its responsibility, and that she will tighten merger review by giving the NZa a role on quality and accessibility.
It is not for me to provide information on the substantive content, costs and involvement of researchers regarding this study.
Het is niet aan mij om informatie over de inhoudelijke strekking, de kosten en betrokkenheid van onderzoekers aangaande dit onderzoek te verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over natuursubsidies Reiderwolde

Opposition MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary why land at Reiderwolde was sold below its appraised value, why its price rose about 4% in five months, whether 9% annual land appreciation is normal, how the subsidy application price was set, and why nature management went to a private operator rather than Staatsbosbeheer. The state secretary answered that the price was negotiated from the appraisal, no instructions were given to the land agency, the subsidy procedure ran through the province and Dienst Regelingen, and the natural function is secured notarially and under the EHS framework.
No instructions were given to the land agency BBL.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen gegeven richting BBL.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het betalen van 188.000 euro van VU medisch centrum (VUmc) aan miljonair R.O. van Eyeworks

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister why VUmc agreed to pay 188,000 euro toward production costs of a TV programme with Eyeworks after a medical confidentiality breach, and whether it should be recovered from VUmc decision-makers. The minister regretted the situation, said the costs come from general reserves rather than care funds, and stated the ministry cannot intervene in private contracts while the OM investigation continues, leaving liability to the parties or a judge.
While the OM investigation, which will also cover the agreements between VUmc and Eyeworks, is ongoing, no further statements can be made about the exact content of those agreements.
Lopende het onderzoek van het OM, dat ook betrekking zal hebben op de gemaakte afspraken tussen VUmc en Eyeworks, kunnen verder geen uitspraken gedaan worden over de exacte inhoud van die afspraken.
Nader antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over een mogelijke financiele regeling bij vertrek van de directeur van het COA

An MP asked ministers whether the departing COA director was granted an unusually large severance package and whether such individual arrangements are normal in the semi-public sector. The minister referred to the Commission of Inquiry report, which records an 18-month severance instead of the usual 6 months, and said a return to COA is ruled out while the COA will consider all relevant circumstances.
The Commission of Inquiry COA report states in annex 5, on the dates 26 and 27 September 2011, that a severance payment deviating from the CAO Welfare and Social Services was agreed with Ms Albayrak.

In het rapport van de Commissie van onderzoek COA wordt in bijlage 5 bij de data 26 en 27 september 2011 aangegeven dat met mevrouw Albayrak een van de CAO Welzijn en Maatschappelijke Dienstverlening afwijkende ontslagvergoeding is overeengekomen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over Veiligheid van en controle op geneesmiddelen

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about the growing production of medicines in low-wage countries, contaminated Ranbaxy omeprazole, inspection limits, and transparency of quality controls. The minister answered that inspections, GMP certification, batch testing and publicly available reports ensure quality, while acknowledging rising risks and that labour conditions fall outside her responsibility.
I cannot comment on the oversight of social and working conditions on site, as this is not under my responsibility.
Over het toezicht op de sociale en arbeidsomstandigheden ter plaatse kan ik geen uitspraak doen, aangezien dit niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid valt.

Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het afwijzen door het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van een vergoeding voor deeltijd WW bij een paardenhouder die ter voorkoming van besmetting van andere paarden met de

MP Van Gerven asked why the Ministry of Social Affairs rejected a request for short-time work benefit for a horse-riding business that closed to prevent spread of the EHV1 virus, and whether this was not an exceptional circumstance. The minister answered that the risk of animal disease is a normal business risk, that the rejection followed the policy criteria, and that the business acted well but does not qualify for the exemption.
There are no exceptional circumstances that cannot reasonably be attributed to the normal business risk.
Er is geen sprake van buitengewone omstandigheden die in redelijkheid niet tot het normale bedrijfsrisico kunnen worden gerekend.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er veel meer q-koortsslachtoffers zijn

An SP MP asked the minister whether the Q-fever outbreak was far larger than previously stated, why past estimates were wrong, and whether a Q-fever compensation fund should be set up. The minister answered that earlier figures were not wrong because notified cases differ from infections, that no national estimate of medical or economic costs exists, and that about 250 chronic patients are being treated, with the Visie op schadefondsen letter setting out the position on a fund.
No national estimate has been made of the medical costs and economic damage resulting from Q-fever.
Er is geen landelijke inschatting gemaakt van medische kosten en de economische schade als gevolg van Q-koorts.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Van Gerven over marteling en mishandeling in Israëlische detentiecentra

MPs Van Bommel and Van Gerven asked the government about a report alleging torture and ill-treatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli detention centres with medical staff involvement, and whether the government would press Israel for independent investigation and accountability. The minister said the government cannot assess the report's findings, leaves judgement and investigation to Israeli authorities and the UN Committee against Torture, and noted Israel's Health Ministry had set up a review commission.
The cabinet does not have the information that would make it possible to form a judgement on the content of the report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de informatie die het mogelijk maakt een oordeel te vellen over de inhoud van het rapport.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over een zoekgeraakte brief van een dierenasiel

MP Van Gerven asked whether an exemption request from Dierenbescherming Limburg for housing rules for an animal shelter in Maastricht had been lost, whether this left municipalities in breach of their duties, and whether a private animal welfare body could file such a request on behalf of a public authority. The state secretary answered that the request was registered on 27 January 2012 and decided within the reasonable eight-week period, that no statutory deadline applies, and that the duty to meet the rules lies with the shelter operator rather than the municipality.
This request was registered with the ministry on 27 January 2012.
Dit verzoek is op 27 januari 2012 geregistreerd bij het ministerie.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het plaatsen van tv-camera’s in het VU medisch centrum

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked whether filming hidden TV cameras at VUmc without patients' knowledge breached medical confidentiality and privacy, and about consent, deleted footage, hospital accountability and commercial ownership. Minister Schippers answered that privacy and confidentiality are distinct, that the CBP is investigating, that the posters approach is inadequate, and that hospital staff should be restrained in media cooperation, but she largely referred back to earlier answers and found no basis to link profit-making to such incidents.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is currently investigating whether privacy has been violated in this case.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) onderzoekt momenteel in deze zaak of de privacy is geschonden.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Van Gerven over de berichten dat de Saxion Hogeschool de niet-geaccrediteerde opleiding tot CAM-therapeut blijft aanbieden

SP MPs asked whether Saxion Next still offers a non-accredited HBO CAM therapist programme and what happens to students and graduates. The state secretary answered that existing students may finish, that their diplomas are legally valid, that no new students were enrolled after accreditation lapsed, and that the website wording has been amended.
Saxion Next has acknowledged this and has since amended the text on the website.
Saxion Next heeft dit onderkend en heeft de tekst op de website inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht ‘bouwplan MST is financiële ramp’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether she shares concerns that MST's new building plan will become a financial disaster, whether a merger with ZGT could be used to cover MST's losses, and about ZGT's interim-staff costs, service relocations and monopoly risks under market competition. The minister declined to judge hospital financial decisions, said a bank consortium carries MST's loan risk, denied a merger was planned, and answered that hospitals and insurers are responsible for service configuration while promising a merger-review bill.
It is not my responsibility to judge the financial decisions a hospital takes: that is the responsibility of the institution's own board, which must account to the Supervisory Board.

Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid een oordeel te vellen over de financiële besluiten die een ziekenhuis neemt: dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling zelf, waarover verantwoording moet worden afgelegd aan de Raad van Toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over het gesteggel rond de financiering van de extra ambulance op de Kop van Walcheren en het geboortecentrum in Vlissingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the dispute over funding an extra ambulance on Walcheren and the Vlissingen birth centre, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says the NZa has independently raised the Connexxion budget retroactively and that the birth centre stays open, while stressing the NZa's independence and placing responsibility for regional care with insurers and providers.
I am politically responsible for the functioning of the NZa as a whole. However, in its judgement the NZa is independent.
Ik ben politiek verantwoordelijk voor het functioneren van de NZa als geheel. In haar oordeelsvorming is de NZa echter onafhankelijk.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de vergoeding van het middel Caphosol en speekselsubstituten/mondspoelmiddelen aan onder andere kinderen met kanker

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked why the minister refuses to reimburse Caphosol and similar saliva substitutes for children and others with cancer-treatment mouth sores, and whether OHRA's exceptional reimbursement shows the drug should be covered. The minister answered that these products are not on the reimbursement list, are classed as self-care products not medically necessary, and that the CZ group's coulance policy would not generally cover them.
Caphosol, like all other saliva substitutes/mouthwashes (except Salvia Orthana), is not a registered medicine but an aid.
Caphosol is net als alle andere speekselsubstituten/mondspoelingen (behalve Salvia Orthana) geen geregistreerd geneesmiddel, maar een hulpmiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de minister en zijn voorgangers een Europese tik op de vingers hebben gekregen

Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum how he responded to an ECHR ruling criticising high barriers for migrants seeking residence permits, whether it affects residence permit fees, and what would follow from a possible EU Court ruling. The minister said the ruling concerns an effective remedy for a welfare recipient, that he will inform parliament shortly on how he will comply, and he compared fee levels across EU member states.
You will be informed in the short term about how I will comply with the ECHR ruling.
U zult op korte termijn worden geïnformeerd over de wijze waarop ik gevolg zal geven aan de uitspraak van het EHRM.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de vergoeding van hulpmiddelen voor uitwendige elektrostimulatie ter behandeling van chronische pijn

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether chronic pain should be treated as a serious condition rather than low disease burden, and whether TENS and similar electrostimulation should remain reimbursed despite a planned CVZ advice to drop them. The minister said the CVZ advice was still a confidential draft, that a position would follow with the annual package advice, and that reimbursement requires proven value rather than a physician's judgement.
I assume that the advice will be incorporated into the 2012 package advice.
Ik ga er vanuit dat het advies meeloopt in het pakketadvies 2012.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het moeilijk kunnen krijgen van een hypotheek of verzekering na kanker

SP MPs asked the health minister about cancer survivors facing higher premiums or refusal for life insurance and mortgages, and whether this breaches equal treatment. The minister acknowledged the social-economic problems, rejected the claim of exploitation or a constitutional breach, and committed only to general attention and existing contact between insurers and patient groups.
For life insurance there is no statutory duty to accept applicants, as there is for the basic health insurance package.
Voor levensverzekeringen geldt geen wettelijke acceptatieplicht, zoals die voor het basispakket van de zorgverzekering wel geldt.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de onduidelijkheid rond toevoegingen aan tabak door de tabaksindustrie

Questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) ask why tobacco packaging does not list ingredients like food does, why additives are not banned, and why manufacturer ingredient data submitted to RIVM since 2007 has not been published, plus why Trouw's FOIA request for policy documents was partly withheld. The minister argues packaging is unsuitable for ingredient information, defends a phased publication via RIVM's tabakinfo.nl, states insufficient evidence to regulate additives, and declines full disclosure of documents citing the Wob exceptions and a pending objection by Trouw.
As long as this objection procedure is still under consideration, I will not make any further statements about this.
Zolang deze bezwaarprocedure nog in behandeling is, doe ik hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de bezuinigingen en reorganisaties van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) en Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST)

Labour MP Van Gerven asks the health minister about cost cuts and reorganisations at two Twente hospital groups, covering weekend psychiatric closures, a hiring freeze, executive pay, service transfers and possible mergers. The minister answers that these are the hospital boards' own decisions, that continuity of care must be guaranteed, that the NZa oversees insurers' duty of care, and that no merger plans have been notified.
Such a decision is for the board of the healthcare institution concerned.
Een dergelijk besluit is aan het bestuur van de betreffende zorginstelling.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het niet vergoeden van de kosten die ouders moeten maken om hun zieke kind te laten behandelen in het buitenland

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why insurers cover an experimental treatment abroad for a sick child but not the parents' living costs, and whether the treatment would be available in the Netherlands. The minister replied that experimental treatment abroad is not insured care under the Zvw, that living costs of family are not covered, that insurers can seek a CVZ opinion, and that no registry of such cases exists.
There are no public registrations tracking how many children undergo treatment abroad for life-threatening reasons.
Er zijn geen publieke registraties die bijhouden hoeveel kinderen er om levensbedreigende redenen een behandeling in het buitenland ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat duizenden vrouwen zijn verminkt door rimpelvullers

An SP MP asked the health minister how thousands of women came to be disfigured by permanent wrinkle fillers, whether permanent fillers should be banned, and how clinics and victims are supervised and helped. The minister answered that the IGZ has warned against permanent fillers since 2006, that only a handful of complaints have come in since, and that a ban is not opportune because permanent fillers are also used in reconstructive surgery and a ban would need EU action.
On this basis I have received no indications that permanent wrinkle fillers are still being used for cosmetic purposes in Dutch hospitals or clinics.
Op grond hiervan heb ik geen aanwijzingen gekregen dat er in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen of klinieken nog permanente rimpelvullers worden gebruikt voor cosmetische doeleinden.

Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het conceptadvies van het College voor zorgverzekeringen om remicade voor de indicatie colitis ulcerosa uit het pakket te schrappen zodat patiënten eerder een darmoperatie dreigen te moete

An SP MP asks whether the CVZ advice to remove Remicade for colitis ulcerosa from the basic package, which could push patients toward surgery, is true and whether the minister will reject it and protect patients. The minister confirms the NZa extra financing condition was not met, but says patients keep entitlement for now, will send the CVZ advice when issued, and will not anticipate it.
Once the CVZ issues a package advice on this, I will send it to you.
Zodra het CVZ een pakketadvies uitbrengt hierover, zal ik dat aan u opsturen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in ziekenhuis de Sionsberg te Dokkum

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the acute obstetrics unit at Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum would close and how the 45-minute access norm and maternal safety would be guaranteed. The minister answered that care providers must draw up a regional maternity care plan by 1 May 2012, that regular births continue meanwhile, and that the Inspectorate will review the plan, while leaving much of the responsibility to providers and insurers.
The care providers are responsible for drawing up a coherent plan for maternity care.
De zorgaanbieders zijn aan zet om een samenhangend plan voor de geboortezorg op te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de sluiting van de GGZ-kliniek in Boxmeer en het schrappen van de geplande nieuwbouw

Several MP Van Gerven asked the minister about the closure of the GGZ clinic in Boxmeer and cancellation of planned new building, and about the continued collection of mental health co-payments despite cuts. The minister answered that the provider GGZ Oost-Brabant decided on financial grounds, that care will shift to outpatient services and other regional clinics, and that co-payments are justified and will be monitored.
For the year 2012 onward I am setting up a monitor of the effect of the co-payment on vulnerable groups.
Ik zet voor het jaar 2012 en verder een monitor uit naar het effect van de eigen bijdrage op de kwetsbare groepen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over fusieplannen van ziekenhuizen in Winterswijk en Doetinchem

An SP MP asks the health minister how she responds to plans by two hospitals in the Achterhoek to merge, possibly closing the Winterswijk site, and what she will do about the resulting local unrest and risks to emergency access. The minister says mergers are not always undesirable, announces a tightened merger review bill now before the Council of State, asks the providers to act carefully, and promises mandatory stakeholder involvement, while declining to assess the exact consequences of the merger.
That is why the merger review will be tightened; a bill to that effect is currently with the Council of State.
Vandaar dat de fusietoetsing zal worden aangescherpt, een wetsvoorstel daartoe ligt thans bij de Raad van State voor.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over de tabakslobby die meespreekt in Den Haag

An SP MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about contacts between ministry officials and the tobacco industry, including an informal arrangement that industry would first raise issues with the director-general, and whether the ministry follows WHO guidelines limiting industry interaction. The minister answered that such contacts are part of normal stakeholder engagement, that the ministry is transparent about them, and that he disagrees with critics' characterisations of tobacco policy.
I was not aware of this specific arrangement, and that is not necessary because it fits the policy line I indicated in answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Ik was niet op de hoogte van deze specifieke afspraak, en dat hoeft ook niet want hij past in de beleidslijn zoals ik bij vraag 1 heb aangegeven.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over dat de controle op medicijngebruik van ouderen faalt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how to ensure medication checks for elderly patients on five or more drugs, including pharmacist review, insurer reimbursement and oversight of mail-order pharmacies and self-bought medicine. The minister agreed such checks are important, pointed to pending NZa market scans and existing guidelines, declined to disclose insurer contract details citing competition sensitivity, and promised no new oversight measures.
I note, however, that this partly concerns competitively sensitive information that I could not simply disclose even if I had it.
Ik merk wel op dat het hier deels om concurrentiegevoelige informatie gaat die ik niet zonder meer naar buiten zou kunnen brengen als ik er wel over beschikte.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over het noodgedwongen stopzetten van psychologische behandeling door weigering aanvullende zorgverzekering

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about Menzis imposing turnover caps on psychotherapists, forcing patients to switch insurers, and the cuts to psychotherapy care. The minister answered that insurers may set such caps within their purchasing and duty-of-care framework, that medical selection in supplementary insurance is the insurer's own matter, and that she sees no reason to intervene or reverse the cuts.
Yes, as far as I am aware the majority of health insurers apply turnover caps for non-budgeted curative mental health providers, including self-employed psychotherapists.
Ja, voor zover bij mij bekend hanteert het merendeel van de zorgverzekeraars omzetplafonds voor niet-gebudgetteerde curatieve GGZ-aanbieders, waaronder vrijgevestigde psychotherapeuten.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de problemen bij de intensive care van het VU Medisch Centrum (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about serious problems on the VU Medical Centre intensive care unit, including two possibly preventable deaths, a whistleblower sidelined, and a possible link to a merger. The minister answered that the Health Inspectorate is acting actively, the hospital board has a remediation plan under inspection, the whistleblower is not suspended but not operating, and the merger is not considered a cause.
Both reports are under investigation and being handled by the IGZ.
Beide meldingen zijn in onderzoek en behandeling door de IGZ.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Leijten over de toekomst van de ziekenhuiszorg in (Noord-oost) Friesland.

MPs Van Gerven, Leijten and Jacobi asked the health minister about the restructuring of hospital De Sionsberg in north-east Friesland, including reliance on confidential KPMG Plexus reports, lifting of supervision by the inspectorate, the insurer's role and the 45-minute ambulance standard. The minister answered that the restructuring decision rests with the hospital board and the inspectorate, that the study's costs, financiers and publication are for the commissioning parties, and that extra ambulance capacity secures acute access.
Information on the costs and financiers of this study and the involvement of researchers is therefore not available to me.
Informatie over de kosten en financiers van dit onderzoek en de betrokkenheid van onderzoekers heb ik dan ook niet tot mijn beschikking.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het UMC Utrecht voornemens is een eicelbank te openen (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a planned egg bank at UMC Utrecht, offering donors about 1000 euro, complies with the Dutch Embryo Act's ban on commercial egg donation, and about age limits and funding. The minister said the reimbursement is a cost allowance still under review by the profession, that the 45-year age limit is kept, that treatment is covered by the basic package, and that the Netherlands' rules match European standards.
I await the formal position on the amount and will decide on that basis whether this amount is indeed a direct consequence of the acts performed with the germ cells.

Ik wacht het formele standpunt over de hoogte van het bedrag af en bepaal op basis daarvan of dit bedrag inderdaad een rechtstreeks gevolg is van de «handelingen die met de geslachtscellen zijn verricht».
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontwikkelingen bij de Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether hospital services in Delfzijl and Winschoten were being concentrated, whether the surgical and cardiology changes affected access to acute care, and what the role of insurers was. Minister Schippers answered that the ICU and cardiac monitoring were moved to Winschoten with substitute beds in Delfzijl, that the changes are the hospital's responsibility under quality criteria, and that the availability-contribution decision awaited the Health Council advice.
The hospital has informed me that preparations are being made to turn department A2 into a heart and lung department.
Het ziekenhuis heeft mij laten weten dat er voorbereidingen worden getroffen om van afdeling A2 een hart- en longafdeling te maken.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over medische selectie door zorgverzekeraars

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about medical selection by health insurers for supplementary insurance, including whether it breaches equal treatment under Article 1 of the Constitution. The minister answered that insurers must accept everyone for basic insurance, that medical selection is permitted for supplementary insurance under EU rules, and that most supplementary policies still apply no selection; she rejected claims of discrimination and of profit-driven harm.
The acceptance policy for a supplementary insurance falls within the insurer's own powers, of which I have no insight.
Het acceptatiebeleid van een aanvullende verzekering behoort namelijk tot de eigen bevoegdheden van de verzekeraar waar ik geen inzicht in heb.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van pakketbezuinigingen voor reumapatiënten

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister how cuts to physiotherapy coverage affect rheumatism patients, whether mobility is essential for them, and whether the government's constitutional duty for public health is met. The minister replied that long-term physiotherapy for several chronic conditions is not proven effective, that short-term proven treatments remain available at patients' own cost or via supplementary insurance, and that the coverage criteria follow the Zorgverzekeringswet and the Grondwet's health duty.
The CVZ examined whether long-term physiotherapy for certain conditions meets the statutory standard of science and practice and the package principle of necessity.

Het CVZ heeft onderzoek gedaan naar de vraag of langdurige fysio- en oefentherapie voor bepaalde aandoeningen voldoet aan het wettelijk criterium stand van de wetenschap en praktijk en het pakketprincipe noodzakelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen Leijten en Van Gerven over de overname van Zonnehuizen en het ontslag van medewerkers

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the state secretary of Health about the takeover of bankrupt Zonnehuizen, job losses, care continuity, the role of the ministry, the Inspectorate and the guaranteed loans, and the recovery of lost funds. The state secretary answered most questions by saying the ministry was not involved in the takeover, the Inspectorate placed the organisation under intensified supervision, and the curator and new owners decide on staff, while withholding details on the property deal and Triodos Bank's role.
My ministry, nor I myself, have been involved in this takeover.
Mijn ministerie, noch ikzelf, zijn betrokken geweest bij deze overname.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verzet van de bevolking tegen de bezuinigingen op het ziekenhuis de Sionsberg in Dokkum (ingezonden 14

SP MPs asked the health minister why the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum faces closure of several departments, whether financial motives play a role, and what the government will do to keep a full hospital in northeast Friesland. The minister answered that the IGZ found the hospital too small to meet minimum volume norms, that finances also played a role, that a 2012 availability payment will match 2011 subject to an adequate plan, and that the government takes no initiative to preserve a full hospital since other hospitals can serve the region.
The IGZ will keep closely monitoring the Sionsberg to see whether the plans are responsibly developed and implemented.
De IGZ blijft de Sionsberg intensief volgen om te zien of de plannen verantwoord worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an extra ambulance post on Walcheren remains unsecured despite earlier commitments and a parliamentary motion. The minister said she asked the NZa in spring 2011 to expand the regional ambulance budget retroactively, but the NZa still lacks correct data from the regional service and insurers, and promised a decision within weeks.
The assessment of this request is for the NZa.
De beoordeling van dit verzoek is aan de NZa.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over reclames voor maagoperaties (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on gastric bypass surgery, the removal of dietary advice from the insurance package, aggressive clinic advertising, commercial pressure and whether the IGZ and NZa should investigate. The minister defends the policy as a stepped-care approach, rejects a separate IGZ or NZa investigation, and says the rise in operations has several causes without accepting commercial pressure as the driver.
I am of the view that quality can be safeguarded in this way without starting a separate IGZ investigation for every procedure.
Ik ben van mening dat kwaliteit aldus geborgd kan worden zonder voor elke verrichting een separaat onderzoek van de IGZ te starten.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat huisartsen aan de bel trekken over de situatie van vreemdel

SP MPs asked the immigration and health ministers about reports that GPs were alarmed at inhumane medical care for rejected asylum-seeking families in COA reception locations, and about a COA-Menzis contract and handover problems. The minister said COA is responsible under the law, access to medical care is guaranteed, COA and Menzis have agreed transfer safeguards, and he sees no reason for further investigation.
I therefore see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen onvoldoende betrouwbaar zijn (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister whether hospital mortality figures (HSMR) give a distorted picture, whether insurers may unfairly blacklist hospitals, and whether government should take responsibility for hospital planning instead of insurers. The minister said the technical findings are accepted but HSMR publication is not blocked, insurers are expected to communicate carefully, government will not return to central planning, and the Swedish model is instructive but not directly transferable.
I am convinced that health insurers will not terminate contracts with hospitals solely on the basis of the corrected mortality figures.
Tegen die achtergrond ben ik ervan overtuigd dat zorgverzekeraars niet louter op basis van de gecorrigeerde sterftecijfers contracten met ziekenhuizen zullen beëindigen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een rechtszaak van het RIVM tegen een kritische huisarts (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked why RIVM sued a critical GP over claims that the director of its infectious disease centre has conflicts of interest with vaccine manufacturers, and whether this chills public debate. Minister Schippers answered that the director has no close ties with pharma firms, that the lawsuit is a principled bodemprocedure seeking a judicial ruling rather than financial harm, and that the matter must be settled by the court so the scientific debate can continue.
Since on two occasions there has been no willingness to rectify, the court will be asked to rule in the public interest involved.
Nu tot twee keer toe geen bereidheid tot rectificatie is getoond zal ten bate van het publieke belang dat daarmee gemoeid is, de rechter om een oordeel gevraagd worden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijkheden tot het verlagen van het aantal dierproeven 1 december 2011 (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how to reduce animal testing, citing criticism that animal tests have limited predictive value and that the risk-assessment framework is outdated. The minister acknowledges limited predictive value, points to the Actieplan Dierproeven en Alternatieven 2011-2021 and ZonMw programmes, and says no test-garden pilots have yet been realised and animal experiments remain necessary for now.
Animal experiments are for the time being still considered necessary to answer complex, socially relevant questions in this area.
Dierproeven worden vooralsnog noodzakelijk geacht om complexe maatschappelijk relevante vragen op dit gebied te beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over doorfok bij paarden en argeloze hondenkopers die misleid worden door LICG (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

MP Van Gerven asks whether dog breeding with hereditary disease (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) is promoted on the government-co-funded LICG website, whether the state will address dog-breeding harms and the horse stud-book inbreeding rules, and how the ETP commission ensures objectivity.
