The state secretary replies that breeding welfare is the breeders' and owners' responsibility, that LICG information is neutral and covers hereditary defects, that exhibitions are private, and that all stud books must meet the 1% inbreeding criterion, with the ETP commission applying 22 criteria neutrally.
That animals suffer hereditary defects from breeding and experience welfare problems as a result, I find worrying.
Dat dieren ten gevolge van fokkerij erfelijke gebreken hebben en hiervan welzijnsproblemen ondervinden vind ik zorgwekkend.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de banden van de minister met de tabaksindustrie en falende rookpreventie (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about ties between her ministry and the tobacco industry, the value of official visits to tobacco firms, possible ministerial conflicts of interest, and whether tobacco-control policy is failing. The minister answered that contacts with industry are technical and occasional, that no ministerial-level meeting occurred, that civil servants' conflict-of-interest rules suffice, and that the disputed mortality estimate is unsubstantiated.
At ministerial level, no meeting with the tobacco industry has taken place since the cabinet took office.
Op ministerieel niveau heeft geen gesprek met de tabaksindustrie plaatsgevonden sinds het aantreden van het kabinet.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een megastal met 1 miljoen kippen (ingezonden 28 november 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether the government will intervene in the planned Nieuw Gemengd Bedrijf in Horst aan de Maas (1.2 million chickens and 35,000 pigs), given his earlier view that such scale is excessive. The secretary replies that intervention is not currently appropriate, that existing spatial and environmental tools suffice, that the province has issued draft permits, and that the municipality is awaiting a GGD health advice before proceeding.
At this moment, intervention by the cabinet is not an option.
Op dit moment is ingrijpen voor het kabinet niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bemiddelingssites waar zich sperma- en eiceldonoren aanbieden (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about online sites where sperm and egg donors offer themselves to people wanting children, including whether they operate within the law, whether providers must vet participants, and whether the Inspectorate or others should supervise them. The minister replies that such brokering is not prohibited but donation must be free under the Embryo Act, that websites have no legal duty to vet parties, that the Inspectorate only supervises once medical care or reserved acts are involved, and that a policy position will follow early next year.
Websites or providers of websites are not obliged to investigate whether people wanting children or the donors act in good faith.
Websites of providers van websites zijn niet verplicht te onderzoeken of mensen met een kinderwens dan wel de donoren te goeder trouw zijn.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zelfverrijking van toezichthouders van de Stichting Gehandicaptenzorg Limburg (ingezonden 27 okt

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the state secretary for Health whether two supervisory board members of Stichting Gehandicaptenzorg Limburg who appointed themselves as temporary administrators and set their own high pay was acceptable, and what sanctions and reclaim measures would follow. The state secretary declined substantive judgement, citing an ongoing procedure before the Governance Commissie Gezondheidszorg, unclear facts, and that the pay norms of the forthcoming WNT would apply.
Given this procedural state of affairs, I therefore exercise restraint in this matter.
Gezien deze procedurele stand van zaken past mij in dezen dus terughoudendheid.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de praktijken van privékliniek Geertgen uit Elsendorp (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the private clinic Geertgen, which offers faster egg-donation-linked fertility treatment, may pressure patients, profits financially, violates the Embryo Act or is supervised adequately. The minister answers that she will return with a broader analysis in early 2012, that the IGZ has addressed missing external quality checks, and that the clinic's practices are not in breach of the WBMV, while declining to inquire into the reasons for ending a hospital partnership.
I will provide the House with a broader analysis and my position on this in the first quarter of 2012.
Ik zal de Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2012 een bredere analyse schetsen en mijn standpunt hierover doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over financiële malaise in de AWBZ-zorg door afwaardering van vastgoed (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked how much profit the 50 largest AWBZ care providers made last year and where that money came from. The state secretary answered that the top 50 reported a positive result of €190.49 million, 1.57% of total income, and broke down their revenue sources, mostly statutory budgets.
The 50 largest AWBZ care-providing institutions (not exclusively AWBZ care) achieved a positive result of €190.49 million.
De 50 grootste AWBZ-zorg leverende instellingen (niet uitsluitend AWBZ zorg) hebben een positief resultaat gehaald van € 190,49 mln.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onduidelijkheid rond inkomens van huisartsen en onderzoek van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) (ingezonden 14 oktober 20

An SP MP asks the health minister whether an independent institute should join the NZa in determining GP incomes, whether the LHV should be involved in the study design, and how a 9% GP funding cut in 2012 (and a 132 million euro saving) can be justified and implemented without harming access and quality. The minister rejects a parallel study, says the NZa consults the LHV as standard, states the cut is based on overspending rather than average GP income (now revised to 112 million), and commits only to asking the NZa for a feasibility review of the payment system.
I see no compelling reason to postpone this measure by a year, especially since the cut is not based on the discussion about GP income.
Ik zie geen dwingende reden om deze maatregel met een jaar uit te stellen, temeer omdat de korting niet is gebaseerd op de discussie over het inkomen van de huisarts
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Indiase operatieassistenten en risico’s voor patiënten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether she would send the Inspectorate's findings on risks from Indian operating-theatre staff and whether hospitals would stop recruiting from India given the Fonds Ziekenhuisopleidingen. The minister agreed to send the Inspectorate's findings with her response in spring 2012 and said recruitment from India would be much less needed as training intake rises, while noting temporary recruitment is acceptable if it meets quality standards.
I am willing to do so. I expect to be able to send the Inspectorate's findings to the House of Representatives in spring 2012, including a response from me.
Ik ben daartoe bereid. De bevindingen van de Inspectie verwacht ik in het voorjaar van 2012 naar de Tweede Kamer te kunnen sturen, inclusief een reactie van mijn kant.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het opzeggen van pachtcontract door Staatsbosbeheer (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Jansen (SP) asked the state secretary whether Staatsbosbeheer's termination of the lease of farmers Evers over Icelandic horses was proportionate, whether mediation was pursued, and whether individual circumstances were considered. The state secretary answered that horse-keeping breached the lease and zoning plan, that termination was a last resort confirmed by the court, and that Staatsbosbeheer had sought alternatives, but the lessee ended talks.
Staatsbosbeheer proceeded carefully in this regard. The lease judge also examined this point.
Staatsbosbeheer is daarbij zorgvuldig te werk gegaan. Dit is iets waar overigens ook de pachtrechter naar heeft gekeken.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het van start gaan van SOS Arts (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the NZa's approval of the SOS Arts on-call doctor initiative, its claimed huisarts role, the risk of a two-tier system, and the supervision of the service. The minister defended innovation and new entrants, argued on-call care is not covered by the basic insurance, and said the IGZ will supervise quality.
I am of the view that more innovative initiatives, which may contribute to improving the quality, accessibility and efficiency of care and offer patients more choice, should be given a chance.

Ik ben van mening dat meer innovatieve initiatieven, die mogelijk kunnen bijdragen aan het bevorderen van de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en doelmatigheid van de zorg en patiënten meer keuzemogelijkheden bieden, een kans moeten krijgen.

Vragen van het lid van Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het fixatiebeleid in de thuissituatie naar aanleiding van de Wet zorg en dwang (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

MP Van Gerven asks the minister whether the new Wet zorg en dwang will encourage restraint (fixation) in home care, given concerns from experts about monitoring, supervision by the Inspectie, and multidisciplinary competence. The state secretary replies that the law sets strict conditions for restraint in both home and institutional care, requires providers to report restraint per client to the IGZ, and that restraint will be prohibited where supervision is lacking.
The bill requires the care provider to regularly provide the IGZ with an overview per client of the involuntary care given, stating its nature, frequency and the reasons for it.
Het wetsvoorstel vereist dat de zorgaanbieder regelmatig een overzicht per cliënt verstrekt aan de IGZ van de onvrijwillige zorg die is verleend
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van zelfdodingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister why suicides rose for a third year, whether barriers to mental health care such as the new co-payments should be lifted, and whether the suicide reporting procedure should be restored. The minister acknowledged the 2010 rise, declined to investigate its causes and to lower financial barriers further, promised to study the effects of co-payments, and refused to reverse the eased reporting procedure.
At the General Consultation of 30 June I promised that I would examine the possible effects of the co-payment on avoidance of care.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 30 juni jl. heb ik toegezegd dat ik de eventuele effecten van de eigen bijdrage op zorgmijding zal onderzoeken.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de diamanten afvloeiingsregeling voor een adviseur van ziekenhuis de Tjongerschans in Heerenveen (ingezonde

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a possible 1 to 1.3 million euro severance arrangement for an adviser at hospital Tjongerschans, a prior 350,000 euro golden handshake, board accountability, supervision, a statutory route to reverse such deals, and a planned merger with MCL. The minister said the arrangement far exceeds the 75,000 euro cap, that the supervisory board decides, that the hospital must cover legal costs itself, that stricter supervision criteria do not cover board pay, and that the government favours the pay-norm legislation; the merger is for the NMa and NZa to assess.
The authority to decide on that lies with the Supervisory Board.
De bevoegdheid om daar een besluit over nemen, ligt bij de Raad van Toezicht.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het inzetten van ongediplomeerde zomerhulpen in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

Member Van Gerven asks the state secretary about unqualified summer helpers used in home care in the Arnhem region, staffing shortages and whether the Inspectorate should act. The state secretary replies that the reported helpers were domestic aides or supervised students doing only tasks they are competent for, that institutions bear primary responsibility for staffing, and that the Inspectorate already tests for qualified care but no specific targeted request is needed.
I therefore see no reason to ask the Inspectorate to specifically focus on care providers that struggle to organise adequate staffing during holiday periods.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de IGZ te verzoeken zich specifiek te richten op zorgaanbieders die tijdens een vakantieperiode moeite hebben om een adequate personeelsbezetting te organiseren.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het niet openbaar maken van meetlocaties van onderzoek naa

An SP MP asks the health and agriculture ministers why the measurement locations of the IRAS study on health risks of intensive livestock farming are not made public, whether this is legally impossible, and whether residents have a right to know about high endotoxin levels. The minister answers that postcodes of some locations are released, that the locations of farm-based measurement points remain confidential under agreements with owners and cannot be disclosed, that no legal means exist to compel disclosure, and that the follow-up study design is being prepared and will be sent to the Chamber after assignment.
These measurement locations of the IRAS study I cannot make public because I do not have them at my disposal.
Deze meetlocaties van het IRAS-onderzoek kan ik niet openbaar maken omdat ik daarover niet beschik.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) om topsalarissen te matigen (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether Medisch Spectrum Twente's intention to align top executive pay with the sector pay code is meaningful, whether existing high contracts can be reopened, whether company cars and high salaries are justified, and whether she will intervene in other hospitals' governance. The minister replied that the code and pay norm apply to new contracts only, that existing contracts are hard to change, that company car decisions belong to institutions, and that intervening in hospital boards would not respect private responsibility, while noting the forthcoming pay norm law.

I have examined what role I can play in the appointment of boards and concluded that intervening in the governance of a care institution does not do justice to the private responsibility of the parties in care.

Ik ben nagegaan welke rol ik kan spelen bij de benoeming van besturen en ben tot de conclusie gekomen dat ingrijpen in het bestuur van een zorginstelling geen recht doet aan de private verantwoordelijkheid van de partijen in de zorg.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onderhandelingen over de ziekenhuiskosten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the health minister whether insurers' letter to hospitals (ZN's campaign) undermines the 2.5% growth hoyer agreement, and how hospital care quality, waiting lists and hospital core tasks are safeguarded. Minister Schippers answered that the letter was not addressed to her, that it is not in conflict with the agreement, that hospitals must manage their finances, and that the agreement guarantees waiting-time norms and care access.
The letter from ZN is not addressed to me but to the Dutch Hospital Association, so it is primarily for those organisations to respond to it.
De brief van ZN is niet aan mij gericht maar aan de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de q-koorts en het desondanks niet tijdig inenten van geiten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about the Q fever outbreak and the failure to vaccinate goats in time, including how many animals may be unvaccinated, whether fines and warnings have been issued, and what steps will secure full vaccination. The state secretary referred to earlier answers given to a PvdD MP on the same questions, without restating substantive figures.
See the answer to the first question on the same subject from MP Thieme (PvdD).
Zie antwoord op de eerste vraag over hetzelfde onderwerp van het Kamerlid Thieme (PvdD)
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een ggz-instelling die overweegt het personeel om een loonoffer te vragen (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether she approves of mental health institution Mondriaan considering asking staff to give up 5 to 10% of their salary, and questions budget cuts, cao compliance and the rights of mental health patients. The minister replies that the idea was preliminary, was not pursued, that cuts stay within the coalition agreement, that cao terms are for employers and unions to negotiate, and that she will monitor effects of care avoidance and inform the House in October.
I promised the House during the GGz committee meeting of 30 June that I will monitor the effects of care avoidance caused by the introduction of the co-payment.
Ik heb de Kamer tijdens het AO GGz van 30 juni jl. toegezegd dat ik de effecten van zorgmijding door introductie van de eigen bijdrage ga monitoren.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de overname van ziekenhuis ’t Lange Land (LZZ) (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

Two MPs (SP) asked the health minister about the planned takeover of 't Lange Land hospital in Zoetermeer, its effects on accessibility and emergency care, job losses, the risk of hospital bankruptcies, and the transfer of the Csz sanitation college to the NZa. The minister answered that hospital reorganisation is a matter for the hospital board, that accessibility norms are met, that the government will not rescue failing providers, and that the Csz tasks will move to the NZa.
I have no objection to a hospital seeking solutions to address its financial problems and realise a care offer more geared to the future.
Ik heb er niets op tegen dat een ziekenhuis op zoek gaat naar oplossingen om zo de financiële problemen het hoofd te bieden en een meer op de toekomst toegespitst zorgaanbod te realiseren.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de privacyschending van medische persoonsgegevens door zorgverzekeraars (ingezonden 10 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Gerven asked the minister whether insurers should be able to view medical records without patient consent, whether records are sent by post and who may review them, and what the NZa and privacy regulator CBP have found about compliance. The minister defended the regulated framework (developed with CBP advice), said postal transfer has adequate safeguards, stated that consent is not required, and described detailed checks as a last-resort, proportionality-tested step under medical adviser responsibility.
Inspection of medical records can therefore only take place as a last resort, if its proportionality can be justified.
Inzage in medische dossiers kan dus uitsluitend plaatsvinden als uiterste middel, indien de proportionaliteit daarvan kan worden gemotiveerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding in het ziektekostenpakket van lapatinib bij de behandeling van patiënten met gemetastaseerde

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Health why lapatinib is not reimbursed for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer after trastuzumab failure, and whether this reflects cost, inconsistency, or class medicine. The Minister answered that reimbursement was refused on lack of demonstrated therapeutic added value and lack of proven survival benefit, not price, and declined to link the decision to pricing or private insurance.
No, this description is not correct. The reimbursement application for lapatinib was not rejected because it would be too expensive.
Nee, deze weergave is niet correct. De betreffende vergoedingsaanvraag van lapatinib was niet afgewezen omdat het te duur zou zijn.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de verwerking van brandbaar afval uit Napels (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary about incineration of combustible waste from Naples in Dutch plants, including whether it displaces Dutch waste, volumes, prices, AVR-Van Gansewinkel's finances and controls on the waste stream. The state secretary replied that no notification had yet been filed, that the flexible import ceiling could block new imports, and that the Inspectorate checks transports by sampling, judging the risk from Naples waste as small.
Setting rates for processing waste from abroad is a matter for the processing companies themselves.
Tariefstelling voor verwerking van afval uit het buitenland is een zaak van de verwerkingsbedrijven zelf.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen en de lessen van de Klebsiëlla-infectie in het Maasstad ziekenhuis (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about liability for patient harm, the director's pay and severance, the Raad van Toezicht's conduct, and the Inspectie's timing and actions in the Maasstad hospital Klebsiella outbreak. Minister Schippers answered that courts decide liability, that the director's income was overstated but his bonus was smaller than reported, that the Inspectie was informed late and then took escalating measures including verscherpt toezicht, and that a severance cap is in a pending bill.
The IGZ is investigating the substantive and administrative handling of this crisis and will publish an interim report in October.
De IGZ doet onderzoek naar de inhoudelijke en bestuurlijke aanpak van deze crisis en komt in oktober met een tussentijds rapport.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de riante ontslagvergoeding voor de directeur van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views the €235,898 severance payment to the Maasstad Hospital director after his resignation, whether such pay after clear mismanagement is improper, and whether she will use her influence to reverse it. The minister said the 2004 contract's one-year severance was not unusual then, that the Raad van Toezicht weighs the full career, that government has no instrument to intervene in existing contracts, and pointed to a pending bill capping executive pay and severance at €75,000 for new contracts.
Neither I nor fellow ministers have an instrument to intervene in existing employment conditions.
Noch ik, noch collega-bewindslieden hebben een instrument om te kunnen ingrijpen in bestaande arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergoeding van de mammaprint vanuit de zorgverzekering (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the CVZ's finding that MammaPrint does not meet the standard of science and practice should be revisited, why some insurers reimburse it, and whether it should be added to the basic package. The minister replied that MammaPrint lacks proven clinical utility, insurers may reimburse it from supplementary funds, and she opposes temporarily adding it to the basic insurance package.
I adopt the CVZ's judgment and agree with them that, given the information currently available, MammaPrint does not belong in the insured package.
Ik neem het oordeel van CVZ over en ben met hen van mening dat de Mammaprint gelet op de thans beschikbare informatie nu niet in het verzekerde pakket thuishoort.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het aantreden van de heer W. als interim-directeur bij het Maasstad Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether appointing a former supervisory board member with a controversial past as interim hospital director is acceptable, given the Klebsiella scandal and gold handshakes, and whether the Inspectorate should intervene or a medical intervention team should be created. The minister replies that the appointment is the supervisory board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate is already doing enhanced supervision, that salary details are not known to her and will appear in the 2011 annual report, and that external removal of boards is not appropriate given private responsibility.
Having a failing board set aside, at my request, by an external intervention team does not do justice to the private responsibility of the parties in healthcare.
Falend bestuur opzij zetten, op verzoek van mij, door een extern interventieteam doet geen recht aan de private verantwoordelijkheid van de partijen in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over regionale producten in duurzaam inkoopbeleid (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a draft of sustainable catering procurement criteria downgraded regional and seasonal products to preparatory considerations, and whether the criteria favour heated greenhouse produce and overseas products over regional field produce, asking if the criteria should be revised. The State Secretary replied that the draft is an unfinished working-group document still under review, pointed to several motions on regional products, and said he had asked for attention to regional products in the revision process.
The official process surrounding the update has not yet been completed.
Het ambtelijk traject rondom de actualisatie is nog niet afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verstrengeling van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ) met private partijen (ingezonden 12 juli 201

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the Minister of Health whether the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's creation of Zeeland Care, its funding via plastic surgery revenue, and outsourcing of dialysis to a partly privately financed entity are desirable, legal, and risk wasting insured care funds on private profit. The minister said the hospital may choose its legal form and financing within existing rules, that private financing is not prohibited, and that insurers must watch for unnecessary care.
I am not aware of the extent to which the various shareholders participate in Zeeland Care.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de mate waarin de verschillende aandeelhouders participeren in Zeeland Care.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toevoegingen aan sigaretten (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether tobacco firms are adding substances to make cigarettes more addictive, and why the Netherlands, unlike France and the US, has no ban on such additives. The minister said there is no reason to think additive use has increased, pointed to RIVM information and an ingredient-reporting scheme, and declined to regulate additives because it does not fit her tobacco policy and evidence is insufficient.
I do not intend to further regulate the composition of tobacco products, because this does not fit the tobacco discouragement policy I have in mind.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de samenstelling van tabaksproducten verder te reguleren, omdat dit niet past in het tabaksontmoedigingsbeleid dat ik voor ogen heb.
Vragen ingediend door het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over openbaarmaking van een brief inzake natuurbeleid (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation to publish a European Commission letter of 8 April 2011 on nature policy, to disclose the government's reply, and to clarify whether the letter refers to an infringement procedure. The state secretary replies that the letter was sent under the informal, confidential EU Pilot procedure, so publication would harm that confidentiality; the letter was instead sent confidentially to the House.
At my request, the European Commission did grant permission to send the letter to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
Op mijn verzoek heeft de Europese Commissie wel toestemming gegeven de brief vertrouwelijk aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de nachtsluiting van de spoedeisende hulp in Zevenaar (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the planned night-time closure of the emergency department at Rijnstate hospital in Zevenaar, its effect on 45-minute access, and whether the government would intervene. The minister said access norms remain met, pointed to the inspectorate's enforcement powers, and refused to intervene to keep the department open at night.
I am not willing to intervene and ensure that the emergency department remains open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Ik ben niet bereid in te grijpen en te bewerkstelligen dat de SEH 7 x 24 uur per dag openblijft.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het intrekken van een kritisch rapport door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ingezonden 8 juli 2

SP MPs asked the minister about the Inspectorate for Health Care's withdrawal of a critical report on a UMCG paediatric anaesthesia case, the lengthy investigation, the parents' lack of apology, and whether pressure was applied or a disciplinary case should follow. The minister answered that the withdrawal was for procedural reasons, that the Inspectorate-General has commissioned an independent review and the Ombudsman is also examining the matter, and that the inspectorate admits the investigation took too long.
The IGZ withdrew the report out of caution, because the conclusions in the first report were insufficiently supported by the facts.
De IGZ heeft uit zorgvuldigheidsoverwegingen het rapport ingetrokken, omdat de conclusies in het eerste rapport onvoldoende door de feiten werden gedragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de prestatielijst van ziekenhuizen bij de behandeling van blaaskanker door zorgverzekeraar CZ (ingezonden 7

SP MPs asked the Minister of Health whether insurer CZ's published ranking of hospitals for bladder cancer surgery, which excludes some hospitals from contracts, is a marketing tool, and whether it is reliable and consistent with the IGZ's role. The Minister replied that insurers may set quality and volume criteria when contracting care, that volume (at least 10 operations per year) matters for quality, that the IGZ cannot judge hospital-level outcomes for this rare procedure, and that she sees no reason to stop insurers publishing such lists.
Care providers are primarily themselves responsible for determining what responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat verantwoorde zorg is.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi (PvdA) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de inzet van Nederland in Brussel (EU) voor een regeling voor oormerkweigeraars (ingezonden 1

Two MPs asked the state secretary what the Netherlands has done in Brussels to secure recognition of the Dutch scheme for cattle ear-tag refusers, and what obstacles the Commission sees and whether EU rules could be amended. The secretary replied that repeated efforts have so far failed because EU rules recognise only yellow ear tags, that alternative identification means will be put on the agenda in autumn and will be pressed, and that the Commission lacks competence to grant conscientious-objector exemptions and sees no reason to amend the rules.
I will once again advocate this with the European Commission.
Ik zal dat wederom bij de Europese Commissie bepleiten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verkoop van een ziekenhuisafdeling aan een private investeringsmaatschappij (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether Orbis Medical Centre plans to sell its eye department to a private investment firm, and whether profit-oriented ownership and private clinics in hospitals are desirable, given quality and access concerns raised by experts. The minister says no sale is planned, only a possible 50-50 joint venture under discussion, announces a bill to allow regulated profit distribution with conditions, and says the Health Care Inspectorate will check quality.
I consider it desirable that over time and under the right conditions more private capital providers will invest in medical specialist care.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat op termijn en onder de juiste voorwaarden meer privaatkapitaalverschaffers zullen investeren in de medisch specialistische zorg.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de halvering van de spoedeisende hulp in het ziekenhuis te Delfzijl (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister about the OZG hospital group's decision to halve emergency department capacity and scale back evening and weekend surgery at its Delfzijl site, and about the consequences for intensive care, the 45-minute access norm and the hospital's finances. The minister replies that the ED capacity is unchanged, that surgery stops after 17.00 hours at Delfzijl with patients referred to Winschoten, that access stays within 45 minutes, and that the availability supplement decision and the Gezondheidsraad advice are still pending.
I cannot give an answer to this question at this time. Whether or not the availability supplement is granted, and its amount, depends on a number of criteria.
Op deze vraag kan ik op dit moment geen antwoord geven. Het wel of niet toekennen van de beschikbaarheidstoeslag en de hoogte is afhankelijk van een aantal criteria.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de praktijken van een aantal artsen en instituten die nog steeds HCG afslankkuren propageren en mogelijk verkopen (ingezonden

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister why doctors and clinics still advertise and possibly sell HCG weight-loss kits despite the ban, what the Inspectorate has done, and whether enforcement is adequate. The minister confirms the practices, reports that the Inspectorate found advertising violations at six providers with fines being prepared and seven still under investigation, rejects off-label justification, and says enforcement is in progress with prioritised capacity.
The Inspectorate assessed the websites of all providers for possible violations of the advertising provisions of the Medicines Act.
De Inspectie heeft de websites van alle aanbieders beoordeeld op mogelijke overtreding van de reclamebepalingen in de Geneesmiddelenwet.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht twee topklinische afdelingen te sluiten (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether she approved the Maastricht academic hospital's decision to close two top-clinical departments (immunology and sarcoidosis), who will treat affected patients, and whether the inspectorate and insurers were involved. The minister answers that the hospital board is responsible, continuity of care is guaranteed through agreements with Utrecht and Nijmegen, the inspectorate is informed and monitoring, and she declines to reverse the decision or launch a new cost-benefit analysis.
Responsibility for providing good quality of care lies with the hospital's Board of Directors.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het bieden van goede kwaliteit van zorg ligt bij de Raad van Bestuur van het ziekenhuis.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de stroomstoring bij het ziekenhuis in Hengelo van de Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) (ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a one-hour power outage at ZGT hospital in Hengelo that forced manual ventilation of intensive care patients, asking about harm, cause, management responsibility and inspectorate oversight. The minister answered that emergency procedures worked, no lives were endangered, the cause was a short circuit in a supply cable, and the Inspectorate has commissioned TNO research into emergency power in hospitals.

The IGZ, following reports and notifications of emergency power problems at several hospitals in recent years, had already commissioned TNO Zorg en Bouw before this incident to research emergency power provisions in hospitals in 2011.

De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van berichten en meldingen van problemen bij noodstroom die de afgelopen jaren in een aantal ziekenhuizen zijn opgetreden, TNO Zorg en Bouw al voor dit incident de opdracht gegeven om in 2011 een onderzoek te doen naar noodstroomvoorzieningen in ziekenhuizen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bestaan van een private kliniek voor plastische chirurgie binnen de muren van ziekenhuis Bernhoven (ingezonden 3 mei 2011)

An MP asked the health minister whether it is permissible for a hospital to host a private cosmetic surgery clinic staffed by its own doctors, how common such arrangements are, and whether discounted promotions and a university hospital's specialist clinic are acceptable. The minister answered that hospitals may set up such clinics, that doctors are paid per procedure under contracts, that she sees no need for investigation but wants clear responsibilities, and that the promotion and AMC arrangement are permissible subject to quality norms and NMa notification.
I have had the hospital inform me about the structure between the clinic and the hospital.
Ik heb mij door het ziekenhuis laten informeren over de constructie tussen de kliniek en het ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dure kankermedicijnen oneerlijk verdeeld zijn (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

The MP asks whether expensive cancer drugs reach the patients who need them, whether this amounts to 'postcode medicine', and what the government will do about regional and hospital differences. The minister answers that access is not a problem since the 2006 measures and research, rejects the term 'postcode medicine' as tied to financial motives, and points to planned reforms from 2012 on financing and registries.
I am therefore not convinced that the current financing of expensive medicines causes the differences between hospitals.
Ik ben daarom niet overtuigd dat de huidige financiering van dure geneesmiddelen voor de verschillen tussen ziekenhuizen zorgt.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een middel tegen levensbedreigende acute leukemie nauwelijks verkrijgbaar is (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister how the leukemia drug cytarabine became scarce, what would prevent patient harm, and what measures would prevent recurrence. The minister explained a supply disruption at the US manufacturer Hospira, described the Inspectorate's coordination with the Erasmus MC pharmacy and suppliers, and promised to consult pharmaceutical industry bodies on earlier information about such problems.
I will consult with the pharmaceutical industry associations and ask to receive adequate and timely information about these and similar problems at an earlier stage.
Ik zal met de koepels van farmaceutische bedrijven in overleg treden waarbij ik zal vragen op een eerder tijdstip adequate en tijdige informatie te krijgen over deze en vergelijkbare problemen.
Vragen ingediend door het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over multinationals bij kwekersvrijstelling in octrooirecht (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about who wrote the legal analysis on a plant-breeder's exemption in patent law, how its independence was ensured, which firms were consulted, and whether access to ministers was equal for farmers, NGOs and large companies. The minister replied that only ministry lawyers wrote it, no peer review took place, a Plantum opinion did not change the analysis, a consultation with five industry bodies is underway, and that all groups have equal access.
No peer review took place because sufficient expertise on this subject is available within the department.
Er heeft geen peer review plaats gevonden omdat de expertise over dit onderwerp voldoende op het departement beschikbaar is.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van een kuur in Davos voor ernstig zieke longpatiënten (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why insurer Univé was forced by court to reimburse a Davos treatment for a seriously ill asthma patient, and whether insurers are increasingly refusing Davos treatment and whether the criteria should be clarified. The Minister said she does not judge individual reimbursement disputes, has no sight of a trend (the SKGZ sees none), and points to the CVZ 2008 ruling leaving the decision to insurers on individual medical grounds.
It is not for me as Minister to pass judgment on a benefits dispute between an insured person and a health insurer, nor on a court ruling on it.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om een oordeel te vellen over een verstrekkingengeschil tussen een verzekerde en een zorgverzekeraar noch over een uitspraak van de rechtbank hierover.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verhoogde norm voor radioactiviteit in voedsel (ingezon

An SP MP asked why the EU temporarily raised radioactivity limits in food after the Japan disaster, why this was not announced, and whether food safety can be guaranteed for vulnerable groups. The minister replied that the raised limits were brief, have since been tightened to match Japanese standards, the change followed Commission consultation with member states, and infant food is now covered.
What is the reason for this change in tolerance values? Why was the sudden increase in the limit values, and the fact that this represents a considerable relaxation, not made public?

Vraag 3, 4, 5 Wat is de reden van deze verandering in tolerantiewaarden? Waarom werd de plotselinge verhoging van de grenswaarden, en het feit dat deze aanzienlijke verruiming betekent, niet bekend gemaakt?
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kwaliteitsnormen voor kankeroperaties (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports that Achmea rated ten hospitals as below quality norms for cancer surgery, questioning why the Inspectorate had not intervened, whether insurers may judge academic hospitals on incomplete data, and whether selective contracting limits patient choice. The minister replied that the NVvH norms are professional standards, that insurers may set quality requirements when purchasing care, that the Inspectorate will apply the same norms from 2012, and that patients remain free to choose providers.
Care providers are primarily themselves responsible for determining what good and responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat goede en verantwoorde zorg is.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aanstelling van M. Calon als speciaal adviseur voor het verbeteringstraject bij de Dienst Regelingen (ingezo

An SP MP asked the state secretary why M. Calon was appointed as special adviser for improvements at Dienst Regelingen despite already sitting on its advisory board, why an independent person was not chosen, and what he is paid. The state secretary confirmed the appointment, cited Calon's specific practical knowledge, said he will step down from the advisory board for two months, and stated he receives EUR 1500 for 1.5 days per week including travel and accommodation costs.
He will step down from his position as a member of the Dienst Regelingen Advisory Council for two months.
Hij legt voor twee maanden zijn functie neer als lid van de Raad van Advies van Dienst Regelingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over verdubbeling van het aantal megastallen (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether megastables have more than doubled since 2005, whether research should identify policies favouring scale growth, whether policy should favour small farmers, and whether pasture access is declining. The state secretary refers to earlier letters on the definition issue, points to a LEI report on scale growth, says a national steering decision will be assessed in preparing the cabinet vision, and acknowledges declining pasture access while noting market initiatives.
In preparing the cabinet vision I will examine whether steering at national level of large-scale (intensive) livestock farming is needed.
In de voorbereiding op de kabinetsvisie zal ik bekijken óf er op rijksniveau gestuurd moet worden op grootschalige (intensieve) veehouderij.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gedragscode van artsen (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views doctors who treated patients of a dysfunctional orthopaedic surgeon without raising alarm, whether the Wet BIG should impose a reporting duty with sanctions, and whether a medical accidents council should be created. The minister says she cannot judge the conduct, points to KNMG disciplinary rules and existing complaint and reporting systems, rejects a new accidents council as adding little, and says the whistleblowing fysiotherapists were not suspended.
I cannot judge whether the doctors' code of conduct was violated in this case.
Ik kan niet oordelen of in dit geval de gedragscode van artsen geschonden is.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bedreiging van Nederlands boerenlandschap door bezuinigingen (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether budget cuts threaten provincial landscape-management foundations, how many farmers and volunteer hours would be lost, and whether the government values the Dutch farming landscape. The state secretary said provinces will decide on subsidies after decentralisation, could not estimate affected farmers, and pointed to regional and EU alternatives while declining to commit to a specific rescue plan.
After decentralisation of landscape management, it is up to the provinces whether or not to use the knowledge and commitment of landscape-management organisations.
Na decentralisatie van het landschapsbeheer is het aan de provincies om al dan niet gebruik te maken van de kennis en inzet van organisaties op het gebied van landschapsbeheer
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verkoop van medicijnen via internet (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about online sales of prescription medicines, including the reach of Netpharm's practices, the Inspectorate's stance, and possible bans on cross-border payments. Minister Schippers answered that illegal online medicine sales are a serious problem, that prescribing without meeting the patient is already prohibited, that the Inspectorate will investigate Netpharm, and that a separate criminal offence for unauthorised offering is proposed, while she considers a ban on cross-border payments unlikely to be feasible.
I will have the Inspectorate investigate the extent to which Netpharm has committed criminal acts.
Ik zal de IGZ laten onderzoeken in hoeverre sprake is van strafbare handelingen door Netpharm.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beperken van de vergoeding voor de diabetesmedicijnen byetta en victoza (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister why the reimbursement conditions for GLP-1 diabetes drugs were tightened, questioning whether patients combining them with insulin are harmed and whether this is a hidden cost cut. Minister Schippers replies that the combination with insulin lacked proven added value, the tightening takes effect 1 May 2011 with a transitional arrangement until 1 January 2012, and that the CVZ advice was not departed from.
There is no question of reversing it. I have decided that the tightening of the reimbursement conditions will take effect on 1 May 2011.
Van terugdraaien is geen sprake. Ik heb besloten om de aanscherping van de vergoedingsvoorwaarden te laten ingaan op 1 mei 2011.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de financiële problemen van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP from the SP asked the health minister about the financial problems of the Admiraal De Ruyter Hospital, including whether bankruptcy is threatened, the size of the deficit, the effects of the merger, staff consequences and continuity of care. The minister answered that no bankruptcy threat currently exists, declined to give merger costs and admission figures citing market sensitivity, refused to judge alleged mismanagement (leaving it to the supervisory board and works council), and said the IGZ monitors quality without reason yet for a directive.
This concerns detailed information about an individual healthcare institution. The information you requested is market-sensitive.
Het betreft hier gedetailleerde informatie over een individuele zorginstelling. De door u gevraagde informatie is marktgevoelig.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitzendkrachten op de ambulance (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether budget cuts in ambulance care are driving the use of temporary agency staff who may lack local knowledge, and about the numbers, recruitment, quality controls and responsibility for such staff. The minister denied a demonstrated link to the cuts, said agency numbers are not kept nationally, stated that staff must meet the same national training requirements, and said the Inspectorate will be asked to stay alert and report if further action is needed.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert in the coming period to signals from the field or the sector that may indicate substandard care or risks that norms and agreements are not being met.

Ik heb aan de IGZ gevraagd om in de komende periode extra alert te zijn op signalen uit het veld of de sector die kunnen wijzen op tekortschietende zorg of risico's dat normen en afspraken niet worden gehaald.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de manier waarop de Thuisapotheek klanten werft (Ingezonden 2 maart 2011).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the Thuisapotheek's call-centre staff pose as local pharmacy staff, know patients' medication without consent, and whether its telephone recruitment based on an internet survey is misleading and should be restricted. The minister says impersonation and unconsented use of medication data are unacceptable and the Inspectie will investigate, expects clearer consent practices, and sees no principled objection to telephone recruitment with explicit consent.
The Health Care Inspectorate will launch an investigation into this.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg zal een onderzoek hier naar instellen

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verplaatsen van het ziekenhuis Medische Centrum Alkmaar (MCA) van Alkmaar naar Heerhugowaard (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether relocating the Alkmaar hospital MCA to Heerhugowaard is desirable, whether emergency access and local interests are harmed, and whether the abolition of the building regime and competition motives played a role. The minister answered that RIVM modelling shows the 45-minute access norm is not endangered, that the relocation was driven by building-age and accessibility reasons, and that the minister lacks competence to block the move, while promising a future letter on continuity of essential care.
If in this case the 45-minute norm is no longer met, I can, on the basis of the WTZi instruments, force parties into further agreements.
Indien in het onderhavige geval de 45 minutennorm niet meer wordt gehaald kan ik op grond van het instrumentarium van de WTZi partijen tot nadere afspraken dwingen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over genderselectie (ingezonden 1 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the health and justice ministers about a businessman referring Dutch clients to a Antwerp clinic for sex selection, whether this is criminal in the Netherlands and Belgium, and whether the inspectorate and prosecutor will act. The minister replied that sex selection for non-medical reasons is prohibited under the Embryo Act, that the Public Prosecution Service found no grounds to prosecute in the Netherlands since the conduct seems to occur abroad, and that the Belgian inspectorate is investigating with Dutch cooperation.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AZM) om academische zorg af te stoten om financiële redenen. (ingezond

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the Maastricht academic hospital (AZM) may drop specialist clinical immunology for financial reasons, and whether the arrangement with the Utrecht and Nijmegen university medical centres was properly scrutinised. The minister replies that the AZM acted on qualitative grounds, that continuity of care is guaranteed, that the hospital boards and internal bodies are responsible for quality, and that no further ministerial intervention is planned.
It is not for me to have the plans of these hospitals regarding clinical immunology assessed.
Het is niet aan mij om de plannen van deze ziekenhuizen omtrent de klinische immunologie te (laten) toetsen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris voor Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de invoer van bont en uitvoering van de motie over verplichte etikettering (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation how the government would give consumers clarity on fur labelling, why the Gerkens motion on mandatory fur labelling had not been implemented, whether it would press Brussels, how much fur is imported, and how illegal fur (dog, cat, polar bear, seal) is controlled. The secretary answered that Dutch support for a mandatory EU labelling requirement is being pushed in Brussels but the Council has no majority so far, that import volumes of fur in finished garments are not registered, and that the nVWA inspects and samples fur products and found no dog or cat fur in 2010.
The requested information is not available: within the EU there is free movement of goods, so there is no visibility of trade flows from EU member states.
De gevraagde informatie is niet voorhanden: binnen de EU bestaat er vrij verkeer van goederen, daardoor is er geen zicht op handelsstromen vanuit EU-lidstaten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over particulier grondeigendom van de staatssecretaris (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he sold his privately owned land, which received nature subsidies, for one euro with a buyback clause, whether he disclosed this land on taking office, whether he played a role in the subsidy and whether his conduct creates an appearance of conflict of interest. The state secretary confirms the sale, says he disclosed nothing in the formation talks, had no role in the subsidy granted to his former wife's application by the ministry, and stands by his conduct.
No statements are made about the conversation with the informateur.
Uit het gesprek met de formateur worden geen mededelingen gedaan.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitspraken van mr. Van Vollenhoven over een onbetrouwbare overheid als het gaat om de plannen inzake natuuro

An SP MP asked the state secretary to respond to criticism by Van Vollenhoven that the government is unreliable on the Ecological Main Structure (EHS) and nature connections, including the realisation percentages and the handling of farmers' land purchases. The state secretary defended the scaled-back, re-evaluated EHS to be completed by 2018 under budget constraints, disputed the 50% figure as relating only to the original new-nature target, and said early clarity on reduced land acquisition is preferable.
Due to scarce available state funds, the cabinet has decided to complete the EHS in a re-evaluated form by 2018 in a feasible and affordable way.
In verband met schaarse beschikbare Rijksmiddelen heeft het kabinet besloten de EHS in herijkte vorm in 2018 haalbaar en betaalbaar af te ronden.
Vragen de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over personele gevolgen bij de invoering van de Wet ambulancezorg (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about staffing, collective agreement coverage, liability and response-time effects of introducing care ambulances (zorgambulances) and helper ambulances in The Hague. The minister answered that differentiated transport is acceptable, that the provider is responsible for staffing and liability, that the CAO question is being handled by sector parties, and that response-time impacts are not known.
I am not aware of any reports that preparedness is negatively affected by this.
Mij zijn geen berichten bekend dat de paraatheid hierdoor negatief wordt beïnvloed.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Zorg Groep Twente om de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te verplaatsen naar Hengel

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about Zorg Groep Twente's plan to move clinical maternity care from Almelo to Hengelo, including quality, travel times, the relation to hospital budget cuts and consolidation policy. The minister answered that no location decision has been made, that the plan is quality-driven rather than budget-driven, that the 45-minute access norm is not endangered, and that the Inspectorate will oversee a plan of action due in 2011.
With a possible concentration of clinical obstetric care in Hengelo, the 45-minute accessibility norm for acute care is not endangered.
Met een eventuele concentratie van de klinische verloskundige zorg in Hengelo komt de bereikbaarheidsnorm van 45 minuten voor acute zorg niet in gevaar.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rol van marktsturing in het besluit de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te schrappen (ingezonden 1

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether market considerations drove ZGT hospital's plan to concentrate clinical maternity care in Hengelo, and whether accessibility should weigh more heavily. The minister said concentration should not be pursued for its own sake, that hospitals must meet quality standards, and that a feasibility study with regional consultation is underway.
I am not in favour of concentration for the sake of concentration.
Ik ben geen voorstander van concentratie om de concentratie.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de bezoldiging van de Raad van Bestuur en de Raad van Toezicht bij Staatsbosbeheer (ingezonden 14 december 2010

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether the remuneration of the Staatsbosbeheer supervisory board and the top executive (reportedly above the Balkenende norm, and rising since 2007) is too high and should be reduced. The state secretary replies that the board fees fit the function and comparable organisations, that the director's salary of EUR 167,262 is within the Balkenende norm (the higher figure includes pension costs), that the rise reflects a part-year in 2007, and that no talks on lowering pay are opportune because the terms were agreed at appointment.
His salary in 2009 totalled EUR 167,262 and therefore does not exceed the Balkenende norm.
Zijn salaris bedroeg in het jaar 2009 in totaal € 167 262,= en overschrijdt daarmee niet de Balkenende-norm.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over internetapotheken (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether online pharmacies and Pfizer's ilivi website, which route repeat prescriptions online, breach the Medicines Act (art. 67) and whether the law should be tightened. The minister answers that the ilivi site refers patients to their own doctor and a legal pharmacy, that the Thuisapotheek may be accepted if it complies with the rules, and that a 2011 policy agenda on counterfeit medicines and an awareness campaign are planned.
If it turns out that any pharmacy does not comply with the legal rules, I will take measures.
Indien blijkt dat welke apotheek dan ook zich niet aan de wettelijke regels houdt, zal ik maatregelen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het beheer van zijn eigen natuurgebieden (ingezonden 25 januari 2011).

Opposition MP Van Gerven asked the state secretary to answer earlier questions on his personal interests in nature management, whether those interests are kept at a distance so conflicts of interest are excluded when agricultural nature-management proposals are made, and how many hectares and how much subsidy he received. The state secretary answered that management of his property has been placed at a distance and ownership transferred, describing 9.37 hectares of converted agricultural land with about 174,000 euros in subsidy from 2006, and said he will have no involvement in subsidy decisions during his term.
During my term of office, I will have no involvement in any subsidy decision.
Ik zal, gedurende mijn ambtstermijn, bij een eventuele subsidiehandeling, geen betrokkenheid hebben.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over preventie via de site gezondheidsrisicotest.nl (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about the gezondheidsrisicotest.nl preventive self-test, its scientific validity, the EUR 19.95 fee, its legality under the WBO, and the Prescan total-body scan. The minister said the Gezondheidsraad found the test unsuitable for the general population, that the test falls outside the WBO licensing rules and the IGZ agrees, and that research funding can be requested from ZonMw while refusing basic-package coverage until effectiveness is shown.
The risk test is therefore not subject to a licence requirement under the WBO. The IGZ supports this position.
De risicotest is dus niet vergunningplichtig conform de WBO. De IGZ steunt dit standpunt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over dioxine in diervoeders (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary whether dioxin-contaminated feed could reach the Netherlands, what measures followed the 1999 feed crisis, the sources of dioxin, enforcement on fat trade, and whether each batch of waste fats must be tested. The state secretary answered that no contaminated feed was known to have been delivered in the Netherlands, described the shift to company self-responsibility and nVWA risk-based inspection, and stated that the implicated Dutch trader acted in good faith and that testing per batch is the feed company's responsibility.
The nVWA conducts risk-based supervision. All feed companies (production and storage companies) are inspected at least once a year.
De nVWA houdt risicogebaseerd toezicht. Alle diervoederbedrijven (productiebedrijven en opslagbedrijven) worden jaarlijks minimaal één keer gecontroleerd.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het besluit van de provincie tot aanleg van de Oostvaarderswold ondanks het voornemen in het regeerakkoord deze

An SP MP asks the state secretary why the province of Flevoland proceeded with the Oostvaarderswold plan despite the coalition agreement's intention to drop it, and how the government will respond to affected farmers and possible legal disputes. The state secretary says the government keeps to the coalition agreement, has informed the province that land acquisitions after 20 October 2010 will not be reimbursed, and expects to reach agreement with the provinces on settling existing obligations.

I again informed the province of Flevoland by letter on 1 December that all legal obligations for land acquisition entered into by the province after 20 October 2010 will no longer be eligible for reimbursement by the central government.

Ik heb de provincie Flevoland op 1 december per brief er nogmaals van op de hoogte gesteld dat alle juridische verplichtingen voor verwerving van gronden die de provincie is aangegaan na 20 oktober 2010 niet meer voor vergoeding door het Rijk in aanmerking komen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van Penthotal bij euthanasie (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether Penthotal, used in euthanasia, should be reimbursed under the basic insurance package and whether it should be added to the drug reimbursement system. The minister apologised for the delay, said the drug should be treated as part of the insured euthanasia care, and planned to add it to the GVS after asking the CVZ for advice, expected in early 2011.
Because this drug is medically regarded as a generally accepted part of the euthanasia treatment, its use should be classed as part of the insured entitlement.

Omdat dit geneesmiddel in medische zin als een algemeen aanvaard onderdeel van de euthanasiebehandeling wordt gezien, dient deze toepassing ervan aangemerkt te worden als onderdeel van de verzekerde aanspraak.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitvoeren van onnodige operaties door artsen (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about large variation in treatment between doctors, whether it reflects care quality, its causes, how to reduce it, and whether hospital financing rewards unnecessary operations. The minister said variation is partly legitimate but unwanted when unexplained, placed primary responsibility on providers, pointed to transparency programmes, a planned quality institute and a move to DOT financing, and declined to institutionalise benchmarking herself.
I see an important role here for health insurers but also for the doctors and hospital organisations themselves.
Ik zie hier een belangrijke rol voor de zorgverzekeraars maar ook voor de medici en ziekenhuisorganisaties zelf.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vertrek van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van HWW-Zorg (ingezonden 6 januari 2011).

SP MPs asked the state secretary for health about the sudden departure of the chair of HWW-Zorg's board, including whether he waived a departure bonus and what he earned in 2010. The state secretary answered that the departure was the board member's own decision for which she is not responsible, that 2010 income will appear in the annual report in mid-2011, and that she would answer before the scheduled debate.
However, it is a decision of the board member himself, for which I am not responsible.
Echter het is een beslissing van de bestuurder zelf, waarvoor ik niet verantwoordelijk ben.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Rijnland Ziekenhuis de operatiekamers uit Alphen aan den Rijn wil wegbezuinigen (ingezonden 26 november 20

An SP MP asks the health minister whether Rijnland Hospital will close operating theatres in Alphen aan den Rijn and how this relates to imposed budget cuts. The minister answers that the hospital has its own reasons (costly temporary staff), that access within 45 minutes is not endangered, and that the 549 million cut was reduced to 314 million.
I have no opinion on the internal business operations of a hospital.
Ik heb geen oordeel over de interne bedrijfsvoering van een ziekenhuis.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van kleine biologische proefboerderijen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister whether Wageningen UR is closing small organic experimental farms, whether subsidies fund a 'megastal' (Dairy Valley) at Goutum, and about cows, feed transport, subsidies and whether the farms could be moved to an independent foundation. The minister answered that Wageningen UR manages its own research facilities, that the ministry funds research programmes rather than facilities, that Goutum is a research location and not a megastal, and that operations are for Wageningen UR and DLO to decide, so no independent foundation is planned.
I do not decide on the operational management of Wageningen UR.
Ik ga niet over de bedrijfsvoering van de Wageningen UR.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het sluiten van kleine biologische proefboerderijen (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the Spelderholt experimental farm, partly financed by EU subsidy, may be closed early and whether the rules are being circumvented by keeping it on paper. The minister answers that the subsidy conditions (maintaining the project until 1 July 2009 and cooperating with publicity until 1 January 2010) have been met, so no repayment or rule evasion is involved.
Wageningen UR has met both conditions.
Aan beide voorwaarden heeft Wageningen UR voldaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een mogelijke ziekenhuisfusie in Oost-Groningen (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister for her view on a proposed merger of Refaja hospital and the Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groep, whether evaluations of past hospital mergers exist, whether a temporary merger moratorium will be declared, and whether a merger would preserve care provision. The minister said the merger is a matter for the hospitals and insurers, noted the Delfzijl emergency department is needed for 45-minute access, said no evaluation exists, pointed to a stricter merger policy with a care-specific merger test, and offered to propose more small-scale care in March 2011.
No, I do not have an evaluation of hospital mergers of recent years and I do not intend to conduct further research into this.
Nee, ik beschik niet over een evaluatie van ziekenhuisfusies van de afgelopen jaren en ben niet voornemens om hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de griepvaccinatie (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Van Gerven asked the health minister for her view on a Zembla broadcast questioning flu vaccine effectiveness, whether double-blind trials are feasible, whether a new trial will be commissioned, and about Health Council conflicts of interest and death registration. The minister disagreed with the broadcast, argued double-blind trials with mortality outcomes are impractical, refused a new trial citing existing studies, and defended current evaluation and communication practices.
No. It is and was known that the current flu vaccine does not fully protect.
Nee. Het is en was bekend dat het huidige griepvaccin niet volledig beschermt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ICT-perikelen van het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AZM) (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about cost overruns in the AZM hospital's ICT renewal, its high-earning board, the dismissal of the ICT head, and whether financial pressures threaten care quality and academic functions. The minister repeatedly declined to judge individual hospital spending, pointing to the supervisory board, annual report, works council and insurers as the correcting mechanisms, while promising a future salary-cap law.
It would go too far to set specific rules from The Hague for these kinds of situations.
Het zou te ver gaan om vanuit Den Haag specifieke regels te bepalen over dit soort situaties.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende ontmanteling van de afdeling immunologie (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister whether the Maastricht academic hospital (AZM) plans to shed clinical immunology and interstitial lung disease, whether patients will have to travel to Groningen, and whether finances are the reason. The minister replies that no decision has been taken, that only two highly specialised conditions with few patients are under review on quality grounds, that the AZM will consult the minister and the NFU before deciding, and that the outstanding motion on financing academic centres is still being implemented.
There is not yet a decision.
Er is nog geen sprake van een besluit.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman , Van Gerven en Smits (allen SP) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen e

Three SP MPs asked ministers about reports that ADHD diagnoses and methylphenidate use have roughly doubled in five years, and whether overdiagnosis, medication without therapy, teacher support, class size and pharmaceutical industry influence are problems. The government confirmed the strong growth in prescriptions, referred to earlier answers on diagnosis, said no signals of medication without therapy exist, and declined to commission studies on pharmaceutical industry influence, citing existing checks.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraar UVIT (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister whether insurer UVIT's preferential purchasing policy for biological and biosimilar drugs (epo, somatropin, filgrastim) is lawful, safe for patients, and transparent given its undisclosed (onder couvert) tendering. Minister Schippers answered that such policy is permitted, that biosimilars are equivalent in efficacy and safety, that off-label and substitution rules are for doctors and pharmacists, and that she sees no need to end the couvert system, while the question-by-question replies remain largely substantive and reassuring.
Ending the preferential policy under couvert would undo its favourable effects for patients and for competition between health insurers.
Het beëindigen van het preferentiebeleid onder couvert zou de gunstige effecten daarvan voor de patiënten en de concurrentieverhoudingen tussen zorgverzekeraars te niet doen.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kwaliteitsnormen voor borstkankerzorg (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether multiple competing quality-norm lists for breast cancer care (from CZ, the patient association and specialists) are desirable, which norms patients should follow, whether CZ acted carefully in contracting hospitals, and whether scientific norms should be the sole standard. The minister answered that quality norms are the responsibility of providers and professional groups, that insurers may set contracting criteria, that patients choose providers, and that CZ's list was revised after hospital checks, though it may have caused confusion.
Care providers are primarily responsible themselves for determining what good and responsible care is.
Zorgaanbieders zijn in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen wat goede en verantwoorde zorg is.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de betrokkenheid van het ministerie bij de benoeming van Professor Vierhout tot directeur van de ziekenhuiz

SP MPs asked the health minister whether her ministry, former minister Klink and a Zeeland deputy were involved in the appointment of Professor Vierhout as chair of the Admiraal de Ruyter hospital board, and about the cost of his advice and the Walcheren hospital.
