The minister denied any ministerial involvement, called the appointment a matter for the hospital itself, and promised a letter on Zeeland hospital care in early December 2010.
There has been no involvement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport in the appointment of Professor Vierhout as chair of the Board of Directors of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital (ADRZ).

Er is geen sprake geweest van betrokkenheid van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport bij de benoeming van professor Vierhout tot voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis (ADRZ).

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het experiment met de SOS-arts dat per 1 januari 2011 van start gaat (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about the SOS-arts home-visit experiment starting in 2011 with fees above the regulated GP maximum, questioning its legality, the doctors' qualifications, and whether it creates a two-tier system. The minister answered that the NZa authorised the small-scale experiment under its innovation policy, that qualified GPs work under IGZ quality oversight, and that data will be collected to evaluate price and quality.
I want to ask the NZa to also collect data on this during the experiment, so that once the experimental phase has ended a sound judgement can be made about the price/quality ratio.

Ik wil de NZa vragen om ook tijdens het experiment gegevens hierover te verzamelen, zodat wanneer de experimenteerfase is afgelopen er een gedegen uitspraak kan worden gedaan over de prijs/kwaliteit verhouding.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verkoop van geneesmiddelen via internet (ingezonden 25 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about poor over-the-counter medicine advice in drugstores and pharmacies, whether internet sales of OTC and prescription medicines like tramadol should be restricted, and about inspection and enforcement. The minister acknowledges weak advice, says the cash-register check is not mandatory, sees no need for a study of drugstore websites, and says the inspectorate acts where it can, including border checks.
Sale of prescription medicines other than through internet sites meeting the applicable requirements is, unlike the sale of AV and UAD medicines, in my view a major risk to public health.

7 Antwoord 8 Verkoop van UR geneesmiddelen anders dan via internetsites die aan de hiervoor geldende eisen 8 voldoen, acht ik, in tegenstelling tot de verkoop van AV en UAD middelen, een groot risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de negatieve effecten van Indiaas OK-personeel (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about burdens on surgeons, language and cultural problems, costs and quality of care linked to Indian operating-theatre assistants recruited by Dutch hospitals, and whether recruitment should be banned as neocolonial. The minister replied that hospitals do not see major problems, that extra training is time rather than money, that hospitals follow the mandatory collective agreement, that quality is the boards' responsibility overseen by the IGZ, and that she sees no reason for a ban, relying on the WHO code and a planned training fund.
I see no reason to prohibit the recruitment of Indian operating-theatre assistants.
Ik zie geen reden om het werven van Indiase ok-assistenten te verbieden.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over voorkruipzorg in het Groene Hart Ziekenhuis in Gouda (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the minister about priority-access arrangements (voorkruipzorg) at Groene Hart Ziekenhuis via Groene Hart Extra Zorg, including possible breaches of the Wmg, equal access under international human rights treaties, and ratification of the VRMB. The minister denied that the hospital had started business-club arrangements, said the plans were not yet submitted to the NZa, argued the arrangements are not discriminatory or in breach of the Wmg, and said the VRMB bill is nearly ready but awaits policy on minors' research.
The approval bill can therefore only be sent to the Council of State once the position on the Doek Committee's advice is ready.
Het goedkeuringswetsvoorstel zal dan ook pas aan de Raad van State gezonden kunnen worden, nadat het standpunt op het advies van de Commissie Doek gereed is.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het conflict tussen de staatssecretaris en de provincie Flevoland aangaande de

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about his decision to drop the Oostvaarderswold nature link and sell state nature land, including the lack of consultation, impact assessment, land figures, costs and the effects on large grazers. The state secretary confirmed the decision follows the coalition agreement, admitted no impact assessment was done, gave land and cost figures, and said further consultation and an EHS review will follow, with a grazers advisory report due 1 November 2010.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hernieuwde poging een zelftest voor darmkanker op de Nederlandse markt te brengen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a Belgian-website self-test for colorectal cancer marketed in the Netherlands, its reliability, costs of false results, legal status, and the timing of a national screening programme. The minister answers that FOB self-tests are already sold, that CE-marking and a channelling rule govern them, that EU enforcement is hard, and that a national screening decision awaits a RIVM feasibility study expected at year end.
I expect this report at the end of the year.
Ik verwacht dit rapport aan het einde van het jaar.

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en Gesthuizen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over het opleggen van een boete door de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit

SP MPs asked the ministers of Health and Economic Affairs about the NMa fining the LHV for a broken seal on a room, and whether they would intervene and commission research into market competition in GP care. The ministers answered that the NMa is an independent regulator, the fine is for the courts and the LHV to contest, and that competition rules protect patient choice and quality, with the NMa currently investigating the GP sector.
This concerns an individual case in which the NMa, as an independent regulator, has discretionary power to seal premises and impose a fine when a seal is broken.

Het betreft hier een individuele zaak, waarin de NMa als onafhankelijke toezichthouder de discretionaire bevoegdheid heeft om ruimtes te verzegelen en om een boete op te leggen wanneer een verzegeling verbroken is.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten dat de minister van VWS een salaris van 285.000 euro voor vrij gevestigde specialisten als maximum salaris aanvaa

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a 285,000 euro maximum salary for self-employed medical specialists, above the Balkenende norm, is acceptable, and why the Balkenende norm is not applied. The minister answered that no decision has been taken on maximum or minimum incomes, that the specialist remains responsible for medical content, and that the income policy would need separate legislation.
I have not taken a decision on the level of the average or on a maximum or minimum income for medical specialists.
Ik heb geen besluit genomen over de hoogte van het gemiddelde of over een maximum- of minimuminkomen voor de medisch specialisten.
Vragen van het lid van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de weigering inzage te geven in een Inspectierapport (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

SP MP van Gerven asks the health minister why a freedom-of-information request for documents on the Inspectorate's handling of a neurologist case was refused, and why the report on the Inspectorate's own conduct is not public. The minister says the criminal investigation justified withholding nearly all documents, points to the public report and later independent studies already sent to parliament, and rejects the claim that the government has something to hide.

Given the ongoing criminal investigation into neurologist J.S., following the Public Prosecution Service's view it was judged that the interest of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences must prevail over the general interest of disclosure.

Gelet op het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar neuroloog J.S. is naar aanleiding van de zienswijze van het OM geoordeeld dat het belang van opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten in dit geval dient te prevaleren boven het algemene belang van openbaarmaking
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over I&R-gewetensbezwaarden (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

An SP MP asks the agriculture minister why conscientious objectors to cattle identification and registration (I&R) are having agri-environment subsidies cut, whether this breaches the protocol, and whether alternative DNA/photo identification and tolerance can be pursued with the European Commission. The minister answers that EU rules require cross-compliance cuts, the protocol only shields objectors from prosecution, the 2009 cut was 20% rather than an increase, the Commission offers no room, and DNA/photo identification is not logistically or EU-acceptable.
No, there is no question of a breach of the implementation protocol.
Nee, er is geen sprake van een schending van het uitvoeringsprotocol
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berisping van de internetapotheek door het Medisch Tuchtcollege (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a Medical Disciplinary Board reprimand of an internet pharmacy selling prescription drugs without valid Dutch prescriptions, and why the site dokteronline.com remained operational despite earlier promises. The minister replied that the pharmacy had stopped the practice after an enforcement order, that existing laws suffice, that the Geneesmiddelenwet omission is being fixed in a pending bill, and that foreign-operated sites are hard to reach across EU borders.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sponsoring patiëntenorganisaties (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about industry sponsorship of patient organisations, including transparency gaps and whether conflicts of interest are excluded, and asked for an overview of sponsorship levels and tighter rules. The minister answered that existing safeguards (subsidy rules, industry codes, audits) are adequate, promised to advise the EMA on HAI's recommendations and to review CBG practice, and said the subsidy scheme would be evaluated.
However, I cannot provide you with a complete overview.
Een compleet overzicht kan ik u echter niet verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onduidelijke eigen bijdragen bij ziekenhuisverblijf (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister why hospitals charge different rates for TV and telephone, whether profits are made, and whether such costs should be covered by health insurance. The minister answered that these are optional extras not part of medical care, that hospitals are free to offer them, and that transparency and client council consultation should be ensured, but declined to regulate tariffs or change the insurance law.
Whether hospitals make profit on these services and how much money is involved nationally is not known to me.
Of ziekenhuizen op deze diensten winst maken en hoeveel geld hier landelijk mee omgaat, is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Irrgang (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit, van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over speculatie in landbouwgewassen (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether speculation caused the 2008 food price spike, how the World Bank report and the energy-food price link should be read, and what action will curb speculation in agricultural commodities such as cocoa. The government answered that the evidence on speculation is inconclusive, that fundamental market factors dominate, and that it will examine how to improve market functioning and price transparency with international partners.
The cabinet is examining, together with international partners, how market functioning can be improved.
Het kabinet onderzoekt, samen met de internationale partners, hoe de marktwerking kan worden verbeterd.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas OK-personeel door de Tergooiziekenhuizen (ingezon

SP MPs asked the ministers whether hospitals recruiting operating-theatre assistants in India for cost savings was acceptable, whether it breached government policy, and what the status was of the WHO code, the sector consultation and a training fund. The minister answered that cost savings were doubtful, that recruitment from outside the EU should be a last resort, that the WHO code is non-binding and that no mandatory Dutch code will be introduced.
I see no reason to move towards drafting a binding Dutch code for recruiting care staff from developing countries outside the EU.
Ik zie geen reden om over te gaan tot het opstellen van een verplichtende Nederlandse code voor de werving van zorgpersoneel in ontwikkelingslanden buiten de EU.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas personeel door het Refaja ziekenhuis en het Sint

SP MPs asked why two Dutch hospitals (Refaja and Sint Jans Gasthuis) recruited Indian operating-theatre assistants, whether this conflicts with the cabinet's stance that recruiting non-EU care staff should be a last resort, and whether the WHO code can prevent such recruitment. The minister answers that the hospitals acted within the knowledge-migrant scheme after domestic and EU recruitment failed, that the recruitment was ethical and circular, and that the government will explore intensifying recruitment in other EU member states.
I will examine together with industry organisations which options for intensifying the recruitment of care staff in other EU member states are possible.
Ik zal samen met brancheorganisaties bekijken welke opties voor het intensiveren van werving van zorgpersoneel in andere EU-lidstaten mogelijk zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en sport over psychofarmaca en kinderen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about a Danish study on adverse reactions to psychotropic drugs in children, rising psychotropic use in the Netherlands, Dutch adverse-event reports, prenatal SSRI risks, and whether independent research or new monitoring is warranted. The minister answers that the Danish study cannot be compared to Dutch data, that the CBG monitors all registered drugs continuously, and that no separate independent study is currently planned.
Setting up specific studies on adverse effects is not the government's task, but the outcomes of studies are of course closely monitored by the registration authorities.

Het opzetten van specifieke onderzoeken naar bijwerkingen is niet de taak van de overheid, maar de uitkomsten van onderzoeken worden uiteraard nauwgezet in de gaten gehouden door de registratie autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de RIVM analyse Noord-Oost Groningen (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister why the RIVM analysis of Noord-Oost Groningen considered only Groningen residents, why it differs from earlier studies, and what closing one or two hospitals would mean for the 45-minute emergency access norm and related system effects. Minister Klink answered that the analysis crossed provincial borders, that the model is an update of earlier work with newer data, that closing one emergency department would still meet the norm, and that hospital financing (beschikbaarheidstoeslag) will be decided by the NZa after a cost study.
I cannot tell you now which hospitals will and will not qualify.
Ik kan u nu niet zeggen welke ziekenhuizen wel en niet in aanmerking komen.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jansen (beiden SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over visserij in de Voordelta (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why intensive fishing (mussel seed and cockle fishing, beam trawling) in the Voordelta Natura 2000 area, possibly in the seabed protection zone near rest areas, is compatible with a 20,000 ha nature reserve compensating for Maasvlakte 2. The Minister replied that the fishing is licensed or exempt under the management plan, that no displacement or increase has occurred, that no unlicensed fishing was found, and that beam trawling above 260 hp outside the protection zone is not yet licensed, with an appropriate assessment under way.
An appropriate assessment is currently being drawn up, in consultation with the fishing sector and nature organisations, for the existing beam trawl fishery in the Voordelta.
Momenteel wordt in overleg met de visserijsector en natuurorganisaties een passende beoordeling opgesteld voor de bestaande boomkorvisserij in de Voordelta.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kleine zorginstellingen voor verstandelijk gehandicapten en psychiatrische patiënten die failliet dreigen t

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether small care farms serving people with intellectual disabilities and psychiatric patients risk bankruptcy due to the temporary national stop on new persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) allocations, and how many farms are affected. The minister replied that the farm in question was already in financial difficulty before the stop, that no farm is known to have failed because of the pgb measures, and that the affected group is mainly new potential pgb holders who can be placed through other financing routes.
To my knowledge, no care farm has yet got into trouble because of the pgb problems.
Bij mijn weten is er nog geen zorgboerderij door de pgb-perikelen in de problemen gekomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het innen van de bestuursrechtelijke zorgpremie bij onderbewindgestelden (ingezonden 8 jul

SP MPs asked the health and justice ministers about the 130% administrative health insurance premium imposed on debtors, including a 76-year-old dementia patient under guardianship whose debts were pursued by a bailiff and split into multiple claims. Minister Klink defended the premium as an incentive, said guardians should pay premiums, rejected separate treatment of guardianship cases, and pointed to a planned statutory cap on collection costs and a complaint to the disciplinary court against the bailiff's office.
The CVZ will still refund the 100% premium withheld from the AOW pension and the collection of the remaining 30% will be stopped.
Het CVZ zal de op het AOW-pensioen ingehouden 100%-premie alsnog restitueren en de incasso van de resterende 30% zal worden stopgezet.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hogere risico op overlijden bij spoedopname in het weekend en sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a UK study finding higher mortality for weekend emergency admissions, whether the findings apply to the Netherlands, and whether hospitals' uncorrected mortality figures were scientifically valid. The minister said extrapolation to the Netherlands requires caution, pointed to IGZ-commissioned RIVM and TNO research due in 2011, and defended publication of the uncorrected figures alongside explanatory text while promising corrected figures in 2011.
As soon as the research results are available I will inform you.
Zo gauw de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn informeer ik u.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het dreigend overschot aan dialysecentra (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the removal of the planning system for dialysis centres in 2002 caused a doubling of centres and threatens quality and home dialysis. The minister says the 2002 deregulation was not driven by market forces, that centre numbers were not a set target, and that quality is assured by ex-post review and insurers, declining to commission new research.
Guarantees in advance, with a few exceptions, cannot therefore be given either.
Garanties vooraf zijn op een enkele uitzondering na dus ook niet te geven.

Vragen van de leden Ouwehand (PvdD), El Fassed en Peters (beiden Groen Links) en Van Gerven (SP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de rechtmatigheid van het proces t

MPs asked the government how it followed the trial of two Greenpeace activists in Japan, whether it would press Japan on fair process, and why it judged no breach of international treaties, despite UN criticism. The minister replied that the embassy follows the case, that the government does not interfere in another country's internal legal process, and that the UN findings do not justify discrediting the proceedings.
I will raise their situation in the run-up to the next EU human rights dialogue with Japan.
Ik zal hun situatie in de aanloop naar de volgende EU-mensenrechtendialoog met Japan doen op brengen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de belangenverstrengeling bij de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) rondom de Mexicaanse griep (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the Netherlands was aware of the WHO's acknowledgement of conflicts of interest around the H1N1 pandemic, including experts advising the WHO who were also on payroll of vaccine producers, and what steps would prevent this. The minister answered that the WHO Director-General denies commercial interests played a role, that an evaluation by a Review Committee is underway, that the Netherlands will press for stricter rules via WHO channels if needed, and that transparency about adviser ties to industry should be promoted.
I assumed that the WHO works with adequate procedures to prevent conflicts of interest.
Ik ben ervan uitgegaan dat de WHO werkt met toereikende procedures om belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een keten van commerciële gezondheidscentra in eigendom van een zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the minister about Menzis's joint venture with investment firm Reggeborgh to run a chain of health centres, including profit distribution limits, whether investor and insurer co-ownership is desirable, and risks to care quality and GP independence from vertical integration. Minister Klink says he has no objection to investor co-ownership, describes the shareholder agreement's five-year no-dividend rule and conditions, and states that the existing supervisory framework (NZa, IGZ, NMa) is adequate, asking the NZa only to proactively monitor GP referral independence.
I have no reason to assume that the supervisory framework described above is inadequate or not properly applied to prevent or correct negative effects of vertical integration.

Ik heb geen reden aan te nemen dat het hiervoor beschreven toezichtskader niet toereikend is, of niet adequaat wordt toegepast, om negatieve effecten van verticale integratie te voorkomen of corrigeren.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt en Van Gerven (beide SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over ontslagen bij MSD in Oss (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would use their influence to prevent or limit job losses at MSD in Oss, meet the company, disclose costs of public support, and intervene with US authorities. The minister replied that government will not intervene in the company's strategic decision, that talks and two working groups are underway to preserve jobs, that cost details of public support are partly confidential, and that the minister has been in contact with MSD leadership including the US CEO.
The government neither wants nor can intervene in the company's strategic decision on the planned efficiency drive, including the sharp downsizing of the Oss site.
De overheid wil en kan niet treden in de strategische beslissing van het bedrijf over de voorgenomen efficiencyslag, waaronder de sterke afslanking van het bedrijf in Oss.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de start van SOS-arts (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether SOS-arts, which started home visits for Maetis on 1 June 2010 without an NZa tariff, substitutes for GP care, breaches the Marijnissen motion on non-medical queue-jumping, and endangers equal access to care. The minister replied that the initiative may operate as an innovative choice-enhancing provider, that the NZa has asked for documentation to assess it, and that the NZa could intervene if access worsens.

Following the new situation, in which SOS-arts has an agreement with occupational health service Maetis, the NZa has asked the parties involved for documentation in order to assess SOS-arts' services.

Naar aanleiding van de nieuwe situatie, waarbij de SOS-arts een overeenkomst heeft met arbodienst Maetis, heeft de NZa de betrokken partijen om documentatie gevraagd om de diensten van de SOS-arts te kunnen beoordelen.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over illegale praktijken in de gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports of task-shifting in hospitals where nurse specialists treated patients and hospitals billed the top DBC rate, whether this should be seen as fraud, why the NZa and IGZ did not act, and whether whistleblower rules and a broader investigation are needed. The minister replied that supervised task-shifting is not illegal fraud, that the NZa intervenes mainly on structural or consumer-interest violations, that a whistleblower scheme was added to the governance code with a review before any statute, and that no separate investigation is planned beyond a monitoring study linked to a pending bill.
Under the legislation the NZa supervises compliance with the billing rules, including the declaration provisions.
Vanuit de wet- en regelgeving ziet de NZa toe op de handhaving van de naleving van de bekostigingsregels, waaronder de declaratiebepalingen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een negatief advies van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg met betrekking tot de aanvraag van het Admiraa

SP MPs asked the minister whether the Inspectorate for Health Care gave a negative opinion on Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's application to perform cardiac catheterisation at Goes, why the advice is not published, and whether the minister will implement a unanimously adopted motion limiting Zeeland to one such centre. The minister confirmed the negative advice, declined to publish it citing detailed information about the hospital and staff, and said an independent third party will be commissioned to examine patient flows before a final decision, with the Chamber to be informed.
The advice contains detailed information about the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital and about persons working there.
Het advies bevat gedetailleerde informatie over het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis en over personen die daar werkzaam zijn.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het dottercentrum in Goes (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about claims that the NMa made a cardiac catheterisation (dotter) centre in Goes a condition of the Ziekenhuis Walcheren/Oosterscheldeziekenhuizen merger, whether the centre can start immediately once licensed, and how the minister will implement the unanimously adopted motion for one shared dotter centre in Zeeland. The minister confirmed the NMa conditions were based on IGZ advice, explained that the NMa left partner and location choices to the hospital, said IGZ found the hospital did not yet meet all licence conditions, and announced an independent review of patient numbers before deciding.
I cannot assess within what period the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital will be able to meet all the conditions.
Ik kan niet beoordelen binnen welke termijn het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis in staat is aan alle voorwaarden te voldoen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en De Roos (allen SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over inkomens boven de Balkenendenorm van bestuurders in de zorg (ingezonden 7 juni 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital and mental health directors earning above the Balkenende norm, including interim directors at Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis and a crisis manager and departing director at GGZ Delfland, and what can be done. The minister said interim pay should follow the BBZ code (which took effect after the appointments), declined to precisely calculate the salary component and referred to earlier answers, deferred 2010 salary data to the annual report, and said supervisory boards must act lawfully on departures.
That is why I also find the approach of the BBZ appealing, which I referred to in my answer to question 2.
Daarom spreekt mij ook de benadering van de BBZ zo aan waar ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 aan refereerde.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het inschakelen van tandartsassistenten die verdoven, wort

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether dental assistants with short training perform invasive procedures such as anaesthesia, root canal treatment, drilling and filling, and about related dental-care oversight, capacity and quality issues. The minister said such delegation is lawful under strict conditions, that the Inspectorate may review its circular, and that the Inspectorate's oversight capacity and training capacity questions will be addressed in a forthcoming cabinet response.
I will therefore consult with the Inspectorate to examine whether its aforementioned circular needs tightening.
Om die reden zal ik in overleg met de Inspectie nagaan of haar voornoemde circulaire aanscherping behoeft.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontmanteling van het ziekenhuis in Vlissingen door het bestuur van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (in

MPs Van Gerven and De Roos (SP) asked the health minister about the downsizing of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital in Vlissingen, including bed cuts, job losses, specialist disagreements, emergency care criteria, whether financial motives drove the plans, and a delayed decision on cardiac dilation permits. The minister largely defended the hospital's plans as a relocation of functions, said the Gezondheidsraad advice was not needed before acting, and promised an independent review before deciding on the permit.
Before taking a final decision on the permit application of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital, I want to have some questions examined further.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorgverzekeraars die hun zorgplicht niet nakomen (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

Dutch MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about a pharmacy fraud complaint by insurer UVIT, the pharmacists' criticism of insurers not meeting their duty of care, and the links to preferential drug policy and a motion on administrative burdens. The minister declined to comment on the substance while UVIT's investigation is ongoing, said preferential policy does not affect prescribing and that no general conclusions can be drawn, and pointed to ongoing consultation (Commissie Alders) as the basis for the motion response.
I cannot and will not respond now that the facts are not established and it is primarily a matter between insurer UVIT and the pharmacists who claim from UVIT.
Ik kan en wil geen reactie geven nu het feitencomplex niet vaststaat en het primair een aangelegenheid betreft tussen zorgverzekeraar UVIT en de desbetreffende apothekers die declareren bij UVIT.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitwijken van honderden Lymepatiënten naar het buitenland uit onvrede over de medische hulp in Nederland (ingezonden 26 ap

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views hundreds of Lyme patients going abroad to Germany and Slovakia out of dissatisfaction with Dutch medical care, and about the treatment controversy and whether current diagnostics and treatment adequately address the rise in infected ticks. The minister regrets patients feel poorly treated, leaves treatment judgments to the professional groups, points to a forthcoming guideline and a ZonMW-funded antibiotic duration study, and announces an expert meeting by RIVM before summer.
I regret that people in the Netherlands do not feel adequately treated and feel compelled to seek care outside the Netherlands.
Ik betreur het dat mensen zich in Nederland niet adequaat behandeld voelen en zich genoodzaakt voelen zorg buiten Nederland te zoeken.

SP MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the NMa's raid on the LHV, the scope of competition law in GP care, and whether it hampers care chains. The ministers answered that the NMa acts independently under the Mededingingswet, that cooperation is generally allowed while market-sharing and price agreements are not, and that the raid does not harm chain-care development.
The NMa decides independently to carry out a raid.
De NMa besluit zelfstandig tot een inval.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het weigeren van een patiënte door huisartsen uit Drunen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about GP practices in Drunen refusing a patient, the role of insurer CZ, the NZa and the Inspectorate. The minister answers that the KNMG guideline requires continued necessary care until another provider is found, that the insurer's duty is limited to mediation and enforcing treatment is a private matter, and that the NZa and IGZ have supervisory roles.
Enforcing the provision of care by the GP is, however, a (private law) matter between the patient and the doctor and ultimately not one for the health insurer.
Het afdwingen van zorgleverantie door de huisarts is echter een (privaatrechtelijke) zaak tussen de patiënt en de arts en uiteindelijk dus niet van de zorgverzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het openen van filialen door het Oogziekenhuis Rotterdam (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister how the Oogziekenhuis Rotterdam's plan to open 20 franchise branches in other hospitals squares with the rules banning profit-making in hospital care, including what the franchise fees amount to, where any surplus goes, and whether staff could benefit personally. The minister answered that hospitals decide their own activities under the budget system, that the Oogziekenhuis is a non-profit foundation so profit distribution is excluded, and that the Nza could only judge once the franchise structure is known.
It is up to the hospitals that want to run the franchise and the Oogziekenhuis to assess whether the franchise, its benefits and costs fit within the goals and conditions of their own organisation.

Het is dus aan de ziekenhuizen die de franchise willen voeren en het Oogziekenhuis om te beoordelen of de franchise, de baten en kosten daarvan passen binnen de doelen en randvoorwaarden van de eigen organisatie.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sluikreclame/informatie gericht op kinderen (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister about covert advertising for ADHD drug Concerta aimed at children, including school talk texts and a brochure, and whether such marketing should be treated as banned covert advertising. The minister says the supervisory bodies (IGZ, CGR, KOAG/KAG) will assess the activities under their agreements, that informational health content is permitted if not linked to a medicine, and that the boundary is hard to draw, so clearer rules are being discussed.

Ik heb kennis genomen van deze activiteiten in opdracht van Janssen-Cilag. De beoordeling of deze activiteiten binnen de wet- en regelgeving t.a.v. dit onderwerp vallen laat ik aan de toezichthoudende instellingen

requests the cabinet to move the Dutch embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem as soon as possible

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat een Hamas-fan die betrokken was bij de terreuraanval van 7 oktober opduikt bij een pro-Palestijnse sit-in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked why a man who filmed the 7 October 2023 attack and praised Hamas could enter the Netherlands and attend a pro-Palestinian sit-in, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers from Islamic countries. The government said it will legislate against glorifying terrorism, will not comment on individual cases, gave no exact figures on Hamas supporters, and refused to close borders by origin, citing non-discrimination law.
The cabinet makes no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raijer en Wilders over het artikel 'gemeente zet stappen tegen moslimdiscriminatie met nieuw actieplan: 'Genoeg is genoeg''

MPs Raijer and Wilders asked whether the state will ban a Den Haag action plan's teaching materials on Islamic heritage and mosque visits, investigate their funders including foreign ones, and close Islamic schools. The State Secretary refused all demands, citing constitutional education freedom under Article 23, said no signals of non-neutral teaching exist, and pointed to the Justice Ministry for foreign interference reporting.
No. Article 23 of the Constitution protects the right to educational freedom and, more specifically, the free choice of teaching materials.
Nee. Artikel 23 van de Grondwet beschermt het recht op onderwijsvrijheid en – meer specifiek – de vrije keuze der leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lammers en Wilders over het bericht ‘Verbijstering om plan voor ’melk en dadels’ op Amsterdamse stembureaus tijdens ramadan: ’Waanzin’’

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a DENK proposal to offer dates and milk at Amsterdam polling stations during Ramadan, endorsed by the mayor as a 'creative solution', breaches election neutrality. The minister answered that municipalities organise elections and may find creative solutions within the Electoral Act, that voters can vote any time from 7:30 to 21:00, and that no additional facilities are required.
Municipalities are free to devise creative solutions to possible staffing problems, within the framework of the Electoral Act.
Het staat gemeenten vrij om creatieve oplossingen te verzinnen voor mogelijke bezettingsproblemen, binnen de kaders van de Kieswet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat een Joods echtpaar met jonge kinderen in de omgeving van Arnhem is afgeperst door een crimineel die eerder optrad als kroongetuige in moordza

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that a Jewish family near Arnhem was extorted by a former crown witness, demanding action against the perpetrators, passport revocation and the minister's contact with the victims. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the antisemitism strategy, said passport revocation is limited by statute, and said assessing crown witness credibility is for the courts.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in individuele zaken te treden.
Antwoord op de leden Boon en Wilders over het voornemen van de HZ Omer Moskee in Epe om vanaf 20 juni 2025 wekelijks een islamitische gebedsoproep te laten horen

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the government would act against a mosque in Epe broadcasting a weekly Islamic call to prayer and whether it would ban such calls nationally. The Interior Minister answered that the freedom of religion protects calls to prayer, that local authorities set noise rules under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that the government is examining whether the rules need changing, with a report to parliament to follow.
The cabinet is examining whether the existing regulations need to be adjusted.
Het kabinet onderzoekt of de bestaande regelgeving aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over de schriftelijke vragen van 18 april 2025 (2025Z07899) over Mohammed B

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice why their April 2025 written questions about Mohammed B., released and present at a sit-in, were answered only after 102 days, and urged his prosecution and immediate serving of his suspended sentence. The minister said answers were delayed by coordination with chain partners, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that the cabinet plans to criminalise support for terrorist organisations, and that antisemitism is addressed through a broader strategy.
The answering of the parliamentary questions was delayed because coordination with various (chain) partners was necessary.
De beantwoording van de Kamervragen is vertraagd doordat er afstemming nodig was met verschillende (keten)partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over dat visumvrij reizen voor Turken wordt versoepeld

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether visa rules for Turkish citizens were being loosened and whether this could bring millions of Turks to the Netherlands. Minister Brekelmans answered that the change only adjusts the Schengen cascade model for repeat, bona fide travellers, that visa conditions are unchanged, and that visa liberalisation for Turkey is not on the table because Turkey still has to meet six outstanding conditions.
It concerns an adjustment of the existing Schengen cascade model for Turkish travellers who have previously used their visa correctly.
Het gaat om een aanpassing van het bestaande Schengen cascademodel voor Turkse reizigers die eerder op de juiste manier gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun visum

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat Denemarken en Italië steun zoeken om de bevoegdheden van het Europese Hof van de Rechten van de Mensen op het gebied van asiel en immigratie te be

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether the government would co-sign a letter by Denmark and Italy seeking to limit the European Court of Human Rights' reach on asylum and immigration, and whether it had been approached to support it. The government answered that it supports the letter's general call for a dialogue on expelling convicted foreigners but will not co-sign because the call to debate the Court's interpretation of the ECHR touches judicial independence, and that it will pursue this via other channels.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression that it wishes to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over evacuatie van Nederlanders uit Israël

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the US embassy in Jerusalem is preparing evacuation plans for its nationals leaving Israel and what the Netherlands is doing for Dutch nationals wishing to leave. The minister replied that Dutch travellers have received security updates, that over 100 were repatriated by bus via Egypte and charter flight, and that a second organised departure is planned later that week.
A second ministry-organised departure is therefore planned later this week so that the remaining repatriates who have registered, and who still wish to, can leave Israel.

Later deze week wordt daarom een tweede door het ministerie georganiseerde uitreis gepland waarmee de overige repatrianten die zich hebben aangemeld, en zulks eventueel nog wensen, uit Israël kunnen vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over signalen van islamisering in het Nederlandse onderwijs

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education about reports of religiously motivated pressure, intimidation of teachers, and antisemitism in Dutch schools, and whether schools' neutrality and safety are being undermined. The state secretary condemned such conduct, pointed to existing duties (civic education, neutrality, safety care) and the inspectorate's enforcement, and said a Vrij en veilig onderwijs bill with an incident-reporting duty is in preparation, but declined an independent investigation.

Are you willing to have independently investigated the extent to which religious pressure, antisemitism and administrative looking away undermine freedom of education, the safety of pupils and teachers, and equality within schools?

Bent u bereid om onafhankelijk te laten onderzoeken in hoeverre religieuze druk, antisemitisme en bestuurlijk wegkijken de onderwijsvrijheid, de veiligheid van leerlingen en docenten en de gelijkwaardigheid binnen de school aantasten?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over islamitische iftars en/of gebedsmomenten op openbare scholen

MPs Uppelschoten and Wilders asked whether an Islamic iftar with prayer at Einstein Lyceum, and similar events at public schools, are compatible with the neutrality of public education, and how many schools hold them. The State Secretary answered that schools may hold religious activities provided no single religion is favoured and no religious acts are imposed, that the Inspectorate will act if this is breached, and that no figures on such events are kept.
I do not know when and how often public schools organise iftars or other religious gatherings such as Chanukah celebrations, Diwali or Christmas celebrations.
Bij mij is niet bekend wanneer en hoe vaak openbare scholen iftars of andere religieuze bijeenkomsten zoals Chanoekavieringen, Diwali of kerstvieringen organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een nieuw uitgesproken fatwa

MP Wilders asked the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government would act against a new fatwa by a convicted Pakistani cleric calling for his killing and whether it would press Pakistan to cooperate with enforcement of a prior Dutch sentence. The government condemned the fatwa, said it had conveyed its view to Pakistani authorities, and stated that Dutch authorities depend on other states' cooperation for cases abroad, while not announcing new concrete action.

As reported in the answers to earlier parliamentary questions from MP Wilders, the cabinet is making maximum efforts to get the Pakistani authorities to cooperate with the requests concerning the persons convicted in the Netherlands.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen van het lid Wilders, spant het kabinet zich maximaal in om de Pakistaanse autoriteiten te laten meewerken aan de verzoeken met betrekking tot de in Nederland veroordeelde personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Wilders en Blaauw over de benoeming van de ambassadeurs van de vrijheid door het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

MPs Boon, Wilders and Blaauw asked whether the National Committee 4 and 5 May's choice of Freedom Ambassadors, including a performer alleged to have joined an antisemitic fundraiser, was acceptable and whether the government would intervene. The State Secretary answered that the Committee is independent, that the selection process was careful, and that the government respects its choices and will not intervene.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is independent and independently determines how the National Commemoration on 4 May and Liberation Day on 5 May are shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelfstandig hoe de Nationale Herdenking op 4 mei en Bevrijdingsdag op 5 mei worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitlevering van drie veroordeelde Pakistanen

An MP asked whether three Pakistani nationals convicted in the Netherlands for serious offences against him had been extradited, what concrete steps had been taken with Pakistan, and insisted on nothing less than extradition. The government answered that Pakistan has been formally asked to extradite, that the matter is raised repeatedly at all levels, but it declined to give details of diplomatic contacts and said the response is up to Pakistan.
As to which specific efforts have been made, given the confidential nature of diplomatic communications with foreign authorities, we will make no further statements.
Over welke inspanningen precies zijn gepleegd, doen wij gezien de vertrouwelijke aard van het diplomatieke verkeer met buitenlandse autoriteiten, geen verdere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel Van Dijk, Van der Velde en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ongehoord Nederland zoekt man of vrouw, ’geen X’, OM doet onderzoek naar discriminatie’

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Education ministers why the Public Prosecution Service is investigating a broadcaster's job ad requiring 'man or woman, not X' while other cases get less attention, and whether the government recognizes only two biological sexes. The minister replied that prosecutors act on their own authority, that there is sexual diversity, that broadcasters set their own hiring within equal-treatment rules, and that no measures will be taken.
The Public Prosecution Service initiates criminal investigations on its own authority and on the basis of known principles.
Het Openbaar Ministerie stelt op eigen gezag en op basis van kenbare uitgangspunten strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Deen en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kamer-bobo laat zich door beveiligers rondrijden in opgeëiste dienstauto: chique bolide heeft pikant verleden’

PVV MPs Deen and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior whether the House Clerk (Griffier) obtained a chauffeured service car driven by Chamber security staff, and whether this should end. The Minister replied that she had no role in the decision, which falls under the House's own budget and personnel responsibility (Presidium), and therefore would not go into the reports.
For the above reasons, I will not go into the reported news any further.
Vanwege bovenstaande redenen zal ik niet nader ingaan op de genoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Omtzigt, Mooiman en Wilders over het bericht ‘Maximale huurverhoging vanaf 1 januari 2025: 4,1% voor vrije sector en 7,7% voor middenhuur’

MPs asked the Minister of Housing whether the 7.7% maximum rent increase for mid-segment rentals in 2025 is acceptable for households, and whether additional measures, a transitional arrangement, or a structural change to the mid-rent increase system are planned. The minister answered that the increase follows from the Wet betaalbare huur tied to collective wage growth, that the actual increase will often be lower, and that no legislative change is planned before the 2027 evaluation, while declining to calculate household income effects.
I therefore cannot make a calculation of the effects on the purchasing power figures.
Ik kan dan ook geen doorrekening maken van de effecten in de koopkrachtplaatjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de hernieuwde fatwa van imam Jalali

Wilders asked whether the government knew of imam Jalali's renewed fatwa against him, whether it condemns the threats, what it has done to get the imam imprisoned, and what consequences non-cooperation by Pakistan would have. The minister said AIVD and NCTV information cannot be discussed publicly, condemned the threats, described diplomatic and legal-assistance efforts with Pakistan, and declined to pre-empt consequences for relations with Pakistan.

As is known to your House, no public statement can be made about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat casuistry and security measures for individuals.

Antwoord 2 Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan er over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigingscasuïstiek en beveiligingsmatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Wilders, Pool en De Roon over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that a German court issued an international arrest warrant against a Ukrainian suspected in the Nord Stream sabotage, and whether Ukraine might be behind it and what Dutch intelligence knew. The government declined to speculate on the German investigation's outcome, did not disclose intelligence details, and said Parliament would be informed through the usual channels.
The cabinet does not state publicly anything about the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our intelligence services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze inlichtingendiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Roon en Pool over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that President Zelensky knew of and approved the Nord Stream sabotage were accurate, and what the consequences would be. The government answered that it does not speculate on the cause of the explosions and will await the outcome of the German investigation.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and is awaiting the results of the German investigation.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Wilders over het feit dat de MIVD de wettelijk verplichte notificatieplicht bij afluisteren, aftappen en andere bijzondere bevoegdheden niet nakomt

MPs Omtzigt and Wilders asked why the MIVD has not fulfilled its statutory duty to notify people subjected to special powers, and about the status of its notification backlog since the CTIVD's 2017 report. The minister acknowledged a backlog from 2019 to November 2023, said measures are underway with full repair targeted by 1 April 2025, but declined to give figures on targets, politicians, lawyers or journalists and did not disclose compliance incidents to Parliament.
The aim is for the MIVD to have fully cleared the backlog by 1 April 2025.
Het streven is dat de MIVD de achterstand voor 1 april 2025 volledig heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland en Pakistan de banden gaan aanhalen

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands is deepening ties with Pakistan while death threats against a Dutch MP come from there, whether pilot projects and technology transfer should stop, and whether military or dual-use technology could flow to Pakistan. The minister answered that the Dutch government consistently condemns the threats with Pakistani authorities, that the projects are mainly private or water and climate related, and that no military technology transfer is planned, while declining to commit to halting cooperation.
The cabinet strongly condemns the fatwas and the threats against the Dutch MP and raises this at all levels with the Pakistani authorities.
Het kabinet keurt fatwa's en de bedreigingen aan het adres van de Nederlandse volksvertegenwoordiger ten sterkste af en bespreekt dit op alle niveaus met de Pakistaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Israëlische ambassade dient klacht in bij Schiphol na incident met vrijgelaten gijzelaar’

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked whether reports were true that two Israeli women, one a former Hamas hostage, were mistreated by a Schiphol security employee, and whether the employee could be dismissed. The minister said he was shocked, the Marechaussee mediated on site, the employee works for Schiphol so the ministry lacks authority over them, and Schiphol says it apologised personally via the embassy.
Because it concerns an employee of Schiphol, the Ministry of IenW has no authority over this employee.
Omdat het een medewerker van Schiphol betreft, heeft het Ministerie van IenW geen zeggenschap over deze medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Ingrijpend miljardenpakket voor opkoop boeren moet koude sanering veestapel voorkomen'

MPs Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the agriculture minister about press reports of a multi-billion buyout package to prevent a cold clearance of livestock, and whether the government would refrain from announcing buyout schemes during the formation period. The minister says a broad action plan responding to the Van Campen motion is being prepared, that a buyout scheme is only one component, that the European Commission has ruled out a new derogation, and asks the Chamber to debate the plan urgently.
This cabinet considers the situation very urgent and intends to send an action plan to the House at short notice after final decision-making.
Dit kabinet vindt de situatie zeer urgent en is voornemens om, na definitieve besluitvorming, op korte termijn een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Wilders over de aanwezigheid van een hoge Talibanfunctionaris op het WHO-congres in Den Haag

MPs Eerdmans and Wilders asked how a senior Taliban health official could attend a WHO conference hosted by the Netherlands and receive a Schengen visa, and how the procedure will be tightened. The minister explains the visa was assessed under the EU Visa Code, the person was not on any sanctions list, the government acknowledges it is undesirable and will review visa and invitation procedures, and provides figures on sanctioned Taliban members.
Although the person concerned is not on any of these sanctions lists, the cabinet does draw lessons from these events
Hoewel betrokkene niet op een van deze sanctielijsten staat, trekt het kabinet wel lering uit deze gebeurtenissen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de ruwe verwijdering van de Israëlische ambassadeur bij de VN

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the UN treated the Israeli ambassador roughly while an Iranian president was given speaking time, whether Dutch representatives attended that speech, and whether the minister would avoid closer ties with Iran. The minister answered that both states have speaking rights at the UN, that a Dutch official attended the speech at working level, that Dutch human rights pressure on Iran continues and ties are not being deepened, and that the Dutch UN mission expressed solidarity with Israel.
It is standing Dutch policy that during the so-called General Debate a representative of the Kingdom of the Netherlands is always present in the hall.
Het is staand beleid van Nederland dat er gedurende het zgn. General Debate altijd een vertegenwoordiger van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden in de zaal zit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het schieten met een pistool en mitrailleur op een foto van mijn hoofd

The MP Wilders asks whether the government is aware of a video showing a threat against him, whether the AIVD and NCTV were informed, what steps are taken to trace the perpetrator, and whether diplomatic measures will be taken if the video comes from Pakistan. The minister condemns the threat, declines to comment on intelligence and protection matters or on the individual investigation, and says the Pakistani ambassador would be informed of concerns and that a legal assistance request is possible.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Saudische universiteit betaalde Nederlandse wetenschappers voor prestige'

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a Saudi university paid Dutch scientists to list it as their first employer for prestige, and about the human rights record of Saudi Arabia. The Minister said such constructions are troubling, that universities as employers should decide on sanctions (noting Wageningen's suspension of one professor), and pointed to transparency measures and a forthcoming evaluation of the research integrity code.
I am not aware of the extent to which Saudi Arabia is trying to improve its international prestige with this kind of arrangement.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre Saudi-Arabië met dit soort constructies probeert haar internationale prestige te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Haga over de zaak De Mos

MPs Wilders and Van Haga asked the Justice Minister about the De Mos corruption case, which they say has politically paralysed The Hague after the Rotterdam court acquitted most suspects, and whether the minister would use her instruction power to halt the case. The minister answered that the prosecution service decides independently, that the case's length reflects its complexity, and that she will not use her instruction power, since ministerial interference in individual criminal cases must be avoided.
I am not willing to use my special instruction power, as referred to in articles 127 and 128 of the Judicial Organisation Act.
Los daarvan, ben ik niet bereid gebruik te maken van mijn bijzondere aanwijzingsbevoegdheid, zoals bedoeld in artikelen 127 en 128 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het artikel 'Terreurverdachten na foute grappen'

Wilders asked the Justice Minister about a news report on terror suspects released after making offensive jokes, including a remark about beheading him, and why the prosecutor did not appeal the acquittal. The minister condemned the remarks, explained the prosecution service had found the verdict well-reasoned and did not appeal, rejected the claim of failure, and declined to discuss individual security consequences.

The Public Prosecution Service informed me that after extensive study of the judgment no appeal will be lodged, because according to the Public Prosecution Service the court's judgment is well reasoned and in line with established case law.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij gemeld dat na uitgebreide bestudering van het vonnis er geen hoger beroep wordt ingesteld, omdat het vonnis van de rechtbank volgens het Openbaar Ministerie goed gemotiveerd is en in lijn is met vaststaande jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

MPs Kops and Wilders asked how often refugee status holders refused housing, why, how many evictions followed, and who handles refusals under the hotel and accommodation scheme. The government answered that initial refusals were about 140 to 300 a year, mostly reversed, with COA and municipalities handling procedures and a guidance document in preparation.
Because status holders have left COA, it is not centrally recorded how many status holders under the hotel and accommodation scheme refuse a home.
Omdat statushouders zijn uitgestroomd bij het COA, wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel statushouders onder de Hotel- en accommodatieregeling een woning weigeren.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de definitieve fatwa en de oproep aan Nederlandse moslims mij te vermoorden

An MP from the PVV asked the government to condemn a Pakistani fatwa calling for the MP's murder, to explain how such threats are handled, and to consider expelling the Pakistani ambassador. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistan, noted a prosecution decision, and declined to discuss threat cases or intelligence assessments in public.
As is known to your House, I cannot publicly make statements about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat cases and personal security measures.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend kan ik over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigings-casuïstiek en beveiligingsmaatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over zeer recent in Pakistan herhaalde en herbevestigde fatwa en honderden dreigementen tegen een Nederlandse parlementariër

Wilders asks the Prime Minister why a Pakistani cleric's renewed fatwa and hundreds of death threats against him have not been publicly condemned and prosecuted, and what the government will do to secure prosecution of threateners abroad. The government condemns the fatwas and threats, says it has raised serious concerns with Pakistan at several levels, notes prosecution of one Pakistan-based person is underway, but states that foreign criminal investigation is for the foreign authorities.
If no legal assistance is provided by the foreign country, the Public Prosecution Service can only prosecute persons in the Netherlands who can be directly identified from their online statements.

Het Openbaar Ministerie kan – als er door het buitenland geen rechtshulp wordt verleend – alleen personen in Nederland vervolgen die rechtstreeks zijn te identificeren op basis van hun online gedane uitlatingen.
Antwoord op op vragen van lid Wilders over het bericht ‘Radicaliseringsexpert Soumaya Sahla wil haar plek bij de VVD terugveroveren’

Wilders asks the Prime Minister, in dozens of numbered questions, to disclose the content, medium and context of his contacts with Soumaya Sahla, a convicted terrorist, and whether he spoke to her in his party or government capacity. Rutte answers that he will not separate his roles on these matters, refuses most questions by pointing to the limits of the ministerial duty to inform, and does not disclose the contents of the messages or calls.

The duty to provide information to members of the House of Representatives and Senate applies to ministers and state secretaries. However, office holders do not perform all their work in their official capacity.
De inlichtingenplicht aan leden van de Tweede en Eerste Kamer geldt voor Ministers en Staatssecretarissen. Bewindslieden verrichten echter niet al hun werkzaamheden uit hoofde van hun ambt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower inzake de lage straf voor het doodrijden van Shana Leurs

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a driver who killed Shana Leurs received a six-month sentence, and whether minimum sentences, mandatory driving bans and other stricter measures could be introduced. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, defended judicial discretion and the existing legal framework, and pointed to a pending motion on lifetime driving bans and an upcoming evaluation.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on this case, or other individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om op deze zaak, en andere individuele zaken, in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de stilgevallen vergunningverlening in Brabant

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders ask the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why permit granting in Brabant has stalled due to nitrogen deposition in vulnerable nature, questioning the EU targets, the impact on housing and farmers, and the AERIUS model update. The Minister answers that the province as competent authority halted permits because the Natura 2000 analyses cannot support the required conclusion, affecting about 1050 homes in two plans, and defends the nitrogen policy while not committing to scrapping it.
It falls within the responsibility of the province as competent authority to make such an assessment.
Het valt binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie als bevoegd gezag om een dergelijke afweging te kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het nieuws dat het CIDI op een Iraanse terrorisme- en sanctielijst is geplaatst

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked what measures the government takes after Iran listed CIDI and its chairman on a terrorism and sanctions list, and whether that is not a reason for a harder line on Iran. Minister Hoekstra condemned the listing, said the threat level in the Netherlands is unchanged and security is a decentralised responsibility, and promised to raise dissatisfaction internationally and keep monitoring Iran.
The cabinet will express displeasure about the imposed sanctions and condemn them when the occasion arises.
Het kabinet zal bij gelegenheid ongenoegen uitspreken over de ingestelde sancties en deze veroordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het niet-vervolgen van doodsbedreigers

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute people who threatened him with death, and whether this undermines his safety and the rule of law. The Minister of Justice answers that individual prosecutorial decisions cannot be discussed to avoid political interference, that threats against MPs are assessed with great care regardless of political affiliation, and that the AIVD monitors threats to protected persons.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot address individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over fatwa’s en bedreigingen

An MP asks the Prime Minister and several ministers what has concretely been done to identify, prosecute or extradite people who issued fatwas and death threats against him, and how many threat cases were prosecuted. The minister replies that individual cases cannot be discussed, that Pakistan has not answered legal assistance requests, that the Public Prosecution Service decides prosecution case by case, and that threats are forwarded to the intelligence services.
I cannot go into individual cases; the Public Prosecution Service is the designated body to inform you confidentially about such matters.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, het Openbaar Ministerie is de aangewezen instantie om u, als betrokkene, vertrouwelijk over dergelijke zaken te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het opnieuw houden van een foeigesprek met een doodsbedreiger

Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Public Prosecution Service handled a death threat by a reprimand instead of prosecution, whether it is failing to act against threats from abroad, and whether it has effectively declared him outlawed. The Minister stressed that threats against MPs are unacceptable, said the OM assesses every complaint with care and that prosecution of individual cases is for the OM, not the minister, and that prosecution abroad depends on foreign legal assistance.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op individuele zaken om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het recente AD-interview met de veroordeelde moslimterrorist Soumaya Sahla

Wilders asked Prime Minister Rutte about his contacts with convicted terrorist Soumaya Sahla, including a 2022 phone call and whether he scouted her for the VVD, and about her potential access to parliament. Rutte answered most questions by declining to go into private contacts and pointing to the VVD as a party matter, while confirming the 2019 meeting and refusing to rule out future security risks.
I will not go into this further for the reason stated in the answer to question 5.
Ik ga hier om de in het antwoord op vraag 5 genoemde reden niet nader op in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over de overname van de tijdelijke opvanglocatie voor asielzoekers door het COA

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why COA took over a municipal emergency reception site in Groningen without consent, whether residents were consulted, and whether more sites will be taken over. The State Secretary replied that takeovers happen in consultation with municipalities, that the Groningen site remains temporary emergency shelter with no plan to make it permanent, that informing residents is the municipality's responsibility, and that more suitable sites are being discussed with municipalities before 1 April 2023.
It is primarily the responsibility of the municipality to inform residents about the emergency shelter remaining open longer.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om de omwonenden te informeren over het langer open blijven van een (crisis)noodopvanglocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het OM dat weigert een doodsbedreiger te vervolgen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute a death threat against him, questioning whether the statute of limitations and the threat's handling were selective compared with a case involving a VVD politician. The Minister refused to discuss individual prosecutorial decisions to prevent political interference, while affirming that threats against MPs are unacceptable and that the PPS assesses all such complaints on their merits.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to address individual cases in order to prevent political interference.
Het is niet aan mij om als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op individuele zaken om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de onbereikbaarheid van energiebedrijven

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy companies were hard to reach about the price cap and why the cap was not better prepared and more generous. The minister acknowledged the overload, said suppliers are working to improve service and app information, and refused to widen the cap or backdate it.
The price cap was established under great time pressure.
Het prijsplafond is onder grote tijdsdruk tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Graus over zware mishandeling en wurging van katten in Gouda

PVV MPs Wilders and Graus asked whether an investigation would be launched into the cat strangulations in Gouda, whether the carcasses were sent to the Veterinary Forensic Team, whether animal abusers could face much harsher penalties, and what would be done to prevent such cases and ensure enough capacity. The Minister said investigations are a matter for the police and prosecutors, pointed to existing maximum penalties and a pending bill allowing an independent animal-keeping ban, and said there was no evidence of insufficient capacity.
It is not for the Minister to decide whether to launch a criminal investigation.
Het is niet aan de Minister om te besluiten over het instellen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en Helder over het artikel waarin gesteld wordt dat het Kamerlid Van Ginneken van de D66-fractie eist dat u uw principiële mening ten aanzien van de transgenderwet herzie

PVV MPs asked Minister Adema whether she accepts that an MP's public demand that she retract her earlier personal opposition to the transgender law undermines her credibility and coalition relations. The minister replied she signed the manifesto in a personal capacity before becoming minister, accepts full cabinet responsibility, and does not see the MP's questions as harming coalition relations.
A minister bears responsibility for the entire cabinet policy, and that is how I will conduct myself.
Een Minister draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor het gehele kabinetsbeleid, en zo zal ik mij dus ook opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Opsporing komt in gevaar door disfunctioneren tapkamer politie’

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that the police wiretap system is outdated, frequently fails, and endangers investigations, plus related questions on camera systems, staff complaints and a 2022 procurement. The minister answered that the new system is being implemented gradually, that the old system still functions adequately, that no known investigation or safety incident was harmed by outages, and that the procurement was fair.
