It is correct that the new wiretap system the police acquired in 2019 is still being implemented.
Het klopt dat het nieuwe tapsysteem voor de politie dat in 2019 is aangeschaft op dit moment nog wordt geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Energiebedrijven wijken niet: laat aangekondigde prijsverhogingen gaan door'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister why energy suppliers were still raising prices on 1 October despite rules against it, and whether he would stop the increases. The minister replied that the regulator ACM had told suppliers to comply and could enforce, and that the five largest suppliers had withdrawn their increases; he did not directly commit to blocking them himself.
It is up to the independent regulator Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) to start any investigation into possible legal violations.
Ik heb ook aangegeven dat het aan de onafhankelijk toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is om een eventueel onderzoek te starten naar mogelijke wettelijke overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Natuur kan nog slechter tegen stikstof, normen moeten mogelijk strenger

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a report on European critical nitrogen loads suggesting stricter Dutch norms, asking its basis, its relation to the Remkes talks, why the UN was involved, and whether the minister would scrap the report and policy. The minister replied the report covers European critical loads without Dutch-specific statements, that the Netherlands does not report nitrogen figures to the Commission as alleged, that Dutch application will be updated using the best available knowledge, and that the results are taken seriously.
The report does not use data on nitrogen deposition in the Netherlands.
Het rapport maakt geen gebruik van gegevens over stikstofdepositie in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het OM dat draalt met de vervolging van mensen die mij met de dood bedreigen

Wilders asks why the OM has not decided on prosecution in several long-running death threat cases from Pakistan and hundreds of other threats against him, whether such threats should be prosecuted, and when a promised letter on protecting threatened politicians will come. The minister answers that threats against politicians are unacceptable and the OM assesses each report, but gives no substantive information on individual cases, referring to the OM, and says a letter on measures will follow shortly.
Regarding individual cases, I cannot, as is known, provide any substantive information.
Over individuele zaken kan ik verder, zoals bekend, geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het geweld tegen Hindoes in Bangladesh en India

Wilders (PVV) asks the government about violent attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh and India, including the killing of a tailor who supported Nupur Sharma, and about threats against himself, and whether it will condemn the violence and press both governments on protection. The minister condemns all violence against religious minorities, says Dutch policy raises the issue through bilateral and EU human rights dialogue, and notes that the perpetrators are being prosecuted and that the threats from Pakistan are raised with its authorities.
The cabinet firmly condemns all forms of violence against religious minorities and monitors global developments on this, including in Bangladesh.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van geweld tegen religieuze minderheden nadrukkelijk af en monitort de wereldwijde ontwikkelingen hieromtrent, zo ook in Bangladesh.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht: ‘Woede over autobranden in Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about car arsons in Eindhoven, including cars parked against homes, whether this constitutes terrorism and whether Extinction Rebellion should be listed as a terrorist organisation. The Minister said the matter is for police and prosecutors, that no reliable count of offences linked to the group is possible, that the NCTV definition of terrorism is adopted, and that Extinction Rebellion is not on the EU/UN terrorist list, while pledging all lawful means to prevent terrorist offences.
It is not possible for the police and the OM to provide a reliable overview of such criminal activities since May 2018.
Het is voor de politie en het OM niet mogelijk om een betrouwbaar overzicht te geven van betreffende dergelijke strafbare activiteiten sinds mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van  de leden Wilders en De Graaf over de rol van gezaghebbers in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether State Secretary Van Huffelen misinformed the House about the duty of island governors (gezaghebbers) in the Caribbean Netherlands to vote in the executive board under the WolBES, and whether she would apologise to Bonaire's governor. The State Secretary replied that she had not misinformed the House, that the governor has a principled duty to vote only when a vote takes place, that consensus is normally sought, and that she sees no reason to apologise.
The House has not been misinformed by me.
De Kamer is door mij niet verkeerd geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar rol OR-voorzitter politie na uitreizen jihadistische broer'

MPs Helder and Wilders asked why no internal investigation was opened into the works council chair of the Landelijke Eenheid whose brother was an IS terrorist, why she was allowed to hold the post without screening, and whether she has access to personnel files. The Minister confirms an orientation investigation is now underway, states the Screening Act is not yet in force, denies access to personnel files, and declines to suspend her or order an external investigation.
It is correct that an orientation investigation is being instituted.
Het klopt dat een oriënterend onderzoek wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Brussel van plan is een fonds op te richten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU plans a reconstruction fund for Ukraine that Dutch taxpayers would largely fund, and under what conditions Ukraine could access it. The minister answered that the Commission has only outlined principles (a mix of grants and loans, linked to reform and anti-corruption), has named no amounts, and that the Dutch contribution is not yet clear.
To what extent and in what form the Netherlands will contribute is not yet clear at this time, and will depend partly on a joint assessment of needs.
In welke mate en vorm Nederland daaraan zal bijdragen is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk, en zal mede afhankelijk zijn van een gezamenlijke inventarisatie van de noden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de berichten 'Je kunt me kankerjood noemen, maar ik meld het wel' en 'Nederlands joodse man onthult het antisemitisme waar hij mee te maken heeft'

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Jewish man in Wijchen repeatedly harassed, spat on and assaulted by a group of youths, and about police and prosecution handling. The minister replied that the police investigated every report, the prosecutor found insufficient evidence for prosecution, police held 'stop talks' with youths and parents, and discrimination handling will be strengthened through the local partnership.
I cannot make any further statements about the identity of those involved in this case.
Over de identiteit van de betrokkenen in deze zaak kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de berichten 'Chaos rond energiegeld – Willekeur in gemeenten' en 'Steeds meer huishoudenskunnen energierekening nauwelijks nog voldoen'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the government about reports of chaos and arbitrariness in municipal distribution of the one-off energy allowance and about households struggling with energy bills, including whether energy suppliers were using debt collectors. Minister Schouten answered that the government has taken relief measures, that municipalities have policy freedom in the allowance, and that the state guarantees financial compensation to municipalities, while leaving much of the response to local democracy and existing debt assistance channels.
With these commitments, in my view there is no longer any brake on the objective of the bill.
Met deze toezeggingen bestaat er naar mijn mening geen rem meer op de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de zeer recent in Pakistan uitgesproken fatwa en dreigementen tegen een Nederlandse parlementariër

An MP asked the Prime Minister about threats and a fatwa from Pakistan against Geert Wilders and whether the government would protest, investigate and protect him. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistani authorities, and explained that Pakistan has not answered prior mutual legal assistance requests while the Public Prosecution Service assesses criminality case by case.
As is known, for security reasons the cabinet makes no statements about specific security matters.
Zoals bekend doet het kabinet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitspraken over specifieke veiligheidsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het afdwingen van opvangplaatsen van vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked whether the government would requisition property such as sports halls, offices, hotels and homes to house asylum seekers, and whether ministers would house migrants in their own property. The state secretary answered that requisitioning property is not currently under consideration and referred to earlier letters on ministers' property holdings, adding that housing migrants in one's own home is a private matter and not an obligation.
For completeness, I refer you regarding ownership of immovable property to letters from the Prime Minister dated 14 January 2022 on the interests of ministers.
Volledigheidshalve verwijs ik u ten aanzien van het bezit van onroerend goed naar brieven van de Minister-President d.d. 14 januari 2022 inzake de belangen van bewindspersonen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over luxe vervoer voor asielzoekers

The PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why asylum-seeker children in Utrecht were taken to school by touring coach despite having free bicycles, and asked for an overview of everything asylum seekers receive for free. State Secretary Van der Burg answered that the coach was temporary because the Afghan evacuees initially lacked bicycles and cycling skills and had no means for public transport, that the service has ended since the spring holiday, and that asylum seekers are entitled to reception under law, with the COA's provisions set out in a regulation rather than a single overview.
A touring coach was temporarily deployed for about 75 school-age children of Afghan evacuees.
Er is tijdelijk een touringcar voor ongeveer 75 leerplichtige kinderen van Afghaanse evacuées ingezet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de veroordeelde moslimterrorist Soumaya Sahla

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his contacts with Soumaya Sahla, a convicted terrorist, including her meeting at the Prime Minister's office, her former role as adviser to the VVD and NCTV/AIVD contacts. The Prime Minister answers that he met her once in 2019, cannot reflect on court rulings, refers party matters to the VVD and says access to government buildings is for each organisation to decide.
As I told the media on 28 January, I will not go further into the content of such conversations.
Zoals ik op 28 januari jl. tegenover media heb gezegd, ga ik niet verder in op de inhoud van dergelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het verder opendraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether raising Groningen gas extraction and exporting Groningen gas to Germany breaks the government's promise to close the field, and why 30,000 damage claims remain open. The state secretary answered that a decision on the extraction level will be taken before 1 April 2022, that claims are being handled with a six-month target, and that export cannot stop immediately because export contracts and household demand abroad constrain it.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a definitive decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over Soumaya Sahla

An MP asked the ministers whether Soumaya Sahla, convicted for Hofstad group membership and illegal weapons possession, had ever advised the AIVD or NCTV. The ministers answered that the AIVD cannot comment publicly on specific conduct, while NCTV experts spoke with her a few times without her being involved in analyses or policy.
The AIVD cannot publicly address specific questions about its conduct.
De AIVD kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete vragen over haar handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland opnieuw niet tegen een VN-resolutie heeft gestemd die enkel de islamitische naam voor de Tempelberg gebruikt

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands abstained rather than opposed a UN resolution that uses only the Arabic name Haram al-Sharif for the Temple Mount, and questioned the government's voting position and negotiations. Minister Knapen answered that the Netherlands pushed to add the name Temple Mount and remove the Arabic-only reference, that the resolution's content on settlements and evictions is supported, and that the final vote reflected a broad interest assessment.

The Netherlands works at the UN to not exclusively use the term Haram al-Sharif, but to always also use the designation Temple Mount, to reflect the historical, religious and cultural connection of this holy site to the various religions.
Nederland zet zich bij de VN in om niet uitsluitend de term «Haram-al-Sharif» te gebruiken, maar daarbij ook altijd de benaming «Tempelberg» te gebruiken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over de toename van incidenten met asielzoekers in de Nederlandse treinen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretaries whether train staff will be protected against incidents with asylum seekers, whether asylum seekers causing nuisance can be sent back, and whether borders will be closed. The government answered that all nuisance is unacceptable and is handled through reporting, extra staff and a harder zero-tolerance approach, but that closing borders is not realistic and that nuisance alone is not legal grounds for rejecting an asylum application.

As stated in the answers to earlier questions from your House, causing nuisance on public transport legally provides insufficient grounds to reject an asylum application and to proceed to direct removal.

Zoals vermeld in de beantwoording van eerdere vragen van uw Kamer, biedt het veroorzaken van overlast in het openbaar vervoer wettelijk gezien onvoldoende grond om over te gaan tot afwijzing van een asielaanvraag en tot directe uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de mogelijke familiebanden van een D66-Kamerlid met een veroordeelde terrorist

Wilders asks the Prime Minister whether he knew of family ties between D66 MP Fonda Sahla and a convicted terrorist sister, whether security services and the Tweede Kamer were informed, and whether the convicted person has access to Parliament. The government declines to comment on MPs' personal circumstances and on specific security matters, says it keeps threat analyses under review and informs protected persons in general terms, and says Parliament controls its own access policy.
The cabinet does not have information about who visits the Tweede Kamer, who has a Kamerpas, and who works for one of the political parties.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie over wie de Tweede Kamer bezoekt, wie een Kamerpas heeft en wie werkzaam is voor een van de politieke partijen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over stijgende gasprijs

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising gas prices, the resulting higher energy bills, the possible need for a strategic gas reserve, and energy poverty. The government answered that it cannot directly set tariffs but is adding temporary energy tax reductions for 2022, extra funds for insulating vulnerable households, rejects a strategic gas reserve for now, and says it monitors energy affordability.
The cabinet has no direct influence on supply tariffs but keeps energy prices and their consequences closely in view.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe invloed op de leveringstarieven maar houdt de energieprijzen en de consequenties daarvan scherp in beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Markuszower en Wilders over woningweigering door statushouders

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that refugee status holders (statushouders) refuse housing offers, citing reports of families expelled from a reception centre, and requested data on refusals since 2010. The minister answered that refusals are rare and mostly handled by COA's procedure, gave figures showing 1,696 refusal procedures since 2013 with 1,598 judged unjustified and 137 eviction procedures started, and rejected calls to deport such persons.
Of the total number of housing refusals, 98 were found justified and 1,598 were found unjustified.
Van het totale aantal woningweigeringen zijn er 98 terecht en 1.598 onterecht bevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het opiniestuk ‘Scholen, aarzel niet tegengif te bieden aan desinformatie uit rechts-radicale hoek’

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the minister whether a school leader's op-ed criticising a pupil's graduation speech and arguing against denying teachers the right to question, and whether such conduct normalises discrimination against PVV supporters. The minister answered that pupils and teachers may express views freely, that discrimination is unacceptable and that the inspectorate would enforce if discrimination were found.
Should the inspectorate find that discrimination and exclusion occur at a school, it will enforce.
Mocht de inspectie constateren dat er op een school sprake is van discriminatie en uitsluiting, dan zal zij handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Geweld en overlast asielzoekers in ov regio Emmen: ’We zijn het spuugzat’'

PVV MPs asked whether asylum seekers in the Emmen public transport region were committing daily intimidation and violence against bus drivers, and demanded expulsion or an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed 7 reported incidents mostly over payment problems, said no police reports were filed, noted that the reported assault turned out not to be physical, and refused to expel offenders or halt asylum, citing legal rights and existing security measures.
Of those 7 incidents, according to Qbuzz no report and/or complaint was filed with the police.
Van die 7 incidenten is volgens Qbuzz geen melding en/of aangifte gedaan bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over de stijgende energielasten

PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising household energy bills, the CO2 price and energy poverty, and whether the government would stop the stacking of climate taxes. The state secretary answered that supply tariffs are set by the market, that the government only directly controls energy taxes, that energy taxes were cut for households under the Climate Agreement, and that the government monitors the energy bill closely while defending the ETS and climate policy.
The cabinet only has direct influence over energy taxes and therefore cannot steer the development of the total energy bill.
Het kabinet heeft alleen directe invloed op de belastingen op energie en kan daarom niet sturen op de ontwikkeling van de totale energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat het financieel steunen van IS niet wordt bestraft

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about the Limburg court's acquittal of two suspects on terrorism financing and participation in a terrorist organisation, and whether judges should be dismissed or elected. Minister Grapperhaus declined to comment on the specific case, said the public prosecution service will appeal, and rejected dismissing judges over a ruling or changing the law because the judiciary is independent.

In the Netherlands we have an independent judiciary; this means among other things that judges are not elected and that judges cannot be dismissed if the content of their ruling is unwelcome to parties or others.

In Nederland kennen we een onafhankelijke rechterlijke macht; dat betekent onder meer dat rechters niet worden gekozen en dat rechters niet kunnen worden ontslagen als de inhoud van hun uitspraak partijen of anderen onwelgevallig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker is aangeklaagd voor zeven moordpogingen

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that an asylum seeker was charged with seven attempted murders at an asylum centre, asking why he was admitted and not detained, and whether borders should be closed. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual cases, said reducing crime and nuisance is a priority with measures already taken, and referred to earlier answers on closing borders to asylum seekers.
As your House is aware, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat de aanpak van zware asielcriminaliteit ernstig faalt

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why serious crime by asylum seekers is rising, why borders stay open, and whether offenders will be expelled and detained. The State Secretary confirmed the rise for the group in COA reception centres, gave conviction figures for Algerian, Moroccan and Tunisian residents, rejected closing the borders as unrealistic, and said expulsion for nuisance is limited by national and international law while enforcement continues.
For the immigration enforcement approach I am bound by national and international laws and regulations.
Voor de vreemdelingrechtelijke aanpak ben ik gebonden aan (inter)nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weggeven van 10.000 Nederlandse paspoorten aan gelukszoekers

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why 10,000 former Ranov-permit holders were being given Dutch passports despite lacking identity documents, and whether this attracts asylum seekers and criminals. The State Secretary rejected the characterisations, said naturalisation conditions and the rule that doubtful identity or nationality leads to refusal still apply, and explained a categorical exemption based on a WODC/IND study; he could not say how many had lied about identity or how many were criminals, pointing to existing public-order criteria and withdrawal rules.
The number of persons who lied about their personal details when granted residence rights is unknown.
Het aantal personen dat bij het verstrekken van het verblijfsrecht heeft gelogen over hun persoonsgegevens is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de rechtszaak tegen Shell

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders questioned the court ruling ordering Shell to cut emissions by 45% by 2030, arguing it was political and that climate science and the court's reasoning were contradictory. The ministers defended the court as acting within civil law on a duty of care, said the economic consequences are not yet known, and refused to withdraw from the Paris Agreement or the national climate law.
It is not yet known what consequences the ruling will have. An analysis is now being carried out, on which the House will be informed after the summer.
Het is nog niet bekend welke gevolgen de uitspraak zal hebben. Er wordt nu een analyse uitgevoerd, waarover de Kamer na de zomer wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Libië dreigde dat Christenen moesten worden vermoord en nu spoorloos verdwenen is

PVV MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked why a Libyan asylum seeker convicted for threats against Christians disappeared, why he received only a two-week sentence, why he was not held or deported, and whether his photo was circulated. The Secretary of State declined to comment on the individual case, explained the general vigilance and detention and publication rules, and said a two-week sentence alone does not justify refusing or revoking asylum status.
As you know, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat in Deelen in Gelderland een AZC komt met 200 asielzoekers en huisvesting voor 400 arbeidsmigranten

MPs Heinen and Aartsen asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs whether bonus rules at Booking.com were changed and whether such bonuses are acceptable for a company receiving state aid. Minister Koolmees answered that bonuses and dividends during NOW support are undesirable, that NOW4 will require consultation with employee representatives on bonus and dividend policy, that Booking.com has repaid its NOW advance, and that no change to the regulatory framework is planned beyond raising concerns with the European Commission.
I have no insight into the amount of bonuses paid by companies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de hoogte van bonussen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Iran in korte tijd meerdere meisjes heeft aangerand

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that an Iranian asylum seeker committed multiple sexual assaults, why he had not been deported after a prior conviction, and whether he would be removed after serving his sentence. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, stated that sexual offences are unacceptable and that the courts decide on sanctions, and explained the legal conditions under which asylum residence permits can be refused or withdrawn.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over de gruwelijke overval in de woning van PSV-spits Zahavi

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about a violent home robbery at PSV striker Zahavi's residence, including whether there was an anti-Jewish motive, the arrest and prosecution rates for home robberies, typical sentences and whether Parliament would be informed. The minister declined details on the ongoing criminal investigation and sentencing averages, provided national statistics on home robberies, and confirmed an anti-Jewish dimension is being investigated.
As long as the criminal investigation in this individual case is ongoing, I cannot provide further substantive information about it.
Zolang het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze individuele zaak loopt, kan ik daarover geen nadere inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de wachttijden voor sociale huurwoningen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior about long waiting times for social rental housing, linking them to housing allocated to status holders and alleged discrimination against Dutch citizens. The Minister rejected the claim that status holders displace Dutch applicants, cited measures to accelerate construction, and said discrimination in the housing market is being tackled through awareness, information and new municipal instruments.
The approach to discrimination in the housing market is being intensified, through awareness and information provision, but also by giving municipalities new legal instruments and enforcement powers.

De aanpak tegen discriminatie op de woningmarkt wordt geïntensiveerd, door in te zetten op bewustwording en informatievoorziening, maar ook door gemeenten nieuw wettelijk instrumentarium en handhavingsmogelijkheden te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders over het bericht dat een farmaceut zijn zakken vult met de hulp van minister De Jonge

MPs Agema and Wilders asked the Health Minister about a report that pharmaceutical firm Roche profited from ministry help with COVID self-test procurement, including the lack of tendering for a 46.5 million euro order and the choice of tests. The minister denied Roche gained an unfair head start, explained the exemption procedure and the urgent direct orders, and acknowledged two procurement irregularities that were reported to parliament.
I have informed you of the irregularities in the procurement.
Van onrechtmatigheden bij de inkoop heb ik u op de hoogte gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het feit dat er gewoon reisbureaus zijn die zich specialiseren in leuke reizen naar Ethiopië terwijl nog steeds mensen uit dit land asiel aanvragen in Nederland

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked whether it is absurd that Ethiopians seek asylum in the Netherlands while travel agencies sell holidays to Ethiopia, and whether all Ethiopian asylum seekers can therefore return, and whether borders should be closed to them. The State Secretary answered that asylum claims are assessed individually against the country situation, that tourist access does not equal absence of risk, that the general asylum report is being considered for implications, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.
I am considering the implications for national asylum policy and expect to inform the House shortly.
Ik ben mij aan het beraden over de implicaties voor het landgebonden asielbeleid. Ik verwacht de Kamer daarover op korte termijn te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het aanbieden van een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers

Two PVV MPs asked the health minister whether he would offer a non-AstraZeneca vaccine to over-60s who wanted one, after he had promised an answer within two weeks. The minister acknowledged the delay and said the 60-64 group who had not yet been vaccinated could book a mRNA vaccine at a GGD from 5 June, while those already given AstraZeneca would get their second dose from the GP.
Unfortunately I did not manage this within those two weeks, but today I have informed you about an alternative vaccine for over-60s
Helaas is het mij niet binnen die twee weken gelukt, maar heb ik u vandaag geïnformeerd over een alternatief vaccin voor 60-plussers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht dat er een Syrische terreurverdachte is opgepakt in een AZC in Friesland

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how a Syrian terror suspect arrested in a Friesland asylum centre could enter the Netherlands and remain free, and whether migration screening can rule out further terrorists. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case because of an ongoing criminal investigation, described the layered screening and monitoring in the asylum chain, and rejected preventive detention of Syrian asylum seekers and border closure while supporting a strengthened Schengen.
As you know, I do not make statements about individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Iran is verkozen tot lid van een VN-vrouwenrechtencommissie

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why Iran was elected to a UN women's rights commission, whether the Netherlands voted against it, and whether it would protest and stop funding the body. Minister Blok confirmed the election, said the secret vote cannot be disclosed, expressed concern about Iran's women's rights record, and declined to protest or change funding, noting indirect Dutch funding via UN Women.
The Netherlands does not publicly state its voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of their vote.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van de door hun uitgebrachte stem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether his earlier answers on COVID-19 testing for children under 13 wrongly implied a testing obligation, since no such obligation exists. The minister confirmed there is no testing obligation, said 'must' was used as a very urgent recommendation, and declined to publicise a correction beyond assuming the public understands it.
There is indeed no testing obligation in force.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat het kabinet de notulen van de ministerraad die eerder naar de parlementaire ondervragingscommissie kinderopvangtoeslag zijn gegaan openbaar maakt

Wilders asks why the cabinet limits publication of Council of Ministers minutes to those already sent to the parliamentary inquiry on childcare benefits, and whether P-notes and minutes on the affair from 2018 onward will be published. Rutte replies that minutes stay confidential for government cohesion, but in this exceptional case the cabinet publishes the minutes given to the inquiry, excluding P-notes and other minutes, and refuses further publication.
For these reasons, the minutes are by default classified as state secret, highly confidential.
Om deze redenen worden de notulen standaard voorzien van de rubricering staatsgeheim, zeer geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over aardgas als duurzame en klimaatvriendelijke brandstof

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether natural gas should be classed as a sustainable fuel under the EU Taxonomy, why households are being moved off gas, and whether the gas-free neighbourhood pilots should stop. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the Commission's proposal to classify gas plants as sustainable, that the transition is voluntary and aligned with the Climate Agreement, and that the Netherlands remains committed to its climate targets.
The Netherlands therefore spoke out against the Commission's new proposal to classify private investments in gas power plants as sustainable under conditions.
Nederland heeft zich dan ook uitgesproken tegen het nieuwe Commissievoorstel om private investeringen in aardgascentrales onder voorwaarden als duurzaam aan te merken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het verwerpelijke Nederlandse stemgedrag in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted alongside states like China and Pakistan on an anti-Israel resolution in the UN Human Rights Council, why it keeps cooperating despite Israel's many condemnations, and whether it will leave the Council. The minister answered that the Netherlands seeks to reduce disproportionate focus on Israel through negotiation with the Palestinians while still criticizing serious rights violations, and that it will remain a Council member to engage with states holding different views.
The Dutch approach remains aimed at countering disproportionate attention to one country within the UN, in line with the motion by MP Van der Staaij.
De Nederlandse inzet blijft erop gericht om disproportionele aandacht voor één land binnen de VN tegen te gaan, conform motie van het lid Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huizen aardgasvrij maken is complex en kost ook meer dan verwacht'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers whether the government would stop the natural-gas-free neighbourhoods programme, citing an EIB study estimating costs of about 40,000 euro per home and doubts about affordability. The Minister of Interior answered that the EIB case is not representative, that costs will fall through innovation, that the programme is a learning exercise, and that the government will not stop the transition.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over rillen in een gasloos huis

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about tenants in gas-free homes in Nijmegen's Meijhorst who were cold and faced rising energy bills, and whether the energy transition is affordable. Minister Ollongren said the situation is unpleasant, that Portaal is contacting tenants and will visit them, rejected the claim that the energy transition is unaffordable, and disputed the Ecorys projection of rising energy poverty.
I therefore do not get the impression that housing corporation Portaal is trying to shift the cause onto the residents.
Ik heb dan ook niet de indruk dat woningcorporatie Portaal de oorzaak op bewoners probeert af te wentelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over de artikelen ‘Arabische lessen op de werkvloer’ en ‘Politie Weert geslaagd voor Arabische taal en cultuur’

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that police in Weert took Arabic language and culture lessons, arguing police time should go to public order and Dutch should be the working language. The Minister answered that basic Arabic and culture knowledge was needed given the asylum centres in the Weert district, that the course was taken in personal time and paid from GGP reinforcement funds, and that one of the two asylum centres has since closed so the course is no longer followed.
Given the composition of the Weert basic team's service area, with two asylum reception centres at the time, the team had a need for basic knowledge of Arabic and Arab culture.
Gezien de samenstelling van het verzorgingsgebied van het basisteam Weert, met destijds twee AZC’s, was er in dit team behoefte aan basiskennis van het Arabisch en de Arabische cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over miskenning door Nederlandse regering van de Joodse relatie met de Tempelberg te Jerusalem

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted for UN resolution A/RES/75/98, which refers to the Temple Mount only as Haram al-Sharif, and whether it would apologise to Israel. Minister Blok defended the vote as a judgement on the resolution's overall content, said the Netherlands tried to have the Temple Mount name removed, and refused to apologise.
The Netherlands assesses each resolution on its total content and merits.
Nederland beoordeelt iedere resolutie op zijn totale inhoud en merites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops, Van Aalst en Wilders over nieuwe rekenregels voor geluid die de woningbouw lam dreigen te leggen

PVV MPs asked whether new noise calculation rules for cumulative noise would stall housing construction, and whether windmill noise would be counted less strictly. The government answered that it is aware of the housing shortage, that the updated aviation noise rule is still under joint impact analysis with local partners and an interim transitional provision keeps the current formula, and that separate noise norms for windmills remain and their noise is included in cumulative assessment without being weakened.
Together with the administrative partners it has been agreed to jointly carry out a further impact analysis of the possible consequences of updating the aviation noise calculation rule.
Met de bestuurlijke partners is afgesproken gezamenlijk een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren naar de mogelijke consequenties van de actualisering van de rekenregel voor luchtvaartgeluid

Antwoord op vragen leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de heer Bouali geld kreeg van het ministerie van VWS voor een coronacampagne en ook een promo maakte voor de minister voor zijn CDA-lijsttrekkersverkiezing

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge whether Ali B received Health Ministry money for a coronavirus influencer campaign and whether he was paid for a promo video backing De Jonge's CDA leadership bid. The minister answered that the campaign was run via agency Roorda with artists Boef and Famke Louise and that the agency paid SPEC EUR 42,350 plus EUR 24,224 for concept work, and that Ali B was not paid for the video.
Ali B. expressed his support in a short video message for my leadership election for the CDA.
Ali B. heeft in een korte videoboodschap zijn steun betuigd voor mijn lijst0trekkersverkiezing voor het CDA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Mohammed B. opnieuw door het lint in de gevangenis’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 2019 prison incident in which two terrorism detainees damaged a gym, causing about 34,000 euro in damage, and why the news came out a year later, and whether terrorist detainees should be fully isolated, moved to the EBI, and deported. The minister said the incident was published in the October 2019 monthly incident overview, that one detainee was punished and reported while the other was punished without a report, and rejected full isolation and a higher security regime as unnecessary and contrary to human rights law, saying deportation of a non-resident is pursued via the return service with a long entry ban.
The newspaper report concerns an incident that took place on 20 September 2019.
Het krantenbericht gaat over een incident dat plaatsvond op 20 september 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huurder moet langer wachten en is duurder uit'

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether the decline in social rental stock, longer waiting times, rent rises and priority allocation of social housing to status holders were acceptable, and whether rents would be cut. The minister rejected the criticism, citing growing corporation output, planned rent measures and CBS data showing rent increases below inflation, and refused to accept that priority for status holders is unfair.
I consider it important that housing corporations build more social rental homes.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat corporaties meer sociale huurwoningen gaan bouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Proefproject 'van gas af' stilgelegd'

PVV MPs asked whether the Purmerend Overwhere-Zuid gas-free pilot, a Programma Aardgasvrije Wijken project, was halted, questioning costs, the EUR 6.9 million allocation and the EUR 100 million second round. The minister replied that the pilot was not stopped but delayed for evaluation, that the funds are a municipal decentralisation grant rather than a subsidy, and that she stands by the programme's learning goal.
An overview of progress at the pilot sites will be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2021 through the annual progress report of the PAW.
Een overzicht van de voortgang bij de proeftuinen zal ik aan uw Kamer sturen in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 middels de jaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage van het PAW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht 'Greenpeace gooit opnieuw keien op zeebodem: 'Levensgevaarlijke actie''

PVV MPs asked whether Greenpeace dumping boulders on the North Sea bed endangers fishers, whether this should be prosecuted as attempted murder or manslaughter, why the Dutch flag can be kept, and whether Greenpeace can be banned. The Minister replied that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, which is examining the matter, that the flag cannot be withdrawn under Dutch law, and that only a court on Public Prosecution Service request can dissolve an organisation.
A judgement on the criminality of this conduct is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Een oordeel over de strafbaarheid van dit handelen is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'gemeente Venlo zoekt naar andere locatie voor beachveld'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Venlo municipality plan to relocate a beach volleyball pitch after objections from a nearby mosque, including questions framing Muslim demands as incompatible with Western culture and proposing that the mosque be moved abroad. The minister answered that the matter is local, rejected the framing of objections as 'gezever' and of Islam as making 'demands', and declined to intervene.
No, this concerns a local matter.
Nee, het betreft hier een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Van Weerdenburg over ‘nog meer Nederlands hulpgeld voor Palestijnse terroristen’

MPs De Roon, Wilders and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked why Dutch aid money goes to Palestinian NGO Al-Mezan, alleged to have ties with PFLP and Hamas, and demanded vetting of all Palestinian aid recipients and suspension of aid. The government denied evidence of links, said it will await an external investigation into UAWC, promised to remove posts from individual staff, and refused to halt aid or close the Ramallah mission.
The cabinet does not provide support to organisations that have ties with terrorist organisations and checks whether the Dutch contribution to these organisations is spent on the agreed objectives.

Het kabinet geeft geen steun aan organisaties die banden hebben met terroristische organisaties en controleert of de Nederlandse bijdrage aan deze organisaties wordt besteed aan de afgesproken doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over berichten dat NAVO-lid Turkije moslimextremisten uit Syrië naar Azerbeidzjan stuurt en ook aan de strijd deelneemt

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Turkey is sending Islamist fighters from Syria to Azerbaijan, whether Turkey is directly fighting, whether the government will press Turkey to stop, what measures will protect Armenians, and whether Turkey should be removed from NATO. The minister replied that the government has no independent information confirming the transfers or Turkish combat involvement, which both countries deny, urged de-escalation and dialogue, and said expulsion from NATO is neither in the Dutch nor the alliance's interest and is not provided for by the treaty.
The cabinet has no independent information that Turkey has transferred foreign fighters to Azerbaijan.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie dat Turkije buitenlandse strijders naar Azerbeidzjan heeft overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de coronatestlocatie op Schiphol alweer gesloten wordt wegens gebrek aan testcapaciteit

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site was closing for lack of capacity, how many risk-area travellers were tested and how many were positive, what happened to the promise to test travellers before boarding, and why there was insufficient test capacity. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a pilot to test asymptomatic people, that about 1.6% of 19,012 tested were positive, that pre-departure testing is legally hard to mandate and is being explored at EU level, and that test capacity shortages stem from material constraints and higher demand, with sufficiency expected by early October.
I have previously indicated that this is being further explored, including at European level.
Ik heb eerder aangegeven dat dit verder verkend wordt, ook in Europees verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat een meneer na 123 dagen op de IC overleed aan corona

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister for Medical Care about a reported COVID-19 patient who died after 123 days in intensive care, and about current ICU numbers and long ICU stays. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, gave the number of COVID ICU patients on 16 September (54), and provided a table of COVID admissions lasting over 21 days by period, but did not answer before the deadline.
On 16 September there were 54 COVID patients in the ICU
Op 16 september lagen er 54 COVID-patiënten op de IC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower en Graus over heksenjacht door NVWA

MPs De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower and Graus asked whether the government instructed the NVWA to target the Israel Producten Centrum over labelling of wine from Judea and Samaria, and why Israel is treated differently from other countries. Minister Blok answered that the NVWA acts on complaints under EU origin-labelling rules applied equally to all countries, and that a binding CJEU ruling requires settlement-origin labelling.
No. Following a complaint received, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) carried out an inspection in April 2019.
Nee. Naar aanleiding van een binnengekomen klacht heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in april 2019 een inspectie uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'A. broedt op derde aanval'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a Syrian asylum seeker who had twice attacked a Jewish restaurant could be deported, whether prosecutors were too lenient in the first case, and what measures would prevent a third attack. The Minister said the residence permit will be reviewed by the IND after conviction and deportation is not currently possible due to the Syrian security situation, declined to comment on the pending case, and pointed to existing police and municipal measures.
Moreover, I understand that the Public Prosecution Service is currently still investigating whether there is reason to also charge a terrorist intent in the current trial.
Overigens heb ik begrepen dat het OM op dit moment nog onderzoekt of er aanleiding bestaat om in de huidige rechtszaak ook een terroristisch oogmerk ten laste te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de corona-teststraat op Schiphol ’s avonds dicht is, ook al landen er duizenden reizigers uit risicogebieden

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked why the Schiphol COVID test site closes in the evening while thousands of travellers from risk areas arrive, and about a 2003 SARS study showing aircraft transmission. Minister De Jonge answered that the site was a research setting, lab capacity is strained, it has been temporarily closed, EU coordination on pre-departure testing is ongoing with no mandatory testing in the Netherlands, and aircraft transmission risks appear limited.
The test site at Schiphol was a research setting examining the effect of testing people without symptoms, in this case travellers.
De teststraat op Schiphol was een onderzoeksetting waarin werd gekeken naar het effect van het testen van mensen zonder klachten, in dit geval reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het aantal besmettingen met corona de afgelopen twee weken is gedaald.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister why the reproduction number stayed above 1 even though weekly infections fell by 2.5 and 3.5 percent. Minister De Jonge explained how R is calculated over the preceding two weeks by RIVM, confirmed infections fell in weeks 33 and 34 but rose again from September, and noted that recent R estimates are not shown on the dashboard due to insufficient reliability.
The reliability of R estimates less than two weeks ago is insufficient and they are not shown on the dashboard.
De betrouwbaarheid voor R schattingen minder dan twee weken geleden is onvoldoende en wordt niet op het dashboard weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Emiel van Dijk en Kops over het aan hun lot overlaten van kwetsbare Nederlanders ten gunste van statushouders in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Amsterdam gives housing priority to refugee status holders over Dutch residents with medical problems, and whether subsidies to Amsterdam should be cut. The minister replied that there is no discrimination by nationality, that municipalities set their own urgency categories and must meet the statutory quota, and that she will not withhold support but is funding pilots and housing projects.
No distinction is made in the Netherlands on the basis of nationality.
In Nederland wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt op basis van nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat het RIVM het protocol voor bron- en contactonderzoek aanpaste na een telefoontje van VWS

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked whether RIVM changed its contact-tracing protocol after a call from the Ministry of VWS, why, and for a full list of protocol changes prompted by the ministry. The minister confirms the mid-quarantine call was dropped after RIVM and GGD GHOR consulted, citing the shortened quarantine and burdensome calls, and says protocol changes are made regularly with expert input and listed publicly.
Following this report, the Ministry of VWS inquired with RIVM whether sufficient account had been taken, in this consideration, of the upcoming adjustment to the GGD GHOR Nederland scaling-up plan.

Naar aanleiding van deze berichtgeving is er vanuit het Ministerie van VWS navraag gedaan bij het RIVM of in deze afweging voldoende rekening gehouden werd met de aanpassing van het opschalingsplan van GGD GHOR Nederland dat aanstaande was.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de uitspraak van de directeur van het RIVM gedaan tijdens de technische briefing van 11 augustus 2020 dat de besmettingen met corona in Dokkum “evident“ buiten gebeur

Opposition MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health minister whether the RIVM director's claim that Dokkum COVID infections were evidently transmitted outdoors was based only on media reports, and whether he should have investigated first. The minister confirmed awareness of the remarks, denied that the claim rested only on media reports, and said the GGD considered outdoor transmission very plausible but not certain, the director using the case as an illustration.
Mr Van Dissel used this case as an illustration that transmission outdoors is indeed possible.
De heer van Dissel heeft deze casus als illustratie gebruikt dat overdracht ook buiten wel degelijk mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat van 70 procent van de coronabesmettingen onbekend is waar men het heeft opgelopen.

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about reports that for 70 percent of COVID-19 infections the source is unknown, and whether this means contact tracing is failing and whether the home-visitor limit of six persons is proportionate. The minister replied that the 70 percent figure does not mean the source is unknown, that the home is the most common setting, and that the measure is proportionate.
However, this does not mean that in all other cases we have no idea what the setting of the infection was.
Dit wil echter niet zeggen dat we in alle andere gevallen geen idee hebben wat de setting van de besmetting is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kolossale fouten gemaakt bij terugkeer tbs’er Michel B.’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of serious failures in the Oostvaarderskliniek's supervision of tbs patient Michel B. and whether other tbs patients are adequately monitored, and asked for the draft inspectorate report and a suspension of all tbs leave. The minister declined to share the draft report pending the final version, expected in autumn, said leave is a safe, essential part of tbs treatment, and refused to suspend leave.
The Inspectorate JenV report is still in draft form and is currently under embargo for hearing of the parties involved.
Het rapport van de Inspectie JenV bevindt zich nog in de conceptfase, en ligt nu onder embargo voor wederhoor voor bij betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat de onderzoeker stelt dat bij de uitbraak van corona in een zorginstelling de ventilatie vrijwel zeker een rol heeft gespeeld.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health how he responds to a researcher's claim, broadcast on Op1, that ventilation very likely contributed to a corona outbreak at a Maassluis care home, and why GGD conclusions were published before the underlying studies. The minister disputes the claim, says viral traces on ventilation equipment were very low, and attaches the public version of the study.
I have attached the public version of the study, which was published on the website of the GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond.
Ik heb de publieksversie van het onderzoek, die op de website van de GGD Rotterdam-Rijnmond is gepubliceerd, bijgevoegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het twitterbericht van de minister van VWS waarin hij schrijft dat we pas veilig zijn voor het coronavirus wanneer er een vaccin is

MPs Wilders and Agema asked Minister De Jonge to justify his tweet that we are only safe from the coronavirus once a vaccine exists, and questioned why medicines, ventilation, or preparedness would not suffice, plus the Mexican flu vaccine compensation. The minister argued vaccines are the most effective preventive tool, that medicines and preparedness play supporting roles, and that the narcolepsy compensation process is still ongoing.
The process aims to reach an amicable settlement. This process is still ongoing.
Het proces is erop gericht om te komen tot een minnelijke regeling. Dit proces is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat er nog steeds een tekort is aan handschoenen in de verpleeghuizen.

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister about reports that nursing homes still lack gloves, and why the government cannot secure protective equipment while imposing corona measures. The minister acknowledged a temporary shortage, said it has now eased, and described the ordering channels available to care providers.
There was temporarily a tight supply, but meanwhile so many gloves have arrived and are available that the situation has eased.
Er was tijdelijk een krappe voorraad maar inmiddels zijn er dusdanig veel handschoenen binnengekomen en leverbaar dat die situatie is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Irakees die zijn Friese vrouw voor ogen van hun kinderen doodde alweer vrij'

PVV MPs asked why an Iraqi man who killed his Frisian wife in front of their children was released so quickly by Iraqi authorities, and called for entry bans and an end to asylum for nationals of countries such as Iraq. The State Secretary said Iraq's prosecution is an internal matter he cannot judge, that Nederland uses Article 1F to exclude criminals from asylum, and that asylum claims must be assessed individually rather than halted by country.
At the same time, in my view it is not for a minister to pass judgment on the prosecution of a criminal offence.
Tegelijkertijd is het naar mijn mening niet aan een bewindspersoon om een oordeel uit te spreken over de berechting van een strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Neonazi Heerlen’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether the German-Iraqi neo-Nazi Fadi J. and his party, who called for killing Jews, should be prosecuted, expelled, and whether the government tolerates violence against Jews. The minister answered that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, expulsion for the courts, and that a general conclusion cannot be drawn from one case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make such decisions, not for me as Minister of Justice and Security.
Het is aan het OM om dergelijke beslissingen te nemen, niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over de door het ministerie van J&V en het COA ondersteunde promotievideo over Nederland als bestemmingsland voor asielzoekers

PVV MPs Van Dijk and Wilders asked whether the government supported a video promoting the Netherlands to asylum seekers, its costs, and whether it would be removed and asylum entry stopped. The State Secretary answered that the video was made and funded by an external party, that the ministries and agencies were only consulted, and that the government bears no responsibility for it and will not close the borders.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, COA and IND are not the sender of the video and did not finance it.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, COA en IND zijn niet de afzender van het filmpje en hebben dit ook niet gefinancierd.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hoe een Haagse moskee een verzamelplaats voor jihadisten werd,’

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why a The Hague mosque allegedly became a gathering place for jihadists, whether the municipality's radicalisation approach is evidence-based, and whether the mosque should be closed and administrative detention introduced. The minister defended the persoonsgerichte aanpak as evidence-supported, declined to name individuals, rejected closing the mosque and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ruit ingeslagen bij restaurant HaCarmel: ‘Het begint bijna gewoon te worden’’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the 100-metre exclusion order on the Syrian asylum-seeker suspected of attacking restaurant HaCarmel was apparently not enforced, and whether the government was responsible. Minister Grapperhaus replied that police did enforce the order with intensive surveillance when warranted and municipal cameras, that the suspect is in pre-trial detention, and that any residence-permit withdrawal and deportation will follow normal procedures, with forced return currently not possible due to the Syrian security situation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over toenemende agressie van Hezbollah tegen Israël

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Hezbollah aggression against Israel, including the EU's failure to list Hezbollah's political wing, the role of UNIFIL, and Dutch support for Israel. The minister answered that the situation is tense but not escalated, that UNIFIL supports de-escalation under resolution 1701, that the Netherlands lists all of Hezbollah as terrorist, and that no Israeli request for aid exists.
The Netherlands has designated Hezbollah in its entirety as a terrorist organisation since 2004, making no distinction between the political and military wings of the organisation.
Nederland bestempelt Hezbollah sinds 2004 in zijn geheel als terroristische organisatie, waarbij geen onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen de politieke en militaire tak van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Markuszower en Wilders over een massale vechtpartij in AZC Budel

PVV MPs asked why only one asylum seeker was arrested after a mass brawl at AZC Budel involving about 100 residents, whether all rioters would be jailed and deported, and whether the centre and all AZCs should be closed and an asylum stop imposed. The State Secretary said about 15 people were directly or indirectly involved, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and rejected closing the centres or borders, noting COA can impose sanctions under the ROV.
While the criminal investigation is ongoing, I cannot provide further information on the outcome of this investigation.
Gedurende het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat de overheid wil dat Nederlanders een asielzoeker in huis nemen

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the government wants Dutch citizens to host asylum seekers, asking why it does not close the borders instead, whether the minister has hosted anyone, whether well-known Dutch people were asked to host, and whether hosting will ever become mandatory. The State Secretary answered that the voluntary logeerregeling applies only to status holders (vergunninghouders), not asylum seekers, that closing borders is not a realistic solution, and that participation remains voluntary for both host and guest.
This starting point of the scheme is not up for discussion.
Dit uitgangspunt van de regeling staat niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Hezbollah en ammoniumnitraat

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hezbollah stored ammonium nitrate and about threats by its leader, and whether the Beirut explosion's chemicals belonged to Hezbollah and how to undermine the group internationally. The minister replied that the Beirut blast was an accident involving seized substances, that the Netherlands supports independent international investigation, and that Hezbollah's military wing has been on the EU terrorist list since 2013 while the Dutch push for listing the political wing lacks support.
The Netherlands strongly advocates thorough, independent international investigation into the explosion and is exploring contributing technical expertise to it.
Nederland maakt zich hard voor gedegen, onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek naar de explosie en onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om hieraan bij te dragen met technische expertise.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrijdaggebed van de krappe moskee naar een ruim bemeten voetbalveld’

Two PVV MPs asked whether Muslim public prayer gatherings should be banned during the coronavirus period, whether all municipalities should be told to stop them, and when all mosques will be closed. The Minister answered that freedom of religion, assembly and expression apply equally to all religious gatherings, that the government will not ban or close all mosques, and gave no commitment to action.
The same rules therefore apply to all types of religious gatherings in the Netherlands; no distinction is made based on religious belief.
Voor alle soorten religieuze samenkomsten gelden dan ook dezelfde regels in Nederland, er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar religieuze overtuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over Statement on Black Lives Matter

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a University College Utrecht Black Lives Matter statement by dean James Kennedy, who also chairs the national canon revision, was ideological and should have been avoided; they also asked whether institutions should stop expressing solidarity with the movement. The minister rejected the criticism, saying the statement promotes awareness and that universities may engage on social issues, leaving the approach to institutions.
It is important that an open discussion about social events takes place within education, and it is education's task to promote good citizenship.
Het is belangrijk dat binnen het onderwijs een open discussie gevoerd wordt over maatschappelijke gebeurtenissen en het is de taak van het onderwijs goed burgerschap te bevorderen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht van de Vereniging van Ouderengeneeskundigen (Verenso) dat stelt dat het voorkomen van een nieuwe lockdown in verpleeghuizen bij een tweede coronagolf vraagt om een an

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Minister of Health about a Verenso statement that preventing a renewed nursing-home lockdown requires a different organisation of care, and about protective equipment, testing, deaths and the use of sedating medication in nursing homes during the lockdown. The minister answered that lessons are being drawn from the bezoekregeling, that protective equipment and testing are secured, and that IGJ is verifying signals on sedative medication use.
There are currently no hard figures available on the use of sedating medication in nursing homes.
Er zijn op dit moment geen harde cijfers beschikbaar over de toepassing van rustgevende medicatie in verpleeghuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over een bericht van Hogeschool InHolland op Facebook

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the minister whether a Hogeschool InHolland Facebook post on Black Lives Matter and anti-racism was indoctrination and whether diversity officers and university-wide anti-racism framing should be stopped. The minister rejected the characterisations, said institutions have freedom to organise education and that diversity work is a matter for each institution, and refused to intervene.
It is up to the institutions to decide whether or not diversity officers are appointed.
Het is aan de instellingen om te bepalen of er wel of geen diversity officers aangesteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het artikel ‘Helpt ventileren tegen corona? Nederland negeert Duits advies frisse lucht’

MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Health Minister about a newspaper article on ventilation against COVID-19, requesting OMT advice, Dutch research on aerogenic transmission, current infection and hospital figures, IFR, the PIENTER study and an evaluation of PCR tests. The minister mostly provided requested figures and referred to RIVM publications and a technical briefing, while declining to answer the question on the unidentified evaluation report as unclear.
For the answers to these questions, I refer you to the letter to the House of 24 June 2020 and its annex: the OMT advice.
Voor de antwoorden op deze vragen, verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief van 24 juni 2020 en de bijlage van de Kamerbrief: het OMT-advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de inzet van biomassa

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of forest clearing in Estonia for biomass pellets, whether biomass is CO2-reducing, and whether the 14 billion euro in subsidies is justified. The minister denies that whole forests are cleared for Dutch use, says subsidised pellets must meet sustainability criteria that are checked, defends biomass as climate-neutral when sustainable, and rejects ending climate policy.
All wood pellets used in the Netherlands with subsidy must meet strict sustainability criteria.
Alle houtpellets die in Nederland met subsidie worden gebruikt, moeten voldoen aan strenge duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Markuszower over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would publicly condemn the arson at the Jewish tomb of Esther and Mordechai in Iran, whether he still considered it adequately protected, and whether he would press Iran to protect it. The minister said the Netherlands regularly raises antisemitism concerns with Iran, that local authorities opened an investigation, and that the Supreme Leader's threatening rhetoric is unacceptable, but gave no commitment beyond continued diplomatic engagement.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about antisemitism and anti-Zionism in Iran in talks with the Iranian authorities and will continue to do so.
Nederland brengt met regelmaat zorgen over antisemitisme en antizionisme in Iran over in gesprekken met de Iraanse autoriteiten en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Kops en Wilders over de achterstelling van Nederlandse woningzoekenden

PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Vlaardingen giving refugees priority on social rental housing is discrimination against Dutch citizens, whether municipalities should be barred from such priority, and whether temporary asylum permits should be withdrawn so social housing goes only to Dutch nationals. The minister rejected the discrimination framing, explained that municipalities set their own urgency categories and that housing refugees serves integration, and refused to withdraw asylum permits.

After the mandatory urgency status of status holders was removed from the Housing Act on 1 July 2017, municipalities can themselves decide which categories of housing seekers they wish to include as urgency categories in the housing ordinance.

Nadat de verplichte urgentiestatus van statushouders per 1 juli 2017 uit de Huisvestingswet is gehaald kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen welke categorieën woningzoekenden ze als urgentiecategorie in de huisvestingsverordening wensen op te nemen.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Wilders over de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security to send the complete app exchange between the minister and the Amsterdam mayor about a demonstration before a parliamentary debate that afternoon. The minister's response is a reference to a separate letter answering the request, with no substance in this item itself.

Will you send the complete app exchange between the Minister of Justice and Security and the Amsterdam mayor about last Monday's demonstration to the House before the plenary debate on the coronavirus developments begins at 14:00 this afternoon?

Wilt u voor het begin van het plenaire debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus hedenmiddag 14.00 uur de complete app-wisseling tussen de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en de burgemeester van Amsterdam inzake de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag naar de Kamer sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘islamitische school hoort erbij’

PVV MPs asked whether an Islamic secondary school in Rotterdam should be denied funding, questioning the government's support for it and calling for all Islamic education to be abolished. The minister replied that the school's application met the statutory conditions under the WVO and that freedom of education is constitutionally protected, so neither revoking the permit nor abolishing Islamic education would be done.
The request from the Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) was assessed against the applicable laws and regulations.
Het verzoek van de Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) is getoetst aan vigerende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het sluiten van de Nederlandse kolencentrales

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would close coal plants when other countries keep building them, whether this undermines energy reliability, and whether the government will withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister answered that the government is preparing additional measures under the Urgenda ruling, that the coal ban has a small global temperature effect but is an effective national CO2 measure, that energy reliability is currently in order according to TenneT, and that the government will not withdraw from Paris.
I will inform the House shortly about the results of this.
Ik zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de resultaten hiervan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka
