Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over de discrepantie tussen de berichtgeving over bestellingen en leveringen van beschermingsmiddelen en de tekorten die nog steeds worden ervaren door zorgmedewerkers

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the health ministers about the gap between reports of protective equipment orders and deliveries and continuing shortages for care workers, referencing an adopted motion and the state of affairs letter, and asked whether supplies are adequate across hospitals, nursing homes, GP practices, home care, and disability/youth/mental health settings. The government answered by referring to its COVID-19 state of affairs letter of the same date rather than answering the questions separately.

The written questions from MPs Wilders and Agema (both PVV) to the Ministers of Health, Welfare and Sport and for Medical Care (2020Z06296) have been answered by letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Medische Zorg ( 2020Z06296 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het weigeren van de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant locatie Breda om gedenkplaten te plaatsen

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked why the Zeeland-West-Brabant court (Breda location) refuses to install commemorative plaques for Jewish judges murdered in WWII, as exist in Amsterdam and The Hague. The Minister replied that the judiciary independently decides on such memorials, that the court found no evidence of Jewish staff victims in its archives, and that the Minister will not engage the court.
The judiciary has the authority to independently decide whether or not to place a memorial.
De Rechtspraak heeft de bevoegdheid om zelfstandig te beslissen over het al dan niet plaatsen van een gedenkteken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de capaciteit van IC-units en beademingsapparaten in Nederland i.v.m. de Corona-pandemie

An MP from the PVV asked the Prime Minister and the Health Minister how many COVID-19 patients were in Dutch intensive care, the projected growth, current IC and ventilator capacity, and what would be done to keep care available. The minister referred to the NVIC website for patient numbers and to earlier letters for capacity measures, gave no concrete figures or projections, and did not answer on the Friday deadline.
To keep everyone well informed about the number of COVID-19 patients in intensive care, the Dutch Association of Intensive Care (NVIC) updates the number daily on its website.

Antwoord 1, 2 Om iedereen blijvend goed te informeren over het aantal COVID-19-patiënten dat op de IC ligt, houdt de Nederlandse Vereniging van Intensive Care (NVIC) dagelijks op haar website ( www.nvic.nl ) bij om hoeveel patiënten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar het e-mailverkeer van maart 2014 tot 9 december 2016 over de uitspraken van de heer Wilders

MP Wilders asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether documents from a June 2014 reflection meeting and an August 2014 College of Procurators-General meeting exist, whether the e-mail traffic on the 2016 FOIA request will be released, and whether a dismissal (sepot) was planned for his March 2014 statements and whether former minister Opstelten knew of it. The minister answered that no such meeting documents or dismissal notices were found, that the court is the proper forum for disclosure of material in the pending case, and that the e-mail traffic on the 2016 FOIA request will be provided with confidential annexes made available for inspection.

When asked, the OM takes the position that for a request to disclose information and documents that touch on the content of the pending, and therefore ongoing, criminal case before the Court, the Court is the designated forum.

Desgevraagd stelt het OM zich op het standpunt dat voor een verzoek tot openbaarmaking van informatie en stukken die de inhoud van de bij het Hof aanhangige en dus lopende strafzaak raken, het Hof het aangewezen forum is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Aalst en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers buschauffeurs intimideren en reizigers bestelen

PVV MPs asked why asylum seekers who intimidate bus drivers and rob passengers are allowed to continue, and whether they should be expelled or jailed. The state secretary answered that overlast by asylum seekers is a serious but relatively small group problem, cited cooperation with transport partners, a landelijk convenant and Top-X lists, and said such behaviour leads to lik-op-stuk measures.
For nuisance behaviour the starting point is that, regardless of the person, this is not tolerated and leads to firm enforcement measures.
Bij overlastgevend gedrag is het vertrekpunt dat, ongeacht de persoon, dit niet wordt getolereerd en dit leidt tot lik-op-stuk maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over anti-Israëlstraatnaamborden in Eindhoven

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked whether street-name signs in Eindhoven describing Israeli places as 'in Palestine' are factually wrong, and whether the municipality should be forced to replace them promptly. Minister Knops agreed the descriptions are incorrect, said the municipality now plans to replace the signs this spring and has already updated the register, and rejected the claim that the signs reflect anti-Israel policy.
The municipality is thereby acting in accordance with its 2014 commitments.
Daarmee handelt de gemeente conform de toezeggingen uit 2014.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het bericht dat hoogbejaarden in woonzorgcentrum Mariaoord te Rosmalen dekens moeten omdoen omdat de verwarming in de gangen uitgezet is wegens CO2-gekte

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the minister whether he shares the view that frail elderly residents of nursing home Mariaoord should not be left cold because heating in corridors was switched off for CO2 reasons, and what he will do about it. The minister answered that a comfortable indoor climate matters, that the Kwaliteitskader Verpleeghuiszorg applies, that the home's measures are evaluated with residents and the client council, and that the IGJ supervises quality and safety and can intervene.
That is why the measures taken are evaluated with residents and the client council so that residents' comfort is not compromised.
Daarom worden ingezette maatregelen geëvalueerd met bewoners en de cliëntenraad opdat het comfort van de bewoners niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over stijgende energielasten door warmtepompen en laadpalen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether rising household energy bills from heat pumps and EV chargers are acceptable, and whether he would abandon climate policy. The minister acknowledged grid investment is needed, pointed to the Climate Agreement and tax measures to lower bills in 2020, and refused to end the climate policy.
The cabinet understands the concerns surrounding the energy bill and considers it important that the energy transition be feasible and affordable for everyone.
Het kabinet begrijpt de zorgen die rond de energierekening leven en vindt het belangrijk dat de energietransitie voor iedereen haalbaar en betaalbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over te pessimistische klimaatonderzoeken

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the minister whether climate research using pessimistic scenarios like RCP8.5 is misleading and whether the government will stop its climate agenda and withdraw from the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected these claims, arguing that worst-case scenarios remain necessary for risk planning, that sea-level rise risks justify precautionary policy, and that Dutch participation in the Paris Agreement continues.
The Netherlands is and remains a party to the Paris Climate Agreement, because it offers the greatest chance of an effective global approach
Nederland is en blijft partij bij het Klimaatakkoord van Parijs, omdat dat de grootste kans biedt op een effectieve mondiale aanpak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Erdogan die dreigt politieke tegenstanders in Europa te kidnappen of vermoorden

MPs De Roon, Markuszower and Wilders asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether Erdogan's reported threats to kidnap or kill political opponents in Europe were known, how many Turkish extradition requests Netherlands received since 2016, and what measures were taken. The government said it knows of reports on repatriation of Turkish nationals from third countries, has no indication of Turkish kidnapping teams active in the Netherlands, and that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to file complaints.
The cabinet currently has no indication that Turkish abduction teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzing dat er in Nederland Turkse ontvoeringsteams actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het toenemende aantal huishoudens dat de energierekening niet meer kan betalen

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the rising number of households unable to pay energy bills and whether the government's energy and climate policy causes energy poverty. The minister rejected the link, pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures shifting costs to businesses and lowering the tax burden on households, and said the government monitors energy bill affordability, but did not commit to reversing policy.
The cabinet keeps a close eye on developments in energy bills and monitors the development of the energy bill.
Het kabinet houdt een vinger aan de pols en volgt de ontwikkeling van de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over illegalen die panden kraken

MPs Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk and Wilders asked why the "We are here" group of squatters can squat buildings unpunished, whether members have been prosecuted or removed from the Netherlands, and whether they will be evicted and expelled immediately. The Minister answered that no figures on prosecutions or removals of this group are kept, that arrest does not end unlawful squatting (eviction is the effective tool), that the OM applies its existing policy, and that most of the group refuses to cooperate with return.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep records of criminal offences committed by persons who count themselves as part of the "We are here" group.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van strafbare feiten die gepleegd zijn door personen die zich rekenen tot de «We are here» groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Turkse aanval op Koerden in Syrië en de chantagepraktijken van Erdogan

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Turkey demanded 28 billion euros in a migrant deal, the status of EU-Turkey accession talks, and how to stop EU funds reaching Erdogan after Turkey's military incursion into Syria. The minister said no such request is known, accession talks are effectively frozen, the Netherlands opposes pre-accession aid, and Turkey remains a valued NATO ally.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Syriëgangers op ambassade Ankara’

Two PVV MPs asked the government how two women who joined IS and their children reached the Dutch embassy in Ankara, and whether such returnees should be permanently barred from Dutch soil. The government said the women escaped the Al Hol camp weeks earlier and reported at the embassy, declined individual details, and explained that Dutch nationals are normally returned in a controlled way for prosecution, with arrest, terrorism detention and possible nationality revocation.
Beyond that, we cannot go into individual cases.
Voor de rest kunnen wij hier niet op individuele gevallen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong, Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht 'Korten kan niet wachten'

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about DNB calls for pension cuts, questioning DNB's stance and its president's fitness, and asked for cuts to be taken off the table. The minister rejected these views, defended DNB's independence and advisory role, and acknowledged that some pension entitlements may need to be reduced while promising a ministerial regulation to soften the MVEV cut.
Following the pension agreement of 5 June 2019, I do intend to draft a ministerial regulation that can soften the so-called MVEV cut by giving pension funds more time to meet the MVEV requirement.
Voortvloeiend uit het pensioenakkoord van 5 juni 2019 ben ik wel voornemens om een ministeriële regeling uit te werken die de zogenoemde MVEV-korting kan verzachten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Wilders en Kops (allen PVV) over een nog hogere bijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese meerjarenbegroting

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with Commissioner-designate Timmermans that rich EU states like the Netherlands should pay more into the EU budget for a climate agenda, and how he would reduce Dutch contributions. The minister answered that the government supports the Green Deal and a Just Transition Fund to be financed within the MFF framework, rejected the claim that the nomination harms the Dutch negotiating position, and committed to pressing for budget savings and possible corrections on contributions.
Once the Commission proposal for the fund has been published, the cabinet will inform your House further.
Zodra het Commissievoorstel voor het fonds is gepubliceerd zal het kabinet uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de greep in de ABP-kas

An MP asked whether the government's past premium reductions for the ABP pension fund, which allegedly cost pensioners over 30 billion guilders, were a political misstep warranting compensation. The Minister of the Interior replied that the cuts followed the rules of the time, the fund has been independent since 1996, and no compensation is warranted.
Contrary to what you state, in my view there is no question of a political misconduct.
Anders dan u stelt is er naar mijn overtuiging geen sprake van een politieke misstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Blauwe moskee wil gebedsoproepen met luidsprekers versterken’

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether mosques should be closed given their alleged danger to democracy and minority rights, and what action the government would take against Friday prayer calls amplified by loudspeakers. The minister answered that founding mosques falls under religious, association and expression freedoms so closing all mosques is not an option, and that prayer calls are permitted under the Wet openbare manifestaties, with municipalities able to set rules on duration and volume.
To protect these important hard-won freedoms, the government will never resort to closing all mosques in the Netherlands.
Ter bescherming van deze belangrijke verworven vrijheden zal de overheid nooit overgaan tot het sluiten van alle moskeeën in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders (allen PVV) over een door de Europese Unie gefinancierd Turks rapport over islamofobie

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funded a Turkish think tank's report on Islamophobia that they say is government propaganda, how much money was involved, and whether Brussels will stop the funding. The minister confirmed the report was partly EU-funded through a civil society dialogue programme selected by Turkey's foreign ministry, said the EU does not endorse its content, and said the Netherlands has pushed to suspend pre-accession aid without sufficient support.
In this specific case, 90% of the total budget of € 126,951.81 for this SETA publication was financed by the CSD.
In dit specifieke geval is 90% van het totaalbudget van € 126,951.81 voor deze publicatie van SETA door CSD gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten en opbrengsten in de belastingsfeer van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the tax revenue and costs attributable to (non-Western) people with a migration background, including tax, benefits and exports of pensions. The minister replied that individual tax contributions cannot be traced for indirect taxes, the Tax Administration does not record migration background, and the requested breakdowns are not available.
For no single person or household can it be determined exactly how much tax money they pay.
Van geen enkele persoon of geen enkel huishouden is exact vast te stellen hoeveel belastinggeld door hem of haar wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the costs of (non-Western) immigrant-background residents across justice and security spending, and to say how it compares with revenues from fees. The minister answered that police, terrorism, prison, and immigration services do not record costs or outcomes by migration background, so the requested breakdowns and estimates cannot be provided.
Data on the costs of police deployment with regard to citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan allochtonen toe te rekenen kosten op het gebied van woning/huisvesting (sociale huurwoningen, huurtoeslag, subsidies etc.)

PVV MPs Wilders, Fritsma and Van Dijk asked the government to quantify housing-related costs (social rentals, rent allowance, subsidies) attributable to non-Western immigrants, compare them with the group's share of the population and its housing-market effects, and break them down by year. The minister answered that no data exist on costs attributable to people with a migration background, that no central administration tracks this, and that no realistic estimate can be made given the many organisations involved.
I have no insight into what share of all housing-related costs can be attributed to Dutch nationals with a Western or non-Western migration background, and I cannot calculate this either.

Ik heb geen inzicht in welk deel van alle aan wonen/huisvesting gerelateerde kosten toe te rekenen zijn aan Nederlanders met een (westerse of niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond en kan dit ook niet berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over EZK-gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the minister for economic affairs to quantify the costs to the state of (non-Western) immigrants in EZK policy areas, compared with the revenue they generate, broken down by year. The government answered that EZK has no administrative system linking policy spending to migration background, so no such data exist, and referred the cost question to the minister of social affairs.

Since that answer, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate has not adopted an administrative system relating policy spending to the possible (Western or non-Western) migration background of recipients.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat is sinds die beantwoording niet overgegaan tot een administratiesysteem waarbij uitgegeven beleidsgelden worden gerelateerd aan de eventuele (westerse of niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond van ontvangers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the infrastructure and water management costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, their share relative to population and revenues, and a breakdown over past, current and projected years. The minister replied that Infrastructure and Water Management does not classify costs by migration background, as in 2009, and referred to a covering letter for the sixth question.

In the answer to the questions of 17 July 2009 it was indicated that Infrastructure and Water Management does not apply a breakdown of costs by citizens with a (non-Western/Western) migration background.
In het antwoord op de vragen van 17 juli 2009 is aangegeven dat Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen indeling in kosten naar burgers met een (niet-westerse/westerse) migratieachtergrond hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kwantificering van zorgkosten

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify health and care costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, premium arrears, and targeted programmes. The minister answered that no breakdown by migration background is available for most items, gave an estimate of about 2.2 million euros for medically necessary care to uninsured non-Western-background residents, and pointed to other sources for cost differences.
We have no insight into what share of care costs is spent on Dutch residents with a migration background.
We hebben geen inzicht in welk deel van de kosten van zorg wordt aangewend voor Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan Defensie gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the Defence Ministry for the costs attributable to people with a non-Western migration background, including Marechaussee enforcement of removals, chaplaincy and halal catering, and the benefits those groups bring. The government answered that Defence has no insight into costs by migration background, gave Marechaussee Vreemdelingenwet costs of EUR 184.8 million in 2018 without any breakdown by origin, and described the chaplaincy and catering arrangements without attributing costs to specific groups.
Defence has no insight into the costs arising from the presence of citizens with a (non-Western/Western) migration background in the Netherlands.
Defensie heeft geen inzicht in de kosten die voortvloeien uit de aanwezigheid van burgers met een (niet-westerse/westerse) migratieachtergrond in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van OCW-voorzieningen voor Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers of education, culture and media to quantify the costs of education and culture provisions for people with a non-Western migration background and to say how these compare with their returns. The government answered that costs cannot be attributed to origin because funding is lump-sum and not tracked by background, and cited targeted programmes and their amounts.
The share of pupils and students with a non-Western migration background cannot be translated into a share of the costs.
Het aandeel leerlingen en studenten met een niet-westerse migratieachtergrond kan niet worden doorvertaald naar een aandeel in de kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten gerelateerd aan de sociale zekerheid van personen met een migratieachtergrond

An MP asked the minister, for the second time in a decade, for a full financial breakdown of social security costs attributable to non-Western migrants, including benefits, remigration payments and workers' insurance. The minister answered with CBS data on benefit use by migration background and said total cost attribution cannot be made one-to-one, though some figures were given.
The CBS has no data on the costs of social security use broken down by persons with and without (non-Western) migration background.
Het CBS heeft geen gegevens over de kosten van het gebruik van de sociale zekerheid uitgesplitst naar personen met en zonder (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over kosten, die voortvloeien uit de aanwezigheid van (niet-westerse) allochtonen in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify costs arising from the presence of (non-Western) immigrants in the Netherlands, including police, intelligence, BZK programmes, provincial and municipal funds. The minister answered that most of these costs cannot be broken down by ethnic background because such data are not kept or not permitted, pointing to other responsible ministries and municipalities.
Data on the costs of police deployment for citizens with a (non-Western) migration background are not available.
Gegevens over de kosten van de inzet van politie ten aanzien van burgers met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond, zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over gasvrij wonen

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about SCP findings that public support for gas-free homes is narrow and that households feel imposed upon, and whether the policy should be abandoned. Minister Ollongren answered that support is important and taken seriously, that the policy will not be scrapped, that co-decision with residents is planned via neighbourhood pilots, and that nuclear energy is not excluded.
It is essential that measures in the built environment are implemented with good involvement of residents and building owners.
Het is essentieel dat de uitvoering van maatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving plaatsvindt met een goede betrokkenheid van bewoners en eigenaren van gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Kops over het bericht 'Alarmerende klimaatstudie blijkt niet te kloppen’ in de Telegraaf van 30 september 201

PVV MPs Wilders and Kops asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether a retracted sea-level study and claims of climate scaremongering undermine government climate policy. The minister replied that correcting errors shows peer review works, that policy rests on the IPCC, that the retracted study used a method without broad consensus, and that sea-level rise and climate change are well documented.
There is no question of scaremongering.
Er is geen sprake van bangmakerij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over berichten ‘Invloed IS op Haags jeugdwerk’ en ‘De Marokkanen nemen in de buurthuis de boel over’

PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of IS influence in Hague youth work and Moroccan takeover of a neighbourhood centre, and proposed measures including dismissals, closures, preventive detention, denaturalisation, mosque closures and ending diversity policy. The minister rejected the far-reaching proposals as disproportionate or contrary to the rule of law, while confirming a youth worker with radical views was dismissed and that deradicalisation funding continues.

Administrative detention, in the sense of a kind of preventive detention, is not one of the cases listed in Article 5 of the European Convention on Human Rights in which deprivation of liberty is possible.

Administratieve detentie, in de zin van een soort preventieve detentie, is niet één van de in artikel 5 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) genoemde gevallen waarin vrijheidsontneming mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over een nieuw Europees migratieplan over bootmigranten

PVV MPs asked whether fourteen member states agreed to an EU plan to redistribute migrants rescued by NGOs, whether the government would keep its promise not to take in such migrants again, and whether it would stop participating in such plans and impose an asylum stop. The State Secretary answered that few member states are actually considering the mechanism, that the Netherlands will in principle not join ad hoc solutions, and that the duty to rescue at sea remains, while refusing an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
For brevity I refer your House to the letter of 14 January. It does not state that the cabinet will never again take in migrants from ships like the Sea Watch-3.
Kortheidshalve verwijs ik uw Kamer naar de brief van 14 januari jl. Daarin wordt niet gesteld dat het kabinet nooit meer migranten over zal nemen van schepen als de Sea Watch-3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over een bericht op Twitter van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie Den Haag

MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Justice Minister why a Den Haag police control room tweet called sales of slaughtered animals from vans legal and whether it was offensive and should be stopped. The Minister said the police checked locations after reports, found a municipal permit for an incidental stand, deferred the permit conditions to the Agriculture Minister, and said the tweet was meant to clarify matters for citizens.
It is up to the police to ensure social media use stays within the legal frameworks and agreements.
Het is aan de politie om zorg te dragen voor social media-gebruik binnen de wettelijke kaders en afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over het bericht dat stelende asielzoekers in Ter Apel de gedupeerde ondernemers uit eigen zak gaan compenseren

PVV MPs asked whether the state should compensate shopkeepers robbed by asylum seekers in Ter Apel, with asylum seekers' living allowance withheld to repay damages, and asked for a detailed overview of crimes by asylum seekers by location. The Secretary of State defended a pilot letting SODA recover indirect damages from asylum seekers' living allowance, declined to provide a per-location, per-offence breakdown, and deferred on the parliamentary work visit.
I am considering how a next incident overview will be structured.
Ik beraad mij op de wijze waarop een volgend incidentoverzicht zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen door de leden Van Aalst, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat Arriva haar personeel afvalt als zij het boerkaverbod in de bus handhaven

PVV MPs asked whether the government would condemn Arriva for dismissing a bus driver who enforced the face-covering ban, and whether they would act against transport operators refusing to enforce it. The minister answered that both driver and police acted lawfully, that enforcement is a police and prosecutor task, that operators must only ask riders to remove face coverings, and that no operator currently refuses to comply, so no action is planned yet.
Contacts with public transport companies currently do not show that they refuse to comply with the law.
Uit de contacten met de openbaar vervoer bedrijven blijkt op dit moment niet dat zij de wet weigeren na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht Hoofdpijn in je milieuhuis

PVV MPs asked whether residents of gas-free renovated homes in Zoetermeer's Palenstein district, who reported headaches and poor air, show that the energy transition harms health, and whether the gas-connection obligation and the gas-free programme should be reversed. The minister acknowledged ventilation problems that have been fixed, rejected reversing the gas-free policy and the pilot neighbourhoods, and defended the climate case while promising monitoring by GGD Haaglanden.
Based on these measurements, GGD Haaglanden classifies the ventilation (CO2 values) in the measured homes as good.
Op basis van deze metingen classificeert GGD Haaglanden de ventilatie (CO 2 -waarden) in de gemeten woningen als goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, Fritsma en Wilders over de steekpartij op klaarlichte dag bij het  asielzoekerscentrum in Arnhem

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the suspect in a stabbing at the Arnhem asylum centre had been detained and deported, whether the centre should close, and whether a full asylum stop should be introduced. The state secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described existing COA measures and cooperation with police, rejected closing the centre, and rejected an asylum stop.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u bekend ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Wilders en Emiel van Dijk over het aantal personen met een migratieachtergrond

MPs Fritsma, Wilders and Van Dijk asked how many people with a non-Western migration background live in the Netherlands, whether third and fourth generations should be counted, whether dual nationality registration should be reinstated, and whether diversity is obscured by current categories. The minister answered with CBS figures (about 2.31 million, 13.4%), said estimating deeper generations is not policy-relevant, declined to reinstate nationality registration citing the Wet BRP conclusion that no obstacles had arisen, and disagreed that the categories hide diversity.
I also see no policy reason to make estimates of how many persons have at least one of their four grandparents, or even one of their eight great-grandparents, originating from abroad.

Ik zie verder ook geen beleidsmatige reden om schattingen te maken van hoeveel personen minstens één van de vier grootouders, of zelfs één van de acht overgrootouders, afkomstig is uit een buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘U.S. State Department issues travel advisory for Netherlands due to terrorism concerns’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why the Dutch public is not informed about terrorism risks as the US State Department issued a travel advisory for the Netherlands, and whether the threat is increasing, and proposed closing borders and administrative detention. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the threat level remains level 4 of 5 (substantial), that the US advisory is unchanged rather than raised, and that the NCTV informs the public periodically.
The U.S. Department of State re-issued the travel advisory for American travellers to the Netherlands on 19 July 2019, without changes from the previous period.
De U.S. Department of State heeft het reisadvies voor Amerikaanse reizigers in Nederland op 19 juli 2019 opnieuw vastgesteld, zonder wijzigingen ten opzichte van de vorige periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het minder Marokkanen proces heeft beïnvloed

Wilders (PVV) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that former minister Opstelten influenced the prosecution decision against Wilders, including a 25 September 2014 meeting, contacts between the ministry and the Public Prosecution Service, draft prosecutorial advice, and a Wob decision. The minister answers largely that no minutes exist, the prosecution service decided independently, and the matter is before the court, providing a timeline and promising no consequences for a whistleblower under the applicable rules.
The OM has since repeatedly stated that it reached this decision independently.
Het OM heeft nadien zoals bekend meermaals aangegeven zelfstandig tot deze beslissing te zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Wilders over een ontsnapte vreemdeling uit detentiecentrum Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked how a migrant could escape from the Rotterdam detention centre, what would prevent recurrence, his nationality and criminal record, whether he had been returned, and how many escapes had occurred over the past decade. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, said an internal investigation was ordered into the escape, reported that he remains wanted, and gave a table showing 8 escapes and 23 other withdrawals since 2009.
The Security and Integrity bureau of the Custodial Institutions Agency has been instructed to investigate how the escape took place and how a repetition can be prevented.

Het bureau Veiligheid en Integriteit van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen heeft de opdracht gekregen te onderzoeken hoe de ontvluchting plaats heeft kunnen vinden en hoe een herhaling kan worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over Pakistan

An MP asked whether the government would respond to a reported video showing images of Geert Wilders with 'dead/murdered' text being walked and spat on in Pakistan, and whether it finds this acceptable. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the video dates from August 2018 and that he discussed Pakistan's reactions and the government's concerns about threats with his Pakistani counterpart in 2018.
I held talks in August and September 2018 with my Pakistani counterpart, Foreign Minister Qureshi, about Pakistan's reactions to this and the cabinet's concerns about the threats.

Ik heb in augustus en september 2018 gesprekken gevoerd met mijn Pakistaanse ambtgenoot, Minister Qureshi van Buitenlandse Zaken, over de reacties van Pakistan hierop en de zorgen van het kabinet over de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Saudi reforms truly improve women's rights, given the continued detention of women's rights activists and the male guardianship system. The minister acknowledged limited reforms (passport, civil registration, labour protections) but said implementation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises activists' cases bilaterally and multilaterally, and that closing the Riyadh embassy is not an option.
The Netherlands also raises women's rights and the protection and support of women's rights activists within the EU and in the appropriate multilateral fora.
Nederland stelt de onderwerpen vrouwenrechten en de bescherming en ondersteuning van vrouwenrechtenactivisten tevens aan de orde in EU-verband en in de daarvoor geëigende multilaterale fora.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Markuszower en Wilders over de statushouder die een 68 jarige vrouw doodmartelde

MPs from the PVV asked whether the statushouder (refugee status holder) suspected of a fatal assault on a 68-year-old woman would have his residence permit revoked and be deported, how screening failed to catch him, and whether asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries should be barred. The minister replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the screening and monitoring process, said revocation is limited by EU and refugee-convention rules and that the government will not categorically close borders.
In principle I make no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in beginsel geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Eritreeër verdacht van verkrachting in Oisterwijk: ‘Het is opgelost, we gaan trouwen’'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice and Security Minister about a news report on an Eritrean suspect in a rape case in Oisterwijk, including whether such cases are common and whether the suspect should be prosecuted and expelled. The Minister condemned sexual violence, noted police capacity, declined to comment on the ongoing case, said figures on comparable cases are not registered, and left prosecution decisions to the Public Prosecution Service.
It does not befit me as Minister to make statements about the case at this time.
Het past mij als Minister niet op dit moment uitspraken te doen over de betreffende zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op een basisschool in Tilburg ramadanvoorlichting wordt gegeven aan kinderen door de GGD

Three PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Tilburg primary school's GGD-provided Ramadan information for children should be stopped, and about the societal costs of Ramadan and measures to keep Islam-related promotion out of health care, education and public media. The minister confirmed the facts, said schools may organise such activities under freedom of education and religion, referred the GGD question to the health minister, declined to quantify costs, and stated that Islam enjoys the same protections as other religions.
I see no reason to look into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onduidelijkheid over blokkeermoslims’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service acted quickly against 'blokkeerfriezen' but not against 'blokkeermoslims' who disrupted a demonstration, and whether he would instruct prosecution and guarantee the right to demonstrate. The Minister said a criminal investigation is ongoing and declined to comment on the case, refused to instruct prosecutors in individual cases, and stated that mayors are responsible for maintaining public order under the Public Assembly Act.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation. While this investigation is ongoing, I cannot comment on this criminal case.
Er is sprake van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek. Lopende dit onderzoek kan ik geen uitlatingen doen over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Betoging Pegida in Eindhoven opnieuw verboden'

Two PVV MPs asked why a Pegida demonstration in Eindhoven was banned again and whether all mayors would be reminded that Dutch law, not sharia, applies. The minister answered that protest management is a mayoral responsibility, that demonstrations may only be banned as a last resort and never because of their content, and that no letter to all mayors is planned.
Banning or ending a (peaceful) demonstration is a last resort and only applies when necessary to protect public health, traffic, or to prevent or combat public disorder.

Daarbij geldt dat het verbieden of beëindigen van een (vreedzame) demonstratie een uiterst middel is en uitsluitend aan de orde is als dat noodzakelijk is ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid, in het belang van het verkeer of ter bestrijding of voorkoming van wanordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Syriëstrijder opgepakt in Kapelle’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports of a Syria fighter arrested in Kapelle, asking how many such persons entered the Netherlands, how screening failed, and whether they would stop admitting asylum seekers from Islamic countries and denaturalise terrorists. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said screening and signal-reporting procedures exist, rejected closing borders as unrealistic, and noted nationality can only be revoked for convicted terrorists who hold another nationality.
I cannot go into the facts and circumstances of this individual case.
Op de feiten en omstandigheden in dit individuele geval kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het minder Marokkanen-proces heeft beïnvloed

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a 25 September 2014 meeting between the then Minister and the Chair of the College of Procurators-General concerning the Wilders prosecution, why it was not disclosed earlier, and whether witnesses and records can be made available. The Minister answers that the earlier questions did not explicitly ask about that meeting, that no minutes were kept, that internal advisory reports are withheld to protect prosecution and departmental communication, and that the case itself cannot be discussed.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to judge an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, te oordelen over een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het ‘minder Marokkanen-proces heeft beïnvloed’

MP Wilders asked the Minister of Justice whether former minister Opstelten gave any opinion or instruction to the Public Prosecution Service about prosecuting Wilders, and about the handling of related documents, witness support and the Pechtold case. The minister answered that no directive, request or opinion from Opstelten was found, but withheld the advisory notes and internal correspondence citing ongoing criminal proceedings and the confidentiality of internal advice.
Therefore I generally do not provide information about a criminal procedure that is still ongoing.
Daarom verstrek ik in het algemeen geen informatie over een strafrechtelijke procedure die nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht 'Jihadboeken in bajesbieb/Haatlectuur op bestelling'

Three PVV MPs asked whether Islamic books inciting hatred and violence are available in prisons, how many Islamic chaplains and Muslim prisoners there are, and whether Islamic books should be banned and imams dismissed. The minister answered that detainees may read religious literature unless it threatens order or security, that the director may refuse books inciting discrimination or violence, that DJI employs 43 FTE Islamic chaplains without central registration of detainees' religion, and rejected banning books or dismissing imams.
Detainees are not centrally registered by religion or belief.
Gedetineerden worden niet centraal geregistreerd op religie of levensbeschouwing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht dat de politie in Limburg negen islamitische nachtmaaltijden organiseert

Two PVV MPs asked whether it is absurd that the Limburg police organise nine Islamic night meals and whether these should be cancelled in favour of fighting crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police units decide locally on community activities across many groups, that police should remain neutral and connected to all groups, and that he supports such activities as strengthening community ties and authority.
The way in which policy can best be given form locally and which activities accompany it, I leave to the police units themselves.
De wijze waarop het beleid lokaal het beste vorm gegeven kan worden en met welke activiteiten dat gepaard gaat, laat ik aan de politie-eenheden zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Moslimdocenten wilden mij weg hebben'

MPs from the PVV asked whether a teacher's criticism of Islam, immigration and climate policy outside school is permitted, whether other teachers were pushed out for criticising Islam, and whether school managers should face consequences for how a teacher was treated by Muslim colleagues. The minister confirmed a teacher may voice criticism outside school, said no similar cases are known, and declined to judge the individual school situation, leaving it to school leadership.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on that based on a newspaper article.
Het past mij niet om daarover op basis van een krantenartikel een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Groen licht voor islamitisch meisjesinternaat in Blerick’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Blerick Islamic girls' boarding school should be closed and whether all Islamic boarding and weekend schools should be shut, given sharia-based teaching. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, rejected closure, and said supervision of youth boarding facilities lies with the municipality, whose mayor can close one only on a well-founded suspicion of an offence or serious threat to a minor's development.
After the youth residence opens, the institution falls under the supervision established by the Youth Residences Act.
Na opening van het jeugdverblijf valt de instelling onder het toezicht dat is gerealiseerd met de Wet op de jeugdverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Onrust in Maastrichtse wijk om komst 'jihadbruid' Aïcha''

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports of unrest in a Maastricht neighbourhood over the expected return of a woman who had travelled to IS territory, and whether she should be permanently barred, preventively detained and stripped of Dutch nationality. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch nationals cannot be denied entry, returnees are questioned and may be prosecuted, a multidisciplinary case consultation is used, preventive detention without reasonable suspicion is not permissible, and nationality can be revoked only after a terrorism conviction or, for dual nationals, for joining a terrorist organisation.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht 'Opnieuw geschiedvervalsing in Nederlands schoolboek'

PVV MPs asked why a VMBO textbook allegedly omits Jewish history of Jerusalem and the Middle East and wanted the government to ensure historically accurate teaching. The minister replied that the content of teaching materials is for schools to assess under freedom of education, pointing to school complaint and participation routes and criminal law limits.

As I and my predecessors have already indicated to your House in many earlier written questions on this subject, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers aan uw Kamer in vele eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over de juridische werking van het Migratiepact van Marrakesh

PVV MPs asked the government to confirm the authenticity of a leaked European Commission legal note suggesting the UN Global Compact for Migration could have binding effects via EU law, and asked why ministers had said the Compact was not legally binding. The government answered that the Commission described the note as an unofficial document by an individual staff member, that the Compact remains legally non-binding and creates no enforceable rights, and that the earlier legal analysis stands.
The fact remains that the Compact is a legally non-binding document and does not generate enforceable rights.
Feit blijft dat het Compact een juridisch niet-bindend document is en geen afdwingbare rechten genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Leerkracht geschorst na beledigen profeet'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a teacher's suspension after insulting the prophet shows that yielding to Islam is a pattern, whether intimidating pupils should have been punished instead, and whether the government will act to reinstate the teacher. The minister denied endorsing the premise, said school boards decide on suspensions within legal limits, and declined to intervene in the case.
In practice it is up to the board, school leader, teachers, parents and pupils to make arrangements with each other, within the limits of the law, about the school culture.
In de praktijk is het aan het bestuur, schoolleider, leraren, ouders en leerlingen om met elkaar en uiteraard binnen de grenzen van de wet afspraken te maken over de invulling van een schoolcultuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vrouwelijke IS’er wil naar Nederland’

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a female IS member wanting to return to the Netherlands could be permanently denied residence, citizenship and entry. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases and only set out general naturalisation, residence and Schengen entry conditions, including refusal on public order or national security grounds.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet ga ik niet op individuele zaken in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de kinderen die bij het kinderpardon zijn afgewezen en nu een herbeoordeling krijgen zoals vermeld in de brief van 29 januari 2019

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about household size, countries of origin, number of asylum and regular procedures, periods of illegal stay, IND appeals, and the use of the cooperation criterion for children rejected under the kinderpardon who now face re-assessment. The State Secretary answered that household size averages 2.2 members and gave the top five nationalities, but said the remaining data are not available in aggregate and require reviewing each file, with figures promised later this year in a letter on the Afsluitingsregeling.
The data requested in these questions are not available at an aggregated level.
De gegevens waar in deze vragen om wordt verzocht zijn niet op een geaggregeerd niveau beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aanpassing van het reisadvies voor Marokko na de gruwelijke moord op twee Scandinavische toeristen

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Morocco travel advice had stayed unchanged since April 2018, how many IS fighters returned to Morocco in 2018, and whether the advice would be tightened after two Scandinavian tourists were murdered. The minister answered that the advice was updated on 21 December 2018 to mention the killings and the heightened terrorism threat, with the main cities now rated yellow, and that no reason to change it existed before 17 December; the number of returning fighters is not known.
It is not known how many IS fighters returned from Syria and Iraq to Morocco in 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel IS-strijders in 2018 uit Syrië en Irak naar Marokko zijn teruggekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the government would bar Turkish-funded weekend schools in the Netherlands, given concerns about foreign influence on children's education, and whether they should be banned. The minister answered that such informal schools fall outside education law, so the Inspectorate has no powers and they cannot be banned, while the government shares concerns about integration and anti-democratic teaching and has raised them with Turkey, which promised transparency and information sharing.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scale of informal education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over criminele asielzoekers in Leersum

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why criminal asylum seekers at the Leersum centre who threaten schoolgirls and bus drivers are allowed to continue, and called for an asylum stop. State Secretary Harbers acknowledged the nuisance, said it requires a targeted approach using criminal, administrative and immigration measures, and refused an asylum stop as contrary to international obligations.
This nuisance therefore calls for a targeted approach, deploying the broad range of criminal, administrative and immigration law measures available for this purpose.

Deze overlast vraagt dan ook om een gerichte aanpak, waar op wordt ingezet middels het brede palet aan strafrechtelijke, bestuursrechtelijke en vreemdelingenrechtelijke maatregelen dat hiervoor ter beschikking staat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het verlenen van asiel aan Asia Bibi

MP Wilders asked whether the government will grant asylum to Asia Bibi, a Pakistani Christian threatened with death over blasphemy charges, and criticised the admission of other asylum seekers. The government answered that it has intensively pressed for her case bilaterally, in the EU and with like-minded countries, and that it is pursuing quiet diplomacy, without addressing whether asylum will be granted.
The Netherlands has over recent years intensively pursued Asia Bibi's case bilaterally, within the EU and with like-minded countries, and the cabinet will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft zich de laatste jaren bilateraal, in EU-verband en met andere gelijkgezinde landen intensief ingespannen voor de zaak van Asia Bibi en dat zal het kabinet blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat oud-minister Opstelten het ‘minder Marokkanen-proces’ zou hebben beïnvloed

PVV MP Wilders asked whether former minister Opstelten influenced the decision to prosecute him for his 2014 remarks about Moroccans, and why RTL Nieuws's information requests and FOIA request received incomplete answers. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Public Prosecution Service took an independent prosecution decision, that searches found no formal instruction or request from the minister, that the minister's communications with the College are confidential ambtsberichten not disclosed, and that no notes or minutes showing ministerial involvement were found.
I will therefore not provide a copy of this official report.
Ik zal daarom geen afschrift doen van dit ambtsbericht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema, De Graaf en Markuszower over de door een prediker gedane uitspraak in een online cursus van de As Soenah moskee te Den Haag, te weten: ‘Vrouwenbesnijdenis is niet verplicht

MPs Wilders, Agema, De Graaf and Markuszower asked about a preacher's statement that female genital cutting is recommended though not mandatory, and how many girls were cut, how many cases were prosecuted, and what subsidised organisations do. The minister answered that prevalence research is under way with results expected mid-2019, that cutting is prosecuted as assault, that cases are not registered separately, and that the government funds an integrated chain approach and will report on it in a progress letter.
It therefore cannot be retrieved from the registers how many court cases of genital mutilation there are.
Het is daarom niet uit de registers te halen om hoeveel rechtszaken van genitale verminking het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen”

PVV MPs asked the government about Syrian weekend schools (informal Islamic/Koranic education), whether they should be closed and funded organisations dissolved, and whether all Syrian asylum seekers and status holders should be returned to Syria. The minister answered that this is informal education not covered by education law, that the government lacks structural oversight of it, and that closing it or returning refugees is rejected.
At present the cabinet has no structural insight into the nature and scale of education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen structureel zicht op de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over ‘De enorme toename van criminaliteit in Kampen door asielzoekers’

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why criminal asylum seekers in Kampen and elsewhere are not quickly rejected, detained and deported, what share of criminal asylum seekers previously applied elsewhere, and whether an asylum stop will be introduced. The State Secretary replied that overlap is handled case by case with partners, cites measures already taken and data-based early warning, says the number of convicted criminal asylum seekers cannot be derived from systems, and rejects a full asylum stop while accepting targeted measures.
I am not willing to do so because I value a careful asylum policy that offers protection to those who need it.
Daartoe ben ik niet bereid omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldig asielbeleid dat bescherming biedt aan degenen die dat nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Gemeenten volgen 160 radicale moslims'

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how the government handles hundreds of jihadists and thousands of sympathisers not under monitoring, why administrative detention is not introduced, how deradicalisation success is measured, how many are placed in work or schooling obligations, and expected costs. Minister Grapperhaus answered that local multidisciplinary case consultations and existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, that administrative detention without reasonable suspicion is not justified and will not be introduced, that deradicalisation programmes are evaluated but numbers are too small for conclusions, and that the local approach receives about EUR 6.5 million annually.
Case law and treaty obligations show that administrative detention, meaning preventive detention without reasonable suspicion, is not a justified deprivation of liberty.

Uit de rechtspraak en verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen volgt dat administratieve detentie, in de zin van preventieve detentie zonder dat sprake is van een redelijke verdenking, geen gerechtvaardigde vrijheidsontneming is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de vastgelopen woningmarkt

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the housing market is a mess under her watch, whether the national housing agenda is empty, why municipalities are slow to build, and whether social rental homes should go to Dutch applicants rather than refugees with status. The minister rejected the critique, pointed to new measures and regional agreements, and said local allocation choices and the equal-treatment principle apply.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Salafisten op sleutelposities'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report on Salafists in key positions, including whether the government would investigate Rotterdam mayor Aboutaleb's role and contacts with Waqf, whether diversity policy is a route for Islamic influence, whether the Muslim Brotherhood would be investigated, and how to reverse 'islamisation'. The minister declined the investigations, saying the report relied on anonymous sources and Rotterdam's council denied the claims, and stated the government takes a neutral position on religion.
I note that the information provided in the reporting comes from anonymous sources and that there are no verifiable statements.
Ik constateer dat de verstrekte informatie in de berichtgeving afkomstig is van anonieme bronnen en dat er geen sprake is van toetsbare verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over de OIC-veroordeling van een cartoonwedstrijd in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the OIC's condemnation of a planned Mohammed cartoon contest in the Netherlands, questioning the OIC's standing, the Cairo Declaration's sharia clause, and whether the government would firmly reject OIC interference. Minister Blok answered that freedom of expression applies to all, that the Netherlands is not an OIC member and does not endorse the Cairo Declaration, that courts rather than the cabinet judge legal limits, and that he informed the OIC Secretary-General that the government has no involvement in the contest.
The OIC is free to speak out publicly in this debate.
Het staat de OIC vrij om zich openbaar uit te spreken in dit debat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht voornemens is een vorderingsbesluit in te zetten om basisschool de Klimroos te verplichten klaslokalen beschikbaar te

Three PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether he shares their view that an Islamic school threatens Dutch values and whether he will support a public primary school resisting Utrecht's plan to requisition classrooms for a new Islamic school. The minister rejected the premise, noted that schools commonly share buildings and that the municipality is responsible for housing, and said the municipality will keep talking with both school boards.
The municipality is responsible for housing schools.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Jong en Wilders over het bericht ‘Pensioenfondsen dicht bij korten’

MPs De Jong and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds with large buffers should avoid cuts, and whether a higher discount rate should be used to prevent them. The minister replied that funds lack sufficient buffers, that cuts may be needed in 2020 if finances do not improve, and that he will not raise the discount rate, while pointing to pension reform.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland lokale verkiezingen in Syrisch rebellengebied financierde

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Dutch funds financed local elections in rebel-held Eastern Ghouta, whether this was covert political interference, and why Parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed a 4,800 euro contribution via the LDSPS programme, defended it as supporting transparent local governance and countering extremist influence, found no evidence of diversion to armed groups, and stated that non-humanitarian support to opposition areas has largely ended.
Through the Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programme, the Netherlands supported the elections in Eastern Ghouta with 4,800 euros.
Nederland heeft via het Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programma de verkiezingen in Oost-Ghouta met 4800,- euro ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over een tsunami van islamitisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether jihadists operate among Fulani herders and whether recent killings of Christians in Nigeria amount to ethnic cleansing or an Islamic agenda. The minister answered that the conflict is mainly driven by socio-economic factors with ethnic-religious elements, that there is no evidence of a religious agenda, and that the government raised the killings with President Buhari during his visit.
There are so far no indications that a premeditated religious agenda lies behind the acts of violence.
Er zijn vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat er achter de geweldplegingen een vooropgezette religieuze agenda schuilgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de bestuurlijke impasse op Bonaire

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the administrative deadlock on Bonaire is too long, why trust in the island council and executive members is warranted, whether investment is wasted while duties are neglected, and whether the State Secretary will intervene temporarily under the Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba Public Bodies Act. The State Secretary acknowledged the deadlock must be broken, pointed to agreed steps for a governing agreement soon after the summer, said the executive bears responsibility for good governance as a condition for further investment, and declined to intervene because existing structures do not prevent solutions.
Clear agreements have been made with the Executive Board on a governing agreement to be concluded, in which a large number of existing administrative knots will be untangled.
Met het Bestuurscollege zijn heldere afspraken gemaakt over een te sluiten bestuursakkoord waarin een groot aantal bestaande bestuurlijke knopen wordt ontward.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitspraken van minister Blok over de multiculturele samenleving

An MP (Wilders, PVV) asked the government to explain Minister Blok's remarks on multicultural society and EU migration and whether they reflect cabinet policy, and asked whether policy should be overturned. The government answered that the remarks were made at a closed meeting, do not change cabinet policy, and that it will not change course.
The statements change nothing about the existing cabinet policy.
De uitspraken veranderen niets aan het staande kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Oekraïense spionage gericht tegen Nederlanders die betrokken waren bij MH-17 onderzoek(en)

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether Ukraine spied on Dutch officials involved in the MH17 investigation, how this affected the Joint Investigation Team, and whether it undermined the findings. The government declined to confirm specific evidence publicly, said cooperation within the JIT remains constructive and the evidence is considered reliable, and said the matter was raised with Ukrainian authorities.
The cabinet cannot make any public statements about this.
Hierover kan het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether the government agreed to take in part of the migrants from the Lifeline ship, how many, and why it acted without parliamentary approval, and urged an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed Netherlands offered a one-off responsibility for up to 20 asylum seekers from Malta and referred the rest to a separate letter to parliament.
For the considerations on which and the terms under which this gesture is made, I refer you to the cover letter accompanying the annotated agenda.
Voor de overwegingen op grond waarvan en de modaliteiten waaronder deze geste wordt gedaan, verwijs ik u naar de aanbiedingsbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether agreements to take in Lifeline migrants were already made at the 24 June 2018 meeting, and why the minister did not disclose this during the debate. The government answered that no agreement was made; Malta conditioned its acceptance on other states taking responsibility, and the Netherlands later agreed as a gesture to take up to 20 asylum seekers.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de detentie en de persoonlijke veiligheid van Tommy Robinson in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asks whether the government will contact the UK to guarantee the safety of detained activist Tommy Robinson, whom he says was moved to a prison with a large Muslim population and has been threatened, and whether it agrees he should be released. The government says it has no details on his detention conditions, considers this a UK responsibility, and that his release is a matter for the British judge.
The cabinet considers this a responsibility of the government of the United Kingdom and makes no further statements about it.
Het kabinet acht dit een verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van het Verenigd Koninkrijk en doet hier geen nadere uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over een verbod op Denk

MPs from the PVV asked whether the government would arrest and deport a Denk party staffer who said he was proud to be an IS supporter, and whether it would seek a ban on the Denk party. The Minister answered that IS-linked conduct is criminal and that dissolving a party is an exceptional measure requiring high legal standards, which is for the public prosecutor to decide, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
It is for the public prosecutor to decide whether a request under article 2:20 of the Civil Code is opportune.
Het is aan het openbaar ministerie om te bepalen of een verzoek ex artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Proefverlof ophanden voor vader die zijn zes kinderen de dood injoeg’

PVV MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a father who murdered his six children could receive trial leave (proefverlof) from TBS detention, and whether minimum sentences and blocking the leave were considered. The minister replied that trial leave is a carefully assessed step in resocialisation with independent review and victim input, that he sees no basis for minimum sentences, and declined to comment on the specific case.
I will not go further into the decision-making and the details of this specific case.
Ik ga hier niet verder in op de besluitvorming en de details van deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en De Roon over de arrestatie van de Britse activist en islamcriticus Tommy Robinson

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would protest to the UK over the arrest and sentencing of Tommy Robinson, citing free speech and his safety in prison, and whether the government accepts that suppressing Islam critics fuels public anger. The minister replied that free speech applies to everyone, that Robinson reportedly breached his earlier parole conditions, and that the government trusts the UK legal process and sees no reason to comment further.
The cabinet has confidence in the legal process in the United Kingdom and sees no reason to comment further on this.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de rechtsgang in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en ziet geen aanleiding zich hierover nader uit te spreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat een openbare school in Rijswijk de lesinhoud aanpast aan de ramadan en docenten vertellen welke islamitische gebeden verplicht zijn

Three PVV MPs asked whether the minister knows that a Rijswijk public school adjusts lessons to Ramadan and tells teachers which Islamic prayers are obligatory, how many schools do so, and whether the minister will act to keep Islamic influence out of public education. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, said he does not know how many schools adjust programmes, and rejected intervention, stating that schools must meet attainment targets and may schedule parts of their programme themselves while taking pupil background into account.
Schools are obliged to provide education in line with the core objectives and the attainment targets.
Scholen zijn gehouden onderwijs te verzorgen in overeenstemming met de kerndoelen en de eindtermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Heerenveen heeft gepleit voor verplicht moskeebezoek voor scholieren

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether it is appropriate that the mayor of Heerenveen proposed compulsory mosque visits for pupils, whether schools may require them, and whether the minister would issue guidance or ask VNG to tell mayors to stay out of curriculum matters. The minister replied that excursions in the regular curriculum are in principle compulsory, parents may request exemption from the school board, schools have freedom of education, and no circular or VNG request is needed.
Question 3: Are you aware how many primary schools require pupils to attend a mosque visit? Answer 3: No.
Vraag 3 Is het u bekend hoeveel scholen binnen het primair onderwijs scholieren verplichten om aanwezig te zijn bij een bezoek aan een moskee? Antwoord 3 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk, De Graaf en Wilders over de uitnodiging voor een Defensie Iftar op donderdag 24 mei 2018

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether he knew of a Defence Iftar invitation for 24 May 2018, and whether he agreed that Islam is a totalitarian ideology unfit for a secular armed forces and should not be facilitated. The state secretary confirmed the invitation, defended religious freedom and the integrated chaplaincy services, and said there is no room for extremist expressions in the armed forces.
Freedom of religion or belief is one of the classic fundamental rights that everyone in the Netherlands has, subject to everyone's responsibility under the law.
De vrijheid van godsdienst of levensovertuiging is één van de klassieke grondrechten die eenieder in Nederland heeft behoudens ieders verantwoordelijkheid voor de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gezellig. Cursussen koran voorlezen op de Vrije Universiteit gescheiden voor mannen en vrouwen’

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Koran reading courses at the VU were segregated by sex and whether the government would pressure the university to stop such segregation. The minister replied that equality of men and women applies, that the VU's rules forbid segregation, that the student association moved the courses to an external location after the university intervened, and that he sees no reason for further talks with the VU.
As soon as the VU received signals about this, they entered into discussion with the student association and indicated that such segregation is not permitted at the VU.
Zodra de VU hier signalen over ontving, zijn ze in gesprek gegaan met de studentenvereniging en is aangegeven dat dergelijke segregatie op de VU niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de daling van het aantal uitzettingen

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why rejected asylum seekers are left at large, why they are not detained and deported, and why countries refusing to take back nationals are not sanctioned. The State Secretary referred to earlier answers, said EU and bilateral pressure is used via positive and negative incentives, and said detention without a prospect of removal would violate the ECHR, while committing to expand detention possibilities within those limits.
Without a prospect of removal, detention is contrary to that treaty.
Zonder zicht op uitzetting is bewaring in strijd met dat verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Nederturken klaarstomen voor carrière’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports on Turkish influence over Dutch Turks via Diyanet and the UETD, and whether mosques and Diyanet should be closed.
