Daarbij geldt dat de Nederlandse overheid op grond van internationale afspraken niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land treedt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over hordes gelukszoekers die Nederland overspoelen

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice twelve questions about asylum seekers, housing, islam and border policy, several in highly polemical terms. The State Secretary answered most questions briefly, rejected the premises of several, and committed to tackling people smugglers and to returning asylum seekers from regions with safe shelter.

As set out in the letter to your House of 8 September on the European asylum problem, the cabinet holds that where sufficient safe reception exists in the region, asylum seekers from that region who still reach the Netherlands on their own should be returned to safe reception in the region.

Zoals aan uw kamer uiteengezet in de brief aan uw Kamer over de Europese asielproblematiek d.d. 8 september jl. is het kabinet van mening dat bij het aanwezig zijn van voldoende veilige opvang in de regio en onder de voorwaarden zoals in de brief vermeld, asielzoekers uit die regio die alsnog op eigen gelegenheid Nederland bereiken, teruggebracht dienen te worden naar de veilige opvang in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over toenemende onveiligheid door gewelddadige gelukszoekers

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked why the government keeps admitting asylum seekers they describe as violent, endangering Dutch citizens, and asked whether reception centres will be closed and borders shut. The State Secretary rejected the generalisation, said incidents are assessed individually, noted efforts to limit inflow and support regional reception, and answered the questions together.
My services are of course always alert to possible contra-indications in every individual case and take this into account in their actions and decision-making.
Mijn diensten zijn uiteraard steeds alert op mogelijke contra-indicaties in elke individuele zaak en betrekken dit bij het handelen en de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over Saoediers hielden Wilders nauwgezet in de gaten

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked whether Dutch authorities knew Saudi Arabia planned a lawsuit against Geert Wilders, whether the OIC and the Saudi crown prince were involved, and whether the ambassador disavowed Wilders' statements, and asked the government to break diplomatic ties. The minister declined to comment on substance because the reporting relied on allegedly confidential WikiLeaks documents, referred back to that answer for the other questions, and rejected breaking diplomatic relations.
The cabinet does not respond substantively to questions about reporting based on allegedly confidential documents published via WikiLeaks.
Het kabinet reageert niet inhoudelijk op vragen over berichtgeving die is gebaseerd op vermeende vertrouwelijke documenten welke zijn gepubliceerd via Wikileaks.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Agema en Wilders over het artikel 'Ouderen op zwart zaad'

PVV MPs asked the government to respond to an article on elderly people's poor finances, calling the situation a disgrace and accusing the government of undermining elderly care, the state pension and pensions. The minister replied that elderly purchasing power has declined due to pension fund problems and budget measures, that low incomes were protected, that long-term care was reformed, and that purchasing power will be reviewed annually with measures in the budget if needed.
Each year the integrated purchasing power picture, including that of the elderly, is weighed for the coming year and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Jaarlijks wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld, waaronder die van ouderen, voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over hordes gelukszoekers die Nederland overspoelen

Wilders asks the State Secretary, in provocative and derogatory terms, whether asylum seekers are given preferential housing and whether borders should be closed and asylum seekers returned, and whether Dutch policy makes the Netherlands a 'luilekkerland'. The State Secretary answers all questions with a single reference to an earlier letter on increased asylum inflow and measures taken, without addressing the substance.
In response to the questions, I refer to my letter of 17 August.
In reactie op de vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief van 17 augustus jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Oproep tot ‘jihadbendes’ in Europa

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the ministers of Interior, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs about a report of calls for Muslim 'jihad gangs' in Europe, including calls to arm, attack police and recruit children, and whether the NCTV's dismissal of the material was adequate, and asked whether Islam is a problem requiring 'de-Islamisation'. The government answered that it takes jihadist violence seriously under its integrated action programme, that the NCTV rightly labelled the material jihadist propaganda with no reason to revise that view, and that Islam enjoys the same constitutional and human rights protection as other religions.
The cabinet takes the threat posed by violent jihadism extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de dreiging die van het gewelddadig jihadisme uitgaat uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over ook een Nederlandse onderscheiding voor de Thalys-helden

Wilders asked whether the four men who overpowered the Thalys attacker should receive a Dutch honour, given that Dutch passengers were likely spared. The minister answered that France and Belgium had honoured them, that the Netherlands supports this and was represented at the ceremony, and that the cabinet will not award an additional Dutch decoration.

The cabinet is of the view that the above-mentioned decorations from the countries first involved have appropriately honoured the heroes' actions and will therefore not award an additional Dutch decoration.

Het kabinet is van mening dat met bovengenoemde onderscheidingen van de eerst betrokken landen op passende wijze eer is betoond aan het optreden van de helden en zal daarom niet aanvullend een Nederlandse onderscheiding uitreiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “EU: Wij willen meer politieke islam in Europa”.

PVV MPs asked the government whether it agrees with EU foreign policy chief Mogherini's claim that Islam belongs in Europe, whether the EU endangers national identity, whether Netherlands should leave the EU, and whether she should be expelled to Saudi Arabia. The minister answered by citing EU treaty values and the Charter on religious freedom, rejected leaving the EU and rejected the expulsion request.
No. The cabinet considers continued membership of the European Union to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Nee. Het kabinet acht blijvend lidmaatschap van de Europese Unie in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Arabisch op Blerickse scholen'

PVV MPs asked whether Arabic lessons in Dutch primary schools should be stopped, arguing the language is irrelevant and linked to radicalisation. The minister rejected these claims and stated that schools may offer Arabic as an extracurricular activity, while within school hours only English, German and French (plus Dutch and Frisian) are legally permitted.
Within school hours, primary schools are legally permitted to offer only English, German and French, alongside Dutch (and Frisian in Friesland).
Binnen de onderwijstijd is het in het basisonderwijs wettelijk alleen toegestaan de talen Engels, Duits en Frans aan te bieden, naast het Nederlands (en het Fries in Friesland).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte gepakt in Limburg’

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of a terror suspect arrested in Limburg, whether terror suspects should be kept out of the Netherlands, whether this should be treated as a security warning, and whether the Netherlands should leave Schengen and reintroduce border controls. The government confirmed the arrest, said suspects can be arrested, prosecuted or extradited, noted the threat requires vigilance, and rejected leaving Schengen while defending its policy of preventing departures of foreign terrorist fighters.

The Cabinet is of the view that persons about whom there is a well-founded suspicion that they will travel to Syria and Iraq with the intention of joining a terrorist organisation must be prevented from departing.

Het Kabinet is van mening dat personen ten aanzien waarvan het gegronde vermoeden bestaat dat zij naar Syrië en Irak zullen uitreizen met de intentie om zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie, het uitreizen moet worden verhinderd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Omstreden haatsjeik donderdag naar Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a cleric calling for throat-cutting and skull-smashing should receive or keep a visa, and whether the Al Fourqaan mosque should be closed for hosting him. The government answered that Italy issued and then withdrew the visa so the speaker may not stay in the Netherlands, and that closing a building is only possible for building-safety violations, drug trade, or if the organisation's aims breach public order, while criminal incitement is prosecuted by the Public Prosecution Service.
This speaker therefore may not reside in the Netherlands.
Deze spreker mag dan ook niet in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bezoek van weer een haatsjeik, ditmaal aan een moskee in Helmond

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether a preacher who allegedly called for violence against Jews, Christians and Shiites should be allowed to speak at a Helmond mosque and whether his visa and the mosque should be blocked. The government answered that free speech is limited when incitement to hatred or violence threatens public order, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hatred, and that after local consultation the mosque cancelled the invitation.
By refusing visas to preachers from visa-requiring countries who call for hatred and violence, the government seeks to temper polarisation and radicalisation.
Door middel van het weigeren van visa aan predikers uit visumplichtige landen, die oproepen tot haat en geweld, tracht de overheid polarisering en radicalisering te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever en Wilders over het bericht 'Medische raad bij ramadan'

Three PVV MPs asked whether patients who fast during Ramadan knowingly endanger their health and whether insurers should bear the extra advice and care costs of those who become medically unstable. Minister Schippers answered that the Health Insurance Act requires care decisions to rest on care-content criteria, that she does not intend to amend it, and that no registrations exist to determine the extra costs.
I am not aware of any records from which these extra costs could be derived without further ado.
Er zijn mij geen registraties bekend waar deze extra kosten zonder meer uit af te leiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

PVV MPs asked why a Belgian sheikh with alleged terrorist links and torture-related convictions was offered a visa for an Utrecht event, and whether the Al Fitrah foundation and its mosque should be dissolved or closed and a blacklist of hate preachers created. The government answered that the sheikh did not attend and held lawful residence in Belgium, that no visa was issued to him, that dissolution or closure is not warranted given free speech limits enforced through criminal law, and that no blacklist exists though an NCTV alert list and Schengen alerts are used.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht dat illegale Marokkanen niet kunnen worden uitgezet

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked whether Morocco stopped accepting the return of illegal Moroccan nationals, why this was not communicated to parliament, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary confirmed Morocco had refused cooperation on forced returns, said Morocco has now agreed to resume cooperation, and noted a Council of State ruling limited detention of Moroccan nationals, which should become possible again once cooperation resumes.
It is not customary to actively inform your House about which countries do or do not (fully) cooperate on forced return.
Het is niet gebruikelijk uw Kamer actief te informeren over welke landen wel of niet (volledig) meewerken aan gedwongen terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Sponsoring conferentie Chatham House

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry sponsored a Muslim Brotherhood-linked congress, what it cost, and why the taxpayer should fund it. The minister denied it was a Muslim Brotherhood event, explained a 10,000 GBP contribution to a Chatham House Middle East conference, and refused to repay the money.
The Netherlands made a contribution of 10,000 British pounds to an activity of the Middle East and North Africa department of the renowned and independent British think tank Chatham House
Nederland heeft een bijdrage van 10.000 Britse Pond geleverd aan een activiteit van de afdeling Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika van de gerenommeerde en onafhankelijke Britse denktank Chatham House
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gouds bestuur lost vrouwenkwestie op’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a planned wall separating women from view of Muslims in a Gouda redevelopment amounts to sharia-based apartheid, and whether the government will ban mosque construction and the planned Gouda mega-mosque. The minister answered that the wall is a site-entrance separation requested by a special school and a child day-care centre, and that the mosque has offered to reduce its size, with an independent facilitator starting a new consultation; he reiterated that Muslims may build mosques within zoning rules and the law.
The mosque board of the new mosque planned in Gouda recently (mid-March) offered to substantially reduce the size of the mosque.
Het moskeebestuur van de nieuw te bouwen moskee in Gouda heeft recent (half maart) het aanbod gedaan om de moskee qua omvang substantieel te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob, Van der Staaij en Wilders over de herdenking van de Armeense genocide

MPs Slob, Van der Staaij and Wilders asked whether the cabinet still backs the Rouvoet motion urging Turkey's recognition of the Armenian genocide, given the minister's view that history is not for the cabinet to interpret, and whether a minister would attend the 100-year commemoration in Armenia or in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the cabinet maintains the motion's supportive interpretation and that the Dutch ambassador to Georgia, also accredited to Armenia, will attend the Armenia commemoration, with attendance at other events decided case by case.
The cabinet maintains the interpretation that previous cabinets have given to the motion.
Het kabinet handhaaft de interpretatie die voorgaande kabinetten aan de motie hebben gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat een bejaarde Rotterdamse gevangen zit in een zwaar versoberd verzorgingshuis; Zorgen om Nelly van 101

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether a 101-year-old Rotterdam resident, reportedly confined to a heavily austere care home after a change to living and care arrangements, reflects the intended closer-to-home care, and whether she really wants this. The state secretary acknowledged the report, said some residents may dread more independent living, and stated that existing residents' situations should be preserved as far as possible while a suitable solution is sought with the care office, provider and client.
That is why, in consultation between the care office, the care provider and the client, a suitable solution must be sought if an institution moves to separate housing and care.
Daarom moet in overleg tussen zorgkantoor, zorgaanbieder en cliënt gezocht worden naar een passende oplossing indien een instelling overgaat tot het scheiden van wonen en zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Halaleten voor elke scholier'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether a Christian school imposing halal food on all pupils, including non-Muslims, on a school trip is unacceptable and whether the proposal will be withdrawn. The State Secretary answered that schools are free to make such choices within the law, parents can raise concerns with school leadership and through the works council, and the national government has no role in meal decisions.
Schools are free to make their own choices, within the limits of laws and regulations.
Scholen zijn vrij om, binnen de grenzen van de wet- en regelgeving, hun eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over censuur bij stripmuseum

PVV MPs Bosma and Wilders asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a municipal council should interfere with exhibition content at a local comic museum, and about the planned Charlie Hebdo cartoon and calls for its removal. The minister answered that government should not interfere in artistic programming except where public order and safety are at stake, stressed free expression and mutual respect, and declined to take sides in the Dordrecht debate.
The government should not interfere with the substantive, artistic programming of a cultural institution.
De overheid heeft zich niet te bemoeien met de inhoudelijke, artistieke programmering van een culturele instelling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Van Haersma Buma, Wilders, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij naar aanleiding van zijn uitspraken tijdens het debat op 14 januari jl. over de aanslagen in Parijs

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister whether his remark that the AIVD, with current staffing and funding, can do its job was meant regarding jihadism, how many staff track returnees, whether budget cuts reduced coverage and staff quality, and how police, mayors and national government coordinate. The government replied that all eleven questions were already answered in an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288), without giving substance in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'extra measures counterterrorism and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Kamerstuk 29 754, no. 288).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het bericht dat het eigen risico niet meer te betalen is

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the health minister how she would respond to reports that people can no longer afford the mandatory deductible, and whether she would lower it using insurer reserves and cut spending on asylum, EU payments and aid. The minister replied that the solidarity system and zorgtoeslag protect low incomes, that reserves are private and cannot be used to lower the deductible though insurers may return surpluses, and that health care remains a government priority.
Healthcare costs should in principle not be a reason to forgo necessary care.
Zorgkosten hoeven in beginsel geen reden te zijn om af te zien van noodzakelijke zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht «Automobilist de klos in de Randstad»

PVV MPs asked whether higher municipal parking tariffs and more section controls on motorways are unfair extra burdens on motorists and whether the government will stop the big cities' plans. The state secretary answered that parking tariffs are a municipal matter, that section controls improve compliance rather than add costs, and that they do little for urban air quality, promising talks with the G7 cities.
Setting the height of parking tariffs is a responsibility of the municipalities and not of the national government.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van parkeertarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en niet van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Religies in gesprek in Ridderzaal’

Two PVV MPs asked why Islamic representatives were invited to a government dialogue in the Ridderzaal, a symbol of freedom, given their view of Islam as a totalitarian ideology. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected by freedom of religion, that the dialogue aimed to bridge differences in a pluralistic society, and that such conversations should continue.
Islam is a religion. Like other religions, this religion falls under freedom of religion and is subject to the same rules.
De Islam is een godsdienst. Deze godsdienst valt net als andere religies onder de vrijheid van godsdienst en is met dezelfde regels omgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het bericht ‘Kritiek op royale vertrekpremie Van Rompuy’

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the Prime Minister whether he regretted honouring Van Rompuy and whether the former European Council President's roughly 630,000 euro departure payment was theft, and whether the honour should be reclaimed. Minister Koenders replied that the entitlement is a legal transitional allowance under EU rules, the actual net amount is about 349,000 euro over up to three years, no relocation allowance applies, and the Netherlands is examining further modernisation of EU political office-holder arrangements.
The amount of 630,000 euro mentioned in some media is therefore incorrect.
Het in sommige media genoemde bedrag van € 630.000 is derhalve onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Iedereen bij moskee wist van shariahuwelijken’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that a mosque community knew of sharia marriages, whether such marriages are tolerated, and whether imams performing them should be expelled or stripped of nationality. The minister said no national overview of sharia marriages exists, confirmed that religious marriages without a prior civil marriage are prohibited and punishable, and stated that stripping Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible under current law or planned.
No national overview of this is available.
Hier is geen (landelijk) overzicht van beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over het aantal jihadisten

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD chief's figure of a few hundred jihadist participants was consistent with the government's figure of about 160 departed jihadists, and why the AIVD spoke of this in Washington rather than to parliament. The minister replied that the AIVD chief spoke of a few hundred potential participants, that parliament had been informed of the same figures in earlier letters, and that there is no discrepancy or difference in message between the two.
The head of the AIVD, Mr Bertholee, therefore did not disclose any figures in Washington other than those already known to your House.
Het hoofd van de AIVD, de heer Bertholee, heeft in Washington dus geen andere cijfers bekend gemaakt, dan die reeds bekend zijn bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht “Jihadronselaar Bilal is nu jongerenwerker in Amsterdam”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a convicted jihad recruiter now working as a youth worker in Amsterdam is truly deradicalised, whether he should be expelled, and whether his sister should be sent to ISIS. The minister said deradicalisation cannot be guaranteed, pointed to the Dutch citizenship-deprivation option and the integrated jihadism action programme, and refused to send the person or his sister away.
Deradicalisation, however, remains human work, so no one can give a guarantee about the degree of deradicalisation.
Deradicalisering blijft echter mensenwerk, waardoor niemand garantie kan geven over de mate van deradicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aantijgingen van de Turkse racismebeschuldiging

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's accusations of Dutch racism and aggression were justified, whether the Turkish ambassador should be summoned, and whether the Patriot missiles should be withdrawn early. The minister replied that he had raised the remarks with the ambassador and Turkish counterpart, that Turkey denied accusing the Dutch state or people, and that the Patriots stay in place as NATO protection.
I see no reason to deny our NATO ally this protection of our Patriots and to withdraw these systems earlier than announced.
Ik zie geen reden om onze NAVO-bondgenoot deze bescherming van onze patriots te ontzeggen en deze systemen eerder dan aangekondigd terug te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over taartverbod in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Saudi Arabia of bakery staff over cupcakes with text critical of Islam, and whether the Netherlands would act for their release and suggest an ambassador present a cake to the King. The minister confirmed the arrests and that the case is ongoing, said the Netherlands values free expression and raises it with Saudi authorities, and called the cake suggestion poor taste.
The Netherlands attaches great importance to freedom of expression and advocates it worldwide.
Nederland hecht groot belang aan de vrijheid van meningsuiting en bepleit dit wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘ISIS-vlag in beslag genomen’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether three men who waved an ISIS-type flag should be stripped of Dutch nationality and have their passports revoked. The minister replied that a prosecution decision is still pending after advice from the anti-discrimination expertise centre, so such measures are not yet on the table, and no further details can be given for reasons of investigation and prosecution.
Because of investigation and prosecution interests, no further information can be provided.
Vanwege belangen van opsporing en vervolging kunnen geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar jihadi-training in Ardennen’

Written questions from PVV MPs asked whether jihadi training facilities exist in or are used from the Netherlands, how many of the 41 passport-confiscated jihadists were trained in the EU, and whether jihadists can be denaturalised and expelled. The minister replied that no evidence of training camps in the Netherlands exists, that 48 passports are flagged, and that a bill to strip nationality from dual nationals convicted of terrorism is being prepared.
I have no indications that jihadist training camps are located in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat zich in Nederland jihadistische trainingskampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat ISIS beschikt over chemische wapens

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that ISIS possesses chemical weapons, including outdated Iraqi stocks, alleged chemical attacks in Kobani, the risk to Dutch trainers, and whether border controls are needed. The ministers answered that the Iraqi weapons were destroyed, that the Netherlands cannot confirm the Kobani findings without samples, that protective measures will follow threat analyses, and that border controls are not necessary given existing EU customs risk regimes.
No, the cabinet sees no need for this.
Nee, het kabinet ziet daartoe geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Nederland kan IS alleen verbieden op initiatief van het OM”

MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether IS can be banned in the Netherlands only on the initiative of the public prosecutor, and why Germany could ban it while the Netherlands could not. The minister answered that IS is already banned in the Netherlands via the EU sanctions list combined with the Civil Code and the Criminal Code, that no civil dissolution procedure is available because IS cannot acquire legal personality here, and that he will act if new measures prove necessary.
If necessary I will act immediately and ensure targeted strengthening of the legal instruments.
Indien noodzakelijk zal ik direct optreden en zorgen voor gerichte versterking van het wettelijk instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over het nieuws dat Turkije de man heeft vrijgelaten die in februari 2013 in Kopenhagen de Deense journalist Lars Hedegaard probeerde te vermoorden

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked why Turkey released the man who attempted to murder Danish journalist Lars Hedegaard, whether the Netherlands should protest, press Turkey to re-arrest and extradite him, and whether a country releasing terrorists belongs in NATO. The minister replied that Denmark has raised the matter with Turkey, which has promised to investigate, and that the cabinet sees no reason to raise Turkey's NATO membership.
Denmark has made inquiries about this matter, which is primarily a criminal case between Denmark and Turkey, with the Turkish authorities.
Denemarken heeft navraag gedaan over deze kwestie, die in eerste instantie een strafrechtelijke zaak is tussen Denemarken en Turkije, bij de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Of slapen er terroristen in Zwolle’

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of possible jihadist terrorists among asylum seekers, whether border closures and subsidy cuts were warranted. The minister answered that there are no concrete indications of planned abuse, that reintroducing internal border controls would be disproportionate, and that he will not close borders or cut subsidies, while pointing to a letter on measures and promising continued vigilance.
For operational reasons, I cannot make specific statements about any possible indications in this regard.
Vanwege operationele belangen kan ik geen specifieke mededelingen doen over eventuele aanwijzingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht moslims delen flyers uit voor protest

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that Muslims were handing out flyers for a protest, and whether the Hizb ut Tahrir caliphate aim undermines the democratic rule of law and whether members with Dutch passports should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister confirmed awareness, described HuT as an anti-democratic radical movement that does not call for violence but warrants vigilance, said measures follow only if criminal offences are committed, and rejected denaturalisation and expulsion as unnecessary.
If HuT were to commit criminal offences, measures would be taken.
Als de HuT zich schuldig zou (gaan) maken aan strafbare feiten dan worden er maatregelen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Superblunder: Franse jihadisten op vrije voeten'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that French jihadists were free in Turkey, whether Dutch-passport jihadists were held or extradited, whether they could be kept out, and whether border and passport controls should be tightened or borders closed. The minister said no Dutch-passport jihadists are currently known to be held in Turkey and none extradited, refused to end automated passport checks at Schiphol or to close borders, citing EU free movement and proportionality rules.
Such a decision is, as far as I am concerned, not on the agenda.
Een dergelijk besluit is wat mij betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over de ebola uitbraak

Two PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands was not part of a ministerial emergency meeting on Ebola, whether the government takes the public health risk seriously, and whether it will push for an EU-wide halt to flights from West Africa. The Minister replied that no invitation was received, that the risk is taken seriously with reference to a letter, and that she rejects flight bans because the virus should be isolated and regional borders kept open.
No. The three affected countries have, in line with WHO guidelines, introduced exit screening.
Nee. De drie getroffen landen hebben, conform de WHO richtlijnen, exit screening ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus, De Graaf en Wilders over het Islamitisch Offerfeest op Werelddierendag

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Islamic Feast of Sacrifice falling on World Animal Day, and the ritual slaughter it involves, was acceptable and whether the practice should end. The minister answered that the government respects religious traditions within the rule of law, that unstunned ritual slaughter is governed by law and enforced by the NVWA, and that it sees no reason to end the practice.
The manner in which unstunned ritual slaughter may take place is laid down in Dutch laws and regulations.
De wijze waarop onbedwelmde rituele slacht mag plaatsvinden is vastgelegd in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder over de terreuraanpak en het dreigingsniveau in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and Helder asked why the terrorism threat level was not raised from substantial to critical after a jihadist's call for attacks in the Netherlands, and how much more concrete a threat must be. Minister Opstelten answered that individual threats do not currently warrant a higher level, that the threat remains within the substantial band, and that services are doing everything to prevent attacks, and noted the Chamber was briefed on 29 September.
The threats expressed by individuals do not currently constitute grounds for raising the threat level.
De bedreigingen die door individuen zijn geuit vormen op dit moment geen reden het dreigingsniveau te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Wilders over de vernieuwde islamitische gebedsruimte op de Vrije Universiteit

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the VU's reopened Islamic prayer room, which they said enables gender segregation and undermines integration, should be grounds for cutting its funding. The Minister replied that universities decide their own diversity policy, that the VU bars gender segregation, that other religions are also accommodated, and that she sees no reason to end funding.
No. Whether and how a university gives shape to its diversity policy is a matter for the university itself. The government has no role in this.
Neen. Of en hoe een universiteit invulling geeft aan haar diversiteitsbeleid is een zaak van de universiteit zelf. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony Van Dijck en Bosma over het bericht ‘Terrorisme wordt vanuit Nederland gesteund met geld’

PVV MPs asked whether terror groups in Pakistan and Afghanistan received money from the Netherlands over 100 times, why money transfers flagged by exchange offices were not stopped sooner, and what action would be taken against those involved. The government answered that the press report misrepresented the figures: 108 dossiers in 2013 were reported to the authorities after analysis, none yet shown to involve terrorist financing, and prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Under the statutory duty of confidentiality, no further details can be given about the amounts involved.
Uit hoofde van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen geen nadere gegevens vermeld worden omtrent de in het geding zijnde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de berichten ‘Nederlandse Marokkanen nu ook in Marokko berecht’ en ‘Luxe auto’s en appartementen: daar gaat het geld naartoe’

PVV MPs asked about reports that Dutch-Moroccan dual nationals are detained and prosecuted in Morocco, how many dual nationals are detained and still receive benefits, and whether citizenship, assets, and benefits should be withdrawn or repatriation encouraged. The minister confirmed about 150 dual nationals detained in each country, explained benefit termination via data exchange, rejected the claim of hundreds involved in killings, noted existing asset-seizure and Moroccan benefit-check powers, and declined denaturalisation and benefit restrictions based on work history.
If a person is in detention and receives a benefit from the Dutch state, this benefit is terminated.
Indien een persoon in detentie verblijft en een uitkering van de Nederlandse staat ontvangt, wordt deze uitkering beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Ouders top-25 geven niet thuis’ en ‘Aanpak top-24 zaak van lange adem’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will strip Moroccan criminals and their families of Dutch nationality and deport them, arguing that the soft approach to crime yields nothing and that parents should bear responsibility. The Minister rejects shifting responsibility to parents, explains that deprivation of nationality is only possible for state-undermining offences with sentences of 8+ years, and refuses to move neighbourhood officers to Morocco.
Revoking Dutch nationality and deportation following a conviction for ordinary offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en uitzetting wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht «Vrouw uit Nederland hielp al-Shabaab met geld»

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked about a report that a Dutch woman financed al-Shabaab, whether other cases of jihad fundraising in the Netherlands are known, and whether the government will investigate Islamic funding flows and detain, denaturalise and deport those financing jihad. The minister answered that suspicious transactions are passed to investigative services without disclosing details, that a WODC study on foreign funding of Islamic institutions is underway (Somalia not included), and that terrorism financing is punishable with prosecution decided case by case, while citizenship can be revoked after a final conviction and that possibility is being extended.
Since the reports concern personal or investigative data, I cannot say anything about the content of the reports.
Aangezien de meldingen persoonsgegevens dan wel opsporingsgegevens betreffen, kan ik over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatimam in de ban'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on a hate-preaching imam, asking whether Islamic teaching should lead to closures and expulsions, whether Turkey's influence via imam appointments should be stopped, how mayors should respond, and whether migration and citizenship should be restricted. The minister answered that religion is not for the government to judge, that the state is neutral on imam appointments provided Dutch law is respected, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hate, that citizenship deprivation for terrorist offences is being expanded, and that the state acts where the rule of law is breached.
Where the limits of the rule of law are exceeded, the government acts, regardless of what inspired certain acts or statements.
Waar de grenzen van de rechtsstaat worden overschreden, treedt de overheid op, ongeacht waardoor bepaalde handelingen of uitspraken zijn geïnspireerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “PvdAer: ISIS is complot”

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether a Ministry of Security and Justice employee whose Twitter posts they called racist and radical should be dismissed. Minister Opstelten distanced himself from the posts, said her secondment to the NCTV was ended immediately, and said she is suspended pending an investigation and a decision on employment measures.
To ensure a careful decision-making process, the outcome cannot be anticipated.
Omwille van een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces kan niet vooruit worden gelopen op de uitkomsten daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de artikelen 'Nederlandse Joden huren bewaking in', 'Angst onder Rotterdamse joden na bedreiging op straat', 'Gesprek moet helpen' en 'Antisemitisme: 'Zo doen wij

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about press reports on Jewish security, antisemitism, a housing association's letters ordering removal of an Israeli flag, Muslim discrimination, and revoking Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers. The minister answered that the housing association regretted its letters and no action is planned, an antisemitism study is due in early 2015, and nationality can only be revoked after a terrorism conviction under limited conditions.
A study into possible breeding grounds and triggering factors for antisemitism ... will be delivered in early 2015.
Een onderzoek naar mogelijke voedingsbodems en triggerfactoren voor antisemitisme ... zal begin 2015 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Helder over de anti-Israëldemonstratie

PVV MPs asked whether police failed to act against Nazi and terror symbols and a Hitler salute at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and whether the mayor failed and suspects should be arrested, stripped of Dutch nationality and expelled. The minister refers to earlier answers, says criminal punishment is for the judge, and explains that Dutch nationality can only be revoked for terrorism convictions after 1 October 2010 and that residence can be ended only after a final conviction.
If someone has committed a criminal offence, it is for the judge to assess what punishment is appropriate, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien iemand een strafbaar feit heeft begaan, is het aan de rechter om te beoordelen welke straf passend is, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de antisemitische demonstratie door moslims in Den Haag

Three PVV MPs asked why police and the mayor did not act against alleged criminal speech (calls to violence, a Hitler salute) at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and why a journalist was removed rather than her harassers arrested. The minister answered that two people were arrested and will be prosecuted, no Hitler salute was found, the mayor lacks legal power to ban a demonstration for its content, and the journalist's treatment aimed to prevent escalation.
The mayor also has no power to act against a demonstration solely to prevent or end criminal offences.
De burgemeester heeft ook geen bevoegdheid tegen een demonstratie op te treden enkel ter voorkoming of beëindiging van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een anti ISIS demonstratie in de Schilderswijk op 10 augustus jl.

An MP from the PVV asked whether the government would tolerate an anti-ISIS demonstration in The Hague being disrupted by counter-demonstrators, whether police capitulated by changing the route, and whether those advocating violence should be expelled. The government answered that police did not capitulate, had agreed route changes beforehand to prevent disorder, and that existing legal powers suffice, without committing to new measures.
The police did not capitulate to the counter-demonstrators.
De politie heeft niet gecapituleerd voor de tegendemonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de voorgenomen nieuwbouw van de Tevhit-moskee in Venlo-Zuid

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government knows of the planned new Tevhit mosque in Venlo, its links to the Turkish Diyanet foundation, its financing, and whether it will block construction. The government confirmed the plan, noted the mosque appears on the foundation's list of branches, said it does not interfere in financing of religious buildings absent suspicion of illegal acts, and pointed to freedom of religion under Article 6 of the Constitution while stating construction is allowed if Dutch law is respected.
The construction of new mosques or other places of worship is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën of andere gebedshuizen is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van de Rijksvertegenwoordiger voor de BES- eilanden

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the minister why the Sint Eustatius island council distrusts the appointed Rijksvertegenwoordiger Isabella and whether his appointment is credible, and demanded assurances he stay off the islands. The minister regretted the council's doubts, stated the appointment followed a transparent procedure with an independent commission and consultation of island executives, and refused to restrict Isabella's future work.
Mr Isabella was appointed through a transparent procedure and on the nomination of an independent committee.
De heer Isabella is benoemd door middel van een transparante procedure en op voordracht van een onafhankelijke commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf , Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Gevaarlijke jihadist vaak buiten beeld’

PVV MPs asked whether the government will reintroduce border controls, detain and expel returning jihadists and impose an immigration stop from Islamic countries after a report that foreign jihadists move freely in Europe unknown to the services. The Staatssecretaris answered that European intelligence cooperation is intensified, rejected the listed measures as incompatible with the constitution and treaties, and pointed to a national action programme on travel-data collection for later this autumn.
Concrete public statements cannot be made about the nature of cooperation between intelligence services.
Over de aard van de samenwerking tussen inlichtingendiensten, kunnen in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de rakettenregen van Hamas en Fatah onder toeziend oog van de terroristische Palestijnse “eenheidsregering"

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian unity government and Fatah allowed rocket fire on Israel, whether the government condemned it, and whether all Dutch and EU financial and political support to the Palestinian government and Authority should be halted. The minister answered that the government condemns the rocket attacks, holds the technocratic government to its actions under the Quartet principles, and sees no reason to stop cooperation or funding since Hamas controls Gaza, not the new government.
On the basis of the above, the government sees no reason to stop cooperation with the Palestinian technocratic government.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om de samenwerking met de Palestijnse technocratische regering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van een omstreden PvdA-wethouder als Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES

MPs Fritsma and Wilders questioned the appointment of a controversial PvdA alderman as Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES, asking about selection criteria and whether the nomination would be withdrawn. The minister replied that a selection committee made a unanimous nomination which he adopted, that island councils were consulted, and that he considers the appointee fully qualified.
This committee made a unanimous nomination to me. I adopted this nomination.
Deze commissie heeft aan mij een unanieme voordracht gedaan. Deze voordracht heb ik overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Helder over de ronselfilm ‘Fighting Journalists, Oh Oh Aleppo “De spookstad”

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they knew of a jihadist recruitment film targeting Dutch youth, whether it aimed at recruiting for jihad, how they view the fact that the people involved are third-generation Dutch-born, and whether they would prosecute the makers and strip citizenship from dual nationals. The minister confirmed knowledge of the film, said it intends to radicalise and recruit youth, stated that recruitment for jihad is a crime with prosecution decided case by case by the Public Prosecution Service, and noted citizenship can be revoked after a final terrorism conviction where dual nationality exists.
Recruiting for jihad is a crime. The Public Prosecution Service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Moskee moet plaats bieden aan duizenden’ en ‘Moslims onder druk om bijdrage moskee’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on a Gouda mosque expansion, including alleged pressure on members to contribute 1,500 euro and past fundraising for Syria. The minister answered that mosque construction is a matter of religious freedom, that contributions must be voluntary and that pressure is rejected, while stating no evidence was found that funds went to jihad and that financing falls within Dutch law.
The board is entitled to ask mosque visitors for a financial contribution toward the construction of a new mosque.
Het bestuur is gerechtigd om de bezoekers van de moskee een financiële bijdrage te vragen ten behoeve van de bouw van een nieuwe moskee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de stand van zaken in Irak en de opmars van ISIS

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about returned Syria jihadists, recruiters, terror financing, mosque closures and denaturalisation/detention of returnees. The government answered that about thirty returnees are known, that operational details and locations are not disclosed, that prosecutors and services monitor them, and that mosque closure and nationality revocation are possible under specific legal conditions.
Operational matters and specific cases cannot be disclosed publicly.
Over operationele aangelegenheden en concrete gevallen kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een deel van de Nederlandse jihadstrijders in Syrië studiefinanciering ontvangt

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked whether the minister knows of reports that some Dutch jihadists in Syria receive student finance, and whether she will stop it by general administrative order. The minister confirmed the reports, said student finance is stopped immediately in concrete cases, and that the cases are now stopped, but declined to name any cases.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over de mislukking van het anti-radicaliseringsbeleid

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on the failure of anti-radicalisation policy, including its cost (around 30 million euros), how the money was spent, and whether Islam is the root cause. The minister confirmed the broadcast, gave a budget breakdown (14.46 million spent over 2007-2011, with 78 projects funded and oversight via subsidy conditions), and rejected the link between Islam and radicalisation.
Decentralisation grants were paid out via the municipal fund. There was consultation about this, but no formal review or control applies.
Via het gemeentefonds zijn de decentralisatie-uitkeringen uitgekeerd. Daarover is wel overleg geweest maar is een officiële toetsing/controle niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hilversumse moskee tart herdenking’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares their revulsion at a Hilversum mosque comparing the Holocaust to the Arab attempt to prevent Israel's creation, and whether the mosque should be closed and its land rezoned. The minister confirmed awareness and said closure or dissolution is only possible under narrow legal conditions (public order, fire/safety violations, drug trade) and that zoning is a municipal responsibility, none of which apply here.
The zoning of land is a municipal responsibility.
De bestemming van gronden is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘In Nederland studerende Saoediër opgepakt in Kenia’

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands contributes to the education of students from Islamic countries such as Saudi Arabia, and whether such students should be barred or expelled after a Saudi student was arrested in Kenya. The minister answered that internationalisation policy does not distinguish by religion, declined to comment on the individual case, and refused to bar or expel students from Islamic countries.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat leden van het Europees Parlement 200 miljoen euro hebben gedeclareerd

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the cabinet would ensure strict checks on European Parliament members' office-cost declarations and whether Dutch MEPs avoid submitting receipts. The minister replied that office costs are paid as a flat-rate allowance without declarations, that the European Court of Auditors is responsible for public control, and that its audit found the EP's control systems effective.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Buurtvader Gestel: “Ik ga derde overvaller Deurne niet aangeven”

PVV MPs asked why no action was taken against a neighbourhood father who said he would not name the third robber of a Deurne jeweller, and whether he should be arrested and whether Moroccans distrusting the Dutch should give up benefits and leave. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation and rejected the claim of a failed integration and parallel society, and rejected the benefit-surrender idea by restating that everyone has equal rights and duties.
The investigation into the robbery in Deurne – and therefore also the investigation into all possible suspects – has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek naar de overval in Deurne – en daarmee ook het onderzoek naar alle mogelijke verdachten – is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over een nieuwe pro-EU-oproep bij de stempas, ditmaal van de burgemeester van Bergen, NH

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a municipal letter sent with EP election polling cards, which mentioned EU regulation, was unacceptable and whether the mayor of Bergen should be called to account. The minister replied that the letter does not argue for more or less EU involvement, saw no need for a talk with the mayor, and knew of no signals of other municipalities trying to influence voters, so no investigation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the investigation you requested.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om het door u gevraagde onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Mogelijk 300 miljoen extra naar Brussel'

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the cabinet budgets for EU payments beyond the 8 billion euro for next year, why the money goes to Brussels rather than domestic tax relief or elderly care, and whether he will leave the EU. The minister replied that the 2015 EU payments are estimated at 7.2 billion in the 2014 budget, that CBS revisions may affect them but cannot yet be quantified, that details will follow in the Spring Memorandum, referred to the Prinsjesdag budget documents for the rationale, and rejected leaving the EU.
In the Miljoenennota 2015 I will address the changes that occur in budget year 2015.
In de Miljoenennota 2015 zal ik ingaan op de mutaties die zich voordoen in het begrotingsjaar 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Brits politicus wegens het citeren van Winston Churchill

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of a British politician for quoting Churchill on Islam violates free speech, whether the UK should be pressed to drop charges, and how the Netherlands will defend free expression internationally. The minister answered that free speech limits are for an independent court to judge, that the Dutch government has no grounds to contact UK authorities, and that free expression is already a priority in Dutch human rights policy.
It is for an independent judge to determine whether the limits of freedom of expression have been exceeded in this case.
Het is aan een onafhankelijke rechter om vast te stellen of de grenzen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in dit geval zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "Grieken belazeren de boel opnieuw...."

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Greece's primary surplus is an illusion, whether Eurostat and member states knew of statistical manipulation, whether the pension fund holds 4.7 billion euro, and whether he will travel to Greece to reclaim loans. The minister denied the manipulation claims, citing Eurostat-confirmed deficit and debt figures and programme definitions, explained the social fund surplus as neutral state transfers, and declined to travel.
No, Eurostat has confirmed that for 2013 the Greek government deficit comes to 12.7% of GDP (incl. bank recapitalisation) and debt to 175.1% of GDP.
Nee, Eurostat heeft bevestigd dat voor 2013 het Griekse overheidstekort uitkomt op 12,7% BBP (incl. bankenherkapitalisatie) en de schuld op 175,1% BBP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over verkapt stemadvies van de gemeente Sittard

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that the municipality of Sittard sent residents a pro-EU letter that they considered covert voting advice, and whether the mayor should be made to retract it. The minister answered that the letter describes the EU's importance and does not amount to voting advice for any party, that voters are free to choose, and that a conversation with the mayor is not necessary.
The mayor's letter describes the importance of the EU and therefore cannot reasonably be regarded as voting advice for or against any party contesting the European Parliament election.
De brief van de burgemeester beschrijft wat het belang van de EU is en kan daarmee redelijkerwijs niet worden beschouwd als stemadvies voor of tegen enige partij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vorig jaar twintig doden door eergerelateerd geweld’

PVV MPs asked the government about a report of twenty honour-related deaths in 2013, probing the role of Islam, shelter data, whether victims relocate for safety, and deportation or denaturalisation of perpetrators. The minister answered that the figures are being collected and the LEC EGG network continues, that culture rather than religion drives honour codes, that shelter nationality data is not kept, and that denaturalisation for common crimes is not permitted under the Dutch law and the European Nationality Convention.
Nationality and religious background are not recorded by the Federatie Opvang.
Nationaliteit en religieuze achtergrond worden niet bijgehouden door de Federatie Opvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over het weigeren van het naleven van hygiëneregels door een moslima

MPs Klever and Wilders asked whether hospital hygiene rules should outweigh a Muslim employee's religious conviction, why the IGZ did not enforce hygiene rules, how many similar cases exist, and how hospitals can avoid lawsuits and settlements. The minister answered that religious dress can be restricted only with objective justification such as hygiene, that the IGZ advised the hospital and the hospital bears responsibility, that no overview is available, and that labour relations in care are not her responsibility.
It is not my responsibility to intervene in labour relations in the care sector.
Het behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid om te treden in arbeidsrelaties in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over allochtone homohaters uit Amersfoort

MPs asked the ministers about reports that a gay man in Amersfoort was driven out of his neighbourhood by harassment from young men, and whether mass immigration and Islamisation hinder gay emancipation and whether perpetrators should be expelled or punished more harshly. The ministers condemned discrimination, said perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected, rejected expulsion of Dutch nationals, and listed existing local and national support measures without new concrete commitments.
Perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected.
Daders moeten worden aangepakt en slachtoffers beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Madlener en Wilders over gesjoemel met EU-subsidie voor moskeeën

MPs asked whether Amsterdam and the Interior Ministry obtained EU subsidy for two mosques by misdescribing a building as a multicultural centre, and asked about a mosque construction halt and punishment of those responsible. The minister answered that the mosque part was excluded from subsidy, that the subsidy went to Amsterdam Groot-Oost rather than the ministry, that the OLAF investigation outcome is pending, and rejected a construction halt and a withdrawal of EU involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een jihadist uit Almere die poseert met 5 afgehakte hoofden

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a jihadist from Almere photographed with five severed heads, asking about his punishment, expulsion and the government's approach to jihadists leaving the Netherlands. The minister confirmed awareness of the photo, said the man's residence right had ended with a 20-year entry ban, and described measures such as stopping benefits, freezing assets and local-triangle interventions, while declining to disclose individual-level details.
However, I cannot make further public statements about the application of the aforementioned measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan echter in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over toepassing van voornoemde maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de oproep een Marokkaanse dame 50 zweepslagen te geven

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about calls for a Moroccan businesswoman to receive 50 lashes after she opened a wine shop, including death threats she received. Minister Opstelten called the call for lashes unacceptable, left the criminal qualification to the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to disclose investigative or protection measures, and said nationality revocation and expulsion for common crimes are not possible.

It is not in the interest of the investigation or of the person concerned to make public statements about whether, and if so which, investigative actions in this case have been or are being carried out.
Het is niet in het belang van de opsporing en van betrokkene om publiekelijk mededelingen te doen over de vraag of, en zo ja welke, opsporingshandelingen in deze zaak zijn of worden verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over "de levenslange uitkering van remigranten"

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that migrants who return under the Remigration Scheme receive a lifelong benefit, health insurance allowance and no job-seeking obligation, and whether the PVV proposal to abolish these will be adopted. The minister answered that the scheme targets long-term benefit-dependent migrants who voluntarily return, that payments are based on living costs in the country of origin and are lower than Dutch benefits, and that the amended Remigration Act takes effect on 1 July, referring to parliamentary debate for further detail.
On 1 July the amendment to the Remigration Act takes effect.
Op 1 juli aanstaande treedt de wijziging van de Remigratiewet in werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de aanhoudende Marokkaanse straatterreur in Helmond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked about youth street crime in Helmond, its harsh enforcement, the over-representation of Moroccan-Dutch youths in crime statistics, and why criminal non-citizens and dual nationals are not deported or stripped of nationality. The minister replied that policing has been intensified with a zero-tolerance approach, that the approach does not distinguish by ethnicity, that sentencing is for the prosecution service, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The share of suspects among Moroccan-Dutch boys under 23 is indeed much higher than the share of suspects among native Dutch youths.
Het aandeel verdachten onder Marokkaans-Nederlandse jongens tot 23 jaar is inderdaad veel hoger dan het aandeel verdachten onder autochtone jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over het stemadvies van vice-premier Asscher

Wilders and Bosma asked the Prime Minister whether Vice-Premier Asscher's campaign advice against voting PVV reflected the whole cabinet and whether it was improper. The Prime Minister answered that Asscher did not call on voters to avoid the PVV, quoting his remark that such statements could be countered by making a different choice.
Mr Asscher did not call on people not to vote for the PVV.
De heer Asscher heeft niet opgeroepen niet op de PVV te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Klever en Wilders over het zwichten van voetbalclub Vitesse voor de Jodenhaat van de VAE (Verenigde Arabische Emiraten)

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Vitesse's decision to travel to the UAE without Jewish player Dan Mori, who was unwelcome there, reflects antisemitism and dhimmitude, and what measures would follow. The minister called the decision a bad signal, acknowledged concern about contemporary antisemitism and announced a study into its causes, but declined any measures against the club and noted that the question about admitting the player was moot after the team's return.
It was a bad signal from Vitesse to travel to the United Arab Emirates without its own player Mori.
Het was een slecht signaal van Vitesse om zonder haar eigen speler Mori af te reizen naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten.

Vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Klever (allen PVV) aan de Ministers van Economische Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «accijnzen nekslag pomphouders» (ingezonden 7 januari 2014).

MPs De Graaf, Wilders and Klever asked whether a news report on excise increases hurting petrol station owners in border regions would prompt the government to cut excise duties to undercut neighbouring countries. The state secretary acknowledged the border-region impact, said a report would follow by mid-May 2014, and declined to commit to lowering excise duties yet, citing the need for more time to assess effects.
My predecessor promised to send a report to the House before the summer.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft toegezegd voor de zomer een rapportage aan de Kamer te zullen zenden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat er op het Ibn Ghaldoun sprake was van een losgeslagen cultuur, een incompetent bestuur en het mede schuldig zijn van ouders en docenten

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the State Secretary for Education about reports of a lax culture, incompetent governance and complicit staff at Ibn Ghaldoun school, including how a teacher who was intimidated was handled, why no criminal complaint was filed, and whether the school was rescued despite known problems. The State Secretary answered that personnel matters belong to the school board, that criminal acts must be reported, that funding was ended after the inspectorate found no trust in the board, and that the inspectorate monitors the new school.
The inspectorate is keeping a close eye on this.
De inspectie houdt daarbij de vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over discriminerende zorgverzekeraars die een spotgoedkope zorgverzekering met nul eigen risico aanbieden aan uitsluitend buitenlanders

MPs Klever and Wilders asked the minister about insurers offering very cheap health policies with zero deductible only to foreigners, and whether this should be ended and extended to Dutch citizens. The minister replied that these are voluntary collective add-on arrangements for groups such as seasonal workers, that the NZa monitors them and finds them small (under 2%), and that she cannot ban them, though she asked the NZa to give them extra attention in its market scan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht "Ook Moldaviër mag zonder visum Nederland in"

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Moldovan nationals can enter the Netherlands without a visa, and why, given existing crime and nuisance, immigration should continue to be allowed. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that the visa waiver covers short stays only, that long-term immigration remains governed by national law, and pointed to the emergency brake procedure as a safeguard.

Furthermore, the emergency brake procedure that came into force on 9 January, which allows the visa requirement to be temporarily reintroduced in the event of a sudden increase in illegal stay and/or asylum applications, provides an adequate safety net.

Verder biedt de op 9 januari jl. in werking getreden noodremprocedure, die het mogelijk maakt bij een plotselinge toename van illegaliteit en/of asielaanvragen tijdelijk de visumplicht weer in te voeren, een adequaat vangnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'PGGM haalt beleggingen uit Israëlische banken'

MPs Madlener, De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government considers PGGM's divestment from Israeli banks a boycott, how much PGGM invests in Israel and the Palestinian territories, and what the government will do against investor withdrawal and anti-Israel sentiment. The minister answered that PGGM's decision is its own, that PGGM still invests in Israeli companies (over EUR 60 million in several dozen firms), that the government does not track investments and does not intervene in company decisions, and that it is working to deepen economic ties with Israel.
The government does not keep track of PGGM's investments.
Het kabinet houdt de investeringen van PGGM niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hundreds of thousands from outside EU could head for UK in passport loophole’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that Bulgaria and Romania issue passports to non-EU nationals, enabling them to reach Northern Europe, and about expected Romanian and Bulgarian labour migration. The government replied that nationality law is a member-state competence, that it expects other states to act with due care, that predicting numbers is uncertain, and that the Netherlands has taken measures with municipalities to manage arrivals and tackle abuse.
Nationality legislation is not a competence of the European Union, and each member state therefore has its own legislation determining who is entitled to the nationality in question.
Nationaliteitswetgeving is geen bevoegdheid van de Europese Unie en iedere lidstaat heeft derhalve eigen wetgeving op basis waarvan vastgesteld wordt wie recht heeft op de betreffende nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het subsidiëren van een aan Milli Gorus gelieerde islamitische stichting

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a Milli Gorus-affiliated youth foundation (MGT) receiving municipal subsidy should lose its funding after its annual report was written 'in the name of Allah', and what measures the government would take. The minister answered that the Amsterdam-West district is responsible for subsidy decisions, that MGT received about EUR 21,725.50 in 2013 for two project subsidies with no 2014 subsidy so far, and that the subsidies do not violate church-state separation, so no further measures were announced.
In this case it is up to the Amsterdam-West district to weigh the granting of subsidies.
Het is in dit geval aan het stadsdeel Amsterdam-West om een afweging te maken ten aanzien van het verstrekken van subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over Nederlands belastinggeld voor anti-Israëlische propaganda

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid money funded a youth NGO's broadcast calling Israelis 'crows and rats' and whether aid to the NDC and Palestinian Authority should stop. The minister condemned the rhetoric, denied NDC funds went to the producer PYALARA, and declined to halt aid.
The cabinet condemns this kind of incitement.
Het kabinet veroordeelt dergelijk opruiend taalgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat de Nederlandse economie tuimelt naar 30e plaats

PVV MPs asked whether the reported drop of the Dutch economy to 30th place means the Netherlands would be better off outside the euro, whether lower taxes would boost growth, and whether the government will reverse tax rises and redirect spending. The minister rejects leaving the euro, says the ranking drop is relative and largely driven by emerging economies, and explains that the government lowers household burdens while reducing deficits mainly through spending cuts.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van geweldsimam Al Haddad

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister knew of reports that Islamist preacher Al-Haddad called for stoning adulterers and death for apostates, whether he posed a public-order threat, and whether he should be expelled. The minister said such statements would be reprehensible but prosecution is for prosecutors and courts, that Al-Haddad may voice his views, and that under EU rules a British citizen can only be refused entry for a genuine, serious threat to public order, which was not established; the event was reported cancelled.
The assessment of criminal liability must in an individual case first be made by the public prosecutor and ultimately by the criminal court.
De beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het openbaar ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
