Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlands geld voor de jihad in Jemen

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether money from the Netherlands funds jihad in Yemen, how much, and what will be done to stop it and prosecute donors. The minister confirmed informal, mostly small-scale flows may reach fighters, said the police and AIVD monitor such flows, and that prosecution under Article 421 of the Criminal Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide case by case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to decide case by case whether to proceed with prosecution.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om per geval te besluiten of tot vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over Visumvrij reizen door Turken

MPs Madlener and Wilders asked whether Turkish citizens would gain visa-free travel to the EU once a readmission agreement is signed, and whether the government would push to halt negotiations. The Minister replied that visa abolition is not yet on the table, that it depends on strict conditions in an action plan, and that the government sees the readmission agreement as in Dutch interests.
Abolition of the visa requirement is not yet on the agenda.
Afschaffing van de visumplicht is nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht Oostblokker verdringt bouwvakker

PVV MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether the government will fully maintain work permits for Romanian and Bulgarian workers after 1 January 2014, given displacement fears in construction. The minister replied that transitional restrictions end on that date under the accession treaties, that displacement through bogus constructions will be tackled, and that bilateral agreements on enforcing Dutch working conditions were made.
From that date no measures are permitted that restrict the access of Bulgarian and Romanian workers to the labour market.
Per die datum zijn geen maatregelen meer toegestaan die de toegang van Bulgaarse en Roemeense werknemers tot de arbeidsmarkt beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de uitvaart van Nelson Mandela

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government would request the arrest and extradition of Suriname's president Desi Bouterse, convicted to 11 years for cocaine trafficking, and whether it was improper for the King to attend a ceremony with him. The minister answered that Netherlands values attendance at the Mandela memorial, that the conviction stands but cannot be enforced while Bouterse enjoys head-of-state immunity.
The court's judgment convicting Bouterse remains in force, but cannot be enforced as long as he enjoys international immunity as head of state of Suriname.

De uitspraak van de rechtbank waarbij Bouterse is veroordeeld blijft van kracht, maar kan niet tot uitvoering worden gebracht, zolang hij als staatshoofd van Suriname internationaal immuniteit geniet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over de uitspraak van Eurocommissaris Kroes over Verhofstadt als kandidaat-voorzitter van de Europese Commissie

MPs Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government supports Guy Verhofstadt as candidate for Commission president, after Commissioner Kroes said the VVD would back him, and asked which liberal has the most EU-right. The government answered that it will decide which candidate to support once the candidates are known, and that this is not yet on the agenda.
The government will decide which candidate for President of the European Commission to support when the candidates are known.
De regering zal een beslissing nemen over welke kandidaat voorzitter van de Europese Commissie te steunen wanneer de kandidaten hiervoor bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verbod op de intocht van Zwarte Piet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a view that Dutch traditions such as Zwarte Piet should be protected against multicultural objections, and what it will do given moves to ban the Piet arrival and remove Piet from schools. The minister answered that the Sinterklaas celebration is a matter for society and local committees and schools, and declined to take national action.
The arrival is a local matter. School boards are free to celebrate festivities and shape them as they see fit.
De intocht is een lokale aangelegenheid. Schoolbesturen zijn vrij om naar eigen inzicht feesten te vieren en deze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de opvang van 600 asielzoekers in vakantiepark Duinrell

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why 600 asylum seekers were being housed in holiday park Duinrell, questioning the choice given Syrian refugees and the regional-aid policy. The State Secretary confirmed temporary housing there until end March 2014 due to rising asylum inflow, said the COA is seeking other sites, and defended regional refugee support and the efficiency of the asylum procedure.
It is correct that asylum seekers are being housed in cottages in Duinrell, where the first asylum seekers arrived from 15 November.
Het is correct dat er asielzoekers worden opgevangen in huisjes in Duinrell waar vanaf 15 november de eerste asielzoekers zijn ingestroomd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Riyad

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of an ambassador's tweet calling Hajj a showcase of Islam as a religion of peace, asked him to explain that claim, and asked whether the ambassador should be recalled. The minister confirmed awareness of the tweet, said the cabinet does not share the MPs' view of Islam, and refused to recall the ambassador.
Question 4: Will you immediately recall this ambassador, who evidently knows nothing of all these matters or behaves like a dhimmi?
Vraag 4 Wilt u deze ambassadeur, die van al die zaken kennelijk geen weet heeft oftewel zich als een dhimmi gedraagt, onmiddellijk terugroepen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de Marokkaanse groepsmishandeling van een vrouw

MPs from the PVV asked about a reported group assault on a woman by Moroccan men, whether the perpetrators had been arrested, whether the government would acknowledge a 'Moroccan problem' and expel convicted offenders, and whether group liability should be extended. The minister replied that police found the woman admitted to fabricating the account, a false-report procedure was started, and that group participation in violence is already punishable under article 141 of the Criminal Code, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
Following this confession, the police drew up an official report against her for filing a false complaint.
Naar aanleiding van deze bekentenis heeft de politie proces-verbaal tegen haar opgemaakt wegens het doen van een valse aangifte.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bouw van de grootste moskee van Nederland (ingezonden 16 september 2013

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the financing of the Ulu mosque in Utrecht, the wages of its board and imam, and how to stop new mosque construction. The minister answered that the mosque was funded by donations, board members are unpaid, the imam is paid by ISN, and that building mosques is lawful under freedom of religion, while urging mosques to be transparent about financing.
I generally do not have information on the financing of mosques or houses of worship and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik in het algemeen niet over informatie over de financiering van moskeeën of gebedshuizen en/of de bestuurders daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht "Israël verbolgen over richtlijnen EU"

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the EU Commission issued guidelines barring EU agreements with Israel from applying to territories occupied since 1967, and whether he would stop them. The minister replied that these are non-binding Commission guidelines consistent with long-standing EU and Dutch policy, that he cannot prevent them, and rejected the calls to cut the EU bureaucrats involved.
No. The Commission can independently adopt guidelines.
Nee. De Commissie kan zelfstandig richtsnoeren vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over "de islamitische inmenging van Koeweit in Nederland"

MPs Van Klaveren, De Roon and Wilders asked whether Kuwaiti state involvement in the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, including funding and board links, should be tolerated, and whether the mosque should be closed and the Kuwaiti ambassador expelled. The minister said the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or funding absent national security concerns, asked the mosque board for openness on financing, and rejected closure and expulsion.
I do not have information on Kuwait's funding of mosques and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de bekostiging door Koeweit van moskeeën en/of de bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de mogelijke transfer van speler Gareth Bale van Tottenham Hotspur naar Real Madrid

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the Finance Minister about the reported 100 million euro transfer of Gareth Bale to Real Madrid, alleged Real Madrid tax debts, and whether Spanish bank Bankia, which received ESM-linked support, is a Real Madrid lender. The minister declined to comment on Spanish tax matters or Bankia's ties to Real Madrid, explained the ESM framework, and answered the closing question about the MP's own football ability with a flat no.
I make no statements about the individual tax matters in Spain, nor about the relationship between Bankia and Real Madrid.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over de individuele belastingzaken in Spanje en ook niet over de relatie tussen Bankia en Real Madrid.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de islamitische bedreigingen na arrestatie ronselaarster (ingezonde

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether more recruiters for jihad should be arrested, how Islamic threats after a Zoetermeer recruiter's arrest should be viewed, whether Islam should be combated structurally, and whether jihadist recruiters can be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that only one arrest has been made so far, rejected all threats, refused to treat Islam as a totalitarian ideology, and said citizenship can be revoked only for dual nationals convicted of terrorism.
For persons holding Dutch nationality, Dutch citizenship can be revoked if the person has been finally convicted of a terrorist offence.
Bij personen die in bezit zijn van de Nederlandse nationaliteit kan het Nederlanderschap worden ingetrokken als de betrokkene onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Christenen die in Nigeria als beesten worden afgeslacht

Two MPs from the PVV asked the foreign minister about reports of Christians being forced to convert and killed in Nigeria, and about alleged Iranian support for militants there. The minister condemned rights abuses, said the Boko Haram attacks also target non-Christians, and said the government has no reliable information confirming Iranian involvement.
The Cabinet does not have reliable information that confirms this assumption.
Het Kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare informatie die deze veronderstelling bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over "besmet verklaren" van bezoek aan Australië

MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an embassy email in Australia telling diplomatic staff, and honorary consuls, not to attend meetings during Wilders' visit, and whether consular assistance was restricted. The minister replied that the request was to avoid the impression of an official visit, that consular help is available to all Dutch citizens, and that no change to consular guidelines is considered necessary.
There was no prohibition on attending as a private person or interested citizen, but on doing so as official representatives of the Netherlands.
Er was geen sprake van een verbod om als privépersoon of geïnteresseerde burger aanwezig te zijn, maar om het feit dat ze niet als officiële vertegenwoordiger van Nederland zouden deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat huiseigenaren door de bank als melkkoe worden gebruikt

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether banks' mortgage margins are historically high, whether the price-leadership ban on Dutch banks should be ended, and what measures will lower mortgage rates. The minister replied that the ING price-leadership restriction has ended and the ABN Amro ban is being weighed in ongoing Commission talks, and referred to earlier answers on mortgage rates without announcing new measures.
See the answers to questions 2 and 3 from MP Monasch (PvdA) to the ministers of Finance and for Housing and Government Organisation on the ECB interest rate decision.
Zie beantwoording van de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over het rentebesluit van de ECB.
Vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Haagse jihadisten vrijuit» (ingezonden 26 juni 2013).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch jihadists fighting with Jabhat al-Nusra in Syria are committing terrorist offences, whether the Hague mayor was wrong to say they cannot be prosecuted, and how society will be protected. The state secretary answered that participation is a terrorist offence and prosecution is legally possible though difficult, and pointed to intensified intelligence, enforcement and personal-approach measures referenced in an earlier policy letter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren,  Bontes en Wilders over 'Ramadandiensten' bij de politie

PVV MPs asked whether police receive extra Ramadan shifts, whether Ramadan and Eid generate more reported nuisance and crime, whether police adapt to Islamic practice, and whether extra deployment could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary confirmed the news report, said police and prosecutors do not record Ramadan-related incidents, stated that the mayor decides deployment based on safety needs, and saw no reason to recover costs.
Neither the police nor the Public Prosecution Service records how many reports are related to Ramadan or the Eid festival.
Er wordt door de Politie of OM niet bijgehouden hoeveel meldingen gerelateerd zijn aan de Ramadan of het Suikerfeest.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, de Roon, Madlener en van Klaveren over de samenwerking tussen de EU en de Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about EU cooperation with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, including its observer status, its stance on criticism of Islam and whether the EU should end contacts. The minister rejected most premises, affirmed continued support for free expression and religious freedom, and declined to end the observer status.
No. However, the OIC has for some time paid considerable attention to combating religious intolerance.
Nee. Wel heeft de OIC al geruime tijd veel aandacht voor het tegengaan van religieuze intolerantie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlandse sponsoring van een Turks festival in Turkije

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands sponsored a Turkish festival in Bodrum with taxpayer money and whether it would be recovered. The minister confirmed a 5,000 euro contribution to the International Bodrum Carnival to showcase Dutch culture and two Dutch bands, and defended cultural promotion abroad as serving Netherlands' international image.
The Netherlands contributed 5,000 euros to the International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, with the aim of introducing a Turkish and international audience to Dutch culture.
Nederland heeft 5.000 euro bijgedragen aan het International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, met als doel een Turks en internationaal publiek te laten kennismaken met Nederlandse cultuur.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de gezochte Syrië-ronselaar die opduikt in Shariawijk

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether complaints had been filed three times against a jihad recruiter seen in a The Hague neighbourhood, why he and possibly others were not arrested, and whether he could be denaturalised. The minister declined to comment on individual criminal cases, confirmed complaints had been filed and an investigation is ongoing, but no arrests have been made.
I make no statements about individual criminal cases, partly to avoid harming possible investigative interests.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele strafzaken, mede om te voorkomen dat eventuele opsporingsbelangen zouden kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Wilders en De Roon over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Defence minister about a military exercise in Amsterdam neighbourhoods, questioning its purpose, whether soldiers should be taught about Islam, and whether mosque construction is facilitated abroad. The minister replied that contact with local populations is standard training, that cultural customs are respected where needed, and that soldiers do not interfere in local opinions, though infrastructure reconstruction may occur on missions.
Soldiers train daily for all possible deployments and missions of the armed forces within their legal tasks at home and abroad.
Militairen oefenen dagelijks voor alle mogelijke inzet en missies van de krijgsmacht in het kader van de wettelijke taken in binnen- en buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht: ‘Rutte: werkloze jongeren naar Nederland halen’ van de website van de Telegraaf

Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether he is aware of a news report that Rutte wants to bring unemployed youth to the Netherlands, and insulted him with a rhetorical question. The government replied that the report is known and that it will respond in answer to a separate request from the Social Affairs committee.
The cabinet will respond to this news report in reply to the request of the standing committee for Social Affairs and Employment of 9 July.
Het kabinet zal op deze berichtgeving reageren in antwoord op het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van 9 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over de wens van het Nederlandse volk de voortgaande islamisering te stoppen

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked the government whether it would stop mosque construction, introduce a constitutional ban on sharia, halt immigration from Islamic countries, and apologise for mass immigration and Islamisation. The minister answered that freedom of religion is a core democratic right, that municipalities decide on new mosques, that nationality is not relevant to residence permits, and that the government does not recognise mass immigration or Islamisation.
People are free to adhere to and profess any religion they choose.
Het staat mensen vrij welk geloof dan ook aan te hangen en te belijden.
Antwoord vragen Helder, Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht: ‘Discriminatie in cellen’

Three PVV MPs asked whether non-Muslim prisoners are being discriminated against by Muslim prisoners, whether Muslim prisoners gain undue influence, what measures will be taken, and how many prisoners hold dual nationality. The state secretary answered that no cases of structural discrimination or complaints to supervisory committees are known, that directors can sanction such conduct and file complaints, and that no further measures are needed.
I am not aware of any cases of (structural) discrimination of non-Islamic detainees by detainees with an Islamic background.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend van (structurele) discriminatie van niet-islamitische gedetineerden door gedetineerden met een islamitische achtergrond.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Madlener over het bericht 'Poll:39% Nederlanders wil uit de EU'

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the government will prepare for Dutch withdrawal from the EU after a poll showing 39% support for leaving, and whether a referendum will be held. The minister replied that the government takes citizens' concerns seriously and will pursue EU reform, that withdrawal is not on the table, and that no referendum is needed.
A departure of the Netherlands from the EU is not on the table as far as the cabinet is concerned.
Een vertrek van Nederland uit de EU is wat het kabinet betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de steun van Nederlandse moslims voor jihadgangers naar Syrië

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a survey showing that nearly three-quarters of Muslims view jihadist travellers to Syria as heroes reflects Islamic approval of violence, and what the government will do about the supposed large-scale support among Muslims for jihadists. Minister Asscher answered that the research confirmed emotional engagement and broad support for fighters against the Syrian regime, but did not examine support for jihadist motives, so the conclusion of majority support for jihadist travellers cannot be drawn.
Support for jihadist motives and jihadist factions in the Syrian conflict was not examined in this research.
De steun voor jihadistische motieven en jihadistische facties in het Syrische conflict is in dit onderzoek niet onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van  de imam al Mutawa

Two PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a cleric they described as a hate preacher who called for stoning women, including by denying him entry and questioning the Islamic University Rotterdam that invited him. The minister condemned calls to violence but said there were no indications the cleric incites violence, that visa applications are assessed under the Visa Code, and that the inviting institution has not shown itself harmful to integration.
However, I have no indications that the person in question calls for violence.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat genoemde persoon oproept tot geweld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Wilders en Madlener over het bericht “Eurozone scheldt mogelijk Griekse schuld kwijt”

MPs Van Dijck, Wilders and Madlener asked the Finance Minister why he suggested in a Greek newspaper that eurozone countries might forgive Greek debt and demanded a public retraction. The minister answered that the Eurogroup will only revisit possible further debt-sustainability measures for Greece at a later date, and that the Netherlands opposes debt forgiveness.
The Netherlands is not in favour of debt forgiveness.
Nederland is geen voorstander van schuldkwijtschelding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wilders over zijn deelname aan de Bilderberg-bijeenkomst

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he attends the Bilderberg meeting, why he is skipping a cabinet meeting, whether the agenda covers nationalism and populism with a report to the Chamber promised, and who pays his costs. The Prime Minister confirmed attendance, said the Vice Prime Minister chairs cabinet abroad, invoked the Chatham House Rule for the meeting, and stated the state paid EUR 1,223 in travel and stay costs.
The Chatham House Rule applies to the meeting, which ensures a meaningful exchange of views.
Voor de bijeenkomst geldt de Chatham House Rule, die een zinvolle gedachtewisseling verzekert.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de anti-Westerse opvattingen binnen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether the Islamic University of Rotterdam receives state subsidies and whether its rector's and teachers' views, which they called incompatible with Western norms on gender, sexual orientation and apostasy, justify withdrawing accreditation and barring its graduates from government chaplaincy work. The minister answered that the university receives no state funding, that the cited statements date from over ten years ago and were personal, that the programmes are accredited with no reason to withdraw accreditation, and that she does not share the view that Islamic chaplains trained there should be barred from government service.
The relevant programmes at the IUR are accredited and I see no need to withdraw these accreditations.
De betreffende opleidingen aan de IUR zijn geaccrediteerd en ik zie geen noodzaak om deze accreditaties in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over tot geweld bereide moslima’s

PVV MPs asked whether Islam calls on Muslims to use violence, how large the group of Muslim women willing to commit violence is, and what measures will counter the long-term risk. The minister says the research sample is not representative so no extrapolation is possible, and refers to the terrorism threat assessment and existing counter-radicalisation measures.
Based on the study 'Radicaal (On)zichtbaar' referred to in the cited newspaper article, no estimate can be made here.
Op basis van het onderzoek «Radicaal (On)zichtbaar» waar het geciteerde krantenartikel naar verwijst kan hier geen schatting van gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders over 100 Nederlandse Jihadisten die vechten in het buitenland

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked whether Dutch jihadists fighting abroad should be detained on return in a special terrorist wing, how many hold dual nationality or residence permits, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister answered that suspects would be placed in the existing Terrorist Wing, declined to give numbers or individual cases, said most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and described immigration measures and the possibility of revoking Dutch nationality after a terrorism conviction where statelessness does not result.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders over de enorme toename van het aantal «Nederlandse» jihadisten

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in Dutch jihadists, whether the government has oversight of them, their dual nationality, Islam's teaching on jihad, and deportation or denaturalisation of jihadists with dual nationality. The minister said the AIVD keeps as much oversight as possible, declined to give numbers or individual cases, noted most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and explained that citizenship can be revoked only for those with another nationality who are finally convicted of terrorism.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de helft van de Nederlanders zijn eigen pensioen met zorgen tegemoet ziet

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked why the government spends billions on eurozone rescue funds while Dutch pension entitlements are cut, and whether pension funds should be allowed a fixed 4% discount rate. The State Secretary replied that euro-fund loans are conditional, that pension cuts are needed because funds fall short of legal funding requirements, and that a risk-free rate is required, so 4% is not acceptable.
In my letter of 1 March to your House I explained why pension funds must calculate their obligations using a risk-free interest rate.
In mijn brief van 1 maart jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik toegelicht waarom pensioenfondsen hun verplichtingen met een risicovrije rente moeten berekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een huishouden in Cyprus gemiddeld vier keer meer vermogen heeft dan een Nederlands huishouden

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked why Cypriot households hold about four times the average wealth of Dutch households and why the Netherlands should contribute to Cypriot bailout aid, asking whether this aid should be reversed. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the ECB itself notes Cyprus data are not comparable across the eurozone, pointed to earlier letters on the bailout, and did not reverse or commit to changing the aid.
The ECB states in its study that the figures for Cyprus are not well comparable with the rest of the eurozone for several reasons.
De ECB stelt in haar studie dat de cijfers voor Cyprus niet goed vergelijkbaar zijn met de rest van de eurozone om meerdere redenen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over "de dagelijkse imperialistische moskeeoproep"

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether daily mosque calls to prayer are harmful to integration and whether mosques should be prevented from broadcasting them. Minister Asscher answered that religious freedom and church-state neutrality protect such calls, that municipalities may set rules on duration and volume under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that no ground exists for banning them.
There is no ground for that.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het propageren van mensenoffers en kannibalisme in Egypte

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Egypt's Al-Azhar university promotes human sacrifice and cannibalism against apostates, and whether the Netherlands funds or cooperates with it. The minister said the material reflects historical theoretical views, that Al-Azhar receives no direct or indirect Dutch or EU funding but takes part in a Dutch-financed interfaith dialogue, and that the government sees no consequences for its policy toward Islamic states.
There is no direct or indirect subsidy of this university by the Netherlands or the European Union.
Er is geen directe of indirecte subsidiëring van deze universiteit door Nederland of de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU 11,2 miljard euro wil om Brusselse gaten te dichten

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would refuse to pay a proposed 11.2 billion euro EU budget increase and demand the money back. The minister answered only that Question 1 was yes and that Questions 2 to 4 were covered in a separate letter to the House.
For an answer to questions 2 to 4, I refer you to the letter I sent to the House of Representatives simultaneously with the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Voor een antwoord op de vragen 2 t/m 4 verwijs ik u naar de brief die ik hierover gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen naar de Tweede Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de sombere CBS-cijfers over de werkloosheid, de huizenprijzen en het consumentenvertrouwen

Opposition PVV MPs asked whether the minister would relax the 3% deficit ceiling and reconsider labour, housing and pension reforms in light of gloomy CBS figures on unemployment, house prices and consumer confidence. The minister replied that the 2013 deficit will exceed 3%, citing a housing package and business stimulus, that the government keeps its spending rules and will not add cuts in 2013, and that it will push ahead with reforms and targeted support for unemployed workers and youth.
The cabinet will further maintain the budget rules for 2013; any overruns will be resolved within the budget, and the spending ceiling will be respected.
Het kabinet zal verder voor 2013 de begrotingsregels handhaven; eventuele overschrijdingen zullen binnen de begroting worden opgelost, het uitgavenplafond wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de nieuwe salafistische moskee van imam Fawaz

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked how the AIVD monitors imam Fawaz after his departure from the As Soenna mosque, whether they agree that a new salafist mosque is unwelcome, whether he should be denaturalised and expelled for calls to violence, and what measures will prevent the mosque opening. The minister declined to comment on individual AIVD investigations, defended religious freedom, explained that calls to violence alone are not grounds for losing Dutch nationality, and said the opening of a prayer house is a municipal zoning matter for The Hague.
No public statements are made about AIVD investigations in individual cases.
Over onderzoek van de AIVD in individuele zaken worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over de berichten Werkstraf in plaats van tien weken cel, Oudjaarstuig lacht om straf en Hufters overal buitensluiten

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice why judges imposed lighter sentences than the prosecution demanded in New Year's Eve 'super-fast court' cases and whether harsher punishments and pink-overall community service should be used. The minister answered that most convictions matched or were close to prosecution demands, that the prosecution appealed some cases, that it raises demands by 75% (200% for assaults on public servants) for event-related crimes, and that the court decides the appropriate sentence.
It is for the judge, taking into account the concrete circumstances of the case, to impose an appropriate sentence.
Het is aan de rechter om, rekening houdend met de concrete omstandigheden van het geval, een passende straf op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klever, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de poging van de KNVB om de mening van een scheidsrechter te verbieden

MPs from the PVV asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the KNVB's attempt to silence a referee who had made comments on social media about Moroccan youth problems. The minister said the KNVB respects free speech but was concerned about offensive posts, that it is for the KNVB to set its own rules, and declined to summon the KNVB board or demand an apology.
I leave it to the KNVB to choose its own course within the federation.
Ik laat het aan de KNVB om binnen de bond daarin een eigen weg te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een petitie tegen de mogelijke bouw van een moskee in Enschede

PVV MPs asked whether the government received a petition against a mosque in Enschede, whether growing opposition should halt construction, and whether the Turkish state controls the Islamic Stichting Nederland. The minister acknowledged the petition, said citizens' wishes matter but that the municipality must judge them, and explained that the mosque will join the ISN network founded under Turkish religious authority, which is permitted within Dutch law.
Everyone in the Netherlands has the right to freedom of religion.
Iedereen in Nederland heeft het recht op vrijheid van godsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the foreign minister to respond to UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk's comparison of Hamas actions with Dutch WWII resistance, and whether he should be dismissed. The minister called the comparisons inappropriate and unacceptable, said Falk's statements are his own responsibility, and stated Nederland will raise the matter in EU context but will keep contact with special rapporteurs.
A Special Rapporteur is appointed by the Human Rights Council.
Een Speciaal Rapporteur wordt aangesteld door de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Madlener over het bericht: ‘EU-controleur in Den Haag’

MPs Wilders, Tony van Dijck and Madlener asked whether the government would send back an EU 'European Semester Officer' stationed in The Hague, object to growing Brussels interference, and station a Dutch controller in Brussels to oversee EU spending. The minister replied that the Commission's Semester role is important for budget oversight, that the officers only facilitate information exchange without changing Commission powers, and that the European Court of Auditors handles EU spending control while Netherlands pushes member-state accountability.
Appointing this officer changes nothing about the powers the Commission has under existing EU regulations.
Het aanstellen van deze functionaris verandert niets aan de bevoegdheden die de Commissie heeft op basis van de bestaande EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op een aanvullende vraag van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he shared criticism of UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk over alleged antisemitic remarks and whether this strengthened the case for removing him and avoiding contact. The minister answered that he was aware of these reactions and referred to his earlier answers on the same matter.
Yes, I have taken note of these reactions.
Ja, ik heb kennis genomen van deze reacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Bosma en Wilders over het bericht “Graaiers moeten inleveren”

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health why top salaries in the public and semi-public sector keep rising, whether pay rises before the WNT pay-cap took effect were improper, and whether executives who sued to escape the cap should be pursued. The minister defended the WNT and its transitional rules, said there is no evidence of pre-emptive pay rises, and stated that challenging government decisions in court is a right.
Anyone is free to have government decisions reviewed by the court.
Het staat een ieder vrij om beslissingen van de overheid door de rechter te laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de vermoedelijke eerwraak op een 16-jarig meisje

PVV MPs asked whether an apparent honour killing of a 16-year-old in IJsselstein was honour-motivated, how many honour killings occurred in ten years, whether immigration from Islamic countries is linked to them, and whether perpetrators with dual nationality should be deported. The state secretary declined to comment on the motive during the ongoing investigation, provided registration figures, rejected the links to religion and immigration, and explained the sliding-scale deportation rules without addressing individual cases.
The investigation into the death of the 16-year-old schoolgirl from IJsselstein is still in full swing.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de 16-jarige scholiere uit IJsselstein is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de onstuitbare opmars van de Marokkaanse crimineel

PVV MPs asked whether Moroccan youth are an unstoppable rise in crime and whether the government will confront a 'Moroccan problem' head-on. The minister rejects the claim in general terms, notes overrepresentation in specific crimes, says policy applies no ethnic distinction and points to existing prevention and enforcement measures.
The cabinet acknowledges that certain groups cause more nuisance and crime than others.
Het kabinet onderkent dat bepaalde groepen meer overlast en criminaliteit veroorzaken dan andere.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, de Roon en Wilders over Malinese jihadisten die profiteren van Nederlands belastinggeld

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid to Mali, including via subsidised NGOs, benefits jihadists and should be stopped or recovered. The minister confirmed aid to the Malian government was suspended after the 2012 coup, said stopping other aid is not at issue and no grounds exist to reclaim funds, and rejected the personal accusation in question 4.
Following the coup in Mali of 22 March 2012, the Netherlands decided in April 2012 to stop aid to the Malian government.
Naar aanleiding van de staatsgreep in Mali van 22 maart 2012 besloot Nederland in april 2012 tot stopzetten van de hulp aan de Malinese overheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over het openen van een Islamitische gebedsruimte in pretpark Walibi.

Two PVV MPs asked whether Walibi amusement park would open an Islamic prayer room and whether the government would act against Islamisation. The minister replied that it is a quiet room open to all faiths, that the government does not oppose it, and that the park is a private company whose activities are not for the cabinet to comment on.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on activities that take place there, as long as they stay within the bounds of the law.
Het is niet aan het kabinet zich uit te laten over activiteiten die zich daar voltrekken, zolang deze binnen de grenzen van de wet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over sharia-patrouilles in Londen

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Muslim patrols in a London suburb, including their remarks about white women, whether such patrols show Islam's nature, the existence of 'Muslim areas' in a major European city, and whether shariah-promoting movements should be banned. Minister Opstelten rejected the remarks and intimidation, said Islam's nature is not shown by the conduct of a few, and that courts would assess any dissolution request case by case under article 20 of the Civil Code.
If the public prosecution service so requests, the judge will have to assess each individual case on the basis of article 20 of the Civil Code.
In het geval dat het openbaar ministerie daartoe verzoekt, zal de rechter elke afzonderlijke zaak moeten beoordelen aan de hand van artikel 20 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de islamitische opvoeding als vrijbrief voor verkrachting

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether a UK court's decision not to jail a rapist because of his Islamic upbringing shows the misogynistic nature of Islam, and whether the government would condemn it and ensure Dutch judges never act similarly. The minister answered that one individual's statements say nothing about a religion and that it is not for the Dutch government to judge a British judge's application of British law in an individual criminal case.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements about the correct application of British law by a British judge in an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om uitspraken te doen over de juiste toepassing van het Britse recht door een Britse rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over multinationals halen miljoenen uit EU-fonds

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that multinationals received millions from the European Social Fund, and whether EU subsidies are being wasted and how fraud will be prevented. The minister answered that the Commission is investigating the Polish case, that the Court of Auditors' error rates are unacceptably high and the Netherlands will push for better accountability and transparency, and that subsidies are open to all firms so no distortion arises, while refusing to halt EU payments.
The results of the European Commission's investigation must be awaited before the cabinet can make detailed statements about this situation.
De resultaten van het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie moeten worden afgewacht alvorens het kabinet gedetailleerde uitspraken kan doen over deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht «Bejaarde is leven niet meer zeker na massale afranseling»

PVV MPs asked the government whether criminal Moroccan youths terrorising neighbourhoods and committing racist violence should be harshly punished, sent to re-education camps, and deprived of Dutch nationality with family deportation. The minister answered that policy does not distinguish by ethnicity, outlined prevention and tough enforcement, rejected re-education camps as unproven, and said revoking nationality for common crimes is not possible.
In this approach no distinction is made by ethnicity.
In deze aanpak wordt geen onderscheid naar etniciteit gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over het racistische Marokkaanse geweld

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a claim that Moroccan-origin youths cause a structural problem of violence, asked for the causes of police contact among young Moroccan men, and asked whether dual-nationality offenders could be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that socio-economic and demographic factors explain over-representation in crime, that enforcement applies no ethnic distinction, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common offences is not possible.
Of course, it is the case that the groups that more often cause problems will accordingly come into contact with this approach more often.
Wel is het uiteraard zo dat de groepen die vaker problemen veroorzaken navenant meer met deze aanpak in aanraking zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over “Brussel straft Tsjechische corruptie met EU-subsidies mild”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the EU's light correction of about 450 million euros for irregularities in Czech use of EU funds is a token penalty, and whether the government will stop Czech EU subsidies. The minister answered that no fraud in the criminal sense is involved, that the Commission applies the rules in EU law, and that he will not halt subsidies or reclaim the Dutch share.
The cabinet cannot confirm the error rates of up to 100% cited in the media unless it obtains disclosure of the sources cited in the newspaper article in question.
Het kabinet kan de in de media genoemde foutpercentages tot 100% niet bevestigen dan nadat openbaarheid is verkregen over de geciteerde bronnen in het desbetreffende krantenartikel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Van Vliet en Wilders over het protest van Marokko tegen het korten van Nederlandse uitkeringen voor Marokkanen

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch ambassador was summoned by Morocco over cuts to Dutch benefits paid to Moroccans, whether the ambassador was told to stay out of Dutch legislation, and whether new benefits to return migrants could be frozen. The minister replied that the ambassador met the Moroccan minister at Dutch request on a previously scheduled matter, that no summoning took place, and that freezing new benefits requires a treaty amendment, pointing to the residence-country principle and planned ending of child benefit export.
No. The Dutch ambassador met with the Moroccan Minister of Employment and Vocational Training on 9 January.
Nee. De Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft op 9 januari jl. gesproken met de Marokkaanse minister van Werkgelegenheid en Beroepsopleidingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Saudische journalist

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he judges the arrest of a Saudi journalist for criticizing Islam, whether he agrees the journalist should be free to say Muhammad's faith must be corrected, and whether he will press for the journalist's immediate release. The minister answered that the grounds for detention are unknown, that EU partners are investigating in Riyadh, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands raises freedom of expression with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten daarvan zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de moskee als toevluchtsoord voor schietende criminelen

PVV MPs asked whether a group of men fleeing a shooting incident in Rotterdam hid in a mosque, whether police entered promptly, and whether the minister would close the mosque. The minister answered that the building was an annex (library, barber) rather than a prayer space, that police entered and found no one, and that closing a mosque is a municipal competence.
The possible closure of a mosque is a municipal competence.
Eventuele sluiting van een moskee is een gemeentelijke bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over dreigende deportatie van een islam-kritische filmmaker

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Spain is deporting Pakistani-born anti-Islam filmmaker Imran Firasat on national security grounds, whether the Netherlands will protest given possible blasphemy prosecution at home, and whether his film can be published in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Spain must assess the security threat, that Dutch intervention is not warranted, that free expression carries responsibilities for courts to judge, and that the film is already online.
It is for the Spanish authorities to assess whether this person residing in Spain poses a threat to national security.
Het is aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om te beoordelen of deze in Spanje verblijvende persoon wel of niet een bedreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het schandaal rondom de Griekse ex-minister van Financiën

MPs Tony van Dijck and Wilders asked the finance minister about the Greek tax-evasion list scandal, including whether it was cleaned of relatives of former PM Papandreou, why Dutch taxpayers should fund Greece, how Greek prosecution would be pursued, and whether an exit from the euro should be prepared. The minister answered that Greece itself is responsible for prosecution, that a new list was sent to the Greek prosecutor, that loan-programme reforms target tax evasion, and that a Greek exit is not on the agenda.
In principle, Greece itself is responsible for criminal prosecution of possible tax evasion.
In beginsel is Griekenland zelf verantwoordelijk voor de strafrechtelijke vervolging van mogelijke belastingontduiking.
Antwoord vragen Wilders, Helder en Agema over het bericht Aanrander bejaarden vrij

PVV MPs Wilders, Helder and Agema asked the Justice minister about reports that a 15-year-old suspect of sexually assaulting elderly women was released, and how victims and nearby residents would be protected. The minister confirmed the reports, explained that the court lifted the pre-trial detention suspension, said further investigation and neighbourhood police contact are underway, and noted that vulnerability can be weighed in sentencing.
During this period neighbourhood police officers remain in contact with those involved.
Gedurende deze periode houden wijkagenten contact met de betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht “Grieken lopen fors achter op schema”

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about reports that Greece is well behind schedule on reforms, including 210 of 300 unimplemented measures, continued pension and disability benefit fraud, and whether the next loan tranche will be blocked. The answer was given in a letter of 28 November 2012, which the summary of the answer text provided here does not include.
Will you block the request for postponement of payment and the disbursement of the next tranche if Greece has not kept to the agreements?
Gaat u de aanvraag om uitstel van betaling en de uitbetaling van de volgende tranche blokkeren als Griekenland zich niet aan de afspraken heeft gehouden?
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Islamitische kersttraditie in Nigeria.

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christmas-night attacks on churches in northern Nigeria reflect Islamic intolerance, whether the OIC acted against them, and whether OIC states that signed the Cairo Declaration should be excluded from the UN. The minister answered that the violence has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions, that the OIC condemned the attacks, and that the Cairo Declaration is outdated and no reason for UN exclusion.
The violence in Nigeria has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions.
Het geweld in Nigeria heeft politieke, sociaaleconomische, etnische en religieuze dimensies.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de vele moskee-internaten in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister how many mosque boarding schools exist in the Netherlands, what legal steps will be taken against them over reported corporal punishment and illegal shops, and how they will be closed. The minister said no national overview is known, that local authorities are responsible, that he will consult affected municipalities on whether existing instruments suffice, and that no legal measures are currently warranted.
It is the responsibility of the local government to have insight into the presence of boarding schools within the municipal boundary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale overheid om inzicht te hebben in de aanwezigheid van internaten binnen de gemeentegrens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht «Griekenland kan niet aan eisen voldoen»

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Finance Minister whether Greece can meet the conditions for its bailout tranche and why Dutch money should go to a country that fails to reform. The minister replied that the Troika found Greece had met the conditions, so the tranche was released and the loan programme continues.
Following the latest Troika progress report, I judge that Greece has ultimately met the requirements to disburse the tranche from the loan programme.
Naar aanleiding van het laatste voortgangsrapport van de Trojka oordeel ik dat Griekenland uiteindelijk aan de eisen heeft voldaan om de tranche uit het leningenprogramma uit te keren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de Europese Unie miljarden verspilt volgens de Europese Rekenkamer

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a report that the EU wasted billions, with an error rate of about 5 billion euro in 2011 according to the European Court of Auditors. The government answered that it is disappointed, will take a critical stance on discharge in the Ecofin Council, and seeks a much leaner EU budget with cuts of at least 100 billion euro.
The cabinet will adopt a very critical attitude when this is dealt with.
Het kabinet zal bij de behandeling hiervan een zeer kritische houding aannemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over herziening van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Iran

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the Netherlands should follow Canada in suspending diplomatic relations with Iran over its nuclear programme, human rights record, support for Syria and Hezbollah. The minister replied that the Netherlands shares concern, keeps a communication channel open, and applies pressure via diplomacy and sanctions, declining to rule out other options.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Het kabinet acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over bericht 'Grieken krijgen circuit'

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked why Greece is funding a 30 million euro Formula 1 circuit amid its economic crisis and EU bailout, and whether the Netherlands should stop loans to Greece. The State Secretary answered that Greece sets its own investment priorities within the EFSF/IMF programme conditions, monitored by the Troika, and that the Dutch position on Greek loans is unchanged.
It is up to the Greek government to determine its investment priorities within the conditions set under the EFSF and IMF loan programme.

Het is aan de Griekse overheid om haar prioriteiten op het gebied van investeringen vast te stellen binnen de randvoorwaarden die zijn opgesteld in het kader van het leningenprogramma van EFSF en IMF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar, Van Klaveren en Wilders over "het ‘ramadan-proof’ maken van cao’s"

PVV MPs asked whether collective labour agreements should accommodate Ramadan, asked about economic costs of Ramadan fasting, and whether Muslims should work in Islamic countries. The minister answered that employers and employees may agree facilitation of religious activities, that direct discrimination on religion is prohibited under equal treatment law, that costs are unknown, and that such arrangements are the employee's own responsibility.
It is the employee's own responsibility to make good arrangements with the employer when he or she wishes to take time off work to take part in such activities in private life.

Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de werknemer om goede afspraken met zijn werkgever te maken wanneer hij of zij vrij wil nemen van het werk voor deelname aan dergelijke activiteiten in de privésfeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat twee meisjes in Hilversum zwaar zijn mishandeld door Marokkaans tuig

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked minister Opstelten about two severe assaults on girls in Hilversum, the second this year, and about the police response, the ethnic share of youth suspects, and whether dual-national perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that suspects were arrested, extra measures were taken with partners, the wider approach does not single out ethnicity, and denaturalisation for common offences is not possible.
The police and municipality, with the other safety partners, have taken additional measures.
Politie en gemeente hebben met de overige veiligheidspartners extra maatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders met betrekking tot het advies van de politie om rustig toe te kijken bij een woningoverval

PVV MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether police advice to watch calmly during a home robbery encourages criminals, and whether burglary victims may defend themselves and police should arrive quickly and robbers should face high minimum sentences. The minister answered that victims must prioritise their own safety and may defend themselves proportionately, that police aim to catch robbers in the act, and that prosecutors seek a three-year starting sentence raised for aggravating circumstances.
Victims of a home robbery or burglary must always put their own safety first.
Slachtoffers van een woningoverval of woninginbraak moeten altijd hun eigen veiligheid vooropstellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht "overheidsmaffiapraktijken op Sicilië"

Two PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of excessive public spending and clientelism in Sicily, and whether the Netherlands would refuse financial aid to Italy. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, said Italy has made no aid request, and that Italy must address its own problems.
Italy has not submitted a request for support.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitspraken van de Finse minister van Financiën dat het uiteenvallen van de eurozone slechts een kwestie van tijd is

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government to react to Finnish minister Tuomioja's remarks that eurozone breakup is a matter of time, and what the Netherlands is doing to prepare, and whether it will stop signing blank cheques for Brussels. Minister De Jager replied that Tuomioja is foreign minister, not finance minister, that the Finnish government did not endorse his view, that the Dutch government considers various scenarios and aims to strengthen the euro, and that existing measures (SGP automaticity, twopack, conditionality on EFSF aid) already reflect its position.
The government's aim is a strengthened euro.
De inzet van het kabinet is een versterkte euro.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Jong en Wilders over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren dramatische vormen aanneemt

PVV MPs asked the ministers why unemployment among non-Western immigrant youth is so much higher than among Chinese youth, and whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants and work refusal in Rotterdam's port explain it. The minister attributed the gap to cyclical sensitivity, lower education levels and flexible contracts, rejected the claim of mass unskilled immigration and of mass work refusal, gave a welfare figure, and declined to revoke residence permits, saying non-Western migrants are treated like Western ones.
The cabinet does not treat non-Western allochtones differently from Western allochtones
Het kabinet behandelt niet- westerse allochtonen niet anders dan westerse allochtonen
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de weigering van de EU om Hezbollah als terroristische organisatie aan te merken

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the EU refuses to list Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, whether EU representatives should negotiate with it, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that EU member states lack consensus, that the Netherlands already treats Hezbollah as terrorist and has no contacts with it, that Dutch policy has not changed, and that the Netherlands will keep raising its position in EU fora.
I cannot make any further concrete public statements about this cooperation.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen verdere, concrete mededelingen doen over deze samenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland relatief veel asielaanvragen inwilligt

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands grants asylum at a relatively high rate compared with other European countries, and whether a cap of 1000 admissions or changes to the Refugee Convention should follow. The minister answered that the data needed for a comparison are not available, pointed to the Dutch fast-track procedure and the EU harmonisation agenda, and rejected a quota or withdrawal from the Convention.
The underlying data behind the admission rates are not available for the Netherlands, and for that reason alone it is not possible to carry out this analysis.
Deze onderliggende gegevens bij de inwillingingspercentages zijn voor Nederland niet beschikbaar en reeds daarom is het niet mogelijk deze analyse te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar en Wilders over de tweede kwartaalcijfers van de vier grootste pensioenfondsen

PVV MPs asked the minister why pension fund coverage ratios fell after record-low interest rates, whether the valuation method is to blame, and what concrete short-term measures will be taken, including returning to a fixed 4% discount rate and spreading recovery deadlines. The minister attributed the decline mainly to market and life-expectancy developments, rejected returning to the fixed rate, and only promised a package of measures in September.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over zakkenvullende eurocraten

Two PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister, Foreign Affairs and the Foreign Affairs state secretary whether they agree that EU officials' salaries, pensions and allowances (commissioners, MEPs, junior staff) are excessive, whether the Dutch EU contribution should be suspended until they are cut, and what the government will do. The government answered that it wants EU staff conditions modernised and reduced, that it pressed for more ambitious Commission proposals and voted against the 2011 indexation, and that it is pursuing lower Dutch contributions in the MFF negotiations, but did not commit to suspending payments.
The cabinet is of the view that in the upcoming revision of the EU staff regulations, the working conditions of EU staff should be modernised and reduced.
Het kabinet is van mening dat bij de komende herziening van het EU-ambtenarenstatuut de arbeidsvoorwaarden van EU-personeel gemoderniseerd en versoberd dienen te worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van een moskee na administratief geblunder van de gemeente

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether a mosque replacing a church after a municipal administrative error should be opposed and how the municipality of Utrecht could be made to reverse the decision. The minister answered that religious freedom applies to all faiths, that the municipality corrected its error by excluding the church plan, and that the minister would not comment on local matters.
It does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to comment on local matters.
Het past mij als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om mij uit te laten over lokale aangelegenheden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Gerbrands over het bericht dat het College voor Zorgverzekeringen wil stoppen met het vergoeden van dure medicijnen voor enkele zeldzame ziekten

PVV MPs Wilders and Gerbrands asked the health minister whether the CVZ's draft advice to stop reimbursing expensive drugs for rare diseases was ethical, what limits on patient numbers and drug costs should apply, and whether she would follow the advice. The minister replied that no final advice exists yet, that the decision rests with her as the political primacy, that rare-disease drugs have a legal prevalence ceiling and no fixed cost limit, and that the CVZ backlog has been resolved.
The final decision rests with me and is therefore the primacy of politics.
De uiteindelijke beslissing ligt bij mij en is daarmee het primaat van de politiek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders met betrekking tot de inzet van politie tijdens de Ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked whether extra police deployment against Ramadan-related crime existed, its cost, whether police see a link between Ramadan and crime, and whether the costs could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary answered that no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan, only capacity management of existing rosters, that no data exist on the suggested link, and that cost recovery is not warranted.
In both The Hague and Utrecht no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan.
In zowel Den Haag als Utrecht wordt geen extra politiecapaciteit ingezet gedurende de Ramadan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Bontes over het bericht "Brussel wil meer geld van EU-lidstaten"

PVV MPs asked the government, after a press report that Brussels wants more money from member states, whether it finds this absurd during the economic crisis and whether it will act like Thatcher to cut Dutch EU contributions. The state secretary replied that the Netherlands voted against the Council position, that it favours a nominal freeze of the EU budget and a substantial reduction of Dutch contributions, and that it keeps its rebate and collection fee.
The Netherlands voted against the Council position mentioned in the report.
Nederland heeft tegen de in het bericht genoemde Raadspositie gestemd
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over het niet terug kunnen sturen van Somaliërs

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked why a Council of State ruling prevents deporting Somalis and how to avoid a pull effect on migration. The minister answers that the ruling concerns travel through Mogadishu, that the government will comply, expects few additional arrivals, and keeps voluntary return as the policy starting point while pursuing forced return options.
The government will of course comply with the Division's ruling.
De regering zal zich uiteraard conformeren aan de uitspraak van de Afdeling.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en Wilders over de zoveelste gekkigheden van Eurocommissaris Malmström inzake immigratie

Two PVV MPs asked the immigration minister whether he had noticed EU Commissioner Malmström's call for much more immigration to Europe, whether she should resign, and whether the Netherlands should leave the EU to regain control of its borders. The minister confirmed he had noticed the statement, noted that Commission members have independent responsibilities and the right to voice their views, and said the government considers continued engagement in the EU in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
The cabinet considers continued involvement in the European process to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Het kabinet acht blijvende betrokkenheid bij het Europese proces in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verknipte en gevaarlijke advies extremistische islamitische organisaties invloed te geven op beleid

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they agree that an advisory report by Forum recommending engagement with extremist Islamic organisations is dangerous, whether the Forum subsidy will be stopped, and whether all Islamic organisations will be monitored and sanctioned. The government disagrees with the advice's clarity but will not adopt it, keeps the Forum subsidy, and rejects blanket monitoring of all Islamic organisations, while pointing to targeted AIVD investigation and existing legal tools.
Should the researchers' advice be to let extremist organisations exert influence on policy, I assure you I will not adopt that advice.
Mocht het advies van de onderzoekers zijn om extremistische organisaties invloed te laten uitoefenen op beleid, verzeker ik u dat ik dat advies niet overneem.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over invallen bij Duitse salafisten

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether Dutch police should raid mosques and homes of salafist groups as Germany did, whether such groups should be banned, and what measures the government will take. Minister Opstelten answered that the German group term covers a narrower spectrum than the Dutch use of salafism, that AIVD has observed no threatening activities by Dutch salafists so far, and that measures will be taken if the security services find cause.
The AIVD has so far not observed any activities by Dutch salafists that pose a threat to national security or that justify the measures you propose.
De AIVD heeft bij Nederlandse salafisten vooralsnog geen activiteiten waargenomen die een bedreiging vormen voor de nationale veiligheid of die de door u voorgestelde maatregelen rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma, Bontes en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU de deur open zet voor vele vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands joins EU mobility partnerships that ease visa access for Moroccans, Egyptians and Cape Verdeans, whether visa-free travel should be used as leverage, and whether the Netherlands should leave the EU. The government answered that mobility partnerships are tailored, conditional agreements covering irregular migration, legal migration, asylum and return, that visa facilitation is not visa liberalisation, and that it will not seek EU withdrawal.
Visa facilitation is not the same as visa-free travel. The Netherlands is very reluctant when it comes to visa liberalisation.
Visumfacilitatie is niet hetzelfde als visumvrij reizen. Nederland is zeer terughoudend als het gaat om visumliberalisatie.
Antwoord vragen Wilders over het hijsen van de Europese vlag door de gemeente Amsterdam

Wilders (PVV) asked the Prime Minister whether he agrees it is absurd that Amsterdam flies the European flag, whether VVD members of the city council show they are pro-EU, whether he will address his Amsterdam party colleagues, and whether he will remove the EU flag from all public buildings. Rutte answered briefly that the national flag instructions only cover central government buildings, not the municipality's flag practice.
The general flag instruction and incidental flag instructions of the Prime Minister relate exclusively to the Dutch flag at buildings of central government.
De algemene vlaginstructie en incidentele vlaginstructies van de minister-president hebben uitsluitend betrekking op de Nederlandse vlag bij gebouwen van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het ontslag van docent maatschappijleer/Leids raadslid naar aanleiding van tweets

PVV MPs Wilders and Beertema asked the education minister whether a Leiden teacher and councillor dismissed over anti-Islam tweets was rightly suspended, why a VU employee's tweet about shooting PVV members had no employment consequences, and whether the minister would press the school to reverse the contract termination. The minister answered that the ministry is not a party, that the school's competent authority and ultimately the cantonal judge decide such matters, and that she cannot intervene in an individual employment relationship.
The ministry of OCW is not a party in this matter.
Het ministerie van OCW is in deze geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over nieuwe anti-christelijke maatregelen in Indonesië

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses news reports of church closures and attacks on Christians in Indonesia, including Aceh's sharia, and what concrete steps the government has taken to protect them. The minister expressed concern, denied that a jihad targets Christians, said Aceh remains subject to national law, and listed diplomatic raising of the issue, the human rights ambassador's visit and support for interfaith programmes.
The Netherlands regularly raises attention to the position of religious minorities in Indonesia.
Nederland vraagt regelmatig aandacht voor de positie van religieuze minderheden in Indonesië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en Gerbrands over het bericht dat verplicht thuis wonen in plaats van in een verzorgingshuis slecht uitpakt bij een proef in Neede

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a Neede pilot in which very old people required to live at home instead of in a care home reportedly became lonely and needed more care, and whether the Kunduz accord plan to close care homes should be reversed. The state secretary acknowledged loneliness as a concern, argued that hybrid home-and-institution arrangements already exist, said the trend toward care at home predates the plan, and promised to elaborate the measure and its property effects.

I indicated in my second progress report on the Long-Term Care Reform of 25 June that I will further elaborate the measure from the budget agreement and also take the effects on property into account.

Ik heb in mijn tweede voortgangsrapportage Hervorming Langdurige Zorg van 25 juni jl. aangegeven de maatregel uit het begrotingsakkoord verder uit te werken en daarbij ook de effecten op het vastgoed te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de door het Koeweits parlement aangenomen doodstraf voor blasfemie

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he views Kuwait's parliament adopting a death penalty for blasphemy and whether the Netherlands will protest, press for release of those detained, coordinate sanctions, and cut ties with OIC states. The minister answered that the Emir had sent the bill back to parliament, that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and is raising the matter with the EU, and that it opposes stripping UN membership or minimising relations with those states.
The embassy is following this issue closely and it is being discussed at EU level at the Dutch request.
De ambassade volgt deze kwestie op de voet en deze wordt op Nederlands verzoek in EU-verband besproken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over het strafproces tegen de Turkse musicus Fazil Say

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Turkish musician Fazil Say for allegedly insulting Islam on Twitter, and whether this signals an attack on free expression in Turkey, including whether the ambassador should be summoned and whether an observer should attend the trial. The minister answered that Say is charged under Article 216.3 of the Turkish penal code, that Dutch concerns about free expression and press freedom in Turkey are raised with the Turkish government, and that the Netherlands is following the case and will consider observer attendance in consultation with EU partners.
Dutch concerns about this are discussed in contacts with the Turkish government.
Nederlandse zorgen hierover worden in contacten met de Turkse regering besproken.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck,  Bontes en Wilders over de berichten "De Jager moet miljard bijlenen voor steun aan Griekenland" en "Merkel pleit voor nieuwe politieke unie in Europa"

MPs Van Dijck, Bontes and Wilders asked whether the government would refuse further Greek support and reject Merkel's call for more EU powers. The government answered that the Greek loan programme is funded via the EFSF without Dutch market borrowing, and that it will respond to the Van Rompuy report on the economic pillar once published.
The cabinet will come with a response to this report as soon as it has been published.
zal het kabinet met een reactie op dit rapport komen zodra dit is verschenen.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitbetaling van 4,2 miljard euro aan Griekenland

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the finance minister whether it is absurd to pay 4.2 billion euro to unstable Greece and whether he will stop such payments.
