The minister replied that the Eurogroup had already approved the Greek loan programme and that the EFSF CEO decided on the timing and amount of tranche payments, with the sum earmarked for bond repayments held by the public sector.
After approval by the Eurogroup, the CEO of the EFSF has the authority to decide on the amount and timing of the various payments of a tranche within the set deadline.

Na goedkeuring door de Eurogroep heeft de CEO van EFSF de bevoegdheid om te besluiten over de hoogte en het moment van de verschillende uitbetalingen van een tranche binnen de termijn die hiervoor is vastgesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de verspreiding van korans in Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister about salafists distributing millions of Qurans in Germany and whether such activity poses a threat in the Netherlands. The minister replied that salafist activity currently poses no national security threat, no plans are known, and distributing the Quran as such is not a threat to public order, while measures would be taken if disturbance were indicated.
Distributing a widely circulated religious text as such does not constitute a danger to public order.
Het verspreiden van een wijdverspreid religieus geschrift als zodanig vormt geen gevaar voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over islamitische censuur

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister would act against billboard ads covered over by alleged Islamic censorship and whether he knew of similar cases. The minister answered that no state censorship occurred because private parties apparently covered the ads, saw no reason to intervene, and knew of no comparable cases.
Censorship in that sense does not arise in this concrete case, in which an advertising message was apparently covered by private individual(s).
Van censuur in die zin is in dit concrete geval, waarin een reclameboodschap schijnbaar door (een) particulier(en) is afgeplakt, geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven, Bosma en Wilders over de Turkse reactie op het in het Rijksmuseum exposeren van een ‘anti-Turkse spotprent’

PVV MPs asked the government about Turkish media criticism of a 1683 anti-Turkish caricature exhibited at the Rijksmuseum, whether Turkish authorities had contacted the Dutch government, and whether the museum's explanatory text was a form of capitulation. The minister answered that the Turkish embassy raised concern via the foreign ministry, that the museum is responsible for its own captions, and that the government does not share the characterization of the museum's conduct.
As for any Turkish contacts with the Rijksmuseum, I refer you to the director of the Rijksmuseum.
Voor wat betreft eventuele Turkse contacten met het Rijksmuseum, verwijs ik u naar de directeur van het Rijksmuseum.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het Frans-Duitse voornemen om een financiële transactiebelasting in te voeren in de eurozone

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government whether it shares business and pension-sector fears that a Franco-German financial transaction tax would cut pensions and shrink the economy, and whether it will oppose the tax. The minister acknowledged fears of higher pension costs and pointed to a cabinet reply to a CPB evaluation for the economic analysis, without committing to a position beyond that.

For a detailed analysis of the risks of structural economic contraction from a possible introduction of the financial transaction tax, and the government's view on the financial transaction tax, I would refer you to the cabinet's response to the CPB evaluation of the Financial Transaction Tax.

Voor een uitvoerige analyse van de risico's op een structurele krimp van de economie als gevolg van een eventuele invoering van de financiële transactiebelasting en de mening van de regering over de financiële transactiebelasting zou ik willen verwijzen naar de kabinetsreactie op de CPB evaluatie Financiële Transactiebelasting.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de voortdurende christenvervolging in het islamitische koninkrijk Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of 42 (government says 35) Ethiopian Christians in Saudi Arabia, prior commitments on raising religious freedom, whether the Saudi ambassador would be summoned, and the timing of the human rights ambassador's visit. The minister said the embassy is in contact with the Ethiopian embassy, that religious freedom is raised bilaterally, multilaterally and in the UPR, that summoning the ambassador is not currently effective, and that the visit took place in February 2012, though a full answer on the visit was deferred.
Summoning the Saudi ambassador is not considered effective at this moment.
Het ontbieden van de Saoedische ambassadeur acht ik op dit moment niet effectief.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel over de komst van wederom een pedofilie promotende imam (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the immigration minister whether a preacher accused of promoting paedophilia and inciting violence against women, Al Arifi, should be barred from the Netherlands and whether mosques preaching such views should be closed. The minister answered that entry decisions are assessed case by case, that the public prosecutor handles criminal incitement, and that closing a mosque is possible only in exceptional cases through a court under civil law.
Closing a mosque is possible only in exceptional cases.
Een moskee sluiten kan slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat salafisten worden ingezet als ordetroepen tijdens de jaarwi

Two PVV MPs asked whether the police in The Hague enlisted the As Soenna mosque, which the AIVD had monitored, to help secure New Year's Eve in the Schilderswijk, and whether this was acceptable given the mosque's views. Minister Opstelten replied that the project involves many community organisations under identical agreements, that policing responsibility stays with the police, and that cooperation with citizens and mosques within legal limits is standard practice.
Responsibility for maintaining public order also during New Year's Eve lies entirely with the police.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de ordehandhaving ligt ook tijdens de jaarwisseling geheel bij de politie.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mishandeling van een Marokkaanse vrouw door Marokkaanse straatterroristen (ingezond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked ministers whether they condemn the assault on a Moroccan woman by young men, whether such street nuisance is a structural problem, what measures will hold parents financially liable and cut benefits, and whether offenders should be denaturalised and deported. The government condemned the conduct, said youth nuisance is addressed through a non-ethnic approach and local measures, and announced a bill so that Dutch nationality lapses after a conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years' imprisonment.

The cabinet is preparing a bill providing that Dutch nationality lapses by operation of law if, within five years of acquisition, an irrevocable conviction is handed down for an offence carrying twelve or more years' imprisonment.

Het kabinet bereidt een wetsvoorstel voor dat regelt dat het Nederlanderschap van rechtswege vervalt indien binnen vijf jaar na verkrijging een onherroepelijke veroordeling plaatsvindt voor een misdrijf waar twaalf jaar of meer gevangenisstraf op staat.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over een brochure betaald door het Duitse ministerie van Justitie

PVV MPs Wilders and Bontes asked the foreign minister whether it is appropriate that a German justice ministry-funded brochure links Wilders' ideas to German neo-Nazi violence, and whether the government will distance itself and summon the German ambassador. The minister answered that the brochure does not make that claim, only factual references to Wilders' visit and a Facebook announcement, that the government distances itself from any reading implying he operates outside the rule of law, and that it will not summon the ambassador but has raised the matter directly with the German ministry.
No, there are direct contacts with the German Ministry of Justice on this subject in which the Dutch position described above has been stated.
Nee, er zijn directe contacten met het Duitse ministerie van Justitie over dit onderwerp waarin de boven beschreven Nederlandse positie is gemarkeerd.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het in Saoedi-Arabische schoolboeken zaaien van haat en aanzetten tot geweld tegen Joden, christenen, «ongelovigen» en g

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how the government views reports that Saudi textbooks incite hatred and violence against Jews, Christians, unbelievers and apostates, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in international bodies to press Saudi Arabia to change the curriculum. The minister answered that Saudi revision of textbooks is ongoing but unfinished, and that the Netherlands has raised freedom of religion and expression with Saudi Arabia through bilateral, EU and UN channels, with a human rights ambassador visit planned.
A visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Saudi Arabia is also planned for February 2012 with the aim of continuing the human rights dialogue.
Ook is een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Saoedi-Arabië gepland voor februari 2012 met als doel het voortzetten van de dialoog op het gebied van mensenrechten.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Kortenoeven en Hernandez (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het door Turkije opschorten van de militaire samenwerking met Frankrijk (ingezonden 23 decemb

PVV MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers whether Turkey's unilateral suspension of military cooperation with France over an 'honour dispute' shows Turkey is unreliable, warranting reconsideration of its NATO membership and missile shield role, and whether Turkey should be barred from EU accession. The ministers replied that Turkey remains an important NATO ally, that the Netherlands regrets the France-Turkey rift and hopes for repair, and that the government keeps its accession policy unchanged while rejecting the characterisations of Turkey and Erdogan.
Turkey is and remains an important NATO ally, including in the collective defence of NATO territory through the missile defence system.
Turkije is en blijft een belangrijke NAVO-bondgenoot, onder andere bij de gemeenschappelijke verdediging van het NAVO-grondgebied via het raketverdedigingssysteem.
Antwoord vragen Van den Besselaar en Wilders over het bericht van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) over mogelijke korting van pensioenen

PVV MPs Van den Besselaar and Wilders asked the minister whether DNB should limit its public communication about possible 2013 pension cuts to pension funds, and whether cuts should be suspended while the European crisis lasts. The minister replied that the cuts were foreseeable, that funds bear primary responsibility for informing members, and that he will not agree to a suspension of cuts.
This does not alter the fact that it is primarily the task of pension funds to inform their participants about fund-specific matters.
Dit laat onverlet dat het primair de taak van pensioenfondsen is om hun deelnemers over fondsspecifieke aangelegenheden te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over mogelijke militaire aankopen door Griekenland van miljarden euro’s

MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked whether Greece plans billions in arms purchases (fighters, frigates, submarines, patrol boats) while relying on EU bailout funds, and whether the Dutch government would confront Greece or cut its funding. Minister De Jager answered that Greece's 2012 budget sets aside only 1 billion euros for defence, that no plans of the claimed size are known to him, and that the Troika would likely not approve such spending.
I am not aware of any plans for military purchases of the above-mentioned magnitude.
Er is mij geen informatie bekend dat er plannen zijn voor militaire aankopen van bovengenoemde omvang.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over rabiate islamitische Jodenhaat op de staatstelevisie van het als «gematigd» bekend staande emiraat Koeweit (ingezonden 1

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about a Kuwaiti state TV preacher's antisemitic remarks, and whether the government would condemn them and inform parliament of Kuwait's response. The minister said the remarks are the preacher's own responsibility, that Kuwait's government had no link to them according to the embassy, and that no formal protest would be lodged.
It is not for the Dutch government to distance itself from the statements of a Kuwaiti sheikh.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om afstand te nemen van uitlatingen van een Koeweiti sheikh.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het systematisch muilkorven, oppakken en detineren van journalisten in herislamiserend Turkije (ingezonden 22 december 2

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the arrests and detention of journalists in Turkey, whether the government would condemn them, what it did for jailed journalist Nedim Sener, and the cost of celebrating 400 years of diplomatic relations. The minister answered that Turkey falls short on press freedom under the Copenhagen criteria, that the government raises it bilaterally and via the EU, that it does not comment on individual charges but monitors the case, and that 2.07 million euro is budgeted for the anniversary.
The cabinet does not go into individual charges.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele tenlasteleggingen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de houding van de Nederlandse regering ten tijde van de Holocaust

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether he would apologise, as Borst and Zalm had suggested, for the Dutch government's passive stance in London during the persecution of Jews in WWII. Rutte answered that the 2000 advisory reports contained nothing significant on that stance and that no broad-based advice or objective information warranted a new government position, so he would not apologise.
The cabinet does not have a broadly supported advice from those involved or objective information that warrants a cabinet position like that of 21 March 2000.
Het kabinet beschikt terzake niet over een breed gedragen advies uit de kring van betrokkenen of geobjectiveerde informatie die noopt tot een kabinetsstandpunt als dat van 21 maart 2000.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders over de islamitische hoofddoek van ons staatshoofd

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether the Queen's headscarf during a mosque visit in Abu Dhabi legitimises the oppression of women and whether this could have been prevented. The government answered that when the Queen visits a place of worship the dress rules of that building are respected, without addressing the substance of the criticism.
When Her Majesty the Queen visits a house of worship, the associated dress regulations are respected.
Bij een bezoek van H.M. de Koningin aan een godshuis worden de daarbij behorende kledingvoorschriften gerespecteerd.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven en Wilders over Nederlands-Iraanse relaties

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked why the Dutch ambassador to Iran was recalled and then sent back, and whether Iran's conduct justified a different stance. Minister Rosenthal answered that the recall was a joint protest against the storming of the British embassy, that dialogue requires a diplomatic presence, and that the government condemns Iran's threats and keeps tightening EU sanctions.
In the view of the countries involved, it is important to keep the channel of dialogue with the Iranian authorities open.
Het is naar het oordeel van de betrokken landen van belang om het gesprekskanaal met de Iraanse autoriteiten open te houden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de schaalvergroting van een Ottomaanse moskee in Limburg (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior about enlarging an Ottoman-style mosque in Limburg, arguing its growth increases Islam's harmful influence and that funding from the Turkish-linked Islamitische Stichting Nederland should be barred. The minister rejected the premise, citing constitutional religious freedom and state non-involvement in religious building finance absent illegal activity, and committed to no new measures beyond existing oversight.
I do not share this view. Moreover, freedom of religion applies in the Netherlands.
Ik deel deze visie niet. Bovendien geldt in Nederland vrijheid van godsdienst.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de aanwezigheid van haatpredikers bij de opening van een Amsterdamse moskee (ingezonden 1 novemb

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether a Taliban-linked speaker and a radical imam who had reportedly called for violence in Germany, both present at the opening of an Amsterdam mosque, pose a public safety threat, whether such mosques should be closed, what the AIVD did with a German warning, and how entry of such preachers is prevented. The government answered that freedoms of speech, religion and association are constitutionally protected, that prosecution or local closure is possible in specific cases, that the AIVD received no warning beforehand, and that entry can be refused on public order grounds.
If statements constitute a punishable offence, the Public Prosecution Service can proceed to prosecution.
Indien uitspraken een strafbare gedraging opleveren, kan het Openbaar Ministerie tot vervolging overgaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bouwplannen voor een megamoskee in Zoetermeer (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister about neighbourhood unrest over a planned mosque in Zoetermeer, its financing, and whether the government would try to stop the mosque or restrict its minarets and loudspeakers. The minister said the local council must weigh the interests, that the municipality provides no funding, and refused to intervene.
It is up to the local authority to weigh the various interests and make a decision on building a mosque at this location.
Het is aan het lokale bestuur om de verschillende belangen te wegen en een besluit te nemen over de bouw van een moskee op deze locatie.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bedreiging en het aanzetten tot geweld door de wereldvoorzitter van de Ahmadiyya Moslim Verga

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a statement by the world leader of the Ahmadiyya movement, warning Geert Wilders and others that they would be destroyed, constitutes incitement to violence and what measures would follow. The minister answered that the statement calls for destruction through prayer rather than violence, sees no incitement to violence and therefore no reason for measures, and that the Dutch branch is part of the worldwide movement.
In the statements I see no incitement to or call for violence, and therefore I see no reason for measures against the Ahmadiyya Muslim Jamaat.
In de uitlatingen zie ik geen aanzet tot of oproep tot geweld en daarom zie ik ook geen aanleiding tot maatregelen tegen de Ahmadiyya Moslim Djamaat.

Vragen van de leden Dille, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voorstel om besnijdenis van meisjes te legaliseren (ingezonden

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Health whether they agree that female genital cutting is barbaric, whether legalising it would advance Islamisation, and whether they will guarantee it stays criminal. The minister confirmed it is criminal mutilation under the Criminal Code, said changing those articles is not planned, and did not give the requested guarantee in absolute terms.
Girls' circumcision is punishable in the Netherlands.

Vragen van de leden Wilders , Kortenoeven en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over apartheidsreizen naar Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Education and Foreign Affairs ministers about Hajj/Umrah trips to Saudi Arabia, which bar non-Muslims from Mecca and Medina, and whether schools organise such trips during school time. The government said religious access restrictions are a religious matter it does not normally comment on, that no Islamic schools are known to organise such trips, that absence is not recorded by religion, and that municipalities enforce compulsory schooling.
The government therefore cannot tell you whether, and if so how many, Islamic compulsory-education pupils were absent without leave during the past Hajj season.
De regering kan u dan ook niet melden of, en zo ja hoeveel islamitische leerplichtigen ongeoorloofd afwezig waren tijdens het afgelopen hadj-seizoen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vervolging van de Turkse cartoonist Bahadir Baruter wegens het afwijzen van Allah (ingezonden 6 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Turkish cartoonist Bahadir Baruter for insulting religious values under Turkish criminal law, and whether this signals Turkish restrictions on free speech and religious freedom. The minister declined to prejudge the Turkish court case, said the provision is not per se incompatible with the rule of law, and stated the Netherlands has raised concerns about free expression and religious freedom in Turkey.
It is not for the Cabinet to anticipate this trial.
Het is niet aan het Kabinet om op dit proces vooruit te lopen.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verijdelde Iraanse terreuraanslagen in de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he assessed reports of foiled Iranian terror plots in the United States and whether he would immediately sever diplomatic relations with Iran if the regime was behind them. The minister said he was appalled, that the cabinet was consulting the US and allies on a joint response, that he would inform parliament when consultations concluded, and that the Netherlands supported raising the matter in the UN Security Council.
I will inform your House when that consultation has concluded.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren wanneer dat overleg is afgerond.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over nog meer Europees geld voor de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Europe should stop sending hundreds of millions of euros to the Palestinian Authority, which they called corrupt and tolerant of terrorist attacks, and what the government could do to oppose the subsidy. The minister answered that EU aid supports the Israeli-Palestinian peace process, that the PA cooperates with Israel against terrorism, and that the funding follows Dutch policy, without committing to any new action.
This funding is in line with the policy of the Netherlands.
Deze financiering ligt in het verlengde van het beleid van Nederland.

Vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat fraude op islamitische scholen niet wordt vervolgd (ingezonden

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked why fraud at Islamic schools (about EUR 4.6 million recovered, only one case prosecuted) was not prosecuted and whether recovered sums should be charged to individual board members with fines. The minister replied that recovery is administrative, that criminal reports were made in three cases and only one led to prosecution, that the prosecution service declined the others on evidentiary and opportunity grounds, and that the ministry lacks power to recover from individuals, though one board was pressed to pursue ex-board members.
The Ministry of OCW has no legal authority to recover unlawfully obtained or spent funding from individual board members or staff of an educational institution.
Het ministerie van OCW heeft geen juridische bevoegdheid om onrechtmatig verkregen of bestede bekostiging te verhalen op individuele bestuursleden of medewerkers van een onderwijsinstelling.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat Griekenland 400 tanks koopt (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked whether reports that Greece is buying 400 tanks are true, and whether the government will pressure Greece and halt aid if it does not cancel. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the reports are incorrect: the US offered the tanks free of charge, but Greece declined because transport and logistics costs would fall on Greece, so no action is warranted.
As the Minister of Finance indicated in response to earlier questions on this from MPs Irrgang and Van Bommel (SP), the reporting about Greece's purchase of 400 tanks is incorrect.

Zoals de Minister van Financiën heeft aangegeven in reactie op eerdere vragen hierover van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (SP) (kenmerk BFB 2011–1972M) is de berichtgeving over de aanschaf van 400 tanks door Griekenland onjuist.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een in Madrid gearresteerde radicale moslim (ingezonden 9 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the minister whether it is acceptable that a Moroccan convicted as a jihadist terrorist worked as a lecturer at the Islamic University of Europe in Rotterdam, and whether such an institution should be closed. The state secretary said the institution is not recognised under Dutch higher education law and OCW has no involvement with it, that work permits do not require employers to check a worker's background, and that action would follow only if the institution breached Dutch legal rules, with a court able to ban an association acting against public order.
I cannot answer the first part of your question, because I have no involvement with the institution in question.
Ik kan het eerste deel van uw vraag niet beantwoorden, omdat ik geen bemoeienis heb met de onderhavige instelling.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bouw van een moskee met een imperialistische minaret van 27 meter hoog (ingezonden 12 augustu

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a mosque with a 27-metre minaret in Leiden, including whether it reflects Islamisation, how citizens are consulted on mosque construction, and whether mosques lower house prices. The minister rejected the Islamisation framing, pointed to municipal competence and the public consultation procedure used in Leiden, and said he knows of no research showing house price drops.
The authority to grant a building permit rests with the municipality.
De bevoegdheid tot het verlenen van een bouwvergunning berust bij de gemeente.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de relaties tussen Nederland en de Islamitische Republiek Iran (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about an IRNA report of his meeting with Iran's foreign minister, alleged 'provocative acts' in Europe, growing bilateral trade, and Iranian human rights, terrorism and nuclear conduct. The minister replied that the Iranian minister did not use the phrase 'provocative acts', that the government distinguishes its views from the PVV's, that the conversation was mainly about the consular dialogue on detained dual nationals, and that the government remains seriously concerned about Iran's nuclear programme and human rights.
Minister Salehi did not use the term 'provocative actions' in his conversation with me.
Minister Salehi heeft in zijn gesprek met mij het woord «provocatieve acties» niet gebruikt.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe pogrom van Indonesische moslims tegen Indonesische christenen (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of unrest on Ambon and about the government's efforts on religious freedom in Indonesia, including the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue and advocacy with Indonesian officials. The minister answered that the Ambon violence was not sectarian in origin, described diplomatic raising of religious tolerance in bilateral and multilateral fora, and promised to answer before the EU-Indonesia framework agreement vote.
I raised the subject with the Indonesian Minister of Foreign Affairs on the margins of the ASEM Foreign Ministers' Meeting on 6 and 7 June 2011.
Ik heb het onderwerp onder de aandacht gebracht van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken van Indonesië en marge van de ASEM Foreign Ministers' Meeting op 6 en 7 juni 2011.
Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bontes en van Dijck (allen PVV) aan de minister-president over de onacceptabele voorstellen van de Voorzitter van de Europese Commissie (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister whether he objects to Commission President Barroso's State of the Union proposals for eurobonds, a financial transaction tax and treaty changes removing member-state veto rights. The Prime Minister answered that the Netherlands opposes eurobonds and an EU-level transaction tax (preferring a global one), supports unanimity on certain files, and will raise these views with the Commission.
The Netherlands is not in favour of abolishing this.
Nederland is er niet voor om dit op te heffen.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over juwelier Kamerbeek in Nijmegen (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about repeated violent robberies of a jeweller in Nijmegen by allochtone offenders, and whether his refusal to admit certain young men was justified, plus when minimum-sentence and denaturalisation bills would be tabled. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing and victim support was offered, that shop owners may apply a door policy, and that the minimum-sentence bill is with the Raad van State and a denaturalisation bill is being prepared.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik daarover geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Vrouw in rolstoel mishandeld» (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported assault on a disabled woman and her assistance dog, and whether the prosecution guideline for assault should be changed to seek higher sentences. The minister said all assault is unacceptable, that the case is a violent street robbery rather than a guideline-governed assault, that the prosecutor tailors the sentence demand to the circumstances including the victim's wheelchair use, and that pre-trial detention is usually requested.
The Public Prosecution Service has no sentencing guideline for this type of case, because formulating the sentence demand is tailor-made work.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen strafvorderingsrichtlijn voor dit soort zaken, omdat het formuleren van de strafeis maatwerk is.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het doodvonnis en de beestachtige detentie van een Pakistaanse christelijke vrouw die islamstichter Mohammed zou hebben

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence and harsh detention of Aasia Bibi and about Pakistan's blasphemy laws, and whether Pakistan can hold a meaningful role in international human rights bodies. The minister replied that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case through bilateral and EU channels, favours quiet diplomacy over public pressure on blasphemy laws, rejects claims of systematic discrimination in flood aid, and asked for understanding for the delayed answer.
The Netherlands regularly raises the blasphemy laws issue in bilateral and multilateral contacts, where quiet diplomacy is considered the most effective approach.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rond de blasfemiewetten in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde, waarbij de weg van stille diplomatie het meest effectief is.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een reis van Nederlandse moslims naar een Egyptisch haatkamp (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported trip by Dutch converts to an Egyptian Islamic camp, asking whether returnees would be monitored, whether the trip threatens security, whether the Landelijk Platform Nieuwe Moslims received subsidy, and whether citizens could be barred from returning. The Minister answered that citizens are free within legal limits, that there is no information indicating a terrorist threat from the camp, that the platform received no central government subsidy, and that Dutch nationals cannot be denied entry.
I have no information that the Islamic camp in Egypt would pose such a threat.
Ik beschik niet over informatie dat van het islamkamp in Egypte een dergelijke dreiging uit zou gaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gratis vechtsportlessen voor overlastgevend tuig in Gouda (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether free martial arts lessons for nuisance youths in Gouda rewarded bad behaviour, what the project costs were, and why not harsher punishment or loss of nationality instead. The minister rejected the reward framing, said the preventive project targets beginning nuisance behaviour with costs of EUR 36,618, and stated that prosecution is for the OM and that nationality cannot be withdrawn for ordinary offences.
I do not share this view. There is no question of rewarding bad behaviour.
Ik deel deze visie niet. Er is geen sprake van beloning van slecht gedrag.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de rechtspositie en veiligheid van christenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Bogor mayor is blocking churches are true, how the Indonesian government is acting, and whether the Netherlands will press Indonesia for religious freedom. The minister answered that the concerns are serious, that the high court and ombudsman ruled the church has valid permits, that Nederland raises religious freedom regularly with Indonesian authorities and the EU does so in human rights dialogue, and did not commit to new specific action.
This reporting is cause for concern.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Miljarden euro's klimaatgeld onderhevig aan corruptie» (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that billions in climate finance are vulnerable to corruption, how much goes to highly corrupt countries, whether climate sceptics sit on the climate bank, and about fraud in CO2 trading. The government answered that all funds are accounted for and corruption is investigated and recovered, that the World Bank will act as trustee with fiduciary standards, and that anti-fraud measures for emissions trading are being strengthened.
Afterwards, all organisations that have received the money must always account for the expenditure.
Achteraf dienen alle organisaties die het geld hebben ontvangen zich altijd te verantwoorden voor de uitgaven.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat topsalarissen in de zorg gewoon worden doorbetaald. (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the health minister how she responds to reports that the executive pay code for healthcare directors (BBZ) is failing, given that most top salaries exceed the norm, and whether she will enforce it and include it in the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister replied that the code applies only to new contracts and disputed the reported non-compliance, promised to analyse the 2010 figures and speak with the sector bodies, and noted that the pay-cap law would make the code binding.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het uitroepen van sharia-zones in Engeland (ingezonden 1 augustus 201

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked whether the government condemns reports of sharia zones in England, the statements of a 'Muslims against crusades' supporter, and whether such organisations should be banned. Minister Rosenthal answered that sharia law does not apply in the UK and is unacceptable in the Netherlands, rejects the statements, and noted that the group Islam4UK has been banned in the UK.
The key point is that sharia legislation does not apply in the United Kingdom.
Kernpunt is dat Sharia-wetgeving niet van toepassing is in het Verenigd Koninkrijk.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de voortgaande straatterreur door Marokkanen (ingezonden 1

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about a violent street attack by a group on a 17-year-old, whether the perpetrators should be denaturalised and deported, what measures would end such street violence, and how to interpret a German study linking Muslim youth to aggression. The government condemned the conduct, left sentencing to the prosecutor and courts, said denaturalisation applies only to certain offences and not to simple assault, pointed to existing local order instruments and a letter on criminal youth groups, and declined to draw a link between Islam and the incident.
If prosecution is pursued, it is for the public prosecutor to decide which penalty to request, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien tot vervolging wordt overgegaan is het aan het OM welke strafvordering wordt gedaan, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Saoediërs blokkeren sites» (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon the Saudi ambassador and publicly criticise Saudi internet censorship after reports that Saudi Arabia briefly blocked Dutch broadcaster Wereldomroep websites. The minister answered that the responsible party could not be established, that the sites were accessible again, and that Netherlands raises internet freedom in EU, UN and Council of Europe fora.
On this matter, an inquiry will be made with the Saudi Arabian embassy in The Hague.
Over deze kwestie zal ter navraag met de ambassade van Saudi-Arabië in Den Haag contact opgenomen worden.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dreiging van Turkije met een crisis over Cyprus (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

PVV MPs Wilders and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Turkey's threat to freeze EU relations if Cyprus holds the EU presidency, and whether he will press EU partners not to yield and will call for ending Turkey's accession talks. The minister replied that the presidency is an EU matter, that the government trusts the Cypriot presidency, that Turkey must meet the 2005 negotiating framework conditions on Cyprus and neighbours, and that accession talks are open-ended with no guaranteed outcome.
The cabinet has confidence in the Cypriot EU presidency, which begins on 1 July 2012.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in het Cypriotische EU-voorzitterschap dat op 1 juli 2012 aanvangt.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het aanzetten tot geweld en bedreiging

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Sharia4Holland, a group whose videos allegedly incite violence and threats, should be considered extremist, what measures would be taken to prosecute it and ban it, and whether its members should leave the country. The government replied that the group has no members or public manifestation, that the Public Prosecution Service found no criminal incitement in the videos so no prosecution will follow, and that residence permits can be revoked after criminal conviction while rejecting Sharia as contrary to Dutch values.
Nevertheless there is reason for vigilance, and I can assure you that developments surrounding Shariah4Holland have our attention.
Er is niettemin reden voor alertheid en ik kan u verzekeren dat de ontwikkelingen rond Shariah4Holland onze aandacht hebben.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bekostiging van een museumdeel door het Sult

MPs Van Klaveren, Elissen and Wilders asked how the Sultanate of Oman financed parts of the Oriëntalis museum park, including the Arab village and mosque, and whether a country applying sharia and ruled by a dictator should be co-responsible for Dutch museums, and questioned a royal attendance at the reopening. The government answered that Oman donated 500,000 euro in 2008 for the museum mosque, that it has no overview of Oman's contribution to the Arab village, that Oman's contribution is cultural and educational, and that the Princess's attendance fits government policy.
I have no insight into the contribution of the Sultanate of Oman to the Arab village, other than a donation in 2008 of 500,000 euro for the construction of the museum mosque.
Ik heb geen zicht op de bijdrage van het Sultanaat Oman voor het Arabisch dorp, anders dan een donatie in 2008 van € 500 000 voor de bouw van de museummoskee.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over het doorbetalen van pensioenen aan overleden Grieken (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked the Finance Minister whether Greece pays about 16 million euros a year in pensions to deceased civil servants and whether Dutch aid to Greece should therefore stop. The minister said he had no reason to doubt the reports, called the fraud serious, and stated that the Dutch loan tranches remain tied to strict conditions, with a further discussion in the Eurogroup and a promise to consult the House before deciding.
Before any decision is taken on this, I will consult the House on the Dutch position.
Voordat besluitvorming hierover plaatsvindt, zal ik met de Kamer over de Nederlandse standpuntbepaling overleggen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het absurde RMO-advies immigranten de taal niet meer te leren (ingezonden 18 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the RMO advice to drop mandatory Dutch language and cultural requirements for immigrants conflicts with the cabinet's integration vision, and whether the RMO should be abolished. The minister acknowledged the advice is partly out of line with the integration vision, promised a cabinet response by mid-August 2011 under the Advisory Councils Act, and rejected the view that the RMO should be dismantled.
In accordance with the Advisory Councils Act, the cabinet will send both chambers its response to the advice no later than mid-August 2011.
Conform de Kaderwet op de Adviescolleges zal het kabinet beide Kamers uiterlijk medio augustus 2011 zijn reactie op het advies doen toekomen.

Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Fritsma en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het invoeren van grenscontroles door Duitsland en Frankrijk voor immi

PVV MPs asked the Immigration minister whether the Netherlands should introduce border controls like Germany and France did against migrants from Italy, given tens of thousands of North African migrants holding Schengen visas issued by Italy. The minister answered that the Netherlands will not reintroduce internal border controls because it would be disproportionate and economically harmful, and instead tightened supervision and wrote to the European Commissioner and Italy.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie over de pro-islam wervingsadvertentie van het ministerie van Defensie in het dagblad Metro (ingezonden 6 april 2011).

PVV MPs Hernandez and Wilders asked the Defence Minister about a recruitment advertisement showing a Muslim soldier praying, whether it fell under the ended Diversity Action Plan, its cost, and whether it signalled Islamisation of the armed forces. The minister confirmed the ad, said it was paid from the regular recruitment budget (EUR 14,000), denied any Islamisation, and said the Islam is treated with the same respect as other religions.
The advertisement cost EUR 14,000 and was paid from the regular recruitment budget.
De advertentie heeft € 14 000 gekost en is betaald uit het reguliere wervingsbudget.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wasruimte op een hogeschool (ingezonden 8 f

PVV MPs asked whether a ritual washing room for Muslims at a Christian university of applied sciences signals Islamisation of education and whether the government will oppose it. The minister rejected the Islamisation view, said the college board decides within equal-treatment law, noted complaints can go to the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling or the courts, and declined any measures.

The College of Governors is responsible for the running of a higher education institution and is therefore authorised to make decisions in this matter as well, within the generally applicable legal frameworks.

Het College van Bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de gang van zaken op een instelling van hoger onderwijs en mitsdien bevoegd om ook in dezen beslissingen te nemen binnen de algemeen geldende wettelijke kaders.

Vragen van de leden Gerbrands en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat verpleegkundigen in de academische ziekhuizen hun onregelmatigheidstoeslag voor een groot g

MPs Gerbrands and Wilders asked the health minister about reports that nurses in academic hospitals would lose much of their irregular-hours allowance, and whether the minister would cut manager pay instead. The minister replied that the matter is a collective labour agreement negotiation between the employers' federation NFU and the unions, to which the ministry is not a party, so it holds no substantive view.
VWS is not a party to these collective labour agreement negotiations.
VWS is geen partij in de deze cao-onderhandelingen.
Vragen van de leden De Mos, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een milieubrochure (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a government-subsidised environmental project for Turkish-origin Dutch citizens, questioning the spelling errors in a brochure, its Turkish-language distribution, and whether the roughly EUR 200,000 was well spent. The state secretary defended the project as reaching a substantial part of the target group, acknowledged the Dutch brochure's spelling errors as regrettable, and stated the SMOM subsidy scheme would no longer be open from 2011.
The SMOM scheme has not been open since 2011, as already announced in this cabinet's coalition agreement.
De SMOM-regeling is met ingang van 2011 niet meer opengesteld, zoals reeds is aangekondigd in het regeerakkoord van dit kabinet.

Vraag van de leden Wilders en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de AIVD heeft gefaald bij de moord op Theo van Gogh (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

PVV MPs Wilders and Elissen asked the Interior Minister whether the AIVD failed to protect Theo van Gogh due to inadequate assessment of information and lack of internal controls, and whether former minister Remkes covered this up. The minister answered that no cover-up occurred, pointing to the CTIVD independent investigation of 2008 and subsequent AIVD improvements.
Contrary to what the De Pers article of 15 April states, there has therefore been no question of 'covering up'.
In tegenstelling tot hetgeen gesteld wordt in het artikel van De Pers van 15 april jl. is er dan ook geen sprake geweest van «verbloemen».

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de financiering van een Amsterdamse moskee door het ministerie van Religieuze Zaken van Koeweit

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister whether Kuwait's religious affairs ministry funding of 1.3 million euro for an Amsterdam mosque was undesirable, how extremist preachers could be kept out, and how construction could be blocked. The minister answered that foreign financing of religious buildings is the initiator's affair under freedom of religion absent suspicion of illegal acts, that entry can be denied to a foreigner who incites violence, and that building permits are a local government competence.
The financing of a building to be erected is a matter for the initiator.
De financiering van een op te richten bouwwerk is een zaak van de initiatiefnemer.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de existentiële bedreiging van Nederland, Israel en de rest van het Vrije Westen door het islamofascistische regime in T

Wilders and Kortenoeven (PVV) asked the foreign minister whether the Iranian regime poses an existential threat to the Free West, citing the documentary Iranium. Minister Rosenthal confirmed awareness of the film, declined to endorse the characterisation, but stated serious concern over Iran's nuclear programme and human rights, pointing to UN, US and EU sanctions.
The Netherlands nevertheless has great concerns about developments in Iran, including its nuclear programme and the human rights situation.
Nederland heeft evenwel grote zorgen over de ontwikkelingen in Iran, onder meer over het het Iraanse nucleaire programma en de mensenrechtensituatie.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een beleidsadvies meer ruimte te creëren voor de islam (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether he would condemn an advisory report urging more accommodation of Islam, such as avoiding lectures during Friday prayer and creating prayer rooms, calling it absurd and an increase in Islam's influence. The minister declined to comment on the personal advice, said accommodating diverse populations reflects Western values of religious freedom, denied that the advice increases Islam's influence, and left the response to local authorities and institutions within legal frameworks.
I see no reason to respond to this advice, which the author wrote in a personal capacity for a think tank of the European People's Party.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een reactie op dit advies, dat door de auteur op persoonlijke titel is geschreven voor een denktank van de Europese Volkspartij.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het recente geweld tegen Koptische christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 15 maart 2011)

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt in March 2011, including the Helwan and Mokattam clashes, and whether Egypt's Muslim Brotherhood influence and the EU association agreement should be used as leverage. The minister confirmed the events in outline, disputed some casualty figures, said the Dutch embassy had raised the issue with Egyptian authorities and that the EU had raised it at the UN Human Rights Council, and stated that further EU measures would be considered if the situation worsened.
In the EU context, the Netherlands advocates swift implementation of concrete measures following the February Council conclusions on freedom of religion.
Nederland pleit in EU-verband voor snelle uitvoering van concrete maatregelen naar aanleiding van de raadsconclusies over godsdienstvrijheid van de Raad van februari jl.
Vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over islamitische scholen die slechter scoren (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the education minister about Islamic schools scoring worse on inspection ratings, arguing they reject Western values and should be closed. The minister answered that low-quality schools of any denomination are a concern, noted improvement in Islamic primary schools, rejected the view that Islamic education does not fit the Netherlands, and said funding would not be withdrawn merely because a school is Islamic, though chronically weak schools face closure.
I have no intention of withdrawing funding from schools because they are Islamic.
Ik heb geen voornemens om de bekostiging van scholen in te trekken, omdat ze islamitisch zijn.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over plannen voor een nieuwe afvaloven (ingezonden 21 fe

Two PVV MPs asked whether the €6 million state subsidy for the Omrin waste incineration plant in Harlingen should be withheld while court proceedings and the annulled permit are pending, and whether there is overcapacity in waste incineration. The state secretary answered that the subsidy is tied to commissioning by 1 May 2011 and would be reduced to zero if the plant cannot operate, that the permit is in force after the Council of State rejected the injunction, and that waste supply is currently below forecasts.
If the REC cannot be put into use due to the lack of an environmental permit, the subsidy will be set at zero.
Als de REC niet in gebruik kan worden genomen als gevolg van het ontbreken van een milieuvergunning, zal de subsidie op nihil worden vastgesteld.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een mishandeling vanwege het niet dragen van e

MPs Van Klaveren, Beertema and Wilders asked whether a reported assault on a girl for not wearing a headscarf showed Islamic oppression, whether this made a school headscarf ban necessary, and what measures would remove and prosecute perpetrators. The minister rejected the oppression framing, said headscarf wearing played no role in the incident, saw no need for a ban, and said the central government lacked competence, pointing to the school's power to suspend and to criminal reporting.
None, the central government is not competent for this.
Geen, het Rijk is hiertoe niet bevoegd.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende onderdrukking van de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van de persvrijheid in Turkije (ingezonden 8 maart 20

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and sentences of journalists and writers in Turkey, including the Ergenekon investigation and sentences of seven years and eleven months for two journalists, and whether Turkey's EU membership should be ruled out. The minister said the government monitors these cases, raised press freedom with Turkey, expressed concern over increasing prosecutions under other penal articles, and stated Turkey cannot join the EU until accession criteria are met.
The Cabinet does not go into individual charges.
Het Kabinet gaat niet in op individuele tenlasteleggingen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wens van bijna 100 ouders na de zomer over te gaan op islamitisch thuisonderwijs in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she considers Islamic home schooling undesirable and what measures she will take to prevent it across the Netherlands, after nearly 100 Amsterdam parents wanted to switch to home education. The minister answered that home schooling is not a way to fulfil compulsory education but is permitted for exempted parents under the Leerplichtwet, that a religious objection exemption is available and judged by the courts where disputed, and that she will reconsider the exemption ground and report back in autumn.
I will therefore consider the desirability of this exemption ground and will inform you of the outcome this autumn.
Ik ga mij dan ook beraden op de opportuniteit van deze vrijstellingsgrond en zal u dit najaar over de uitkomst informeren.
Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het nieuwe immigratierecord (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

PVV MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the immigration minister about a record immigration figure and whether the coalition agreement measures should be implemented quickly, and whether emigration of native Dutch and skilled workers signals a brain drain. The minister said the measures are being pursued with timelines depending on EU processes and that the emigration data do not show mass departure of natives or braindrain among second-generation migrants.
My aim is explicitly to implement the measures in the coalition agreement in the shortest possible time.
Mijn inzet is er nadrukkelijk op gericht de in het regeerakkoord genoemde maatregelen op de kortst mogelijke termijn door te voeren.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat de Dienst Islamitische Geestelijke Verzorging van het ministerie van Defensie een symposium houdt over islam en krij

PVV MPs Hernandez and Wilders asked the defence minister whether a Defence Islamic chaplaincy symposium on Islam and the armed forces received state subsidy, and whether it should be stopped as propaganda for Islam. The minister confirmed the symposium, said no specific subsidy was involved beyond providing Defence facilities, and rejected calling Islam a totalitarian ideology or ending the chaplaincy.
This symposium was organised at the Marinekazerne Amsterdam. There is therefore no specific subsidy for this symposium.
Dit symposium werd georganiseerd op de Marinekazerne Amsterdam. Er is dus niet sprake van een specifieke subsidie voor dit symposium.

Vragen van het leden Kortenoeven, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat het Europese Parlement en de Duitse regering de Europese betrekkingen met de islamitische schurk

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he shares the view of an MEP and a German minister that EU relations with Iran should be deepened, and whether he will reprimand the German minister. The minister replied that Iran is an important regional actor but its behaviour is unpredictable, so relations should be kept up mainly where Dutch or EU interests are served, and he reaffirmed a two-track policy of pressure and dialogue.
Expanding or deepening relations is for me only on the table where it serves our or EU interests.
Uitbreiding of verdieping van de betrekkingen is wat mij betreft alleen aan de orde waar het onze of de EU-belangen ten goede komt.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Aso’s isoleren in Tuigdorpen» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper proposal to isolate repeat offenders in 'tuigdorpen' (tent or container villages), asking whether it would help and whether the government would implement it. The state secretary rejected the proposal, citing existing remand facilities, the Inrichting voor Stelselmatige Daders (ISD) measure, and the experience of earlier Skaeve Huse-type projects that struggled with locations.
When it comes to providing a facility pending a criminal case, I do not consider an open facility appropriate.
Als het gaat om het bieden van een voorziening in afwachting van een strafzaak vind ik een open voorziening niet passend.

Vragen van de leden Helder, Wilders en van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Gevangenis huurt meer imams in en minder pastors en humanisten» (ingezonden 28 januari

PVV MPs asked the state secretary of Security and Justice about a report that prisons were hiring more imams and fewer pastors and humanist counsellors, and whether this threatened integration. The government answered that the increase follows a preference survey of prisoners, denied any integration effect, and refused to introduce an imam stop, citing the legal duty to match religious care to inmates' beliefs.
I therefore see no reason whatsoever to introduce an imam stop (as spiritual caregiver) at DJI.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele aanleiding om een imamstop (als geestelijk verzorger) in te voeren bij DJI.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over moskeeën die medewerking weigeren aan het onderzoek naar lijfstraffen en het verspreiden van ant

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked why mosques in Amsterdam and Tilburg refused to take part in a study of corporal punishment and anti-Western sentiment in weekend Islamic education, whether the minister had understated the evidence of abuse, and whether those mosques should be closed. Minister Donner answered that participation is voluntary, that the separate GGD investigation into concrete signals of child abuse is still ongoing, and that there is no basis for closing the mosques.
Participation in the study by the Verwey-Jonker Institute into the pedagogical climate during non-formal weekend education in mosques is based on voluntary participation.
Deelname aan het onderzoek door het Verwey-Jonker Instituut naar het pedagogisch klimaat tijdens non-formeel weekendonderwijs in moskeeën geschiedt op basis van vrijwilligheid.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een rapport van «EU-diplomaten» over Jeruzalem (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he would distance the Netherlands from an EU diplomats' report suggesting East Jerusalem be treated as a Palestinian capital, and whether Dutch diplomats contributed to it and whether the report should be discarded. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports a two-state solution with Jerusalem's final status left to negotiation, that the report was largely factual with options the Netherlands endorsed only where they maintained existing policy, and that Dutch contributions followed government policy and distanced the Netherlands from calls contrary to it.
Options that anticipate the outcomes of the final status negotiations have not been supported by the Netherlands.
Opties die vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de finalestatusonderhandelingen zijn niet door Nederland ondersteund.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door moslims op Kerstavond aangerichte bloedbad tegen christenen in Nigeria (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Christmas Eve killings of Christians in Nigeria were part of a global Islamic war, whether they could be called genocide, and what action was being taken. The minister rejected the global-war framing, said the attacks were claimed by Boko Haram and are under investigation, stated the genocide definition is not met, and listed EU and Dutch measures such as calls for prosecutions and support for a conflict-management centre.
Regarding the qualification 'genocide', I refer to the definition of genocide in the 1948 Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide.
Ten aanzien van de kwalificatie «volkerenmoord» verwijs ik graag naar de definitie van genocide zoals opgenomen in het Verdrag inzake de Voorkoming en de Bestraffing van Genocide uit 1948.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma, Van Klaveren, en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «WOII moet weer centrale plek krijgen» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Holocaust lessons are being adapted for Muslim pupils and to what extent. The minister said there is no national overview, that lesson design is teachers' professional responsibility, and that a survey indicated one in five history teachers in big cities had sometimes found it hard to raise the Holocaust, without this implying structural problems.
In essence this is the professional responsibility of teachers, in which the government has no involvement.
In essentie is dit de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van leraren waar de overheid geen bemoeienis mee heeft.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over halal-lunch bij de politie (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

PVV MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether police lunches served only halal food, calling it unacceptable Islamisation, and whether he would end it. The minister answered that lunch packages without pork were an organisational measure given the number of people who do not eat pork, and refused to end it.
Here it is a matter of providing lunch packages without pork because it is organisationally easier to carry out.
Hier is sprake van het verstrekken van lunchpakketten zonder varkensvlees omdat het organisatorisch beter uitvoerbaar is.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het financieren van Turkse anti-PVV propaganda door de Nederlandse regering (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government funded a Turkish documentary and journalist visit critical of the PVV and Geert Wilders, and whether such funding would stop. The minister confirmed about 11,998 euro was spent on travel and stay via embassy and consulate facilitation, said the programme must not facilitate propaganda, and gave no commitment to stop.
The programme may not lead to conducting or facilitating propaganda.
Het programma mag niet leiden tot het bedrijven of faciliteren van propaganda.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de organisatie sharia4holland (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the Sharia4Holland organisation threatens democracy and whether it should be banned and its members expelled. Minister Donner answered that he rejects introducing sharia, but that freedoms of expression, association and religion protect the group, and the government has no indications it breaks the law or threatens the democratic order.
The government currently has no indications that Shariah4Holland, in exercising its fundamental rights, violates the law or poses a danger to society or the democratic legal order.
De regering heeft vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat Shariah4Holland bij het uitoefenen van haar grondrechten de wet overtreedt en een gevaar vormt voor de samenleving of de democratische rechtsorde.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bomaanslag op Egyptische christenen (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a New Year's bombing of a Coptic church in Alexandria, including whether Egyptian security withdrew shortly before the attack and whether the ambassador should be summoned to demand better protection of Christians. The minister said the reports of security presence conflict, the prosecutor is investigating, extra security had been ordered after warnings, and he had asked Egypt in a condolence letter to protect religious minorities.
The investigation into the bombing in Alexandria is led by the public prosecutor-general.
Het onderzoek naar de bomaanslag in Alexandrië wordt geleid door de openbaar hoofdaanklager.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende islamitische jihad tegen christenen in Irak (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether attacks on Iraqi Christians form part of a wider Islamic jihad against Christians, linked to recent attacks in Egypt and Nigeria, and what is being done to prevent destruction of the community. The minister said there is no concrete evidence linking the incidents, attributed them to local causes, and described Dutch and EU engagement with Iraqi authorities and the planned EU Foreign Affairs Council discussion.
On the basis of their primary responsibility, I first approached the Iraqi authorities to promote an improvement in the security situation in Iraq.
Ik heb mij, op grond van hun primaire verantwoordelijkheid, allereerst tot de Iraakse autoriteiten gewend om te bevorderen dat de veiligheidssituatie in Irak zal verbeteren.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bouw van twee moskeeën voor illegalen in Athene onder andere gefinancierd door Nederlandse belastingb

Three PVV MPs asked whether an EU emergency fund finances two mosques for illegal immigrants in Athens with Dutch taxpayers' money, and how such a decision was made. The State Secretary replied that the report is largely incorrect: only one mosque was approved by Greek law in 2006, funded from Greek national budget, not from the EU fund or Dutch taxes.
No Dutch taxpayers' money is being spent on the construction of the mosque.
Aan de bouw van de moskee wordt geen Nederlands belastinggeld besteed.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over uitlatingen van de korpschef van de politie Amsterdam-Amstelland over handhaving van het boerkaverbod (ingezonden 5 jan

PVV MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a police chief's public statement that he would not enforce a possible face-covering ban, and would be civilly disobedient, was acceptable. The minister replied that the law applies and is enforced throughout the country including Amsterdam, that the government will propose a general ban with sanctions, and that the Amsterdam triangle has publicly confirmed enforcement.
Laws are enforced throughout the entire country.
Wetten worden gehandhaafd in het hele land.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Hernandez en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het bericht dat de Islamitische Republiek Iran zou beschikken over geavanceerde Noord-Koreaan

MPs Kortenoeven, Hernandez and Wilders asked whether NATO discussed reports that Iran already had North Korean BM25 missiles capable of reaching Western Europe with nuclear weapons, why this was not public, and whether sanctions should be tightened. The government answered that the threat was discussed in connection with missile defence, that the Strategic Concept already covers it, and that existing UN and EU sanctions already target Iran's ballistic missile programme.
The current sanctions policy towards Iran, UN Security Council Resolution 1929 and the European Regulation on sanctions against Iran, already targets countering Iran's ballistic missile programme.

Antwoord 5 Het huidige sanctiebeleid jegens Iran, VN Veiligheidsraadresolutie 1929 3 en de Europese Verordening inzake sancties tegen Iran, richt zich reeds op het tegengaan van het ballistische rakettenprogramma van Iran.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over beëindiging samenwerking Israël met United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) (ingezonden 8

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the foreign minister whether Israel suspended cooperation with UNESCO over its decision to list Jewish holy sites as Islamic mosques, and whether UNESCO should reverse it. The minister answered that Israel's suspension announcement was retracted but Israel refuses to implement five UNESCO decisions, that the decision is unwise, and that the Netherlands will press for return to consensus voting.
The Netherlands will, where possible, press for a position of the Executive Board in favour of the previously existing consensus method.
Nederland zal wel waar mogelijk aandringen op een stellingname van de Uitvoerende Raad ten gunste van de voorheen bestaande consensus-methode.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitlatingen van de Palestijnse leider Abbas over het verbreken van afspraken (ingezonden 12 november 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Palestinian leader Abbas saying Palestinians are free to break agreements with Israel, and whether Arabic-language statements contradict Western-language ones and whether Dutch support to the Palestinian Authority should end. The minister confirmed Abbas spoke of feeling released from obligations if Israel does not comply, said the Netherlands calls on parties to refrain from harmful statements, and declined to end Dutch support to the PA.
No, I see no reason to suspend Dutch support to the PA.
Neen, ik zie geen reden om de Nederlandse steun aan de PA op te schorten.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende islamitische jihad in Indonesië tegen christenen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about rising Islamist violence against Christians in Indonesia and whether the Indonesian government tolerates religious intolerance, and whether the Netherlands would raise the issue at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister acknowledged concern, said Indonesia's constitution guarantees religious freedom, blamed small radical groups and weak local capacity or will, and pledged continued raising of the issue bilaterally, in the EU dialogue and at the March 2011 Council session, without committing to specific cases.
The Netherlands will certainly pay attention to freedom of religion, the position of religious minorities and, where necessary, places where this freedom is under pressure.
Nederland zal hier zeker aandacht besteden aan godsdienstvrijheid, de positie van religieuze minderheden en indien nodig plaatsen waar deze vrijheid onder druk staat.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de rol van de Egyptische veiligheidsdienst bij spanningen tussen moslims en christenen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether Egyptian state security tolerated or incited anti-Christian demonstrations and whether it was arrested Muslim Brotherhood members to deter election participation. The minister answered that tensions stem from religious and socio-economic causes, that the government is working to prevent escalation, denied confirming the presence of the state security chief, rejected the characterization of the security services' motives, and said the Netherlands raises religious freedom with Egypt.
Nee, dit kan ik niet bevestigen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de behandeling van christenen in het islamitische koninkrijk Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Saudi religious police arresting Catholics at a Mass, the legal position of Christians in Saudi Arabia, embassy guidance for Christian Dutch nationals, and whether Saudi Arabia's treatment of Christians should be raised internationally. The minister acknowledged concern over discrimination against religious minorities, said Christians in practice must convert to obtain citizenship, stated that travellers bear responsibility for informing themselves, and said the human rights ambassador and bilateral and EU channels have raised freedom of religion.
