The State Secretary rejects the discrimination claim, explains the tool supports employers, and says UWV will further develop it in 2017.
I do not share the view that there is any discrimination or any degree of exclusion.
Ik deel niet de mening dat er sprake is van discriminatie of enige mate van uitsluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Gemeente profiteert van gedraal Plasterk’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that municipalities profit from delayed abolition of the precario levy on underground utility networks, which shifts costs onto non-residents and rose sharply in 2016. The minister acknowledged the cross-subsidy effect, called the levy indirect and democratically opaque, said the 10-year transition gives municipalities enough time, and refused any extra municipal fund compensation.
The indirect nature of the precario levy on utility networks, in my view, obscures the democratic weighing that should legitimise the imposition of taxes.
Het indirecte karakter van de precariobelasting op nutsnetwerken vertroebelt naar mijn mening de democratische afweging die de heffing van belastingen dient te legitimeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake leerrechten van vluchtelingenkinderen en terugdringen van thuiszitters

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about the right to education of refugee children, how many asylum-seeker children are not in school, and why the target of zero long-term truants is set for 2020 rather than earlier. The state secretary answers that asylum-seeker children have the same schooling obligations and access within three months, that about 200 of 7,500 are not attending school, and that the 2020 target is realistic given how persistent truancy is.
As shown by the file comparison included in my letter of 14 July 2016, about 200 of the 7,500 school-age asylum-seeker children are known not to attend school.

Zoals uit de in mijn brief d.d. 14 juli 2016 opgenomen vergelijking van bestanden blijkt, is van de 7500 leer- en kwalificatieplichtige asielzoekerskinderen van ongeveer 200 bekend dat zij niet naar school gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelatie (Wet DBA) en de positie van zzp’ers

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Wet DBA and the loss of assignments for zzp'ers, including whether it affects government bodies and whether the Charter's freedom of enterprise applies. The State Secretary says enforcement is suspended until at least 1 January 2018, a review of the criteria is planned, and the Charter does not apply because the Wet DBA is national law.
With the exception of evidently malicious parties, enforcement is suspended until at least 1 January 2018.
Met uitzondering van evident kwaadwillenden 5 , wordt de handhaving tot in ieder geval 1 januari 2018 opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Keuzevrijheid jeugdzorg onder druk’

An MP asked the state secretary whether Dutch youth-care law obliges municipalities to present the choice between a personal budget (PGB) and in-kind care, and whether youth teams discourage PGBs, citing monitoring reports and a sample study of ten municipalities. The state secretary answered that municipalities must offer choice where reasonably possible, that the sample study yielded no quantitative data and only signals, and that VNG and Per Saldo will develop a support programme for municipalities.
Most of the municipalities examined could not provide sufficient insight into the number of refusals and their reasons, because this information cannot be retrieved from their systems.
Het merendeel van de onderzochte gemeenten kon onvoldoende inzicht geven in aantallen weigeringen en de redenen daarvan, omdat deze informatie niet uit hun systemen te halen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over bijlage 4 bij de Tweede voortgangsrapportage Wet DBA

MP Klein asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the 'kwaadwillenden' (malicious parties) exception in annex 4 to the Wet DBA progress report could cover almost all organisations, whether staffing and costs are affected, and whether the annex should be better communicated and clarified. The State Secretary answers that the exception covers only exceptional cases of fraud or deceit, estimated at about ten, that enforcement is folded into existing audit planning at no extra cost, and that communication is being done through news items, letters to associations and other channels.
Naturally, this does not concern an independent professional about whom there is noise regarding the authority relationship.
Vanzelfsprekend gaat het daarbij dus niet om een zelfstandige professional bij wie er ruis is over de gezagsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Nederlands overnamerecord: topman NXP pakt 380 miljoen’

MPs Klein asked whether the NXP CEO's roughly 380 million euro gain from his shares and options on the takeover is fair, and whether the claw-back rule for takeover bonuses works as intended. The minister answered that the government does not set executive pay in private companies, that the gain is accrued value rather than a payout, that the claw-back rule's evaluation is pending, and that the rule applies only to companies listed on a European exchange.
In the government's reaction to the evaluation of the claw-back rule in article 2:135(7) of the Civil Code, the geographic scope of the rule will be considered.
In de kabinetsreactie op de evaluatie van de afroomregeling van artikel 2:135 lid 7 BW zal de geografische reikwijdte worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel “Kandidaten 50plus beloven hun zetel niet te roven”

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the written pledge 50Plus requires candidates to sign (to give up their seat if they leave the party faction) is legally enforceable and whether it conflicts with the Constitution and Electoral Act. The minister answered that the pledge is not legally enforceable, that MPs vote without instruction under Article 67 of the Constitution, and that he saw no reason for further information or consultation with the Electoral Council.
Under Article 67, third paragraph, of the Constitution, members vote without instruction.
Ingevolge artikel 67, derde lid, van de Grondwet stemmen de leden zonder last.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Klein over het bericht ‘Duizenden kinderen zitten onnodig thuis’

MPs Ypma and Klein asked the State Secretary of Education about reports that thousands of children stay home unnecessarily due to schools and municipalities failing to find suitable places, cost disputes between schools, municipalities and youth care, school refusals, and exemptions. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Thuiszitterspact and the appointed facilitator, committed to a school-inspectorate monitoring route, a study into rising exemptions, and to further dialogue on a development budget, without introducing new legal powers.
That is why I have agreed with the Inspectorate of Education that these signals can be reported there.
Daarom heb ik met de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) afgesproken dat deze signalen daar kunnen worden gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over wachtlijsten en geldtekort bij jeugdzorg

Member Klein asks the State Secretary about youth care waiting lists, the share of psychologists with waits over four weeks, and whether Almere may temporarily halt part of specialist youth care due to budget shortfalls. The State Secretary says waiting times are being discussed with municipalities and branches, with a progress letter promised, and refers the Almere question to an earlier answer to a related question.
In the progress letter on youth care that I will send to the House before 14 November, I will inform you further about the outcomes of the consultations held.
In de voortgangsbrief Jeugd die ik voor 14 november aan Uw Kamer zal toesturen, zal ik u nader informeren over de uitkomsten van het gevoerde overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake de aandacht op de publieke tv-zenders voor de Paralympische Spelen

An MP asked the government about the limited TV airtime (about 35 hours) the public broadcasters gave the Paralympics compared with the Olympics, and whether the government would investigate a fairer split. The State Secretary declined to judge the airtime allocation, stressed that public broadcasters decide their own programming under the Mediawet, pointed to increased Paralympic coverage and online streams, and rejected a study as unnecessary and undesirable.
The Mediawet explicitly provides that the public media institutions themselves determine the form and content of their media offering and are themselves responsible for it.
In de Mediawet is nadrukkelijk bepaald dat de publieke media-instellingen zelf de vorm en inhoud van hun media-aanbod bepalen en daar ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over “de reactie van de minister op twee moties van het lid Klein”

MP Klein asks the Secretary of State for Safety and Justice about the government's response to two of his motions on child protection, including whether guardians' reports separate facts from opinions, whether substitute guardians threaten truth-finding in court, and whether guardians should swear an oath before the court. The Secretary of State points to a privacy/facts-and-opinions guideline, says no data exist on how often guardians are replaced, reasons that the oath was abolished as a formality without added value, and relies on the certification, registration and disciplinary system instead of reinstating the oath.
Substitution at the hearing has no effect on the report as such; the way the relevant facts are presented in it does not change when the guardian is replaced at the hearing.

Vervanging ter zitting heeft geen invloed op de rapportage als zodanig; de manier waarop daarin de van belang zijnde feiten worden aangevoerd verandert niet door vervanging van de gezinsvoogd ter zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel over jongeren die niet meer kunnen rondkomen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a newspaper report that young people can no longer make ends meet, citing falling economic independence and rising youth unemployment. The minister replies that the decline mainly reflects longer education, outlines measures on youth unemployment, internships and a lower youth minimum wage, and rejects an unconditional basic income.
To improve the income position of young people, the cabinet is working on a legislative amendment to lower the statutory age threshold for the adult statutory minimum wage to 21.

Om de inkomenspositie van jongeren te verbeteren werkt het kabinet dan ook aan een wetswijziging om de wettelijke grens voor het ingaan van het volwassen wettelijk minimumloon te verlagen tot de leeftijd van 21 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel ‘Gaan Wiebes en de VVD door met ondernemers pesten?’

MP Klein asks whether self-employed contractors without staff cannot fully indemnify clients against wage-tax liability under the approved model contracts, whether this is unfair competition, whether temporary measures for escrow (g-rekening) accounts will be taken, and what the Tax Authority thinks of model contracts allowing recovery of insurance premiums from contractors. The State Secretary replies that clients following approved model contracts are protected from back-tax assessments, that no interim escrow measures are planned while the g-rekening review continues, and that recovery of wage tax and national insurance contributions from workers is lawful while recovery of employer-borne premiums is void.

As long as clients and self-employed contractors comply with the model contract they use, the client is in fact protected from back-tax assessments and from liability claims under the fiscal joint-employer liability rule.

Indien en zo lang opdrachtgevers en zzp’ers de door hen gebruikte modelovereenkomst naleven is de opdrachtgever dus feitelijk gevrijwaard van naheffingsaanslagen en ook van aansprakelijkstellingen op grond van de fiscale inlenersaansprakelijkheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de fiscale behandeling van zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the ministry, UWV and Belastingdienst apply rules on freelancers (zzp-ers) to avoid employment relationships, including use of the g-rekening payment account via brokers and whether freelancers should be allowed to use it. The State Secretary answered that these bodies must ensure no employment relationship exists, that they do not use g-rekeningen in their own hiring, that deblocking does not prevent later recovery of levies, and that extending the g-rekening to freelancers is being considered pending a modernisation study.
The Ministry of Finance, the Belastingdienst and the UWV must, like other clients, ensure in their processes that there is in fact no employment relationship when hiring zzp-ers.

Het Ministerie van Financiën, de Belastingdienst en het UWV moeten, net als andere opdrachtgevers, in hun processen borgen dat er ook feitelijk geen sprake is van een dienstbetrekking bij de inhuur van zzp’ers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de fiscale behandeling van zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers)

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority and UWV have ensured that DBA-based contracts with self-employed workers (zzp-ers) prevent any employment relationship, and asks about the use and sanctions of the g-rekening for chain and user liability. The state secretary answers that measures are in place but individual employment relationships cannot be ruled out, that using the g-rekening to hold back part of invoice sums is not misuse, and that misuse can lead to termination of the account agreement, civil action or criminal prosecution.
However, it cannot be ruled out that in individual cases there is nevertheless an employment relationship.
Het is echter niet uit te sluiten dat er in individuele gevallen toch sprake is van een dienstbetrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Natuurlijk mislukt het inburgeringsbeleid, dat hadden we kunnen weten’

An MP asked whether the Wet inburgering 2013 rested on untested assumptions and whether its design reflected budget cuts rather than expected results. The minister rejected the claim that the assumptions were doubtful, said the law partly implemented a budget cut, and noted that participation effects can only be assessed around end-2017.
I do not share the conclusion of the research that the tenability of the assumptions behind the Wet inburgering 2013 were already questionable in advance.
Ik deel de conclusie van het onderzoek niet dat de houdbaarheid van de aannames achter de Wet inburgering 2013 al op voorhand discutabel zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Marjo maakt foutje, dag €17.000 spaargeld’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks should check payee names against account numbers to prevent misdirected transfers, and whether reissuing closed account numbers should be avoided. The minister answers that the current procedure recovers over 80% of misdirected payments, that name-number checks are complex, costly and error-prone, and that the Betaalvereniging is mapping the problem, while leaving banks responsible for implementing any risk measures.

I trust that once the results of the research into the nature and numbers of misdirected transfers are known, the Consumer Association and the Dutch Payments Association will consider how customers can be better assisted in preventing and recovering such transfers.

Ik vertrouw erop dat als de resultaten van het onderzoek naar de aard en aantallen van verkeerde overboekingen bekend zijn, de Consumentenbond en de Betaalvereniging zullen bezien hoe klanten beter kunnen worden bijgestaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over een mogelijk referendum aangaande TTIP

MP Klein asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a website calling for a referendum on the EU trade deals with the US (TTIP) and Canada (CETA), disputing claims of secret negotiations, lack of democratic control, regulatory cooperation, investor arbitration and the referendum's availability. The Minister answered that negotiations carry normal confidentiality but documents are published and parliamentarians have reading-room access, that parliament is involved through debates and motions, that investment protections preserve state policy space, and that CETA and TTIP would be referendable if handled as mixed agreements, with the timing left open.
In addition, Dutch and European parliamentarians have access to all EU negotiating documents, most of which are now also public, and to all consolidated negotiating texts in the reading rooms.

Daarnaast hebben Nederlandse en Europese parlementariërs toegang tot alle EU-onderhandelingsdocumenten, waarvan de meeste inmiddels ook voor het publiek openbaar zijn, en tot alle geconsolideerde onderhandelingsteksten in de leesruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de berichtgeving in verschillende media inzake de veiligheid van persoonsgegevens bij gemeenten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about media reports on personal data security at municipalities, including a data leak in Amersfoort and an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens report on consent in social domain. The minister answers that the Amersfoort incident was a human error handled openly, disputes that the report shows a general problem, and points to existing guidance and support for municipalities.
The Amersfoort incident was due to human error, not to a fault in the technology or procedures.
Het incident in Amersfoort berustte op een menselijke fout, niet op een fout in de techniek of procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de criteria gezag, arbeid en loon

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the criteria of authority, labour and pay used to assess freelance work, including past inspection options, the 80% figure, clarity of the authority criterion, payroll and intermediary relations, and opting-in. The State Secretary answers that the criteria come from the Civil Code and are sufficiently clear, that model agreements give certainty, and that the authority test is applied to the actual contractual terms, while committing to no new action.
The three criteria of authority, labour and pay come from the Civil Code.
De drie criteria gezag, arbeid en loon komen uit het Burgerlijk Wetboek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat een onderzoek van het SCP en de Universiteit Utrecht aantoont dat het kabinetsbeleid aangaande zorg contrair is aan de voorkeur van de meerderheid van de Nederlan

An MP asks whether a study showing the cabinet's care policy diverges from majority public preferences means those views obstruct policy, and whether the policy should change. The state secretary replies that citizens' views on care are diverse, that parents are not obliged to use formal childcare, and that the government does not see public opinion as obstructing its care policy, pointing to ongoing mantelzorg measures and an SER advisory request due in September 2016.
The cabinet does not believe that parents' views on childcare stand in the way of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de opvattingen van ouders rondom kinderopvang het kabinetsbeleid in de weg zit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht  ‘We hebben helemaal geen pensioenprobleem’

An MP asked the state secretary whether pension funds receive more premiums than they pay out, whether using long-term returns instead of the risk-free rate would solve pension problems, and whether guaranteed pensions should be abolished as an illusion. The state secretary answered that funds take in more premiums than they pay out, rejected using expected long-term returns as the discount rate, defended buffers, and deferred the question of abolishing guaranteed pensions to a forthcoming debate.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of that, because we will be discussing them in your House soon.
Op de uitkomsten daarvan wil ik niet vooruitlopen, want we gaan daar binnenkort in uw Kamer over spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Streekbus met 185 geflitst, verkeersagenten Oost-Nederland twijfelen aan apparatuur”

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that mobile speed cameras record implausible speeds (e.g., a bus clocked at 185 km/h) and whether citizens wrongly fined can easily object and how future errors will be prevented. The Minister replies that errors arise only in specific reflection situations, that the system is NMi-certified and reliable, that officers can filter faulty images, that wrongly issued fines can be dismissed via the police, and that software upgrades and reminders to officers are underway.
When two large vehicles, such as buses and lorries, pass each other in opposite directions and are in the radar beam at exactly the same moment, the measurement can deviate due to reflection.

Wanneer twee grote voertuigen, zoals bussen en vrachtwagens elkaar in tegengestelde richting passeren en zich op precies hetzelfde moment in de radarbundel bevinden, kan de meting afwijken als gevolg van reflectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel “Wie houdt gemeenten in toom”

MP Klein asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about municipalities raising property tax (OZB) and precario levies to fill budget gaps, linked to decentralised social-domain tasks with a 25% budget cut, and the burden on non-resident business owners. The Minister replied that municipal budgets are sufficient, that local councils decide tax rates, and that a bill abolishing precario on utility networks will be sent to parliament this spring with a ten-year transition.
The bill provides for abolition, but gives municipalities a further ten years to charge at most the rate in force in their municipality on 1 January 2016.
Het wetsvoorstel gaat uit van afschaffing, maar biedt gemeenten nog tien jaar de mogelijkheid om maximaal het op 1 januari 2016 in hun gemeente geldende tarief te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de berichtgeving rondom de te verwachte toekomstige tekorten van het schildkliergeneesmiddel Thyrax

An MP asked the health minister about expected shortages of the thyroid medicine Thyrax, the manufacturer's delayed notice, and whether the state can compel producers to keep medicines available. The minister answered that producers are legally obliged to keep supply adequate and notify discontinuations, that the IGZ is investigating the Thyrax case including possible breach of the Medicines Act, and that she will intensify the shortage working group.
The marketing authorisation holder did not comply with the period specified in the Medicines Act.
De handelsvergunninghouder heeft zich niet aan de in de Geneesmiddelwet gespecificeerde termijn gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over naar aanleiding van reactie aan de Eerste Kamer, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, 34 036, F

MP Klein asked the State Secretary of Finance, following up on a letter to the Senate, how many self-employed workers (zzp'ers) the Tax Administration, Finance Ministry and UWV hire, whether they may be replaced, and how this fits EU procurement and employment-relationship rules. The State Secretary answered that the ministries and UWV hire 111, 21 and 119 zzp'ers directly, that third-party hires cannot be tracked, that substitution is allowed only exceptionally with consent, and that the Wet DBA will require them to verify the absence of an employment relationship.
The Tax Administration and the Ministry of Finance do not have data on the number of zzp'ers hired through third parties.
De Belastingdienst en het Ministerie van Financiën beschikken niet over gegevens omtrent aantallen zzp'ers die via derden worden ingehuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat de Nationale Ombudsman te kennen heeft gegeven dat zijns inziens burgers, die hun boetes niet kunnen betalen omdat ze te krap bij kas zitten, onterecht van hun vr

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the National Ombudsman's view that people unable to pay fines due to lack of money are wrongly deprived of liberty through detention (gijzeling), and whether this should be addressed earlier through personal payment or debt-relief arrangements. The State Secretary agrees detention should not be used against people genuinely unable to pay, says fines must still be paid, points to a separate letter on the Ombudsman's report and to measures already taken, and says the cost of detention cannot be unambiguously stated.
Detention must, however, be targeted at persuading persons to pay where they can pay a fine but do not want to.
Gijzeling moet echter gericht worden ingezet om personen tot betaling te bewegen indien zij een boete wel kunnen betalen, maar dit niet willen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht van Techzine van 2 december

MP Klein asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Techzine report that UWV may have leaked personal data via MijnUWV, and how this happened. The minister answered that 20 reports of clients seeing others' data on werk.nl were received, caused by a firewall software fault, now fixed with an interim replacement and an update under testing, and that no client damage is known.
UWV took action immediately after the first report, contacted the reporter, and together with the suppliers started an investigation into the cause of the problem.
UWV heeft meteen na de eerste melding actie ondernomen, heeft contact opgenomen met de melder en heeft in samenwerking met de leveranciers het onderzoek gestart naar de oorzaak van het probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat een hoger loon voor leraren in de Randstad niet helpt om leraren voor het onderwijs te behouden

An MP asked the Education Minister about a report that higher pay for teachers in the Randstad does not help retain them, and why 7 percent still leave. The state secretary replied that the CPB found no retention effect from the salary scale policy in secondary education, though slightly more teachers stayed in the Randstad and in-service training rose, and outlined measures such as teaching bursaries and HRM support to address shortages.
The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) found no effect that strengthening the salary scale mix kept more teachers in secondary education.
Het Centraal Plan Bureau (CPB) heeft geen effect gevonden dat door de versterking van de functiemix er meer leraren behouden blijven in het voorgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake de bevestiging van de VARA dat gasten in het tv-programma Pauw betaald worden voor hun bijdrage

An MP asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster VARA confirmed that guests on the talk show Pauw are paid, and whether this affects transparency and journalistic integrity. The state secretary said fees are a matter for broadcasters and must not compromise independence, and promised to urge the NPO to issue internal guidelines and to report on a motion for transparency of genre-level costs by spring 2016.
The NPO does not currently have that information because it is the responsibility of individual broadcasters.
De NPO beschikt nu niet over die informatie omdat dat de verantwoordelijkheid is van individuele omroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid klein over het RLI-Rapport “Rijk zonder CO2: naar een duurzame energievoorziening in 2050”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the RLi report on a fully sustainable energy supply in 2050 focused only on CO2 and whether the RLi would receive an additional assignment covering other emissions and renewables. The minister replied that the RLi's definition of a sustainable supply covers CO2-equivalents including methane and that no additional assignment is needed, promising the Energy Report at year-end and an Energy Dialogue starting in 2016.
I therefore do not consider an additional assignment for the RLI to be opportune.
Ik vind een aanvullende opdracht voor de RLI dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de aanpassingen voor het woningwaarderingsstelsel

An MP asked the Minister for Housing about the 2015 change in the rent-valuation system replacing the 'serviceflatwoning' category with 'zorgwoning', including why conditions were changed, consultation, choice, stigma and rent effects. The minister answered that the change aligns rules with current practice, followed consultation with stakeholders, and does not affect tenant choice or permit rent increases beyond existing legal limits.
Replacing the term 'serviceflatwoning' with 'zorgwoning' does not lead to the possibility of a rent increase.
Het vervangen van het begrip «serviceflatwoning» door het begrip «zorgwoning» leidt niet tot de mogelijkheid van een huurverhoging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Schippers: hogere kiesdrempel om kleine partijen uit Kamer te weren’

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a remark by Minister Schippers about making it harder for small parties to enter parliament, and a possible 5% electoral threshold, reflected cabinet policy and how it would affect democracy and coalition formation. The minister replied that there is no cabinet policy on this, the cabinet has no plans to introduce a threshold, and he answered no to whether decision-making without opposition matters more than democratic faction formation.
There is no question of cabinet policy, as Minister Schippers herself also indicates in the interview.
Van kabinetsbeleid is, zoals Minister Schippers zelf ook aangeeft in het interview, geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het stimuleren om aan het werk te gaan door werken vanuit de WW lonend maken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployed people should be encouraged to work by making work pay from WW benefits, why the new income offset applies only to new WW claimants from 1 July 2015 rather than existing ones, and whether similar offsets should apply to other benefits. The minister answered yes to the principle, said existing WW rights are respected for technical implementation reasons with one exception for overlapping benefits, and promised to inform parliament after the summer on other benefits.
Your House will be further informed about this topic after the summer.
Uw Kamer wordt na de zomer over dit onderwerp nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Lerato wordt gek van brieven Belastingdienst”

An MP asked whether the Tax Authority would commission an independent investigation into its complaint handling after repeated erroneous letters to a child, and how it compensates damages including forced house sale and non-material harm. The State Secretary declined an independent inquiry, citing the volume of errors, said complaint coordinators exist and apologies were made, and explained that compensation requires unlawful conduct and is assessed case by case, with non-material damage limited to specific grounds.
An independent investigation into such errors will not change that.
Een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar dergelijke fouten zal daar geen verandering in brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het beleid van het Agentschap Telecom ten aanzien van de regelgeving rondom regiogerichtheid van radiozenders (

MP Klein asks the minister how the government will implement a Rotterdam court ruling on regional programming requirements for commercial radio and whether frequency scarcity still exists. The minister contests the court's finding on digital DAB+ reach, announces an appeal on that aspect, says enforcement rests with the Agentschap Telecom and points to forthcoming policy letters on commercial radio frequencies and medium wave.
In this procedure I am the defendant.
In deze procedure ben ik verweerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein inzake het artikel "Subsidie? We helpen je graag verder", over de gang van zaken rond subsidieverstrekking aan de Gay Krant

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether ministry officials rewriting subsidy applications for the Gay Krant was lawful and how many such cases occur each year. The Minister answered that technical assistance on incomplete applications is lawful under the Awb, that rewriting applications is not an official's task, and that the ministry does not record how each application was handled.
Rewriting a subsidy application is not among the tasks of an official.
Het (her)schrijven van een subsidieaanvraag behoort niet tot de taken van een ambtenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht over een Huissens gezin dat het huis moest verkopen door fouten van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a family in Huissen had to sell their home due to Tax Authority errors, whether the Tax Authority admitted its mistake, and why compensation is not offered proactively. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case citing tax confidentiality, said compensation depends on circumstances and is handled via a published claims scheme with decisions within eight weeks, and rejected proactive offers.
The tax confidentiality obligation prevents me from addressing this individual case.
De fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht belet mij om in te gaan op dit individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de waterrekening

MP Klein asked the Minister of Interior about high precarious levies (precarioheffing) on water and energy bills, the government's view on their fairness, and why the promised bill abolishing precario on utility networks has been repeatedly delayed. The minister answered that levies vary by municipality, water companies pass them on only to residents of the levying authority, energy network costs are spread nationally, and that the government intends to inform the House soon, while weighing competing interests and noting that abolition without compensation is undesirable.
Of course I intend to inform your House about this subject as soon as possible, in which I take all interests into account as far as possible.
Uiteraard ben ik voornemens uw Kamer over dit onderwerp zo spoedig mogelijk nader te informeren, waarin ik zoveel mogelijk met alle belangen rekening houd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de uitspraak van de AFM dat zzp’ers verplicht aan pensioensparen moeten doen

MP Klein asked the State Secretary whether it is premature for the AFM to call for mandatory pension saving for self-employed workers before their voluntary scheme has started, and whether it is appropriate for a supervisor to advise on this. The State Secretary answered that the AFM raised a legitimate question within the National Pension Dialogue, that it only considers mandatory participation if voluntary saving proves insufficient, and that a supervisor's broad view makes its contribution valuable.
I consider this an open and constructive contribution to the National Pension Dialogue.
Ik acht dit een open en constructieve bijdrage aan de Nationale Pensioendialoog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Nibud: koopkracht 2015 minder positief dan loonstrookje”

MP Klein asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Nibud report on lower 2015 purchasing power than shown on payslips warrants a response and policy adjustment. The minister replied that the report adds nothing new, explained that payslips omit inflation and changes in allowances, and said no policy correction is needed though purchasing power will be monitored.
These developments give no reason to adjust policy.
Deze ontwikkelingen geven geen aanleiding voor bijsturing van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over "het artikel ‘de volksvertegenwoordiging gepiepeld"

An MP asks the state secretary whether a Follow the Money column was right that parliament was misinformed about the death-benefit exclusion clause in net pension insurance, and what will be done about disabled workers losing pension accrual. The secretary rejects the claim of misinformation, maintains the net pension is a continuation of the earlier survivors' provision, and says the specific disability group's coverage depends on social partners' agreements and a promised study is underway.
I therefore believe there is no question of 'the parliament being taken for a ride' as stated in the article.
Ik meen derhalve dat geen sprake is van «het piepelen van de volksvertegenwoordiging»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Pensioenpot gemeenten komt half miljard tekort’

An MP asks why the ministry sat on a Deloitte report about the underfunded pension pot for local politicians (Appa) and whether the state and provinces failed to act, and asks about legal compliance and provincial oversight. The minister confirms receipt in April 2013, says the report was withheld pending cabinet decision-making, rejects a standalone fund as unviable, and says provinces are not obliged to reserve for these pensions, while committing to no concrete new action beyond ongoing deliberation.
For this reason, before the WOB request there was no reason to make the results of the study public.
Om deze reden was er voorafgaand aan het WOB-verzoek geen aanleiding de resultaten van het onderzoek kenbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klein en Baay-Timmerman over gewijzigde tarieven van personenalarmering

Two MPs asked why the VAT exemption for personal alarm services was removed, pushing the state to justify the sharp price rise and to bring alarm equipment into the basic health insurance package for frail elderly. The State Secretary explained the VAT change as a competition measure, said the price rise can only partly be explained by VAT, refused to extend basic insurance coverage to elderly people not already eligible, and declined to consult insurers.
Based on the attached document, it is unclear to me what the underlying causes are of the rise in the tariff apart from VAT.
Op basis van bijgevoegd stuk is mij onduidelijk wat de onderliggende oorzaken zijn van de stijging van het tarief los van de btw.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over stijging van de Onroerende Zaak Belasting (OZB) boven de door overheden vastgestelde en aanvaarde ‘Macronorm’, en de gevolgen hiervan voor de individuele burger

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior about OZB property tax increases exceeding the agreed macro-norm, the COELO findings on the sanction mechanism, and protection for individual homeowners. The Minister confirmed the 2014 overshoot, said municipal tariffs are an autonomous council decision, and deferred substantive answers on the norm and sanctions to an ongoing evaluation discussed with the VNG.
The analysis of the 2014 macro-norm overshoot will be discussed with the VNG in the administrative consultation on financial relations (BOFv) on 19 May.
De (analyse van de) overschrijding van de macronorm 2014 wordt besproken met de VNG in het bestuurlijk overleg financiële verhoudingen (BOFv), dat op 19 mei plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de ernstige gevolgen van de in 2013 doorgevoerde accijnsverhoging op alcoholhoudende dranken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the alleged severe effects of the 2013 excise increase on alcoholic drinks, including falling sales, lost VAT, job losses and bankruptcies. The State Secretary answered that data are only available in the Financieel Jaarverslag, that no direct link can be drawn between excise and VAT or employment, that bankruptcy data are unavailable, and that the excise rise was needed for the budget agreement.
Contact with Statistics Netherlands revealed that an overview of bankruptcies in the drinks sector is not available.
Uit contact met het CBS is gebleken dat een overzicht van faillissementen in de drankensector niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het opmerkelijke aantal ‘spookstemmen’ uitgebracht bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

MP Klein (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior about the large gaps between counted ballots and counted voters in the 2014 municipal elections, which could affect final results. Minister Plasterk answered that the gaps stem from many causes including counting and procedural errors, that the ministry evaluates each election, that a recount is possible only in limited circumstances, and that voting machines would not fully remove the problem.
For the municipal council and European Parliament elections, my ministry has made a new instruction available to the municipalities.
Voor de verkiezing van de gemeenteraden en het Europees Parlement is door mijn ministerie een nieuwe instructie aan de gemeenten beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over uitsluiting van autoverzekering op grond van leeftijd

An MP asked the government about insurers refusing car insurance to older drivers on age grounds, whether this is age discrimination, what is being done about insurers' poor communication, the status of the EU equal treatment directive, and whether national anti-discrimination law will be introduced. The minister answered that age criteria may be justified by risk, that the AFM will watch insurers' information duties, that the EU directive negotiations are stalled, and that no national legislation is planned.
Unjustified distinction, on whatever ground, is not acceptable.
Ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid, op welke grond dan ook, is niet acceptabel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klein en Baay-Timmerman over de artikelen “Stichting verrijkt zich ten koste van bewoners serviceflats” en “Oud CDA-politicus verrijkt zich ten koste van bewoners seniorenflats”

MPs Klein and Baay-Timmerman asked the minister about press reports that a service-flat management foundation (SDS) cut services while charging high prices, had conflicted managers, and pressured residents into selling homes below cost. The minister answered that service flats are a market initiative governed by general rules, residents may go to court, and existing branch certification is sufficient, so no new measures are planned.
Ultimately it is up to the judiciary to pass judgment and not for me to comment on the substance.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechterlijke macht om een oordeel te vellen en niet aan mij om hier inhoudelijk op in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Klein over het bericht “School doet er alles aan om van oudere leraar af te raken”

MPs Mohandis and Klein asked the Minister of Education whether schools push older teachers out for financial reasons and whether the government will protect older teachers and their competence. The Minister rejects the claim that older teachers are disproportionately dismissed, points to UWV unemployment inflow figures, and says personnel policy and cao rules are the responsibility of schools and cao parties, promising only a new senior scheme to be elaborated at the cao table.
Conducting good personnel policy is the responsibility of the schools themselves.
Het voeren van een goed personeelsbeleid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Aantal laaggeletterden stijgt snel’

MP Klein (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Education about a report that functional illiteracy is rising fast among older adults, and whether targeted action, funding and links to unemployment and poverty are planned. The Minister said the policy covers all age groups, pointed to the Action Plan, Taal voor het Leven pilots and existing funding, and said decisions on targeting older adults would await evaluations, without committing to a specific older-adult measure.
Beyond these activities, I am not undertaking any additional action aimed specifically at the older age group.
Naast deze activiteiten onderneem ik geen extra actie gericht op de groep ouderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Klein over de schenkingsvrijstelling en boeterente

MPs Omtzigt and Klein asked the government whether banks would waive early-repayment penalties when mortgages are repaid with gifts under the temporarily expanded gift-tax exemption, and whether ABN AMRO's conditions contradict earlier letters to parliament. The Minister replied that banks have implemented the call differently (ABN AMRO and ING for underwater mortgages, Rabobank and SNS for gifts up to 100,000 euro), that penalty waiver is a bank decision, and that he would answer the remaining questions before the vote on the Tax Plan.
Providers have therefore given different interpretations to the cabinet's call.
Aanbieders hebben derhalve op een verschillende manier invulling gegeven aan de oproep van het kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Krol en Klein over het ontbreken van bereidheid bij banken om boeterente  bij vervroegde aflossing van hypotheken te laten vervallen

MPs Krol and Klein asked the Finance Minister whether banks should drop early-repayment penalty interest on mortgages, given negative equity and the expanded gift-tax exemption. The minister answered that the penalty is a legitimate compensation for lost interest, that some banks (SNS, ABN AMRO) are considering waiving it when the exemption is used, and that he has asked banks to do so.
As is known, I have asked the banks to waive the penalty interest when use is made of the expanded gift exemption.
Zoals bekend heb ik de banken gevraagd de boeterentes te laten vervallen indien gebruik wordt gemaakt van de verruimde schenkingsvrijstelling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klein over het aantal verkeersdoden in 2012

An MP from 50PLUS asked the minister what is being done to reduce road deaths among people aged 65 and over, including via consultation with senior organisations, electric bicycle and scooter accidents, and vehicle safety rules. The minister pointed to the existing 23-measure programme, the Blijf Veilig Mobiel partnership, ongoing research by VeiligheidNL and SWOV, and EuroNCAP-driven vehicle safety, while declining to change the vehicle regulation for now.
Amending the Vehicle Regulation is not yet on the agenda.
Aanpassen van de Regeling Voertuigen is nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen Klein over het bericht “Pensioen onzekerder voor werknemers in de zorg”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about press reports that pensions for care workers are becoming less secure under a planned switch by PFZW to a new pension contract, and how accrued rights would be protected. The state secretary answered that the new contract resembles the Pensioenakkoord model, that a trial on transferring accrued rights (invaren) will start in 2013 with safeguards to be included in a Pensioenwet amendment, and that he was unaware of the fund's proposal put to social partners, while suggesting the reporting was one-sided.
The experiment will yield information on how careful decision-making on transferring accrued rights and a careful transfer procedure can be ensured.
Het experiment levert informatie op over de wijze waarop een zorgvuldige besluitvorming over invaren en een zorgvuldige invaarprocedure kan worden geborgd.

m: Motie van de leden Eijsink en Berckmoes-Duindam over het zo veel mogelijk compenseren van negatieve inkomenseffecten
Motion asks the government to compensate military personnel as far as possible for negative income effects of the Wul tax change.
requests the government, taking into account the negative income effect of introducing the Wul, to compensate as much as possible
verzoekt de regering, hiermee rekening houdend het negatieve inkomenseffect als gevolg van de invoering van de Wul zo veel mogelijk te compenseren
Motie Van Hijum/Berckmoes-Duindam over de werkgroep Onderwijs en Kinderopvang
Asks the government to make the Werkgroep Onderwijs en Kinderopvang part of the Landelijk Steunpunt Brede Scholen as a single contact point for school-childcare cooperation, within existing funds.
requests the government to make the expertise and knowledge of the WOK part of the Landelijk Steunpunt Brede Scholen, within existing funds
verzoekt de regering om de expertise en kennis van de WOK onderdeel te laten worden van het Landelijk Steunpunt Brede Scholen, binnen de bestaande middelen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht Amsterdam wil versneld duizend extra huizen voor daklozen

An MP asked the state secretary about Amsterdam's plan to accelerate 1,000 extra homes for homeless people, the current homeless numbers, what other municipalities are doing, and the latest intergovernmental consultation on long-term independent living. The state secretary answered that the latest national data are from 2013 (about 16,900 homeless in 39 municipalities), that a quick scan and further data are coming, that municipalities and housing corporations are responsible for local housing agreements, and that a follow-up study on exit flows from shelters is being arranged.
There is no national data on homelessness available for 2014 and 2015.
Er zijn geen landelijke gegevens over dak- en thuisloosheid beschikbaar voor 2014 en 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het Berckmoes-Duindam over het artikel ‘Amsterdamse Kinderombudsman signaleert problemen bij uithuisplaatsingen’

The MP asked the state secretary about children separated from parents in care due to shortages of family shelter places, the numbers involved, and municipal measures to prevent family homelessness. The state secretary said such separation is not centrally registered, that municipalities are responsible for alternatives, and pointed to existing municipal practices and a forthcoming Trimbos study without committing to new measures.
It is not known how many children are separated from their parents due to a shortage of family shelter places, because this data is not centrally registered.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderen worden gescheiden van hun ouders door een tekort aan opvangplaatsen voor gezinnen, omdat dit gegeven niet centraal wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht ‘Stichting wil betere hulp aan daklozen Amersfoort bieden’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about a news report on a foundation wanting better help for homeless people in Amersfoort, including the share and flow of 'new homeless', the priority of fast move-out from shelters, and person-tailored guidance. The State Secretary says data on underlying problems are not registered everywhere, points to housing corporations' role and the Wmo 2015 duty of individual investigation, and leaves implementation to municipalities.
No. The underlying problems of people using the social shelter are not registered everywhere.
Nee. De achterliggende problematiek van personen die gebruik maken van de maatschappelijke opvang wordt niet overal geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over de steekpartij bij een opvanglocatie voor maatschappelijke opvang in Eindhoven

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a stabbing at a shelter in Eindhoven, how often violence against shelter staff occurs, and whether staff and client safety is adequately guaranteed. The answer says no figures exist on total violent incidents, states that responsibility for safety lies with the shelter institutions, and describes past inspections and the planned Inspectorate SZW checks from November 2014 to February 2015.
No figures are available on the total number of violent incidents against staff in the social shelter sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het totaal aantal gewelddadige incidenten tegen personeel in de maatschappelijke opvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over resolutie van Parlementaire Assemblee van de OVSE over water en veiligheid

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knows the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly resolution making water management and security a 2014 OSCE priority, whether he supports that focus, and whether he will press for it at the OSCE ministerial. The minister confirmed awareness, outlined Dutch water diplomacy efforts, and said he will raise water management with the Swiss counterpart before the December ministerial.
I intend to discuss water management with my Swiss counterpart already before the OSCE Ministerial Council in December.
Ik ben voornemens om reeds voorafgaande aan de Ministeriële Raad van de OVSE in december watermanagement te bespreken met mijn Zwitserse collega.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het bericht “Reservisten NATRES laten zich de vrijwilligersmedaille niet afpakken”

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the Openbare Orde en Veiligheid volunteer medal is being abolished for NATRES reservists, whether this removes their eligibility, and what the reasons are. The minister replied that the medal is not abolished but will no longer be awarded to NATRES reservists from 1 January 2014, because it overlaps with existing service decorations and Defence does not decorate twice for the same act, and that the ministry is examining extending krijgsmachtdeelmedailles to reservists.
For these reasons I have decided that from 1 January 2014 the Volunteer Medal will no longer be awarded to NATRES reservists.
Ik heb om die redenen besloten de Vrijwilligersmedaille vanaf 1 januari 2014 niet meer toe te kennen aan reservisten van de NATRES.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over het artikel “Defensie wisselt technici duur in”

An MP asked the Defence minister about reports that the armed forces will cut about 1,100 technical posts in the Royal Army and whether a EUR 10,000 recruitment premium for technicians is wise instead of filling vacancies internally. The minister said the reorganisation is not yet final so the number of technical staff leaving is unknown, that EUR 1.1 million is budgeted for 550 technicians per year, and that external recruitment is needed because too few technicians of the required rank are available internally.
It is therefore not yet known how many technically trained staff the defence organisation will have to leave.
Het is nog dus nog niet bekend hoeveel technisch geschoolde medewerkers de defensieorganisatie zullen moeten verlaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over inspecties van de GGD van kinderopvangcentra en peuterspeelzalen

An MP asked the minister whether the costs of GGD inspections and re-inspections of childcare centres, playgroups and host parents are publicly funded, how many re-inspections occur, what they cost, and whether providers could pay or fines could be raised. The minister explained that inspection costs are funded via a structural Rijk payment to the municipal fund (about EUR 29.4 million per year), gave 2010 re-inspection counts for daycare and out-of-school care, and said he will examine charging offenders and higher fines as part of research into municipal enforcement effectiveness.

The suggestions to have the offending entrepreneur pay the costs of re-inspections themselves, as well as applying higher fines to organisations that repeatedly violate the law, I will examine further.

De suggesties om de kosten van de herinspecties door de overtredende ondernemer zelf te laten betalen, evenals het hanteren van hogere boetes voor organisaties die herhaaldelijk de wet niet naleven, zal ik nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over waarborging van de veiligheid van kinderen in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the minister whether he knew of childcare staff behaving inappropriately without criminal conviction, whether such people should be allowed to work with children again, and what steps he would take. The minister acknowledged such situations occur, pointed to employer screening, and announced continuous criminal-record screening and a statutory reporting duty for abuse, while saying primary responsibility for non-criminal conduct lies with private providers and the sector.

Therefore I will introduce a form of screening under which it is continuously checked whether a new, relevant criminal offence has been recorded in the Judicial Documentation System under the name of a staff member in childcare or playgroup work.

Daarom zal ik een vorm van screening introduceren waarbij continue wordt bekeken of op de naam van een medewerker in de kinderopvang of in het peuterspeelzaalwerk een nieuw, relevant strafbaar feit in het Justitiële Documentatie systeem is bijgeschreven.

Vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam (VVD) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over onnodige bureaucratie omtrent het in- en uitschrijven van gastouders in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (ingezonden

An MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about the burden on childminders who must deregister from the national childcare register when they temporarily stop caring for children, with municipalities issuing fines. The minister agreed the rule is burdensome for temporary breaks and said a new regulation effective 1 January 2012 will let childminders stay registered during temporary interruptions such as pregnancy or illness.

In the new Decree on Childcare and Playgroup Registers, effective 1 January 2012, it will be arranged that a childminder's registration in the National Childcare Register can be maintained during a temporary interruption of actual care.

In het nieuwe Besluit registers Kinderopvang en Peuterspeelzalen, dat per 1 januari 2012 in werking treedt, wordt geregeld dat de inschrijving van de gastouder in het Landelijk Register Kinderopvang gehandhaafd kan blijven in geval van een tijdelijke onderbreking van de daadwerkelijke opvang.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 45 over het uitstellen van de inwerkingtreding van de multiplier lucratief belang tot 2028
Postpones the entry into force of the box 2 multiplier for substantial interests to 1 January 2028, financed by a small increase in the AOF premium.
article I, part C, under 1, enters into force on 1 January 2028
treedt artikel I, onderdeel C, onder 1, met ingang van 1 januari 2028 in werking
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 72 over het met een jaar uitstellen van de pseudo-eindheffing
Delays by one year the introduction of the pseudo-excise duty on company fossil-fuel cars and the transitional rules, to allow an SME test and advice.
The submitter therefore calls for a one-year postponement of the measure
Indiener pleit daarom tot een jaar uitstel van de maatregel
Amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk over het met een jaar uitstellen van de pseudo-eindheffing
Postpones by one year the pseudo-eindheffing on fossil company cars and the related transitional rules, to allow an SME test and an ATR advice.
The submitter therefore argues for a one-year postponement of the measure, so that an SME test and an ATR advice can still take place.
Indiener pleit daarom tot een jaar uitstel van de maatregel, zodat alsnog een MKB-toets en ATR-advies kunnen plaatsvinden.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies betreffende invoering van een pseudo-eindheffing voor fossiele leaseauto's
Asks the government to carry out an SME test and a regulatory burden advisory (ATR) opinion on the pseudo-excise tax for fossil lease cars, and to monitor and report to the Chamber regularly.
requests the government to still carry out an SME test and an ATR advice for this measure
verzoekt de regering alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies plaats te laten vinden bij deze maatregel
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Asks the government to give high priority to enabling full digital objection procedures within the Wmebv implementation, and to report on progress in the Voorjaarsnota.
requests the government to give high priority to the digital objection phase within the further implementation of the Wmebv
verzoekt de regering om binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit te geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over krachtig inzetten op een gelijk speelveld en behoud van de concurrentiekracht van het Europese en Nederlandse bedrijfsleven
Asks the government to push in international negotiations for a level playing field and lower administrative burden on the Pillar 2 global minimum tax, with safe harbours and room for tax facilities.
requests the government to press in international negotiations for a level playing field and preservation of competitiveness of European and Dutch business
verzoekt de regering in de internationale onderhandelingen krachtig in te zetten op: – een gelijk speelveld en behoud van de concurrentiekracht van het Europese en Nederlandse bedrijfsleven
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over een voorstel voor het inpassen van de structurele indexering van de schijfgrens binnen het budget van de Wbso
Asks the cabinet to propose, in the Belastingplan 2027, how the Wbso schijfgrens can be indexed every year within the existing Wbso budget.
requests the government to jointly from the ministries of EZK and Finance make a proposal in the Belastingplan 2027
verzoekt de regering om gezamenlijk vanuit de ministeries van EZK en Financiën bij het Belastingplan 2027 een voorstel te doen
Amendement van de leden Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over eenmalige indexatie van de schijfgrens van de WBSO

I do not see a role for me to have a judgment on this.
Ik zie voor mij hier geen rol om hier een oordeel over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuurders van sportclubs afhaken

MPs asked whether the government shares concerns that board members of sports clubs are withdrawing due to regulatory burden and the Wbtr's director-liability risks, and whether proposals and timelines will follow. The government answered that it is running a regulatory-burden review and a Significant Public study on whether volunteer insurance covers liability risks, with results expected before summer recess, and that the Wbtr evaluation (due before 1 July 2026) will examine unintended effects on volunteer liability.
The expectation is that the outcomes of this study will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Het is de verwachting dat de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek voor het zomerreces naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'IMF maakt in analyse gehakt van Nederland koopkrachtfetisjisme'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees with the IMF that Dutch policy should shift from purchasing-power support toward investment, and asked about long-term growth, capacity bottlenecks, and follow-up on a motion on high-leverage investments. The minister answered that the cabinet supports structural investment, will assess purchasing-power measures in August, points to existing long-term policy in the Miljoenennota, and committed to address the motion in the Miljoenennota 2026.
The caretaker cabinet endorses the importance of structural investments in the Dutch economy.
Het demissionaire kabinet onderschrijft het belang van structurele investeringen in de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het bericht 'Werkgevers lokken jonge werknemer met studieschuldregeling' in het FD van 11 mei 2025

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked whether tax-advantaged employer repayment of student debt should be broadened, given high debts and write-offs of residual debt. The Staatssecretaris answered that the existing workplace expenses scheme and free allowance already allow it, that a specific exemption does not fit the scheme's purpose, and that budgetary effects of broadening it would need to be financed and are being evaluated.
The ongoing evaluation of the workplace expenses scheme will also consider whether employers should be fiscally incentivised to let employees repay student debt at favourable terms.

Bij de op dit moment lopende evaluatie van de werkkostenregeling wordt ook meegenomen of werkgevers fiscaal gestimuleerd moeten worden voor het voordelig laten aflossen van studieschulden door werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Lokale wielrenners balen van afgelast NK wielrennen”

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether sports events, including the NK wielrennen, are being cancelled due to police capacity shortages linked to the NATO summit, and about police deployment data and protocols for small events. The minister answered that local authorities decide on event permits, no national figures are kept, and no protocol is planned, while pointing to burgermotorverkeersregelaars as an alternative.
There is no overview of the number of sports events that cannot proceed due to a lack of police capacity.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal sportevenementen dat niet kan doorgaan wegens een gebrek aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 31 maart 2025 en dan specifiek het onderwerp 'Senioren geweigerd voor tijdelijke lening ondanks overwaarde'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the Ministers of Finance and Housing about a Radar broadcast reporting that seniors with home equity were refused bridging mortgages. Minister Keijzer (Housing) said such refusals are undesirable, that she will consult ouderenorganisaties, banks, NVB and supervisors, and will raise bridging credit in the monitoring of the Convenant Ouderen & Toekomstbestendig Wonen.
Therefore I want to consult stakeholders to find out why seniors have difficulty obtaining a bridging mortgage.
Daarom wil ik in gesprek met stakeholders achterhalen waarom senioren moeilijk een overbruggingshypotheek kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de uitsluiting van het Afghaanse vrouwen voetbalelftal van de kwalificatie voor het WK door de Taliban

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would press FIFA to recognise and finance the Afghan women's football team excluded by the Taliban from World Cup qualifiers, and how it viewed the erosion of women's rights in Afghanistan. The government condemned the systematic repression of Afghan women, said it would not interfere in FIFA's decision-making, and noted that the timing of FIFA's plan for Afghan players was unknown.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the decision-making or policy of FIFA.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de besluitvorming of het beleid van de FIFA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over pensioenfondsen en verzekeraars die bereid zijn geld te steken in de versterking van defensie

Two CDA MPs asked whether pension funds and insurers are willing to invest in defence but are waiting for a plan from The Hague, and why this takes so long. The government answers that Defence is talking with industry and investors, that financing is a shared responsibility, that investment decisions remain with financial institutions, and lists initiatives such as Defport, a financing table and planned measures, without giving a firm timetable.
Ultimately it remains up to banks, insurers, pension funds and other investors themselves to decide to what extent and how they want to invest in the defence industry.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen en andere investeerders zelf om te bepalen in welke mate en op welke wijze zij willen investeren in de defensie-industrie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over het Raad van State-advies ten aanzien van het amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. op het wetsvoorstel voor de verlenging van de transitieperiod

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State's critical advice on the Joseph amendment, which would make non-transfer the default in the pension transition, and its consequences for members, implementation, social partners and courts. The minister answered that the amendment weakens intergenerational solidarity, risks compulsory participation, causes transition delays and legal conflict, conflicts with ILO conventions on collective bargaining, and that he considers it undesirable and will address this in the government's response.
From my administrative responsibility for compliance with the Pension Agreement, orderly legislation and predictability for implementation, I consider this undesirable.
Vanuit mijn bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor de naleving van afspraken uit het Pensioenakkoord, ordentelijke wetgeving en voorspelbaarheid voor de uitvoering acht ik dit niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk, en Haage over het bericht ‘Minister Van Hijum kraakt plan pensioenreferendum van zijn eigen partij: kritisch advies in concept-brief’

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a critical draft advisory note on a pension referendum amendment was real and why supporting documents had not been published. The minister confirmed awareness, said underlying departmental notes will be published with the cabinet response before the plenary debate, and explained that advice is withheld until a ministerial decision is made.
All underlying departmental notes from SZW and Finance used in decision-making will be made public at the same time as the cabinet response.
Alle onderliggende departementale nota's van SZW en van Financiën die zijn gebruikt bij de besluitvorming, zullen tegelijk met de kabinetsreactie openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fouten bij UWV schelen soms honderden euro’s per maand’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a 2021 internal UWV report that reportedly flagged doubts about calculating the reference wage used in WIA disability decisions, which could wrongly reject claims. The minister confirmed the 2021 report, said it was not shared with the ministry until 2024 and was not reported in UWV's annual reports, and promised a follow-up letter with results and remedial steps.
It is important that relevant information, such as errors in the determination of benefits, is detected in time and that my ministry is informed of this in time.
Het is belangrijk dat relevante informatie, zoals fouten in de vaststelling van uitkeringen tijdig worden geconstateerd en dat mijn ministerie hier tijdig over wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fiserv neemt CCV over’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Fiserv's takeover of payments provider CCV and whether CCV is critical payment infrastructure, and whether the US CLOUD Act could force disclosure of Dutch payment data. The minister answered that CCV is one of several retail payment providers, declined to say publicly whether it is critical infrastructure citing confidentiality under the investment screening law, and stated that US CLOUD Act access is possible under strict conditions but considered low risk, pointing to GDPR and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
I cannot make public statements about which institutions belong to the critical or vital infrastructure of the Netherlands, as this is confidential information.
Ik kan geen openbare uitspraken doen over welke instellingen onder de kritieke, dan wel vitale, infrastructuur van Nederland behoren aangezien dit vertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over overbodige regels waardoor vrijwilligers voor carnavalsoptochten dreigen af te haken

An MP asked the State Secretary about excessive rules (APK inspection, registration, insurance) making volunteers building carnival floats drop out, and whether exemptions are possible. The government answered that existing exemptions apply, insurance rules protect third parties, no national data on premiums exists, and it will address the issue within its volunteer regulatory-burden approach.
No national data are available on the development of insurance premiums for carnival floats or on the number of insurers that had to pay out claims.
Er is op landelijk niveau geen data beschikbaar over de ontwikkeling van de hoogte van verzekeringspremies voor carnavalswagens en het aantal verzekeraars dat schade heeft moeten uitkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de combinatie box 3 en Wet betaalbare huur belangrijkste reden om uit te ponden

Two CDA MPs asked whether a survey of 368 property investors showing box 3 tax and the Affordable Rent Act as main reasons for selling rental homes reflects the real drivers, and whether ministries should urgently study the cumulative effects and tighten the box 3 counter-evidence rule. The minister replied that a mix of rent regulation, tax changes and a stronger owner-occupied market drives sales, promised a broader integrated assessment and a later report on middle-segment investment, and deferred the counter-evidence question to a separate state secretary letter.
We will inform the House later this year about the outcomes of this research.
Wij zullen uw Kamer later dit jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
