Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Scherpe kritiek op onderzoek Jeugdbescherming naar eigen rol bij gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire'

MPs Krul and Inge van Dijk asked why the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's self-reflection on child removals of childcare-benefit scandal victims relied only on file review and professional interviews, without speaking to parents and children. The State Secretary defends the self-initiated reflection, acknowledges the missing parent and child perspective, notes other studies did include them, and promises a policy response and possible further research by June 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat een geheime deal een gapend gat achterliet in de pensioenen van DSM

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a reported EUR 99 million transfer from the DSM pension fund to the employer, low premium payments, the fund's complaints committee and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister answered that the fund must follow the law under DNB and AFM supervision, that the Ombudsman acts independently, and that the questions could not be answered within three weeks because information was being obtained from external parties.
I cannot go further into specific questions about the supervision that AFM and DNB exercise over institutions.
Ik kan verder niet ingaan op specifieke vragen over het toezicht dat AFM en DNB op instellingen uitoefenen.

Antwoord op vragen die leden Aartsen, Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Rikkers en Flach over het bericht “Hoge Raad: bij beoordeling of sprake is van arbeidsovereenkomst geldt geen rangorde tussen de mee te wegen omstandigheden

Five MPs asked the minister how the Supreme Court ruling that no hierarchy exists among factors in classifying employment, including entrepreneurship, affects the online tool hetjuistecontract.nl, Belastingdienst practice, government hiring of freelancers and the VBAR bill. The minister answered that the tool already covers external entrepreneurship, that no change or takedown is needed, that the Belastingdienst weighs all factors, and that the VBAR follow-up will be communicated soon.
Because, in line with the Supreme Court ruling, all factors are weighed in the web module, there is no reason to take the web module offline.
Omdat, in lijn met de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad, alle gezichtspunten worden meegewogen in de webmodule, is er geen reden om de webmodule offline te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Hogere lonen hoeven inflatievuur niet op te stoken'

An MP asks the government about employee participation (profit-sharing, shares) as a tool against inflation, citing the 2023 Bontenbal/Marijnissen motion and international comparisons. The state secretary replies that the government supports the goals in principle but will not actively stimulate profit-sharing with tax incentives, leaving it to social partners, and only plans a further study of growth-sharing for startups.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to introduce active tax stimulation of financial employee participation through profit-sharing.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens met actieve fiscale stimulering te komen van financiële medewerkersparticipatie via winstdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Financiële les op school moet toenemende schulden bij jongeren tegengaan'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister of Finance about rising youth debt, financial literacy in schools, BNPL regulation, and the link between unpaid health insurance and benefit timing. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing financial education subsidies and debt-prevention measures, said BNPL rules will tighten with the CCDII implementation, and committed to a study on harmonising payment dates.
The Ministry of SZW will therefore commission a study in the coming months into harmonising payment dates.
Het Ministerie van SZW gaat daarom in de komende maanden een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar het harmoniseren van betaalmomenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Zwaarst getroffen UWV-gedupeerden worden door Minister niet geholpen’, en dat mag volgens juristen niet'

An MP asks why the minister's UWV recovery operation excludes errors in sociaal-medische beoordelingen and whether limiting it to 2020–2024 is legally sound. The minister says the scope is a policy and political choice within legal room, that UWV will set up a specialist client support team, and that an outside-UWV operation is not currently desirable.
There is no legal obligation to actively trace the errors ex officio.
Er is geen juridische verplichting om ambtshalve de fouten op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk en Haage over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland ECLI:NL:RBGEL:2024:7601 en het bericht op LinkedIn van 16 januari 2024

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Gelderland court ruling that a toeslagen victim is entitled to free legal aid for broad support, and why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand appealed. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad filed a pro forma appeal to clarify the legal question, and argued that gemeentelijke brede ondersteuning falls under the normal Wrb income criteria.

On appeal, the question is whether there is an entitlement to free legal aid, regardless of income or assets, under the Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

In hoger beroep staat ter discussie of er aanspraak bestaat op kosteloze rechtsbijstand, ongeacht inkomen of vermogen, op grond van de Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'VNG: 'BZK tovert op papier miljardenkorting weg''

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior why the Integrale Overzichten Financiën letter omitted the multi-billion euro cut to the municipal fund that VNG and CPB point to, and whether the government complies with the Financiële-verhoudingswet and Gemeentewet on funding decentralised tasks. The Minister rejects the claims, saying the letter is retrospective, that future fund developments appear in budget documents, and that talks with local governments on the balance of tasks and funding continue, with a fund-normering impact report promised for spring.
I do not recognise the claim that the cabinet would not comply with the Financial Relations Act and the Municipalities Act.
Ik herken mij niet in de stelling dat het kabinet niet zou voldoen aan de Financiële verhoudingswet en de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Inge van Dijk over uitsluiting juridische hulp bij conflicten die te maken hebben met invaren door DAS rechtsbijstandverzekering

MPs Joseph and Van Dijk asked whether insurer DAS excluded legal aid for disputes about the transition to the new pension system (invaren) and what this means for citizens' legal protection. The minister confirmed the exclusion, said the Wtp offers internal complaint routes and the GIP and Kifid as low-threshold external bodies, and said insurers set their own terms while the government has not yet found reason for intervention.
The effective legal protection for people during invaren is not determined by the policy terms of any legal expenses insurer.
De effectieve rechtsbescherming voor mensen bij het invaren wordt niet bepaald door de polisvoorwaarden van enige rechtsbijstandsverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over sportcomplexen die zonder extra geld uit de BOSA snel verouderen

An MP asks the state secretary about the sports facilities subsidy (BOSA) being oversubscribed within days, the transition to the DUMAVA sustainability scheme, its differing conditions, and monitoring of funds for sport. The state secretary answers that applications closed at 155% of budget, sets out the differences between the schemes, and commits to informing parliament by Prinsjesdag 2025 on the share of DUMAVA funds reaching sport.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Pump.fun verboden in het Verenigd Koninkrijk’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the UK ban on the memecoin platform Pump.fun and whether comparable platforms should be regulated and restricted in the Netherlands, including protecting young people from finfluencers and a commission ban for crypto apps. The minister points to the new EU MiCA regulation, a forthcoming study on crypto risks and finfluencers, and says further steps depend on its outcome and the MiCA evaluation.
I have no information about the activities of individual parties.
Ik heb geen informatie over de activiteiten van individuele partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de noodklok van de Wethoudersvereniging over onuitvoerbaar beleid

An MP from CDA asks the Minister of Interior about the Wethoudersvereniging's alarm over unworkable national policy, the feeling that The Hague acts as a sole ruler, insufficient involvement of local officials, and a shortfall in local funding for open-ended decentralised tasks. The Minister responds by pointing to the Overhedenoverleg, the UDO feasibility test, planned structural talks with aldermen's representatives, a review of the maximum number of aldermen, and ongoing consultations with the VNG, while asserting that municipal funds are unconditional and that medebewind costs are reimbursed.
In addition, I consider it important that when new bills are introduced, (organisations of) decentralised governments are invited to contribute through formal consultation.
Daarnaast vind ik het van belang dat bij nieuwe wetsvoorstellen (organisaties van) decentrale overheden worden uitgenodigd om door middel van een formele consultatie hun inbreng te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Oud-IT-hoogleraar waarschuwt voor chaos bij UWV' en 'Onrust bij UWV over nieuwe werkwijze’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's reorganisation plan (the Verandermotor) and warnings that it could delay the WIA/Wajong repair operation and should be paused for an independent review. The minister answered that the reorganisation is monitored closely with UWV, that the repair operation is run separately and given top priority, and that UWV has no plan to pause the work.
Specifically, it has been agreed that SZW will be involved in further planning, rollout and interim evaluations, including decisions on the pace of what follows.
Concreet is de afspraak gemaakt dat SZW wordt betrokken in de verdere planvorming, uitrol en de tussentijdse evaluaties, waarbij onder meer besloten wordt over het tempo van het vervolg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden lid Inge van Dijk en Dijk over het bericht ‘Rechter geeft Renate en Jeroen uit Nijverdal gelijk: 'Weer een baanbrekend vonnis voor alle slachtoffers van toeslagenschandaal'’

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why the state litigated against parents seeking independent expert assessment of their childcare-benefit scandal damages, what the court case costs, and whether the inquiry's remit will cover children. The government says it offers several out-of-court routes with independent experts, that it opposed appointing court experts for procedural and causal-link reasons, that it partly lost in court, and that it will consider children's position via the advisory commission but will not amend the remit now.
The State regrets that the parents lost confidence in that independent expert and that this prompted them to submit the request to the court.
De Staat betreurt het dat de ouders het vertrouwen in die onafhankelijke deskundige zijn verloren en dit voor de ouders aanleiding was om dit verzoek bij de rechter in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Einde Buy Now Pay Later stap dichterbij'

An MP asks the Finance and Justice ministers whether Buy Now Pay Later providers profiting from late-payment fees fall under the consumer credit directive, following a CJEU ruling. The minister confirms the ruling, explains that the Dutch case awaits the Supreme Court, and notes that the revised directive will bring BNPL under strict credit rules; timing of the Supreme Court decision is expected in the second half of 2025.
To determine whether the BNPL provider in this specific case falls within the scope of the current Consumer Credit Directive and what the implications are, the court's ruling must be awaited.

Om te kunnen bepalen of de betreffende BNPL-aanbieder in deze specifieke zaak binnen het toepassingsbereik van de huidige Richtlijn consumentenkrediet valt en welke implicaties dit heeft, moet de uitspraak van de rechter worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kan kabinet niet optreden tegen buy now pay later? Dat ligt net een beetje anders’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether EU rules allow a national ban on buy-now-pay-later services, whether member states such as Germany have national rules, and when the new consumer credit directive will be implemented. The minister answered that a permanent ban is not allowed under the new directive, a temporary ban would be undesirable, the implementation consultation is expected in early 2025, and the bill is expected to reach parliament in autumn 2025.
A ban on BNPL services (in physical shops and/or online) is therefore not possible under the CCDII.
Een verbod op BNPL-diensten (in fysieke winkels en/of online) is onder de CCDII dan ook niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland door net opgerichte bedrijven

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about sanctions evasion against Russia by newly founded small firms, as flagged by a CBS and University of Groningen study, and about due diligence and compliance obligations for exporters. The minister responded that evasion is a government priority, that the expanded anti-circumvention clause and best-efforts and due diligence duties apply, that enforcement data is not yet available, and that a letter on chip manufacturers' compliance was sent on 26 November 2024.
Countering sanctions circumvention is a priority for the cabinet.
Het tegengaan van sanctie-omzeiling is een prioriteit voor het kabinet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht: ‘Overheid aan kop met het inzetten van interim-managers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that government use of interim managers remains high, that their rates rise faster than market rates, and whether the target to cut external hiring is realistic. The minister answered that interim management was 5% of external hiring spending in 2023, disputed the rate-increase claim, pointed to a planned action plan on reducing external hiring in Q1 2025 and a new ministerial committee.

In the committee debate on the functioning of the civil service of 6 November 2024, I committed in this context to send Parliament an action plan for reducing external hiring in the first quarter of 2025.

In het commissiedebat Functioneren Rijksdienst van 6 november 2024 heb ik in dit kader toegezegd om in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 een plan van aanpak terugdringen externe inhuur aan Uw Kamer te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Helft stichtingen ondervindt problemen met de bank: 'Het systeem is doorgeslagen''

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that many charities and foundations face problems with banks due to anti-money-laundering screening, and about the fees and account access issues involved. The minister acknowledged the problem, said banks must apply the risk-based approach, pointed to DNB supervision and an NVB standard, and promised to raise bank fees at the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer.
I therefore consider it essential that banks continue to work on improving their risk-based approach, to prevent unnecessary problems and exclusion.
Ik vind het daarom van essentieel belang dat banken blijven inzetten op het verbeteren van hun risicogebaseerde aanpak, om onnodige problemen en uitsluiting te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Geschrokken reacties na vuurwerkbekogeling raadsleden'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how she would respond to fireworks thrown at councillors on their way to a council meeting, and what could be done against threats to councillors. The minister condemned the attack, pointed to existing criminal and administrative options, contact with the municipality, and the Weerbaar Bestuur support team, and promised continued support but no new legal measures.
I find all forms of aggression and intimidation against political office holders unacceptable.
Ik vind alle vormen van agressie en intimidatie tegen politieke ambtsdragers onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Inge van Dijk, Grinwis en Maatoug over ‘het uiterst kritische Raad van State advies over het nieuwe box 3 stelsel’

MPs from D66, CDA, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked how the government views the Raad van State's critical advice on the new box 3 wealth tax system, including delay, budgetary shortfall, the Hoge Raad's view on the forfait, and wealth inequality. The Staatssecretaris answers that a one-year delay to 2028 is expected, a shortfall of about 2.4 billion euro in 2027 will be covered by raising the forfait on other assets and lowering the tax-free allowance, and that alternatives including a wealth tax are being studied, with a reply to the advice to follow.
In a further report on that advice the cabinet will provide a full response, and I cannot anticipate that now.
In een nader rapport op dat advies komt het kabinet met een uitgebreide reactie, daarop kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Grinwis en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Kabinet krijgt tik op de vingers uit Brussel'

MPs Vijlbrief, Grinwis and Inge van Dijk asked Finance Minister Heinen how the cabinet will respond to a European Commission warning that debt and deficits rise beyond EU reference values over the longer term, and why it added 8 billion in spending despite low debt. The minister says the cabinet stays within EU reference values during its term apart from a one-off 2026 deficit overshoot, that further consolidation is for future cabinets, and gives no concrete additional cuts or measures.
The cabinet will not submit to the European Commission a different budgetary path than the frameworks set by the cabinet.
Het kabinet zal niet een ander budgettair pad aan de Europese Commissie voorleggen dan de door het kabinet vastgestelde kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over vrijwillige verenigingsbestuurders die persoonlijk aansprakelijk gesteld kunnen worden

An MP asked the state secretaries whether volunteer association board members face growing personal liability, whether the Wbtr (Wet bestuur en toezicht rechtspersonen) was intended to change liability, and what is being done about the risks. The government answered that the Wbtr extended bankruptcy-based liability for board members of informal and non-commercial associations, that no cases are known in published case law, that information campaigns and support measures are planned, and that the law will be evaluated by 2026.
It is difficult to say whether the total number of liability claims against association board members has increased.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen of het totaal aantal aansprakelijkheidsstellingen van verenigingsbestuurders is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over de politiecapaciteit voor de begeleiding van wielerwedstrijden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk asked about the status of a motion on keeping cycling races going, the timing of an Antea Group study on volunteer motorcycle traffic controllers, and the effect of reduced police capacity around the 2025 NATO summit. The Staatssecretaris replied that the study is finished and will be shared soon with a letter on how its findings will be followed up, that local mayors decide on permits, and that police cannot guarantee escort for races from January to August 2025 except possibly a limited selection.
The Antea Group study will be shared with your House as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek van Antea Group wordt zo spoedig mogelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Staat moet Holland Casino afstoten’

An MP asked whether the state should divest its stake in Holland Casino and whether online gambling legalisation should be reversed, citing rising addiction concerns. The government answered that the casino stake is under review, that the 2023 evaluation found state shareholding not strictly necessary but not to be ruled out, that talks with Holland Casino on the gambling tax increase are ongoing, and that a decision and update are expected around summer 2025.
I aim to inform you around summer 2025 about developments at Holland Casino.
Ik streef ernaar om u rond de zomer van 2025 te informeren over de ontwikkelingen bij Holland Casino.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Ceder en Patijn over het bericht 'Crisis UWV nog groter, ook missers bij mogelijk duizenden jonggehandicapten: 'Kommer en kwel''

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the ministry knew earlier of problems at UWV affecting Wajong disability benefit assessments, and whether it would commission independent research, extend the Court of Audit request, and address WW and Ziektewet. The minister answered that Wajong quality measurements were discontinued from 2020 so quality cannot be verified, promised further investigations, a letter on remedies, and a check on WW and Ziektewet, but declined to commit to an Algemene Rekenkamer investigation until ongoing studies finish.
Unfortunately, quality measurements were scaled down from 2020 onward, and it is now insufficiently clear how the quality of Wajong assessments stands, because it is not traceable.
Helaas zijn de kwaliteitsmetingen vanaf 2020 afgeschaald en is het nu onvoldoende duidelijk hoe het is gesteld met de kwaliteit van de Wajong-beoordelingen, omdat dit niet navolgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over verschillende vormen van woonegoïsme

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about residents who file objections or appeals against housing projects to extract buyouts, and about procedural delays in housing construction. The minister condemned appeals made purely for financial gain but said it cannot be measured, defended the right to appeal, and pointed to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting to speed up housing-project litigation through single-instance appeal.
It is not possible to determine how many objections and appeals have been withdrawn in recent years on such suspicion.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel bezwaar- en beroepschriften de afgelopen jaren vanwege een dergelijk vermoeden zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Stultiens over het NRC artikel ‘Methode Laurentien ligt stil: veel gedupeerden van Toeslagenschandaal wachten nog op hulp'

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Stultiens (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether the SGH route for childcare benefit victims has stalled after a NRC report, and what caused delays, including SGH's list of 11 implementation blockages. The State Secretary replied that a new service agreement was reached in summer, that delays stem from SGH's capacity and quality of damage statements, that ministry checks are not described as delay, and that discontinuing the SGH route is not on the table.
The ministry takes SGH's signals seriously.
Het ministerie neemt de signalen van SGH serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk, Helder en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Honderden agenten met PTSS krijgen geen passende WIA-uitwerking door gebrek aan kennis over ziekte bij UWV’

MPs from CDA, BBB and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether UWV medical assessors lack knowledge of PTSD, leaving police officers without proper WIA benefits, and proposed a specialist desk and training. The minister denied a knowledge gap, said PTSD is covered by general medical knowledge and assessor re-registration, and offered no new training or desk beyond existing optional courses.
I do not recognise that picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Werkgever ‘mist kans’ met werknemersaandelen: ‘Dit is de manier om werkeneden te laten profiteren van welvaart’

An MP asked whether the government would investigate financial employee participation, including fiscal obstacles, comparisons with the UK and Germany, a national policy plan, and information provision. The Secretary of State answered that the government is positive about such schemes but sees them as a matter for employers and employees, identifies four practical obstacles, denies any current fiscal barrier, and points to the Stichting van de Arbeid process and ongoing startup tax research without committing to new studies or a national plan.
Given the various advantages and disadvantages, it is up to employers and employees to weigh these and see whether financial employee participation offers added value for them.
Gegeven de verschillende voor- en nadelen is het aan werkgevers en werknemers om deze samen te wegen en te kijken of financiële werknemersparticipatie voor hen meerwaarde biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister ontkent inzet slimme software voor WIA-fouten, ondanks dat dit wel verteld is aan UWV-medewerkers'

An MP (CDA) asked the minister whether signals about smart software being used to detect WIA benefit errors at UWV had been properly disclosed, given the minister earlier denied such use. The minister answered that a 'digital assistant' tool, not AI, may be used to sort the roughly 250,000 WIA decisions from 2020–2024 for manual review, that it makes no decisions, and declined to reconsider a motion.
I was not insufficiently informed. See my answer to question 2.
Ik was niet onvoldoende op de hoogte. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Grote zorgen over nieuwe regels voor toeristen in Spanje'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment whether Spain's mandatory tourist registration, based on EU rules, overlaps with the Dutch debate on registering EU labour migrants, and why EU tourists can be registered while EU migrants cannot be required to register for stays under three months. The minister answered that the Spanish rule serves security and that the Dutch debate concerns labour conditions and BRP registration, that no unjustified difference exists, and that the Ministry of Interior is exploring use of night-register data for labour migrant registration.
The Ministry of the Interior is currently exploring, together with the VNG, whether data from the night register can be used to improve the registration of labour migrants in the BRP.
Het Ministerie van BZK verkent op dit moment in samenwerking met de VNG of gegevens uit het nachtregister gebruikt kunnen worden voor de verbetering van de registratie van arbeidsmigranten in de BRP.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Kathmann en Inge van Dijk over de opkomst van niet-Europese online marktplaatsen en de impact hiervan op concurrentievermogen, consumentenbescherming en productveiligheid

MPs Thijssen, Kathmann and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the flood of parcels from Chinese online marketplaces, unequal competition, consumer protection and product safety, and asked what the government itself can do. The Minister acknowledges the concerns, points to EU instruments (DSA, DMA, customs reform, Digital Product Passport) and to supervisors' responsibility, and commits to talks with the Consumentenbond and retail associations and to coordination with Germany and at EU level.
I am willing to enter into discussion with the Consumentenbond and the retail industry associations and to inform the House about relevant outcomes.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de Consumentenbond en de retailbrancheverenigingen en de Kamer te informeren over relevante uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Ceder over het artikel ‘Roep om einde aan ‘incasso-industrie’ te maken: ‘Schuld van 50 euro kan nu oplopen tot 800 euro’’

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked whether maximum debt-collection costs and the debt-collection industry's profit margins are still reasonable, and how the government will respond to the Consumentenbond's proposals and the IBO on problematic debts. The State Secretary answered that the current cost rules are being examined in the IBO follow-up, that a Rijksincassovisie and a research on overheid claims are pending, and that a cabinet response to the IBO will follow this year, without committing to the Consumentenbond's specific proposals.

Given also the analyses from the IBO report, I intend to examine the funding system within the out-of-court collection phase more closely in the coming period, with particular attention to the cost escalation on small claims.

Gegeven ook de analyses uit het IBO rapport ben ik voornemens om de bekostigingssystematiek binnen de buitengerechtelijke incassofase de komende periode nader onder de loep te nemen, met bijzondere aandacht voor de kostenoploop bij kleine vorderingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Wet Hersteloperatie toeslagen in strijd met artikel 6 EVRM?’ van universitair docent Bestuursrecht dhr. Rens Koenraad op LinkedIn, 30 augustus 2024

An MP asked whether affected childcare-benefit parents should be able to prove informal debts by means other than a notarial deed, and whether courts should be allowed to depart from the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen, citing article 6 ECHR. The State Secretary refused to change the evidentiary requirement, arguing alternatives are not administrable and that the hardship clause and court review provide sufficient safeguards.
I therefore see no reason to give administrative judges room to depart from the Wht.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om bestuursrechters ruimte te geven om af te kunnen wijken van de Wht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Rechter vreest nieuw toeslagenschandaal’

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the government responds to a court warning that the Tax Authority's rigid stance on the notarial-deed requirement for informal debts echoes the childcare benefits scandal, and how to avoid a drawn-out, overly rigid redress process. The State Secretary answered that the hardship clause in the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen allows deviation in extreme cases, that compensation schemes are ongoing with the aim of completing all integral assessments by end of next year, and that 96% of public debts of affected parents have been written off.

By including the hardship clause in article 9.1 of the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen, the legislator deliberately gave administrative bodies room to deviate from certain parts of the Wht where application would lead to a very unreasonable outcome.

Door de opname van de hardheidsclausule in artikel 9.1 Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen (Wht) heeft de wetgever bewust ruimte geboden aan bestuursorganen om af te wijken van bepaalde onderdelen in de Wht als toepassing daarvan tot een zeer onbillijke uitkomst leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over het bericht «Bureaucratie binnen de Rijksoverheid uitgegroeid tot zeldzame proporties»

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked about reports that over half of ministry staff work in overhead, its causes, Woo workload, and cost-cutting goals. The minister estimates overhead at 45-50 percent, admits no reliable per-ministry figures, promises a Woo workload study and a bureaucracy-reduction agenda, but gives no concrete targets yet.
I do not have reliable figures per ministry.
Over betrouwbare cijfers per ministerie beschik ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Omtzigt en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Crisis bij UWV: tienduizenden uitkeringen na jaren aangepast wegens fouten' en brief van minister SZW d.d. 4 september 2024 naar aanleidin

MPs Saris, Omtzigt and Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV errors in WIA benefit calculations, whether benefits decided long ago can be adjusted against recipients, the legal basis and protection, known problems, audit reports, and the timing and scope of the government's knowledge and remedies. The minister answered at length: errors are being identified, UWV expects a complete picture by December, recovery depends on individual case review with attention to the human scale, and the government plans WIA reforms and an independent inquiry.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitspraken van staatssecretaris Jansen over de limiet voor contante betalingen

An MP from CDA asked the Finance Minister whether the government stands by its proposed 3,000-euro cash payment limit after State Secretary Jansen was quoted saying a stricter limit misses its goal and that a 10,000-euro limit is reasonable for businesses. The Minister answered that the 3,000-euro limit balances money-laundering risks, access to payments and business burdens, that the cabinet position is unchanged, and that the State Secretary's remarks fall outside his portfolio.
The cabinet position is unchanged: a limit on cash payments for goods from 3,000 euros is an effective way to address money-laundering risks
Het kabinetsstandpunt is onveranderd: een limiet op contante betalingen van goederen vanaf 3.000 euro is een effectieve manier om witwasrisico's aan te pakken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bedrijven van de toekomst vragen om meer steun van Den Haag’

An MP asks the minister about calls for more government risk-sharing with scale-ups, the progress and funding of the National Technology Strategy, and an amendment on NTS funding. The minister replies that existing instruments (Invest-NL, ROM's, guarantees, procurement guidance) already share risk, that NTS work continues with timelines through 2025, and that funding is uncertain because the Nationaal Groeifonds is being phased out.
At this moment I cannot say what amount is needed for the implementation of the NTS.
Ik kan op dit moment niet zeggen welk bedrag nodig is voor de uitvoering van de NTS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘(Oud-)topsporters noemen lagere inkomsten ‘ramp voor de clubs’: ‘Bezuinig niet op sport’’

Three MPs asked the minister about press reports that budget cuts threaten sport, including volunteer burden, the CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA proposals, gambling tax differentiation and the health costs of cutting sport. The state secretary answered that sport is valued and that a multi-year strategy and clearer information will follow, but gave no figures on the cuts and no firm commitment on the gambling-tax motion or a sports law.
As indicated in the letter of 2 April 2024, I aim to inform the House further on this before the legislative consultation on the Sport and Exercise budget item for 2025.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief 2 van 2 april 2024 streef ik ernaar uw Kamer hier voor het wetgevingsoverleg over begrotingsonderdeel Sport en Bewegen voor het jaar 2025, nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht “Overzicht eerste half jaar 2024” op www.hypotheekshop.nl

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about inconsistent treatment of student debt in mortgage capacity calculations after new DUO debt rules, and whether they would adopt clearer rules. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the 2025 amendment regulation will clarify how lenders calculate student loan payments (including temporary reductions), and that consultation responses will be considered.
I intend to include this point in the annual amendment regulation on mortgage credit.
Ik ben voornemens dit punt mee te nemen in de jaarlijkse wijzigingsregeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht ‘Een hypotheek voor een tiny house, Esther kreeg het voor elkaar: ‘Ik kan het nog steeds bijna niet geloven’’

CDA MPs asked the housing and finance ministers about difficulties obtaining mortgages for tiny houses and flexible homes and the resulting inequality. The minister said the government will study mortgage rules for movable homes with the Ministry of Finance, NHG and the market, and will discuss with the NVB, but defended current lender risk-based conditions and gave no data on tiny house mortgages.
There are no figures available on the owner-occupied sector.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de koopsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het toezicht op webwinkels als Temu, AliExpres en Shein

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked the ministers about oversight of Temu, Shein and AliExpress, covering unfair trade practices, dark patterns, product safety, privacy, Chinese ties and BNPL promotion. The minister answered that existing EU and Dutch rules and the ACM, NVWA and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are responsible, pointed to pending EU initiatives such as the fitness check, DSA and product safety regulation, and declined to order investigations or disclose details of internal app measures.
Because of this confidentiality, I cannot go further into these measures.
Door deze vertrouwelijkheid kan ik dan ook niet verder ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over olympische sporters die moeite hebben met rondkomen

MPs asked whether the topsport stipend is adequate for elite athletes who struggle to make ends meet, whether it should be seen as a job, and about claw-back rules, the income threshold, and the ongoing review of the support package. The state secretary answered that NOC*NSF and the Fonds voor de Topsporter are primarily responsible for the stipend rules, that a new support model is being explored, and that an update will follow in autumn 2024.
It is my intention to inform your House in autumn 2024 about the progress.
Het is mijn voornemen om uw Kamer in het najaar van 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Dijk over een gepubliceerde e-mail van 13 oktober 2021

MPs Inge van Dijk and Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance whether a published email from 13 October 2021 about the childcare benefits affair was genuine, how widely it spread, what was done with its proposals, and whether its tone was acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the email could not be found in Tax and Customs or Toeslagen systems, so its authenticity could not be established, that no follow-up was given, and that such language would not be accepted if used by staff.
Despite an intensive search of the Toeslagen and Tax Administration systems, the email has not been found.
De e-mail is ondanks een intensieve zoektocht in de Toeslagen- en Belastingdienstsystemen niet gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Mensen voelen zich niet serieus genomen door UWV bij WIA-aanvraag: 'Arts zei dat ik mijn klachten aandik'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that many people feel not taken seriously by UWV in WIA disability assessments, and whether a complaints point will be opened and when analysis and OCTAS alternatives will be sent to parliament. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the ministry and UWV are examining the reports and will inform parliament shortly after summer, and that OCTAS proposals will be detailed with parliament informed in autumn.
As promised by my predecessor, my ministry is working with UWV to find out exactly what the reports underlying the recent media coverage contain.
Zoals door mijn voorganger is toegezegd, zoekt mijn ministerie samen met UWV uit wat de rapporten waarop de recente berichtgeving in de media is gebaseerd precies inhouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de kabinetsreactie op de invoeringstoets op de Wet open overheid (Woo)

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked about the government's response to the Woo implementation review, including unknown FTE capacity for handling Woo requests, a cost study, and anti-misuse measures. The minister agreed to a study of implementation costs and capacity expected in Q1 2025, but deferred decisions on a benefit-cost weighing and legal changes until that study is complete.
For this reason, a study into the concrete implementation burdens, costs and (required) capacity for handling Woo requests is also being carried out.
Mede om die reden wordt ook het onderzoek naar de concrete uitvoeringslasten, kosten en (benodigde) capaciteit voor de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Welzijn over het bericht ‘Erfpacht oneerlijk, CDA-Raadslid wil ACM dwingen naar systeem te kijken’

MPs asked whether municipalities should inform residents better about erfpacht (leasehold) formulas, whether general erfpacht conditions favour municipalities, and whether the guidance should be binding and supervised by the AFM. The minister replied that the existing guidance is voluntary and sufficient, that the ACM rightly declined an enforcement request, that erfpacht is a private-law matter, and that the AFM is not the appropriate supervisor.

Intervening in the local trade-offs, the local autonomy and contractual freedom of municipalities (within the general principles of good governance) are very far-reaching measures and I see no need for them at this time.

Ingrijpen in de lokaal te maken afwegingen, de lokale autonomie en contractvrijheid van gemeenten (uiteraard binnen de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur) zijn zeer vergaande maatregelen en ik zie daar op dit moment niet de noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Podt en Inge van Dijk over het dreigende vertrek van ASML

MPs Sneller, Podt and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about reports of a secret government operation ('Project Beethoven') to prevent ASML from relocating abroad, the economic stakes, the fourth Growth Fund round, talent attraction and expat policy. The government confirmed Project Beethoven as a sector-support effort, explained the stakes and measures, said the fourth Growth Fund round is paused and will likely be dropped by the new coalition, and outlined talent and migration policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 1 april jl. en artikelen inzake speculatieve grondhandel

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked ministers about speculative land trade in farmland shown on Radar, including misleading sales practices, the AFM and ACM supervisory roles, notary duties and the number of victims. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a Kadaster study of about 7,000 owners and 2,000 hectares split into investment plots, and said a working group is examining options such as a splitting ban, AFM supervision and notary obligations, with results due in autumn.
You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat het budget voor de subsidieregeling Stimulering bouw en onderhoud sportaccommodaties (BOSA) voor dit jaar al bijna op is

An MP asked whether the 2024 budget for the BOSA sports-facility subsidy scheme would run out soon, and whether sports clubs would face higher contributions as a result. The minister confirmed demand far exceeds the €79 million ceiling, raised the ceiling to €111.5 million via a cash shift and a transfer from another scheme, said applications will close on 1 August, and promised to inform parliament on a sustainable future budget in the autumn.
The number of applications and the amounts already granted now exceed the €79 million initially available for the BOSA scheme.
Het aantal aanvragen en de reeds toegekende aanvragen overstijgen inmiddels de € 79 miljoen die aanvankelijk beschikbaar was voor de BOSA-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden sportclubs niet meer kunnen verduurzamen

MPs Van Dijk, Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the minister about reports that hundreds of sports clubs cannot sustainably upgrade their facilities because the BOSA subsidy budget is exhausted, and about whether the budget should be increased. The minister answered that the budget ceiling for 2024 is raised from 79 to 111.5 million euro, that demand still exceeds it, and that the application portal closes on 1 August.
The subsidy ceiling for 2024 is thus raised in total from 79 million euro to 111.5 million euro.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het buurtinitiatief grijpt naast de opdrachten voor energiebesparing’

An MP asked whether neighbourhood initiatives tackling energy poverty are being crowded out of municipal tenders by commercial parties, and whether municipalities can use other allocation methods. The minister answered that municipalities have broad discretion to spend the funds (tendering, subsidies, in-house, open house), that tender rules allow weighting of sustainability and social impact, and promised a meeting on sharing best practices under the MVOI manifesto.
No, I do not have that overview.
Nee, dat overzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het optreden van de Atletiekunie na mogelijk seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een atleet

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about how the Atletiekunie handled alleged sexual boundary-crossing behaviour by an athlete, including whether victims feel free to report to the ISR and whether the federation acted within disciplinary rules. The minister answered that the case is pending before the ISR and cannot be commented on, that victims can report through several channels, and that the ISR professionalisation progress will be covered in a letter before summer.
This concerns an ongoing case under investigation by the ISR, and as Minister I can make no statement or judgment about it.
Dit betreft een lopende zaak in onderzoek bij het ISR en daar kan ik als Minister geen mededeling of een uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Herstel toeslagenaffaire dreigt ongekende strop te worden: nog 5 miljard extra’

MPs Stultiens and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that the childcare benefits scandal recovery could cost an extra 5 billion euros, requesting a breakdown of costs, funding and the reasons for higher compensation under one recovery route. The State Secretary largely deferred answers to a forthcoming letter and evaluation of the new damage route pilot, saying the 5 billion figure is not fixed and that the precise answers could not yet be given.
As previously reported to the House of Representatives, a cabinet decision will soon be taken based on an evaluation of the pilot of this new damage route.
Zoals eerder gemeld aan de Tweede Kamer zal op basis van een evaluatie van de pilot van deze nieuwe schaderoute binnenkort een kabinetsbesluit worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk  over het artikel 'Netbeheerders kunnen weinig met prioriteit voor Brainport'

CDA MPs asked whether the minister knew of reports that grid operators could do little with the government's promised priority for the Brainport region, why the November 2023 letter seemed to surprise them, and what the grid response would be. The minister answered that the priority concerns congestion instruments and the regional energy infrastructure plan (MIEK), not individual connection priority which is set by the regulator ACM, and described short-, medium- and long-term actions with TenneT, Enexis and the region.
The priority status of Brainport is not intended to mean that connecting individual companies on the waiting list in the region would automatically get higher priority than in other regions.

Met de prioritaire status van Brainport is niet bedoeld dat het aansluiten van individuele bedrijven die op de wachtlijst staan in de regio per definitie een hogere prioriteit zou krijgen dan in andere regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Mkb’ers verliezen bankrekening door strikte anti-witwasregels: ‘Onacceptabele toestanden’'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Finance whether strict anti-money-laundering rules are unduly burdening small businesses that struggle to get bank accounts and credit, and whether the government will act on proposals such as a basic business payment account. The Minister acknowledges the problems, argues that DNB supervision is not the main cause and that banks must apply the risk-based approach better, and promises to inform parliament around the summer about options including a basic business payment account.
I aim to inform the House about this further around the summer.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer rond de zomer hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitzending van Kassa over kermissen die onder druk staan van 20 april 2024

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about a Kassa broadcast on fairground pressures, including whether the government will convene stakeholders to find support measures for small-town fairs. The minister acknowledges the cultural value of fairs, points to a municipal guidance document, and agrees to explore a short-term consultation with trade bodies and the VNG.
I will have EZK contact the Dutch Fairground Association, the national fairground operators' association and the VNG to establish whether they want a consultation in the short term.

Ik zal vanuit EZK contact laten leggen met De Nederlandse Kermisbond (NKB), de Nationale Bond van Kermisbedrijfhouders (BOVAK) en de VNG om te inventariseren of er vanuit die partijen behoefte is aan een overleg op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek banken: criminele geldstromen blijven te vaak onopgemerkt'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about an industry threat assessment on bank-based money laundering detection, its claimed shortcomings, the role of gatekeepers beyond banks, crypto and underground banking, trade finance, and whether the gatekeeper role should be reorganised. The minister replied that the confidential assessment is not shared beyond banks and authorities, that the FATF rated the Dutch anti-money-laundering approach as robust, that a wider crypto regulation is coming, and that the group could not answer in time for the debate.
I respect the decision not to share these findings beyond these parties, as they are the gatekeepers, investigative bodies and FIU that must act on these risks.
Ik respecteer de keuze om deze bevindingen niet verder te delen buiten deze partijen, het zijn immers de poortwachters, opsporingsinstanties en FIU die moeten acteren op deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Krul over dat in New Towns als Almere “het sociale cement het stenen cement nauwelijks kan bijbenen”

CDA MPs asked the government to respond to a report on social resilience in Almere and to reflect on how New Town problems such as debt, loneliness, teacher shortages and youth crime relate to rapid growth and national financing, and what action is needed. The minister replied that the report was commissioned by Almere and that the government points to existing programmes (NPLV, GALA, IZA, regional deals) and will await a broader WijkWijzer study before reflecting further.
For a reflection on the problems in the New Towns, the results of that study will be awaited.
Voor een reflectie op de problematiek in de New Towns, worden de resultaten van dat onderzoek afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Pleidooi voor strengere regels na eerste rechtszaak tegen financieel influencer'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the spread of unlicensed brokers promoted by finfluencers, the AFM's slow enforcement and the expected EU rules justify stricter measures. The Minister replied that existing rules are sufficient for now, pointed to ongoing AFM supervision and a planned influencer certificate, and committed to pushing the EU to ban promotion of unlicensed financial firms.
The AFM cannot give insight into all measures taken because of its statutory duty of confidentiality and does not normally comment on ongoing investigations.
De AFM kan geen inzicht geven in alle genomen maatregelen vanwege de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht en doet normaliter ook geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Marktplaats-melding aan fiscus blijkt ook risico voor uitkering; 'Overheid heeft geen goed track record in zulke zaken''.

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about risks that DAC7 platform data sharing with the tax authority could lead to benefit clawbacks and extra checks on welfare recipients selling goods online. The government answered that DAC7 creates no new obligations, that the tax authority only gives yes/no income signals to municipalities via the Inlichtingenbureau, that municipalities initiate checks, and that the effects will be monitored and reported in December 2024.

The Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions will inform the House in the Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in December 2024 about the effects of platform data sharing on municipalities' enforcement activities.

De Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen informeert uw Kamer via de Stand van de Uitvoering sociale zaken in december 2024 over de effecten van de gegevensdeling van platformbedrijven op de handhavingsactiviteiten van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vermeer over de reactie van de minister over de landelijke uitrol van de Streetwise-methodiek

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vermeer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Streetwise method, which has supported startups and filled vacant shop space, should be rolled out nationally and what the ministry will do to support it. The minister answers that the approach is positive and not specific to Limburg, that a pilot in Overijssel could help, but that no firm rollout plan exists yet and the ministry will only stimulate partners to draw one up.
At present my ministry is playing a stimulating role in bringing about a broadly supported step-by-step plan by bringing parties together and convincing them of the need for such a plan.

Op dit moment speelt mijn ministerie een stimulerende rol bij het totstandkomen van een gedragen stappenplan door partijen bij elkaar te brengen en ze te overtuigen van de noodzaak van een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Dijk over het bericht 'Schadeproces toeslagenaffaire volledig op de schop: 'Het is bij de wilde konijnen af''

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Dijk (SP) asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade is reinventing its damage-assessment process for Toeslagenaffaire victims, whether closed cases will be reviewed, and why this was not raised in the parliamentary debate, and asked for a letter within a week. The State Secretary says CWS was asked for a plan on capacity, treatment of parents and backlogs, that CWS denies reviewing closed cases, and that he will inform the House on the final plan as soon as possible after discussing it with CWS, though not within the week.
I will discuss this plan with CWS. Any additional actions that follow from it I will share with your House at the same time as the plan.
Dit plan bespreek ik met CWS. Eventuele aanvullende acties die hieruit volgen, deel ik gelijktijdig met het plan met uw Kamer.

Antwoord op vragen van het leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Koekkoek over de berichten 'Steeds meer arbeidsmigranten op straat: 'De opvang moet humaner'', 'Een half miljoen arbeidsmigranten: uitbuiting en maatschappelij

MPs from CDA and Volt asked the ministers about media reports on homeless EU labour migrants, including causes, the BRP temporary address registration, the legal-entitlement tool for municipalities, language barriers and WW benefits, and measures against exploitation. The government answered that the numbers are uncertain and being monitored via a new census, that causes are varied and mostly personal, that a legal tool and a short-stay pilot are underway, and that existing measures such as the agency-licensing bill and the labour-market reform are the route forward.
The cabinet recognises the signals that the legal reality regarding the rights of EU citizens is complex.
Het kabinet herkent de signalen dat de juridische werkelijkheid ten aanzien van de rechten van EU-burgers complex is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over sportverenigingen die alleen met ondersteuning van onder meer betaalde krachten blijven functioneren

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to research showing sports clubs get little support on regulation, sustainability and sports climate, and to NOC*NSF's call for structural paid support for volunteers, and how the Sportakkoord II and Human Capital Agenda address this. The minister answered that support on these themes can ease club practice, listed sport and movement counters, budgets and programmes for volunteer management, and described the Human Capital Agenda's aims, without any commitment to new oversight or powers.
I am of the view that providing support on the mentioned themes can simplify the daily practice of board members.
Ik ben van mening dat het bieden van ondersteuning op de genoemde thema's de dagelijkse praktijk van de bestuurders kan vereenvoudigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Jimmy Dijk over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam, nr. AMS 23/2601 van 5 februari 2024

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Jimmy Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Rotterdam... no: an Amsterdam district court ruling that waived the notarial deed requirement for an informal debt of a childcare-benefit victim, and whether the government will appeal and change the law. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is exceptional, that the court's evidence of overdue amounts is not in line with the Wht, that no appeal will be lodged for this case, and that no legislative change is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ''Bank vraagt klantgegevens aan ondernemers bij contante betaling''

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Finance about reports that banks demand customer information and impose restrictions on entrepreneurs during anti-money-laundering checks, including for cash payments, and whether banks may restrict accounts when information is withheld. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says such measures are proportionate only in specific high-risk circumstances, and commits to asking DNB to review its guidance and to banking-sector discussions on communication with customers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het Didam-arrest

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the Didam ruling by the Supreme Court has made it legally and practically harder for municipalities to select one-on-one buyers for land with public added value, and whether the ruling should be restricted. The minister answers that legal room is unchanged, that objective selection criteria can still favour socially valuable plans, and that he sees no reason to restrict the ruling's application.
I have no concrete figures on the extent to which the Didam ruling has in practice led to plans not going ahead.
Ik heb geen concrete cijfers in hoeverre het Didam-arrest in de praktijk ertoe heeft geleid dat plannen niet zijn doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht dat de stijgende WOZ-waarde de sociale huurder hard treft

Rep. Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether rising WOZ property values hit social tenants hard, how this affects rent burdens, and whether municipalities, housing corporations and the Waarderingskamer will act to prevent pass-through and better inform tenants about objections. The minister answered that WOZ increases do not directly raise rents under the rent regulation system, that tenants pay no OZB, that corporations cannot pass WOZ increases through, that the Waarderingskamer supervises municipalities and promotes tenant objection rights, and that no new contact with housing associations was needed.
Also, as of 1 July 2023, around 600,000 tenants of housing corporations in the regulated segment received a rent reduction to € 575.
Ook hebben per 1 juli 2023 circa 600.000 huurders met een huurwoning van een woningcorporatie in het gereguleerd segment een huurverlaging naar € 575 gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Uitvoerder waarschuwt: Ondernemers raken gefrustreerd en haken af'

A CDA MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about RVO's warnings that complex schemes frustrate entrepreneurs, how signals from the field reach ministries, whether RVO is consulted early on feasibility, and how interdepartmental friction and regulatory burden are tackled. The minister answers that RVO feedback is shared with ministries through several structural consultations, that early involvement and a new 'opgavegericht' approach are being developed, and that a regulatory-burden coordinator structure already exists, but offers no new binding commitments.
Where the signals concern bottlenecks in policy, these are fed back to the departments concerned.
Daar waar het signalen over knelpunten in beleid betreft, worden deze teruggekoppeld naar de betrokken departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Resultaten MOB-vergadering 28 november 2023’

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the MOB's reachability monitor showing falling business satisfaction with payment services, bank information points, de-risking standards, bank tariff increases, and public cost-sharing for payments. The minister said he will report to parliament on the MOB's further analysis (expected autumn 2024), that bank information point pilots are continuing, that the NVB risk-based standards are non-binding and will be evaluated, and that he sees no reason for public subsidies for payments infrastructure.
When the outcomes of this are known, I will inform your House of the conclusions.
Wanneer de uitkomsten hiervan bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over het bericht 'Rendement particuliere verhuurders onder druk'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked about a study showing that the net return for private landlords falls sharply due to rising interest rates, the Wet betaalbare huur and tax measures, and whether this threatens rental supply. Minister De Jonge answered that the dataset is not representative, that the bill keeps investment in middle-rent attractive, and that the WWS will be made binding with stronger enforcement against overpriced rentals.
I will send the Wet betaalbare huur bill to your House shortly, so that it can take effect on 1 July 2024.
Het wetsvoorstel betaalbare huur zal ik op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen, zodat de inwerkingtreding per 1 juli 2024 kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ombudsman: Overheid dwingt burgers tot fraude'

MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary for the Interior about an Ombudsman report finding that citizens are pushed into fraud by using others' DigiD credentials, since representatives such as guardians and informal carers lack a workable digital proxy option. The State Secretary acknowledged the practice and dilemma, pointed to the phased rollout of digital representation facilities and ongoing engagement with stakeholders, and gave a partial answer on usability research and the timeline.
I am aware that some representatives, including guardians and informal carers, use the DigiD username and password of the persons they represent to gain access to digital services.

Het is mij bekend dat sommige vertegenwoordigers, waaronder ook bewindvoerders en mantelzorgers, de DigiD gebruikersnaam en wachtwoord van de personen die zij vertegenwoordigen gebruiken om toegang te krijgen tot digitale dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Brink, Krul en Inge van Dijk over het niet doorgaan van amateur wielrenwedstrijden

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers why amateur cycling races are being cancelled because police motorcycle escorts are unavailable, and whether volunteer civilian motorcyclists could be deployed, including via a pilot and changes to traffic rules. The minister answered that a study by Antea Group is underway with results expected in summer 2024, that a temporary experiment would need a legal amendment and AMvB taking about a year, and that changing traffic rules awaits the study's outcome.
I expect the results of the above-mentioned study in the summer of 2024.
De uitkomsten van het bovengenoemde onderzoek verwacht ik in de zomer van 2024.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de brief van 13 december 2023 over uitvoering van de motie Inge van Dijk c.s. over met het oog op herstel, rust, stabiliteit, voortgang en een vertrouwd gezicht waarborge

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a cabinet collapse threatens continuity in the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation, and why the government relies on steering delivery rather than structural guarantees, given complaints about delays and ouders going to court. The government answers that cabinet changes cause no delay, that the parents' committee and IBTD serve as signalling continuity guardians, and that it is exploring strengthening the chair's role, without yet committing to concrete measures.
As indicated, the cabinet sees it as a fruitful option to talk with the chair of the parents' committee about strengthening his role.
Zoals aangegeven ziet het kabinet het als een vruchtbare optie om met de voorzitter van de oudercommissie in gesprek te gaan over het versterken van zijn rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘UWV vordert tienduizenden euro’s aan toeslagen terug vannietsvermoedende arbeidsongeschikten’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV reclaimed tens of thousands of euros in supplementary benefits from disability recipients who received back-payments of disability pensions, and whether UWV followed its own rules. The minister acknowledged two confirmed cases, said UWV regrets the contact failures, outlined ongoing efforts on gross reclaiming, pension cooperation, and a review of recovery policy, but did not provide aggregate figures.
Pension funds and UWV unfortunately have no insight into the number of disabled Dutch citizens who received a back-payment in the past five years.
Pensioenfondsen en UWV hebben helaas geen inzicht in het aantal arbeidsongeschikte Nederlanders dat in de afgelopen vijf jaar een nabetaling heeft ontvangen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwacht megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs Inge van Dijk, Vedder and Van der Plas asked whether farmers who joined the set-aside scheme and planted fast-growing forest were wrongly denied the agricultural exemption and faced tax assessments after decades. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the Tax Authority's position is consistent, that no assurances were given about the agricultural exemption, and that the pending Supreme Court ruling will be awaited.
As with our answers of 5 September 2023 to the previous questions from your House on this subject, we note at the outset that the case is still before the courts.
Net als bij onze antwoorden van 5 september 2023 op de vorige vragen van uw Kamer over dit onderwerp stellen wij voorop dat de zaak nog onder de rechter is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government why its acknowledgement that red tape for volunteer organisations is a serious problem has not led to concrete measures, how the Beleidskompas ensures volunteer organisations are consulted, whether the AVG obligations and the volunteer allowance should be changed, and what a further volunteer allowance increase would cost. The government replies that it is working on a plan of action with the sector, that the Beleidskompas will be evaluated before any changes, that banks have adopted a new sector standard reducing checks on non-profits, that AVG obligations will not be reduced, and that raising the volunteer allowance by 500 euro would cost about 3 million euro a year, while promising a further policy response in December 2023.
We are therefore holding talks with various departments, the sector and other relevant stakeholders to arrive at concrete and serious measures to counter the red tape.
Wij zijn daarom met verschillende departementen, de sector en andere relevante betrokkenen gesprekken aan het voeren om tot concrete en serieuze maatregelen te komen om de regeldruk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over armoede onder middeninkomens

An MP asked the government about very low net incomes and extreme marginal tax rates faced by middle-income households through combined benefit and tax schemes, and whether these effects were foreseen. The government acknowledges these outcomes are undesirable, explains methodological differences, notes a planned temporary bridging measure and a structural fiscal fix for single-earner couples from 2028, but says no simple solutions exist for the extreme marginal rates.
The cabinet commits to a structural solution through the tax system.
Het kabinet committeert zich aan een structurele oplossing via de fiscaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Herstel van Toeslagenaffaire groeit uit tot peperdure, ambtelijke moloch'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the government knowingly made unachievable promises to victims of the childcare benefits scandal, whether the recovery operation's delays can be solved by shortening rather than extending deadlines, and what is being done about slow processing, professional objection agencies, administrative costs and urgent cases. The State Secretary answered that the statutory deadlines proved unachievable due to larger-than-expected inflow, that the focus is on shortening processing times with the integrated assessment expected by 2025, and that urgency routes and other measures are being introduced.
At the start of the recovery operation, the cabinet, anticipating the inflow of affected parents, chose a relatively generous statutory period of 6 months, extendable by another 6 months.

Bij de start van de hersteloperatie heeft het kabinet, met het oog op de verwachte toestroom van gedupeerde ouders, voor een relatief ruime wettelijke termijn gekozen van 6 maanden, met mogelijkheid tot verlenging met nogmaals 6 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat ecologisch onderzoek nodig is bij het isoleren van spouwmuren

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about the Council of State ruling that ecological research is required before insulating cavity walls, including effects on costs, speed and energy poverty. The minister acknowledges the ruling, outlines a medium-term plan of municipal species management plans and a task force, and refers several questions to a Kamerbrief without giving concrete figures on individual research costs.
See the letter to the House of Representatives.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake het onterecht intrekken van de ANBI-status van de As-Soennah-moskee

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Hague district court ruling that the tax authority wrongly revoked the ANBI status of the As-Soennah mosque, and whether selection of ANBI institutions was based on nationality or religion.
