The State Secretary declined to address individual taxpayers citing fiscal secrecy, noted pro forma appeal, explained the selection practice in general terms and said the mosque-related CAF investigation continues.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot address an individual taxpayer.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik niet ingaan op een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Experts: adviesbureaus nemen taak ambtenaren over bij energietransitie’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities and provinces lack expertise for the energy transition, whether consultancies are awarded contracts without public tender, whether Klimaatroute (a subsidiary of Essent) can claim independence, and how local civil servants are being supported. The minister acknowledged capacity shortages, pointed to a 1.04 billion euro CDOKE scheme, a forthcoming ROB review, and the NPLW programme, and said tenders below EU thresholds are not mandatory and that customers must be able to trust independent advice without committing to new rules.
Households must be able to trust that they receive independent and good advice – especially when this is carried out under the responsibility of a municipality.
Huishoudens moeten er op kunnen vertrouwen dat hen onafhankelijk en goed advies wordt gegeven – zeker indien dit onder de verantwoordelijkheid van een gemeente wordt uitgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk (CDA) en Van Baarle (DENK) over het bericht dat commissarissen en bestuurders bij zo'n twintig woningcorporaties privéhuizen blijken te verhuren voor persoonlijk rendement

Two MPs asked the minister about a report that board members and supervisory directors of about twenty housing corporations rent out private homes for personal profit, and whether this is incompatible with their roles. The minister says conflicts of interest must be prevented, endorses a stricter 'no, unless' governance code rule drafted by Aedes and VTW, and says the Autoriteit woningcorporaties sees no reason yet for its own additional measures.
Conflicts of interest (or the appearance of them) must be prevented at all times.
Belangenverstrengeling (of de schijn daarvan) moet te allen tijde worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Beleidsmakers en wetenschappers: afschaffen btw op groente en fruit is ‘effectief en uitvoerbaar’’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Health why the government did not follow a group of experts calling for abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables, given SEO's finding of only a small sales effect and its claim of legal complications. The government, in a caretaker position, said it shares the goal of healthy eating, that the decision on a zero VAT rate is left to the next cabinet, and that it will weigh the measure against alternative health measures without disputing the SEO findings.
Decision-making on whether or not to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables, and on any introduction date, is left by the cabinet, given its caretaker status, to a next cabinet.

Besluitvorming over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit, alsmede over de eventuele invoeringsdatum daarvan, laat het kabinet gezien haar demissionaire status aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op ragen van Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht Koester familiebedrijven, ze dragen de economie

MPs Inge van Dijk, Palland and Amhaouch asked whether family businesses deserve protection and whether the planned tightening of the business succession exemption (BOR) risks harming them, citing commentary by Maarten de Groot. The State Secretary agreed family firms add substantial economic value and should be supported, but rejected claims that the BOR changes would threaten them, citing a CPB evaluation, and promised to report after a pending study requested by a motion.
The cabinet does not expect that the announced adjustments to the BOR will lead to this.
Het kabinet verwacht niet dat de aangekondigde aanpassingen in de BOR hier toe zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government to respond to the final report on administrative burden for volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions, including whether the AVG and Wwft obligations should be relaxed for small organisations and how departments coordinate. The State Secretary answers that burden is a serious problem, points to ongoing talks with the sector, and declines to exempt small organisations from the AVG while promising a fuller response in December.

The cabinet considers it very important to reduce the administrative burden on volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions given the important social value of these organisations in our society.

Het kabinet vindt het erg belangrijk om de regeldruklasten bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen te verminderen gezien de belangrijke maatschappelijke waarde in onze samenleving van deze organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwachts megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs from CDA and BBB asked whether the Ministry of Agriculture gave farmers who converted land to fast-growing forest under the set-aside scheme a promise that the land would remain agricultural, and why the Tax Authority now taxes capital gains on that land. The minister answers that the ministry only commented on the planning designation, which stayed agricultural, while the tax authority applies the agricultural exemption only to periods when land was used within a farm business, so the case is pending before the Supreme Court and no concrete remedy is offered.
Because the case is still before the courts, we follow the line of recent court rulings in this answer and await the Supreme Court's judgment.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is volgen we de lijn van de recente rechterlijke uitspraken in deze beantwoording en wachten we het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het bericht dat de provincie Zeeland geen geld ontvangt uit het Volkshuisvestingsfonds

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked whether Zeeland received no money from the Volkshuisvestingsfonds despite submitting eligible projects, and how regional distribution is decided. The minister replied that Zeeland's 2021 applications scored too low on effectiveness and efficiency, that Utrecht was similarly affected, and that prioritisation for border and shrinkage regions was raised for 2023.

It is important to take regional differences into account, and in line with the answer to question 4 this is further elaborated in the multi-year specific grant scheme for housing restructuring underlying the 2023 Housing Fund.

Het is van belang om rekening te houden met regionale verschillen en in lijn met het antwoord op vraag 4 is dat nader uitgewerkt in de Meerjarige regeling specifieke uitkering herstructurering volkshuisvesting
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Iedere wijk een straatje erbij’

An MP from the CDA asked the housing minister whether municipalities should be made able to add small clusters of affordable homes to neighbourhoods and villages, and how to remove barriers. The minister agreed in principle, said EIB research on practical obstacles is due in August, and said the Ladder for sustainable urban development may be revised, without committing to a firm timetable beyond sending that review before summer.
I am also examining whether an adjustment of the Ladder for Sustainable Urban Development is needed to remove obstacles to building on the edges of cities and villages.
Daarnaast onderzoek ik ook of een aanpassing van de Ladder voor Duurzame verstedelijking nodig is om belemmeringen weg te nemen om te kunnen bouwen aan de randen van steden en dorpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boutkan en Inge van Dijk over de ongelijke fiscale behandeling grenswerkers

MPs Boutkan and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about unequal tax treatment of cross-border workers who work from home, and about negotiations with Germany and Belgium and a possible temporary arrangement like the COVID-era one. The government says it will pursue a bilateral home-working measure with Germany and Belgium, form an EU-level taskforce, and rejects a temporary COVID-style agreement as unsuitable for a permanent solution.
The Netherlands wants to include a home-working measure aimed at cross-border workers in the bilateral tax treaties with Germany and Belgium.
Nederland wil in de bilaterale belastingverdragen met Duitsland en België een thuiswerkmaatregel gericht op grenswerkers opnemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Belasting betalen over geld dat je nooit hebt verdiend: box 3 'desastreus' voor start-ups'

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how the planned box 3 reform, taxing actual returns through an unrealised-gains (vermogensaanwas) tax, would affect startup employees and angel investors, and how this squares with the stock-option rules. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, notes the liquidity problem and that the final design, including a possible realisation-based alternative, is not yet decided, and promises to take the signals into account and consider mitigating measures.
Measures to mitigate the identified liquidity problem are currently being examined.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden om het gesignaleerde liquiditeitsprobleem te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Eigen Huis: subsidieaanvraag voor groen huis rompslomp'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about reports that homeowners find the ISDE green subsidy application cumbersome. The minister acknowledged the procedure can be simpler, pointed to RVO website and form improvements and planned work with stakeholders and behavioural insights, but offered no formal change to the process.
Following the results of the Vereniging Eigen Huis complaints desk, I want to investigate further, using behavioural insights, how the application process can be simplified further.

Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten van het meldpunt van de Vereniging Eigen Huis wil ik met gebruikmaking van gedragsinzichten nog beter onderzoeken hoe het aanvraagproces verder vereenvoudigd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Succesvolle retoursticker voor moeilijke brieven’

An MP asked about a campaign encouraging citizens to return hard-to-understand government letters with a sticker requesting plain language, and about the effectiveness of plain-language covenants. The Secretary of State supports plain language, points to the Direct Duidelijk deal, the Werk aan Uitvoering programme, Belastingdienst letter rewrites and a planned amendment to the Awb on plain-language reasoning, without committing to new oversight measures.
Government organisations must ensure that the person for whom they write can read the letter.
Overheidsorganisaties moeten er namelijk voor zorgen dat degene voor wie zij schrijven de brief kan lezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Schrikbarende’ conclusies in zeer kritisch advies: Den Haag heeft ‘de regio’ stelselmatig verwaarloosd’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether she endorses the advisory report finding that government policy has widened gaps between rich and poor regions, and what steps will address regional neglect, central government visibility, efficiency focus, and regional electoral representation. The minister acknowledges concern, points to Regio Deals and planned responses, and states government will reply to the advisory report before the summer recess, while outlining measures on civil service distribution, participation, and a proposed candidate-vote electoral reform.
As a cabinet we are currently working on a response to the advisory report 'Elke regio telt!'. It will be sent to the House before the summer recess.
We zijn als kabinet op dit moment bezig om te komen tot een reactie op het adviesrapport «Elke regio telt!». Voor het zomerreces zal deze aan de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ministerie plant eindtoets basisscholen tijdens carnaval en suggereert: verplaats carnaval maar’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the 2024 end-of-primary test (doorstroomtoets) clashes with carnival and whether the ministry suggested carnival be moved. The minister says the test window is set by law at the first two full weeks of February, that schools can schedule around carnival, and withdraws the ill-chosen wording suggesting carnival be moved, while stating no change to the test window is planned for now.
In answering a citizen's question there was an unfortunate choice of words, which I hereby withdraw.
Bij het beantwoorden van een burgervraag is sprake geweest van een ongelukkige woordkeuze, die ik hierbij wil terugnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Stel uit Nijverdal krijgt gelijk van rechter: Staat handelde onrechtmatig jegens slachtoffers toeslagenaffaire' en 'Na de klap in Almelo krijgt belastingdie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about two civil court rulings finding the State acted unlawfully toward parents in the childcare benefits scandal, and about their consequences for compensation. The government confirmed the rulings, said it will acknowledge unlawful conduct in similar pending cases, and stated the rulings do not change the Hersteloperatie compensation framework, while promising continued review of faster supplementary compensation.
The State will therefore, for these and similar future cases, acknowledge the unlawfulness of the decision.
De Staat zal voor deze en soortgelijke toekomstige zaken dan ook de onrechtmatigheid van het besluit erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Afhankelijkheid van China moet niet worden herhaald bij 6G'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the role of the ministry in the 6G Future Network Services project, its link to strategic autonomy and reducing dependence on China, SME involvement, Nationaal Groeifonds funding and European cooperation. The minister answers that the ministry co-submitted the proposal, that strategic autonomy is a stated goal, that public funding is necessary, and that European cooperation is being pursued.
Yes, promoting digital and open strategic autonomy is one of the objectives of the project.
Ja, het bevorderen van digitale en open strategische autonomie is een van de doelstellingen van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Peelland Truckrun afgelast vanwege verzekeringskwestie’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about truckruns cancelled over insurance problems, and whether event insurance is becoming scarce for volunteer organisers. The minister answered that the problem stems from an insurance uncertainty about passengers without seatbelts, that insurers cover the trucks and seated, belted passengers, and that there is no sign of a broad insurance problem, so no new government measures are proposed beyond monitoring.
I have no indications that insuring events organised by volunteers in a broad sense is increasingly becoming a problem.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het verzekeren van evenementen die worden georganiseerd door vrijwilligers in brede zin steeds vaker een probleem is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Strolenberg en Inge van Dijk over initiatieven van sportduikers

MPs Strolenberg and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would act so that volunteer sports divers searching for missing persons are no longer treated as occupational diving under the Working Conditions Act, after a court upheld a fine against Signi Zoekhonden. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the outcome is uncertain, points to a project group advising by autumn 2023, and outlines a possible timeline for amending regulations or introducing a transitional arrangement.
I will examine, within the Working Conditions Act and regulations and their objectives, whether and if so which amendments to the statutory provisions are possible and necessary.
Ik zal bezien binnen de Arbowet en -regelgeving en de doelstellingen daarvan of en zo ja welke aanpassingen in de wettelijke voorschriften mogelijk en nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de energieregeling voor openbare zwembaden

An MP asked the minister about closures of several swimming pools and whether they qualify for the public swimming pool energy scheme, which is nearly finalised with applications expected from late May. The minister answered that only De Zeehoek is a public pool eligible, that the others are private and may fall under the TEK scheme, and that heat-network-connected pools are eligible, with a promised further update on SME heat-network cases.
Based on the data known to me, only swimming pool De Zeehoek in Wervershoof is a public swimming pool eligible for the energy scheme for swimming pools.
Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens is alleen zwembad De Zeehoek in Wervershoof een openbaar zwembad dat in aanmerking komt voor de energieregeling voor zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'In de slag om glasvezel blijft geen tegel onberoerd'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about duplicate fibre-optic network rollout in several municipalities, including whether municipalities can prevent it, whether co-investment and a statutory standard dig-rest period should be introduced, and whether the government will take a larger coordinating role. The Minister answered that municipalities cannot in first instance block additional networks under EU and Dutch telecom law, but can impose conditions on works, that no statutory standard period is needed, and that the government will mainly facilitate and inform municipalities.

No, not in the first instance, because under the European Electronic Communications Code and its implementation in the Telecommunications Act, municipalities must tolerate that every provider of a public telecom network may lay such a network in public land.

Nee, in eerste aanleg niet, omdat gemeenten vanuit de Europese Telecomcode (richtlijn (EU)2018/1972) en implementatie daarvan in de Telecommunicatiewet moeten gedogen dat elke aanbieder van een openbaar telecomnetwerk (waaronder een glasvezelnetwerk) een dergelijk netwerk mag aanleggen in de openbare grond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht 'Medewerkers op Schiphol krijgen deze zomer 840 euro per maand extra'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland (CDA) asked about reports that Schiphol staff would receive extra pay via a summer bonus and an allowance rather than a raised collective wage, and about how these payments affect net income, benefit entitlements and repayment risk. The government gave a detailed answer with example calculations showing high marginal tax burdens for some groups, and said it was in contact with Schiphol and the unions, with no new binding commitment beyond existing ones.
I have asked Schiphol whether it is aware of this.
Ik heb Schiphol gevraagd of hier oog voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rechtszaak over trage besluitvorming herstel toeslagenaffaire'

CDA MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about pending lawsuits against the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen over slow decision-making on compensation for childcare-benefit scandal victims, and whether the court's ruling would lead to process or legislative changes. The State Secretary reported 35 substantive appeals and 1,118 non-decision appeals, said a government reaction would follow in the next progress report, and said any changes would depend on the ruling.
I find it valuable that the court gave the opportunity during the hearing to clarify the dilemmas involved in not being able to decide on applications and objections on time.

Ik vind het waardevol dat de rechtbank de gelegenheid heeft geboden om ter zitting de dilemma's toe te lichten die verbonden zijn aan het niet tijdig kunnen beslissen op aanvragen en bezwaarschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Den Haag schiet tekort voor het Limburgs’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior about a report that the Dutch government pays too little attention to the Limburgish dialect, and about calls for legal language rights and wider use in education and media. The minister replied that Limburgish is recognised under the European Charter, that the province of Limburg leads language policy under a 2019 covenant, and that the covenant is being evaluated with results expected in autumn.
At present the Covenant on the Dutch recognition of the Limburgish language is being jointly evaluated by the Ministry of BZK and the Province of Limburg.
Op dit moment wordt het Convenant inzake de Nederlandse erkenning van de Limburgse taal door het Ministerie van BZK en de Provincie Limburg gezamenlijk geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het karakter en het moment van Provinciale Statenverkiezingen

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether provincial elections should focus on provincial issues, be staggered, allow mid-term dissolution of provincial councils, be strengthened by regional media, and be less overshadowed by the Senate election, and whether the 2027 evaluation will assess their use as a national popularity poll. The minister largely declines structural change: she opposes staggering to protect turnout, keeps mid-term dissolution under study without commitment, notes regional broadcasters' efforts, supports the Senate-by-halves bill as giving provincial mandates a purer basis, and promises a survey report on the role of national politics by year end.
I would find that undesirable. In view of the above, I currently have no intention of making proposals that would enable staggering of the state elections.
Ik zou dat onwenselijk vinden. Gelet op het bovenstaande heb ik op dit moment geen voornemens om voorstellen te doen die spreiding van de statenverkiezingen mogelijk maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Overheidsfinanciën in gevaar door verouderde ict van Belastingdienst’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether the outdated Cool:Gen ICT systems behind income and wage tax could be replaced in time, and whether the risks to tax collection were real. The State Secretary answered that the continuity risk is unfounded, the systems are stable but costly to change, a multi-year modernisation portfolio and mitigation measures are in place, and the planning to finish by end 2026 is still feasible.
The fear that the continuity of tax collection is at stake is unfounded.
De vrees dat de continuïteit van de belastingheffing op het spel staat is ongegrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over fossiele subsidies

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked whether the fossil subsidy debate should focus on the carbon pricing gap identified by PBL, whether energy tax on electricity is too untargeted and should be revised, and how the Energy Tax Directive and non-energy use of fossil fuels should be handled. The government answered that carbon pricing analysis is useful, agreed to ask PBL for an update, acknowledged the electricity tax issue and EU negotiations, and said further study of non-energy fossil use is needed.
I will ask PBL to update the 2021 analysis.
Ik zal het PBL vragen om een actualisatie van de analyse uit 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht "Vrijwilligers in de knel door regels fiscus voor vergoeding: "Gedwongen om te stoppen""

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Landelijke Cliëntenraad report showing that rules on volunteer expense allowances are unclear and can harm people on benefits, asking whether the rules should be simplified and the hardships addressed in the Tax Plan 2024. The government acknowledged the concerns but declined to change the scheme now, stating the flat-rate allowance is a cost-reimbursement rule meant to reduce administrative burden, pointing to better communication, and promising the Minister of Social Affairs will consider simplification of the WW and WIA and the Minister for Poverty Policy will alert municipalities to incorrect implementation under the Participatiewet.
On the other hand, it is also important not to lose sight of the character of the scheme, a cost-reimbursement scheme.
Aan de andere kant is het ook van belang om het karakter van de regeling, een kostenvergoedingsregeling, niet uit het oog te verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over gemeenten die voor een dilemma staan over de hoge energiekosten van schaatsbanen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about municipalities facing a dilemma between closing ice rinks or paying large sums because of high energy costs, requesting cost overviews, contract expiry dates, monitoring of the motion-Van Dijk/Van der Laan, and support for Thialf. The minister answered in detail on estimated extra energy costs, monitoring letters, municipal support via the Gemeentefonds, Thialf funding of 1 million euro plus talks on sustainability, and a sustainability taskforce action plan.
It is not possible to monitor precisely how the additional adjustment to the Municipal Fund is used by municipalities.
is het niet mogelijk te monitoren hoe de extra bijstelling op het Gemeentefonds precies door gemeenten wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Compensatie ouders toeslagenaffaire kan zomaar tot 2030 duren’ en het bericht ‘Rutte bestrijdt vrees trage afhandeling toeslagenaffaire’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that compensation for parents in the childcare benefits scandal could last until 2030, and about the Prime Minister's claim that it would not. The State Secretary answered that the government is working to speed up the recovery operation, that there is no single solution, that the ministerial committee meets when needed, and that 90% of assessments are expected to be completed by early 2025.
The aim is to complete the recovery operation as quickly as possible and to ensure that parents and children can take up their lives again.
De inzet is erop gericht om de hersteloperatie zo snel als mogelijk af te ronden en ervoor te zorgen dat ouders en kinderen hun leven weer kunnen oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ook Lelystad Airport omstreden stikstofmarkt op: vliegveld is op zoek naar boeren voor opkoop'

CDA MPs asked ministers whether buying up nitrogen rights by Lelystad Airport and the state-linked Schiphol Group, while PAS-melder farmers remain unresolved, is acceptable, and whether the government should stop it and apply the motion on a transparent nitrogen bank. The minister answered that the airport acts within the principle that initiators must mitigate their own emissions, that it only bought from farms that volunteered, that a nitrogen bank does not yet exist, and that Schiphol's operational permit matters are for its board.
The airport's conduct is in line with the nitrogen policy principle that initiators are themselves responsible for mitigating nitrogen emissions.
Het handelen van de luchthaven is in lijn met het uitgangspunt van het stikstofbeleid dat initiatiefnemers zelf verantwoordelijk zijn om stikstofuitstoot te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Besparing is beter dan financiële compensatie'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about a Catshuis expert roundtable on the budget, its attendees, topics, whether a report would be issued, how the House would be informed, and whether more such sessions are planned. The minister confirmed attendance, explained the expert selection and themes, said no official report would be made but that the spring budget decision would reflect the input, and noted more expert talks are routine before the spring memorandum.
No official report of this Catshuis session will be drawn up.
Er wordt geen officieel verslag van deze Catshuissessie opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over bankzaken op Saba

CDA MPs asked about banking access on Saba, including the Eilandsraad motion, bank and ATM presence, DNB supervision, mortgage access and ATM costs. The State Secretary acknowledged problems, pointed to agreements and a task force, and explained that supervision and market conditions limit options, without committing to a specific new measure.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, I do not have institution-specific information about PSB at my disposal.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van toezicht heb ik geen instelling specifieke informatie over PSB tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'iPhone 14 kan vanaf nu noodoproepen sturen via satellieten'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Apple's satellite emergency SOS feature for iPhone 14 and whether Dutch emergency access (112) could be improved through such technology. The minister answered that the feature offers little added value in the Dutch context given good mobile coverage, notes it routes via Apple call centres and privacy concerns, and said the government would examine a central reporting point for 112 accessibility problems in 2023, after prioritising VoLTE support.
It is also uncertain whether this service will in all cases remain completely free for users and emergency centres, as European regulation requires.
Ook is niet zeker dat deze dienst in alle gevallen volledig gratis blijft voor de gebruikers en alarmcentrale, zoals de Europese regelgeving voorschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Terwijl Amerikanen zwaar materieel aanvoeren voor de oorlog, verkopen EU-staten havens aan China'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about Chinese stakes in European ports, including Dutch ports, and what the Netherlands and EU should do to protect strategic interests. The minister answered that no full overview of Chinese stakes exists, that Dutch port authorities remain publicly owned, that Chinese firms are strongly present in container logistics, and that the government will raise the issue with the Commission, Germany, France and Belgium and push for a joint European approach.
The cabinet does not keep track of this per port.
Het kabinet houdt dit niet per haven bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zwartspaarder spint garen bij schrappen vermogenstaks’

An MP asks whether the Supreme Court's Kerstarrest ruling prevents the tax authority from re-assessing or fining undeclared box 3 wealth from 2017 onward, and whether this is fair to those who objected; the State Secretary replies that re-assessment and fines remain possible for pre-2017 years (12-year period, plus other routes), that post-2017 amounts will be limited by the lower rates under the rechtsherstel legislation, and that a review of fine law is being started, without data on past re-assessments.
The Kerstarrest explicitly does not mean that the Tax Authority can no longer re-assess or fine tax evaders.
Het Kerstarrest brengt nadrukkelijk niet met zich dat de Belastingdienst bij zwartspaarders niet meer kan navorderen of beboeten.
Antwoord op het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nieuwe penningmeester? ‘Door procedures bank al maanden geen pasje

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about long bank processing times, caused by customer due-diligence under anti-money-laundering rules, that prevent newly appointed association treasurers from obtaining a bank card and account. The minister acknowledged the problem, said banks should be more risk-based, and announced talks with the banking association and DNB, without changing the rules themselves.
I agree with DNB that banks' risk-based approach can and must be improved.
Ik ben het met DNB eens dat de risicogebaseerde aanpak van banken beter kan en moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ruim 900 Nederlandse bedrijven in handen van Chinezen: 'Risico op spionage'

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs, Foreign Trade and Justice about a report that 903 Dutch firms are majority-owned by Chinese parents or the state, and what the government will do about economic dependence and espionage risks. The ministers acknowledge the espionage risk and point to existing and planned instruments (investment screening, espionage offence, knowledge security), but say they keep no active overview of ownership structures and give no concrete list of sectors at greatest risk.
The cabinet does not keep an active overview of companies' ownership structures.
Het kabinet houdt geen actief overzicht bij van eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Van der Molen, Knops en Inge van Dijk over studeren op kosten van een brievenbusfirma

MPs asked whether Dutch universities should be subject to anti-money-laundering checks on tuition payments from foreign students, including screening for PEPs and cash payments. The government replied that universities are not obliged institutions under the Wwft, that the National Risk Assessment shows no indication of laundering risk in university services, and that cash tuition payments may be justified in some cases, with the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen receiving about 300,000 euro in cash in 2022.
It is therefore not desirable to make the obligations under the Wwft apply to universities.
Het is daarom niet wenselijk de verplichtingen uit de Wwft voor universiteiten te laten gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht dat gemeenten duurdere gascontracten moeten sluiten

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal asked whether Dutch municipalities should be forced to switch away from Gazprom-linked gas contracts, arguing this benefits Russia, and asked about costs and compensation. The minister answered that SEFE (formerly Gazprom Germania) was nationalised so existing contracts can be kept and no exemption is needed, while confirming municipalities will be compensated for extra costs incurred from switching.
That information is not available at my ministry and is commercially confidential, and was therefore also not shared with us by the company or the German government.
Die informatie is bij mijn ministerie niet aanwezig en is commercieel vertrouwelijk en dus ook niet gedeeld met ons door het bedrijf of de Duitse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Inge van Dijk over universiteitsfondsen nemen meer beleggingsrisico

MPs Van der Molen and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about university funds taking on more investment risk, including staff paid by universities working for the funds, and the transparency of donations. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that public funds must not pay for fund activities, that the minister's role is to clarify the rules via a policy rule, and that the funds are not covered by the higher education act, so transparency cannot be tightened through it.
I think that in these cases state-funded universities should, when asked, have to demonstrate that no public funds are used for staff costs for university funds.
Ik vind dat in deze gevallen rijksbekostigde universiteiten desgevraagd dienen aan te tonen dat er geen publieke middelen worden aangewend voor personeels-kosten ten behoeve van universiteitsfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Internet kan tientallen euro’s goedkoper in Nederland'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether Dutch internet prices are the highest in Europe, whether competition is too weak, and what the government can do to promote competition and regulate dominant providers. The minister replied that prices are relatively high, that the independent regulator ACM (which concluded the market is an oligopoly) is responsible for judging competition, and described the regulatory instruments available to the ACM, including an upcoming market analysis.
It is up to the ACM to form a judgment on competition and tariffs in the internet market.
Het is aan ACM om een oordeel te vellen over de concurrentie en de tarieven op de internetmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ook poging schadeafhandeling ouders toeslagenaffaire te versnellen vertraagd’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the pilot with settlement agreements (vaststellingsovereenkomsten) for 15 childcare-benefit affair parents is delayed beyond the promised 8 to 10 weeks, and whether parents must prove their damages. The government answers that the pilot values parental control and needs more time, that 3 draft damage overviews have been submitted, that the process is being evaluated, and that parents are not required to fully prove damages with documents.
Parents are not asked to prove their complete damage conclusively by means of supporting documents.
Aan de ouders wordt niet gevraagd om de complete schade onomstotelijk te bewijzen door middel van bewijsstukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Engelse voetballer komt uit de kast, nu nog in Nederland’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of openly gay professional male footballers in the Netherlands, low acceptance ratings in football, and the handling of homophobic remarks. The government acknowledged that homophobia does not belong in sport and pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen) but committed to no new concrete action.
Homophobia and negative expressions do not belong in sport and therefore also not in football.
Homofobie en negatieve uitingen horen niet thuis in de sport en dus ook niet in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ombudsman: financiële hulp regelen vaak te moeilijk voor ouderen'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about an Ombudsman report finding that financial support is often too hard for older people to apply for, and about the Inspectorate's similar signal. The State Secretary acknowledged non-take-up of benefits (about 10% for care and rent allowances), outlined outreach campaigns and intermediary networks, and said an evaluation with further data would follow.
Under the Grinwis motion, the ongoing evaluation of the Awir and Toeslagen service delivery will update knowledge on non-take-up of allowances.
5 wordt in de lopende evaluatie van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen (Awir), uitvoering en dienstverlening Toeslagen, kennis over het niet-gebruik van toeslagen geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Vermogenden gebruiken eigen goede doelen als belastingconstructie'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that wealthy people create their own ANBI charities to reduce income tax, including by donating bare ownership of shares or artworks while keeping the income or use, and asked for data on scale, oversight and fixes. The State Secretary confirmed the IBO findings and the risk of abuse, said data on the number of cases is not available, and announced a EUR 250,000 cap on periodic gift deductions from 1 January 2023 plus a broader anti-tax-construction push.

That is why the cabinet intends, as announced in the cover letter to the Tax Plan 2023, to cap the deduction of periodic gifts at EUR 250,000 per taxpayer and any partner together from 1 January 2023.

Daarom is het kabinet voornemens om, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij het Belastingplan 2023, de aftrek van periodieke giften per 1 januari 2023 te begrenzen tot € 250.000 per belastingplichtige en eventuele partner samen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'ING te druk met witwasonderzoek, weert stichtingen en verenigingen'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ING's temporary refusal to open bank accounts for foundations and associations due to anti-money-laundering workload, and whether banks can keep serving such clients. The minister answers that ING's stop is temporary and due to capacity, that banks should apply risk-based customer due diligence without categorical exclusion, and that she is discussing de-risking with banks and DNB, though no signals were received that a foundation cannot open an account anywhere.
I am in discussion with representatives of banks and DNB about the risk-based approach of the Wwft and de-risking.
Ik ben met de vertegenwoordigers van banken en DNB in gesprek over de risicogebaseerde aanpak van de Wwft en de-risking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner, Inge van Dijk en Palland over het beschermen en behouden van maritiem erfgoed.

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about protecting maritime and sailing heritage, including historic houseboats, and about registration, legal anchoring and a plan of action. The State Secretary answered that the national government's role is mainly support and facilitation, that existing registers and designation tools are in place, and that the Erfgoedwet evaluation and a follow-up meeting with the sector will come later.
For the national government, that role lies mainly in support and facilitation in the field of knowledge and expertise.
Voor het Rijk ligt die vooral in ondersteuning en facilitering op het vlak van kennis en kunde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief Beleidsinstrumentarium ten behoeve van de borging van het vestigings- en investeringsklimaat, maatschappelijke langetermijnwaardecreatie en nat

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government views the practical difficulties of applying their adopted amendment bringing campus operators under the investment screening law, and whether it will be implemented. The minister answered that an external study by Birch Consultants and HCSS, started 25 July 2022, will define which firms qualify as campus operators, and that the government intends to implement the amendment depending on the study's findings.
The research assignment shows that I am working on implementing the amendment.
Uit de opdracht tot onderzoek blijkt dat ik werk maak van de uitvoering van het amendement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'hoge prijzen leiden tot miljardenwinst voor olie- en gasbedrijf Shell'

An MP from the CDA asked the government how it views Shell's large profits and share buybacks during the energy price crisis, whether a solidarity levy should be introduced, and how state participation EBN could be expanded. The minister answered that a levy on fossil producers is being examined with a decision due on Prinsjesdag, that the state already receives about 70% of domestic oil and gas profits, and that Shell has committed to investing in the energy transition in the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister about backlogs at the UBO register, whether banks may refuse accounts over missing registrations, and whether guidance is clear. The minister explained the backlog from late registrations, announced a temporary tolerance rule extended to 1 January 2023, and pointed to existing guidance and consultations.
This prevents the temporary peak in processing times from leading to an obstacle to entering into a business relationship.
Dit voorkomt dat de tijdelijke piek in verwerkingstijden zou leiden tot een belemmering voor het aangaan van een zakelijke relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de Circulaire Samenloop vergoedingen raadsleden met een uitkering en het borgen van inclusiviteit in de lokale democratie

Two CDA MPs asked whether municipal councillors receiving WIA disability benefits must surrender 75% of their council allowance, how this compares with Participatiewet rules, and whether the 2015 circular should be updated to promote inclusiveness in local democracy. The ministers answered that the WIA offset rules apply to council allowances, outline the rules by benefit phase, confirm the circular is substantively correct but needs updating, and point to an action plan and a planned website expansion.

However, it indeed needs to be updated because, for example, the decision on the legal position of council and committee members was replaced by the Decision on the Legal Position of Decentralised Political Office Holders as of 2019.

Zij moet echter inderdaad geactualiseerd worden omdat bijvoorbeeld het rechtspositiebesluit raads- en commissieleden per 2019 is vervangen door het Rechtspositiebesluit decentrale politieke ambtsdragers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Drugs per post neemt vlucht: 'Overal ter wereld meer dancefeesten'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked about a report that drug shipments by post were rising sharply and about customs seizures, staff safety, and cooperation with the US and other countries. The government answered that seizures rose from 4,080 in the first half of 2021 to nearly 13,500 in the first half of 2022, attributed partly to increased customs inspection capacity, described safety measures for postal staff, and said cooperation with the US, Australia and New Zealand is intensive, with a joint postal team planned.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘De Kamer van Koophandel moet meer doen aan fraudebestrijding’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether many companies registered at one address indicate illegal trust services, how the Chamber of Commerce and DNB detect such activity, and how data access and enforcement can be improved. The minister explained that domicile provision is regulated under the Wwft and supervised by BTWwft, that DNB acts mainly on signals with limited proactive enforcement, and that a registration obligation for domicile providers is being explored but is difficult to implement.
I will send the study, including my assessment, to your Chamber in the short term.
Ik zal het onderzoek inclusief mijn appreciatie op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Postchaos in ’s-Heer Arendskerke nog niet voorbij: 'Het is nu tijd om verdere stappen te nemen''

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether she knew of ongoing postal delivery failures in 's-Heer Arendskerke and whether she would work with PostNL and the municipality on a structural fix. The minister said delivery problems are caused by labour shortages and similar factors, that PostNL is recruiting and in direct contact with residents, and that ACM supervises and can enforce.
It is up to ACM to supervise this and to take enforcement action where necessary.
Het is aan ACM om hier toezicht op te houden en om zo nodig handhavend op te treden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Havens in Noord-Nederland moeten 'beducht zijn' voor snellere toename drugscriminelen, als Rotterdam overstapt op zwaardere controles’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister and the Finance State Secretary about a report that northern Dutch ports are poorly controlled and vulnerable to drug smuggling if Rotterdam tightens checks, and about whether 100% controls, displacement risks and the 24 million euro package would address this. The government replies that customs, Marechaussee and police have a good information position, that smuggling volumes in northern ports are relatively stable, that it monitors displacement and will not adopt 100% checks on specific goods, and that the structural funds focus on five major hubs with regional funds available for other hubs.

The Politie en Wetenschap research is however a reason to examine, both separately and jointly, what options exist to further strengthen the information position on possible dubious practices in the northern seaports.

Het onderzoek van Politie en Wetenschap is echter wel een aanleiding om, zowel afzonderlijk als in gezamenlijkheid, te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de informatiepositie over de mogelijke malafide praktijken in de Noordelijke zeehavens verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de winsten van oliebedrijven

CDA MPs asked the government whether it considers oil company profits from high energy prices morally acceptable, whether share buybacks and higher dividends are acceptable, what a reasonable profit is, and whether companies invest enough in the energy transition and should contribute more. The minister answers that the government has no moral judgement on lawful profits, that companies may use profits as they see fit, that it will steer investment through carbon pricing, subsidies and tailored agreements, and gives no view on a reasonable profit level.
In general, the cabinet has no moral judgement on profits that profit-seeking companies make, as long as this happens within the rules and they pay fair tax on them.
In algemene zin heeft het kabinet geen moreel oordeel over winsten die bedrijven met een winstoogmerk boeken, zolang dit binnen de regels gebeurt en zij hierover een eerlijke belasting afdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over de mobiele netwerkdekking in Kattendijke

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage in Kattendijke, including a 2016 death where emergency messages reportedly failed. The minister acknowledges patchy coverage, says mobile coverage cannot be guaranteed 100% and recommends fixed lines in some cases, and reports contact with the municipality and operators plus a coverage requirement on 700 MHz licences.
At the same time, it is necessary to acknowledge that it is impossible to guarantee 100% mobile network coverage.
Tegelijkertijd is het noodzakelijk om te erkennen dat het onmogelijk is om 100% mobiele netwerkdekking te garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: zzp’ers en de fiscale oudedagsreserve’

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report showing many self-employed workers claim the fiscal retirement reserve (FOR) without actually setting the money aside for retirement, and about the complexity, efficiency and consequences of the FOR. The State Secretary answered that the FOR is largely a tax deferral tool, that he finds this undesirable, and that the cabinet will propose abolishing the FOR from 1 January 2023 in the Belastingplan 2023.
As part of the Tax Plan 2023, it will be proposed to abolish the FOR.
Als onderdeel van het Belastingplan 2023 zal worden voorgesteld de FOR af te schaffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de mobiele netwerkdekking in Termunten (Groningen)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about poor mobile coverage in Termunten, the state of the KPN-municipality dispute, the Ministry's role, and the status of a motion on unconnected areas. The Minister answers that the municipality is steering operators toward a shared mast near Baamsum, that the Ministry's role is to ensure fixed and mobile connectivity and encourage local antenna policy, and that 112 remains reachable and the motion has been reported on in a separate letter.
I have recently informed your House about this in my letter on the motions Inge van Dijk et al. and Inge van Dijk-Rajkowski.
Ik heb uw Kamer hier recent over geïnformeerd in mijn brief over de moties Inge van Dijk c.s. en Inge van Dijk-Rajkowski.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Recordaantal klachten en vragen over discriminatie in 2021'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a report that discrimination complaints in 2021 were at a record high, mostly concerning disability and chronic illness, and about accessibility, measures under the UN Disability Convention, and the effects of COVID-19. The ministers answered that accessibility remains a matter of awareness, that 88% of respondents complied with rulings, that a 2022 policy approach continues implementation, and that they will continue inclusion efforts and housing and labour market initiatives.
88% of the respondent parties found to be in violation were willing to take measures following a ruling finding a breach of equal treatment legislation.

88% van de in het ongelijk gestelde verwerende partijen waren bereid om maatregelen te treffen naar aanleiding van een uitspraak waarin tot schending van de gelijke behandelingswetgeving werd geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over de gevolgen van een recent gewezen arrest over letselschadevergoedingen

MPs Idsinga and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of a 25 March 2022 Supreme Court ruling on wage tax treatment of injury compensation from workplace accidents, including refund rights and possible financial impact. The State Secretary answered all ten questions, arguing the ruling is new case law that adds a new condition to the 1983 Smeerkuil doctrine, so no ex officio reduction of past assessments and no compensation or specific policy change is required.
I am of the opinion that this is new case law.
Ik ben van mening dat sprake is van nieuwe jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Recordboete voor Belastingdienst vanwege zwarte lijst’

An MP asks whether the record fine imposed by the Data Protection Authority on the Tax Authority over the blacklist can be earmarked to strengthen taxpayers' legal protection, and how the fine flows through the budget. The State Secretary confirms the fine is paid from the Tax Authority budget, reaches the Justice budget via the CJIB, and that the cabinet may propose uses for these funds, but declines to commit to earmarking them for taxpayer legal aid.
I am therefore, ahead of final decision-making, exploring what possible situations a compensation would be appropriate in and what that compensation could be.
Ik ben daarom, vooruitlopend op definitieve besluitvorming, aan het verkennen wat mogelijke opties van situaties zijn waarin een tegemoetkoming passend is en wat dit voor tegemoetkoming kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Zuidaskantoren oefenden invloed uit op publicaties medewerkers belastingrecht'

MPs Van der Molen and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that large law and tax advisory firms influenced publications by UvA tax law staff, and about the balance and ethics of tax law curricula and side jobs. The Minister replied that side jobs are permitted under existing integrity rules and are a university responsibility, promised to discuss transparency with UNL, and said he would await the UvA's independent investigation before drawing conclusions.
I am in discussion with UNL about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met UNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het uitzonderen van sportbeoefening bij mogelijke toekomstige coronamaatregelen

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether sports restrictions remain possible under the sixth extension of the COVID-19 temporary law, whether sport could be designated essential, and how the long-term plan would protect sport. The minister confirmed sports measures stay available, said sport is a priority though not formally essential, and promised a long-term plan and health campaign by June, but did not answer all questions in time.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to provide the answers at this time.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording voor dit moment plaats te laten vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van Der Molen over het bericht 'Wachttijd voor identiteitsbewijzen loopt op tot maanden'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van Der Molen asked about reported months-long waiting times for passports, ID cards and driving licences, and what causes them. The government answered that waiting times are not centrally tracked, that a sample showed up to 13 weeks with most municipalities offering appointments within two weeks, and pointed to Ukrainian refugee registration, elections and seasonal peaks, while declining to extend document validity beyond legal limits.
It is not centrally tracked what the waiting time is at municipalities.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden wat de wachttijd is bij gemeenten.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over de toekomst van de zeilende beroepsvaart

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a 2022 report on financing the future of the sailing commercial fleet (bruine vloot) as maritime heritage, and whether they would consult sector and government partners and answer before the tourism debate. The answer is only a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter on tourism.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'Reaction to committee request on supplementary main lines on tourism' (Parliamentary paper 26 419, no. 96).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «Reactie op verzoek commissie over aanvullende hoofdlijnen inzake toerisme» (Kamerstuk 26 419, nr. 96 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Banken weren contant geld, bedrijven radeloos' en 'Hoe een metaalhandelaar tot wanhoop wordt gedreven door de bank'

CDA MP Inge van Dijk asks the Finance Minister about reports that banks are restricting cash use by businesses, forcing them to cut cash transactions quickly and facing high costs, and about the tension with DNB supervision. The Minister acknowledges the tension, says mitigating measures must be client-specific and proportionate, points to the Convenant Contant Geld with DNB, and commits to no new concrete step beyond advising clients to talk to their bank.
I do not have a complete overview of the banks that take mitigating measures regarding cash.
Ik beschik niet over een volledig overzicht van de banken die mitigerende maatregelen nemen op het gebied van contant geld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder heeft dubbel gevoel bij reclames WOZ-aanslag’

An MP asked the government about rising WOZ property-valuation objections, the profits and public fees of no-cure-no-pay firms, their success rates versus citizens filing themselves, and the Waarderingskamer's advice. The government confirmed the trends, defended low-threshold legal protection including via no-cure-no-pay firms, and promised its reaction to the report before summer.
Yes, it is important that citizens' legal protection against the determination of the WOZ value is low-threshold.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat de rechtsbescherming van de burger tegen de vaststelling van de WOZ-waarde laagdrempelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het T-rijbewijs in de grensregio

Three CDA MPs asked why T-category agricultural licences are not harmonised in the EU, why Belgian and German T-licences are not recognised in the Netherlands, and what cross-border options exist for residents of the border region. The minister answers that T-licences fall outside EU harmonisation, that mutual recognition is being explored pending a comparative study by CBR, and that residence requirements apply, with several questions answered by cross-reference.
The CBR has been asked to produce a comparative overview of the national examination requirements in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
Aan het CBR is gevraagd om een vergelijkend overzicht te maken van de nationale exameneisen in Nederland, België en Duitsland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingexpert: 'Compensatie spaartaks kost maar € 3 miljard en kan rap worden opgelost'' en het artikel 'Een voorstel voor een goed uitvoerbaar

Two MPs (Idsinga, VVD and Inge van Dijk, CDA) asked the State Secretary for Finance about press reports proposing a quick, flat-rate compensation scheme for taxpayers wrongly taxed under box 3 (the savings tax). The State Secretary answered questions 2 to 12 by referring to a separate preparatory letter for a technical briefing, providing no substantive answer in this document.
Questions 2 to 12 are answered, as proposed in question 13, in the 'preparatory letter' sent to the House simultaneously with this reply.
De vragen 2 tot en met 12 worden, zoals voorgesteld in vraag 13, beantwoord in de «voorbereidingsbrief» die gelijktijdig met deze beantwoording aan uw Kamer is gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over correspondentie van de Belastingdienst in reactie op verzoeken van betrokkenen met betrekking tot inzage in hun persoonsgegevens vanwege registratie in de Fraudesignaleri

MP Inge van Dijk asked whether the Tax Authority's formal refusals of access requests about FSV fraud-register data, citing GDPR exceptions in general terms without explanation or contact, are acceptable and whether communication should change. State Secretary Van Rij answered that refusals are needed where oversight or third-party safety is at stake, cannot always be explained, and that the letters will be reviewed for a more human tone while remaining legally sound.
I will have the manner of communication in the context of FSV registration examined further.
Ik laat de wijze van communicatie in het kader van de FSV-registratie nader bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Project Panda: hoe 'kroonjuweel' High Tech Campus toch in buitenlandse handen kwam'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the government did not prevent the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to foreign owners, whether a state stake or Dutch counteroffer was considered, and how campuses can be protected from unwanted takeovers. The minister replied that the ministry checked for national security risks, found none, saw no reason to intervene in a market transaction, rejected a state stake, and judged the investment screening law disproportionate for property deals, pointing to other instruments.
Under the motion by Amhaouch and Inge van Dijk, I am exploring the desirability and feasibility of applying the investment screening bill to real estate transactions involving high-tech campuses.

In het kader van de motie-Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk verken ik de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheid van toepassing van het wetsvoorstel Veiligheidstoets investeringen, fusies en overnames op vastgoedtransacties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over zwembaden die door hoge energieprijzen tot wanhoop gedreven worden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how swimming pools and sports halls facing high energy prices could be kept open and affordable. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to VAT cuts, municipal sports funding for energy costs, and sustainability subsidies, and said a Mulier Institute study is pending.
The Cabinet has proposed several generic measures to mitigate the consequences of this price increase, including lowering the VAT on energy from 21 to 9 percent as of 1 July 2022.
Het Kabinet heeft enkele generieke maatregelen voorgenomen om de gevolgen van deze prijsstijging te dempen waaronder verlaging van de btw op energie van 21 naar 9 procent per 1 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitzending 'Verenigingen bezwijken onder strenge regels’

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asks the Finance Minister about regulatory burden on voluntary associations after a broadcast on their struggles with strict rules, and asks for an overview of relevant laws and dialogue with volunteer organisations. The minister acknowledges the value of associations, lists recent rules (UBO register, VAT for mind sports, GDPR, WBTR) and commits to discuss the impact with the Chamber and volunteer organisations while noting that responsibility is spread across several departments.
The cabinet is willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Raadsleden worstelen met werkdruk’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about reports that municipal councillors struggle with workload, including whether time spent is the main reason for leaving, the effects of decentralisation and inter-municipal cooperation, and whether the 50% volksvertegenwoordigende norm should be adopted. The Minister acknowledges the time-burden problem, notes that the 2004 Leemhuis report sets no 50% norm, and points to measures on councillor support, training and the rechtspositie of councillors.

Through the implementation of the Van Dijk motion, adopted during the Tweede Kamer's handling of the amendment to the Joint Arrangements Act, the development direction of domestic governance is being discussed with the other tiers of government.

Via de uitvoering van de motie-Van Dijk, aangenomen bij de behandeling van de wijziging van de Wet gemeenschappelijke regelingen in de Tweede Kamer, wordt met medeoverheden gesproken over de ontwikkelrichting van het binnenlands bestuur
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over het bericht 'Accijnzen op voorraad diesel en propaan terugvragen tot en met 8 april'

CDA MPs asked why the deadline to claim excise refunds on stocks of diesel and propane was only one week, whether firms without the required EH3 eHerkenning level could still apply, and whether the deadline would be extended. The Secretary of State said the five-working-day term follows from the Excise Act, that applications can also be filed in writing or via DigiD, and agreed to extend the deadline to 13 April.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Hallo, wij hebben 125 mille studieschuld, hoeveel hypotheek krijgen we?'

Two CDA MPs asked whether student debt under the loan system, which reduces mortgage capacity, is fair, whether students were aware it counts, and whether municipalities could guarantee student loans. The minister acknowledged students were not always aware, defended including student debt under the consumer-protection rules, said guarantees add little, and saw no clear state role.
I find it important that the student debt is still taken into account.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de studieschuld wel wordt meegenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Huisartsentekort is doorn in ’t oog voor Gemertse politiek maar die kan het zelf niet oplossen; honderd mensen nu zonder arts'

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about a shortage of GPs in Gemert, where about 100 patients are without a GP, and about the GP-access and insurer duty-of-care framework. The minister says access to GP care is under pressure, points to existing access norms and insurer duties of care, and says the regional GP-training distribution is not available but is being discussed.
I do not have this information available.
Deze informatie heb ik niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ik dacht dat beleggen voor vermogende mannen was

An MP asked the Finance Minister about research by ABN Amro and McKinsey showing women invest less, feel less supported by banks, and face more difficulty obtaining financing, and asked whether action and greater financial literacy were needed. The minister agreed the situation is undesirable, pointed to the Wijzer in geldzaken partnership and its toolkit, and said banks can improve their treatment of female clients, without committing to a concrete new step.
I find it very undesirable that women relatively experience more barriers in financial services and have fewer opportunities to obtain financing.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst als vrouwen relatief meer barrières ervaren in de financiële dienstverlening en minder kansen krijgen bij het aantrekken van financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemers: Stel UBO-register uit tot uitspraak Europese Hof’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the Finance Minister whether the UBO register registration deadline should be postponed pending a CJEU ruling, and about privacy protection of beneficial owners. The minister answered that the Advocate-General's opinion is not binding, that Dutch practice already largely follows its points, that no grounds exist to postpone the deadline, and that the privacy impact will be evaluated after one and four years.
I therefore see no reason, or legal basis, to postpone the legally established registration deadline.
Daarmee zie ik dan ook geen reden, of grondslag, tot uitstellen van de wettelijk vastgelegde registratiedeadline.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de aanleg van glasvezel in het Westland

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the absence of fibre-optic internet in the Westland rural area, the cause of the withdrawal of Delta Fiber, and possible government intervention. The minister explained that high construction costs due to the area's complexity made fibre unviable, that upgraded coax networks will deliver at least 200 Mbps, and that a study into hard-to-reach areas is underway, with results to be sent to parliament this quarter.
I expect that your House can be informed this quarter about the outcomes of the ongoing research and the next steps.
Ik verwacht dat uw Kamer nog in dit kwartaal kan worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van het lopende onderzoek en de vervolgstappen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over het mogelijk verdwijnen van de Bredabus n.a.v. het bericht van omroep Zeeland ‘Van Zeeland tot Breda: politici willen Bredabus koste wat k

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary whether he shares concerns about the possible loss of bus line 19 (Bredabus) between Hulst and Breda, the proposal to end it at Antwerp, and what can be done to prevent public transport decline in Zeeland. The State Secretary answered that public transport is important, that the province of Zeeland (the responsible authority) wants to keep the link but faces rising costs, that the province is talking with NS about student travel, and that decentralised authorities bear responsibility for service design.
The responsible public transport authority, the province of Zeeland, has informed me that it also sees the importance of the Hulst-Breda link and therefore wishes to keep it.
De verantwoordelijke OV-autoriteit, de provincie Zeeland, heeft me laten weten ook het belang van de verbinding Hulst-Breda te zien en wil deze daarom ook graag behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Knops over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

CDA MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that a FIOD special operations team was sent home for months over an allowance dispute and alleged fear-based management culture. The State Secretary declined to discuss specifics because of the labour and court proceedings, denied knowledge of such a culture without signals, and said efforts were underway to find a quick solution.
This is a labour-law dispute between employees and their employer. I cannot make any public statements about it.
Er is hier sprake van een arbeidsrechtelijk geschil tussen werknemers en hun werkgever. Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘verdrievoudiging van bedreigingen en geweld tegen gemeenteraadsleden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked about a report that threats and violence against municipal councillors had tripled since 2015, and about support, aftercare and measures against intimidation. The minister responded that the government works with the Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur on norms, prevention and aftercare, will report monitoring results before summer, and that the doxing bill will be sent to parliament after the Council of State advises.
I consider it important to periodically monitor how the number and form of intimidation and threats against councillors and other local political office holders develop.
Ik vind het belangrijk om periodiek te monitoren hoe het aantal gevallen en de vorm van intimidatie en bedreiging onder raadsleden en andere decentrale politieke ambtsdragers zich ontwikkelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Inge van Dijk en Peters over noodverordening op en rond azc Budel na steekpartijen

MPs Kuik, Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and stabbings at the Budel asylum centre and the emergency ordinance that followed, including causes, short- and long-term actions and consequences for perpetrators' asylum claims. The State Secretary acknowledged serious incidents, listed security measures agreed with the mayor, the Commissioner of the King, and COA, and explained the legal grounds for refusing protection to offenders.
Of course I will inform your House of the outcomes of the research into options for action.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar handelingsperspectieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Europese Rekenkamer: uitrol 5G te traag en te versnipperd'

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Rajkowski (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the European Court of Auditors' report on slow, fragmented 5G rollout, including the digital divide, cybersecurity coordination, rollout pace, EU funding, data protection, compensation for replacement costs and local licence holders. The minister largely endorsed the report's conclusions but rejected a common EU quality standard, said the rollout is on track, and promised an advisory report by 1 May 2022 and to inform parliament, while deferring some EU matters to the Commission and noting national security competence.
As soon as I have received the advice, I will inform your House about the advice and the next steps and further planning.
Ik zal zodra ik het advies heb ontvangen, uw Kamer over het advies en over de vervolgstappen en nadere planning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Familiebedrijf Balk Shipyard in Chinese handen'
