MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported takeover of family shipyard Balk Shipyard by a Chinese investment group, including fit with industrial policy, financing instruments, screening under the investment screening law, and whether the firm will stay on Urk. The minister answered that the takeover is welcomed for enabling growth, that no screening obligation appears to apply, and that no reason exists to expect the firm to leave, while giving only generic information about the investor and no commitments on local agreements.
The cabinet does not collect information on business locations, corporate or ownership structures of companies unless required by laws and regulations.
Het kabinet verzamelt geen informatie over vestigingslocaties, bedrijfs- en/of eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven zolang dit niet is vereist voor wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Wall Street aast op de Nederlandse camping' en 'Steeds meer Nederlandse vakantieparken in bezit van roofinvesteerders'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that holiday parks and campsites in the Netherlands are increasingly acquired by foreign investors, and what government can do about it. The government answered that two motions on the topic were adopted and that it will commission a study on acquisitions, impacts on owners and tenants, nature and spatial planning, with results expected in Q2 2022.
I will have this study carried out together with the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
Ik zal dit onderzoek samen met de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat uit laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het artikel 'Juridische fuik overheid maakt burgers 'kansloos''

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the government about press reports that strict Awb deadlines leave citizens powerless when they file late objections, and about the 'bestuurlijke lus' and the citizen's ability to navigate the law. The minister says the Awb will be revised, citing a 2021 change in case law softening late-objection rules, and promises to examine a 'burgerlijke lus' and to consider more lenient handling of deadlines in two-party disputes.
In this context it is being examined whether to give administrative bodies more room to substantively handle an objection that was not filed within six weeks.
Hierbij wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid om meer ruimte te bieden voor bestuursorganen om een niet binnen zes weken ingediend bezwaar alsnog inhoudelijk te kunnen behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Arrest vermogenstaks volgend hoofpijndossier voor fiscus'

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Finance, after two court rulings finding the current box 3 wealth tax unlawful, whether the tax can stay in place until 2025, what could be done to bring forward a tax based on actual returns, and when the cabinet will respond. The State Secretary replies that the current legislation is not in line with the Supreme Court ruling, that keeping it until 2025 is undesirable, that options to amend it earlier are being studied, and that a debate is scheduled for 2 February.
The legislation is currently not in line with the Supreme Court ruling.
De wetgeving is momenteel niet in lijn met het arrest van de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'Meer dan miljoen spaarders lopen fiscale teruggave mis door wetswijziging'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that over a million savers may miss box 3 tax refunds because of the 2016 change to the mass objection procedure, asking about objection numbers, budgetary effects, and how the government will handle the Supreme Court ruling and pending ECtHR cases. The State Secretary answered that about 120,000 objections were lodged, the scope of the group eligible for redress is not yet determined, budget impacts are being mapped, and the government will inform parliament once options are clear.
Once the elaboration is clear, I will inform the House about this.
Zodra de uitwerking helder is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Huizentekort? Schaf de straf op samenwonen af’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an article claiming that cohabitation can cause large net income losses through tax and benefit rules, pushing people to keep two homes; the questions included worked examples of losses for single-parent and pensioner couples. The government answered that cohabitants share living costs, that the outcomes reflect the ability-to-pay principle, that the examples look different once cost-sharing is standardised, and that it plans to stop counting young adults up to 27 as cost-sharers under the benefit rule.
I cannot estimate the extent to which the situations described in the article occur in practice.
Ik kan geen inschatting maken van de mate waarin de in het artikel beschreven situaties zich in de praktijk voordoen.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Van den Berg, Inge van Dijk  en Van der Laan over het volgens het kabinet benodigde onderzoek om de sportsector toe te voegen aan de groep van essentiële sectoren

MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether the research needed before adding the sports sector to the essential sectors (per the Van den Berg motion) is finished, and what additional research is still required given existing studies on fitness and sport participation. The minister said the government considers sport a high priority, cites its own consideration of existing studies and OMT advice, and reports that a large part of sport was allowed again from 14 January 2022.
That is why the cabinet has stated that sport is a high priority, even though it does not fall under the definition of essential retail and/or services.
Daarom heeft het kabinet uitgesproken dat sport een hoge prioriteit heeft, ook al valt het niet onder de definitie van essentiële detailhandel en/of dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onderzoekscommissie: DNB schoot tekort in toezicht op verzekeraar Conservatrix'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the evaluation committee's findings that DNB fell short in supervising insurer Conservatrix, and about relief for 92,000 affected policyholders. The minister said a fuller response, including DNB's input on implementing the recommendations, will follow in March, and that the curators are responsible for winding up the insurer and policyholder outcomes are not yet settled.
The aim is to send a comprehensive response to the report to the House in March.
Het streven is om een uitgebreide reactie op het rapport in maart aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Blijvende inspanning gemeenten betaalt zich nog niet terug’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities bearing unreimbursed costs for supervising former unaccompanied minors and about the lack of reception places, as motion-Van Dijk ('no extra tasks without money') was adopted. The Minister answered that a one-off 10 million euro payment is being arranged for 2022, but that structural funding and compensation are left to a future cabinet.
Whether and how this extended care should be financed structurally is a matter a next cabinet will have to consider.
Over de vraag of en op welke wijze deze verlengde opvang op structurele wijze gefinancierd dient te worden, zal een volgend kabinet zich moeten buigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Soms lang reizen om geld te pinnen'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that people must travel far to withdraw cash after cash machines disappeared, and whether the five-kilometre access norm still holds. The minister affirms cash access as important, states the norm is met (99.62% coverage) and that Geldmaat places machines where demand is, while noting that longer trips can be inconvenient.
I attach importance to good access to cash machines.
Ik hecht belang aan een goede toegang tot geldautomaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de artikelen “Toezichthouder waarschuwt voor risico’s onverstandig beleggen” en “AFM vreest financiële problemen bij deel “doe-het-zelfbeleggers”

The CDA MP asks the Finance Minister about AFM warnings that many execution-only retail investors act unwisely and are vulnerable if markets or housing turn, and about the status of banning negative savings rates. The minister acknowledges the risks, points to financial literacy, European retail investment strategy work and existing mortgage measures, and says the negative-rate ban question remains open with a commitment to revisit it if access to non-negative-rate banks is significantly restricted.
I consider it important that consumers realise they must always keep a liquid savings buffer to absorb an unforeseen expense or a drop in income.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat consumenten beseffen dat zij altijd een liquide spaarbuffer moeten aanhouden om een onvoorziene uitgave of terugval in inkomsten op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over 'gemeenten helpen gedupeerden toeslagaffaire: 'Het kan in kleine dingen zitten''

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority matches municipalities in the human approach to childcare benefits scandal victims, whether municipalities are overburdened with objections and default notices, and how cooperation and compensation work. The State Secretary answers that a personal approach is central, that UHT assigns personal case handlers, that cooperation has improved through contact points and consultations, and that municipal support is funded via a specific grant, while promising a revision (herijking) letter with proposals.

In the letter on the revision that will be sent to your House together with these answers, I will go further into the conclusions from those conversations and the steps I will take to improve the process for parents.

In de brief over de herijking die gezamenlijk met de beantwoording van deze vragen naar uw Kamer wordt verzonden, ga ik dieper in op de conclusies uit die gesprekken alsmede welke stappen ik ga nemen om het proces voor ouders te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Een miljoen 'ongebruikelijke' transacties maar weinig aanhoudingen''

An MP asked the government about a report of a million unusual transactions yet few arrests, the mismatch between bank reporting staff and the limited FIU and police capacity, the effectiveness of the anti-money-laundering law, and steps to improve it. The minister answered that reporting is a key preventive part of the system, that capacity at the FIU is being expanded to 90 fte, that a 2019 action plan and pending FATF and Court of Audit reviews are underway, and that the government will keep monitoring but could not say how often reports lead to convictions.

For the reasons above, it cannot be stated how often a report of an unusual transaction that the FIU-Nederland has declared suspicious ultimately leads to a concrete criminal investigation or conviction.

Om bovenstaande redenen kan niet worden aangegeven hoe vaak een melding van een ongebruikelijke transactie die door de FIU-Nederland verdacht is verklaard, uiteindelijk leidt tot een concreet opsporingsonderzoek of veroordeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Problemen met kwetsbare 112-meldkamers na zes jaar nog niet opgelost’

MPs Palland and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about reports that vulnerable 112 emergency control rooms remain unresolved after six years, including staffing, responsibility fragmentation, ICT investigation and implementation of inspection recommendations. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the concerns are shared and a multi-year transition is underway, but largely defended the existing governance split, promised a WODC evaluation in 2022, periodic updates and a mobile coverage map by spring 2022.
I therefore do not share the supervisors' view on this point.
Ik deel het standpunt van de toezichthouders op dit punt dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Inge van Dijk over wederom een bericht over matchfixing

MPs Van der Laan and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government will act on KNVB calls for further investigation into possible matchfixing in youth football, whether betting operators monitor these competitions, and whether an OM study on criminalising matchfixing will be shared with parliament. The minister says the Signalenoverleg Sportfraude will discuss the signals, that betting on the Onder 21 competition is prohibited, and that the OM study is still being advised on, with parliament to be informed later.
Your House will be informed about the advice afterwards.
Uw Kamer wordt daarna geïnformeerd over het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toename afsplitsingen in lokale politiek: al 150 nieuwe fracties’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that around 46% of municipal councils have seen councillors split off to form their own factions since 2018, and whether the minister's earlier call to discourage such splits had been heeded. The minister confirmed the figures come from NRC research, said the VNG considers discouraging splits undesirable given the personal mandate of councillors, and committed to a circular encouraging municipalities to adopt reading-rule measures and to re-engaging the VNG.
In my view, including such provisions in the municipal council's rules of procedure would be a suitable way to discourage splits.
Mijns inziens zou het opnemen van dergelijke bepalingen in het reglement van orde van de gemeenteraad een geschikte wijze van het ontmoedigen van afsplitsingen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de voortgang afhandeling waterschade in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Security Minister about the progress of flood damage compensation in Limburg and Brabant, covering teeltplanschade interpretation, communication, helpdesks, processing times, turnover compensation, the Maas floodplains, EU solidarity funding, and climate resilience for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that productie loss is assessed per crop, outlined communication channels and a helpline, said turnover loss is not covered by the Wts and that a decision on compensation is still under exploration, and declined to set a timeline for some questions.
For determining crop plan damage, the production loss is assessed per company per production direction.
Voor de bepaling van de teeltplanschade wordt per bedrijf per productierichting gekeken naar het productieverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Fort uit Tachtigjarige Oorlog staat op instorten'

Two CDA MPs asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister about reports that Fort Crèvecoeur from the Eighty Years' War is at risk of collapse, including its European heritage nomination, a dispute with 's-Hertogenbosch, the 2010 agreement, steps taken, municipal powers and repair costs. The minister answered that the Ministry of Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are preparing a decision on urgent consolidation measures, that costs are commercially confidential, and that the municipality lacks enforcement powers because the fort is a national security matter under the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management.
The expected costs are for the time being commercially confidential.
De te verwachten kosten zijn vooralsnog commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Ierse privacywaakhond onderzoekt hoe TikTok gegevens van kinderen verwerkt'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked about TikTok's processing of children's data, the Irish DPC investigation, and related Dutch actions. The minister replied that the Dutch AP fined TikTok in 2021, transferred its 2020 investigation to the Irish DPC, has no evidence of data sharing with China, and will follow the DPC's second investigation while a cybersecurity study for apps is being commissioned.
The AP cannot make any statements about the content of that investigation.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan de AP geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het artikel 'De Tweede Kamer opnieuw geschoffeerd…'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked why the State Secretary no longer responded integrally to comments from the NOB and RB on tax bills, and whether this practice would continue, asking for prompt answers before the debate. The State Secretary defended selective answering as avoiding duplication with MPs' own questions and promised a reply to the NOB and RB comments shortly.
The cabinet will respond to the comments of the NOB and the RB in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de commentaren van de NOB en het RB op korte termijn van een reactie voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'High Tech Campus niet naar Amerikanen, maar in handen van Singaporese staat'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a consortium led by Singapore's GIC, probing motives, legality, national security, and whether government can regain control. The minister answered that the sale was a lawful private market transaction cleared by the ACM, with no national security risks found, that it cannot be reversed, and that the proposed investment screening law would not apply.
It is not for the Dutch government to address the commercial motives underlying the investment.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om in te gaan op welke commerciële motieven ten grondslag liggen aan de investering.
Antwoord op vragen Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Banken huilen krokodillentranen om negatieve spaarrente'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance whether small savers below €100,000 will face negative interest rates, how to view bank profits alongside negative savings rates, and whether banks can be pressed to pass benefits to savers, and asked about anti-money-laundering costs and Denmark's threshold. Minister Hoekstra answered that he will reconsider legislation if savers' options at non-negative-rate banks become significantly limited, that banks are private and set their own pricing, and that he will share an updated DNB report on the low-rate environment.
If those options are significantly restricted, I will take up the matter again and consider legislation, where appropriate.
Indien die mogelijkheden significant worden beperkt neem ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand en overweeg ik, indien opportuun, ook wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Peters over Europese Missie voor 100 klimaat neutrale steden tegen 2030

MPs from the CDA asked how the Dutch government will engage with the EU Cities Mission (100 climate-neutral cities by 2030), including its role in the City Climate Contract, selection criteria and funding. The State Secretary answers that BZK and EZK coordinate the mission, that the government will decide later whether to co-sign contracts, that selection is up to cities, and that about EUR 300 million is reserved at EU level without geographic earmarking.
Whether the national government should play a major role in this and how that could take shape is not yet clear at this moment.
Of de rijksoverheid hierin een grote rol moet spelen en hoe dat vorm zou kunnen krijgen, is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Inge van Dijk over studenten die beleggen met een DUO-lening

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that students borrow student loans to invest, and whether this should be prohibited. The minister disagrees that it is sensible, says the loan is not meant for investing and that a ban is unenforceable, but will improve student information and has asked the Nibud to address it.
It is not prohibited to use the student loan to invest in it.
Het is niet verboden om de studielening te gebruiken om mee te beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Peters over het artikel 'Mogelijk honderden kinderen uit gezinnen die de dupe waren van toeslagenaffaire, zijn uit huis geplaatst'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked whether children were taken from home as a result of wrongly imposed childcare-benefit repayments, and what the state is doing to reunite families. The government says it does not yet know how many families are affected, that financial problems alone are no legal ground for removal, and that it is working on a recovery programme and a route via municipalities.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had to deal with an out-of-home placement or reinstatement.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over ‘de onwerkbare situatie voor zwerfdierstichtingen’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister about legal uncertainty and impracticable rules for dog-rescue foundations under EU animal health law, illegal dog trade and registration obligations. The minister acknowledged the signals, explained that the regime applies to commercial movements of dogs, promised communication efforts, a regulatory aid tool and talks with the foundations, while declining to confirm or deny claims about illegal trade and forged passports.
The suspicion is that these numbers are considerable, but because of their illegal nature, exact figures are unknown.
Het vermoeden is dat deze aantallen behoorlijk zijn maar vanwege de illegale aard ervan zijn exacte cijfers onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch , over het bericht ‘Opnieuw problemen met Keolis-bussen die plotseling uitvallen'

MPs from the CDA asked the government about recurring failures of BYD-built Keolis buses in the Overijssel emergency concession, including whether provinces can exclude foreign manufacturers and how the EU International Procurement Instrument would affect bus procurement. The minister replied that the faults were limited and did not endanger safety, that provinces have limited ability to set origin requirements for privately purchased buses, and that the IPI would apply to public tenders but not private purchases, with information to provinces to follow once it takes effect.
In theory the province could purchase the buses itself, but in practice this almost never happens.
In theorie zou de provincie de bussen zelf kunnen inkopen, maar in de praktijk gebeurt dit vrijwel nooit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Weer schrik door storing bij fiscus'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary of Finance about erroneous tax penalty letters sent to businesses after an IT disruption at the Tax Authority, asking how many were affected, how the error occurred, whether COVID payment-deferral applicants were affected, and how to inform and compensate them. The State Secretary answered that 37,700 entrepreneurs wrongly received assessments and fines due to a human error during disruption repair, that affected businesses are being informed by letter and will not need to object, that costs for legal aid may be reimbursed under normal rules, and that a structural system replacement is being prepared.
In total, 37,700 entrepreneurs were wrongly issued a additional assessment and a late-filing fine.
In totaal hebben 37.700 ondernemers onterecht een naheffingsaanslag en een aangifteverzuimboete opgelegd gekregen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over schriftelijke vragen van 27 augustus 2021 over de beantwoording van prejudiciële vragen van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden door de Hoge Raad van 2 juli 2021

MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance to respond urgently to earlier written questions about the Supreme Court's answers to preliminary questions from the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court, since taxpayers face deadlines in their objection procedures. The State Secretary acknowledged the urgency, said the questions could not be answered within a week, and stated that taxpayers lose no rights and that the normal statutory objection procedure still applies, with the tax authority not suspending individual objections.
Nevertheless, I hope and expect that taxpayers will take from the answers the reassurance that they do not lose any rights and that their legal position is not harmed.
Niettemin hoop en verwacht ik dat belastingplichtigen uit de beantwoording van de vragen de geruststelling halen dat zij geen rechten verliezen en dat hun rechtspositie niet wordt geschaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van den Berg over het artikel 'Bas van den Dungen toezichthouder bij Amphia'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Interior whether a top civil servant's secondary position on a hospital supervisory board was properly approved. The minister answered that the procedure under the civil service rules and integrity code was followed, with tailored conditions, and saw no obstacle to the role.
I see no obstacle to exercising this secondary position.
Ik zie geen belemmering voor het uitoefenen van deze nevenfunctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de beantwoording van prejudiciële vragen van het Hof Arnhem-Leeuwarden door de Hoge Raad van 2 juli 2021

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Authority refuses to hold the individual part of box 3 tax objections in abeyance while the Supreme Court's collective (mass objection) procedure runs, and whether taxpayers risk losing individual rights. The State Secretary answers that the individual and collective questions are separate, that taxpayers can withdraw the individual part without losing collective rights, and that holding them in abeyance would impose an administrative burden, while the answer to the questions was not given within one week.
Withdrawing the objection insofar as it concerns the individual, specific issue of the taxpayer therefore does nothing to affect the taxpayer's rights in the mass objection procedure.

Het intrekken van het bezwaar voor zover dat ziet op de individuele, specifieke kwestie van de belastingplichtige doet dus niets af aan de rechten van de belastingplichtige in de massaalbezwaarprocedure
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Afhandeling toeslagenaffaire loopt opnieuw vast, slachtoffers in geldnood'

An MP asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade backlog for victims of the childcare benefits affair, which leaves some parents in financial distress, is acceptable and how it will be resolved. The Secretary of State acknowledged the backlog and expects it to shorten, but denied urgent distress cases and said the agencies coordinate well.
The waiting list that has arisen at the CWS is obviously undesirable, but it does not create urgent distressing situations as described in the article.
De wachtlijst die is ontstaan bij de CWS is vanzelfsprekend onwenselijk, maar hierdoor ontstaan geen urgente schrijnende situaties zoals beschreven in het artikel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het artikel “Het belastingstelsel zit intussen vol met fouten”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Elsevier article listing errors in the tax system is accurate, whether the examples (marginal tax pressure, the treatment of certain income components, alimony, the IACK child credit timing, savings BVs for allowances, and box 3 taxation) are justified, and whether a fix and an overview of unintended effects will be provided before Budget Day. The State Secretary generally agrees that trade-offs cause friction, defends most examples as consistent with policy goals, promises to pursue a box 3 return-based tax in preparation for a new cabinet, and says the questions could not be answered before Prinsjesdag.
In general terms I agree that bottlenecks can arise in the current tax system.
In algemene zin ben ik het ermee eens dat er knelpunten kunnen optreden in het huidige belastingstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Vier grote radiozenders dreigen 7- tot 13-voudige te moeten betalen voor verlenging FM-vergunning'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the renewal prices for commercial FM radio licences are 7 to 13 times higher than current fees, and whether this conflicts with a motion calling for proportionate fees. The State Secretary defended the SEO-calculated, market-conform prices as based on the licences' future earning potential under the Telecommunications Act and state-aid rules, provided the SEO report, and described consultation with the sector and the next procedural steps.
I have therefore, as with previous extensions, asked SEO Economic Research (SEO) to come with an independent advice.
Ik heb daarom, net als bij eerdere verlengingen, SEO Economisch Onderzoek (SEO) gevraagd met een onafhankelijk advies te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de opschalingskorting op het gemeentefonds

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the municipal fund cut ('opschalingskorting'), its amounts, efficiency basis, legality under municipal finance law, and whether it will be frozen in 2022. The minister answered in full, stating the cut is not tied to new tasks, and confirmed the government decided to freeze its increase for 2022 as well.

I am of the view that the scale-up cut complies with the legal standards for deductions from the municipal fund under article 2 of the Financial Relations Act and article 108 of the Municipalities Act.
Ik ben van mening dat de opschalingskorting voldoet aan de wettelijke normen voor uitnamen uit het gemeentefonds van artikel 2 Financiële-verhoudingswet en artikel 108 Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ouderen in geldproblemen door sluiting bankkantoren: 'Grote stille armoede aan het ontstaan".

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that closures of bank branches and digitalisation are causing financial problems for elderly people, and how many banks and access points remain. The minister acknowledged the signals, pointed to a Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer action plan on accessibility, and said the threshold is accessibility of services rather than a number of branches.
My lower limit therefore lies in the accessibility of the service, not specifically in the number of bank branches.
Mijn ondergrens ligt dan ook in de toegankelijkheid van de dienstverlening, niet specifiek in het aantal bankkantoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de postbezorging in Kattendijke

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about postal delivery problems in Kattendijke and whether PostNL would be asked to find a structural solution with the municipality and residents. The State Secretary answered that PostNL acknowledged delayed deliveries caused by non-compliance with its quality norms, apologised, redelivered the post, and took measures, and that no regions currently show structural labour shortage problems.
Yes, I have made inquiries with PostNL.
Ja, ik heb navraag gedaan bij PostNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over de schadevergoeding na de wateroverlast in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked why the compensation area for the July 2021 flood damage in Limburg and North Brabant does not match the area actually affected, and whether businesses outside it should be compensated. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that compensation is limited to the legally defined damage area under the Wts, that businesses outside it cannot be covered under current law, and that the government will discuss turnover losses with the region in the fourth quarter.
Outside this area there is no disaster as referred to here.
Buiten dit gebied is er geen sprake van een ramp als hiervoor bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rechtbank: Vermogensbelasting is discriminerend voor spaarders'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that the box 3 wealth tax discriminates against savers, and urged faster reform, retroactive remedy, and a firm deadline. The State Secretary answered that the appeal cases are pending before the Supreme Court, that retroactive redress is premature, and that a contour note on taxing actual returns will be presented in 2021, with the decision left to the next cabinet.
Providing legal redress does not fit within the ongoing mass objection procedures for 2017 and 2018 and is moreover premature.
Het bieden van rechtsherstel past niet in de nog lopende massaal bezwaarprocedures over de betreffende jaren 2017 en 2018 en is bovendien prematuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Portugal, België en Luxemburg ontvangen eerste geld EU-herstelfonds'

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, including the status of the Dutch recovery plan, stakeholder consultation, deadlines and competitiveness effects. Minister Blok answered that the plan will be drafted after the new cabinet decides its content, that consultation with stakeholders will follow, and that the Netherlands still has time to submit before summer 2022.
That is why it was chosen to let the new cabinet decide on the content of the plan.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen om het nieuwe kabinet een besluit te laten nemen over de invulling van het plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over mobiele bereikbaarheid en overal in Nederland 112 kunnen bellen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about poor mobile coverage for emergency number 112 in various Dutch regions, requesting a coverage map and additional measures. The State Secretary answered that 112 is reachable on all networks, via WiFi and abroad, that 100% coverage is physically impossible, that a 2015 study found coverage adequate, and that a coverage map and possible measures for 'white areas' will follow by early 2022.
A map showing the combined outdoor coverage of the mobile networks is currently being created.
Er wordt momenteel gewerkt aan het creëren van een kaart die de gezamenlijke buitenhuisdekking van de mobiele netwerken inzichtelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de belastingheffing over Duitse oorlogsgerelateerde uitkeringen

MP Inge van Dijk asked whether the twelve-year back-assessment period could be used for income tax and social premiums on German war-related benefits, whether penalties apply, whether heirs are liable, and why GDPR is applied to protect possible war criminals when the Tax Authority breached GDPR in fraud enforcement. The State Secretary answered that the twelve-year period applies to assets held abroad case by case, that understatement fines require intent or gross negligence, that heirs are liable, and that the Tax Authority has no information on convictions and the data-protection improvement programme is ongoing.
Moreover, the Tax Authority may not hold such (criminal) information, since this information is not relevant and necessary for the Tax Authority's statutory task.

Bovendien mag de Belastingdienst niet over dergelijke (strafrechtelijke) informatie beschikken, aangezien deze informatie niet relevant en noodzakelijk is voor de wettelijke taak van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Banken sluiten negatieve rente voor kleinere spaarders niet uit’

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asks the Finance Minister about banks possibly charging negative interest to small savers, the government's role, state-owned bank options, margins, and whether a ban is needed. The minister answers that most savers face no negative rate, DNB is updating its analysis, and a legal ban is not proportionate at present, though legislation will be reconsidered if options for ordinary savers significantly narrow.
Should those options significantly narrow in the future, I will take up the subject again and, where appropriate, consider legislation.
Mochten die mogelijkheden in de toekomst significant worden beperkt dan zal ik het onderwerp opnieuw ter hand nemen, en indien opportuun ook wetgeving overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Snels, Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over de noodzaak om zo snel als mogelijk financiële instellingen verplichten over klimaatrisico’s te rapporteren

MPs asked the Finance Minister about speeding up mandatory climate-risk reporting by financial institutions, including the TCFD framework, its alignment with the EU's proposed revision of the non-financial reporting directive, and the timing of EU and IFRS standards. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU-level harmonisation over a national patchwork, and that it will assess the Commission proposal via a BNC-fiche and pursue international convergence rather than launch national legislation now.
The cabinet wants to work towards a swift and prompt completion of the European process and its implementation in our national laws and regulations.
Het kabinet wil zich inzetten voor een voortvarende en spoedige afronding van het Europese traject en implementatie daarvan in onze nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het feit dat de Belastingdienst ervoor gezorgd heeft dat ouders onterecht weer zijn belaagd door deurwaarders

An MP asks the state secretary how the Tax Authority (Toeslagen) sent an incomplete list of harmed parents to bailiffs, causing renewed collection letters, and what remedies, accountability and prevention measures exist. The secretary admits the list was incomplete (about 6,000 parents missing), apologises, says no executions are being carried out, promises corrective data sharing, stricter checks, a working group and a review, and says the Tax Authority is liable for extra costs.
Unfortunately, this check was carried out on the basis of the specification for delivering parents paid under the Catshuis scheme.
Helaas is deze controle echter uitgevoerd op basis van de specificatie voor het opleveren van ouders uitbetaald als onderdeel van de Catshuisregeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Palland over Nederlandse (midden en klein-)bedrijven meer laten profiteren van grote overheidsaanbestedingen zoals de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk

CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat ensured that the Afsluitdijk renovation contract, awarded to Levvel, would use innovative Dutch small and medium enterprises and avoid leakage of money abroad (e.g. Chinese valve products). The minister answered that the contract was tendered as a whole for integrality, that EU procurement law prevents mandating product origin, and that a large share of investment benefits the Dutch economy, though exact figures are withheld for competition reasons.
I cannot make precise figures public for reasons of competition.
Precieze cijfers kan ik uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet openbaar maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Gijs van Dijk over het krantenbericht van het Eindhovens Dagblad dat een aquaduct bij Oirschot ruim 100 miljoen euro goedkoper is dan Rijkswaterstaat eerder voorrekende

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report by IPV Delft, commissioned by the municipality of Oirschot, claiming an aqueduct alternative to the A58 viaduct would cost about 100 million euros less than Rijkswaterstaat estimated. The minister answered that the compared figures were wrong, explained the differing assumptions on engineering costs, risk reserves and VAT, and declined to reopen the decision or enter new talks.
No new facts have come to light in the studies that give me reason to enter into discussion with the regional administrators about this or to reconsider my earlier decision.

Er zijn uit de onderzoeken geen nieuwe feiten op tafel gekomen die voor mij aanleiding zijn om hierover het gesprek met de regionale bestuurders aan te gaan en tot heroverweging van mijn eerdere besluit te komen.

m: Motie van het lid Wilders c.s. over alle boetes voor het overtreden van de avondklok intrekken
Asks the government to withdraw all fines issued for breaking the curfew, which is unlawful, and refund fines already paid.
withdraw all fines issued for breaking an unlawful curfew and refund as quickly as possible all fines already paid
alle boetes die zijn uitgeschreven voor het overtreden van een onrechtmatige avondklok in te trekken en alle boetes die reeds zijn betaald, zo snel mogelijk terug te storten
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over intrekken van de Tijdelijke wet en  de huidige avondklokmaatregel
Asks the government to withdraw the Temporary law restricting outdoor gatherings during covid-19 and the current evening curfew.
requests the government to withdraw the Temporary law restricting staying outdoors covid-19 as well as the current evening curfew measure
verzoekt de regering, de Tijdelijke wet beperking vertoeven in de openlucht covid-19 ( 35 732 ), alsmede de huidige avondklokmaatregel, in te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de Tijdelijke wet per direct controversieel verklaren
Asks that the temporary law restricting presence in the open air during covid-19 be immediately declared controversial, which would allow a citizen referendum on it.
should immediately be added to the list of controversial subjects and immediately declared controversial
per direct toegevoegd dient te worden aan de lijst van controversiële onderwerpen en per direct controversieel wordt verklaard
Amendement van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de mogelijkheid van het indienen van ondersteuningsverklaringen via een audiovisueel communicatiemiddel
Allows support declarations for new parties to be signed and submitted via audiovisual means to the municipality during the COVID period, with delegated rules on verification.
a support declaration may also be signed via audiovisual means within four weeks before or on the day of nomination
kan een verklaring van ondersteuning ook binnen een termijn van vier weken voorafgaand aan of op de dag van de kandidaatstelling via een audiovisueel communicatiemiddel worden ondertekend
Motie van het lid Graus c.s. over een integraal plan voor de doorontwikkeling van VDL Nedcar
Asks the government to help VDL Nedcar with an integrated plan for its further development in Born, including national co-financing options.
requests the government, with VDL Nedcar and regional bodies, to help with an integrated plan for the further development of VDL Nedcar
verzoekt de regering, met VDL Nedcar, de provincie Limburg, betrokken gemeenten, kennis- en onderwijsinstellingen te helpen met een integraal plan voor de doorontwikkeling van VDL Nedcar
Amendement Van Kooten-Arissen over een evaluatie van de wet gelijktijdig met iedere verlenging
Requires the health minister to send Parliament an evaluation of the COVID law's effectiveness and effects alongside each proposed extension decree.
Simultaneously with submitting the draft royal decree under the third paragraph, the health minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Gelijktijdig met de overlegging van het ontwerp van een koninklijk besluit als bedoeld in het derde lid, zendt Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement Van Kooten-Arissen over een maximale groepsgrootte op plaatsen bestemd voor gemeenschappelijk belijden van godsdienst of levensovertuiging
Would cap group gatherings at places of worship at 30 people under the COVID measures, removing the exemption for religious buildings and allowing mayors to grant exemptions.
It is not permitted to gather in groups in a building or enclosed place with more than 30 persons for religious worship
Het is niet toegestaan zich in groepsverband op te houden in een gebouw of op een besloten plaats
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over mensen die in verzet gaan tegen de coronaboete actief erop wijzen dat zij eventueel in aanmerking kunnen komen voor juridische bijstand
Asks the government to work with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand so that people contesting a corona fine are actively told they may qualify for legal aid cost support.
people who contest the corona fine imposed on them and wish legal aid are actively told that under conditions they may still qualify for a contribution to legal aid costs

mensen die in verzet gaan tegen de aan hen opgelegde coronaboete en juridische bijstand wensen, actief op de mogelijkheid worden gewezen dat zij onder voorwaarden toch in aanmerking kunnen komen voor een tegemoetkoming in de kosten voor juridische bijstand
Amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. over een O/GS-tegemoetkoming
Adds a compensation scheme for parents wrongly labelled as intentional or grossly negligent in childcare benefit debts, with the tax authority keeping the burden of proof.
The burden of proof for the qualification as intent or gross negligence lies and remains with the Tax Authority/Benefits
De bewijslast voor de kwalificatie als opzet of grove schuld ligt en blijft liggen bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen
Motie van het lid Diks c.s. over brievenbusfirma's uitsluiten van investeringsbescherming onder CETA
Asks the government to press the European Commission to define 'substantial business activities' under CETA to exclude letterbox companies from investor protection.
requests the government to urge the European Commission to swiftly establish and formalise a definition of 'substantial business activities'
verzoekt de regering, bij de Europese Commissie aan te dringen op het spoedig tot stand brengen en formaliseren van een definitie van «substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten»
Motie van de leden Diks en Van Kooten-Arissen over geen EU-handelsverdragen over landbouwproducten
Asks the government to work toward EU trade agreements that do not cover agricultural products.
requests the government to work toward trade agreements to which the EU is a party not covering agricultural products
verzoekt de regering, zich ervoor in te zetten dat handelsverdragen waarin de EU partner is geen betrekking hebben op landbouwproducten
Motie van het lid Diks c.s. over geen verlaging van importtarieven op fossiele brandstoffen in EU-handelsverdragen
Asks the government to ensure EU trade agreements contain no reductions of import tariffs on fossil fuels.
requests the government to work towards trade agreements in which the EU is a partner containing no reduction of import tariffs on fossil fuels
verzoekt de regering, zich ervoor in te zetten dat handelsverdragen waarin de EU partner is geen verlaging van importtarieven op fossiele brandstoffen bevatten
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over een impuls geven aan de aanpak van kinderarmoede
Asks government with VNG to boost the fight against child poverty, study Scandinavian approaches, and report to parliament annually instead of biennially.
to inform the House annually, instead of every two years, on the results of the approach to child poverty
de Kamer jaarlijks, in plaats van iedere twee jaar, over de resultaten van de aanpak van kinderarmoede te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over gemeenten laten leren van succesfactoren van pilots met basisbanen
Asks the government, with the VNG, to urge municipalities to learn from successful basic-job pilots and expand minimum-wage basic jobs for welfare recipients.
requests the government, in cooperation with the VNG, to urge municipalities to learn from the success factors of pilots with basic jobs
verzoekt de regering om, in samenwerking met de VNG, gemeenten op te roepen te leren van de succesfactoren van pilots met basisbanen
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het oormerken van het budget voor schuldhulpverlening aan zzp'ers
Motion asking the government to earmark the municipal debt-assistance budget for self-employed people.
requests the government to earmark debt assistance for self-employed people after all
verzoekt de regering, om de schuldhulpverlening aan zzp'ers alsnog te oormerken
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Kooten-Arissen over jobcoaching en re-integratiedienstverlening beter op elkaar afstemmen
Asks the government to study how job coaching and reintegration services can be better coordinated within the Breed Offensief.
invites the government to examine, within the Breed Offensief, whether and how job coaching and reintegration services can be better aligned
nodigt de regering uit om in het kader van het Breed Offensief te onderzoeken of en hoe jobcoaching en re-integratiedienstverlening beter op elkaar afgestemd kunnen worden
Motie van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Brenk over het bij opdrachtgevers op simpele wijze in rekening brengen van de kosten van pensioenopbouw voor zzp'ers
Motion asks the government to study how pension contributions for self-employed workers can be collected from clients like VAT and transferred to a pension fund.
requests the government to investigate how the costs of pension accrual for self-employed workers can be charged simply to clients
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe de kosten van pensioenopbouw voor zzp'ers op een simpele wijze in rekening gebracht kunnen worden bij opdrachtgevers
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over mogelijkheden voor kraam- en ouderschapsverlof voor zzp-partners
Asks the government to investigate options for maternity and parental leave insurance for self-employed partners and inform the House of the results.
requests the government to investigate the possibilities for maternity and parental leave for self-employed partners and to inform the House of the outcomes
verzoekt de regering, om de mogelijkheden voor kraam- en ouderschapsverlof voor zzp-partners te onderzoeken, en de Kamer over de uitkomsten te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen c.s. over onderzoek naar "minder leiding en meer collega's" bij de politie
Asks the government to investigate how to reduce the number of management and policy positions in the police to free funds for frontline officers.
requests the government to investigate how the number of management positions and policymakers in the police can be reduced
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe het aantal managementposities en beleidsmakers bij de politie verkleind kan worden
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over een redelijke vergoeding voor sociaal advocaten
Asks the government to adopt the commission-Van der Meer scenario 1 as the basis for a reasonable fee and point valuation for social lawyers, starting with family law.

requests the government to adopt scenario 1 of the Van der Meer commission as the starting point and work as quickly as reasonably possible towards a reasonable fee and correct point allocation for social lawyers

verzoekt de regering, dit scenario 1 van de commissie-Van der Meer als uitgangspunt te omarmen en zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk is toe te werken naar een redelijke vergoeding en juiste puntentoekenning van sociaal advocaten
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over voorzien in de stijgende behoefte aan mediation
Asks the government, if mediation demand in 2020 exceeds the available budget, to ensure that the rising need for mediation in criminal cases can still be met.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Erdogan volgens uitgelekt vertrouwelijk NCTV-rapport een grote rol speelt bij de opkomst van het salafisme in Nederland

MP Van Kooten-Arissen asked about reports of a leaked confidential NCTV draft analysis on Erdogan's role in the rise of salafism in the Netherlands, and on government conduct toward Turkey, Milli Görüş, Diyanet and the Utrecht tram attacker's associates. The government answered that it cannot discuss the content of the unfinished, confidential draft, which is not policy, that a definitive analysis will follow before summer 2021, and that existing policy and positions remain unchanged.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Kooten-Arissen over het beleid rondom maskergebruik ter preventie van SARS-CoV-2 infecties in de ziekenhuiszorg

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the RIVM guidance on masks for healthcare staff treating COVID-19 patients is adequate, given aerosol transmission concerns and calls for FFP2 masks. The minister replied that the expert advice (OMT and RIVM) still considers type IIR surgical masks sufficient outside aerosol-generating procedures, while employers may deviate on risk assessment and must support staff requests, and that the guidance is for professional bodies rather than politicians to set.
It is not for me to determine when which type of PPE/face mask must be prescribed for use by healthcare workers.
Het is niet aan mij om te bepalen wanneer welke type PBM/mondneusmasker voorgeschreven dient te worden voor gebruik door zorgmedewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over ‘het bericht dat de minister-president onderzoek naar de Nederlandse steun aan Syrische rebellen probeert tegen te houden’

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he is trying to block an inquiry into Dutch non-lethal support to Syrian rebels, and whether the promised investigation has been carried out, including questions on contacts with MPs about a motion and on objections from allies. The government replies that an independent CAVV/AIV advisory process replaced a retrospective fact-finding inquiry, that it opposes a new investigation citing security risks and allies' concerns, that it denies pressuring MPs, and that it will share a non-lethal assistance assessment framework in spring 2021.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de btw-verlaging op o.a. groente en fruit in Duitsland

The government says effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be limited, rejects a temporary Dutch VAT cut for now, and points to existing prevention programmes without committing to reversing the VAT rise.
Currently the cabinet does not intend to temporarily lower VAT rates in the Netherlands.
Momenteel is het kabinet niet voornemens de btw-tarieven in Nederland tijdelijk te verlagen.

An MP asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing capacity, the government's testing policy, the role of asymptomatic carriers, nursing-home safety, OMT advice documents and when a recovered person stops being infectious. The minister answered that capacity is sufficient under current policy, pointed to letters to parliament for the strategy, and said the questions could not be answered earlier.

Do you recall sending the 60th and 61st OMT reports to the House on Thursday? Can you send all reports/advice from the 45th to the 57th OMT to the House, along with other unnumbered reports on this subject?

Vraag 15 Herinnert u zich dat u op donderdag het 60e en 61e verslag van het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) aan de Kamer stuurde? Kunt u alle verslagen/adviezen van het 45e OMT tot en met het 57e OMT aan de Kamer doen toekomen

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).

have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de samenwerking van het ministerie van Financiën met kinderopvangbranchevereniging BOinK

The government replied there is no formal agreement with BOinK, explained the selection and collaboration, and said it does not track all contacts with the organisation.
I do not have figures on how often BOinK has been spoken with about the suspension and recovery of childcare benefits.
Ik beschik niet over aantallen hoe vaak er met BOinK gesproken is over het stopzetten en terugvorderen van de kinderopvangtoeslag.

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het gebruik van een levende haan tijdens Kallemooi

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of a live rooster hung for three days at 18 metres during the Kallemooi festival on Schiermonnikoog, including whether enforcement agencies checked compliance with imposed welfare measures since 2016. The minister answered that no physical inspections occurred after 2015, that the court found no animal mistreatment, that enforcement requests were received in 2019 and under review, and that the tradition will not be banned while the law is respected.
In the following years no physical inspection was carried out by the LID.
In de daarop volgende jaren heeft geen fysieke controle plaatsgevonden door de LID.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Inlichtingendiensten: stop je intimiderende bezoekjes’

MPs Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether intelligence and police informant recruitment targeting climate activists was intimidating, disproportionate and lawful, and how citizens can hold the state to account on climate and rights. Minister Grapperhaus replied that individual cases cannot be discussed for confidentiality reasons, that police must act within legal frameworks and handle complaints, and that the government shares concern about climate policy pace.
As I stated in my letter of 18 June (Kamerstuk 29 628, no. 885), given the confidentiality, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals ik gemeld heb in mijn brief van 18 juni jl. (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr. 885 ), kan er gelet op de vertrouwelijkheid niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten–Arissen over het afschot van wilde zwijnen in het leefgebied van de wolf

An MP asked the minister about wolf-territory culling of wild boar, night-vision and silencer use by hunters, and whether the wolf's presence requires a change in culling policy and a hunting ban during the wolf pup season. The minister answered that provinces set and supervise culling permits, that no conflict exists because wolf prey species are not hunted, and that no policy change is needed for now, while promising to monitor the wolf population.
The permits issued by the provinces prescribe how and in what manner the culling of wild boar may take place. The provinces also supervise compliance with the permits.
In de door de provincies afgegeven ontheffingen is voorgeschreven hoe en op welke wijze het afschot van wilde zwijnen mag plaatsvinden. De provincies zien ook toe op naleving van de ontheffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat een varkenshouder met beroepsverbod in Duitsland zijn varkensstal in Nederland gewoon uit mag breiden

An MP asks the Ministers of Agriculture and Justice how a pig farmer banned from practising in Germany can still expand his Dutch stables, and whether current enforcement tools are sufficient. The minister replies that the German ban does not apply in the Netherlands, that NVWA has inspected the farm 22 times with interventions, and that a tightened enforcement bill is planned, while the EU blacklist exploration is still in progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het houden van dolfijnen in gevangenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether keeping dolphins in captivity, especially at the Dolfinarium in Harderwijk which left the zoo association, is still justified given scientific findings and Belgium's plans to ban it, and whether the zoo licence should be re-examined. The Minister said the licence is reviewed by an inspection committee on application, that the Dolfinarium will be asked to shift its show toward education, that the NVWA will inspect in Q4, but declined to propose a national ban.
I will make concrete agreements with the Dolfinarium on adapting the show.
Ik zal met het Dolfinarium concrete afspraken maken over het aanpassen van de show.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht waaruit blijkt dat Nederland de wettelijke verplichting om te stoppen met overbevissing uiterlijk in 2020 bij lange na niet gaat halen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the Netherlands will not meet its legal obligation to end overfishing by 2020, including quota levels above scientific advice and enforcement of the landing obligation. The minister largely defended current policy, said MSY goals remain the basis of Dutch positions, and committed to informing parliament about mackerel and herring negotiations within three weeks.
I will inform you within three weeks about the advice for mackerel and Atlanto-Scandian herring.
Ik zal u binnen drie weken informeren over de adviezen van makreel en Atlanto Scando haring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht 'Shell wil fundamenten olieplatforms in Noordzee na gebruik laten staan'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about Shell's plan to leave the concrete base of decommissioned North Sea platforms in place, including OSPAR rules, German objections, and the 11,000 tonnes of contaminated material remaining. The minister answered that the Netherlands has not yet taken a position, is commissioning an independent review and will submit a draft position to parliament first, while acknowledging that contaminated material would slowly enter the environment in the very long term.
I will submit this draft position to your House before adopting the final position toward the UK.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit conceptstandpunt voorleggen alvorens het definitieve standpunt richting het VK in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Staatsbosbeheer wil duidelijker bosbeleid van minister’

MPs Thieme and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the minister about Staatsbosbeheer's timber harvesting, nesting-bird protection during felling, net CO2 effects of forest loss, biomass burning and EU carbon-neutral treatment. The minister answered that harvesting is limited to regular management and calamities, that surveys precede felling under the code of conduct, and that biomass is treated as carbon-neutral under international rules, with a forest strategy to follow.
However, the forest strategy I am developing together with the provinces will also address forest management and the questions that arise.
Wel zal bij het maken van de bossenstrategie, die ik samen met de provincies ga ontwikkelen, ook worden ingegaan op het beheer van bossen en de vragen die daarbij spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het ontbreken van vergoeding voor het Freestyle Libre systeem dat grote voordelen heeft voor diabetespatiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the FreeStyle Libre glucose monitor is not reimbursed for all type 1 diabetes patients, citing benefits and cost savings and comparing Dutch coverage with other countries. The Minister said the Zorginstituut will issue a position on wider eligibility by end 2019, that cost considerations are not part of its clinical assessment, and that Dutch diabetes care is already effective and accessible.
It is expected that Zorginstituut Nederland can issue a ruling on reimbursement of FGM for all people with type 1 diabetes by the end of 2019.
Het is de verwachting dat Zorginstituut Nederland voor einde 2019 een uitspraak kan doen over vergoeding van FGM voor alle mensen met diabetes type 1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht ‘Gratis wonen. Als je mee laat kijken in je bed’

An MP asked the ministers whether a Helmond smart-district initiative offering rent reductions in exchange for personal data, and sensor-based monitoring, is acceptable, and how it fits with privacy and oversight. The minister answered that the project is a citizen-involved experiment bound by the GDPR, that no concrete data agreements exist yet, that the rent-for-data plan is still in feasibility, and that the Ethics Commission and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens remain relevant, with no commitment to halt the initiative.
Nothing has been decided yet. Should the experiment go ahead, I will closely monitor its design and implementation.
Er staat op dit moment nog niets vast. Mocht het experiment wel worden uitgevoerd, dan ga ik de uitwerking en de uitvoering daarvan nauwlettend volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de ontheffing voor het doodschieten van onder andere de das, eekhoorn, haas, konijn, ree, wild zwijn, steenmarter, vos en 22 vogelsoorten op het terrein

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about a provincial exemption allowing the killing of protected animals (badger, hare, deer, fox and 22 bird species) at Twente Airport, and questioned oversight, the procedure, and whether the exemption should be withdrawn. The minister answered all 17 questions, largely stating that the province is the competent authority and declining to intervene, while confirming the province will withdraw the exemption at the applicant's request.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations the provinces make when taking those decisions.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen die de provincies bij het nemen van die beslissingen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de zeehondenjacht in Canada

An MP asked whether the minister knows Canada's commercial seal hunt starts today and whether the government will urge Canada to end it and lobby the Canadian ambassador and subsidies. The minister confirmed the hunt starts, said the Canadian government knows the Dutch position and that EU import of seal products has long been banned, saw no need to contact the ambassador, and stated the commercial hunt is not subsidised by Canada.
I see no need to personally inform the Canadian government or the Canadian ambassador of the Dutch position.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om de Canadese overheid of de Canadese ambassadeur van het Nederlandse standpunt persoonlijk op de hoogte te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de falende aanpak van hondengevechten

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why dog fighting enforcement fails, citing a report on criminal networks and high-risk dog trade, and asked about prosecutions, sentences, cooperation between enforcement bodies and policy changes. The minister answered that an ongoing investigation prevents disclosure of details, that no data on earlier cases is available, outlined existing penalties and enforcement frameworks, and pointed to pending legislation and measures without committing to new policy changes.
Since this concerns an ongoing investigation, no further statements can be made.
Aangezien dit een lopend onderzoek betreft, kunnen er geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Wassenberg over bomenkap in Nederland

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Wassenberg asked the minister about large-scale tree felling in the Netherlands, its scale compared with Brazil, its biodiversity impact, and whether felled Natura 2000 trees must be replanted. The minister confirmed high felling rates, said biomass is mostly a by-product rather than a main driver, did not claim a general biodiversity conclusion, and promised a forest strategy and further investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over de beelden van een paard met een brandend dekje in de Efteling

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a horse with a burning blanket galloping in an Efteling show, questioning its welfare and whether the park should be called to account. The minister said NVWA inspections found no breach of animal welfare rules, no burns or stress, and declined to actively challenge the park while continuing routine inspections.
There are many situations in which horses are used and where entertainment is involved.
Er bestaan veel situaties waarin paarden worden ingezet en waarbij sprake is van vermaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Limburg heeft besloten wasberen te gaan schieten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about the Limburg province's plan to shoot raccoons, questioning its effectiveness, costs, population estimates and the minister's responsibility for EU invasive species policy. The minister answers that the province has chosen a two-track approach, that the minister supports removing the invasive species, and that the province makes its own choices under the decentralised nature policy, with the ministry in contact with the province.
The province of Limburg makes its own choices in how invasive alien species are combated.
De provincie Limburg maakt eigen keuzes in de wijze waarop invasieve uitheemse soorten worden bestreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het uitzetten van paling als symptoombestrijding
