The UWV has deployed extra capacity to provide the copies to employers as quickly as possible.
Het UWV heeft extra capaciteit ingezet om de kopieën zo snel mogelijk aan werkgevers te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP from the VVD asked the minister about outages on the UWV website Werk.nl, ICT spending of about 3 billion euro since 2002, the cost and handling of telephone help, sanctions on benefit recipients who could not report on time, and how future outages will be prevented. The minister answered that the outage problems were resolved, that claimants face no penalties for missed obligations, that ICT spending is needed for efficiency with a modernisation and savings programme, and that a new platform is planned for 2015 without a guarantee of no future disruption.
Customers will suffer no financial disadvantage if, as a result of the instability, they cannot meet their obligations on time.
Klanten ondervinden er geen financieel nadeel van als zij als gevolg van de instabiliteit hun verplichtingen niet tijdig kunnen nakomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de berichtgeving dat alleenstaande AOW-ers minder vakantiegeld krijgen dan andere jaren

An MP asked the State Secretary why single AOW pensioners receive less holiday allowance this year, and whether the SVB would clearly communicate the cause and effect. The State Secretary explained the tax-table effect, pointed to the SVB's website and staff information, and said the communication was adequate, without committing to further action.
In my view, the SVB has acted adequately in its communication.
De SVB heeft naar mijn oordeel in de communicatie adequaat gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asked the minister about a reported 6 million euro childcare benefit fraud case, how long it went undetected, whether fraud is more widespread, and what regulatory measures are planned. The minister confirmed the facts, explained the 2011 detection and the 2012 rule change limiting retroactive claims, and said no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures for now.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Potters en Schut-Welkzijn over de nieuwe Wajong

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the new Wajong disability benefit, including UWV's handling of transitions from the old scheme, the 14-week decision period, and criteria for transferring. The state secretary answered that transition is voluntary, UWV published information in advance, the 14-week period is a statutory maximum, and she will evaluate the first three months before informing the House.
I want to form a picture based on the experiences of the first three months and consultation with UWV, and then inform the House.
Ik wil mij op basis van de ervaringen van de eerste drie maanden en overleg met het UWV hierover een beeld vormen en de Kamer aansluitend informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Potters (VVD) asked the minister about the prolonged outage of the UWV website (mijnUWV), the resulting call centre surge and waiting times, compensation for affected clients, and structural fixes. The minister acknowledged the outage lasted 7 to 17 January, reported call volumes and waiting times, described alternative service channels, and rejected compensation because no sanctions would be imposed on affected clients.
Nevertheless, it remains unpleasant that the outage has lasted so long.
Desondanks blijft het vervelend dat de storing lang heeft voortgeduurd.

m: Motie van het lid Pool over onderzoeken of en hoe het nieuwe tankbataljon in Nederland gestationeerd kan worden
Asks the government to investigate whether and how the new tank battalion could be stationed in the Netherlands instead of Germany.
requests the government to investigate whether and how the new tank battalion can be stationed in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of en hoe het nieuwe tankbataljon in Nederland gestationeerd kan worden
Motie van het lid Pool over stoppen met het gebruiken van streefcijfers en voorkeursbeleid bij Defensie
Asks the government to stop using numerical targets and preferential policies for specific groups at the Ministry of Defence.
requests the government to stop using targets and preferential policy at Defence
verzoekt de regering te stoppen met het gebruikmaken van streefcijfers en voorkeursbeleid bij Defensie
Motie van het lid Pool over uitspreken dat verdere integratie van delen van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht met buitenlandse krijgsmachten ongewenst is
Declares that further integration of parts of the Dutch armed forces with foreign armed forces is undesirable.
declares that further integration of parts of the Dutch armed forces with foreign armed forces is undesirable
spreekt uit dat verdere integratie van delen van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht met buitenlandse krijgsmachten ongewenst is
Motie van het lid Pool over het Van Heutsz-regiment met vaandel een prominente plek geven tijdens de Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus in 2024
Asks the government to talk with the National Remembrance organisers so the Van Heutsz regiment with its banner gets a prominent place in the 2024 commemoration.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the organisers of the National Remembrance 15 August
verzoekt de regering met de organisatie van de Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus in gesprek te treden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Pool over nieuwe aanvallen op vrachtschepen in de Rode Zee

MPs De Roon and Pool asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about renewed Houthi attacks on shipping in the Red Sea, including a sinking, and whether the Houthis should be listed as terrorists, whether threat levels and protection measures should change, and what sanctions target Iran. The government confirmed the attacks, condemned them as violating international law, said there is no EU support yet for a terrorist listing but it keeps pursuing that option, noted the highest threat level has applied since December 2023, pointed to ongoing EUNAVFOR Aspides contributions and existing Iran UAV sanctions, but withheld details of further sanctions for confidentiality reasons.
Due to confidentiality, no further sanctions will be discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid wordt niet ingegaan op eventuele verdere sancties.
Antwoord op het lid Pool over het nieuws dat veteranen te vaak en te lang moeten wachten op een beslissing over schadevergoeding

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that traumatised veterans wait too long for compensation decisions, and whether the 60% miss rate on the two-year target is acceptable. The minister agrees the delays are unacceptable, lists measures such as expanding the claims team and a new ICT system, and promises to report to parliament by end 2025.
I will inform the House at the end of 2025 about the progress of the various measures in line with the recommendations of the Netherlands Court of Audit and the Veterans Ombudsman.
Ik zal de Kamer eind 2025 informeren over de voortgang van de verschillende maatregelen conform de aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Veteranenombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pool over de demonstratie op 24 september jl. bij de Kromhout Kazerne te Utrecht

An MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about a pro-Palestinian protest that blocked access to the Kromhout Barracks and forced cancellation of a Defence-NIDV industry event, and whether conceding to such actions encourages further protest. The Minister replied that cancellation was a joint decision for participant safety, called it regrettable, noted that mayors assess whether to restrict demonstrations near military sites, and said talks on a new date are underway.
The decision to cancel the meeting was taken in joint consultation between NIDV and Defence.
Het besluit om de bijeenkomst af te lasten is in gezamenlijk overleg tussen de NIDV en Defensie genomen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Wilders, Pool en De Roon over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that a German court issued an international arrest warrant against a Ukrainian suspected in the Nord Stream sabotage, and whether Ukraine might be behind it and what Dutch intelligence knew. The government declined to speculate on the German investigation's outcome, did not disclose intelligence details, and said Parliament would be informed through the usual channels.
The cabinet does not state publicly anything about the knowledge level, working methods or sources of our intelligence services.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze inlichtingendiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Roon en Pool over Nord Stream

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that President Zelensky knew of and approved the Nord Stream sabotage were accurate, and what the consequences would be. The government answered that it does not speculate on the cause of the explosions and will await the outcome of the German investigation.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and is awaiting the results of the German investigation.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pool en Markuszower over het nieuws dat het demissionaire kabinet onderzoekt of er asielzoekers kunnen worden opgevangen op locaties van Defensie

PVV MPs asked whether the caretaker cabinet's plans to house asylum seekers on Defence sites should be abandoned, citing security risks, incidents and the military's primary purpose. The Defence Minister answered that such requests are weighed case by case for humanitarian reasons and legal feasibility, that security measures are added after consent, and that incidents are recorded by COA.
For the number of reported incidents, I refer you to the 'COA incident registration per location' on www.coa.nl.
Voor het aantal gemelde incidenten verwijs ik u naar de «COA incidentenregistratie per locatie» op www.coa.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pool over het nieuws dat Nederlandse koopvaardijschepen worden bedreigd op de Rode Zee

The MP asks whether Dutch merchant ships have been attacked by Houthi forces in the Red Sea and whether military escorts will be provided after shipping industry requests. The Minister answers that no Dutch-flagged ships have been specifically targeted, that Dutch support continues through existing missions and a staff officer for US-led operation Prosperity Guardian, and that the government is studying a further contribution.
The cabinet is closely monitoring the situation in the Red Sea.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie rondom de Rode Zee nauwlettend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Azmani over het bericht dat Tunesië een nieuwe springplank voor illegale migratie naar Europa wordt

MPs Ten Broeke and Azmani asked the ministers about reports that Tunisia is becoming a new departure route for illegal migration to Europe, including the scale of arrivals, possible undercounting, and cooperation with Tunisia. The government answered that arrivals from Tunisia have risen sharply but remain far below 2011 levels, that Tunisia is cooperating on border control and root causes, and that an integrated approach is needed.
Although this is relatively limited compared with the total number of arrivals in Italy, it is a striking increase compared with 2016.
Hoewel dit op het gehele aantal aankomsten in Italië relatief beperkt is, betreft het een opvallende stijging ten opzichte van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over VN-schoolboeken die uitpuilen van Israëlhaat en antisemitisme

Geert Wilders' party MP De Roon asked the government about UNRWA textbooks used with Palestinian children that allegedly contain anti-Israel and antisemitic content, whether UNRWA is responsible, and whether Netherlands will fight antisemitism in the UN and stop funding UNRWA. The ministers answered that the Palestinian Authority, not the UN, authored the books, that UNRWA says 90% are not used and the rest are being reviewed, and that the government will not stop UNRWA funding.
In a press release of 6 October, UNRWA reports that 90% of the books named in the study are not used in the current curriculum in UNRWA schools.
In een persbericht van 6 oktober jl. meldt UNRWA dat 90% van de in de studie genoemde boeken niet wordt gebruikt in het huidige curriculum in UNRWA-scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over het verstrekken van Europese paspoorten na een investering in de Cypriotische economie

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Cyprus granting EU passports to wealthy investors, whether the Commission is investigating, and whether the Netherlands engages in similar practices. The minister said no Commission investigation exists, that EU states decide their own nationality rules, that Dutch investor residence permits require a five-year legal stay before naturalisation, and that no conflict with international law has been established so no further action is planned.
It is up to the country to establish whether the national (legal) conditions for issuing a passport have been met and to prevent criminals possibly being facilitated thereby.

Het is aan het land om vast te stellen of aan de nationale (wettelijke) voorwaarden voor verstrekking van een paspoort is voldaan en om te voorkomen dat daardoor mogelijkerwijs criminelen worden gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat honderden rijken uit Rusland en Oekraïne een Cypriotisch paspoort hebben kunnen kopen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether Cyprus sold EU citizenship via its golden passport scheme to wealthy Russians and Ukrainians, including revenue, vetting, sanctions checks, money laundering and whether national parliaments can see recipients. The minister answered that Cyprus's individual naturalisation files are not visible, that the Netherlands does not act unless national law conflicts with international law, and that disclosure is a matter for member states.
No insight can be given into the individual naturalisation procedures actually followed.
Over de daadwerkelijk gevolgde individuele naturalisatieprocedures kan geen inzicht worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat een niet bestaand land lid is geworden van Interpol

PVV MPs asked why the Palestinian Authority could join Interpol, whether the Netherlands supports this, and when aid would be cut given attacks on Israel. The government said the bid had sufficient support in Interpol's General Assembly, the Dutch delegations abstained because the Kingdom does not recognise a State of Palestine, and it sees no reason to revise relations with the Palestinian Authority.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to revise the relationship with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen aanleiding om de relatie met de Palestijnse Autoriteit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse technologie in Zuid-Koreaanse fregatten die o.a. aan Egypte worden doorverkocht

MP Karabulut asked whether Dutch technology (Thales/Hollandse Signaal radar and C3 systems) aboard South Korean Po Hang-class corvettes resold to Egypt and other countries was authorised, and on what grounds. The ministers confirmed Dutch consent was given for transfers to Egypt, the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam based on EU criteria assessment, and that export licences apply to re-exports from third countries.
The Netherlands previously consented to the resale of South Korean ships with Dutch equipment on board to the Philippines, Peru and Vietnam.
Nederland heeft eerder ingestemd met de doorverkoop van Zuid-Koreaanse schepen met aan boord Nederlandse apparatuur aan de Filipijnen, Peru en Vietnam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de 'Leaders Agenda' van de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about the European Council President's 'Leaders Agenda', extra summits and whether agendas and decision notes will be made public and sent to parliament in time. The minister replies that the Netherlands supports the agenda, that the government cannot guarantee the timing of documents circulated by the European Council President, but that parliament will receive annotated agendas and confidential access to preparatory documents.
The cabinet therefore cannot give guarantees about the content and the timing of when documents are distributed.
Het kabinet kan dus geen garanties geven over de inhoud en het moment waarop stukken worden verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Nederlander die mogelijk 33 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Dutch Jaitsen Singh, possibly wrongly imprisoned in the US for 33 years, and whether the Dutch state abandoned him, including the handling of a trust report and internal disagreement over transfer. The minister denies abandonment, says regular consular assistance was given, that the transfer request was rejected under the treaty framework, and that no new US requests are pending yet, while support would resume if they are filed.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has provided Mr J.S. with regular consular assistance since the start of his detention.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft aan de heer J.S. sinds aanvang van zijn detentie de reguliere consulaire bijstand verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bewapening van de Luchtverdedigings- en Commandofregatten (LC-fregatten)

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether NATO's missile defence and possible SM-3 acquisition for the LCF frigates disturb the strategic balance and could fuel proliferation. The Defence Minister replied that the NATO BMD system does not disturb the strategic balance, that the SMART-L radar software was tested in Formidable Shield, that no decision on SM-3 acquisition has been taken, and that proliferation is a different question.
The NATO BMD system therefore does not disturb the strategic balance in Europe.
Het BMD-systeem van de Navo verstoort het strategische evenwicht in Europa dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat Erdogan Interpol misbruikt om jacht te maken op politieke tegenstanders

MPs De Roon, Helder and Markuszower asked whether Turkey misuses Interpol systems to pursue political opponents, what safeguards exist, and whether Dutch nationals have been affected. The government answered that it shares concern, describes Interpol's safeguards (Constitution article 3, Secretary General review, the CCF complaints commission) and Dutch pre-checks of Red Notices, and says it knows of no cases involving Dutch nationals.
The cabinet is concerned about reports, such as this one, that Turkey uses INTERPOL for arrest requests that violate article 3 of the INTERPOL Constitution.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over berichten, zoals onderhavig rapport, dat INTERPOL door Turkije wordt gebruikt voor arrestatie-verzoeken die een schending vormen van artikel 3 van de INTERPOL Constitutie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over Chinese moslims die hun korans moeten inleveren

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Chinese measures restricting Muslims in Xinjiang, including confiscating Qurans, banning beards and Islamic names, and mandatory spy apps, and asks what the government will do. The minister says the government shares concerns and has raised them bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, but declines to seek an international fact-finding mission and gives no new concrete action.

The cabinet does not consider it opportune to push for an international investigation and believes the current course, raising China's own international and constitutional human rights obligations bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, is the most appropriate.

Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op een internationaal onderzoek aan te sturen en is van mening dat de huidige koers, om zowel bilateraal als in EU- en VN-verband China aan te spreken op de eigen internationale en constitutionele mensenrechtenverplichtingen, de meest gepaste is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een fatwa tegen Somalische christenen in Europa

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a fatwa calling for action against Somali Christians in Europe poses a real threat, and what protection is needed. The minister answered that the threat cannot be confirmed, the video had only 135 views, no signals of unrest were received, and that threats reported to authorities would be investigated with measures taken if needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over het bericht dat Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa zouden hebben gewerkt aan de bouw van een Deens marineschip

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked whether North Korean forced labour was used to build a Danish navy vessel, a NATO ally's ship, and whether this poses a security risk and has been raised in NATO. The government answered that the issue has not been discussed in NATO, that individual allies bear responsibility for ships they make available, that the Danish government cannot yet confirm or deny the reports, and that the EU has adopted measures to reduce North Korean workers in the EU to zero.
The matter has not been discussed within NATO.
De kwestie is niet in NAVO-verband besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en van Dam over het artikel ‘Ik hoop dat je gepakt wordt’; De Turkse Kliklijn’

MPs Knops and Van Dam asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a Turkish consulate 'click line' for reporting Turkish Dutch citizens and threats of reporting them to Turkish intelligence. The minister said there is no evidence of a current reporting line in the Netherlands, condemned such practices, and said the government raises the issue with Turkey and will act directly if a reporting line exists.
If a click line were to exist, the Dutch government will therefore act directly.
In het geval van het bestaan van een kliklijn zal de Nederlandse overheid dus direct optreden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er kilometerslange files hebben gestaan bij de grensovergangen tussen Turkije - Bulgarije, Bulgarije - Servië, Servië - Hongarije en Servië – Kroatië, en het beric

Kuzu (DENK) asked about long border queues at Turkey-Bulgaria and other Balkan crossings, reports of intimidation and disinfection fees imposed on Turkish-Dutch travellers in Bulgaria, and Bulgarian corruption. The minister attributed queues to systematic EU border checks and to Bulgaria's general rules, offered complaint channels, and said the government supports keeping the CVM in place while noting EU funds are used for border management.
Following these parliamentary questions, the Dutch embassy in Sofia added to its website contact details of the Bulgarian Ministry of Interior where travellers can lodge complaints.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen heeft de Nederlandse ambassade in Sofia haar website aangevuld met contactgegevens van het Bulgaarse Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over toegang van terroristen tot het Europees Parlement

PVV MPs asked whether the government knew that Leila Khaled had been received in the European Parliament, whether it finds this absurd, how a convicted hijacker obtained a Schengen visa, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to judge the Parliament's invitation decision, explained the SIS refusal mechanism in general terms without discussing the individual case, and stated no action on the invitation policy.
I see no reason to intervene in the assessment made by the European Parliament when inviting Ms Khaled.
Ik zie geen aanleiding te treden in de afweging die door het Europees parlement is gemaakt bij de uitnodiging aan mevrouw Khaled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over mensenrechtenschendingen tegen Burundese vluchtelingen

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about human rights violations against Burundian refugees in Congo, including shootings, EU diplomatic pressure, MONUSCO's protection role, refugee camp conditions and the safety of returnees to Burundi. The government condemned the violence, reported that Congolese authorities and MONUSCO opened investigations, and said Burundi's repression and economic weakness make returns risky.
The cabinet is shocked by the incident and condemns the disproportionate use of force by the Congolese security services.
Het kabinet is geschokt door het incident en veroordeelt het disproportioneel gebruik van geweld door de Congolese veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Israëls aanval op Palestijns onderwijs: complete school weg'

An MP asked the government about the Israeli demolition of a Palestinian school at Jubbet adh Dhib, which was EU-funded, and the violence against residents, and asked what steps the EU and the Netherlands would take. The government condemned the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, said it would raise the issue through EU joint action and dialogue, but did not commit to specific new measures beyond considering further steps if asked by the EU.
The cabinet condemns the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, regardless of whether it was financed by the EU or not.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de sloop en confiscatie van Palestijnse bezittingen, ongeacht of deze door de EU zijn gefinancierd of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de voorgenomen ontruiming van twee Palestijnse dorpen

MP Karabulut asks whether the government is aware of B'Tselem's claim that the planned evacuation of the Palestinian villages Susiya and Khan al-Ahmar is a war crime, and whether it will urge Israel to abandon the plan. The ministers confirm the threat, state that forced displacement and destruction of property under occupation law are prohibited, call on Israel to comply, and say the government keeps pressing Israel bilaterally and through the EU to drop the plans.
The cabinet calls on Israel to strictly comply with these obligations.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot strikte naleving van deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over ernstige bedreigingen en onrechtmatig geweld door het Israëlische leger tegen Palestijnse burgers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about threats and lethal force by the Israeli army against Palestinian civilians, including a reported commander known as 'Captain Nidal', and whether the government would seek an official response and take firmer action. The minister said the government lacks information to verify the commander's existence or the allegations, will press Israel on international law and proportionality through bilateral and EU channels, but declined to change Israel's friendly-nation status.
The cabinet has insufficient information to verify the existence of 'Captain Nidal' or to judge the allegations.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende informatie om het bestaan van «Captain Nidal» te kunnen verifiëren of om een oordeel te kunnen geven over de beschuldigingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Azmani over het bericht ‘Omstreden alFitrah legt 1,7 miljoen euro op tafel en koopt pand alsnog’

MPs Tellegen and Azmani asked the government about reports that the contested alFitrah organisation bought a building with 1.7 million euros, and about its financial transparency, Kuwaiti funding and possible sanctions. The minister said the funds came via a Dutch company, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that transparency measures such as a foundations publication duty are being examined, and that the municipality of Utrecht uses the three-track approach.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat België de hulp aan Palestijnse scholen opschort

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked whether Dutch aid money had gone to Palestinian schools that were named after a terrorist and glorify violence, and whether a ban on all Dutch funding to such schools is warranted. The ministers answered that the Netherlands does not fund schools directly, that glorification of violence is unacceptable, that the EU and Netherlands press both parties on incitement, and that they do not agree that no Dutch money should go to Palestinian schools.
The Netherlands does not provide direct funding to schools, so also not to this particular school.
Nederland geeft geen directe financiering aan scholen, dus ook niet aan deze bewuste school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de benoeming van een topambtenaar van PvdA-huize op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

MP Sjoerdsma asked why René Cuperus, a Wiardi Beckman Stichting staffer, was appointed as a 'scholar in residence' at the Foreign Ministry without a public vacancy or competing candidates, and whether the appointment would be reconsidered. Minister Koenders said the post was filled via a shortlist because of its specific requirements and short term, that the procedure followed the rules, and that he would not reopen the appointment.
No, given the very specific job requirements and the short duration and limited scope of the appointment, it was decided to draw up a shortlist of potentially suitable candidates.
Nee, gelet op de zeer specifieke functievereisten en de korte duur en beperkte omvang van de aanstelling is ervoor gekozen om een shortlist van mogelijk geschikte kandidaten op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Van den Bosch over landen die in Nederland onderdelen voor massavernietigingswapens proberen te kopen

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers whether countries such as Iran, Syria and Pakistan are procuring weapons-of-mass-destruction components in the Netherlands, what has been done about successful purchases, what extra measures are needed, how businesses and SMEs are made aware of the risk, and whether a blacklist of intermediaries exists. The government confirmed the risk, described export-control and awareness measures, and declined to publish a blacklist or specific case details for national security reasons.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case matters that touch on the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Diks over de inbeslagname door Israël van een door Nederland gesubsidieerd zonne-energieproject in het Palestijnse dorp Jubbet adh Dhib

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Israel would return seized Dutch-subsidised solar panels in Jubbet adh Dhib, compensate the damage, and how the Israeli permit regime relates to humanitarian obligations and EU responses. The government reported that the panels were returned to COMET-ME as a temporary solution pending a zoning plan decision, gave permit statistics showing very few Palestinian approvals in Area C, and described EU efforts to press Israel on demolitions while declining to answer some questions on Israel's intentions.
It is not for the cabinet to answer this question about the intentions of the Israeli government.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om deze vraag naar voornemens van de Israëlische regering te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over geweld en intimidatie tegen Israëlische mensenrechtenorganisaties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an arson-intimidation plot against Breaking the Silence, alleged government-linked smear campaigns against Israeli human rights NGOs, steps under the Sjoerdsma motion, and a vote-manipulation campaign against Gisha in the Human Rights Tulip. The minister acknowledged the trend and concern, referred to earlier reporting on the motion, said the government raises human rights in EU dialogue without committing to a formal demand, and explained the vote analysis and fraud filters.
The cabinet devotes intensive attention to human rights issues in its dialogue with the Israeli authorities, where possible within the EU.
Het kabinet besteedt – waar mogelijk in EU-verband – intensieve aandacht aan mensenrechtenonderwerpen in de dialoog met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over beknotting van de vrijheid van meningsuiting door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

An MP asked the foreign minister about the arrest of human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian Authority security forces, the Electronic Crimes Law, and Dutch support to Palestinian security institutions. The government expressed concern, said it raises freedom of expression with the PA and supports Amro diplomatically, and committed to monitoring the cases and to linking support to human rights respect without specifying new concrete measures.

The Netherlands and the EU will continue to closely follow the cases against Amro and continue to stress to the Palestinian Authority the importance of human rights defenders and organisations for a free and pluralistic society.

Nederland en de EU zullen de zaken tegen Amro nauwgezet blijven volgen en bij de Palestijnse Autoriteit het belang van mensenrechtenverdedigers en -organisaties voor een vrije en pluriforme samenleving blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de vermindering van het aantal zetels in het Europees Parlement na Brexit

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would push, in the European Council, for cutting 73 European Parliament seats after Brexit, and questioned a proposal on seat allocation. The government replied that it has consistently argued for reducing the EP by 73 seats, that few member states share this, and that it will await the definitive Commission/EP seat proposal before taking a position.
The cabinet is awaiting the definitive proposal on the seat allocation of the European Parliament and will determine its position on that in due course.
Het kabinet wacht het definitieve voorstel voor de zetelverdeling van het Europees Parlement af en zal zijn standpunt daarop te zijner tijd bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over massasurveillance door de Oezbeekse overheid

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the government about mass surveillance in Uzbekistan, its human rights implications, the role of a Dutch-headquartered telecom firm's Uzbek subsidiary, and surveillance technology exports. The ministers condemned the human rights situation, said talks at senior official level were held with Veon, and stated that no export licences for surveillance technology to Uzbekistan had been granted.
The Netherlands has not granted any licences for the export of surveillance technology to Uzbekistan.
Nederland heeft geen vergunningen verleend voor de uitvoer van surveillancetechnologie naar Oezbekistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het mogelijk steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen, in dit geval Boskalis en van Oord

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (Atradius DSB) would support Boskalis and Van Oord's role in the Nord Stream 2 pipeline and whether this conflicts with Paris climate goals. The government answered that a non-binding letter of interest was issued, that each application will undergo an environmental and social assessment, and that it sees no reason to exclude oil and gas projects from export credit insurance, while stating the political debate falls outside the scope of the export credit framework.
When assessing any applications, political and financial risks will be examined and an assessment of environmental and social impacts will be carried out.
Bij de beoordeling van eventuele aanvragen zal naar de politieke en financiële risico's worden gekeken en zal een beoordeling van de milieu en sociale gevolgen worden uitgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het overdragen van sociale media data van gewone Nederlanders aan de Amerikaanse overheid, de Muslimban en de onderhandelingen over de Amerikaanse "preclearance"

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked about US handling of Dutch travellers' social media data, refusals of entry to dual nationals and Dutch citizens, the Muslim travel ban, and preclearance negotiations at Schiphol. The government answered that it is not actively informed when entry is refused, that the EU PNR court opinion does not affect US data exchange, and that preclearance talks continue under Dutch, EU and international law including human rights.
The Dutch government is not actively informed when Dutch nationals are denied entry to the US.
De Nederlandse regering wordt niet actief geïnformeerd indien Nederlanders de toegang tot de VS is ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Keijzer en Van Toorenburg over het bericht “Albanese maffia slaat hier zijn tentakels uit”

MPs Omtzigt, Keijzer and Van Toorenburg asked about reports of Albanian organised crime in the Netherlands, including whether a visa requirement should be reintroduced under EU rules and whether Albania should keep candidate status. The minister answered that Albanian-national suspects rose to about 700 in 2016, that the government will await the Commission's Western Balkans monitor before considering the EU emergency brake, and that the answers were delayed beyond the two-week target.
I will make this report available for confidential inspection by your House until the end of the year.
Deze rapportage leg ik tot het einde van het jaar ter vertrouwelijke inzage in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over het stopzetten van de financiering aan de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee (WATC)

MPs Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke and De Roon asked whether Dutch funding to the Women's Affairs Technical Committee (WATC) was stopped after WATC backed a youth centre named after a terrorist, and whether other subsidised organisations glorify terrorism. The ministers confirm the funding was halted with other donors, citing glorification of violence, and state that existing subsidy conditions are sufficient to prevent support to such organisations.
For this reason, the Netherlands, together with the other donors of the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, has decided to immediately end cooperation with WATC.
Om deze reden heeft Nederland – samen met de andere donoren van het Human Rights and International Humanitairan Law Secretariat – besloten de samenwerking met WATC per direct stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over door de Europese Unie georganiseerde reizen voor journalisten naar de Westoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about EU-funded press trips for European journalists to the West Bank, their aims, and why Israel is not included, arguing the programme may be one-sided. The minister explained the trip aims to inform journalists about EU-Palestinian Authority relations and aid, rejected the call for a different programme, and noted a planned visit to Israel's COGAT was being considered.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van de Rohingya in Myanmar

An MP from DENK asked the Dutch foreign minister, in 18 questions, about the Rohingya crisis in Myanmar, including the humanitarian toll, army conduct, blocked aid, possible genocide, refugee intake and trade with Myanmar. The minister condemned the violence, called on Myanmar's authorities to protect civilians and allow aid, pledged extra humanitarian funding and backed a UN Fact Finding Mission, but declined to halt trade or commit to large-scale resettlement.
The cabinet has, in recent weeks, taken note with horror of the reports of violence in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen weken met afschuw kennisgenomen van de berichten over het geweld in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over martelingen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he accepts reports of systematic torture and impunity in Turkey after the failed coup, and what pressure the Netherlands and the EU can apply. The minister said the individual reports cannot be confirmed but that the trend is worrying, and listed ongoing bilateral and EU efforts, including calls for CPT report publication and support for civil society.
The cabinet cannot confirm the individual reports from the cited reports.
Het kabinet kan de individuele berichten uit de aangehaalde rapporten niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over terreurkampen voor Palestijnse kinderen georganiseerd door o.a. de Verenigde Naties

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked the government how many children attend alleged Hamas and UNRWA 'terror camps' and whether Dutch funding to UNRWA should stop. The government distinguishes Hamas camps from UNRWA summer camps, says it has no evidence of terrorist links to UNRWA camps, and refuses to halt UNRWA funding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma en Maeijer over door NGO's gefaciliteerde asielinvasie naar Europese Unie

Two PVV MPs asked whether NGO sea rescue operations facilitate people smuggling and whether Dutch public money funds such NGOs, and urged closing the borders. The government answered that no Dutch subsidies go to Mediterranean rescue operations, that Italian criminal investigations must be awaited, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.

As also exchanged in previous answers and during various General Consultations, the Dutch government does not provide subsidies or other forms of financing to organisations for rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea.

Zoals ook in eerdere beantwoording en tijdens verschillende Algemene Overleggen is gewisseld, verstrekt de Nederlandse overheid geen subsidies of andere vormen van financiering aan organisaties voor reddingsoperaties op de Middellandse Zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Tony van Dijck over exorbitant reisgedrag van Eurocommissarissen

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the travel costs of EU Commissioners, including €492,249 spent in January–February 2016 and a €75,000 trip by High Representative Mogherini to Baku. The minister replied that the trips served Dutch interests, that EU travel is paid from the EU budget under oversight by the European Court of Auditors, the Council and the European Parliament, and that the Commission now publishes these costs; he declined to commit to any action.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors and the Council.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer en de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 2017 Venezuelan constituent assembly election, its violence, legitimacy, sanctions, possible EU measures, humanitarian access, Dutch nationals and refugee flows to the Caribbean islands. The minister's reply, issued jointly with the trade and development minister, refers the MP to a separate letter on the Venezuela situation and the implementation of a motion, rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Sjoerdsma (D66), question number 2017Z10660, have been answered by letter 'Current situation in Venezuela and implementation of the Knops/ten Broeke motion'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma (D66), vraagnummer 2017Z10660 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Actuele situatie Venezuela en uitvoering van de motie Knops/ten Broeke» (Kamerstuk 29 653, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de walgelijke uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Hongarije

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the Dutch ambassador to Hungary, who had compared Hungarian government action on immigration to Islamist terrorists, spoke on behalf of the government and whether he should apologise and be removed. Minister Koenders distanced the government from the remark as unfortunate, said the ambassador had been told so, and considered the matter closed while acknowledging concerns about Hungary's rule of law.
The Dutch ambassador's statement in Hungary about terrorism is therefore unfortunate.
De uitspraak van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Hongarije over terrorisme is daarom ongelukkig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht ‘Op geluidsopnamen is te horen hoe dit reddingsschip contact heeft met mensensmokkelaars’

An MP asks whether NGO rescue missions in the Mediterranean facilitate people smuggling, whether Dutch-flagged NGO ships and subsidies exist, and about Dutch responsibility and cooperation with Italy. The government answers that most NGOs act under maritime law at Italy's request, that only one ship (Iuventa) is on the Dutch register, that no subsidies are paid for Mediterranean operations, and that Italian investigation findings should be awaited.
No statements are made about ongoing (criminal) investigations.
Over lopende (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken worden geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'B’Tselem chief: Israel sabotaging fight against anti-Semitism to retain West Bank'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli government uses antisemitism accusations to deflect criticism of its West Bank policy, and whether the IHRA working definition of antisemitism blurs the line with criticism of Israel. The government answered that it sees no official Israeli policy of this kind, distinguishes criticism of Israeli policy from antisemitism, and holds that the IHRA definition does not change the legal assessment of such statements for government bodies.
As far as is known, there is no official policy of the Israeli government aimed at this.
Voor zover bekend is er geen sprake van officieel beleid van de Israëlische regering dat hier op zou zijn gericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat de EU een peperduur kantoor in Parijs wil huren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press the European Parliament and Commission to stop a costly new lease for the House of Europe in Paris, arguing the money should go to citizens instead. The minister replied that the choice of location rests with the Commission and Parliament, that the budget fits the EU framework, and that the Netherlands favours efficient spending in the upcoming MFF negotiations.
The rental costs of this building fit within the budget frameworks of the European Parliament and European Commission budgets, as part of the EU budget.
De huurkosten van dit gebouw passen binnen de begrotingskaders van de begroting van het Europees parlement en de Europese Commissie, als onderdeel van de begroting van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de humanitaire crisissituatie in Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, including fuel and electricity shortages, sewage pollution, blocked medical referrals to Israel, and what the government is doing to ease access and fund relief. The minister acknowledged serious shortages and a combination of causes, described diplomatic efforts, a planned gas pipeline and trade-access support, and said an extra UNRWA contribution would be considered if budget room arises.
The cabinet does not have precise information on the refusal of seriously ill patients in Gaza to specialised hospitals in Israel.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de weigering van ernstig zieke patiënten in Gaza tot gespecialiseerde ziekenhuizen in Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inzet van 70-plussers

An MP asked whether the age limit of 70 for DUO exam surveillants (and whether governments can set age limits for employing 70-plussers) bars valued staff, and whether exceptions or a broader review are possible given the higher AOW age. The state secretary confirmed the 70 limit applies to CvTE/DUO exam staff, said it is not a uniform government rule, and agreed to have the CvTE explore adjusting the limit, with a report to parliament by end 2017.
I am willing to have the CvTE explore whether there are possibilities to adjust this age limit.
Ik ben bereid om het CvTE te laten verkennen of er mogelijkheden zijn om deze leeftijdsgrens aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma c.s. inzake het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellinge

MPs Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked how Saudi Arabia and Kuwait share information via Notes Verbales about funding requests from Dutch religious institutions, when the Labour Minister was informed, and what action has been taken on earlier motions. The government answered that the information is shared confidentially, that since 2016 it goes to several agencies including SZW, and that only one case led to ended funding, with a convenant on transparency under discussion.
This information was obtained through diplomatic channels and is therefore confidential.
Deze informatie is verkregen via diplomatiek verkeer en daarmee vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de onrustige situatie in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had raised concerns with Morocco about the unrest in the Rif and possible violations of the right to demonstrate, and what could be done bilaterally and multilaterally to prevent escalation. The minister answered that the embassy is in regular contact with Moroccan authorities and EU partners, monitors the situation including alleged abuses, and that Morocco has announced an investigation into mistreatment of detained demonstrators.
The cabinet closely follows the situation on the ground, including reports of possible violations of the right to demonstrate.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie ter plaatse nauwlettend, inclusief de berichten over mogelijke schendingen van het recht op demonstratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over protesten in het noorden van Marokko

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and a court sentencing of Rif protest leaders in Morocco and about a meeting in Utrecht allegedly organised by the Moroccan state. The minister confirmed the arrests, described the charges and sentences, called the socio-economic demands legitimate, and said the government was not aware of Moroccan state involvement in the Utrecht meeting.
As indicated in the answer to the questions from MP Van den Hul, the situation is being closely monitored.
Zoals in antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Hul is aangegeven, wordt de situatie nauwlettend gevolgd.
Vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan (beiden DENK) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 1 juni 2017).

DENK MPs asked the foreign and social affairs ministers about protests in northern Morocco, the government's stance, the response of Moroccan authorities, arrests, tensions in the Netherlands, contact with Morocco, risks to Dutch nationals and possible de-escalation. The minister answered that peaceful protest is a right, that incidents should be investigated, that exact arrest numbers cannot be verified, that Dutch nationals face no generally increased danger, and that Dutch projects in the region contribute, while the resolution lies with Moroccan actors.
The exact number of arrests cannot currently be verified.
Het exacte aantal arrestaties is op dit moment niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat twee Rotterdamse studenten na aankomst in Amerika geweigerd zijn om het land te betreden

MPs asked whether the government would press the US after two Dutch students were refused entry and sent back, allegedly on religious grounds, and whether they would be assisted. The minister replied that no consular request was received, the ministry had no contact with US authorities, the US is sovereign in border decisions, no travel advice change is needed, and the ministry cannot help with damage claims.
The United States, like all other countries, subject to its international legal obligations, is sovereign in deciding who it admits to its territory.
De Verenigde Staten zijn, net als alle andere landen, met inachtneming van hun internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen, soeverein in het bepalen wie zij toelaten tot hun grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Knops over het bereiken van een definitief akkoord tussen Turkije en Rusland over het leveren van S-400 luchtverdedigingssystemen

MPs Ten Broeke and Knops asked whether Erdogan's claim of a settled deal with Russia on S-400 air defence systems is confirmed, why Turkey chose Russian rather than NATO-compatible systems, and what the consequences would be for NATO if a deal is final. The government answered that no definitive agreement has been confirmed, so it cannot yet assess motives or consequences, though interoperability problems and exclusion from NATO networks are likely if the purchase proceeds.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement.
Het kabinet kan daarom niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handel in zand uit West-Sahara

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dutch shipper Eemswerken transported sand from Western Sahara to Gran Canaria, whether this is illegal, and whether the minister contacted the company. The minister confirmed a Spanish inspection found such sand aboard, noted a local investigation is ongoing, saw no indication of Dutch or EU violations, and pointed to general CSR and investment-warning policy.
The government has currently received no indication from supervisory bodies or the Public Prosecution Service that there has been a violation of Dutch or European regulations.
De regering heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen ontvangen van toezichthoudende instanties of het Openbaar Ministerie dat er sprake is van een overtreding van Nederlandse of Europese regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over beschermde identiteit voor teruggekeerde Zweedse jihadisten

MPs De Roon, De Graaf and Wilders asked whether returning Swedish jihadists receive protected identities to aid reintegration, whether they could travel and settle in the EU and Netherlands, and whether Dutch services know of them. The ministers replied that the reports are incorrect, that Sweden only offers privacy-data protection for threatened citizens and not new identities, and that the other questions therefore do not apply.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over terugkerende jihadisten naar Zweden die een nieuwe identiteit krijgen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked whether Sweden gives returning jihadists new identities without local authorities knowing where they live, and what risks this poses for the EU. The ministers answered that the reports are inaccurate according to Swedish authorities, that no EU state is known to pursue such a policy, and they described existing EU information-sharing and PNR arrangements.
Enquiries with the Swedish authorities show that this report is incorrect.
Uit navraag bij de Zweedse autoriteiten blijkt dat deze berichtgeving onjuist is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over activiteiten van de Turkse inlichtingendienst in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the Turkish intelligence service operates from The Hague, including compiling kill-lists of Kurdish activists, and what the government will do about it. The ministers declined to comment on the French prosecution and said they cannot publicly discuss investigations into foreign intelligence activity, only that the government takes measures when unauthorised activity is found.
No public statements can be made about investigations into such activities by foreign intelligence and security services.
Over onderzoek naar dergelijke activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked the government about reports that North Korean workers in Europe, largely in Poland, are subjected to forced labour that funds the North Korean state, and about the government's knowledge, EU subsidies and NATO-ship links. Minister Asscher answered that Poland has found no illegal work or forced labour, that the matter has been raised in the UN, Council and International Labour Conference, that EU subsidy control lies first with member states, and that no North Korean workers were found working on Dutch navy ships at CRIST.
Precise amounts are not known and estimates vary.
Precieze bedragen zijn niet bekend en schattingen lopen uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de resolutie van het Europees parlement over de bestrijding van antisemitisme

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism and the IHRA working definition, including whether the definition is legally unclear and risks restricting free speech on Israel. Minister Asscher answers that definitions work differently across legal systems, that Dutch criminal law is leading, that expressions about Israel remain protected by free speech, and that existing anti-discrimination instruments are effective.
Statements about Israel are protected by freedom of expression.
Uitlatingen over Israël worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Visser over het bericht 'Opzeggen vissersakkoord door Britten kan ramp zijn voor Nederland'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about the UK's notice to terminate the London Fisheries Convention and its consequences for Dutch fishers, including the 6-12 mile zone and the Brexit negotiations. The government confirmed the termination was filed on 3 July 2017, said Dutch-flagged vessels barely fish that zone, and noted the issue will be part of the wider EU-UK relationship talks.
The Convention has a two-year notice period and ceases to apply to the United Kingdom on 3 July 2019.
Het Verdrag heeft een opzegtermijn van twee jaar en verliest zijn werking jegens het Verenigd Koninkrijk op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het regime van Eritrea opnieuw een bijeenkomst in Nederland organiseert

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about a Eritrean government-linked festival in Rijswijk, including attendance by Eritrea's foreign minister, possible propaganda use, and security measures. The minister answered that the cabinet has no objection to cultural festivals but felt uneasy about officials attending for political purposes, that the foreign minister was asked to stay away and did not come, and that public order is a local responsibility handled by the municipality.
The cabinet asked Minister Saleh to refrain from visiting the festival in Rijswijk.
Het kabinet heeft Minister Saleh verzocht om af te zien van een bezoek aan het festival in Rijswijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnse terroristen of hun nabestaanden

An MP asked the government whether it would press the Palestinian Authority to stop payments to convicted Palestinian prisoners and their families, which reward more violence, and whether Dutch aid could be reduced. The ministers answered that the government favours transparent, need-based payments, will increase pressure on the PA and PLO to change the system, but will not cut aid because that would harm Palestinians and the PA's credibility.
The cabinet is working, together with like-minded countries, to increase pressure on the Palestinian Authority and PLO to change the system of payments to prisoners.
Het kabinet zet zich in, samen met gelijkgezinde landen, om de druk op de Palestijnse Autoriteit en PLO op te voeren om het systeem van uitkeringen aan gevangenen te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Verhoeven over anti-corruptie rechtbanken in Oekraïne

Dutch MPs Groothuizen and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with the European Commission president that a dedicated anti-corruption court in Ukraine was unnecessary and whether the Netherlands would press for one. The minister replied that the EU and IMF demand independent anti-corruption institutions, that the Netherlands supports an independent anti-corruption court and will keep advocating it, while stressing that the independence and transparency of the judicial structure must be guaranteed.
The Netherlands has also actively lobbied the Ukrainian authorities for this.
Nederland heeft hier ook actief bij de Oekraïense autoriteiten voor gepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de veiligheidssituatie van diplomaten in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that US diplomats' families were being withdrawn from Venezuela due to security concerns, and what the Netherlands is doing to protect its diplomats and their families. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to discuss security measures publicly, stated that the situation is monitored daily and that the travel advice was last updated on 2 August 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot make public statements about the security or security measures for diplomats and their families.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlands Zaken kan geen openbare uitspraken doen over de veiligheid c.q. veiligheidsmaatregelen ten behoeve van diplomaten en hun families.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over uitreisverboden voor Nederlanders in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about a Dutch man arrested in Turkey and banned from leaving for allegedly insulting President Erdogan, about ten Dutch nationals reportedly barred from leaving over Gülen links, resumed extraditions to Turkey, and whether the government will press Turkey to lift the bans and tighten travel advice. The government confirmed one case but withheld details on privacy grounds, stated about ten persons had reported bans, defended case-by-case extradition review with Turkish guarantees, said the embassy has repeatedly raised the bans with Turkish authorities, and noted existing travel advice already warns of these risks.
Due to privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with further information about an individual case through this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen verdere informatie verstrekken over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de arrestatie van een Nederlander in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and travel ban imposed by Turkey on a Dutch national for allegedly insulting Erdogan, including the legitimacy of the ban, consular support, the number of Dutch nationals under travel bans, a joint EU position, and whether extradition to Turkey should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the embassy has raised these cases repeatedly with Turkish authorities, declined to give details of individual cases for privacy reasons, pointed to Turkish courts for judging legitimacy, reported about ten people still affected and seven who had left, and noted coordination with like-minded EU states and a travel advice update.
For reasons of privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with information about individual cases through this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen informatie verstrekken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Nederlander vast na kritiek op Erdogan’

CDA MPs asked about a Dutch national detained after criticising Erdogan and about Dutch citizens barred from leaving Turkey, including travel advice and consular action. The minister said about ten people have reported exit bans, withheld their circumstances for privacy reasons, described existing travel warnings and consular efforts, and promised continued pressure on Turkish authorities.
For reasons of privacy protection, I cannot provide your House with information about the background to these cases in this public letter.
Vanwege privacybescherming kan ik uw Kamer via deze openbare brief geen informatie verstrekken over de achtergronden bij deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over het bezoek van diplomaten aan de Evin-gevangenis in Teheran

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a visit by 45 diplomats, including the Dutch ambassador, to Tehran's Evin prison, a photo showing the Dutch flag, and whether the visit was a propaganda stunt shown only the 'luxury' part of the prison. The minister confirmed the visit and the Dutch participation, said the programme was not known in advance, and defended joining with like-minded countries to raise human rights concerns directly with Iran.
The visit did not give a complete picture of the facilities in Evin prison, nor of the prisoners' living conditions.
Het bezoek gaf geen volledig beeld van de faciliteiten in de Evin-gevangenis, noch van de leefomstandigheden van de gevangenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over risico’s van willekeurige arrestaties in Turkije

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether he was concerned that Turkey arrests foreign journalists and activists for statements made abroad, and what this means for Dutch travellers. The government says it urges Turkey to respect the rule of law, has reinforced travel advice warning of prosecution for insulting the head of state and terrorism-linked activity, and will keep raising concerns in EU and Council of Europe settings.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs continuously considers whether travel advice needs to be adjusted.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kijkt voortdurend of reisadviezen aanpassing vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke marginalisering van Assyriërs in Koerdisch gebied in Irak

The MP asks whether the government finds it troubling that Kurdish authorities removed an Assyrian mayor and whether the Assyrian mayor of Tel Keppe is under pressure from the KDP, and asks the government to warn Iraqi and Kurdish authorities that ethnic or religious administrative purges would lead to withdrawal of Dutch support, and whether an autonomous Christian region in the Nineveh Plain is preferable. The minister says the government has no independent information on the mayoral changes, shares concern for minorities, treats internal administration as an Iraqi matter while urging inclusive governance, and does not see federal self-rule as a durable solution.
The cabinet has no independent information on the background of the administrative changes in Tel Keppe.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de achtergronden van de bestuurswisselingen in Tel Keppe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke marginalisering van Assyriërs in Koerdisch gebied in Irak

An MP asked whether the government was aware of the appointment of a Muslim Kurd as mayor of a traditionally Christian municipality in Kurdish Iraq, why, and whether it would raise Christian fears of political marginalisation with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities. The minister acknowledged the appointment, called it an internal Iraqi matter, said the Netherlands raises inclusive governance and minority rights in bilateral and multilateral channels, but argued self-rule alone does not solve the problem.
Internal governance matters such as this are first and foremost a domestic Iraqi issue.
Interne bestuursaangelegenheden als deze zijn in de eerste plaats een Iraakse binnenlandse kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over mogelijke toetreding tot de NAVO door Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Ukraine's wish to join NATO, including a Membership Action Plan, possible security risks from the Russia conflict, and the scope of NATO and Dutch support to Ukraine. The minister replied that MAP status or membership is not on the agenda, that NATO support focuses on security-sector reform under the Comprehensive Assistance Package, and that the Netherlands gives no bilateral military aid, only contributions to NATO trust funds.
Granting MAP status to Ukraine or NATO membership is not on the agenda.
Verlening van MAP-status aan Oekraïne of toetreding tot de NAVO is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Hijink over het gebruik van spyware in China

MPs Karabulut and Hijink asked whether China forces residents of Xinjiang to install surveillance spyware under threat of prosecution, and whether the government finds this unacceptable and will raise it with Chinese authorities. The Minister confirms reports of the mandatory app, calls the privacy intrusion serious, and says the government will raise it in the next bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
The use of the app to gain access to devices and the obligation imposed by the Chinese government to install it constitute a serious infringement of the privacy of the citizens concerned.
De inzet van de app om toegang te krijgen tot apparaten en de verplichting tot het installeren ervan door de Chinese overheid maakt ernstige inbreuk op de privacy van de betrokken burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de civielrechtelijke regeling naar aanleiding van standrechtelijke executies in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

MP Karabulut asked whether the government would extend the deadline for claims by widows of people summarily executed in former Dutch East Indies and extend the scheme to children. The minister confirmed a further two-year extension of the claim window and declined to extend the scheme to children, citing pending court cases on limitation.
Given the special nature of the matter, however, the cabinet sees reason to extend the filing period by another two years.
Gezien de bijzondere aard van de zaak ziet het kabinet echter aanleiding de termijn voor indiening nog eens met twee jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Turkse legerleiding die Turkse NAVO-militairen tot spionage beveelt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish military leadership had ordered Turkish NATO personnel to spy on former colleagues, whether such practices are banned in the Netherlands, and whether NATO is investigating. The minister answered that foreign intelligence services may not operate in the Netherlands without permission, that the government acts against unauthorised activity but does not discuss specific cases publicly, and that NATO sees no specific threat to the organisation, so the matter is for the national state concerned.
As you know, specific matters are not discussed in public.
Zoals u bekend wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op specifieke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanschaf van een Russisch luchtafweersysteem door NAVO-lid Turkije

MPs Ten Broeke asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about reports that NATO member Turkey agreed to buy the Russian S-400 air defence system, and the consequences for NATO. The government said it could not confirm a definitive deal, declined to speculate on consequences, and noted that arms purchases are sovereign and NATO has no rules barring them.
However, the cabinet cannot currently confirm that Russia and Turkey have concluded a definitive agreement and also has no further information about this possible agreement.
Echter, het kabinet kan thans niet bevestigen dat Rusland en Turkije een definitieve overeenkomst hebben gesloten en beschikt ook niet over nadere informatie over deze mogelijke overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Amhaouch over de afbraak en inbeslagname van door Nederland gefinancierd zonne-energie project door Israël

MPs Knops and Amhaouch asked whether Israeli authorities demolished and largely confiscated a Dutch-funded solar project in Jubbet adh Dhib without notice, and about its harm, legal obligations, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers confirmed the demolition, reported about 40,000 euro in damage, said Israel has promised to return the panels after Dutch protests, and noted ongoing talks and EU coordination.
Prime Minister Netanyahu has informed the Netherlands by letter that the panels will be returned to the Netherlands.
Premier Netanyahu heeft per brief laten weten dat de panelen teruggegeven zullen worden aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat Israël een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject heeft gesloopt

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch development projects in Israeli-controlled Area C without permits fit Dutch policy, and whether the embassy notified Israeli authorities that the Dutch-funded project was seized. The government answered that Israel rarely issues permits, that it need not disclose donors, that the seizure lacked a prior stop-work order, and that it will leave coordination to implementing agencies without announcing a change.
As long as there is no fundamental change in the permit system, the cabinet will leave it to the implementing organisations to decide the extent to which they coordinate with the Israeli authorities.

Zolang er geen fundamentele verandering in het vergunningstelsel komt, zal het kabinet het aan de uitvoerende organisaties laten om te bepalen in welke mate zij wel of niet coördineren met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over Brussel die de deur open zet voor EU- lidmaatschap van Oekraïne

MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked whether EU Council President Tusk's quote on Ukraine's European choice undermines the Dutch no vote and the referendum, and whether the government will ever accept Ukraine's EU accession.
