The minister replied that the Council decision of 15 December 2016 legally binds an interpretation of the Association Agreement excluding candidate status, that this addresses referendum concerns, and that no accession application has been filed.

The decision of the heads of state and government does not amend the Association Agreement nor constitute a reservation, but legally binds how the EU member states implement the Association Agreement on a number of specific points.

Het besluit van staatshoofden en regeringsleiders wijzigt de Associatieovereenkomst niet en vormt evenmin een voorbehoud, maar legt juridisch bindend vast hoe de lidstaten van de Europese Unie op een aantal specifieke punten uitvoering geven aan de Associatieovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sjoerdsma over de escalatie tussen Rusland en VS inzake de strijd in Syrië

MPs Belhaj and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about the US shootdown of a Syrian jet, Russia's threat against coalition aircraft, the effect on the fight against ISIS and the Dutch tanker, and reports of rising civilian deaths and changed rules of engagement. The government answered that it lacks facts to assess the shootdown, that the fight against ISIS continues, that the Dutch tanker's deployment is unchanged, that the US says its rules of engagement were not changed, and that at least 484 civilian casualties from coalition action have been acknowledged.
The cabinet does not have the necessary facts to further interpret this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feiten om deze aanval verder te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops over de confiscatie van 50 kerken, kloosters en begraafplaatsen door Turkije

MPs Van Helvert and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported confiscation of 50 churches, monasteries and cemeteries in Mardin, the Aya Sofia Koran reading and alleged Islamist-driven Christian persecution. The minister answered that the transfers stem from lawful administrative reorganisation, that the embassy is monitoring the Aramean community, and that Aya Sofia should not become a site of provocation, while declining to characterise Turkey as systematically persecuting Christians.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's decision to place the Old City of Hebron on the World Heritage List, which they said neglects Jewish history, distorts history, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister answered that the decision was taken by the World Heritage Committee members, that ICOMOS could not verify the emergency procedure criteria because Israel denied a site visit, that the cabinet follows ICOMOS advice, and that the Netherlands will not protest but will urge coexistence.
The cabinet's position is that it follows the advice of ICOMOS.
Het kabinet hanteert als standpunt dat het de adviezen van ICOMOS volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Maeijer over de 22 miljard euro die door de EU uitgetrokken is voor de migratiecrisis

MPs Fritsma and Maeijer asked about the EU's 22 billion euro for the migration crisis, including whether the Turkey deal is included, which recipients receive funds and for what purpose, results achieved, and rescue and return numbers. The minister answered in detail on budget categories, funding instruments, Frontex and EASO, rescue figures, and IOM voluntary return numbers, while noting that the Commission does not break down the 22 billion figure and that return figures for the Netherlands will follow later.
However, the Commission does not give in detail how it arrived at these amounts in the factsheet.
De Commissie geeft in het factsheet echter niet in detail aan hoe men tot deze bedragen is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van witte fosfor in Syrië

MP Karabulut asked whether the US-led coalition used white phosphorus near Raqqa, whether that breaches international law, and whether the Netherlands will press for an immediate halt. The minister answered that international humanitarian law has no specific ban on white phosphorus, that the coalition uses it for marking and smoke screens rather than as an incendiary, and that the Netherlands will keep pressing for civilian-protection measures.
The Netherlands will continue to give particular attention within the coalition to measures to minimise the risk of civilian casualties.
Nederland blijft in coalitieverband bijzondere aandacht vragen voor maatregelen om de kans op burgerslachtoffers te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Thieme en Van den Hul over een ter dood veroordeelde Amerikaan

MPs asked the minister whether he knows of claims that US inmate Clinton Lee Young was wrongly convicted and whether the government will contact the Texas governor to seek a stay of execution. The minister confirmed awareness, restated Dutch opposition to the death penalty, and said the EU ambassador and the Dutch ambassador in Washington will write to the Texas governor expressing objections.
In this case too, the European objections will be conveyed by a letter from the EU ambassador in Washington to the governor of Texas.
Ook in dit geval zullen de Europese bezwaren door middel van een brief van de EU-ambassadeur in Washington aan de gouverneur van Texas kenbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van onder meer de Turkse directeur van Amnesty International

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the arrest of Amnesty International's Turkish director and other rights activists in Turkey, and whether the detainees should be released and what prior government efforts on rule of law in Turkey had achieved. The minister confirmed the arrests, condemned them, and described diplomatic steps (EU démarches, Council of Europe statement, Freedom Online Coalition, suspending pre-accession aid pressure) while stating that concerns on Turkey's rule of law remain serious but not directly answering whether the detainees should be released.
The cabinet condemns the arrests and the lack of protection for human rights defenders in Turkey.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de arrestaties en het gebrek aan bescherming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over een schip dat in de nabijheid van marineschepen is geëxplodeerd voor de kust van Somalië

MPs De Roon and Popken asked the ministers whether a ship exploding near naval vessels off Somalia was a navy ship, whether EU navies were involved, and which navies were present, and whether the cause would be investigated before a Dutch ship deployed there. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that the ship was very likely not a naval vessel, that an Italian frigate found nothing on investigation, and that the incident gave no reason for further inquiry.
Neither the initial incident report nor the subsequent actions of EUNAVFOR Atalanta give reason to carry out further investigation.
Zowel de initiële incidentmelding als de daaropvolgende acties van EUNAVFOR Atalanta geven geen aanleiding om verder onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Organisaties: Nederland doet te weinig voor Tsjetsjeense homo’s”

MPs Groothuizen and Sjoerdsma asked whether the Netherlands is doing enough for LGBTI people persecuted in Chechnya, including whether it funded shelters, how it treated an asylum-seeking journalist, and whether it will press Russia. The government answered that it has taken an international lead, funds small-scale first-line shelter in Russia, denies sending the journalist away, does not register asylum claims by sexual orientation, and will continue to raise the issue with Russia.
I cannot answer this question: the IND does not keep records of applications based on sexual orientation or ethnicity, or of applications based on conversion.
Op deze vraag kan ik geen antwoord geven: de IND houdt geen registratie bij van aanvragen op grond van seksuele gerichtheid of etniciteit dan wel van aanvragen op grond van bekering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de mogelijke uitlevering van Saïd C.

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands arrested Saïd C. on a Moroccan extradition request, what guarantees Morocco gave on serving any sentence in the Netherlands and on a fair trial, and whether torture concerns and Dutch prosecution were considered. Minister Blok answered that Morocco agreed to transfer enforcement of any sentence to the Netherlands and to Dutch conversion of the sentence, that the request is now for a court to assess, that the minister declines to comment on the individual case, and that the Netherlands does not normally prosecute itself when another state requests extradition.
As is customary in individual cases, I exercise restraint in my statements about the case.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk in individuele gevallen, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Nederland op het spoor is van contacten tussen hulporganisaties en smokkelbendes

MPs Knops, Keijzer and Van Helvert asked the ministers about reports that Dutch and German intelligence were tracking contacts between aid organisations and smuggling networks in the Mediterranean, and about EU operation Sophia and a near-collision with the Libyan coast guard. The government declined to discuss intelligence operations, said it awaits the outcome of an Italian fact-finding investigation, and noted that Sophia's mandate does not cover combating contacts between aid organisations and smugglers.
No public statements are made about operations of the Dutch intelligence services or about the exchange of information with partners.
Over operaties van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten en het uitwisselen van informatie met partners worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de 1f-status van alle oud-medewerkers van de Afghaanse geheime dienst

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 1F status of former Afghan secret service staff and whether MPs had access to the sources behind a 2000 country report, including verification and whether access would be granted now. The minister said several MPs were given confidential access to the underlying documents, that the Council of State found the report supported, and that future access requests would be assessed on their merits.

The cabinet will assess any concrete requests from MPs for access benevolently and on their merits, in light of necessity and the cabinet's responsibility to handle the confidential nature of the sources carefully.

Het kabinet zal eventuele concrete inzageverzoeken van Kamerleden welwillend en op hun merites beoordelen in het licht van noodzaak en tegen de achtergrond van de verantwoordelijkheid van het kabinet om zorgvuldig om te gaan met het vertrouwelijke karakter van de bronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Saoedi-Arabië dat is verkozen tot lid van de VN-vrouwenraad

Two PVV MPs asked why Saudi Arabia was elected to the UN Commission on the Status of Women, whether the Netherlands supported it, and whether Dutch funding of UN human rights bodies should stop. The Minister replied that the vote in ECOSOC is secret so countries cannot be held to account for it, that the Netherlands did not support the election, that a seat offers a chance to raise women's position with Saudi Arabia, and that the Commission is funded from the general UN budget rather than directly by the Netherlands.
The vote in ECOSOC is secret.
De stemming in de ECOSOC is geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verkiezing van Saudi-Arabië als lid van de VN-commissie die zich bezighoudt met vrouwenrechten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's election to the UN Commission on the Status of Women, including why the vote was secret, which countries ran, and whether the Netherlands would raise women's rights with Saudi counterparts. The minister said the election offers a chance to address Saudi Arabia on women's position, that the vote was secret and the Netherlands had no vote, and that human rights including women's rights are raised regularly in bilateral contacts.
The cabinet will also continue to do so intensively in future talks, and will where possible work together with EU partners or like-minded partners.
Het kabinet zal dat ook en op intensieve wijze in toekomstige gesprekken blijven doen, en zal waar mogelijk in EU-verband of samen met gelijkgestemde partners optrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over een politieteam in Indonesië tegen LHBT'ers (Lesbiënnes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) moet opsporen

MPs Van Helvert, Ten Broeke and Voordewind asked about a planned West Java police unit to hunt LHBT people, alleged threats of harsh punishment, Dutch aid to Indonesia, and whether the Netherlands will act via EU dialogue. The government says the unit has not been formally established, confirms the Netherlands raised LHBTI concerns bilaterally and via the EU, lists aid being phased out by 2020 while support to civil society continues, and commits to raising the issue in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Curaçaose kust gaat dicht”

MPs Ten Broeke and Bosman asked the government about a report that Curaçao was closing its coast to stem Venezuelan migration, and about the scope of the Kustwacht's tasks and the Dutch role in any investigation. The minister answered that the report rests partly on misinterpretation, that border control is Curaçao's own responsibility, that no concrete signs of a large refugee flow exist, and that the Kustwacht's border-guarding task is not new.
Border control is an autonomous matter of the country Curaçao.
Grensbewaking is een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over mensenrechten in de Republiek Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about heavy-handed police action against protesters in Suriname, alleged rights violations, the handling of the December murders trial, and whether the Netherlands should raise human rights with Suriname. The minister acknowledged excessive police force and promised agreements to prevent recurrence, but largely defended the Surinamese state's rights record and said the Netherlands will continue raising human rights bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands will continue to call attention to the human rights situation in Suriname, both bilaterally and multilaterally.
Nederland blijft aandacht vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Suriname, zowel bilateraal als multilateraal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU een nieuw peperduur parlementsgebouw wil

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the EU Parliament's plan to demolish and rebuild its Brussels building for 430 million euros, and whether the government will block the use of Dutch taxpayers' money and reject the EU itself. The minister confirmed awareness, said the government will not anticipate the three options under study and favours restraint on EU administrative costs, and stated that the government opposes dissolving the EU because of Dutch economic and security interests.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate this.
Het kabinet wil hier niet op vooruit lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bezoek van minister-president Modi van India aan Nederland

MP Voordewind asked the government to raise with PM Modi the restrictions on civil society and NGOs in India, visa problems for Dutch critics, labour and child labour abuses in supply chains, and violence against Dalits, Muslims and Christians. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally, without committing to specific new steps beyond ongoing dialogue.
In contacts with the Indian government, the cabinet consistently underlines the importance of civil society organisations for a well-functioning democratic constitutional state.
Het kabinet onderstreept in contacten met de Indiase overheid voortdurend het belang van maatschappelijke organisaties voor een goed functionerende democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over Oekraïne als drugsroute

Two SP MPs asked about a BBC/RTL documentary alleging drug smuggling through Ukraine and corruption among border guards, and what the EU has done about it. The minister answered that anti-corruption efforts have intensified since the Euromaidan, that the EU supports Ukrainian border reform with several million euros, and that the scale of drug flows cannot be reliably estimated.
This is difficult to estimate: Ukrainian data on intercepted drug shipments mainly concern quantities of drugs entering Ukraine.
Dit is moeilijk in te schatten: Oekraïense data over onderschepte drugszendingen zien immers vooral op hoeveelheden drugs die Oekraïne binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat een nieuw politieteam LHBT’ers (Lesbiennes, Homoseksuelen, Biseksuelen en Transgenders) in Indonesië moet opsporen

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about a West Java police chief's announced unit to track down LGBT people in Indonesia and how the Netherlands would respond. The minister said no concrete unit has been formed yet, that the Netherlands raised LGBTI rights with Indonesian authorities and through an EU demarche, and that the issue will return in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
During his visit to Indonesia from 1 to 12 May 2017, the human rights ambassador raised the Dutch concerns about the situation of the LGBTI community with the Indonesian authorities.

De mensenrechtenambassadeur heeft tijdens zijn bezoek aan Indonesië van 1 t/m 12 mei 2017 de Nederlandse zorgen over de situatie van de LHBTI-gemeenschap aan de orde gesteld bij de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over financiële steun van de EU aan Turkije

MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether EU financial aid to Turkey has been assessed for effectiveness, whether monitoring existed, and whether Turkey's accession talks should be terminated and pre-accession aid stopped and recovered. The minister said the European Court of Auditors is free to choose its audits, that IPA projects are monitored, and that accession talks are effectively stalled, with the Commission to report in 2018 on constitutional changes, while Netherlands keeps pressing to suspend pre-accession aid but lacks Council support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het oppakken van de directeur van Amnesty International in Turkije

MP Karabulut asks the Foreign Minister about the detention of Amnesty International Turkey's chair Taner Kiliç and 22 other lawyers after the 2016 coup attempt, and whether Netherlands will press for their release. The minister confirms the arrests on terrorism-membership charges, calls on Turkey to prove the charges quickly or release them, and says the Netherlands will raise the matter bilaterally, in the Council of Europe and the EU, and consider monitoring any trial.
The cabinet urgently calls on the Turkish authorities to quickly prove the accusations, in line with the standards of the European Convention on Human Rights.
Het kabinet roept de Turkse autoriteiten dringend op om de beschuldigingen spoedig te bewijzen, conform de standaarden van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Ten Broeke over het bericht 'honderden zeeschepen van de radar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Foreign Affairs about reports that hundreds of ships enter Dutch waters each month after switching off their GPS/AIS signals, and about controls on such vessels. Minister Blok answered that the Coast Guard monitors the North Sea around the clock, cannot confirm the report's claims, uses risk profiling and information-led intervention, and sees no problems with ship registration.
The Coast Guard does not have the research data on which Windward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm such a statement.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoeksgegevens waarop Windward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve een dergelijke uitspraak niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het idee om een EU-missie naar het zuiden van Libië te sturen

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about a proposed EU mission to southern Libya, including its content, human rights safeguards and existing EU missions. The minister replied that Germany and Italy had only made a general call, no formal proposal exists yet, and that the government supports examining all options while stressing human rights and migrant protection in existing programmes.
Germany and Italy have not submitted a formal proposal.
Duitsland en Italië hebben geen formeel voorstel ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Oorlog op zee tegen redders vluchtelingen'

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dijk asked whether the Public Prosecution Service knows of Dutch participation in actions against migrant rescue operations in the Mediterranean and whether such actions could be criminal, and about a Libyan coastguard warning-shot incident. The minister answered that no signals of Dutch involvement were received, that prosecution depends on jurisdiction and the national law of the country where acts occur, and that the government will keep raising maritime coordination and human rights with Libya.
I have not received any signals from the Public Prosecution Service that Dutch nationals may be involved in such activities.
Ik heb geen signalen van het openbaar ministerie (OM) ontvangen dat er mogelijk Nederlanders betrokken zijn bij dergelijke activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Groothuizen en Bouali over het bericht dat verdachte schepen niet worden gecontroleerd

MPs Jetten, Groothuizen and Bouali (D66) asked whether ships that switched off their AIS signal or changed identification before entering Dutch waters are being properly checked, and what the consequences for security and enforcement are. The government answers that AIS gaps have many legitimate causes, that the Kustwacht and Douane use risk profiling and treat AIS switch-offs as a risk indicator, that the numbers from Winward cannot be confirmed, and that modernisation and EU cooperation are underway.
The Coast Guard does not have the investigation data on which Winward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm the numbers Winward cites.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoekgegevens waarop Winward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve de door Winward genoemde aantallen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Noord-Korea en de veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlandse toeristen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the number of Dutch tourists to North Korea, the risk of hostage-taking and evacuation in case of military conflict, travel advice, sanctions, a possible US terrorism-list designation, and Dutch political and economic ties. The minister answered that registration is voluntary, that risks rise with tensions, that there is no Dutch embassy and only limited consular help, that the travel advice would be updated if needed, and that Dutch policy is critical engagement with minimal bilateral contact.
The House is only informed about specific areas of attention and the current knowledge level of the MIVD through the appropriate channels.
Over specifieke aandachtsgebieden en het actueel kennisniveau van de MIVD wordt de Kamer slechts via de daartoe geëigende kanalen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Turkse luchtaanvallen in Syrië en Irak

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish airstrikes on Kurdish fighters in Syria and Iraq, including casualty figures, whether IS benefits, and whether Turkey lacks a legal mandate and should be condemned and asked to withdraw. The minister answered that Netherlands has no independent information to confirm the reports, that IS may benefit, that Turkey has a right to self-defence, and that restraint is appropriate, without committing to a concrete démarche.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over de berichten dat Turkije Koerdische doelen in Noord-Syrië en Noord-Irak heeft aangevallen

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish strikes on Kurdish targets in northern Syria and Iraq, including whether evidence supports Turkey's claim the targets were PKK smugglers and what is known of casualties among Syrian Christians and Yazidis. The minister answered that Turkey has a right to self-defence but should show restraint and act proportionately, that the government has no evidence to confirm or refute Turkey's claim, and that it has no independent information on casualties, only open-source reports of protests.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Leijten over wapenexport naar landen die betrokken zijn bij de oorlog in Jemen

Two SP MPs asked the government about arms exports to Yemen coalition states (Egypt, UAE navies), Airbus's tax ruling, investments by pension funds and banks in Airbus, and tax facilitation of Airbus. The government said it refuses export licences for coalition states where goods may be used in combat in Yemen, declined to disclose sales volumes and tax ruling details citing confidentiality, and said banks and pension funds are addressed through due-diligence and OECD guideline frameworks.
However, under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information about individual taxpayers can be provided.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de AWR kan echter geen informatie over individuele belastingplichtigen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bezoek van de Mozambikaanse president aan Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why President Nyusi of Mozambique was received in the Netherlands before the hidden-debt fraud investigation concluded, and about his role and the government's response. The ministers answered that the topic was raised in talks, that the independent audit and criminal investigation are ongoing, and that aid resumption depends on concrete action.
In that context, the need for concrete follow-up with possible criminal prosecution was central.
Daarin is de noodzaak tot concrete opvolging met eventuele strafrechtelijke vervolging centraal gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Europarlementariërs schimmig over miljoenen aan onkostenvergoedingen”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that MEPs are opaque about spending of their general expense allowance, and whether it will push for transparency. The minister answered that transparency over allowances is primarily for MEPs and the European Parliament to decide, that a flat-rate system applies under the MEP statute, and that the government will not itself take action toward Dutch MEPs.
The cabinet considers it up to the members of the European Parliament themselves to decide how and to what extent they wish to be transparent about expense allowances.
Het kabinet acht het aan de leden van het Europees Parlement zelf te bezien op welke wijze en in hoeverre zij transparantie wensen te betrachten over onkostenvergoedingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking van Palestijnen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the UN rapporteur's view that Israel violates international law through mass administrative detention and transfer of Palestinian detainees, whether he will press Israel on treatment of prisoners, and whether he shares concerns about solitary confinement and denial of lawyers to hunger strikers. The minister answered that the government shares concerns about administrative detention, will raise prisoner conditions in regular human rights dialogue, and that the EU raised the issue with Israeli authorities and issued a local statement calling for full respect of prisoners' human rights.
The government shares concerns about the scale and duration of administrative detention.
Het kabinet deelt zorgen over de schaal en duur van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat in het Indonesische Atjeh twee mannen tot stokslagen zijn veroordeeld wegens homoseksualiteit

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about two men in Aceh, Indonesia, sentenced to caning for homosexuality, and whether the government raised concerns with Indonesia and the EU and how to prevent spillover. The minister answered that the Netherlands raised the case through the human rights ambassador and an EU demarche, and will discuss LHBTI rights in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue later this year.

The human rights ambassador directly raised Dutch concerns about the situation of the LGBTI community, including developments in the case against two men in Aceh, during his visit to Indonesia from 1 to 12 May 2017.

De mensenrechtenambassadeur heeft dan ook direct tijdens zijn bezoek aan Indonesië van 1 t/m 12 mei 2017 de Nederlandse zorgen over de situatie van de LHBTI-gemeenschap, waaronder ontwikkelingen rondom de zaak tegen twee mannen in Atjeh, besproken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat in Indonesië twee homoseksuele mannen vandaag 85 stokslagen hebben gekregen en 141 mannen in een 'homosauna' zijn gearresteerd

The MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knew of the caning of two gay men in Aceh and the arrest of 141 men in a Jakarta 'homosauna', what steps the government had taken, and how it would press Indonesia to stop such treatment. The minister confirmed the events, described the diplomatic steps taken (the human rights ambassador's visit, an EU demarche, and a planned EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue) and said the government would continue to raise concerns about LHBTI rights bilaterally and in the EU.
The Netherlands will bilaterally and within the EU, in regular contacts with the Indonesian government, voice its concern about the situation of LHBTI persons in Indonesia
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband in reguliere contacten met de Indonesische overheid zijn zorg uitspreken over de situatie van LHBTI's in Indonesië
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over Nederlands belastinggeld voor pro-Oekraïne propaganda

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch taxpayer money funded the Ukraine Crisis Media Centre and whether EU money or Ukrainian oligarch-funded broadcasts were involved before the referendum-related vote on the association agreement. The minister confirmed two MATRA-fund projects worth about EUR 198,000 in total, denied EU funding, and rejected the claim that the government was involved in the broadcast.
The Dutch Embassy in Kiev financed two projects of the Ukraine Crisis Media Center from the MATRA fund.
De Nederlandse Ambassade in Kiev heeft een tweetal projecten van het Ukraine Crisis Media Center gefinancierd uit het MATRA-fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de detentie en repressie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and deportation to Saudi Arabia of human rights defenders, including Al-Otaibi, and about rising repression, asking whether Dutch action and an EU statement were planned. The minister said the Netherlands was surprised by the deportation, raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that an EU statement proved unfeasible, so the Dutch ambassador would raise the case with Saudi authorities.
The Netherlands, like other countries, was surprised by the sudden deportation of the person concerned by the Qatari authorities to Saudi Arabia.
Nederland werd, net als andere landen, verrast door de plotselinge deportatie van betrokkene door de Qatari autoriteiten naar Saoedi-Arabië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Nederlandse financiering van mobiele (sharia) rechtbanken in Somalië

An MP asked whether the Netherlands' 2 million euro contribution to Somalia's Joint Rule of Law Programme funds sharia-based mobile courts, and whether the money should be withdrawn. The minister answered that the funds target access to formal justice, that the formal system is being strengthened to reduce space for sharia and armed-group courts, and that the government will press Somalia on anti-piracy legislation.
The cabinet of course maintains close oversight of the spending of Dutch funds.
Het kabinet houdt uiteraard goed toezicht op de besteding van de Nederlandse middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het meewerken aan illegaal commercieel draagmoederschap uit Cambodja door de Nederlandse ambassade

An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Dutch embassy in Cambodia assisted in bringing a baby from an allegedly illegal commercial surrogacy arrangement to the Netherlands, and raised questions about surrogacy policy, nationality recognition, and possible extradition. The minister answered that the embassy only accepts passport applications under Dutch law, defers the broader policy question on surrogacy to a future cabinet, and says it is for foreign authorities to act on illegal conduct abroad.
A decision on following up the Staatscommissie's recommendations, including those on surrogacy, I gladly leave, in light of this, to a next cabinet.
Een beslissing over de opvolging van de aanbevelingen van de Staatscommissie, waaronder die over draagmoederschap, laat ik mede in dat licht graag aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de concentratiekampen voor homoseksuelen in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to reports of concentration camps for gay men in Chechnya, including casualty figures, contacts with Russian authorities, Kremlin statements, asylum treatment of LGBTI refugees and Dutch leadership on LGBTI rights. The minister condemns the reports, describes Dutch diplomatic and multilateral efforts (EU, OSCE, Equal Rights Coalition, talks with Lavrov and the UN) and notes that LGBTI asylum seekers from Russia are treated as a risk group, while resettlement is a UNHCR decision.
Precise figures are not known, but various media and NGOs speak of 160 persons detained and at least 3 men who died during or after their detention.
Precieze cijfers zijn niet bekend maar verschillende media en ngo's spreken van 160 personen die gevangen zijn gezet en minimaal 3 mannen die tijdens of na hun gevangenschap zijn overleden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de VN-Veiligheidsraad

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked whether the government would make prosecution of MH17 downers and ISIS fighters priorities of Dutch Security Council membership, and whether it would send the monthly programme of the presidency. The minister said priorities would be sent in a letter in autumn, that MH17 accountability remains top priority, that ISIS prosecution will be explored, and that the programme will be sent monthly.
To that end, the House will receive a letter in the autumn, after government-wide consultation.
Daartoe zal de Kamer in het najaar een brief toegaan, na rijksbrede afstemming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgelijke ontwikkelingen binnen de rechterlijke macht in Polen

An SP MP asked the government about the erosion of judicial independence in Poland and what further action it would take. The government answered that it monitors developments closely, will keep pursuing multiple channels (EU, Council of Europe, UN, bilateral), and cites mutual trust in judicial decisions and ongoing dialogue with the Commission as its approach.
The cabinet is aware of developments in Poland, follows them closely and with concern.
Het kabinet is op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen in Polen, volgt die op de voet en met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'Turkije haalt uit: Nederland is xenofoob en islamofoob'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Turkish ambassador should be expelled after Turkey accused the Netherlands of xenophobia and Islamophobia, and whether Turkey's human rights record should be taken into account. The government answered that it seeks to de-escalate diplomatic tensions and does not consider sending the ambassador back desirable.
The Cabinet is aiming to de-escalate the diplomatic tensions between the two countries.
Het Kabinet zet in op de-escalatie van de diplomatieke spanningen tussen beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de beveiliging van websites van Nederlandse ambassades

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about insecure websites of Dutch embassies in Afghanistan, China, Egypt and Sudan, whether the risks were known for months, and when a fix would come. The minister denied the sites remained insecure, said they have been replaced by new HTTPS-enforcing sites, and argued the earlier risk was low because no sensitive personal data was collected.
No, it is not correct that the websites of the Dutch embassies in the four named countries are still insufficiently secured.
Nee, het klopt niet dat de websites van de Nederlandse ambassades in de vier genoemde landen nog altijd onvoldoende zijn beveiligd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat Israël het visum van NRC-correspondent Derk Walters niet wil verlengen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to press Israel over its refusal to extend the visa of NRC correspondent Derk Walters, questioning press surveillance and the claim that content was not a factor. The minister replied that Israel cites visa violations, acknowledges it is free to set its admission policy, regrets the decision, and says it has repeatedly raised press freedom with Israeli authorities.
Israel, like any other country, is free to determine its admission policy.
Israël is net als ieder ander land vrij zijn toelatingsbeleid te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het programma Ontvoerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice cooperated with the RTL programme Ontvoerd on child abduction, and raised concerns about child harm, due process and media interests. The state secretary answered that the Central Authority gave only general information in three meetings in 2012–2013, that the ministries were not involved in producing the programme, and that broadcasting and participation decisions rest with the broadcaster and parents.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 10 and 11, three meetings took place in 2012 and 2013 between officials of the Central Authority and the editorial team of RTL-Ontvoerd.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in antwoord op de vragen 1, 10 en 11 hebben in 2012 en 2013 drie gesprekken plaatsgevonden tussen ambtenaren van de Centrale autoriteit en de redactie van RTL-Ontvoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van trucks naar Soedan

MP Karabulut asked whether used military trucks exported by Dutch firms to Sudan, possibly still militarily equipped, were used in the armed conflict and whether this breaches the Sudan arms embargo. The government answered that the trucks were demilitarised and exported as civilian vehicles without licence requirement, that it lacks data on their use in the conflict, that the export does not breach the embargo, and that export criteria for ex-military vehicles were already tightened in 2016.
The ministry does not have independent information on the use of trucks in the armed conflict in Sudan.
Het ministerie beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de inzet van trucks in het gewapend conflict in Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat de Europese Unie geld heeft gestoken in een Tsjechisch bordeel

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether EU structural funds paying for a Czech brothel shows the failure of the EU, how much similar opaque spending occurs, and whether the Netherlands should cut its contribution to zero. The minister answered that EU and national controls detected the misspending, the Czech authorities recovered the funds, and the cabinet stands by the Rome Declaration and its treaty obligations.
In this case, this control system revealed that there was undesirable spending.
In dit geval is door dit controlesysteem aan het licht gekomen dat er sprake is van ongewenste besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Turkse regering die campagne voert in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would act against Turkish ministers campaigning in the Netherlands, including by pressing the Turkish government and preventing municipalities from hosting such events, as Germany had done. The answer refers to a separate letter to the House on the campaign visits and the events around 11 March 2017, rather than answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes ... have been answered by way of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes ... zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheden tot het verbieden van campagnes van buitenlandse politici van niet-vrije landen in Nederland

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government could ban political campaigning in the Netherlands by foreign politicians from non-free countries, citing the European Convention on Human Rights and its Article 16. The government answered that questions 1 to 8 were addressed in a separate letter to parliament on the Turkish ministers' campaign visits of March 2017.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de schoffering van Nederland door de Turkse regering

Two MPs from the Bontes/Van Klaveren group asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged insults to the Netherlands, dual nationality and loyalty, expelling the Turkish ambassador, and halting EU accession talks. The government referred to a separate letter on Turkish ministers' campaign visits and did not answer the substantive questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ten Broeke , Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Grashoff en Voordewind over schandalige intimidatiepraktijken en misleiding door Turkije

Six MPs asked the government about reported intimidation of Turkish-Dutch citizens and a Rotterdam CDA councillor by Turkish consular officials, whether the consul misled Dutch authorities, and whether the consul should be expelled. The government answered by referring the MPs to a separate letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 34 824, nr. 195) on the ministerial campaign visits and the events of 11 March 2017, without answering the questions in the reply itself.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van den Hul over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal in Rusland in 2018

Two MPs asked the government about reports of forced labour and modern slavery among North Korean workers building a World Cup stadium in Russia, whether this breaches sanctions, and what Dutch action is possible. The minister said the reports are serious, that FIFA should investigate and that the Netherlands will press for action in EU and UN settings, while noting the sanctions do not ban such employment.
The cabinet expects FIFA to investigate this matter thoroughly and to take the results of the investigation seriously.
Het kabinet verwacht van de FIFA dat het deze zaak grondig onderzoekt en de resultaten van het onderzoek serieus neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de gedwongen sluiting van de Central European University in Hongarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hungary's amended higher education law effectively forces out the Central European University and whether a bill on foreign-funded NGOs restricts civil society, and how the Netherlands would respond. The minister answered that the government is concerned, raised the matter with Hungary, noted the Commission's infringement procedure against Hungary over the higher education law, and said the NGO bill is still being monitored and not yet adopted.
The cabinet supports the European Commission in monitoring that member states comply with European rules and in safeguarding shared values, and will closely follow further steps.

Het kabinet steunt de Europese Commissie die er op toeziet dat lidstaten zich aan Europese regelgeving houden en als het gaat om het waarborgen van gedeelde waarden, en zal vervolgstappen nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid Voordewind over over het bericht dat vluchtelingen worden mishandeld langs en binnen de grenzen van de Europese Unie

MP Voordewind asked the ministers about an Oxfam Novib report on pushbacks and abuse of migrants at EU borders, asking whether the government would press Croatia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia and Macedonia on rights and abuses and support more safe asylum routes. The government condemned violence against refugees, said enforcement of EU law rests primarily with the Commission, said Bulgaria's border protection does not imply abuse was state policy, and pointed to existing support for Serbia and Macedonia and to resettlement as the preferred route.
The cabinet condemns all forms of violence against refugees.
Het kabinet veroordeelt iedere vorm van geweld tegen vluchtelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Fritsma en Wilders over EU watertaxi’s die 8500 migranten redden

PVV MPs asked about reports that 8,500 migrants were rescued off Libya over Easter weekend, including how many were picked up by Frontex, Italy, NGOs and merchant ships, where they were landed, whether they are held in closed centres, whether terrorists could be among them, whether EU policy creates a pull effect, and whether the Netherlands will close its borders. The government confirmed the figures, said it lacks detailed data on each rescue, described hotspot screening and Europol checks, rejected border closure as neither a complete solution nor clearly feasible, and pointed to a broader EU approach with Libya.
The cabinet does not have detailed information on all rescue operations carried out by various vessels over the Easter weekend.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gedetailleerde informatie over alle reddingsoperaties die in het paasweekend door verschillende schepen zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Turkije een Turkse beul heeft aangesteld bij een VN-vredesmissie

The MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that a Turkish police officer suspected of torture was assigned to a UN mission in South Sudan, and whether UN screening leaves vetting to contributing countries. The minister says the allegations cannot be verified, that persons under criminal investigation should not be deployed, explains the UN candidate screening procedure, and maintains the Dutch contribution to UNMISS.
The cabinet cannot, however, verify what is described in the article and therefore cannot confirm it either.
Het kabinet kan hetgeen beschreven is in het artikel echter niet verifiëren en dus ook niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat UNESCO een resolutie in stemming wil brengen waarin de soevereiniteit van Israël over West-Jeruzalem ontkend

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and VVD asked whether the government would use its influence in UNESCO to block a draft resolution denying Israeli sovereignty over West Jerusalem, and why UNESCO engages with such politicised texts. The minister said the Netherlands criticised the draft, voted against the adopted version together with Germany, Greece and Lithuania, and that UNESCO's focus on the Old City reflects its World Heritage listings, but did not commit to further action.
The Netherlands therefore voted against the decision, as explained in a joint statement of vote with Germany, Greece and Lithuania.
Nederland heeft daarom tegen het besluit gestemd, zoals toegelicht in een gezamenlijke stemverklaring met Duitsland, Griekenland en Litouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de campagne in Nederland voor het referendum in Turkije

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about the Turkish referendum campaign in the Netherlands, including bus transport aimed only at Yes or No voters, intimidation of campaigners and a journalist, and where the limit on foreign influence over Turkish Dutch citizens lies. The government answered that transport offers are not unusual and lawful, that intimidation is unacceptable and should be reported to police, that foreign interference is firmly opposed, and that the journalist's case is under police investigation.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence the choices of Dutch citizens.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat buitenlandse overheden keuzes van Nederlandse burgers openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Martin Bosma over de roofmoord op een Nederlander in Zuid-Afrika

PVV MPs De Roon and Bosma asked the Foreign Minister about the robbery-murder of a Dutch national on his farm in South Africa, the rising number of farm murders, conviction rates, police follow-up, and pressure on the South African government. The minister confirmed the killing, said official data on a rise is lacking, cited an AfriForum report showing 23 percent of suspects convicted, said the embassy and Dutch police are following the investigation, and said the government raises public order concerns through existing cooperation and the EU human rights dialogue.
The Dutch Embassy in Pretoria is in contact with the Barberton police, the South African police force investigating the murder.
De Nederlandse Ambassade in Pretoria staat in contact met de politie van Barberton, het Zuid-Afrikaanse politiekorps dat de moord onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Azmani en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse AK-partij weer een ronselbrief aan Nederlanders met een Turkse achtergrond heeft gestuurd

VVD MPs asked whether the Turkish AK party again sent a recruitment letter, signed by the Turkish prime minister, to Turkish-Dutch citizens about the referendum, whether it used the same address list as in 2015, and whether the government will raise this with Turkey. The minister confirmed some recipients received the letter, said it is unknown whether the 2015 address list was reused, noted Turkish parties can buy voter address lists, and said the government remains opposed to political campaigning by Turkish officials in the Netherlands.
It is not known whether the AK party used the same address list as in 2015.
Het is niet bekend of de AK-partij gebruik heeft gemaakt van hetzelfde adressenbestand als in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van Meenen over de berichten ‘Turkse spionage in Duitsland’ en ‘Terrorist vanwege interview met Rutte’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Turkish intelligence espionage reported in Germany also occurs in the Netherlands, including watch lists, whether Turkish-Dutch citizens are warned, whether Dutch services have enough Turkish language capacity, and how the government responds to threats against a journalist after an interview with PM Rutte. The government declined to say publicly whether such activity occurs or what services know, citing that no public statements can be made about investigations or service expertise, condemned threats against press freedom, and urged the journalist to file a police report.
No public statements can be made about investigations into activities these services might carry out without Dutch government permission, or about any resulting course of action.

Over onderzoek naar activiteiten die deze diensten zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren en over het eventuele handelings-perspectief dat uit een dergelijk onderzoek zou voortvloeien, kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanleg van een pijpleiding in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the government about bank financing for the Dakota Access pipeline, the status of the project, concerns of the Sioux tribes over environment, drinking water, sacred land and treaty rights, and whether ING remains involved. The government answered that the permitting is a US sovereign matter with courts open to objectors, that the Dutch government respects indigenous rights, and that ING has agreed to sell its loan following dialogue with the Standing Rock Sioux.
The decision to grant a permit for the construction of infrastructure projects is a national and sovereign competence of the United States.
De afweging om een vergunning te verlenen voor de aanleg van infrastructurele bouwprojecten is een nationale en soevereine bevoegdheid van de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de behandeling van Pakistaanse asielzoekers en vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the treatment of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including whether Thailand treats them as an immigration matter, arbitrary detention risks, Dutch dialogue results and NGO support. The minister answered that Thailand still treats refugee matters as immigration, that Pakistanis are not singled out, that Dutch and EU raise the issue regularly, and that resettlement destinations are a matter for the State Secretary of Justice and Security.
Thailand still regards the fate of refugees and asylum seekers within its borders as an immigration matter.
Thailand beschouwt het lot van vluchtelingen en asielzoekers binnen de landsgrenzen nog altijd als een immigratiezaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een blogger uit Bangladesh die met de dood wordt bedreigd

MP Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to reports that Sweden refused asylum to Bangladeshi blogger Mishu Dhar, and about the threats and protection of bloggers in Bangladesh. The minister said Dutch authorities cannot intervene in another country's individual asylum decisions, described the security situation and diplomatic efforts with Bangladesh, and pointed to the Shelter City and ProtectDefenders options without committing to new action.
An application for asylum in a country falls under privacy legislation.
Een aanvraag tot asiel in een land valt onder de privacy wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Berlijn zeer terughoudend is geworden met wapenexport naar Turkije

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked whether Germany had become very restrictive on arms export licences to Turkey after the 2016 coup attempt and what the Netherlands was doing in response. The ministers answered that licences are assessed case by case against EU criteria, that four licences were refused in 2016 on internal-situation grounds, and that no EU-wide change or unilateral embargo is planned.
The cabinet publishes a monthly overview of issued arms export licences.
Het kabinet publiceert maandelijks een overzicht van afgegeven vergunningen voor wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de situatie in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about alleged human rights abuses and a curfew in Korukoy, southeast Turkey, and whether the government would press Turkish counterparts to admit independent observers and investigate. The minister confirmed a curfew and communications cut from 11 February to 2 March, said the abuse reports cannot yet be verified, and said the government is concerned and has urged that Turkish counter-terrorism measures be proportionate, without committing to new contacts or an investigation.
Reports from human rights organisations and Kurdish politicians about torture, killing, destroyed homes and other human rights violations are cause for concern, but cannot yet be verified.

Berichten van mensenrechtenorganisaties en Koerdische politici over marteling, moord, vernielde woningen en andere mensenrechtenschendingen zijn reden tot zorg, maar kunnen nog niet worden geverifieerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de toestroom van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen naar Curaçao

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked about the sudden influx of Venezuelan refugees to Curaçao, whether the government had informed parliament, its earlier claims of no mass migration, the number of registered and unregistered refugees, reception capacity, crisis scenarios, support given, and asylum legislation gaps. The government answered that there is no mass migration flow, that about 20 asylum applications were registered on Curaçao and 2 on Aruba, that the islands lack capacity for thousands, that crisis scenarios and planning exist with the islands primarily responsible, and that asylum law is an autonomous matter for Curaçao and Aruba.
There is no question of a mass migration flow towards the Caribbean part of the Kingdom.
Er is geen sprake van een massale migratiestroom richting het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat Duitsland voorstellen heeft gedaan om minder rekening te houden met mensenrechten zodat migranten kunnen worden teruggestuurd naar Noord-Afrikaanse landen om d

MP Voortman (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether they knew of German proposals to weaken human-rights safeguards so migrants could be returned to North African countries to await asylum decisions, and whether the government would oppose such proposals. The state secretary replied that the government was aware, that international and European human-rights obligations frame the German proposal, that it would review safe-third-country conditions critically, and that it would keep international migration law central, without committing to any specific step against the proposal.

The government is of the view that the situation in a third country must always be assessed to determine whether that country, now or in future, can be considered safe in accordance with the applicable European and international legal frameworks.

Het kabinet is van mening dat steeds op basis van de situatie in een derde land moet worden bezien of dit land, nu of in de toekomst, als veilig kan worden bestempeld conform de geldende Europees- en internationaalrechtelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Raak over het bericht dat de CIA kwetsbaarheden in met het internet verbonden apparaten misbruikt

MPs Voortman and Van Raak asked whether the CIA uses smartphone and smart TV vulnerabilities to spy on people, including Dutch citizens, whether it withholds vulnerabilities from developers, and whether Dutch services will gain similar powers under the new intelligence law. The government said it has no concrete evidence of unlawful intrusion on Dutch citizens, referred to earlier letters on vulnerability handling, declined to judge the CIA's conduct on the basis of leaked material, and saw no reason to raise the matter with US authorities.
Based on the information published by Wikileaks, the cabinet cannot conclude that the American authorities have been negligent.
Op basis van de door Wikileaks gepubliceerde informatie kan door het kabinet niet worden geconcludeerd dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten nalatig zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de positie van de Ahmadiyya gemeenschap in Algerije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Ahmadiyya members in Algeria for promoting their faith and the community's treatment there. The minister confirmed the arrests of 12 members on grounds including an unlicensed religious association and distribution of publications harming state interests, said the government shares concern over the situation, and pledged to raise human rights and Ahmadiyya protection in bilateral talks, EU forums and the UPR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de gang van zaken in de nasleep van de moord op drie vrouwen in Parijs

The MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch authorities knew that suspect Ömer Güney had died, what information was exchanged with France and Turkey about the Paris murders, whether he was a Turkish infiltrant, and how information misuse can be prevented. The government answered that it did not know of his death until media reports, declined to discuss the information exchange or the French indictment, said it had no information about an infiltrant, and deflected questions on Turkish use of shared information.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over de mensenrechtensituatie in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Morocco, including limited NGO access, the death of fishmonger Mohsin Fikri, police handling of protests, and Dutch projects supporting fair justice. The minister acknowledged remaining shortcomings, said the case is before Moroccan courts and the embassy will monitor it, and listed Dutch-supported training projects, without committing to a new independent inquiry.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor developments and regularly stress the importance of respecting the right to freedom of demonstration in bilateral contacts and within the EU.

Nederland zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en met regelmaat het belang van de eerbiediging van het recht op vrijheid van demonstratie blijven benadrukken in de bilaterale contacten, alsmede in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de berichten dat Hongarije en Oostenrijk buiten de EU om immigratiebeleid willen gaan voeren

MP Voortman asked whether the government knows of Hungary's plans to detain asylum seekers and of Austria's proposal to process asylum claims outside the EU, and how it will respond. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said the Commission will examine Hungary's law and the government is concerned, and pointed to the Commission and Malta's presidency as the channels for EU-wide asylum reform, without committing to new national steps.
It is up to the European Commission to monitor compliance with EU law and regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om toe te zien op de naleving van EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders

SP MPs asked whether hundreds of North Korean forced labourers work at a Polish shipyard of CRIST S.A. that repairs Dutch civil vessels, whether such labour occurs elsewhere in Europe or the Netherlands, what Dutch and EU action is taken, and how much of their wages go to the North Korean state. The minister replied that Polish inspections found no forced-labour indicators, that Dutch firms are expected to apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and the 2014 ILO Protocol, and that Netherlands has raised the issue in EU and UN fora.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de schrikbarende stijging van het aantal ‘plaasmoorde’ in Zuid-Afrika

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported sharp rise in farm murders in South Africa, including the claim that over 30 white farmers and family members were killed in the first two months of 2017, and what the government is doing about it. The minister could not confirm the figures, noted that official statistics do not separate victims by race or occupation, described the causes and South African police measures, and said prosecution is South Africa's own responsibility while Netherlands cooperates only ad hoc.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm with certainty the numbers stated in your question.
Het kabinet kan daarom de gestelde aantallen in uw vraag niet met zekerheid bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over een interventie door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in een onderzoek naar een smeergeldaffaire waarin het Saoedisch koningshuis betrokken zou zijn

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether the Foreign Ministry intervened to halt a bribery investigation involving Saudi royals, including cancelling the hearing of a Saudi witness, and whether a criminal investigation may be blocked for diplomatic reasons. The ministers answered that the decision not to send a mutual legal assistance request followed the normal procedure, weighing security risks to the witness rather than diplomatic relations, and declined to launch a separate inquiry.
Contrary to what the questions suggest, relations with the country to be approached are not decisive in weighing whether a legal assistance request is submitted.
Anders dan in de vragen wordt gesuggereerd, zijn verhoudingen met het aan te zoeken land niet van doorslaggevend belang bij de afweging of een rechtshulpverzoek wordt ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Maij over het wegduiken van lidstaten bij gevoelige kwesties in Europa

MPs Van der Velde and Maij asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about member states avoiding contentious EU decisions on GMOs and pesticides, and whether the Commission's proposal to shift comitology responsibility to member states is adequate. Minister Koenders answered that impasses arise over health and safety questions, Dutch positions follow stated policy, the appraisal of the proposal is still being formed, and the next steps are not yet known.
That is why he announced that he wanted to present the proposals now on the table to place political responsibility for decisions on implementing acts more with the member states.

Daarom kondigde hij aan met de nu voorliggende voorstellen te willen komen om de politieke verantwoordelijkheid voor besluitvorming over uitvoeringshandelingen in grotere mate bij de lidstaten neer te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Knops over de lobby om het Europese geneesmiddelenagentschap naar Nederland te halen

Two CDA MPs asked why the government focuses its bid to host the European Medicines Agency on a site near Schiphol and whether South Limburg was considered. The minister answered that Schiphol's accessibility and facilities best meet the agency's criteria and that South Limburg was assessed but offers fewer connections, while declining to commit to including South Limburg in the bid.
The Netherlands wants to put the best possible bid on the table, and the cabinet believes the Netherlands creates the most promising offer with an EMA location near Schiphol.
Nederland wil het best mogelijke bod op tafel leggen en het kabinet is van mening dat Nederland het meest kansrijke aanbod creëert met een locatie van de EMA in de nabijheid van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de wijziging van het zetelverdrag van het Joegoslaviëtribunaal

Two MPs asked whether amendments to the host-state agreement of the Yugoslavia Tribunal extend AOW pension coverage to family members of its staff retroactively to 2009 and why not to 1994 as the UN requested. The minister confirms the 2009 retroactive date, explains it was a goodwill choice rather than a legal obligation, and declines to extend it to 1994 because family members were explicitly excluded in the 1994 agreement.
The decision on retroactive effect is not based on an (international) legal obligation but was chosen as an accommodation for the MICT.
Het besluit met betrekking tot de terugwerkende kracht is niet gebaseerd op een (internationaal) juridische verplichting, maar is gekozen als tegemoetkoming voor het MICT
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht inzake de illegale opstelling van raketten door Rusland

MP Ten Broeke asks the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether Russia deployed new intermediate-range missiles in breach of the INF treaty and how NATO has responded. The government says it cannot yet confirm the deployment, notes that such deployment would breach the treaty, and describes ongoing NATO-Russia dialogue and a pattern of Russian provocations.
the government cannot yet confirm that the Russian armed forces have deployed a ground-launched cruise missile with a range of 500 to 5,500 kilometres
kan de regering het opstellen van een grondgelanceerd kruisvluchtwapen met een bereik van 500 kilometer tot 5.500 kilometer door de Russische krijgsmacht vooralsnog niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de omgang van Nederland met het seksueel misbruik van minderjarige jongens (‘bacha bazi’) in Afghanistan

MP Belhaj asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers how the Netherlands handled bacha bazi (sexual abuse of boys) in Afghanistan, including pre-deployment briefing, protocols, reports by soldiers and Afghan criminal law. The ministers answered that no specific protocols existed, one 2007 incident was reported to Afghan police without known prosecution, and they would raise children's rights in existing dialogues.
There are no specific guidelines or protocols for Dutch soldiers on how to act regarding bacha bazi.
Er zijn geen specifieke richtlijnen of protocollen voor Nederlandse militairen hoe zij moeten handelen ten aanzien van «bacha bazi».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over de verdergaande ondermijning van de rechtsstaat en de democratie in Polen

Two SP MPs asked the government about the erosion of rule of law and judicial independence in Poland, EU sanctions under Article 7, judicial cooperation, and Kaczynski's remarks on a two-speed EU and refugees. The government answered that it follows developments closely, pursues dialogue bilaterally and in EU fora, considers Article 7 not currently at issue, and that judicial cooperation continues as no grounds to refuse were found.
Triggering the Article 7 procedure is not currently on the table.
Het in werking stellen van de artikel 7 procedure is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de slag om Chora

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers whether they would revise the official civilian death toll from the 2007 Chora operation after a documentary with eyewitness claims, whether Australia objected to artillery use, and whether a COMISAF report and NATO's response can be shared. The government declined to revise its position, pointed to several prior investigations, said Australia raised no objection and was not involved in the fire decisions, and withheld the COMISAF report and NATO response as operationally sensitive.
The COMISAF report and the reaction of SACEUR and the NATO Secretary General contain operationally sensitive information.
Het rapport van COMISAF en de reactie van SACEUR en de Secretaris-generaal van de Navo hierop bevatten operationeel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Keijzer en Ten Broeke over uitspraken van de president van Mali over terugname van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers en illegalen
