MPs from CDA and VVD asked the ministers whether Mali's president's statements that Mali would never sign a readmission agreement undermined the EU-Mali migration deal and whether Mali was cooperating enough on returning its nationals, and whether pressure or aid conditionality should be used. The government answered that the joint declaration remains valid, that Mali is bound by international law to cooperate on returns, that only about ten Malians returned voluntarily since 2014 and none forcibly, and that it prefers a broad pragmatic approach over negative incentives such as cutting aid.
The cabinet is of the view that measures to encourage this cooperation are most effective when they are part of a broader package.
Het kabinet is van mening dat maatregelen om deze medewerking te stimuleren het effectiefst zijn als zij onderdeel zijn van een breder pakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw na 24 jaar het Verenigd Koninkrijk moet verlaten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch woman living in the UK for 24 years must leave after Brexit, and whether Dutch citizens in the UK would be supported and the UK government contacted. The minister could not confirm the case, said it was not generalisable, noted the embassy provides information, and said rights of EU citizens will be negotiated after the UK formally triggers Article 50.
No, I cannot confirm the content of the newspaper article.
Nee, ik kan de inhoud van het krantenartikel niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw het Verenigd Koninkrijk na 24 jaar moet verlaten

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that a Dutch woman married to a Briton, with 24 years' residence in the UK, was told to leave after her citizenship/residence application was refused over her passport copy, and whether more Dutch citizens face the same problem. The minister says the case is not confirmed, the ministry was not involved, the woman reapplied and reportedly got a residence permit, and that Brexit rights will be addressed in negotiations.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is not automatically involved in immigration or naturalisation applications by Dutch citizens abroad.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is niet automatisch betrokken bij immigratie of naturalisatie aanvragen van Nederlandse burgers in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over een tweet van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Denemarken

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about a tweet by the Dutch ambassador to Denmark calling a possible VVD refusal to govern with the PVV 'Good news! No more feeding the beast?', and whether this denigrates PVV voters and whether it fits an official's conduct. The minister says the ambassador apologised, that the tweet should not have been posted, and that social media use by ambassadors is encouraged within the integrity code.
The ambassador has decided to apologise on Twitter.
De ambassadeur heeft besloten op Twitter zijn excuses aan te bieden.

Vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religie

MPs asked the government about reports that Gulf states inform the Netherlands about financing of religious institutions, including why a list of mosques receiving Saudi funding was not published and what agreements exist with Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. The minister replied that the information is shared confidentially via diplomatic channels, that interdepartmental sharing was agreed in 2016, that talks with Gulf states are ongoing, and that the Chamber was informed confidentially in November 2016.
The information the cabinet holds is obtained through diplomatic channels and is therefore confidential.
De informatie waarover het kabinet beschikt wordt via diplomatiek verkeer verkregen en is daarmee vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Voordewind over het bericht dat de UNHCR gehinderd wordt door Turkije in de monitoring van de vluchtelingendeal

MPs Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked about reports that UNHCR lacks unhindered access to Turkish reception centres and to monitor returned migrants under the EU-Turkey deal, and about deaths at the Syrian border. The minister replied that access is a recurring topic with Turkey and the Commission, that there is no systematic refusal, that the government cannot confirm the reported shooting deaths, and that it will keep raising access in the Commission's regular reporting.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to press the Commission that regular access forms part of the joint approach, and that this receives attention in the regular reporting.
Nederland zal dan ook bij de Commissie blijven bepleiten dat regelmatige toegang deel uitmaakt van de gezamenlijke aanpak, en dat daarvoor bij de reguliere rapportage aandacht bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over weer een lancering van een ballistische raket door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran's January 2017 Khorramshahr ballistic missile launch violates UN resolution 2231, what measures were taken after earlier launches, and whether Iran's conduct is tolerated. The minister confirmed the launch, said it is legally not a violation but inconsistent with Annex B, and described raising the issue in the UN Security Council, EU statements and bilateral contacts while noting insufficient support for new sanctions.
The cabinet will have to keep increasing pressure on Iran, as far as possible jointly with the EU partners.
Het kabinet zal, zoveel mogelijk gezamenlijk met de EU-partners, druk op Iran moeten blijven opvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het opheffen van de bibliotheek van het Vredespaleis

MP Sjoerdsma asked why the government planned to end subsidy for the Peace Palace library from 2019, noting its importance for international courts, and whether the Carnegie foundation's founding deed obliges the Netherlands to maintain it. The minister replied that no separate library subsidy exists, that the Foreign Ministry pays EUR 4.4 million per year to the Carnegie Foundation which manages the library, and that there is no reason to assume the library will disappear.
There is no separate subsidy for the Peace Palace library.
Er is geen sprake van een aparte subsidie voor de bibliotheek van het Vredespaleis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ünver en Maij over het bericht dat in Turkije geen televisieberichtgeving over aanslagen is toegestaan

MPs Ünver and Maij asked the Foreign Minister about a reported Turkish ban on television coverage of terrorist attacks, its legality, Turkey's wider press freedom restrictions, and Dutch action in the Council of Europe and ECtHR. The minister confirmed the ban was government-ordered during the state of emergency, listed journalist detentions and media closures, and described Dutch support for independent Turkish media and Council of Europe engagement.
By issuing this instruction from the government, Turkish media are, in the period immediately following an attack, only permitted to pass on official government communications to the public.

Met het van overheidswege uitvaardigen van deze instructie wordt het Turkse media in de periode direct volgend op een aanslag uitsluitend nog toegestaan om officiële regeringsmededelingen door te geven aan het publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de mensenrechtensituatie van de Rohingya-bevolking in Myanmar

Labour MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about alleged serious human rights violations against the Rohingya in Myanmar, including army conduct after the 9 October attacks, and urges pressure on Myanmar. The minister answers that the Netherlands presses for independent investigation and humanitarian access, reports disciplinary action against police, notes an EU resolution at the UN Human Rights Council, and says the government has no evidence that IS is recruiting among the Rohingya.

The Netherlands, together with other EU member states, calls for an independent and credible investigation into the 9 October attacks and the army's conduct, and for an adequate government response to the findings.

Nederland pleit met andere EU lidstaten voor een onafhankelijk en geloofwaardig onderzoek naar de aanvallen van 9 oktober en het optreden van het leger en een adequaat antwoord van de regering op de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een ter dood veroordeelde in Iran

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Belgian-based Iranian researcher Ahmadreza Djalali had been sentenced to death in Iran after an unfair trial and whether the government would press Iranian authorities. The minister answered that the trial had not yet taken place and no official charge was known, but that the Dutch ambassador, on behalf of the EU, urged a fair trial, medical care and abandonment of the death penalty.
As acting local EU chair, the Dutch ambassador in Tehran urged the Iranian judiciary's human rights council on behalf of the EU that Mr Jalali receive a fair trial.

Als waarnemend lokaal EU-voorzitter heeft de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Teheran er namens de EU bij de mensenrechtenraad van de Iraanse rechterlijke macht op aangedrongen dat de heer Jalali een eerlijk proces krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht dat ‘geheime’ wetten de EU nog minder democratisch maken

The MP Bisschop asks whether shortening EU legislation via skipping a second reading and trilogues reduces public information and democratic legitimacy, and what steps will be taken. Minister Koenders disputes that the trend shortens procedures or that the European Parliament debates less openly, says trilogues are needed for agreement, and points to Dutch efforts and earlier letters on improving transparency.
That does not detract from the fact that the Netherlands does see possibilities for improving the transparency surrounding trilogues.
Dat laat onverlet dat Nederland wel mogelijkheden ziet in de verbetering van de transparantie rondom trilogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de MH17

Dutch MPs Omtzigt asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Interior ministers about withheld MH17 documents (interview transcripts, the JIT agreement), the unfinished internal police evaluation, deleted emails under the Archiefwet, and Russian radar data. The minister refused disclosure of the interview records and JIT agreement on grounds of confidentiality and ongoing criminal investigation, and gave partial, procedural answers on the other points.
The JIT agreement is not suitable for disclosure because it records operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation.
De JIT-overeenkomst leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking omdat hierin operationele afspraken over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over honderdduizenden kinderen die vastzitten in Mosul, in Irak

Van Bommel (SP) asked the foreign minister about an estimated 350,000 children trapped in west Mosul under ISIS control, lacking aid, and about civilian protection and humanitarian access. The minister confirmed the estimate is plausible but unverifiable, said civilians face unavoidable risks that Iraqi forces and the coalition must minimise, and noted Dutch efforts on protection and aid while stating aid delivery to west Mosul is currently impossible.
The Netherlands remains in discussion with the UN, Red Cross and the Dutch Relief Alliance to see whether humanitarian aid can be delivered to people in west Mosul.
Nederland blijft met de VN, Rode Kruis en de Dutch Relief Alliance in gesprek om te kijken of humanitaire hulp geleverd kan worden aan de mensen in het westen van Mosul.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het ontnemen van staatsburgerschap en onteigening door de Turkse staat

The MP asks the Foreign Minister how Turkey's threat to revoke citizenship and expropriate firms squares with the European Convention on Nationality and the ECHR, and what support Turkish-Dutch citizens can get. The minister answers that the Convention on Nationality does not bind Turkey, that affected persons can go to the European Court of Human Rights, that no Turkish-Dutch cases are known, and that the government urges Turkey to respect the rule of law, without committing to a concrete new step.
The government therefore continues to urgently call on the Turkish authorities to respect the rule of law and apply proportionality.
Het kabinet blijft de Turkse autoriteiten dan ook met klem opgeroepen tot het respecteren van de rechtsstaat en het toepassen van proportionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het weren van maatschappelijke organisaties door de Indiase overheid

An MP asked the ministers whether India's freezing of funds and restrictions on NGOs such as Compassion and Navsarjan Trust, and its restrictive Foreign Contributions Regulation Act, were of concern and whether the Netherlands would press India to reverse them. The ministers said they share concern about the Act, have raised it bilaterally and multilaterally, will raise it at the March 2017 consultations and in the EU, and that embassy contact with Compassion is under way.
The Netherlands has made efforts at various levels, in bilateral contacts and multilaterally, to draw attention to this situation and will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft zich op verschillende niveaus in bilaterale contacten en in multilateraal verband ingespannen om aandacht te vragen voor deze situatie en zal dit onverminderd blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “het bericht “Kurdish-Turkish war will be triggered if Abdullah Öcalan is harmed”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report that a Kurdish-Turkish war would follow if Abdullah Öcalan were harmed, whether a KCK official claimed AKP and MHP plan to kill him, whether he could face the death penalty if reinstated, and what role he plays in Turkey-Kurdish talks. The minister said the claimed statement cannot be verified, no death penalty bill is before parliament, and Öcalan has no formal role in talks, as he serves a life sentence.
It is not a formal European Parliament event and no record of the conference is available, so it is not possible to verify the quoted statement.
Het betreft geen formeel evenement van het Europees parlement en er is geen verslaglegging van de conferentie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de opgepakte Syriëgangers in Turkije

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether returning jihadists should always be denied entry to the Netherlands, whether the government will explicitly refrain from requesting their extradition from Turkey, and the status of the nationality-revocation bill. The minister replied that the government does not adopt a blanket entry ban but assesses each returnee case by case with arrest, prosecution, multidisciplinary consultation and monitoring, declined to say whether extradition will be requested citing ongoing criminal investigations, and reported that the bill passed the Eerste Kamer plenary on 31 January 2017.
Regarding criminal investigations, the cabinet makes no statements about the instruments the Public Prosecution Service does or does not wish to deploy in that context.
Inzake strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doet het kabinet geen mededelingen over de instrumenten die het OM in het kader daarvan al dan niet wenst in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de bouw van nederzettingen in Oost-Jeruzalem na aantreden van Trump

MP Servaes (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli settlement construction in East Jerusalem after Trump's inauguration, including the 566 homes, the US embassy move, and possible EU measures such as suspending cooperation agreements. Minister Koenders condemned settlements as contrary to international law, said the government would keep pressing Israel and the EU, declined to pre-empt EU options, and said recognition of a Palestinian state would be used only at a strategic moment.
The government continues, both bilaterally and through the EU, an active policy to preserve and achieve the two-state solution.
Het kabinet blijft, zowel bilateraal als via de band van de EU, een actief beleid voeren ten behoeve van het behoud en de totstandkoming van de twee-statenoplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het uitblijven van luchtsteun in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether France, the UK and the US agreed in May 1995 to halt air strikes on Serbian targets without informing the Netherlands, and whether they had access to documents on this. The government answered that a NIOD exploration found no evidence of secret international decision-making, that it had asked allies for information but does not expect release soon, and that it will not renew the request.
The NIOD concludes in its report that the exploration found no evidence or indications of secret international political decision-making, unknown to the Netherlands, on providing such air support.

Het NIOD concludeert in zijn rapport dat de verkenning geen bewijzen of aanwijzingen heeft opgeleverd voor het bestaan van voor Nederland geheime internationale politieke besluitvorming over het verlenen van dergelijke luchtsteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over schoonmakers die werken bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken

MPs asked whether the government will act on cleaners at the Foreign Affairs ministry who may lose jobs after the move to Rijnstraat 8, including whether the government as client will protect their security, alternative work, and a permanent post at the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie. The minister says the contractor ISS has no legal obligation to take over staff, no specific employment requirements were set, a social plan with partial takeover (9 of 21) was contractually agreed, and the Social Affairs minister is examining priority placement in other government buildings.
I will have the implementation of this plan supervised.
Ik zal toezicht laten houden op de uitvoering van dit plan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake de situatie van de heer Van Laarhoven

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma ask the Foreign Minister to clarify director-level contacts with Thailand on the case of Mr Van Laarhoven, including the legal basis for transfer to the Netherlands and the reasons for his relocation within prison. The minister answers that two director-level contacts took place (by phone and in Seoul), that extradition requests are for the Public Prosecution Service and the Justice Minister rather than the Foreign Minister, and that the Thai authorities decided on the transfer despite a Dutch request to keep him in the reception unit.
Extradition requests are made by the Minister of Justice and Security, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service.
Uitleveringsverzoeken worden gedaan door de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het bericht dat de Griekse asielopvang verre van winterbestendig is

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked about reports that Greek asylum reception is not winter-proof, including Dutch support, conditions in Serbia, tents on Greek islands, relocation delays for unaccompanied minors and the Dutch relocation share. The State Secretary answered that Netherlands contributed funds via EU and bilateral channels, that Greece and Serbia are improving winter shelter, that relocation time limits apply, and that Dutch relocation share grows up to the Council maxima.
The cabinet considers it important that member states, like the Netherlands, respect this maximum period.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat lidstaten, net als Nederland, deze maximale termijn respecteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Midden-Oosten conferentie in Parijs

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Israel had lobbied the Netherlands to stay away from the Paris Middle East conference and whether the Netherlands would oppose anti-Israel UN steps. The minister confirmed Israel asked for ministerial non-attendance, said he attended to argue for the two-state solution, and rejected the premise that settlements are Israeli domestic policy.
Israel asked the Netherlands, in a conversation between the National Security Council and the Dutch ambassador in Tel Aviv, not to take part at ministerial level in the Paris conference.
Israël heeft Nederland in een gesprek tussen de National Security Council en de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tel Aviv verzocht niet op ministerieel niveau deel te nemen aan de conferentie in Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Taverne over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

MPs Ten Broeke and Taverne (VVD) asked about the European Court of Auditors report on EU assistance to Ukraine, including reporting on indicators, repayment options, and measures to strengthen control over EU aid to Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. The minister welcomed the Court's recommendations, explained the aid framework, conditionality and transparency, and said the EU Association Agreement does not affect member states' decisions on financial aid to Ukraine.
The Netherlands will use the Council discussion of the report to invite the Commission to place greater emphasis on conditionality in programming.
Nederland zal de bespreking in Raadsverband van het rapport aangrijpen om de Commissie uit te nodigen nog meer nadruk te leggen op conditionaliteit in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over EU-bijstand aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a European Court of Auditors report on EU aid to Ukraine, covering anti-corruption results, the absence of a pre-set strategy for the 2014 aid package, Ukrainian civil society, and the trade agreement's effect on Dutch trade. The minister acknowledged corruption concerns, cited reform progress and EU procedures, and said trade rose 7.5% though causal attribution is uncertain.
The cabinet is convinced that anti-corruption efforts in Ukraine benefit from the entry into force of this association agreement.
Het kabinet is er van overtuigd dat de corruptiebestrijding in Oekraïne gebaat is bij inwerkingtreding van dit associatieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het mogelijk bestaan van een Nederlandse nepambassade in Ghana

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch fake embassy operated in Ghana alongside a US one, and what the government knew of its activities, the response from Ghanaian authorities, and the risks to Dutch visas and security. The minister replied that Ghanaian authorities found no evidence of a Dutch or US fake embassy, that contacts with the US are ongoing and the investigation continues, and that found Schengen visas, including five long-expired Dutch visas, pose no recent security risk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over de blokkade van NOS in Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the blocking of NOS's website and app in Turkey, why it occurred, whether he had protested, and whether he would act and raise it in the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands objected and requested clarification, and noted that press and internet freedom are EU values raised regularly with Turkey, without announcing a specific new step.
In response to the blocking, the Netherlands lodged an objection with the Turkish authorities and requested clarification.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de blokkade bezwaar aangetekend bij de Turkse autoriteiten en om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Ünver over de blokkade van de website en app van de NOS in Turkije

MPs Maij and Ünver asked the Foreign Minister about the Turkish blocking of NOS website and app, its cause, the government's response, and whether Turkey's press freedom is being restricted. The minister replied that the Netherlands objected to Turkish authorities and requested clarification, that the block followed NOS publishing footage of the Russian ambassador's murder and was upheld by a court, and that press freedom is raised regularly in bilateral and EU contexts.
The Netherlands has, following the blocking, objected to the Turkish authorities and requested clarification.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de blokkade bezwaar aangetekend bij de Turkse autoriteiten en om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Verhoeven over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Verhoeven asked the ministers about the documentary 'Grenzeloos misbruikt' on online child sexual abuse, covering police undercover and honeypot powers, use of decoy personas, Philippine cooperation, detection technology like PhotoDNA, and education. The government answered that current law limits deanonymising darknet users, that pending bill Computercriminaliteit III would add powers, that decoy personas are permitted under the Tallon criterion, and described ongoing cooperation and education efforts.
Current legislation offers little to no possibility to de-anonymise users in the relevant environments on the TOR network.
De huidige wetgeving biedt weinig tot geen mogelijkheden om de gebruikers op de bedoelde omgevingen op het TOR-netwerk te de-anonimiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het stopzetten van internationaal draagmoederschap

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the government about reports that countries such as Cambodia are halting international surrogacy, the number of Dutch citizens affected, the legal position of intended parents and children, and whether a transitional arrangement is needed. The minister answered that no overview or data exists, that legal parentage is assessed case by case under Dutch law, and that a surrogacy regime is being considered in response to the Staatscommissie report, without committing to a transitional arrangement.
I do not have an overview of countries where international surrogacy exists, is threatened to be halted, or has been halted.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van landen waar internationaal draagmoederschap bestaat, dreigt te worden stopgezet of is stopgezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de eindejaarswensen van de Nederlandse ambassade in Berlijn

MPs Knops, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch embassy in Berlin sent only New Year wishes and no Christmas wishes, and whether other Dutch embassies do the same. The minister replied that embassies are not obliged to send season's greetings, that the choice is left to each post, and that the Berlin embassy did send a digital card wishing a merry Christmas and a happy 2017, so no reference was avoided.
So there is no question of messages being avoided.
Er is dus geen sprake van dat boodschappen worden gemeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse ambassades in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the use of Dutch embassy buildings abroad after reports that a minister's engagement party was held at the Paris residence. The minister denied a private party took place, said the event was a fundraising activity for the National Musical Instrument Fund, and stated that anyone within the stated framework could have used the residence.
There was no question of an engagement party in a government building.
Er was geen sprake van een verlovingsfeest in een rijksgebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Servaes over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse journalist in Panama

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Panama of Dutch journalist Okke Ornstein, whom they linked to exposing corruption, and what the ministry was doing about it. The minister answered that Ornstein faced criminal defamation charges, that the Dutch embassy and minister pressed Panama for press freedom and visits, and that a presidential pardon was expected so he would be released soon.
At my request, the Dutch ambassador spoke with several ministers of the Panamanian government and with President Varela.
Op mijn verzoek sprak de Nederlandse ambassadeur met verschillende ministers van de Panamese regering en met president Varela.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over geweld tegen activisten in Colombia

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported spike in lethal violence against activists in Colombia, including members of Marcha Patriótica, and whether the government would raise this with Colombian counterparts. The minister confirmed the rise, attributed it to shifting power in rural areas after the FARC withdrew, called the 123 killings a realistic estimate, and said the Netherlands and EU have raised concerns and pressed authorities to protect activists and prosecute perpetrators.

On 22 November, the Netherlands together with the EU, EU member states, Switzerland and Norway issued a statement expressing concern about the recent killings of community leaders and human rights defenders.

Nederland heeft op 22 november jl. samen met de EU, de EU-lidstaten, Zwitserland en Noorwegen een verklaring uitgegeven waarin de zorg wordt uitgesproken over de recente moorden op gemeenschapsleiders en mensenrechtenverdedigers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse staat New York Nederlandse bedrijven op een zwarte lijst heeft gezet omdat zij Israël zouden boycotten en het bericht over

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would act after New York State blacklisted four Dutch firms for allegedly boycotting Israel, and what it thought of a German CDU position calling the BDS campaign antisemitic. The minister said the ambassador raised due-process concerns with New York, the firms denied any boycott, the government opposes boycotts of Israel, and it rejected the view that BDS is antisemitic.
The cabinet considers that before publishing such a list, careful hearing and rebuttal should take place.
Het kabinet vindt dat voor publicatie van een dergelijke lijst zorgvuldige hoor en wederhoor zou moeten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Nederlandse bedrijven die door de staat New York op een zwarte lijst zijn geplaatst

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether four Dutch companies were placed on New York State's blacklist for boycotting Israel and whether other US states maintain similar lists. The government confirmed the listing, said the companies deny any boycott, and reports that its ambassador raised the matter with New York, which agreed to an early review of the listings.
The Dutch Ambassador to the United States raised the issue with the authorities of the State of New York.
De Nederlandse Ambassadeur in de Verenigde Staten heeft de kwestie aan de orde gesteld bij de autoriteiten van de staat New York.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een politie-inval in het hoofdkwartier van de Ahmadiyya Moslim Gemeenschap in Rabwah, Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a police raid on the Ahmadiyya headquarters in Rabwah, Pakistan, the arrests of Ahmadis under blasphemy provisions, and the deteriorating position of Ahmadis. The minister described the raid and arrests, confirmed the 2014 Punjab ban on Ahmadi literature, and said the Netherlands raises religious minorities' position bilaterally and multilaterally, including at the Mensenrechtenambassadeur's planned visit.
The Netherlands regularly raises the position of religious minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contexts and will continue to do so.
Nederland stelt de positie van religieuze minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilateraal en multilateraal verband aan de orde en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en De Roon over het artikel "Qatar financiert omstreden Deense moskee via Den Haag"

PVV MPs De Graaf and De Roon asked whether the government knows of an NRC report that Qatar channels funding for a controversial Danish mosque via its Hague embassy, whether embassies should finance Islamic infrastructure, and whether other cases exist and the Qatari ambassador should be expelled. The minister answered that transparency rules on foreign religious funding are being drafted, that the embassy is also accredited to Denmark so the matter is bilateral, and referred to a separate letter.
The cabinet is therefore drawing up further rules on the transparency of financing flows.
Het kabinet stelt daarom nadere regels op over de transparantie van financieringsstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “EU betaalt nog steeds salaris aan 16 ex-eurocommissarissen”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the EU still pays about 99,996 euros a year to 16 former Commissioners, some of whom have new paid jobs, and whether this undermines transparency and conflict-of-interest safeguards. The minister said the Commission's disclosure process is unknown to the cabinet, described the new 2016 regulation shortening and reducing the transitional allowance, declined to name individuals or amounts paid, and said Commission rules on post-office conduct are being reviewed with Parliament.
The cabinet does not know the precise sequence of events leading to the Commission releasing the information Die Zeit requested and therefore cannot assess it.
De precieze gang van zaken in aanloop naar het vrijgeven van de door Die Zeit gevraagde informatie door de Commissie is het kabinet niet bekend en kan het kabinet derhalve niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne en de agenda van de Europese Top

MP Omtzigt asked the government why the agenda for the December 2016 European Council was late, whether a European Council conclusion is legally binding, what plan B exists if the EU-Ukraine association agreement fails, and how the government acted on a motion about EU funds and torture. The answer refers the MP to letters on the European Council and the General Affairs Council, which were sent separately.
have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to requests for additional information regarding the European Council of 15 December 2016'
zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op verzoeken om aanvullende informatie aangaande de Europese Raad van 15 december 2016»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de geheime moskeelijst van het kabinet

Two MPs asked whether a list of mosques and Islamic organisations receiving Saudi funding exists, why parliament was allegedly misinformed, and whether anything is being withheld. The government refers to earlier answers on the matter, says there is nothing further it is withholding, and states that the overview was shared confidentially with parliament.
The cabinet has shared the relevant overview with your House on a confidential basis.
Het kabinet heeft het betreffende overzicht vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

MP Taverne asked the ministers whether their earlier answer on the EU Electoral Act negotiations meant the government would accept the proposal in the Council even if Parliament rejected it, and asked them to confirm they would implement the Taverne motion requiring prior Parliament approval before a Council vote. The minister confirmed the motion is being implemented, noting it is not a formal parliamentary reservation under the Lisbon treaty approval law but will have that effect in substance.
In substance, however, it will have this effect. The motion is therefore being implemented.
Materieel zal het echter wel deze werking hebben. De motie wordt derhalve uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een in Rusland veroordeelde activist

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of activist Ildar Dadin in Russia, Amnesty's view that he is a prisoner of conscience, and torture allegations. The minister acknowledged the shrinking space for opposition and shared concerns about due process, but rejected the claim that torture is used systematically, and said the Netherlands would not take additional action for now given Russian investigations and EU coordination.
In view of these developments, the Netherlands, in consultation with EU partners, will for the time being not take additional action towards the Russian authorities.
Gelet op deze ontwikkelingen zal Nederland, mede in overleg met EU-partners, voorlopig geen aanvullende actie richting de Russische autoriteiten ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de bosbranden in Israël

The MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the wildfires in Israel and whether the Netherlands would offer firefighting help as other European countries had. The minister confirmed awareness, said talks with Israeli authorities about help took place but the Netherlands lacked the requested firefighting aircraft, and expressed sympathy.
However, the specific Israeli need could not be met, because the Netherlands does not have the requested firefighting aircraft.
Er kon echter niet in de specifieke Israëlische behoefte worden voorzien, omdat Nederland niet over de gevraagde blusvliegtuigen beschikt.

Vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religie

Four MPs (Sjoerdsma, Azmani, Knops, Karabulut) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states inform the Netherlands about funding of religious institutions, including why a list of mosques funded from Saudi Arabia was not published, when agreements on sharing information were made, and whether municipalities hold talks on foreign funding. The minister (Foreign Affairs) answered that Saudi Arabia and Kuwait share such information ad hoc and confidentially through diplomatic channels, that a 2010–2013 list exists but was never meant as a complete overview and is kept confidential to protect voluntary sharing, and that municipalities hold critical talks under the existing three-track approach.
Publication of this information endangers the voluntary sharing of it by the countries involved.
Openbaarmaking van deze informatie brengt de vrijwillige deling hiervan door betrokken landen in gevaar.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid van Bommel over de arrestatie van Koerdische politici in het zuidoosten van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Kurdish mayors and pro-Kurdish politicians in southeastern Turkey, including how many have been detained or dismissed since July 2015 and whether the government views the repression as undermining the rule of law. The minister confirmed the arrests and charges, gave detailed figures, stated serious concern, said the Netherlands pushed for an EU statement and backed Council of Europe involvement, but made no commitment to raise the issue bilaterally beyond the EU channel.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about these developments.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstig zorgen over deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de arrestatie van twee democratisch gekozen co-burgemeesters van oppositiepartij HDP in Diyarbakir (Turkije)

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two elected HDP co-mayors of Diyarbakir, whether it was linked to the post-coup purge, how many people had been detained, and the humanitarian situation in the southeast. The minister confirmed the arrests on terrorism-related charges, said the government is seriously concerned, pushed for an EU statement and Council of Europe involvement, but gave no link-free assessment of the purge and no firm commitment beyond diplomatic pressure.
The Netherlands therefore pressed for a joint EU member state response, which was issued as a statement on 8 November.
Nederland heeft dan ook aangedrongen op een gezamenlijke reactie van de EU lidstaten, zoals is uitgegaan per verklaring van 8 november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het dispuut rondom Oyster Pond

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether French authorities inspected a construction site on the Dutch side of Oyster Pond, whether the border there is settled, and whether this is a territorial dispute and what its consequences are. The minister confirms a disagreement over the land border, says the status quo agreed in 2014 was breached by the French inspection, notes that border negotiations will start soon, and says relations with France are not affected.
The land border negotiations will be started as soon as possible.
De landgrensonderhandelingen zullen zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het mandaat van de VN-missie dubbelzinnig is

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the UN MINUSMA mandate in Mali is ambiguous, since troops must be impartial while supporting state-building, and whether impartiality problems explain attacks on peacekeepers. The minister replied that the mandate is clear, centred on supporting the peace agreement, that the attacks are terrorist acts by non-signatory groups, and that the Rules of Engagement are clear, so no changes were planned.
The cabinet is of the view that the mandate of MINUSMA is clear.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het mandaat van MINUSMA duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland een Nederlandse onderzeeër op de Middellandse Zee verjaagt

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Russia drove a Dutch submarine out of the Mediterranean, whether it was in international waters, what Russia's legal basis was, whether there was diplomatic contact, and what the submarine was doing there. The ministers only acknowledged the Russian statements, declined to comment on submarine movements, and said there had been no contact with Russia.
No statements are made about the movements of Dutch submarines.
Over de bewegingen van Nederlandse onderzeeboten worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie op de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged extrajudicial killings of suspected drug users and dealers in the Philippines under President Duterte, and whether the Netherlands would support UN and EU calls for due process and an independent UN investigation. The minister replied that the government is seriously concerned, has raised these concerns bilaterally, in EU and UN channels, and supports rule-of-law programmes, but that other bodies have their own mandates and the government's answers on further steps were largely general.
The Netherlands is concerned about the Philippine approach to drug crime and the rising number of victims linked to it.
Nederland is bezorgd over de Filipijnse aanpak van drugscriminaliteit en het stijgend aantal slachtoffers dat daarmee in verband wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid ten Broeke over het besluit van de Britse regering om gelden ten behoeve van de Palestijnse Autoriteit te bevriezen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UK froze aid to the Palestinian Authority over payments to terrorists' salaries, and whether the Netherlands would press the EU to act and use aid as leverage. The government denied a freeze, said the Netherlands is pushing to change the prisoner-payment system, and stated that Dutch and EU funds cannot be used for payments to the PLO or prisoners.
The cabinet will continue along the chosen path of gaining support within the EU to convince the Palestinian Authority that the system must be changed.
Het kabinet zal doorgaan op de ingeslagen weg om binnen de EU steun te vergaren om de Palestijnse Autoriteit te overtuigen dat het systeem veranderd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat Wit-Rusland weer begonnen is met het uitspreken en uitvoeren van de doodstraf

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Belarus has resumed death sentences and executions after EU sanctions were lifted, and about the OSCE critique of the 2016 parliamentary elections. The minister expresses concern, says Belarus keeps execution figures secret, defends critical engagement over reinstated sanctions, and reports dialogue on a moratorium through UN bodies.
The cabinet is of the view that critical engagement can ultimately achieve more than new sanctions measures.
Het kabinet is van mening dat met kritisch engagement uiteindelijk meer kan worden bereikt dan met nieuwe sanctiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Verenigde Naties verzaken om de Rohingya in Myanmar te beschermen

An MP asks the Dutch government about leaked UN documents and a documentary suggesting the UN failed to protect the Rohingya in Myanmar, and about reports of intimidation and restricted aid access. The minister answers that the government is concerned, supports UN and NGO work in Rakhine, raised the issues during a visit, and rejects the claim of institutional complicity, while declining to share an internal UN report.
The Netherlands does not have the report. It is an internal report commissioned by the UN.
Nederland beschikt niet over het rapport. Het betreft hier een intern rapport dat in opdracht van de VN is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de terugtrekking van Afrikaanse landen uit het Internationaal Strafhof

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the announced withdrawal of Burundi, Gambia and South Africa from the International Criminal Court, and what the government was doing to implement the Servaes/Sjoerdsma motion on support for the ICC. The minister replied with a detailed account of diplomatic efforts, EU and UN action, planned ministerial meetings at the Assembly of States Parties, and Security Council coordination with Italy, while not committing to a specific new formal step beyond those efforts.
The cabinet fully implements the Servaes/Sjoerdsma motion.
Het kabinet voert de motie Servaes/Sjoerdsma onverkort uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Exodus dreigt bij Internationaal Strafhof'

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that several African states, including Burundi, South Africa and Gambia, plan to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the government regrets the withdrawals, has lobbied the EU, the ICC Assembly president and African states, and will keep engaging at the Assembly of States Parties, while rejecting concessions that would compromise the ICC.

The cabinet has no indications that developments toward extending the ICC's jurisdiction over the crime of aggression played a role in the decision of Burundi, South Africa and Gambia to withdraw from the Rome Statute.

Het kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat ontwikkelingen richting uitbreiding van de rechtsmacht van het Strafhof met het misdrijf agressie een rol heeft gespeeld bij de beslissing van Burundi, Zuid-Afrika en Gambia terug te treden uit het Statuut van Rome.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over het bericht over de situatie van Johan van Laarhoven en zijn vrouw Tukta

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why he judged it not in the interest of Johan van Laarhoven to raise his detention in Thailand now, and what contact and advice the embassy provided. The minister replied that he is well informed, that the embassy visits and raises his detention and health with Thai authorities, that consular help to his Thai-national wife is not possible, and that transfer to the Netherlands cannot occur until the Thai appeal is concluded.
The Dutch embassy in Thailand proactively maintains contact with the penal institution where Mr Van Laarhoven is held.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Thailand onderhoudt proactief contact met de penitentiaire inrichting waar de heer Van Laarhoven verblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

An MP asked the ministers about progress on the EU Electoral Act revision for European Parliament elections, including which proposals were gaining Council support and whether the government would inform parliament before Council votes. The government replied that member states are sorting provisions into acceptable, unacceptable and undecided groups, that Dutch positions stay anchored in its 2015 standpoint, and that it will inform parliament of emerging majorities and not agree to a Council position parliament rejects.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes  en Kerstens over Uitbuiting van personeel bij de Qatarese ambassade

MPs Servaes and Kerstens asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about reported labour exploitation of staff at the Qatari embassy and how the government supervises working conditions at embassies. The minister said privacy prevents discussing individual cases, described a monitoring system for domestic staff and a mediation practice for local staff, noted that embassies cannot be forced to comply with court rulings, and said staff can access legal aid.
Due to privacy considerations, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot address individual cases.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen kan het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de subsidie ten behoeve van het tijdschrift OneWorld

An MP asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the government subsidy to the online magazine OneWorld via the NCDO, its aims, how its effects were measured, and whether a competing trade journal was treated unfairly. The minister answered that the subsidy is being phased out through 2017 under an agreed transition, that the aims focus on core functions, and that the government has no further agreements beyond the current arrangement.
Er is geen nieuwe evaluatie voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de tientallen miljoenen die Assad krijgt van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asks why the UN pays tens of millions of dollars in contracts to Assad-regime-linked entities, including a Damascus hotel partly owned by a sanctioned ministry, and whether this undermines UN independence. The ministers answer that cooperation with the regime is a practical necessity for reaching millions in need, that private contracts are separate from aid, that the EU and US sanctions do not cover UN transactions, and that they raise the matter in the ISSG and with the UN.
In the discussion, the Netherlands emphasises the importance of dialogue between humanitarian organisations working in Syria and argues for preserving room to voice criticism.
Nederland benadrukt in de discussie het belang van dialoog tussen humanitaire organisaties werkzaam in Syrië, en pleit voor behoud van ruimte om kritiek te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Hongaarse regering vluchtelingen mishandelt en hen maandenlang zonder redenen opsluit

MPs Maij and Kuiken asked the government about reports that Hungary abuses and arbitrarily detains refugees, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government called the reports worrying, said Hungary must respect European and international obligations, noted that the Commission has opened an infringement procedure whose outcome is expected in September 2017, and referred to its earlier assessment instead of a separate one.

The cabinet's position that the treatment of refugees must be in line with European treaties and agreements, including the European Convention on Human Rights, the European acquis and international refugee law, remains unchanged.

Het kabinetsstandpunt dat de behandeling van vluchtelingen in lijn moet zijn met Europese verdragen en afspraken, waaronder het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en het Europese acquis, evenals internationaal vluchtelingenrecht, blijft onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de Nederlandse positie inzake een AVVN-resolutie over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

An MP asked how a UN General Assembly resolution launching negotiations on a treaty banning nuclear weapons fits with NATO nuclear commitments, the NPT, and Russian nuclear posturing. The minister answered by referring the MP to a separate letter to parliament on the negotiations, without answering the questions on substance here.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Negotiations on an international ban on nuclear weapons' (Parliamentary paper 33 783, no. 23)
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens» (Kamerstuk 33 783, nr. 23 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Grashoff, Thieme en Öztürk over deelname aan onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands opposed paragraph 67 of the OEWG report recommending negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, whether it would support the UNGA resolution to negotiate such a ban in 2017, and whether it would take part in the conference. The answer refers to a separate letter ('Onderhandelingen over een internationaal verbod op kernwapens') rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het landarrest van een Nederlander in India

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch citizen under house arrest in India since 2014, alleged blackmail by police, delays in his trial, and whether the ambassador was ignored. The minister answered that consular aid is provided, delays are not exceptional in India, an independent local lawyer is investigating the proceedings, and political intervention would breach judicial independence, while passport return is not possible during the trial.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Sjoerdsma, Gesthuizen en Voortman over de uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

Five MPs asked whether the Netherlands is extraditing two genocide suspects to Rwanda despite expert doubts about fair trials there, and whether this should be suspended pending independent review. The minister confirmed the extradition proceeds after appeal courts found no real risk of an unfair trial, argued trial in the country of the crime is preferred, and refused to suspend extradition or commission new independent research.
I am therefore not willing to suspend the extradition.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid de uitlevering op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Beertema over het bericht dat Brussel haast heeft om visumvrij reizen voor Turken mogelijk te maken

PVV MPs asked why the EU is rushing visa-free travel for Turks despite unmet conditions, whether the government will oppose the Turkey deal, and whether it supports leaving the EU. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is conditional on all benchmarks being met, that the deal reduced irregular inflows, and that the government does not favour leaving the EU.
Only when it is established that all criteria have been met will there be full visa exemption, as repeatedly stated.
Pas wanneer geconstateerd wordt dat is voldaan aan alle criteria zal sprake zijn van volledige visumvrijstelling, zoals bij herhaling aangegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat Nederland in EU verband heeft gelobbyd om als unie een afzwakking van een absoluut verbod op de opsluiting van minderjarigen voor te stellen op de Algemene Ver

An MP asked whether the Netherlands lobbied within the EU to soften a ban on detaining minors at the UN General Assembly, and about child immigration detention generally. The minister denied aiming to weaken the text, said child detention is a last resort limited to two weeks in the Zeist family facility, and reported roughly 130 children detained in 2015 and 80 in 2016.

The Netherlands consistently argued during the negotiations that immigration detention of children should only be used as a last resort and that the best interests of the child should always be weighed.

Nederland heeft zich er tijdens de onderhandelingen steeds voor ingezet dat vreemdelingenbewaring van kinderen alleen in het uiterste geval wordt ingezet en het belang van het kind daarbij steeds wordt meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radardata m.b.t. MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia holds raw primary radar data from the MH17 area, why it was not shared for over two years, and how the Dutch government assesses cooperation and prosecution strategy. The minister answered that Russia has promised to share the data with the JIT but has not yet handed it over, that the government has repeatedly urged full cooperation, and that prosecution options (an ad hoc tribunal or national prosecution) remain open.
For that reason we cannot inform your House in detail which information was requested or received from which party.
Om die reden kunnen wij uw Kamer niet in detail melden welke informatie van welke partij is gevraagd of gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de relatie tussen Taiwan en luchtvaartorganisatie ICAO

Two PVV MPs asked the government why Taiwan is excluded from ICAO while North Korea is a member, and whether the Netherlands will support Taiwan's permanent presence at ICAO meetings. The minister answered that only states can be members, that Taiwan gets ICAO information through indirect channels, and that the Netherlands will weigh participation case by case under the one-China policy without committing to permanent presence.
For future ICAO meetings, a case-by-case assessment will be made to determine whether some form of pragmatic cooperation with Taiwan is possible.
Voor toekomstige vergaderingen van de ICAO wordt per geval een afweging gemaakt om te bezien of enigerlei vorm van pragmatische samenwerking met Taiwan mogelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het omstreden referendum dat onrust stookt in Servisch Bosnië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the referendum in Republika Srpska held despite a Constitutional Court suspension, its risk of unrest, and whether the Dayton Agreement and EU stance are at stake. The minister called the holding of the referendum regrettable, said Dayton is not likely under pressure, backed de-escalation calls, and noted EU and Dutch efforts in Bosnia.
It is regrettable that the referendum was nevertheless held despite this ruling.
Het is spijtig dat het referendum in weerwil van deze uitspraak toch is gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over geheime beïnvloedingsoperaties door Rusland

An MP asked the ministers whether the government knows of covert Russian influence operations, including alleged efforts to influence the US election and Dutch politics, and whether it will investigate or inform parliament. The government replied it has no concrete knowledge of Russian funding or influence of Dutch parties, cannot make public statements on ongoing intelligence activities, and so cannot share details.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about alleged Russian activities aimed at influencing the US presidential elections.
Het kabinet kan geen publieke uitspraken doen over (vermeende) activiteiten van Rusland teneinde de presidentsverkiezingen in de VS te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Wolbert over het bericht dat de Poolse regering abortus wettelijk wil verbieden en strafbaar stellen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Poland would criminalise abortion, including for women and doctors, and about risks to women's health and rights under European law. The minister said the concerning bill, a citizens' initiative, was rejected by the Polish lower house, that Dutch policy promotes access to safe abortion as part of sexual and reproductive rights, and that it will keep raising these issues in the EU.
The cabinet finds this report worrying.
Het kabinet vindt dit bericht zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de door Turkije verspreide lijst van zogenaamde Gülenorganisaties in Nederland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the government about a list of Dutch organisations labelled as Gülen-linked that Turkey's state news agency circulated, and whether the government would act against Turkish interference and protect those named. The Minister of Foreign Affairs condemned such lists, said he had conveyed to Turkish officials that direct interference in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to letters and the government's existing protection arrangements for those under threat.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating in any form, regardless of who is on them.
Het kabinet keurt ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm dan ook en ongeacht wie daarop staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse staatsmedia een lijst met Gülen-organisaties in Nederland heeft gepubliceerd

Two SP MPs asked the government about a Turkish state media list of Gülen-linked organisations in the Netherlands, including whether agreements were made with Turkey to stop intimidation and political export, whether Zaman Nederland and HOGIAF are labelled terrorist, whether extradition or prosecution requests exist, and whether Dutch research was shared with Turkey. The minister replied that the government firmly rejects such lists, has conveyed that Turkish tensions must not be exported, has received no evidence of direct involvement of the named organisations, has received one extradition request under review, and has not directly shared the Dutch research with Turkish authorities.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating, in whatever form and composition, and by whomever.
Het kabinet keurt het ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm en samenstelling dan ook, en door wie dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Jemen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about Yemen's political situation, the Hadi government's control and legitimacy, and the international approach to the conflict. The minister answered that government control is patchy, that Hadi's mandate was extended pending elections, that Resolution 2216 remains the basis, and that a VN-led inclusive settlement is being pursued.
The cabinet has not expressed support for the intervention by the Saudi Arabia-led coalition in Yemen.
Het kabinet heeft geen steun uitgesproken voor de interventie van de door Saoedi-Arabië geleide coalitie in Jemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de erkenning van de genocide, die op dit moment door ISIS gepleegd wordt

An MP asked the government whether it recognises ISIS as committing genocide against minorities and what obligations follow under the 1948 Genocide Convention, citing European Parliament, Council of Europe and US positions. The minister answered that the government does not formally determine genocide absent a court ruling, outlined existing counter-ISIS and foreign-fighter measures, and declined to publish internal legal advice.

The Cabinet has been advised internally several times under international law on this issue. The Cabinet attaches importance to civil servants being able to advise their ministers freely and to present all views, and publishing that advice afterwards would undermine this.

Het Kabinet is intern meermalen volkenrechtelijk geadviseerd over deze kwestie. Het Kabinet hecht eraan dat ambtenaren hun ministers vrijelijk kunnen adviseren en daarin alle standpunten kunnen weergeven. Het achteraf openbaar maken van die adviezen staat daaraan in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Rekenkamer EU was in 2007 tegen toetreding Bulgarije, Roemenië”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report that the European Court of Auditors opposed Bulgaria's and Romania's 2007 accession, and about Olli Rehn's remark that the decision was already taken, plus questions on Western Balkan candidates and publication of country reports. The minister replied that the audit report assessed Phare projects rather than accession readiness, that the government upholds a strict, conditionality-based enlargement process, and that accession depends on progress against criteria with parliamentary ratification required.
Ratification of an accession treaty requires parliamentary approval in all EU member states.
Voor ratificatie van een toetredingsverdrag is parlementaire goedkeuring in alle EU-lidstaten vereist.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Knops en Rog over de uitlatingen van de Turkse consul-generaal te Rotterdam over de Hizmet/Gülen-beweging en de invloed die Turkije uitoefent op burgers in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Knops and Rog asked the ministers about the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam's remarks on the Gülen movement, pressure on Turkish-Dutch citizens, threats and the effects of the post-coup crackdown in the Netherlands. The government condemned intimidation, said Turkish authorities must not interfere with Dutch citizens' choices, noted about 175 reports and ongoing investigations, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy and citing ongoing proceedings.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Vuijk en Bosman over het bericht “Venezuela beschuldigt Nederland en VS opnieuw van agressie”

MPs Ten Broeke, Vuijk and Bosman asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Venezuela's accusations against the Netherlands and the US of airspace violation and aggression, and whether the government would respond. The minister answered that Venezuela did not accuse the Netherlands of airspace violation, that the government has no information on any airspace breach, and that he voiced concern to the Venezuelan foreign minister and urged that such statements be avoided.
In a conversation with the Venezuelan Minister of Foreign Affairs, I expressed my surprise and concern about these unjustified and public accusations directed at Venezuela.
In een gesprek met de Venezolaanse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik mijn verbazing en zorg over deze onterechte en publieke beschuldigingen uitgesproken richting Venezuela.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Extra veel Belgische Nederlanders bij buitenlandloket’

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why the Brussels embassy and Antwerp consulate-general stopped issuing passports and ID cards from November 2015, how many applications and waiting times were involved, and how backlogs would be cleared. The minister answered that the change is part of a modernisation of consular services, that alternatives exist, that waiting times at some Dutch municipalities are comparable, and that capacity is being expanded and an external-provider pilot started.
It is not possible to retrieve figures from the systems on the time between application and actual issue of a travel document.
Het is niet mogelijk om cijfers uit de systemen op te vragen met betrekking tot de tijdsduur tussen de aanvraag en de daadwerkelijke uitreiking van een reisdocument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de politie in Istanbul leden van de Gay Pride-organisatie heeft gearresteerd

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knew the official reason for Istanbul police arresting Gay Pride organisers, and how it would respond to Turkey's treatment of LGBTI rights. The ministers answered that Turkish authorities gave no official reason, that the government regrets the cancelled Pride but accepts possible security motives, and that it funds LGBTI projects in Turkey and raises the issue in EU accession talks.
The Turkish authorities have not given an official explanation for why these people were briefly detained.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben geen officiële verklaring gegeven waarom deze mensen korte tijd zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over een brief van de Turkse consul-generaal

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from the Turkish consul-general in Rotterdam to mayors on handling demonstrations by opponents of the Turkish government, and whether this amounts to political interference. The minister says the letter does not request a ban on demonstrations, that interference in Dutch citizens' choices is unacceptable, and that Turkish tensions should not be exported to the Netherlands, which was raised during his visit to Turkey.
It is unacceptable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence those choices.
Het is onacceptabel dat buitenlandse overheden die keuzes openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Gesthuizen over bancaire dienstverlening aan activiteiten van humanitaire organisaties in sanctielanden als Syrië en Rusland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch banks are wrongly over-applying sanctions regimes and blocking banking services to humanitarian organisations in Syria and Russia, and whether the government will act. The government replied that banks make their own risk assessments within EU sanctions rules, that humanitarian exemptions can be requested from the Ministry of Finance, that it is in dialogue with banks and will encourage them to facilitate humanitarian organisations, and that a 'white list' idea merits further EU discussion.
The cabinet is in dialogue with the banks on sanctions policy.
Het kabinet is over het sanctiebeleid in dialoog met de banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over vernielingen van de Nederlandse onderneming Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopië

An MP asked whether arson destroyed Esmeralda Farms in Ethiopia, whether other Dutch firms were affected, what drives the unrest and what Ethiopia is doing to protect foreign investors, and whether Dutch firms have a legal basis for compensation. The ministers confirmed major damage, explained the regional grievances and urged reform, said the Ethiopian authorities and investment commission will assess damage and that compensation is primarily a matter for Ethiopian courts or investment insurance, with no basis under the bilateral investment treaty.
The Dutch embassy in Addis Ababa is in close contact with the affected Dutch companies and Ethiopian authorities.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Addis Abeba staat in nauw contact met de Nederlandse getroffen bedrijven en Ethiopische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over financiering van de referendum campagne in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked the government about foreign and undisclosed funding of the 2016 Dutch referendum campaign, including donor disclosure rules, GRECO recommendations on foreign donations, and contacts with George Soros's organisations.
