Minister Plasterk answered that party donations above EUR 4,500 are disclosed, no rules exist on foreign donations or referendum-period disclosure, the government had no direct contact with Soros, and the referendum subsidy audit is still ongoing.
I do not have overviews of organisations or persons who spent more than EUR 4,500 on campaign activities for the referendum of 6 April.
Ik beschik niet over overzichten van instanties of personen die meer dan € 4.500 hebben uitgegeven aan campagneactiviteiten voor het referendum van 6 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over een bezoek van een Turkse minister aan Nederland

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked whether a visiting Turkish minister made inflammatory remarks about Gülen supporters and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that the statements were the Turkish minister's responsibility, that the government had raised concerns with Turkish authorities and that it does not consider entry bans appropriate.
The cabinet does not share that view. We must remain in dialogue with the Turkish authorities.
Het kabinet deelt die opvatting niet. We moeten in gesprek blijven met de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked ministers to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on unintended loss of Dutch nationality, including whether government informed citizens adequately and whether nationality law should change. The government largely rejects the claim of inadequate information, pointing to past campaigns and its website, promises to examine how outreach can be more active, and says it cannot yet judge the report's findings on nationality law.
On the basis of the recommendations in this report, I will examine whether that information can be made even more active and targeted.
Aan de hand van de aanbevelingen van dit rapport zal ik onderzoeken of die voorlichting nog actiever en gerichter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Het gebruik van in Nederland geregistreerde postbusfirma’s voor de ontwijking van internationale sancties door het Assad-regime

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch companies supplied oil to the Assad regime via Panama-registered shell companies, and what action was taken against them and against Staroil B.V. The government answered that a Customs investigation found no breach of the sanctions rules applicable at the time, so no enforcement or prosecution followed, and that it would keep pressing international partners and informing firms about sanctions.
Based on the outcome of the Customs investigation, the Public Prosecution Service decided not to take any further steps regarding enforcement or prosecution.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de Douane heeft het Openbaar Ministerie besloten om verder geen stappen te nemen met betrekking tot handhaving of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes en Jasper van Dijk over een uitnodiging aan Saoedi-Arabië voor een Nederlandse wapenbeurs

MPs asked whether the Royal Netherlands Navy invited a Saudi delegation to the MAST 2016 defence fair, why the first question was not fully answered, and how an invitation squares with a strict arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia given the situation in Yemen and human rights. The government confirmed invitations went to 23 countries including Saudi Arabia, that no Saudi delegation attended (reason unknown), maintained its strict export licensing, and said it could not provide a central overview of past defence-fair invitations.
The Ministry of Defence does not keep a central registration of defence fairs.
Het Ministerie van Defensie voert geen centrale registratie van defensiebeurzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het archief van de MH17

An MP asks the government about the archiving of MH17 crisis documents, including whether emails were lost, why interview transcripts and evaluations were withheld, and the status of the JIT and prosecution strategy. The minister answers that no separate hotspot list exists, that archive transfers have not yet taken place, that interview transcripts remain confidential to protect research validity, and that some evaluations and prosecution strategy details are still in progress.
This promised confidentiality weighs very heavily for me in considering not sending the report to your House.
Deze toegezegde vertrouwelijkheid weegt voor mij zeer zwaar bij de afweging om het verslag niet aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat bedienden van diplomaten uitbuiting op ambassades in Nederland melden

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether exploitation of domestic staff of diplomats at embassies in the Netherlands is acceptable, whether further investigation and sanctions are possible, and whether staff are informed of their rights. The minister replied that Dutch labour law applies, but inspection and enforcement bodies lack legal competence on embassy premises, so BZ relies on semi-annual monitoring interviews, a sanction of withdrawing the domestic-staff privilege, and rights briefings.

Based on the Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations and the headquarters agreements with international organisations, Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate or enforce on the premises of embassies, consulates or international organisations.

Op basis van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Diplomatiek Verkeer, het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Consulaire Betrekkingen en zetelverdragen tussen hier gevestigde internationale organisaties en Nederland hebben Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen op het terrein van ambassades, consulaten en/of internationale organisaties of om daar handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het artikel “Ze dacht dat Nederland veilig was"

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about press reports of intimidation and threats against a human rights lawyer working with the International Criminal Court in the Netherlands, and what protection and oversight measures were taken. The government confirmed a criminal investigation has been open since February, withheld details of protection measures for security reasons, and described an activated consultation mechanism with NGOs, the Court and the host state, with follow-up meetings planned.
That investigation began in February of this year. Because of the investigation, the cabinet cannot respond with details.
Dat onderzoek is februari dit jaar begonnen. Vanwege het onderzoek kan het kabinet niet op details reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Ngo’s dachten in Nederland veilig te zijn, maar dat pakt anders uit”

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers how they view threats against human rights lawyer Nada Kiswanson and the temporary closure of four NGO offices in The Hague, whether such threats are recurrent, why no official report was made after her complaint, and what protection is provided. The government says it takes the threats very seriously, a criminal investigation is underway, the ministries have convened meetings with NGOs, the ICC, prosecutors and police, and it has activated the host-state consultation mechanism, while stating that organisations bear primary responsibility for their own security and that it will not disclose protection measures.
The government makes no public statements about possible measures, because that could harm her safety.
De overheid doet geen openbare uitspraken over eventuele maatregelen, want dat zou haar veiligheid kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat een mensenrechtenjurist in Nederland ernstig bedreigd wordt

MP Kuzu asked whether a human rights lawyer working for al-Haq on ICC preliminary examinations of Israel and Palestine was threatened, why police initially did not take threats seriously, whether NGOs were obstructed, whether a state actor was behind the threats, and whether the Kamer would be informed of the investigation. The ministers confirmed the threats and an ongoing criminal investigation, described a consultation mechanism with the ICC and NGOs, but declined to comment on state involvement and said it is not customary to inform parliament about ongoing investigations.
It is not customary to inform the Kamer about ongoing investigations or their conclusion.
Het is niet gebruikelijk de Kamer te informeren over lopende onderzoeken of de afronding hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Turkse steun voor jihadi’s en een Turks verzoek om de inzet van  inlichtingendiensten voor de jacht op opponenten van Erdogan

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether a Turkish request for German intelligence help in hunting Erdogan opponents had reached Dutch services, whether Turkish support for jihadists was known to the AIVD and MIVD, and whether cooperation should end. The government said it cannot discuss concrete contacts with foreign services publicly, outlined its cooperation criteria, and declined to give details on the services' knowledge.
The government cannot publicly discuss concrete contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over het organiseren van een lezing die wordt gegeven door een terroristenknuffelaar

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the ministry hosted a lecture by John Esposito, whom they called an apologist for Saudi Arabia and Islamist groups, and what it costs and who was invited. The minister answered that Esposito cancelled his trip for family reasons, described the event as part of broader counter-radicalisation outreach, and said costs fall on the hosting organisations while invitees were experts from inside and outside government.
Unfortunately, for family reasons he had to cancel his trip to Europe.
Helaas heeft hij wegens familieomstandigheden zijn reis naar Europa moeten afzeggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten getiteld “Request for initiating an investigation in Thailand” in de zaak-Van

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch consular conduct and detention conditions for Van Laarhoven in Thailand, the Thai money-laundering conviction linked to Dutch cannabis-shop revenue, and possible bias of the Dutch prosecutor. The government answered that Thailand receives extended consular assistance, that it cannot judge foreign rulings, that the Dutch prosecution is ongoing, and that no substantive irregularities were found in the investigation.
The Public Prosecution Service decides which instruments it considers necessary within an ongoing criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bepaalt welke instrumenten het wanneer nodig acht in het kader van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over kindermisbruik in Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

Two MPs asked the government about reports of rising child and women abuse in Greek refugee camps, the Red Cross's role, and what Netherlands and the EU will do to protect residents and deport perpetrators. The minister said Greece is responsible, the issue was raised with Greek authorities and at EU level, EU funding has been given to improve camps, and the Greek government denies abuse reports were filed, without giving exact figures.
The Greek government is responsible for the reception of migrants, in line with European legislation and international law.
De Griekse overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de opvang van migranten, in lijn met Europese wetgeving en het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Turkije nog altijd onderdak biedt aan talloze islamitische extremisten

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey deliberately shelters leaders of Islamist groups designated as terrorist by the EU and US, including Jabhat al-Nusra and Muslim Brotherhood figures, and how the government views Turkish conduct against ISIS and Hamas. The minister answered that Turkey is an essential counter-terrorism partner, that Nusra is on Turkey's national terrorism list, that Turkish support for other groups cannot be excluded, and that Turkish counter-terrorism efforts have strengthened, while stating that the Erdogan statements are his own responsibility.
The cabinet is of the view that it is not at odds with the fight against terrorism that members of the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood reside in Turkey.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het niet op gespannen voet staat met de strijd tegen terrorisme dat leden van de Egyptische Moslimbroederschap woonachtig zijn in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de Duitse regering Turkije een platform voor islamisten noemt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that the German government calls Turkey a platform for Islamists, whether Turkey supports the Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas and armed opposition groups, and how he judges that support by a NATO ally. The minister confirmed awareness, said the German answers were only partly public and the leaked part is confidential, and stressed Turkey remains a counter-terrorism partner while confirming Turkish contacts with these groups.
The cabinet can confirm that Turkey maintains contacts with the Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas and various armed opposition groups.
Het kabinet kan bevestigen dat Turkije contacten onderhoudt met de Egyptische Moslimbroederschap, Hamas en verschillende gewapende oppositiegroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het toegenomen geweld in de Angolese provincie Cabinda

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about rising violence in Angola's Cabinda province, including reported military deaths, the conflict's background, Chinese involvement, Angolan de-escalation efforts, mediation prospects and Dutch activities. The minister denied the reported incident could be confirmed, outlined the conflict history, saw no direct reason for Dutch mediation, and largely answered on substance without addressing parliamentary scrutiny of the Dutch government itself.
The incident mentioned in the article cannot, however, be confirmed.
Het in het artikel genoemde incident kan echter niet bevestigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat de regering-Merkel er zeker van is dat Erdogan bewust radicaalislamitische bewegingen helpt

The ChristenUnie MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the German government believes Erdogan knowingly supports radical Islamist movements can be confirmed, and what political consequences the Netherlands would draw, including halting Turkey's visa liberalisation and EU accession talks and condemning Turkish support for Hamas and Syrian rebels. Minister Koenders answered that the leaked part is confidential and that Germany still regards Turkey as an essential partner against terrorism, that the government will not halt the talks given Turkey's rule-of-law developments, and that Turkish border support for armed groups cannot be excluded and will be addressed through border control.
The cabinet is not of the view that the current negotiations with Turkey on visa liberalisation or EU accession should be stopped because of this reporting.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de huidige onderhandelingen met Turkije over visumliberalisatie of EU-toetreding gestopt moeten worden omwille van deze berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat de Duitse regering meent dat Turkije islamitische organisaties en terreurgroepen steunt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that leaked German government documents say Turkey supports Islamist organisations and terrorist groups, and whether the Netherlands would consult Germany, reassess cooperation, or halt EU accession talks and the migration deal. The minister replied that the government stands by Turkey as a partner against terrorism, sees no need for consultation with Germany, does not consider the leaks a reason to halt accession talks or the EU-Turkey statement, and will keep cooperating with Turkey.
The cabinet underlines, like the German government, that Turkey is and remains a partner in the fight against terrorism.
Het kabinet onderstreept, net als de Duitse regering, dat Turkije een partner is en blijft in de strijd tegen terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de verspreiding van abortuspillen door Women on Waves naar Noord-Ierland

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the Women on Waves abortion-pill action toward Northern Ireland was lawful, whether the Dutch permit was affected, and whether there was contact with Ireland. The Minister answered that Northern Ireland's authorities are responsible for enforcement, no temporary permit was required since the action took place abroad, and there was no contact with Ireland or Northern Ireland.
Since Women on Waves' conduct did not take place on Dutch territory, no permit is required under Article 296(5) of the Criminal Code.
Aangezien het handelen van Women on Waves niet op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvond, is er geen vergunning vereist
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Smaling over de inzet van Europees ontwikkelingsgeld ten behoeve van buitenlandse krijgsmachten in Afrikaanse landen

MPs asked whether EU development funds would be used to finance foreign armies in African countries, including Sudan's, and whether this is acceptable. The government answered that the Commission proposal would only allow non-ODA funds under the IcSP in exceptional cases, that ODA cannot be used to strengthen foreign armies, that Sudanese army support is not on the table, and that the Netherlands will push to keep development money for development.
Your House will be further informed about this proposal in September via a BNC fiche.
Uw Kamer zal in september nader worden geïnformeerd over dit voorstel via een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een brief over confiscatie van gebouwen in Palestijns gebied

Member Van Bommel (SP) asked whether the Dutch ambassador in Israel signed a letter from eight EU ambassadors protesting Israel's confiscation of donor-funded Bedouin shelters in Area C and why not. The minister confirmed the letter, said the shelters were funded by the UN with donor support rather than Dutch or EU money, explained the group chose not to ask other countries to co-sign, and said the government condemns such demolitions and would consider joining a collective protest if asked.

If countries asked the Netherlands for support, the cabinet would certainly consider it, because the number of project demolitions shows a negative trend and the cabinet favours joint action to send a strong signal against it.

Indien landen Nederland steun zouden vragen, dan zal het kabinet dat zeker overwegen, omdat het aantal gevallen van sloop van projecten een negatieve trend vertoont en het kabinet voorstander is van een gezamenlijk optreden om hier een krachtig signaal tegen af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de implementatie van de Terezin Verklaring over de compensatie van Holocaust-slachtoffers

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands is doing enough to implement the 2009 Terezin Declaration on compensating Holocaust survivors, and whether the EU could take concrete steps such as appointing a special envoy. The minister replied that the Netherlands does not recognise the described shortfall, points to its existing social laws and post-war restitution commissions, and rejects an EU envoy in favour of sharing best practices through the IHRA.
Given the importance of the subject, the Netherlands is willing to share national best practices within the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA).
Nederland is gezien het belang van het onderwerp wel bereid om binnen de International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance (IHRA) nationale best practices te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Iran na het sluiten van de atoomdeal zou hebben geprobeerd nucleair materiaal aan te schaffen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Iran tried to acquire nuclear-relevant materials after the 2015 nuclear deal, and about Iranian ballistic missile tests. The minister answered that the government has no evidence of procurement in breach of the JCPOA or UNSC Resolution 2231, that no new sanctions were pursued, and that NATO missile defence is being strengthened.
Given the sensitivity of this information, no statements can be made about possible procurement activities for proliferation-sensitive goods in the Netherlands and the European Union.
Gezien de gevoeligheid van deze informatie kunnen er geen uitspraken gedaan worden over eventuele verwervingsactiviteiten van proliferatiegevoelige goederen in Nederland en de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het testen van een ballistische raket door Iran in juli 2016

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran conducted a further ballistic missile test in July 2016, whether North Korean technology was used, whether this violates UN resolutions 1929 or 2231 and the nuclear deal, and why stronger action has been slow. The minister answered that the reported test could not be confirmed, that intelligence services are investigating, that the Netherlands has raised concerns in the EU and UN Security Council, and that sanctions lacked support in those bodies.
The cabinet cannot for the time being confirm this news report.
Het kabinet kan dit nieuwsbericht vooralsnog niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de beperking van godsdienstvrijheid in islamitische landen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on religious freedom in Islamic countries, the US State Department findings, Dutch action, and Boko Haram's calls for violence against Christians. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch human rights support and multilateral efforts, and outlined counter-Boko Haram measures without providing precise casualty figures.
It is not possible to provide precise figures on the number of Christians and churches affected by violence in Islamic countries in the recent period.
Het is niet mogelijk om precieze cijfers te verstrekken van het aantal christenen en kerken dat in de afgelopen periode getroffen is door geweld in islamitische landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over de verstoring van een Israëlkraam in een Jumbo supermarkt

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked the ministers whether an online protest campaign against an Israeli product display in a Jumbo supermarket in Krimpen aan den IJssel was undesirable, and what the government would do to protect supermarkets and staff from intimidation. The minister answered that such actions fall under freedom of expression, that criminal law applies to threats or intimidation, that no signals of disruption of public order were received, and that no extra measures against protest campaigns are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures against protest campaigns.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om extra maatregelen te nemen tegen protestcampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Government austerity policy a breach of international human rights, says UN report”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a UN committee report finding UK austerity policy breaches economic and social rights, and whether such committee judgments are appropriate for the Netherlands. Minister Koenders answered that the committee's recommendations are non-binding, that the Dutch parliament is better placed to judge Dutch laws, and that the Optional Protocol ratification is still under consideration.
The Committee was established by ECOSOC with the aim of supervising compliance with the ICESCR by states parties.
Het Comité is door ECOSOC in het leven geroepen met als doel toezicht te houden op de naleving van het ESC-Verdrag door de staten die partij zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het Turkse dreigement de vluchtelingendeal op te blazen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would yield to Turkey's threat to end the refugee deal unless visa liberalisation for Turks is granted by October, and whether the deal was wise given Turkey's authoritarian turn. The minister answered that government visa policy is unchanged (visa-free travel only once all roadmap benchmarks are met), that the deal is needed to manage migration, that criticism of Turkey's post-coup developments stands, and that pre-accession aid would be cut and the death penalty is a red line if the rule of law deteriorates further.

Government visa liberalisation policy remains unchanged: only when Turkey meets all benchmarks of the Roadmap for visa liberalisation can the Netherlands agree to visa-free travel for Turkish citizens.

Het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie blijft onveranderd: enkel wanneer Turkije aan alle benchmarks van de Roadmap visumliberalisatie voldoet, kan Nederland instemmen met het invoeren van visumvrijheid voor Turkse burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het pleidooi de uitleveringen aan Turkije te stoppen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked whether extraditions to Turkey should be suspended given doubts about judicial independence, fair trial rights, long pre-trial detention and possible reintroduction of the death penalty after the failed coup. The minister said the government is seriously concerned and urges the rule of law, but that a blanket suspension of extradition and legal assistance would be undesirable, with each request assessed case by case under the treaties and ECHR.

Suspending all extradition and legal assistance to Turkey in advance would mean that all suspects or convicted persons, including for example in human trafficking, sexual or violent offences, could evade their punishment or prosecution.

Het op voorhand volledig opschorten van alle uitlevering en rechtshulpverlening aan Turkije zou tot gevolg hebben dat alle verdachten of veroordeelden, dus ook inzake bijvoorbeeld mensenhandel, zeden- of geweldsdelicten, hun straf(vervolging) kunnen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over marteling in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares Amnesty's concern about torture of detainees in Turkey and whether he will press for a CPT visit there. The minister said the concerns are real, raised them with the Council of Europe Secretary General, and has urged the CPT to visit Turkey and Turkey to receive it, with a follow-up at the Committee of Ministers in September.
The cabinet considers it of the utmost importance that the Turkish authorities treat those accused of involvement in the coup within the framework of the rule of law and transparency.

Het kabinet vindt het van het grootste belang dat de Turkse autoriteiten diegenen die beschuldigd worden van betrokkenheid bij de coup behandelen binnen de kaders van rechtsstatelijkheid en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de noodzaak om NAVO-kernwapens weg te halen uit Turkije

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government shares concern about NATO nuclear weapons stored at Incirlik in Turkey, whether they should be removed, and whether Turkey should be expelled from NATO after the post-coup crackdown. The ministers declined to confirm locations or numbers of nuclear weapons, stated that Turkey's NATO membership is not under discussion, and said the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to respect the rule of law.
Based on alliance and legally binding agreements, no statements are made about the locations and numbers per location of these nuclear weapons in Europe.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken worden geen mededelingen gedaan over locaties en aantallen per locatie van deze kernwapens in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het interview met de Turkse zaakgelastigde in Nederland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish chargé d'affaires' interview alleging intelligence surveillance of Gülen-linked Turkish Dutch residents, intimidation, and staged violence in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed six staff were deregistered at Turkey's request, said the Netherlands does not bear responsibility for an embassy's personnel matters, and stated the government has repeatedly urged Turkey not to import tensions into the Netherlands, without committing to a new request for explanation.
The cabinet bears no responsibility for internal personnel matters of a foreign embassy.
Het kabinet draagt geen verantwoordelijkheid voor interne personeelsaangelegenheden van een buitenlandse ambassade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Sjoerdsma over mishandeling van migranten door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Voortman and Sjoerdsma asked whether the EU and Dutch support to the Libyan coast guard, including the Sophia mission, makes them complicit in abuses of migrants reported by Amnesty International, and what follow-up is planned. The minister acknowledged the situation, described Dutch-funded IOM projects and EU mandate changes, and said the EU training phase has not started and that human rights will be raised with Libyan authorities, without accepting responsibility or changing course.
The Netherlands will work to discuss international human rights standards with the Libyan authorities and to include them in the training curriculum.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor bespreking van de internationale mensenrechtennormen met de Libische autoriteiten en voor opneming ervan in het curriculum van de trainingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het rapport van Amnesty International aangaande ontvoeringen en martelingen door de Egyptische veiligheidsdiensten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on enforced disappearances and torture by Egyptian security services, whether anti-terror law silences dissent, what the EU has done since 2014, and whether Egypt breaches the EU Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged the report as a credible source and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights in the EU, but did not confirm the figures independently and did not commit to placing the issue on the July Foreign Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet cannot confirm the findings on the numbers and timing of the increase from its own sources, but regards the Amnesty International report as an authoritative source.
Het kabinet kan de bevindingen over de aantallen en het moment van toename niet op basis van eigen bronnen bevestigen, maar beschouwt het rapport van Amnesty International als een gezaghebbende bron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over oproep van een Arubaanse minister om een visumplicht voor Venezolanen in te voeren

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior about an Aruban minister's call for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, and whether the issue had been discussed among the Kingdom countries. The government answered that there is currently no reason or request from Aruba for a temporary Caribbean visa requirement, that the issue has been raised in consultations and videoconferences, and that screening measures are preferred.
There is currently no request to that effect from the Aruban government or other Kingdom countries.
Er ligt op dit moment geen verzoek daartoe van de Arubaanse regering of andere Koninkrijkslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over toenemende repressie in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government shares Germany's concern about Turkey's state of emergency, judges the post-coup response disproportionate, and will push to suspend EU accession talks at the General Affairs Council. The minister answered that earlier written answers, a Kamerbrief and supplementary replies already addressed these questions adequately, without a substantive new position.

I expect that with the answers contained in the report of a written consultation of 21 July, the letter to parliament on the situation in Turkey of 21 July, and the supplementary answers in the report of a written consultation of 23 July, I have sufficiently answered the questions posed.

Ik verwacht met de antwoorden vervat in het verslag van een Schriftelijk Overleg van 21 juli jl., de Kamerbrief inzake de situatie in Turkije van 21 juli jl. en de aanvullende antwoorden vervat in het verslag van een Schriftelijk Overleg van 23 juli jl. de gestelde vragen afdoende te hebben beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de evacuatie van Nederlanders uit Zuid-Soedan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the evacuation of Dutch nationals from South Sudan, including how many remain and whether the government actively supports them in leaving. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter on recent developments in South Sudan rather than answering the questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de gevolgen van een Brexit voor de City of London, Nederlandse bedrijven, en de Amsterdamse Zuidas

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the effects of a Brexit on the City of London, Dutch firms and the Amsterdam Zuidas, covering timing, sector impacts, financial passporting and talent. The government answered that the UK remains an EU member until withdrawal, that Dutch sectors such as food processing and chemicals face the largest risks under WTO rules, and that the effects on the City and the Zuidas remain uncertain.
The cabinet will attend such meetings more often in the coming weeks and months, including at sector level, such as with the Dutch manufacturing industry.
Het kabinet zal de komende weken en maanden vaker dergelijke bijeenkomsten bijwonen, onder meer op sectorniveau, zoals met de Nederlandse maakindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk en Servaes over een Saoedische delegatie die op uitnodiging van de Koninklijke Marine een Nederlandse wapenbeurs bezoekt

MPs Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk and Servaes asked whether a Saudi delegation was invited by the Royal Netherlands Navy to the MAST arms fair, and how such an invitation fits with the motion on Saudi arms exports, the EU Parliament resolution and alleged humanitarian law violations in Yemen. The ministers replied that no Saudi delegation attended MAST 2016, and that the government maintains a very strict case-by-case arms export policy toward Saudi Arabia, with no export licences granted in 2016 so far.
No, no Saudi delegation was present at the Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Neen, er is geen Saoedische delegatie aanwezig geweest op de Maritime/Air Systems & Technologies (MAST) 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Molukse gevangenen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Moluccan prisoners held far from their families, whether they were jailed for a 2007 dance displaying the RMS flag, whether they were tortured or neglected, and what steps were taken to have them detained closer to home. The minister said the prisoners were arrested for displaying the flag and performing a dance before the Indonesian president, treated as freedom of expression, that official inquiries could not establish torture, and that the issues were raised bilaterally, in EU dialogue and with Indonesian ministers, with Netherlands promising to keep raising the matter.
From the information obtained, it could not be established with certainty that the detainees had been tortured.
Uit de ingewonnen informatie kon niet met zekerheid worden afgeleid dat de arrestanten zijn gemarteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Eritrea

MPs Voortman and Grashoff asked the government about the UN Commission of Inquiry on Eritrea, EU and Dutch development aid to Eritrea, reports of Eritreans being returned from Sudan, and Sudan's border assistance under the Khartoum process. The government answered that it supports ICC referral only via the UN Security Council, keeps Eritrea in the DGGF and backs an EU programme with conditions, deems Sudanese returns possible refoulement, and says aid to Eritrean and Sudanese border authorities will be monitored and kept restrained without commitment to new binding limits.
The Netherlands will also oversee this via its involvement in the EUTF and will also work for restrained use of EU ODA funds for border control in this context.
Nederland zal hiertoe via betrokkenheid bij het EUTF ook op toezien en zich eveneens inzetten voor een terughoudend gebruik van EU ODA-middelen voor grensbewaking in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het Verhoeven over het bericht dat gemeenten en winkels zich niet houden aan de regels voor wifi-tracking

An MP asked whether municipalities and shops are complying with privacy rules on wifi-tracking of phones in public spaces, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Data Protection Authority did not investigate concrete cases in 2016, gave guidance letters instead, considers its enforcement powers sufficient, and pointed to awareness campaigns, while stating that the AP found no non-compliance by municipalities.
It is therefore not known whether municipalities and shops comply with the rules.
Het is dus niet bekend of gemeenten en winkels zich aan de regels houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over het bericht dat de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties (VN) is gechanteerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports that Saudi Arabia pressured the UN Secretary-General into removing its coalition from the children and armed conflict blacklist, and whether the Netherlands would press the UN to restore it. The minister called the findings on child casualties in Yemen very concerning, said the listing was removed pending further fact-finding, condemned any political pressure as unacceptable, and said the Netherlands is coordinating with the EU and the Group of Friends on a joint response supporting the independence of the Special Representative.

The cabinet is consulting within the EU and with partners in the Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict on how to respond jointly to this situation and to publicly express support for the independent mandate of the UN Special Representative.

Het kabinet overlegt binnen de EU en met partners binnen de Group of Friends on Children and Armed Conflict op welke wijze gezamenlijk op deze situatie te reageren en publiekelijk steun uit te spreken voor het onafhankelijke mandaat van de Speciaal Vertegenwoordiger van de SGVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Ten Broeke, Thieme en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een mensenrechtenactivist in Bahrein

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of human rights activist Nabeel Rajab in Bahrain, its charge, and whether the government would raise it with Bahrain. The minister confirmed the arrest on the charge of spreading false news, said the government finds the repression very concerning, and said the EU will make a demarche in Manama seeking clarification.
The European Union will shortly make a demarche in Manama to the Bahraini authorities to raise the recent pressure on human rights defenders and the opposition.
De Europese Unie zal op korte termijn in Manama een demarche uitvoeren bij de Bahreinse autoriteiten om de recente druk op mensenrechtenverdedigers en de oppositie aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het beeld Terrorismebestrijding Turkije: ISIS door draaideur, academici in de cel

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's handling of ISIS suspects, releases of suspects, MIT powers and the EU visa-liberalisation benchmark on terrorism law. The minister said the cabinet cannot judge Turkish proceedings without the case files, that Turkey's terrorism law is used against terrorist groups but also criticised on press freedom, and that visa liberalisation requires meeting all benchmarks, which has not yet happened.
Since the cabinet has no access to the investigation files, it is not possible to judge the Turkish legal process in these cases.
Aangezien het kabinet geen inzage heeft in de onderzoeksdossiers is het niet mogelijk een oordeel te vellen over de Turkse rechtsgang in deze zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het schenden van mensenrechten in Brazilië in de aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about police violence and erosion of protest and expression rights in Brazil ahead of the Olympics, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns with Brazilian authorities and the Olympic Committee. The minister acknowledged serious concern about urban violence and police conduct, said the Netherlands raises human rights issues in bilateral and EU dialogues and at the consulate, and said it would voice concern about the anti-terrorism law if it restricts protest or expression, but did not commit to a specific new initiative with the Olympic Committee.
If application of this law indeed leads to restriction of the right to peaceful protest or freedom of expression, the Netherlands will express its concern about this to the Brazilian authorities.

Indien toepassing van deze wet inderdaad leidt tot inperking van het recht op vreedzame protesten of vrijheid van meningsuiting, zal Nederland zijn zorg hierover uiten aan de Braziliaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het bericht “Arubaanse delegatie in Caracas voor Citgo-deal”

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch ambassador played a formal role in an Aruban trade delegation's visit to Venezuela tied to a lease of the San Nicolas refinery. The minister answered that the ambassador only received and accompanied the Aruban delegation as is customary, and that the Dutch government has no formal role because the matter is Aruba's autonomous responsibility.
This concerns an autonomous competence and responsibility of Aruba.
Dit betreft een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de beperking van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in India

Voordewind (ChristenUnie) asks the Foreign Minister whether he shares Human Rights Watch and UN rapporteur Kiai's concerns that Indian authorities misuse vague laws, including the foreign contributions regulation law, to silence critics, and whether he will raise this with India, the EU and in the UPR. Minister Koenders answers that the Netherlands shares the rapporteur's concerns about the foreign contributions law, that it raises civil society and free expression in bilateral, EU and multilateral dialogue, and that it has no information showing anti-terror laws are disproportionately used against minorities.
The Dutch government shares the concerns of UN rapporteur Maina Kiai about the law on foreign donations.
De Nederlandse overheid deelt de zorgen van VN-rapporteur Maina Kiai over de wet m.b.t. buitenlandse giften
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over de ‘etikettering van Israëlische producten’

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether an action by BDS supporters checking supermarket products for Israeli origin was antisemitic and whether the government would distance itself, and whether it would ignore the EU interpretative notice on labelling Israeli settlement products. The minister said consumers may freely investigate product origin, the government distances itself from any discriminatory or violent incidents, and the EU notice merely clarifies existing law which the NVWA enforces.
Consumers are generally free to investigate the origin of products, regardless of the effects intended.
Het staat consumenten in algemene zin vrij om onderzoek te doen naar de herkomst van producten, ongeacht welke effecten ermee worden beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over de moord en inbraak bij een Oegandese mensenrechtenorganisatie

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the Foreign Minister about the murder and break-in at a Ugandan human rights organisation, the status of the NGO Bill, and support for the LGBT community in Uganda. The minister said the perpetrators are not yet arrested, that the EU will raise the break-in in a political dialogue and seek better protection for human rights groups, and that the NGO Bill is not yet applied, with no current grounds for further measures.
During this dialogue the EU will raise the violent break-in and press for measures to better protect human rights organisations against such break-ins.
Tijdens deze dialoog zal de EU de gewelddadige inbraak aan de orde stellen en aandringen op maatregelen om mensenrechtenorganisaties beter te beschermen tegen dergelijke inbraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse die vast zat in Qatar

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that a Dutch woman had been detained in Qatar since March after reporting being raped, why she remained in custody, what had been done to bring her home, and whether the Qatari ambassador would be summoned. The minister referred to his answers to earlier written questions on the same case without restating substance in this document.
See my answers to the written questions from MPs Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff and Sjoerdsma on the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar.
Zie mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff en Sjoerdsma
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over belegeringen en voortdurende bombardementen in Syrië

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister about sieges, market bombings and starvation in Syria, including UN Security Council resolution 2268 on humanitarian access. The minister condemned attacks on civilians, described the efforts to reach besieged areas and food airdrops, and said a full rapid answer before the Council meeting was not possible.
Unfortunately it has not proven possible to meet this request.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken aan dit verzoek te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat dertien EU-landen wapens leveren aan Egypte

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked whether thirteen EU states exported arms to Egypt despite the 2013 Council agreement to suspend licences for goods usable for internal repression, and whether the government would press for enforcement and harmonisation. The government answered that no formal embargo exists, that it lacks full export data, that EU states decide licences nationally, and that it will keep pushing for harmonisation without committing to new EU action.
However, the cabinet does not have exact information on the goods exported to Egypt, since within the EU only refusals and not approvals of export licences are shared.

Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over exacte informatie betreffende de goederen die naar Egypte uitgevoerd zijn, aangezien binnen de EU alleen de afwijzingen en niet de toewijzingen van uitvoervergunningen gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de indirecte Nederlandse steun aan de Boycot, Desinvesteringen en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

Three MPs asked whether Dutch-funded NGOs fund other NGOs promoting the BDS campaign against Israel, whether this fits subsidy criteria, and to list supported NGOs. The minister answered that the government does not finance BDS activities against Israel, that support for BDS is not a disqualifying criterion because of freedom of expression, and that it does not keep an overview of such organisations.
The cabinet ensures that it does not finance BDS activities against Israel.
Het kabinet stelt zeker dat het geen BDS-activiteiten tegen Israël financiert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over arrestatie van een Nederlands-Iraanse journalist in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of a Dutch-Iranian journalist in Iran was true, whether contact had been made with Iranian authorities, and for an update on the journalist's condition. The minister replied that the Dutch ambassador had requested confirmation of the arrest, that Iran recognises only Iranian nationality for dual nationals and so provides no consular access, and that the Netherlands will pursue consular assistance through quiet diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de import van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether tomatoes from Western Sahara were sold in Dutch supermarkets labelled as Moroccan, whether origin labelling is misleading, and whether Morocco's economic activity there is lawful after the EU General Court annulled the 2012 trade agreement. The government replied that it does not track the specific production location, that businesses bear responsibility for correct origin labelling, that consumers can complain to the NVWA, that economic activity in Western Sahara is not per se unlawful, and that the EU has appealed the court ruling so no export changes are yet foreseen.
The Dutch government does not keep information on the specific place where foodstuffs are produced.
De Nederlandse overheid houdt geen informatie bij over de specifieke plaats waar levensmiddelen zijn geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops en Grashoff over de vernietiging van Palestijnse waterbronnen door Israël

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP, CDA and GroenLinks asked whether Israel plans to destroy water cisterns in Kusra built with Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands could recover damages. The government answered that the cisterns are subject to stop-work orders that owners are contesting legally, that nothing has yet been destroyed so no compensation arises, and that the Dutch representation is intensifying dialogue with Israeli authorities and following legal developments closely.
In this context the Representation has lodged a protest against the latest stop-work orders and will continue to follow the legal developments very actively.
In dit kader heeft de Vertegenwoordiging protest aangetekend tegen de laatste stop-work-orders en zal het de juridische ontwikkelingen zeer actief blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de uitzetting van een VN-functionaris door Sudan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Sudanese government's refusal to renew the residence permit of UN OCHA head Ivo Freijsen amounts to a de facto expulsion, what reasons Sudan gave, and whether the Netherlands would protest. The minister confirmed the permit will lapse, noted Sudan gave no official reason beyond alleged non-cooperation and inaccurate UN reporting, and said the Netherlands and donors have urged Sudan to reverse the decision.
The cabinet finds it incomprehensible and disappointing that Mr Freijsen has to leave the country in this way.
Het kabinet vindt het onbegrijpelijk en teleurstellend dat de heer Freijsen op deze manier het land moet verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg, Knops en Keijzer over de zaak Saban B. in Turkije

CDA MPs asked about the case of Saban B., convicted in the Netherlands to 7 years 9 months for trafficking and assault but still free in Turkey, and about Turkey's cooperation on enforcing Dutch sentences. The minister answered that Turkish proceedings are still pending, that Dutch requests since 2010 cover 23 persons with at least 6 granted, and that a memorandum of understanding is being negotiated, but did not provide a complete list or the requested one-week timeline.

In the context of protecting the privacy of the persons concerned, I can only inform you that since 2010 the Netherlands has, under the Wots, expressed to Turkey the wish to transfer enforcement of a Dutch sentence for 23 persons.

In het kader van bescherming van de privacy van de betrokken personen, kan ik u slechts mededelen dat Nederland vanaf 2010 op grond van de Wots ten aanzien van 23 personen aan Turkije de wens kenbaar heeft gemaakt de tenuitvoerlegging van een Nederlands vonnis aan Turkije over te dragen.
Antwoord op het vragen van lid Voortman over het bericht dat EU-diplomaten onderhandelen over een vluchtelingendeal met een van de Libische regeringen

An MP asked the government about reports that EU diplomats were negotiating a migration deal with a Libyan government, and about the Dutch role, the prospects of such a deal given Libya's instability, and rescue capacity on the Italy route. The minister replied that no broad migration agreement is under negotiation, that Libya cannot yet be a safe third country, that Dutch support is limited to coast guard and migration projects, and that EU operations already contribute to rescues.
There is, however, no question of negotiations on a broad migration agreement between the EU and Libya.
Er is echter geen sprake van onderhandelingen over een breed migratie-akkoord tussen de EU en Libië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het testen van een ballistische middellange afstandsraket door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm reports of an Iranian mid-range ballistic missile test, whether it violates UN resolutions 1929 and 2231, what consequences earlier launches had, and whether trade easing is compatible with a critical stance. The minister said the cabinet cannot confirm the report, outlined UN and EU responses to earlier launches while stating Netherlands did not sign the letters from the four permanent-member states, and said trade-related payment easing does not preclude a critical stance.
The cabinet does not have information that can confirm this report.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die dit bericht kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de consequenties van een Brexit voor verblijfsrechten van Nederlanders en Britten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Brexit's effects on residence rights of Dutch and British citizens, British voting eligibility in the referendum, naturalisation and integration requirements, and the UK's possible single-market access terms. The minister answered that the government cannot yet say what Brexit would mean for residence status, depends on negotiations, and declined to take positions on scenarios, while committing only to the standard Article 50 process.

The cabinet cannot currently state what the impact of a possible UK withdrawal from the European Union would be on the residence status of Dutch nationals in the UK and of British nationals in the Netherlands.

Het kabinet kan op dit moment niet aangeven wat de invloed is van eventuele terugtrekking van het Verenigd Koninkrijk uit de Europese Unie op de verblijfsstatus van Nederlanders in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en van Britten in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van fosfor in het zuidoosten van Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish forces used phosphorus bombs against civilians in Nusaybin, what international humanitarian law says about such weapons, and whether the minister would raise the matter with Turkish counterparts and support independent investigation. The minister could not confirm the use, said civilians are among the victims, explained that IHL restricts incendiary weapons without banning phosphorus munitions outright (Turkey not party to Protocol III), and said he raises the conflict with Turkish counterparts while urging resumption of the Kurdish peace process.
I regularly raise the conflict with the PKK in contacts with my Turkish colleagues and urge the resumption of the Kurdish peace process.
Ik breng het conflict met de PKK geregeld op in contacten met mijn Turkse collega’s en dring daarbij aan op hervatting van het Koerdische vredesproces
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Bommel over het bericht dat Turkse parlementsleden voortaan vervolgd kunnen worden

MPs Maij and Van Bommel asked whether the Turkish move to lift parliamentary immunity, which mainly affects pro-Kurdish HDP members, is concerning, and whether it breaches the ECHR. The minister said the development is worrying, raised concerns with President Erdogan, and noted that the measure could have a discriminatory effect, while stating that parliamentary immunity is not itself a human right.
The Prime Minister expressed his concern to President Erdogan on 23 May, on the margins of the World Humanitarian Summit, about the lifting of parliamentary immunities.

De premier heeft in zijn gesprek met president Erdoğan op 23 mei jl. en marge van de World Humanitarian Summit zijn verontrusting kenbaar gemaakt over de opheffing van de immuniteiten van de parlementsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over Burundese vluchtelingen en het voortdurend vermoorden van (vermeende) tegenstanders van president Nkurunziza in en buiten Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about escalating violence in Burundi, refugees being attacked in camps abroad, shortages in refugee camps, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers answered that Dutch and EU pressure, sanctions, suspended direct budget aid and support for a regional dialogue continue, and that Dutch humanitarian funding and a 1 million euro contribution for the Mahama camp were provided, while the AU observer deployment is delayed.
Because of the violence and the poorly conducted elections, the Netherlands suspended direct aid to Burundi in 2015.
Vanwege het geweld en de slecht verlopen verkiezingen heeft Nederland in 2015 de directe hulp aan Burundi opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Servaes over het Amnesty-rapport 'WK Voetbal Qatar: FIFA negeert uitbuiting arbeidsmigranten'

MPs Van Dekken and Servaes asked the ministers about Amnesty's report on exploitation of migrant workers building Qatar 2022 World Cup venues, FIFA's inaction, and Qatar's sponsorship system. The ministers acknowledged serious abuses remain, pointed to EU-level pressure on FIFA and Qatar, the ILO mission and complaint process, and the EU Presidency's integrity agenda, without committing to new binding steps.
The cabinet will therefore continue to press for improvements in the position of migrant workers in talks with Qatar and business.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom in de gesprekken met Qatar en het bedrijfsleven blijven inzetten voor de verbetering van de positie van arbeidsmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over niet meer internationaal bellen vanuit Venezuela

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether Venezuela's mobile operators stopping international calling, the end of international post, and its effects on opposition and migration reflect a repressive escalation affecting the Kingdom. The government answered that the cut stems from foreign-currency shortages linked to the economic crisis, that opposition risks are not shown to rise, and that it monitors migration closely without expecting large-scale flows.
The government closely monitors developments in Venezuela.
De regering monitort de ontwikkelingen in Venezuela nauw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over medicijntekort in Suriname

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a medicine shortage in Suriname that could cost lives, including its scale, causes, and whether the Netherlands could help via suspended treaty funds. The minister said there is no general medicine shortage but a shortage of basic consumables in hospitals, that Suriname has made no aid request, and that the suspension of treaty funds since 2012 remains unchanged.
Suriname has not yet submitted an international aid request. Should that happen, the cabinet will look at it seriously, as is customary for such requests.
Suriname heeft vooralsnog geen internationaal hulpverzoek ingediend. Mocht dat komen, dan zal het kabinet daar serieus naar kijken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over Israëlische dreigementen tegen aanhangers van de boycot, desinvesteringen en sancties (BDS)-beweging

MP Grashoff asked the Dutch government about Israeli ministers' statements calling for targeted measures against BDS activists, Israeli anti-boycott legislation, and possible sanctions against Dutch or EU citizens. The government said it cannot interpret foreign ministers' remarks, noted the Israeli minister's clarification that he meant no physical measures, described the anti-boycott law and a visa bill as not yet having led to cases, and stated that supporting BDS falls under freedom of expression.
It is not for the cabinet to explain what ministers of another state precisely mean by their statements.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uit te leggen wat bewindspersonen van een andere staat met hun uitspraken precies bedoelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over Nederlandse subsidies aan de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he shares concern over a campaign in Israel against the NGO Breaking the Silence, which the Dutch government funds, and whether it will fund extra security measures for the group. The government answers that it shares concern about shrinking space for Israeli human rights NGOs, sees no reason to doubt the group's professionalism and its prior military censorship, and will assess any security subsidy request on its merits.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de mishandeling van twee homoseksuele mannen in Marokko

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the government about the assault on two gay men in Morocco, the status of the perpetrators, and whether the government would raise the issue with Moroccan authorities. The minister confirmed shock at the footage, corrected the reported sentences, described the criminalisation of same-sex acts in Morocco as incompatible with international human rights obligations, said the EU had raised the case with Morocco's National Human Rights Council, and described ongoing support for LGBT rights through civil society, but did not commit to a new specific demand to Moroccan authorities.
The cabinet will therefore continue to unreservedly commit itself to the rights of this vulnerable minority.
Het kabinet zal zich daarom onverkort blijven inzetten voor de rechten van deze kwetsbare minderheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over vermeende standrechtelijke executies door Iraakse militairen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reported video evidence of summary executions of IS fighters by Iraqi soldiers was known, how the government judged it, and whether it would press Iraq on humanitarian law. The minister replied that the allegations could not be verified, that there was no sign of a pattern of violations, and that the government repeatedly stresses compliance with humanitarian law to Iraqi authorities and in coalition training.
It has not been possible to obtain information showing whether these images and allegations are correct or not.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken informatie te verkrijgen waaruit kan worden opgemaakt of deze beelden en beschuldigingen juist zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat aan Turken in Nederland om beledigingen te melden

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked ministers about a Turkish consulate call for Turks in the Netherlands to report insults against Turkey, its president and flag, and whether this undermines free speech and intimidates critics. The government response is a cross-reference to a letter answering a related Karabulut question, so the substance is not given in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat in Nederland om beledigingen van Erdogan te melden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Turkish consulate in Rotterdam was right to call on Turkish organisations in the Netherlands to report insults of Erdogan, and how the government would respond. The answer is a cross-reference to a letter on a related request from MP Karabulut, so the substance of the government's position is not set out in this document.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes, question number 2016Z08377, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), vraagnummer 2016Z08377 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het niet uitvoeren van de motie Servaes inzake een internationaal verbod op kernwapens

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch delegation to the UN Open Ended Working Group did not act on the Servaes motion calling for negotiations on a nuclear weapons ban, and whether it would be instructed to do so. The minister answered that the delegation had followed its existing instruction in the first week, that a nuclear ban was on the agenda only in the second week, that further instructions reflecting the motion were sent, and that Parliament would be informed in writing about the second session.
You will be informed in writing, in line with my earlier commitment, about the progress of this second session of the OEWG.
U zult conform mijn eerdere toezegging schriftelijk nader geïnformeerd worden over het verloop van deze tweede sessie van de OEWG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht dat op Sheremetyevo Airport een vluchteling vast zit in de transit-zone

SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a Syrian asylum seeker is stranded in Sheremetyevo airport's transit zone, including Russia's asylum practice, passport handling, how common such stranding is, and whether the Netherlands will intervene. The minister confirmed the case, said Russia rarely grants formal asylum but more often temporary status, described passport handling as standard practice, and said the Dutch embassy works through UNHCR rather than direct action on the specific case.
The Dutch embassy regularly has contact with the local UNHCR office in Moscow on refugee and migration matters.
De Nederlandse ambassade heeft regelmatig contact met het lokale kantoor van UNHCR in Moskou over vluchtelingen- en migratiezaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over illegale bouwactiviteiten in Judea en/of Samaria, gefinancierd door Nederland en/of de Europese Unie

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch and EU aid funds building in area C of the West Bank without Israeli permits, and how much was spent including rebuilding demolished structures. The minister answered that such aid supports Palestinian communities under international law, that Israel has obligations as occupying power, reported EU spending of about 65 million euros in 2011-2015, and rejected the characterisation of this as wasteful.
How much money has the Netherlands and how much money has the European Union spent on this in the past five years?
Hoeveel geld heeft Nederland en hoeveel geld heeft de Europese Unie daaraan uitgegeven in de afgelopen vijf jaren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over confisqueren van kerken en vernielen van cultureel erfgoed door Turkije

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about Turkey's expropriation of about 6,300 parcels in Diyarbakir's historic Sur district, including churches, damage to heritage sites, a police photo mocking Christians, and whether the Netherlands will protest or request independent investigation. The minister answered that expropriation is legal for restoration under Turkish law with compensation and appeal rights, damage stems from mutual fighting, church damage is limited, and the Netherlands urges an end to violence and monitors the situation.
Affected parties can further appeal against expropriation.
Betroffenen kunnen verder beroep aantekenen tegen onteigening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar, Jasper van Dijk, Van Veldhoven, Voordewind, Grashoff, Dijkgraaf, Thieme over het gebrek aan bescherming van Syrische kinderen

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about the lack of protection for Syrian children, including the petition and reports by UNICEF, Save the Children, War Child and World Vision, and what the Netherlands does on education, psychosocial aid and school protection. The minister answered that Dutch funding for education and psychosocial support in Syria and neighbouring countries is ongoing, that it supports the call to honour pledges, and that it will raise school protection and MHPSS at the EU and World Humanitarian Summit, but gave few figures on outcomes and no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands is working within international frameworks to ensure that the pledges are also honoured.
Nederland zet zich in internationaal verband in om ervoor te zorgen dat de toezeggingen ook worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het hoge tempo waarin Palestijnse gebouwen op de Westelijke Jordaanoever worden gesloopt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked about the rapid pace of Israeli demolitions of Palestinian buildings in the West Bank, including the number destroyed, displacement, donor-funded losses, recourse for damages, and EU action. The ministers confirmed the situation is very serious, reported 539 buildings demolished in Area C by 8 April 2016 versus 453 in all of 2015, cited €77,000 and €416,000 in damage to Dutch and EU-funded projects, and said the matter is raised in the EU and that Israel does not pay compensation.
In the case of demolition orders or confiscations, the Netherlands raises compensation.
Nederland stelt in geval van slooporders of confiscaties schadevergoeding aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het opgelaaide geweld om Nagorno-Karabach

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the April 2016 fighting over Nagorno-Karabach, including casualties, its cause, calls for a ceasefire and the state of OSCE Minsk Group mediation. The minister confirmed at least thirty deaths per both sides' figures, said the trigger was unclear, outlined EU and Dutch calls for a ceasefire, and described ongoing support for the Minsk Group talks.
To date it is still unclear what caused the flare-up of the conflict in the night of 1 to 2 April.
Tot op heden is nog onduidelijk wat de aanleiding was voor het oplaaien van het conflict in de nacht van 1 op 2 april.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de aanstelling van Michael Lynk als VN-rapporteur

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the appointment of Michael Lynk as UN Special Rapporteur on the Palestinian territories is impartial, given alleged bias against Israel, and whether the Netherlands tried to block it. The minister replied that the appointment followed a transparent UN procedure, that rapporteurs are bound by a code of conduct, that the government will assess his reports on expertise, independence and impartiality, and that Canada did not object to the appointment.
The government will assess Michael Lynk on his work and examine whether his reports are expert, independent and impartial.
De regering zal Michael Lynk beoordelen op zijn werk en bezien of de rapporten van deze rapporteur deskundig, onafhankelijk en onpartijdig zijn opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het vrijlaten van gevangenen uit Guantánamo Bay

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would accept Guantánamo detainees, whether it was discussed with the US, and how the Obama closure plan should be assessed. The minister said the Netherlands opposes Guantánamo and welcomes steps toward closure, that it is not a transfer destination, that the US request is repeated at official level, and that the earlier condition of further US steps will not yet be reconsidered.

It is therefore too early to reconsider the government's earlier conclusion that the US request to accept detainees from Guantánamo will only be considered after the US has taken further meaningful steps toward closing the detention facility, including prosecution of the remaining detainees.

Het is daarmee te vroeg om de eerdere conclusie van het kabinet dat het Amerikaanse verzoek tot opname van gedetineerden uit Guantánamo pas in overweging zal worden genomen nadat de VS verdere betekenisvolle stappen heeft gezet richting sluiting van de detentiefaciliteit, inclusief berechting van de overgebleven gedetineerden, te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse subsidie voor antisemitisme- en terreurverheerlijking
