Two Dutch MPs asked whether the government funds the Palestinian NGO RWDS, which held events honouring a terrorist, and whether it will stop indirect subsidies to organisations promoting antisemitism and terrorism. The minister confirmed past funding of RWDS (about 460,000 euro and 104,852 euro via Oxfam Novib), denied any support for the event, and said the government will not fund such organisations and will suspend or end grants if subsidy conditions are breached, though it did not commit to a specific new stop or the requested EU/UN initiative.
If, however, it is established that an organisation has breached the subsidy conditions, measures will be taken, including suspending or ending the contribution.

Indien evenwel geconstateerd wordt dat er sprake is van schending van de subsidievoorwaarden door een organisatie, zullen maatregelen worden getroffen, waarbij het opschorten of beëindigen van de bijdrage tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over Nederlandse subsidies aan de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and PVV asked whether Dutch subsidies to the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence should be reconsidered after reports it collected classified IDF information, and how the government ensures subsidies are lawfully spent. The minister replied that no charges have been filed, that the government is concerned about NGO space in Israel, and that the Human Rights Secretariat has strict selection and monitoring procedures with no finding of breach so far.
However, no such finding has been made in the case of the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence.
Van een dergelijke constatering is in het geval van de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence evenwel geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Knops over de aanslag op Eerste Paasdag in Lahore, Pakistan, waarbij 72 mensen om het leven zijn gekomen en in het bijzonder christenen doelwit waren

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Easter Day bombing in Lahore that killed 72 people, including whether Christians are targeted, whether Pakistani state protection for religious minorities is adequate, and how Pakistan's fight against Taliban-linked groups can be supported. The minister acknowledged the attack, described the claimed motives, said the Netherlands raises minority protection bilaterally and multilaterally, and pointed to planned NGO programmes and EU and GCTF cooperation on counterterrorism.
The Netherlands therefore intends to support NGO programmes in Pakistan from this autumn via the Addressing Root Causes fund.
Nederland is daarom voornemens om vanaf dit najaar via het Addressing Root Causes fonds ngo-programma's in Pakistan te steunen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over de executie van een Palestijn door een Israëlische soldaat

MPs Sjoerdsma and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about a video showing an Israeli soldier executing a wounded Palestinian, and about reports of extrajudicial killings, asking whether the government had raised this bilaterally and in the EU and would press for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the government was shocked, that the EU consistently urges Israel to ensure responses are necessary and proportionate, and that Israel's Ministry of Defence has opened an investigation which the Netherlands will follow closely.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the progress of Israeli investigations into its own conduct.
Nederland zal het verloop van Israëlische onderzoeken naar eigen optreden nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over IMF-programma en hervormingen van de energiesector in Oekraïne

Mr Van Bommel (SP) asks the Foreign Minister about IMF-linked reforms in Ukraine, including energy subsidy cuts, coal mine closures, and a reported assault on a miners' union leader, and whether the reforms cause unemployment and inflation. The minister answers that the IMF reforms aim to stabilise the economy, that tariff rises are cushioned for the poorest, that mine closures are planned, and declines to disclose an oligarch's assets as not the cabinet's matter.
It is not for the Cabinet to make statements about the assets of foreign persons.
Het is niet aan het Kabinet om mededelingen te doen over de bezittingen van buitenlandse personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over lancering van raketten die kernwapens kunnen dragen door Iran

The MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government views Iran's March 2016 ballistic missile launches, which are capable of carrying nuclear weapons, and whether the Netherlands co-signed a letter from the US and other European states to the UN. The minister says the missiles likely fall under MTCR Category 1, that the tests are highly undesirable, and that the Netherlands was not a signatory but fully supports the letter's content.
The cabinet fully supports the content and purport of this letter.
Het kabinet steunt de inhoud en strekking van deze brief ten volle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de ontmanteling van een Nederlands ontwikkelingsproject door het Israëlische leger

MP Kuzu asked whether Israeli forces dismantled a Dutch-funded agricultural development project, the consequences for Dutch aid and bilateral ties, and whether the ambassador should be summoned. The ministers say the report is inaccurate (a stop-work order on one site of a larger project), describe protests and legal avenues, and say the Israeli side is being pressed on damage while bilateral dialogue continues.

This is not correct. It concerns a so-called stop-work order for one of the locations where Palestinian farmers, with support from a Palestinian NGO funded by the Netherlands, had further developed their land to achieve a better harvest.

Dit is niet correct. Het betreft een zgn. stop-work order voor één van de locaties waar Palestijnse boeren, met steun van een door Nederland gefinancierde Palestijnse NGO, hun land verder ontwikkeld hebben om een betere oogst te kunnen realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over de nalatigheid van de Europese Commissie bij het uitvoeren van mensenrechtenanalyses bij handelsverdragen

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about the European Commission's failure to carry out a human rights analysis for trade agreements, including the delayed TiSA impact study and the EU-Vietnam FTA. The ministers answered that the Commission has committed to including human rights in future Sustainability Impact Assessments, that the Netherlands will push this during its EU presidency, and that the EU-Vietnam agreement already contains human rights links.
Following the Ombudsman's call, one of these ambitions concerns including a human rights analysis in the usual Sustainability Impact Assessments.
In navolging van de oproep van de Ombudsman betreft één van deze ambities het opnemen van een mensenrechtenanalyse in de gebruikelijke Sustainability Impact Assessments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over het bericht dat mensenrechtenactiviste Berta Cáceres is vermoord in Honduras

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers how the government would respond to the murder of Honduran activist Berta Cáceres, how it would monitor Honduras's human rights efforts, what steps it had taken regarding FMO's involvement in a dam project, and how it would address the protection of human rights defenders. The ministers answered that the government condemned the killing, had the ambassador raise investigation demands with Honduran authorities, pressed FMO on land rights and transparency, and outlined existing human rights defender protection programmes.
The government regularly speaks with FMO about its investment policy.
Het kabinet spreekt regelmatig met FMO over haar investeringsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inname van Palestijns land door Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel annexed about 240 hectares on the West Bank and whether the government would contact Israeli counterparts and push for a strong EU condemnation. The minister confirmed a 234-hectare appropriation, said the EU and the Netherlands have publicly opposed it, and stated that the government regrets the decision as unlawful under international law without announcing a new concrete step.
The government regrets this decision, which constitutes an unlawful appropriation in violation of international law
Het kabinet betreurt dit besluit, dat een onrechtmatige toe-eigening vormt in strijd met internationaal recht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over sancties tegen Rusland

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether he opposed a German minister's push to lift Russia sanctions, a proposed EU-Russia free trade deal, and the conditions for keeping sanctions tied to the Minsk agreements and Crimea. The minister replied that sanctions stay linked to full Minsk implementation and Crimea non-recognition, that lifting them is not on the table, and that a free trade deal and a High Representative visit to Moscow are not currently planned.
A possible easing of the sanctions is currently not on the agenda.
Een eventuele verlichting van de sancties is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland

MP Grashoff asks the Foreign Minister about the human rights situation in Russia, including attacks on journalists and human rights defenders in Chechnya, EU and Dutch responses, and follow-up to a motion. The minister condemns the attacks, describes a worsening climate for civil society and media in Russia and Chechnya, and says the Netherlands raises human rights bilaterally and within the EU without taking additional bilateral action on this case.
After consultation with the countries involved, the Netherlands, given the above, has not taken any additional bilateral action.
Na overleg met betrokken landen heeft Nederland gelet op bovenstaande geen aanvullende bilaterale actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Knops en Voordewind over het onderzoeksrapport over christenvervolging door Boko Haram in Nigeria

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on Christian persecution by Boko Haram and related violence in Nigeria, and how Dutch efforts compare and what concrete action is possible. The minister answered that the violence is serious but driven largely by economic and ethnic-religious conflicts, described existing Dutch and EU support for dialogue, deradicalisation and a regional task force, and acknowledged the particular vulnerability of Christian communities.
The Netherlands actively works worldwide for freedom of religion and belief for everyone.
Nederland zet zich wereldwijd actief in voor vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about information given to Thai authorities on the Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, the Thai conviction of a former coffeeshop owner for laundering drug money, the prosecutor's role, and police testimony. The minister answered most questions in substance, withheld Thai and ongoing-investigation documents, and rejected the claim that the conviction exposes Dutch coffeeshop operators to prosecution.
I cannot provide any documents on this, as they are Thai documents in the Thai criminal investigation.
Ik kan eventuele stukken hierover niet verstrekken, nu dit Thaise stukken betreffen in het Thaise strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse luchtvaartmaatschappij Mahan Air

An MP asked the ministers about US sanctions on Iranian airline Mahan Air, whether it operates in the Netherlands and links to Aviareps, and whether EU sanctions exist and why the airline should not be banned from the Netherlands. The minister replied that the US sanctions are a US sovereign matter, Mahan Air is not active in the Netherlands, Aviareps is a service provider, EU sanctions require unanimity and lacked support, and no action is needed since the airline is not active here.
Het instellen van sancties vergt unanimiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Eijsink over Bescherming scholen en universiteiten tegen militair gebruik tijdens gewapend conflict

MPs Servaes and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about implementing guidelines protecting schools and universities from military use in armed conflict, and about the #WatchOurSchools campaign. The government answered that Dutch forces already follow the spirit of the guidelines through humanitarian law training, though they are not part of Rules of Engagement, and that Nederland has urged other states to endorse the Safe Schools initiative and recorded 52 supporting countries.
The guidelines are not part of the Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for operations, as ROEs are not a suitable instrument for including provisions of the law of armed conflict.
De richtlijnen maken geen deel uit van de Rules of Engagement (ROE's) voor operaties, aangezien ROE's geen geschikt instrument zijn voor het opnemen van oorlogsrechtelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse kritiek op aanwezigheid van een Nederlandse diplomaat bij een strafproces tegen journalisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish leaders' objections to Dutch diplomats attending a criminal trial of journalists reporting on alleged Turkish arms supplies to Syrian militants, and whether the Netherlands would continue sending diplomats and summon the Turkish ambassador. The minister confirmed the criticism, said diplomats routinely observe trials under the Vienna Convention, and stated that the Netherlands values this role and raised concerns with Turkish authorities, without announcing that it would summon the ambassador.
In a conversation with Turkish authorities in Ankara this was clearly pointed out, and surprise and criticism were also expressed about President Erdoğan's statements on this issue.
In een gesprek met Turkse autoriteiten in Ankara is hier duidelijk op gewezen, en is er ook verbazing en kritiek uitgesproken over de uitspraken van President Erdoğan over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de nijpende situatie van Lesbische, Homo-, Biseksuelen en Transgenders (LHBT's) in Indonesië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dijkstra asked the government about rising hostility toward LGBT people in Indonesia, including declarations of war by militant groups and stigmatising remarks by ministers. The minister answered that the Netherlands is monitoring the situation, raised concerns with Indonesian ministers, supports NGO and HIV programmes, and will raise human rights in the EU-Indonesia dialogue.
The cabinet shares the view that the stigmatisation of and negative statements about LGBT people are undesirable.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de stigmatisering van en negatieve uitspraken over LHBT's onwenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over kritische rapporten over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de verbreding van het Egyptische Suezkanaal

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers about critical reports (SOMO and One World) alleging that Dutch dredging firms and the state-backed export credit insurer Atradius DSB failed to apply due-diligence standards to the Suez Canal widening, and whether commercial interests outweighed human and environmental rights. The government rejects the conclusion that economic interests prevailed, says it gathered sufficient information for an environmental and social assessment, and explains the differing findings of the SOMO report and the Witteveen & Bos study.
The cabinet has taken good note of the SOMO report in question and takes its observations and findings seriously.
Het kabinet heeft goede nota genomen van het betreffende SOMO-rapport en de observaties en bevindingen nemen wij serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over de voorlopige toepassing van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked how long the EU-Ukraine association agreement could stay provisionally applied if it never enters into force, which parts fall under exclusive EU competence, and whether a narrower EU-only agreement is being considered. Minister Koenders answered that non-ratification is uncharted territory, outlined the EU competence rules in general terms without a definitive list of articles, and said no such overlegs on an EU-only alternative had taken place while the agreement remains the best basis for cooperation.
The association agreement does not specify which provisions fall under the exclusive competences of the EU.
Het associatieakkoord specificeert niet welke bepalingen vallen onder de exclusieve bevoegdheden van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over het onderzoek inzake de kunstroof in het Westfries Museum in Hoorn

Two Christian Democrat MPs asked why Ukraine appears not to take the Hoorn museum art theft investigation seriously, including questions about unheard suspects and the Ukrainian security service's role. The Ministers answered that Ukraine is conducting a criminal investigation, that the Netherlands cannot comment on an ongoing prosecution, and that cooperation is satisfactory, while declining to share case progress details with Parliament.
Since this concerns an ongoing criminal investigation, no statements about it will be made to the House.
Gezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft, worden hierover geen mededelingen aan de Kamer gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over luchtaanvallen in Irak en Syrië

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked the Dutch government about civilian casualties from anti-IS coalition airstrikes in Iraq and Syria, Dutch involvement in specific strikes, and transparency. The government said exact civilian casualty numbers cannot be determined, that Dutch involvement cannot be fully ruled out in the cited strikes, that two possible civilian-casualty cases from Dutch strikes are under investigation, and that it will press for greater coalition transparency.
For operational reasons, no details of the individual investigations are released. The House will be informed of the outcomes.
Om operationele redenen worden geen details vrijgegeven van de afzonderlijke onderzoeken. De Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Fokke over Eurochild

MPs Maij and Fokke asked the Foreign Minister about child rights organisation Eurochild's recommendations to the Dutch EU Presidency on children's interests, including child poverty, unaccompanied minors and youth involvement. The government answered that it will address radicalisation of youth, involve young people through EU and school programmes, treat poverty mainly as a member state responsibility, and promise a general report on the Presidency afterwards.
After the EU Presidency a general report will follow to inform the House about the activities and outcomes of the Presidency.
Na afloop van het EU voorzitterschap volgt een algemene rapportage om de Kamer te informeren over activiteiten en uitkomsten van het voorzitterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Tonnen voor opinieplatform”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister why the 'Raam op Rusland' initiative, which applied for nearly EUR 3 million in subsidy, is not journalism and whether the subsidy risks funding ordinary journalistic work. The minister confirmed the application under the POBB programme, stated the first-three-year budget is EUR 364,000 covering website, staff and freelancers, and said the foundation is a knowledge platform with no journalistic purpose, so no funding of journalism or the Ukraine referendum campaign.
The project proposal Raam op Rusland is not a journalistic or opinion-forming project, but the establishment of a knowledge platform
Het projectvoorstel Raam op Rusland betreft geen journalistiek of opiniërend project, maar de oprichting van een kennisplatform
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de benoeming van een omstreden hoogleraar tot rapporteur van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's shortlisted special rapporteur on the Palestinian territories, Penny Green, is partial given her alleged BDS sympathies, and what the government had done to counter bias against Israel in the Council. The minister answered that no appointment had yet been made, that rapporteurs must be independent and impartial and will be judged on that, and that the Netherlands criticises one-sided UN resolutions while coordinating with the EU.
Special Rapporteurs are expected to report independently, competently and impartially.
Special Rapporteurs worden geacht onafhankelijk, competent en onpartijdig te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het gratieverzoek van een Nederlands staatsburger gedetineerd in een Amerikaanse gevangenis

The MP asks whether the government has supported a clemency request on humanitarian grounds for a Dutch national detained in a US prison, whether that request has been filed, and whether the Prime Minister discussed it with the Californian governor. The government answers that it has repeatedly expressed Dutch support for both the parole and clemency requests, including via the ambassador and a Prime Minister letter, and declines to speculate on the timing of the US decision.
I do not want to speculate on the answer to the question of when the American authorities will decide on the requests of Mr. S.
Ik wil niet speculeren over het antwoord op de vraag wanneer de Amerikaanse autoriteiten gaan beslissen op de verzoeken van de heer S.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over tegenwerken door Israël van de Speciale VN-gezant voor mensenrechten in de bezette Palestijnse gebieden

MP Servaes asked whether the UN Special Rapporteur Wibisono's resignation over Israel blocking access to the Palestinian territories is accurate, and whether the government will press Israel on access and on the UN criticism of his mandate. The minister confirmed the resignation and reason, said the Netherlands and the EU repeatedly call on Israel to grant access, and gave a general answer on concern for Palestinian victims and on the next rapporteur, without committing to a new bilateral or Council action.
The Netherlands attaches great importance to free access for Special Rapporteurs.
Nederland hecht grote waarde aan vrije toegang voor Speciaal Rapporteurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over ‘fiscaal onderdak Rostec’

An MP asked the government whether Rostec's arms-exporting subsidiary Rosoboronexport, linked to the BUK missile, should be denied tax residence in the Netherlands, and about the EU sanctions on Rostec's director Chemezov. The government answered that the sanctions and the 2014 listing were in place, that tax confidentiality prevents detail on a single company, and that the Netherlands cannot refuse a company's seat based on its activities.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot provide further information about individual taxpayers (legal persons).

Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet geen verdere informatie verstrekken over individueel belastingplichtige (rechts)personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een vermiste imam uit Venlo

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Moroccan imam from Venlo reported missing since September 2015 while on pilgrimage to Mecca, including whether Saudi Arabia arrested him, whether there are suspicions against him, and whether the minister will seek clarification from Saudi and Moroccan counterparts. The minister replied that the cabinet lacks further information, that Morocco as the imam's sole nationality state is responsible for consular assistance and inquiries, and that the matter was brought to the Moroccan embassy's attention, without committing to direct inquiries.
It is up to the imam's national state to provide consular or other assistance and to make inquiries about the alleged disappearance.
Het is aan de nationale staat van betrokkene om consulaire of andere vormen van bijstand te verlenen en navraag te doen over de vermeende vermissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de opmerkingen van het OM over de vervolging van Julio Poch in Argentinië

MPs Sjoerdsma asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about remarks attributed to the Public Prosecution Service on the Argentine prosecution of Julio Poch, whether a fair trial was assured, and whether an independent trial observer would be sent. The minister replied that the quoted remark came from an anonymous source not identified as the Dutch prosecutor, that the Dutch state's cooperation was judged lawful by a civil court, and that the state does not interfere in foreign proceedings beyond routine consular assistance.
The Dutch State cooperated in the arrest of Mr Poch in Spain by providing information about his travel movements.
De Nederlandse Staat heeft meegewerkt aan de aanhouding van de heer Poch in Spanje door informatie te verschaffen over zijn reisbewegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de bijstand die verleend wordt aan Romano van der Dussen, die op 11 februari 2016 is vrijgelaten

Two CDA MPs asked how Romano van der Dussen, released from a Spanish prison in February 2016 after 12 years, will receive reintegration help, legal assistance, and progress on his case. The government replied that consular assistance, coordination with Spanish authorities and Dutch reclassering/municipal support are available, that further legal procedures are his own responsibility, and referred to earlier letters for the case history.
See my letter to your House of 17 February 2016 (TK 30 010, no. 26).
Zie mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 17 februari 2016 (TK 30 010, nr. 26 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over plannen om het referendum te verstoren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers about reports of plans to disrupt the Dutch referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement through intimidation and other pressure, and whether these threats are serious. Minister Plasterk answered that reports are investigated by relevant bodies and security measures taken where risk warrants, noting Ukrainian authorities say the documents are forged and referring to a separate answer on militia threats.
Reports of possible attempts to disrupt the referendum are investigated by the relevant authorities where necessary.
Meldingen van mogelijke pogingen om het referendum te verstoren, worden waar nodig onderzocht door de relevante instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Turkse staatscensuur

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government knows of the Turkish state takeover of a critical newspaper, shares concern over intensifying censorship, and whether it will press Turkey on press freedom and oppose its EU membership. The minister confirmed the reports and concern, said the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally and in the EU, and opposed the view that Turkey should never join the EU, preferring accession talks as the framework for reform.
The Netherlands therefore continues to proactively raise press freedom with Turkey, bilaterally and within the EU.
Nederland blijft Turkije daarom proactief aanspreken op persvrijheid, bilateraal en in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk en 18 andere lidstaten oproepen tot doelstellingen om Europese regels te verminderen

An MP asked whether the Netherlands regrets not co-signing a 19-member-state call for EU regulatory-reduction targets and how it has implemented the motion on measurable better-regulation goals. The minister says the Netherlands supports the targets but did not co-sign for reasons of the upcoming EU presidency, and lists its prior efforts and plans to push the topic during the presidency.
During the presidency, the Netherlands will explicitly give attention to quantifying results and introducing reduction targets.
Nederland zal tijdens het voorzitterschap nadrukkelijk aandacht geven aan het onderwerp kwantificering van resultaten en invoering van reductiedoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het vermeende Oekraïense filmpje dat op internet is geplaatst

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked whether the government is aware of reports that a threatening Ukrainian video against the Netherlands was a forgery, and whether it would promptly investigate the video's origin and share the results with parliament. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion disavow the threats, and said the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, without committing to an investigation or disclosure.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over financiering van veroordeelde terroristen door de Palestijnse Autoriteiten

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Palestinian Authority funds convicted terrorists with foreign aid should change Dutch donor policy and how the government implements earlier motions calling for pressure on the PLO to stop such payments. The minister replied that the Israeli deputy minister's claims are her own, that the World Bank made no such finding, and that the government keeps raising the PLO's payment policy bilaterally and in the EU, where only one member state shares the concern.
The cabinet continues to raise the PLO's policy in bilateral talks with the PA and the PLO.
Het kabinet blijft het beleid van de PLO aankaarten in bilaterale gesprekken met de PA en de PLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht “Europese Commissie voorspelt economische groei voor Oekraïne op basis van gedateerd onderzoek”

An SP MP asked the ministers whether outdated economic studies (Ecorys, German advisory group) still justify the EU-Ukraine association agreement given the conflict since 2013, and about its effects on prices and Ukrainian firms. The government replied that the CGE-based studies remain relevant, a new analysis is informative but not necessary, and the agreement is a sovereign Ukrainian choice with a ten-year phase-in and SME support.
In that sense, the cabinet considers a new analysis informative but not necessary for its assessment of the effects of the association agreement.
In die zin acht het kabinet een nieuwe analyse informatief, maar niet noodzakelijk voor het oordeel over de effecten van het associatieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het opheffen van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

Servaes (PvdA) asks why the EU lifted sanctions on 170 individuals and 3 companies in Belarus despite concerns about the 2015 elections and human rights, and whether unanimity was needed and what the Dutch position was. Minister Koenders answers that only part of the sanctions was lifted, that Nederland argued for maintaining pressure, that human rights concerns remain, and that renewed sanctions would require unanimity, without committing to specific future steps.
During the discussions the Netherlands argued against full suspension and pointed to the importance of maintaining sufficient pressure on Belarus.
Nederland heeft tijdens de discussies gepleit tegen volledige opschorting en gewezen op het belang van het houden van voldoende druk op Wit-Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Franse dreiging om de content van een Nederlandse website te censureren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether France's threat to block content of the Dutch website TPO.nl, and possible censorship, is compatible with freedom of expression and how the Netherlands would respond. The Minister answered that such requests are specific, that member states implement EU counter-radicalisation commitments under their own law, that the Netherlands uses notice-and-take-action procedures and stresses rule-of-law limits, and that the Turkish YouTube case differs because the French request is targeted and providers can go to French courts.
The specific request referred to in the TPO article came from the French authorities.
Het specifieke verzoek waaraan wordt gerefereerd in het TPO-artikel is uitgegaan van de Franse autoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over bericht Turkse journalisten bedreigd met levenslang vanwege 'Adana-gate'

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish prosecutors seeking life sentences against journalists Can Dündar and Erdem Gül over reports on alleged arms transports to Syria, including press freedom, prison access, EU action and the case for an international inquiry. Minister Koenders answered that the Netherlands raises press freedom with Turkey, views the charges as very serious, and sees no need for an independent international investigation, while leaving judicial matters to the courts.
The cabinet sees no need for an independent international investigation.
Het kabinet ziet geen noodzaak voor een onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Turkse luchtaanvallen op Koerdische doelen in Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish air strikes on Kurdish targets in Syria, whether he shares the US and French call for them to stop, and whether he will urge Turkey directly. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said the US-Russia ceasefire took effect on 27 February and the government wants it maintained, and stressed that all parties including Turkey must uphold it.
In this regard the cabinet stresses that all parties involved, including Turkey, must take their responsibility to keep this ceasefire in place.
Het kabinet onderstreept in dit verband dat alle betrokken partijen, inclusief Turkije, hun verantwoordelijkheid dienen te nemen om deze wapenstilstand stand te laten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Rusland de Nederlandse politiek financieel beïnvloedt

MPs Verhoeven and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russia has tried to influence Dutch politics, financially or otherwise, including the upcoming referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, and whether the Netherlands would follow up on a reported US investigation. Minister Koenders answered that the AIVD reports Russian influence efforts in general but the government has no indications of improper Russian influence on the referendum or of clandestine funding of Dutch parties, declined to comment on possible intelligence investigations, and saw no reason to ask US authorities.
No public statements can be made about any possible investigations by the Dutch intelligence services.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen gedaan worden over eventuele onderzoeken van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het lot van gewonde Koerden in de Turkse stad Cizre

MP Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister about the fate of Kurdish civilians trapped in a cellar in Cizre, how many remain alive, what has been done to rescue them, and whether the EU and the Netherlands pressed Turkey for aid. The minister answered that the government urges all parties to lay down arms and resume the peace process, and that Turkey may act against terrorism within proportionality and human rights, but gave no specifics on rescue or numbers.
According to Turkish authorities, those involved are PKK fighters. According to HDP, they are injured civilians, including children.
Volgens Turkse autoriteiten betreft het PKK-strijders. Volgens HDP betreft het gewonde burgers, waaronder kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de verslechtering van de situatie in Venezuela

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about Venezuela's economic emergency decree, Maduro's plan to rule by decree, the removal of parliament's control over the central bank and doubts about the Supreme Court's independence. Minister Ploumen answered that the decree curbs parliament's economic role and strengthens state control, that the Supreme Court is largely under government influence, and that the government keeps a constant dialogue with Venezuela's government and opposition, without announcing new concrete steps.
The government's decree reduces the chance of dialogue between government and parliament and the chances of constructive cooperation in tackling the severe economic crisis Venezuela is in.

Het decreet van de regering vermindert de kans op dialoog tussen regering en parlement en de kansen op constructieve samenwerking in de aanpak van de zware economische crisis waarin Venezuela zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over het bericht ‘€ 5 miljard van Nederland in Oekraïne geïnvesteerd? Bijna de helft is van deze oligarch’

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a report that nearly half of a reported 5 billion euros in Dutch investment in Ukraine belongs to one oligarch, and whether Ukrainian oligarchs avoid tax via Dutch shell companies. The government answered that DNB data show 9.8 billion euros invested in 2014, that tax confidentiality prevents breakdown by individual taxpayers, that anti-abuse measures are being pursued internationally and in a treaty negotiation, and that the trade benefits Dutch firms though job effects cannot be precisely quantified.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents further breakdown based on Tax Authority data on individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen verhindert verdere uitsplitsing op basis van gegevens van de Belastingdienst over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de illegale annexatie van Palestijns land door de Israëlische regering

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Israel's reported annexation of about 154 hectares of Palestinian land, whether it is illegal, what steps the government will take, and about efforts to restart peace talks and recognition of a Palestinian state. The minister condemns the designation of 234 hectares near Jericho as state land as unlawful appropriation contrary to international law, describes EU and Dutch diplomatic efforts to revive talks, and says recognition of Palestine will be used at a strategic moment and is a national decision.
The cabinet regrets this decision, which constitutes an unlawful appropriation in violation of international law.
Het kabinet betreurt dit besluit, dat een onrechtmatige toe-eigening vormt in strijd met internationaal recht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over gebrekkige arbeidsomstandigheden in Qatar bij de voorbereidingen op het WK voetbal van 2022

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the foreign and trade ministers about poor labour conditions for migrant workers in Qatar ahead of the 2022 World Cup, including Amnesty's report of stalled reforms, the concrete steps taken on the Parliament's June motion, and FIFA's transparency. The ministers answered that Qatar has taken some positive steps but reforms are incomplete, that the Netherlands is pressing Qatar bilaterally, in the EU and through the ILO (including a high-level ILO mission), and that FIFA integrity questions await ongoing investigations.
Various (criminal) investigations into the awarding of these World Cups are currently underway. The cabinet is awaiting the outcomes of these investigations before taking a position.

Momenteel worden er diverse (strafrechtelijke) onderzoeken verricht naar de toewijzing van deze Wereldkampioenschappen. Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken af alvorens een standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Servaes over een nieuw vredesinitiatief en mogelijke erkenning van de Palestijnse staat door Frankrijk

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about France's plan for an international peace conference and possible recognition of a Palestinian state, and about Israeli settlement expansion. The minister says the Netherlands will weigh recognition at a strategic moment in consultation with EU partners, supports the French initiative in principle, and condemns settlement expansion as contrary to international law while reaffirming support for a two-state solution.
The cabinet wants to deploy recognition at a strategic moment when it is effective, real and opportune in the peace process.
Het kabinet wil erkenning inzetten op een strategisch moment als het effectief, reëel en opportuun is in het vredesproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vernielingen door Israël in Palestijns Gebied

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli demolitions of over twenty buildings in Palestinian territory, including EU-funded structures, leaving more than 100 people homeless, and whether the government would protest and press the EU for tougher measures. The minister confirmed the facts, said the demolitions appear not to meet the military-necessity exception under occupation law, and stated the EU has expressed concern and urged transformative steps by Israel, without announcing a concrete new protest or measure.
Based on the available information, these demolitions do not appear to fall under this exception.
Op basis van de beschikbare informatie lijken deze vernielingen niet onder deze uitzondering te vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over “de puinhoop bij het toekennen van subsidies voor het referendum op 6 april 2016”

CDA MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked why only three subsidy applications for the 6 April 2016 advisory referendum had been granted despite a three-week decision deadline, and sought data on delays, form errors, costs and fairness. Minister Plasterk answered that 73 applications had been granted, that the independent Referendum Commission is responsible for the subsidy scheme and will evaluate it after the summer recess, and that he has full confidence in its decision-making.
The Referendum Act chose to entrust this task to an independent Referendum Commission.
In de Wet raadgevend referendum is er voor gekozen deze taak in handen te geven aan een onafhankelijke Referendumcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over een Nederlandse voormalig coffeeshopeigenaar die is veroordeeld in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a former Dutch coffeeshop owner sentenced in Thailand to 103 years (effectively 20), including whether Dutch authorities initiated the prosecution and whether the Dutch tolerance policy was explained to Thai authorities. The minister declined to judge the foreign ruling, said the Thai authorities were informed of Dutch tolerance policy, refused to share the liaison officer's letter citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and gave a partial account of embassy contacts.
Can you send this letter to the House? Answer 8: The investigation referred to is part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Kunt u deze brief aan de Kamer zenden? Antwoord 8 Het onderzoek waarnaar wordt verwezen is onderdeel van een nog lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over consulaten die geen registratieformulieren voor het referendum hebben ontvangen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether consulates abroad failed to receive pre-printed registration forms for the 2016 advisory referendum, whether this frustrated expatriate voters, and whether all consulates would be sent forms. The minister answered that one case was known, that posts were told to point voters to the Den Haag website and print forms on request, and that registration procedures match those for regular elections.
All embassies and consulates-general have since been reminded of this once more.
Inmiddels zijn alle ambassades en consulaten-generaal hier nogmaals op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over studenten die zijn opgepakt in West-Sahara

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch student and nine Norwegian students detained and escorted out of Western Sahara by Moroccan police, including the reasons, legal basis, whether a record was made, and whether the Dutch embassy was informed and provided consular help. The minister confirmed the events, said Morocco cited an unauthorised 'political visit', that no record was drawn up and no prosecution started, and that the embassy checked with the Norwegian embassy and found no need for further consular assistance, with the case to be raised in EU human rights dialogue.
If not, why not? Answer 11: This case will be taken up in the Dutch efforts to promote human rights in Morocco and Western Sahara.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 11 Deze zaak zal worden meegenomen bij de Nederlandse inzet bij de bevordering van de mensenrechten in Marokko en de Westelijke Sahara.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een subsidie aan hulporganisatie B’Tselem die Palestijnse doodseskaders faciliteert

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Dutch government funds B'Tselem, which they say informs on Palestinians selling land to Jews, leading to torture and death, and whether that funding will be stopped and recovered. The Minister says the government is aware of the reports, that the Palestinian law carries prison or forced labour rather than death, that the Israeli investigation found no link to injury or death, and that Netherlands jointly funds B'Tselem (USD 710,000 for 2014–2016) as a legitimate human rights voice, so no halt or recovery is planned.
Organisations like B'Tselem represent a legitimate voice in Israeli society and strengthen the democratic character of Israel.
Organisaties als B’tselem vertegenwoordigen een legitieme stem in de Israëlische samenleving en versterken het democratische karakter van Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het referendum over het associatieverdrag Oekraïne

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked whether the government would suspend implementation of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement pending the April 2016 advisory referendum, and whether it would respect a no vote. Minister Koenders answered that provisional application continues because the referendum is part of national ratification, that the government will follow the Referendum Act, and that a negative outcome would lead to a further decision in consultation with parliament.
In the event of an irrevocable advisory rejection, the cabinet will submit to the House, under the Referendum Act, a bill to withdraw or to bring into force the approval act.

Bij een onherroepelijke raadgevende uitspraak tot afwijzing zal het kabinet op grond van de Wet raadgevend referendum een wetsvoorstel tot intrekking dan wel tot inwerkingtreding van de goedkeuringswet bij de Kamer aanhangig maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het zikavirus

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about Zika virus information for pregnant women, travel advice consistency with Belgium, and implementation of a motion on a medical rapid-response unit. The minister answered that information is provided via RIVM, LCR and foreign affairs channels, that the Netherlands follows WHO advice without a negative travel advice, and that Dutch contributions to the EU medical corps and WHO reform are underway.
The RIVM follows the WHO advice unless conditions in the Netherlands are so different that they justify different advice.
Het RIVM volgt de advisering van de WHO tenzij de omstandigheden in Nederland zo anders zijn dat dit een andere advisering rechtvaardigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de penibele situatie van gestrande migranten bij de Griekse grensplaats Idomeni

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about stranded migrants at Idomeni on the Greek-Macedonian border, including lack of shelter, whether a closed Greek camp could be reopened, and EU hotspot implementation. The government answered that it monitors the fluid situation, the camp has reopened, Dutch humanitarian funding has been provided, and it is working on hotspots and coordination within the EU.
The cabinet is attentive to the situation in Idomeni, which is very fluid, and follows developments closely.
Het kabinet heeft aandacht voor de situatie in Idomeni, die zeer fluïde is, en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ‘Toenemende twijfels over neerhalen Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije’

MP Knops (CDA) asked the government whether it still believes Turkey's account of shooting down a Russian Su-24, given analyses of radar data suggesting the jet did not clearly enter Turkish airspace, and whether the Netherlands has independent intelligence. The government replied that the exact circumstances cannot be verified from the released radar images alone, that it relies on the consistent assessments of several allies and NATO's Secretary General, does not comment publicly on intelligence sources, and sees no reason for an international investigation.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the information position or sources of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de informatiepositie of bronnen van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over export van militair materieel aan Saoedi-Arabië

SP MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Dutch arms export licences to Saudi Arabia breach EU and international law given the Yemen war and blockade, and whether Nederland will restrict such exports. The ministers acknowledge likely violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition, report four licences since March 2015 worth 2.8 million euro, and say they reject most military-related requests and will grant further licences only where no use in Yemen or rights abuses is conceivable.
Only when it is indisputably established that goods cannot be used in the fighting in Yemen or for human rights violations will a licence still be issued.
Alleen wanneer onomstotelijk vaststaat dat goederen niet kunnen worden ingezet in de strijd in Jemen of bij mensenrechtenschendingen zal nog een vergunning worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over Russische bombardementen op Turkmeense minderheden in Syrië

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkmen in Syria fled after Russian bombings, and about condemnation, EU/NATO/UN action, aid, casualty figures, and the Geneva talks. The minister answered that the government has repeatedly condemned Russian attacks on the moderate opposition, supports UN resolution 2254, provides humanitarian aid regardless of ethnicity, and cannot independently verify casualty figures, while withholding details on supported groups for security reasons.
For security reasons, the specific fate of the groups supported by the Netherlands cannot be addressed.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan niet worden ingegaan op de specifieke lotgevallen van de groeperingen die door Nederland worden gesteund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief van commissievoorzitter Juncker aan de Turkse regering met beloftes over de toetredingsonderhandelingen van Turkije tot de EU

Omtzigt asked the government about a letter from Commission President Juncker to Turkey promising progress on EU accession talks, including whether the Commission committed to finishing preparatory work for chapters 15, 26, 23 and 24 by 1 April, and about Turkey's human rights and Copenhagen criteria. The minister answered that the Commission's commitment only concerns completing preparatory documents, that the Netherlands supports treating rule-of-law chapters 23 and 24 with Cypriot blockade in place, and referred back to earlier letters for the rest.
The content was first communicated to your House in the report of the EU-Turkey Summit of 29 November, sent to your House on 2 December.
Over de inhoud ervan is uw Kamer voor het eerst geïnformeerd in het verslag van de EU Turkije Top van 29 november, dat uw Kamer op 2 december is toegegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de situatie in de Turkse stad Cizre en de strafeis tegen twee journalisten

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of wounded civilians in Cizre denied medical care, urging condemnation under international humanitarian law, and about the life sentences sought against two Cumhuriyet journalists under terrorism laws. The minister expressed concern, called on parties to resume peace talks and stressed proportionality and human rights, said the Netherlands and EU raise these issues regularly, and stated that the court must decide while press freedom must improve.
I find these reports and the situation in southeast Turkey very worrying.
Ik vind deze berichten en de situatie in het zuidoosten van Turkije zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de eis van de Turkse justitie van levenslange gevangenisstraf voor twee journalisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Turkish prosecution's demand for life imprisonment for two journalists, the charges against them, and the wider trend of journalist arrests in Turkey. The minister said Nigeria... no: the minister said the court must decide, called the demand exceptionally harsh, stressed that press freedom must improve in Turkey, and said the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, while giving only a rough count of about seventeen jailed journalists.
The Netherlands and the EU attach importance to freedom of expression and press freedom in Turkey.
Nederland en de EU hechten aan vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over over leveranties van gifgas aan jihadisten in Syrië via Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey facilitated sarin precursor supplies to jihadists in Syria, the related Turkish prosecution case, and whether the government would investigate or seek clarification from Turkey. The minister replied that the government has no independent information to judge these claims, notes the case details and the status of parliamentary immunity proceedings, and sees no reason to reopen the Ghouta investigation or support an international inquiry.
The cabinet has no information that would allow it to form an independent judgement on these claims.
Het kabinet heeft geen informatie een eigenstandig oordeel te vellen over deze beweringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Knops en De Roon over de ranglijst christenvervolging van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and PVV asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2016 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising killings, Dutch policy response, a proposed UN inquiry and ISIS treatment of minorities. The minister said the government shares serious concern, cites funding for religious freedom projects and EU/UN engagement, but opposes a UN inquiry focused on one group in favour of an inclusive approach.
The cabinet is however not in favour of a UN inquiry focused on one specific group.
Het kabinet is echter geen voorstander van een VN-onderzoek gericht op één specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de ‘verdwenen’ radarbeelden van MH17

MP Ten Broeke asked whether the government took action through ICAO to obtain the allegedly missing MH17 radar images, whether ICAO received legal assistance requests, how ICAO's dispute procedure works, and whether the Safety Board and JIT need the images. Minister Van der Steur answered that the government pressed for cooperation bilaterally, that the prosecutor and Safety Board currently have sufficient information, that no ICAO request was made, and that JIT legal assistance requests were sent to states holding the images without disclosing details.
Evidence gathering and the legal assistance requests aimed at it are by their nature confidential.
Bewijsgaring en daarop gerichte rechtshulpverzoeken zijn naar hun aard vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het verwijderen van een reclamespotje door de Poolse overheid vanwege de aanwezigheid van een homoseksuele acteur

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Polish government decision to pull an environmental commercial featuring a gay actor reflects anti-LGBT bias, and what the government will do about it. The minister says the Netherlands opposes any role for sexual orientation, that the Polish minister attributed the removal to costs rather than sexuality, and that Dutch officials raised the matter directly and follow the situation, though the EU has no specific competence in individual member states.
The Netherlands is of the view that the sexual orientation of actors should play no role in such decisions.
Nederland is van mening dat de seksuele oriëntatie van acteurs bij dergelijke beslissingen geen rol mag spelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht 'Don't mention the Brexit: EU bans Plan B Studie'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether EU economists were banned from studying the economic consequences of a Brexit and whether the Commission's research agenda is independent. The minister said the cabinet knows nothing of such a ban, that impact assessments are publicly available, and that the cabinet sees no reason to challenge the Commission on this.
The cabinet is not aware of this.
Het kabinet is hiervan niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven en Voordewind over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt, Verhoeven and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the provisional application of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, including which articles apply, whether unanimity and parliamentary consent were needed, and what happens if the Netherlands rejects it in the referendum. The minister answered that about 355 articles (roughly 70%) are provisionally applied under EU competence, that the Council decisions were adopted by unanimity with Dutch consent, and that the Netherlands will follow the referendum law without prejudging the outcome.
The cabinet does not have continuous insight into the timing and manner in which the national parliaments of the 27 member states are informed of the decision on provisional application.
Het kabinet heeft niet voortdurend zicht op het tijdstip en wijze van informeren van de nationale parlementen in 27 lidstaten over het besluit tot voorlopige toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over commerciële handel in weefsel van geaborteerde kinderen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Health whether Planned Parenthood clinics engaged in commercial trade in foetal tissue and altered abortion methods, and what diplomatic or subsidy measures the government would take regarding IPPF funding. The minister answered that no commercial trade occurs under US law, that Dutch law forbids compensation for foetal tissue, that IPPF receives about 2.5 million euro annually for youth sexual and reproductive health, and that withdrawing subsidies is neither warranted nor desired.
There is no question of commercial trade or of a profit motive.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële handel of van een winstoogmerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het optreden van Nederlandse special forces in Afrika

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk asked about Dutch special forces training African militaries in counter-terrorism, the participation in Flintlock exercises since 2007, and a secret marine taskforce against piracy off Somalia that was not reported to parliament. The government answered that training takes place in secured military areas with negligible risk, lists Flintlock deployments year by year, and states that anti-piracy operations were reported via the article 100 procedure without naming this taskforce.
The name of the taskforce in question was not mentioned at the time.
De naam van onderhavige taskforce is destijds niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over propaganda tegen mensenrechtenverdedigers in Israël

The MP Grashoff asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli nationalist group's video portraying Israeli human rights defenders, funded partly by the Netherlands, as foreign agents, and whether the government had responded or would press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the accusations threaten rights and defenders' safety, that the EU and the Netherlands have raised concerns with Israeli authorities, and that Likud MP Kisch distanced himself from the video.
The Netherlands will continue to convey this message to the Israeli authorities.
Nederland blijft deze boodschap uitdragen richting de Israëlische autoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat de OVV onderzoekers geen primaire radargegevens ontvangen hebben voor het onderzoek naar de MH17 van de Rusland, van Oekraïne of van andere landen, terwijl ze daar

An MP asked the ministers why the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) did not receive primary radar data on the MH17 downing from Russia, Ukraine or other countries despite requesting it and despite ICAO obligations to retain such data. The government answered that the OVV had sufficient information for its conclusions, that Russia stated no radar data was stored, that Ukraine's radars were not operational, and that the OVV's investigation was independent, with the government having no role in obtaining the data.

In view of this, the Netherlands will work within the EU and ICAO to remove this ambiguity by advocating a retention obligation that always applies when radar data may be relevant to aviation accident investigations.

Met oog hierop zal Nederland zich in EU-verband binnen ICAO inzetten om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen door een bewaarplicht te bepleiten die altijd aan de orde is als radargegevens relevant kunnen zijn voor onderzoek naar luchtvaartongevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visumvrij reizen voor staatsburgers Oekraïne

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether visa-free travel for Ukrainian and Georgian citizens is planned for mid-2016, whether the Commission recommended approval, and how the Association Agreement's visa provisions relate to the referendum and EU competence. The minister replied that both countries have a perspective on visa liberalisation, that the Commission found all conditions met and will propose list changes in 2016 subject to Parliament and Council decision, and that provisional application of Article 19 does not require suspension and does not remove the need for a separate EU decision.
Once that proposal has been received, your House will be informed in accordance with the usual procedure and within the applicable deadlines.
Zodra dat voorstel is ontvangen, zal uw Kamer hier volgens de gebruikelijke procedure en binnen de geldende termijnen over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het executeren van 47 mensen door Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's execution of 47 people, including Shia cleric Nimr al-Nimr, and related UN, regional escalation and counterterrorism-law questions. The government condemned the executions, said it pressed for an EU statement and would keep raising the death penalty in the UN Human Rights Council, but gave limited detail on the evidence and on specific protests.
The evidence in the al-Nimr case has not been made public.
De bewijzen in de zaak van al-Nimr zijn niet publiek gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitlatingen van de Nederlandse Vertegenwoordiger bij het Politiek en Veiligheidscomité van de EU, over het immigratiebeleid de "Merkel-way"

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch representative's remarks praising Merkel's migration policy as an opportunity, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answered by referring to existing government positions on migration and EU asylum packages, without explicitly disavowing the remarks, and said the Netherlands would act as an honest broker during its EU presidency.
Are you willing to distance yourself from the remarks of the representative concerned?
Bent u bereid afstand te nemen van de uitlatingen van de betreffende Vertegenwoordiger
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over executies in Saudi-Arabië

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the mass execution of 47 people in Saudi Arabia, including whether the trials were fair and independently observed, and what the government had done bilaterally and through the EU to voice concern. The minister answered that the trials followed local law but independent verification is impossible, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns bilaterally, backed an EU High Representative statement, and will send the human rights ambassador to Riyadh.
However, this is impossible to establish independently, because, as far as is known, no evidence has ever been made public in these cases.
Dit is echter onmogelijk onafhankelijk vast te stellen, omdat er, voor zover bekend, in deze zaken nooit bewijzen openbaar zijn gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Russische luchtaanval op een Syrische markt

MP Sjoerdsma asked the government about a reported Russian airstrike on a Syrian market in Idlib, including civilian deaths, alleged cluster munitions, and whether Russia should join the Cluster Munitions Convention. Minister Koenders answered that the government cannot confirm the casualty figures or cluster munition use, supports universalisation of the convention, and favours independent investigation but notes access inside Syria is blocked.
The cabinet has no information that can confirm this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die dit kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de lancering van een medium range ballistische raket door Iran

An MP asked whether Iran's 21 November 2015 ballistic missile launch breached UN Security Council resolution 1929 and what the government would do about it. The minister said the missile likely falls under MTCR Category 1, that the matter should be examined through UN mechanisms such as the Expert Panel, and that the UN Security Council is handling the earlier October launch, which the Expert Panel found to be a breach, with no consensus expected on new sanctions.
At this stage it is not obvious to raise this issue with Iran outside the multilateral framework.
Het ligt in dit stadium niet voor de hand om buiten het multilaterale kader dit vraagstuk bij Iran aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het neerhalen van een Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asks the government about Turkey's shootdown of a Russian Su-24, questioning Turkey's account (the 17-second claim, speed calculations, Rules of Engagement, warnings) and whether NATO should investigate. The ministers answer that the government has no independent information, sees no reason for its own investigation, considers Turkey's right to protect its airspace subject to necessity and proportionality, and backs NATO's call for de-escalation without taking a position on the legal merits.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make well-founded statements about the application of those requirements in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om gefundeerde uitspraken te kunnen doen over de toepassing van die vereisten in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het toezicht op Polen vanwege de mediawet

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU would strip Poland of voting rights over its media law, whether the Netherlands supports that, and what other pressure tools exist. The minister answered that no voting-rights sanction is on the table yet, that the Commission and Council of Europe have started a dialogue with Poland, and that the Netherlands will await a factual analysis before judging the law.
It is premature to draw definitive conclusions now about the nature, content and possible effects of the new Polish media law.
Het is prematuur nu reeds definitieve conclusies te trekken over de aard, inhoud en mogelijke effecten van de nieuwe Poolse mediawet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Nederland gooit deur dicht voor Amerikaanse delegatie’

MPs Knops and Verhoeven asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands would not host a US Congress–European Parliament Transatlantic Legislators' Dialogue meeting during its EU presidency, and whether this was due to cost or hassle. The minister replied that no formal request had been received, that he welcomes such contacts, that Brussels is the preferred venue for third-country meetings for cost and coherence reasons, and that relations with the US are good.
If the cabinet receives a formal request to host this meeting – which has not been the case so far – I will of course look at it seriously, in close consultation with your parliament.

Als het kabinet een formeel verzoek ontvangt om gastheer te zijn van deze ontmoeting – wat tot op heden niet het geval is – dan zal ik daar uiteraard serieus naar kijken, in nauw overleg met uw parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat Turkije tientallen Koerdische rebellen heeft gedood

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkish forces killed 54 Kurdish rebels, and about escalation, possible Dutch or EU mediation, and human rights. The minister confirmed awareness, shared the concern, and referred the substantive questions to a separate letter to parliament's European Affairs committee.
For these answers I refer further to the letter on the current situation in south-eastern Turkey
Ik verwijs verder voor deze antwoorden naar de brief over de actuele situatie in Zuidoost-Turkije
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Intolerantie in Somalië en Brunei

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the reported bans on Christmas celebrations for Muslims in Somalia and Brunei justify freezing Dutch ties, and whether Dutch military support in Somalia should end. Minister Koenders answered that Nederland keeps bilateral political and economic ties with both countries, raises human rights including freedom of religion and expression in dialogue, EU and UN fora, and will keep contributing to Somalia's reconstruction and EU training mission.
Within this relationship, human rights can be discussed in a constructive manner.
Binnen deze relatie kan op constructieve wijze over mensenrechten worden gesproken.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld in Zuidoost-Turkije (ingezonden 23 december 2015).

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of military destruction of neighbourhoods, civilian suffering, possible deaths of PKK fighters, proportionality of Turkish military action, calls for a ceasefire, and access for independent journalists and observers in southeast Turkey. The minister said he shares the concerns and referred to a separate letter to the European Affairs committee rather than answering each question.
I refer further for these answers to the letter on the current situation in southeast Turkey that was sent to the standing committee on European Affairs
Ik verwijs verder voor deze antwoorden naar de brief over de actuele situatie in Zuidoost-Turkije die is toegegaan aan de vaste commissie Europese Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en De Roon over resoluties bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister why 19 or 20 of the UN General Assembly resolutions in the 70th session target Israel, how the Netherlands voted, whether the Golan resolution language is fair, and how the UN could better address states that violate international law. The minister replied that the Netherlands pushed for balance and proportionate wording, supported 15 of 19 resolutions in EU coordination, saw many actors responsible for the Golan conflict, and pointed to resolutions on other states and the UN Human Rights Council review.
The Netherlands works in several ways to ensure that countries violating international law are called to account by the UN General Assembly.
Nederland zet zich er op verschillende manieren voor in dat landen die het internationaal recht schenden daarop worden aangesproken door de AVVN.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat de Russische president een wet heeft bekrachtigd om uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) niet te hoeven navolgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister how he views Russia's law letting its Constitutional Court declare ECHR judgments unenforceable, and what diplomatic steps are being taken. The minister called it very worrying, said Russia is bound to implement ECtHR judgments, and said Russia is being raised in the Council of Europe, while stating the Netherlands wants Russia to remain a member.
All member states of the Council of Europe are obliged to implement judgments of the European Court of Human Rights.
Alle lidstaten van de Raad van Europa zijn verplicht tot het ten uitvoer leggen van uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een nieuwe Russische wet waarmee het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens terzijde kan worden geschoven

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how to view a new Russian law letting the Constitutional Court declare ECtHR judgments unenforceable, and whether Russia might invoke it more often. The minister called it very worrying, said Russia is bound to enforce ECtHR rulings, raised the issue in Council of Europe bodies, but declined to predict the law's future use and did not commit to a state complaint.
The Russian Federation is being addressed on this new law within the Council of Europe framework, including by Secretary General Jagland and in the Committee of Ministers.
