De Russische Federatie wordt binnen de kaders van de Raad van Europa, onder meer door Secretaris-Generaal Jagland en binnen het Comité van Ministers, aangesproken op deze nieuwe wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vervolging van de Decembermoorden en het bloedbad van Moiwana in Suriname

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about prosecution of the December Murders and the Moiwana massacre in Suriname, including a Surinamese court ruling ordering resumed prosecution of Desi Bouterse and the Inter-American Court's call to prosecute the Moiwana perpetrators. The minister answered factually on the court ruling, the suspension history and the Inter-American Court judgment, and said the Netherlands will raise both cases in the next UPR and EU dialogue.
The Netherlands will also make recommendations at the upcoming UPR regarding prosecution in the December Murders trial and for the events in Moiwana.
Nederland zal ook bij de komende UPR aanbevelingen doen met het oog op een vervolging in het Decembermoordenproces en voor de gebeurtenissen in Moiwana.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzoek om OVSE/ODIHR-waarnemers te laten observeren bij het aanstaande referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would invite OSCE/ODIHR observers to the April 2016 advisory referendum on the EU-Ukraine association agreement, which is the first referendum under the Wrr and does not regulate observers. The minister replied that observers may attend with consent of the mayor and polling board chair, that the government will invite ODIHR, but that ODIHR decides independently whether and how to observe.
Although the Wrr does not require it, the cabinet will invite OSCE/ODIHR to send observers to the upcoming referendum so they can be present when the votes are cast.
Hoewel de Wrr daartoe niet verplicht, zal het kabinet OVSE/ODIHR uitnodigen bij het aankomende referendum waarnemers te zenden om aanwezig te kunnen zijn bij het uitbrengen van de stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Visumplicht Venezuela

Two MPs asked whether a visa requirement for Venezuelans, floated by Aruba's tourism minister, should be considered, and about risks to Bonaire. The minister confirmed the remarks, said visa requirements affect bilateral relations and reduce bona fide tourism, noted Aruba and Curaçao's stricter entry controls, and said a visa requirement is not currently warranted but would be decided jointly for all Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
Aruba and/or Curaçao cannot unilaterally decide to introduce the visa requirement.
Aruba en/of Curaçao kunnen niet eenzijdig beslissen tot het instellen van de visumplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat een man al dertien jaar ten onrechte vastzit in Guantánamo Bay

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that a man was wrongly held in Guantánamo Bay for thirteen years due to a name mix-up, the number of detainees never charged, whether the Netherlands would press the US to close the facility, which countries have taken detainees, and whether the Netherlands will accept some approved-for-transfer detainees. The minister said the details of the case are unknown to the cabinet, gave the detainee count and review process, reiterated that Guantánamo should close, and said no decision has been taken on the US request to accept 1-2 detainees, to be considered only after further meaningful US steps.
The details of this case are not known to the cabinet.
De details van deze zaak zijn niet bekend bij het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het opgelaaide geweld in Israël en de Palestijnse Gebieden

The MP Van Bommel asks the Minister of Foreign Affairs about Amnesty's findings of possibly extrajudicial killings by Israeli forces, proportionality of force, and attacks on medical personnel in the Palestinian territories. The minister says the Amnesty findings are serious, the government condemns attacks on civilians and expects proportionate Israeli responses, that Israeli authorities are investigating incidents, and that concerns about medical personnel will be raised in regular contacts with Israel.
The situation gives reason to keep following it critically and to raise the concerns on this point in regular contacts with Israel.
De situatie geeft aanleiding om deze kritisch te blijven volgen en de zorgen op dit punt in de reguliere contacten met Israël op te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de schrijnende situatie in Burundi

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about Burundi's suspension of ten civil society organisations, its prosecution of them, Dutch links to those groups, conditions for resuming aid, the recall of Burundian EALA members, US sanctions, and support for refugees in neighbouring countries. The government answered that it had raised its concern about the measures with Burundian ministers, that three of the ten organisations receive Dutch funding, that aid resumes only after conditions such as a peaceful climate and media independence are met, and that it added funds for refugee relief.
Naturally, the Netherlands also expects the Burundian government to give civil society sufficient room to function, without fear of persecution.
Uiteraard verwacht Nederland eveneens dat de Burundese regering het maatschappelijk middenveld voldoende ruimte geeft om te kunnen functioneren, zonder angst voor vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over het vervolgen van vrouwen voor vermeende abortus

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the 30-year sentence of Teodora del Carmen Vasquez in El Salvador for alleged abortion and whether women prosecuted after miscarriages should be protected. The minister agreed that women have bodily autonomy and access to care, and said the Netherlands will raise the issue in El Salvador's next Universal Periodic Review and in bilateral contacts.
Are you willing to raise the case of Ms Del Carmen Vasquez in international forums and convey your concerns to the El Salvadoran government?
Bent u bereid de zaak van mevrouw Del Carmen Vasquez in internationaal verband aan te kaarten en uw zorgen hieromtrent over te brengen aan de El Salvadoraanse regering?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het besluit van de Duitse Bondsdag om nieuwe richtsnoeren over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Jordaanoever, Oost-Jeruzalem en de

MPs Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the German Bundestag's reported rejection of EU labelling guidance for products from the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, and whether Griechenland and Hungary also refuse to implement it. The minister says the cabinet has no knowledge of a German decision, that the Netherlands stands by its signature on the earlier letter, and that member states are expected to implement the interpretive communication, with the implementation question left to the businesses and to the member states' own deliberation.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise its position, which is based on established policy.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om zijn standpunt, dat gebaseerd is op staand beleid, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief, die Europarlementarier Schaake (D66/ALDE) samen met 33 Europarlementariers aan eurocommissaris Timmermans geschreven heeft op 10 december 2015

Omtzigt asks whether the government will disclose the Juncker letter to Turkey's prime minister, all deal elements, and details of the refugee redistribution proposal before the EU summit debate. Minister Koenders replies that the government cannot share the Commission letter as it is an official Commission document, points to earlier letters for the deal's contents, and says the redistribution proposal will be shared with parliament in the usual way.
The cabinet is not authorised to give access to this letter between the European Commission and a third party.
Het kabinet is niet gemachtigd inzage te geven in deze brief tussen de Europese Commissie en een derde partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het nareisbeleid ten aanzien van Tibetanen

An MP asked the government about family reunification for Tibetans, including whether the permanent residence requirement, the Chinese passport problem, the lack of biometric capacity at the Nepal honorary consulate and UNHCR registration in India create special circumstances warranting exemptions. The government answered that the IND does not count how often the requirement is applied, that it accepts individual exemptions on humanitarian grounds and does not usually apply the requirement to family members of refugees, but it did not commit to a general exemption.
The IND does not record how often the permanent residence requirement is cited as a ground for refusal in MVV procedures.
De IND registreert niet hoe vaak het bestendigheidsvereiste als afwijzingsgrond wordt tegengeworpen bij MVV-procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de situatie in Moldavië

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the disappearance of about 1 billion euro in Moldova, the status of an investigation, the frozen EU budget support and the rule of law there. The minister replied that the Central Bank of Moldova's investigation is unpublished, EU budget support remains frozen pending a new IMF programme, and that Moldova bears primary responsibility for the investigation and reforms.
The European Commission has not launched its own investigation into the missing funds. The Moldovan authorities bear the primary responsibility for this.
De Europese Commissie heeft geen eigen onderzoek ingesteld naar de verdwenen fondsen. De Moldavische autoriteiten dragen hiervoor de primaire verantwoordelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een in Saudi-Arabië ter dood veroordeelde Palestijn (ingezonden 25 november 2015).

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the reported death sentence for blasphemy against Palestinian poet Ashraf Fayadh in Saudi Arabia and whether the Netherlands would press for his release. The minister said the government opposes the death penalty, is shocked by the report, is still verifying the facts, and will coordinate with EU partners on an effective response, while noting the poet can appeal.
The cabinet will closely follow developments and, in close consultation with other EU member states, will consider what the most effective response is to denounce this.
Het kabinet zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen, en zal in nauw overleg met andere EU-lidstaten bekijken wat de meest effectieve reactie is om dit aan de kaak te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van Koning Willem-Alexander aan China

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether the King's private holiday in China before the state visit, and his failure to voice human rights concerns personally, undermined the message on human rights in China. The minister replied that the King raised human rights in the banquet speech and at CELAP, that the government consistently prioritises human rights, and that a dialogue is maintained.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze opvatting niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops inzake nieuwe onthulling over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP from CDA asked the ministers whether they recognised a leaked German intelligence finding that Turkey supplied weapons to rebel groups in Syria, whether those groups are jihadist, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with Turkey and Germany or confirm it through AIVD/MIVD. The government answered that it is aware of reports of Turkish support to jihadist groups but that the situation is complex, that it has regular contacts with Turkey and Germany, and that AIVD and MIVD do not publicly comment on their findings.
No public statements are made about the subjects or the results of investigations by the AIVD and MIVD.
Over de onderwerpen of de resultaten van onderzoek door AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het aandacht vragen voor gendercide tijdens het staatsbezoek aan China

An SGP MP asked whether the government would raise gendercide (sex-selective killing of girls and abortion) during the state visit to China, and how. The minister replied that the issue was raised in human rights consultations, with the health state secretary and in the embassy, and that China says sex disclosure is legally banned and campaigns against gendercide.
Combating violence against girls and women, including unborn girls, is one of the Netherlands' policy priorities.
Het tegengaan van geweld tegen meisjes en vrouwen, met inbegrip van ongeboren meisjes, is één van de beleidsprioriteiten van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verkrijgen van panda’s uit China

An MP asked whether three former Prime Ministers wrote letters to China to obtain pandas, what those letters argued, and whether the cabinet accepts animals as diplomatic currency and taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the loan is part of a wider conservation project with Ouwehands Dierenpark funded by the zoo, declined to provide the letters as a commitment, and stated that no Dutch government money was invested.
Can the House be given access to all letters written by the cabinet regarding the supply of pandas?
Kan de Kamer inzage krijgen alle brieven die vanuit het kabinet inzake de levering van panda’s zijn geschreven?
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over kinderarbeid bij goudwinning voor de elektronicasector

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van Laar) asked the government about child labour in gold mining supplying the electronics sector, including responsibility of electronics firms, EU and OECD action, development programmes in Mali, and due diligence convenants. Minister Ploumen answered that the government will raise the issue with the Conflict Free Smelters Program, pursue a sector IMVO covenant for gold by summer 2016, seek EU Council conclusions during the Dutch presidency, and support child labour programmes in Mali.
In the process towards an IMVO covenant for the gold sector, the ministry is in close consultation with, among others, several companies from the electronics sector.
In het traject om te komen tot een IMVO-convenant voor de goudsector is het ministerie in nauw overleg met onder meer enkele bedrijven uit de elektronicasector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over EU-Turkije top

MP Omtzigt asked the government for the EU-Turkey deal text, a report of the summit, a list of commitments for each party, Turkish funding and Dutch contributions, resettlement and refugee-convention commitments, returns of migrants, budget implications and whether a parliamentary reservation was made. The minister answered that the action plan is provided via a letter, that Dutch funding (up to EUR 117 million extra, EUR 3 billion EU-wide) will be decided in the Spring Memorandum, and that no general parliamentary reservation was made, while leaving detailed modalities and resettlement commitments largely open.
No concrete agreements have been made on resettlement of refugees from Turkey.
Over hervestiging van vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije zijn geen concrete afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ontvoering van kinderen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that 25 Dutch children were abducted abroad over summer, and about the case of two children held in Egypt since 2003. The government said the figure came from a CIKO press release, explained the Hague Convention and diplomatic routes for return, and declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy law.
I cannot go into the substance of ongoing individual cases in the interest of those cases and under the Personal Data Protection Act.
Op de inhoud van lopende individuele zaken kan ik in het belang van deze zaken en in het kader van de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Volp en Servaes over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de United Nations General Assembly Special Session (UNGASS) on the World Drug Problem die in 2016 zal plaatsvinden

Four MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch policy for the 2016 UN drugs special session had changed, whether the Netherlands should back regulated cannabis cultivation, and how death penalty cases for drug offences would be handled. The government answered that the Dutch position has not changed, that it opposes regulated cannabis cultivation and mayors' calls for it, and that it works to end the death penalty for drug offences while noting three Dutch nationals face such sentences.
Regulation/legalisation of cannabis cultivation is not cabinet policy, so it is not appropriate for the Netherlands to take the leading role the questioners propose at the UNGASS.
Regulering/legalisering van de hennepteelt is geen kabinetsbeleid en het ligt daarom niet voor de hand bij de UNGASS een door de vragenstellers beoogde voortrekkersrol op dit vlak te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over gasdeals van Gasunie en Shell met Russisch staatsbedrijf Gazprom, alsmede over de politieke onafhankelijkheid van gasproductie in de Noordzee

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked whether the Gasunie and Shell/BASF gas deals with Gazprom comply with EU sanctions, public interest duties and efforts to reduce Russian energy dependence. The minister answered that the government is not party to private deals, sees no conflict with sanctions in principle, that Gasunie must still weigh public interest in concrete projects, and that no separate impact study is planned.
The cabinet does not consider this necessary.
Het kabinet acht dit niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Ten Broeke over de oproep van World Wide Relief-woordvoer Ouaali om Israëlische toeristen aan te vallen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about public calls by World Wide Relief spokesperson Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists, including whether the group is state-funded and what is being done against rising antisemitism. The government answered that the statements are condemned and under criminal investigation, that the group receives no Dutch state funding, that antisemitism incidents rose in 2014, and outlined existing police and anti-discrimination measures.
World Wide Relief receives no financial support from the Dutch government.
World Wide Relief ontvangt geen financiële ondersteuning van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over het optreden van de Turkse politie en het leger in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish military and police operations in southeastern Turkey, including civilian deaths, curfews and the Domestic Security Bill. The minister said the Netherlands lacks verified casualty figures, acknowledged concerns about proportionality and mobility restrictions, and said it raised the issue with Turkey and suggested an independent inquiry.
The Netherlands has brought the option of an independent investigation to the attention of the Turkish authorities.
Nederland heeft de optie van een onafhankelijk onderzoek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het claimen van de westmuur als onderdeel van de Al-Aqsa moskee door de Palestijnen

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about a draft UNESCO resolution by Arab states that would have called the Western Wall part of al-Aqsa mosque, and whether the Netherlands would oppose related requests and the status quo of the Temple Mount. The minister answered that the Western Wall clause was dropped after Dutch and other pressure, that the final resolution was one-sided and the Netherlands voted against it, and described Dutch de-escalation efforts.
Because of the one-sided nature of the resolution put to a vote, the cabinet concluded that it does not contribute to maintaining the status quo on the Haram al-Sharif / Temple Mount.

Vanwege het eenzijdige karakter van de resolutie die ter stemming werd voorgelegd, heeft het kabinet geconcludeerd dat deze niet bijdraagt aan de handhaving van de status quo op de Haram al-Sharif / Tempelberg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een aanslag op Kamp Hurriya in Irak

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the rocket attack on Camp Hurriya/Liberty in Iraq, including who claimed it, whether refugee status and UNHCR protection apply to residents, the Iraqi government's treatment of the camp, and alleged Iranian involvement. The minister answered that a pro-Iranian militia claimed the attack, the Iraqi government was called on to investigate and protect residents, UNHCR provides support, living conditions meet UN standards, and there is no evidence of Iranian involvement.
There are no indications pointing to Iranian involvement in the attack, or violence against the residents of Camp Hurriya/Camp Liberty.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen die duiden op Iraanse betrokkenheid bij de aanslag, of geweld tegen de inwoners van Kamp Hurriya/Camp Liberty.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht “Geen kabinetscampagne Oekraïne-referendum”

An MP asked whether the cabinet would run a campaign supporting the EU-Ukraine association agreement ahead of the advisory referendum, and whether the referendum commission's role includes campaigning. The minister answered that the commission only informs voters, and that the cabinet supports the agreement and will take part in the public debate without a separate campaign timetable.
As the advisory referendum act provides, it is the task of the referendum commission to provide voters with information about a law subject to a referendum.
Zoals de wet raadgevend referendum bepaalt, is het de taak van de referendumcommissie om informatie aan de kiezer te verstrekken over een aan een referendum onderworpen wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanslag op kamp Hurriya in Irak

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a rocket attack on Camp Liberty in Iraq, its perpetrators, the government's response, humanitarian conditions and resettlement of residents. The minister condemned the attack, said Iraq was urged to investigate, stated camp conditions meet UN standards, and declined to commit to new demands on Iraq or to admitting camp residents to the Netherlands beyond Dutch nationals.
Within the EU, the Iraqi government has been called upon to investigate the attack and to protect the camp's residents in accordance with the December 2011 agreement with the UN.
In EU-verband is de Iraakse overheid opgeroepen om een onderzoek uit te voeren naar de aanslag en de bewoners van het kamp te beschermen conform de overeenkomst met de VN van december 2011.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de invoering van grenscontroles tijdens de Klimaattop in Parijs

An MP asked whether France's temporary reintroduction of border controls during the Paris climate summit was meant to block demonstrators and whether the Netherlands would press France to protect peaceful protest. The government answered that France notified the Commission under Schengen Borders Code Article 23 for threats to public order and security, that the Netherlands did the same for a 2014 summit, and that it trusts France to respect the right to protest.
I trust that France will abide by its international legal obligations and will not restrict the right to peaceful protest.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Frankrijk zich aan zijn internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen zal houden en het recht op vreedzaam protest niet zal inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de in Suriname vermiste helikopter met een Nederlander aan boord

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked about the status of Dutch assistance in searching for a helicopter missing in Suriname with a Dutch national aboard, and what Dutch help was offered. The minister replied that Dutch search-and-rescue expertise was offered and used, but the Netherlands lacks the requested foliage-penetrating radar and will consider any future Surinamese request.
The Netherlands had to conclude that the request could not be met.
Nederland heeft moeten constateren dat niet aan het verzoek kon worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yucel over de sociale kloof in de EU

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Bertelsmann Stiftung report showing a widening social gap in the EU, its figures on unemployment and poverty, and the effectiveness of the EU Youth Guarantee for young people. The government answered that the figures match Eurostat and CBS data, that structural reforms and sharing of best practices are the priority, that it is too early to judge the Youth Guarantee's effectiveness, and that the Netherlands performs well on youth unemployment and poverty; it promised a further explanation during the budget debate.
As previously promised, you will receive the further elaboration of the plans before the SZW budget debate.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt u voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW de nadere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over een niet-aanvalspact tussen Europa en China op het gebied van cyber

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the Dutch cyber envoy is negotiating a digital non-aggression pact between Europe and China, and related questions on its purpose, mandate and participants. The government answered that no such negotiations took place; the envoy only joined an informal dialogue on cyber norms, and the government promised no further information on a pact.
There was no question of negotiations on a 'non-aggression treaty' during the meeting on 26 and 27 October.
Van onderhandelingen over een «niet-aanvalsverdrag» was geen sprake tijdens de bijeenkomst op 26 en 27 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het opschorten van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the EU suspended Belarus sanctions for four months, shortly after flawed presidential elections, and what human rights conditions apply. The minister answered that the partial suspension rewards released prisoners and Belarus's constructive stance on Ukraine, that the government remains critical on human rights, and that no formal criteria will be set in advance.
However, the Cabinet does not consider it useful to define in advance criteria that Belarus would have to meet for further easing or lifting of the sanctions regime.
Het Kabinet acht het echter niet nuttig om op voorhand criteria uit te werken waaraan Wit-Rusland zou moeten voldoen voor verdere verlichting of opheffing van het sanctieregime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Bommel over de plaatsing van nieuwe kernwapens in Duitsland

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about German nuclear-capable upgrades at Büchel, whether Dutch costs for Volkel were estimated, whether modernising B61 weapons conflicts with Global Zero and risks an arms race, and whether the Netherlands should drop modernisation now the JSF will not carry nuclear tasks. The government declined to speculate on Russian reactions, said NATO funds the WS-3 upgrades and gave no cost figures, rejected the view that modernisation conflicts with disarmament, and said it will keep the nuclear task debate open within NATO and not press for abandoning the B61 life-extension.
Under alliance agreements, no statements are made about the Netherlands' nuclear task.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken worden er geen mededelingen gedaan over de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over luchtaanval op het ziekenhuis van Artsen zonder Grenzen in Kunduz

An SP MP asked the ministers about the October 2015 airstrike on the Médecins Sans Frontières hospital in Kunduz, including the death toll, consequences for patients, whether coordinates were shared with parties, and whether an independent international investigation should be called for. The government expressed condolences, said it welcomed ongoing US, Afghan and NATO investigations, and saw no reason yet to call for an extra international inquiry.
The cabinet first wants to await the outcome of ongoing investigations and currently sees no reason to call for an additional international investigation.
Het kabinet wil eerst de uitkomst van lopende onderzoeken afwachten en ziet op dit moment geen reden om te pleiten voor een extra internationaal onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over tegenwerking van mensenrechtenorganisaties in Israël

MP Grashoff asked the Foreign Minister about coordinated right-wing campaigning that displaced human rights groups B'Tselem and Adalah in the Human Rights Tulip vote, Israeli bills and tax/registration rules targeting NGO funding, and EU responses. The minister answered most questions in substance, acknowledged the vote was influenced, declined to compensate the organisations, and said the government would raise concerns with Israel and ask for explanations.
The cabinet has so far not been approached by the Israeli Minister of Justice.
Het kabinet is tot op heden niet benaderd door de Israëlische Minister van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Klaveren over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit veroordeelde Hamas terroristen heeft betaald

MPs asked whether the Palestinian Authority pays convicted Hamas terrorists, the total amounts paid, and what the government will do to press the EU to stop the policy. The minister declined to confirm the reported amounts, referred to earlier answers, said Pegase payments do not fund prisoners, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally with the PA and PLO.
The cabinet cannot confirm the amounts mentioned in the news report.
Het kabinet kan de in het nieuwsbericht genoemde bedragen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht: “Eurozone crosses Rubicon as Portugal’s anti-euro Left banned from power”

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Portuguese president's handling of government formation after the 2015 election, including his remarks against an anti-euro Left coalition, and about the effects of Portugal's austerity programme. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects the president's choice following Portuguese custom, sees no reason to doubt constitutional procedures, and described the economic recovery and remaining reform needs.

The Netherlands respects President Cavaco Silva's decision to follow the Portuguese custom for appointing a formateur and has no reason to doubt that the Portuguese democratic and constitutional frameworks were not respected.

Nederland respecteert het besluit van president Cavaco Silva om de Portugese gewoonte voor de benoeming van een formateur te volgen en heeft geen reden om er aan te twijfelen dat de Portugese democratische en grondwettelijke kaders niet zijn gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat meer dan een half miljoen illegalen Europa zijn binnengekomen

Two MPs asked the government whether it was aware of reports that over 600,000 illegal migrants had entered Europe, what the ratio of legal to illegal migrants is, how many are heading to the Netherlands, and what measures will prevent this. The government answered that it is working on Europe-wide and national solutions, that no data exist on legal or illegal entries as such (Frontex counted 425,167 illegal border crossings from June 2014 to June 2015, often by the same people), and that where these migrants went cannot be established with certainty, referring to IND reports.
Where these foreigners went cannot be established with certainty.
Waar deze vreemdelingen naar toe zijn gegaan valt niet met zekerheid te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Klein en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Turkije actieplan migratie

MPs Voortman, Klein and Sjoerdsma asked about the sequencing, financing, Turkish commitments, Frontex data exchange, accession talks and migration law reform under the EU-Turkey migration action plan. The minister answered that the plan sets no sequence or fixed amounts, that Dutch funding awaits further talks, and that details will be worked out later with Turkey.
Neither the action plan nor the European Council conclusions contain target amounts or worked-out agreements on financing and spending.
Het actieplan noch de ER-conclusies bevatten streefbedragen of uitgewerkte afspraken over financiering en besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het verloop van de aankomende verkiezingen in Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares UN rapporteur Lee's concerns about restrictions on free expression and assembly, exclusion of voters and minorities, and police violence ahead of Myanmar's November 2015 elections, and whether he will raise human rights with Myanmar's authorities. The minister acknowledges shortcomings but says the elections are a significant step, that Dutch diplomacy has raised human rights concerns, that the EU observer mission is adequately equipped, and that a Dutch embassy will be opened.
The cabinet shares the concerns of Special Rapporteur Lee about the use of police force in ending the student protests this spring.
Het kabinet deelt de zorgen van Speciaal Rapporteur Lee over het gebruik van geweld door de politie bij het beëindigen van de studentenprotesten dit voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de vernietiging van kerken op Atjeh door de Indonesische politie onder druk van moslims

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the destruction of churches in Aceh under pressure from Muslim groups and the wider threat to religious freedom in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the incidents, said the Indonesian authorities condemned the violence and arrested suspects, and committed to raising the issue with his Indonesian counterpart.
This subject will be raised in my next meeting with the Indonesian Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Dit onderwerp zal in mijn eerstvolgend onderhoud met de Indonesische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de inval van de Turkse politie bij een mediaconcern in Turkije

An MP from the Labour party asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish police raid on a media group in Istanbul, including its press-freedom implications, its effect on democracy before elections, and the EU's options to press Turkey. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on recent developments in Turkey and the raid, without answering the questions on substance here.

The written questions from MP Maij (PvdA), question number 2015Z20077, have been answered by means of the letter 'Current developments in Turkey and raid by Turkish police on a media group' (Parliamentary paper 32 623, no. 156).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) vraagnummer 2015Z20077 , zijn beantword middels de brief «Huidige ontwikkelingen in Turkije en inval van Turkse politie bij een mediaconcern» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr. 156 )
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about Dutch arms exports to Egypt, Egyptian navy involvement in the Yemen blockade, humanitarian impacts, and whether licences should be maintained. The ministers answered that the Yemen humanitarian situation is grave, that Egyptian ships are enforcing the UN arms embargo, that reports of bombing could not be confirmed, and that they see no reason to change the Egypt licensing policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the policy regarding Egypt on this point.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om het beleid ten aanzien van Egypte op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het onderzoek van de Europese Ombudsman naar de transparantie van trilogen tussen Europees Parlement, Europese Raad en Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Ombudsman's inquiry into transparency of EU trilogues and the Council's position that the Ombudsman lacks competence. The minister replied that Netherlands agreed with the Council's response, stating the Ombudsman's powers are set by Article 228 TFEU, while saying transparency of trilogues can be improved and that the Netherlands is pushing for it.
For the Netherlands too, Article 228 of the TFEU and the Statute of the European Ombudsman are decisive for the Ombudsman's powers.
Ook voor Nederland geldt dat artikel 228 van het EU-Werkingsverdrag en het statuut van de Europese Ombudsman leidend zijn voor de bevoegdheden van de ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de lancering van een ballistische raket door Iran

The MP asked whether Iran's October 2015 ballistic missile launch violated UN Security Council resolution 1929, what consequences should follow, whether the JCPOA is breached, and how the EU snapback on sanctions is secured. The minister answered that the launch very likely violated resolution 1929, that the UN panel and sanctions committee should address it, that ballistic missile restrictions are not part of the JCPOA, and that EU sanctions will be reinstated by Council commitment if Iran significantly breaches the deal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de 70ste Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties (AVVN)

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked why older-persons organisations were not invited to the political-civil society delegation to the UN General Assembly, and how demographic change could be raised there. The minister replied that delegation members are chosen by participating organisations without age limits, and outlined Dutch efforts on sexual and reproductive health, gender equality and population data within UN bodies.
Parliament and the participating organisations, except the youth organisation, set no age limits themselves when nominating a delegation member.
Het parlement en de deelnemende organisaties, met uitzondering van de jongerenorganisatie, trekken zelf geen leeftijdsgrenzen als het gaat om het afvaardigen van een delegatielid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de door Nederland gedoneerde scanner op de grens tussen Gaza en Israël

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch-donated container scanner at the Gaza-Israel border really serves to boost Gaza exports, and why truck counts and export capacity differ from other reports. The minister confirms the scanner's export and import purpose, explains the differing truck figures, notes that export is still only about 7% of pre-2007 levels, and says the current scanner's capacity is nearly reached, so a second scanner has been requested.
The Netherlands will continue, together with international partners, to work for further expansion of export opportunities.
Nederland blijft samen met internationale partners inzetten op verdere verruiming van export mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het oplaaiend geweld van Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the surge of Palestinian violence, President Abbas's role and silence on attacks, and Palestinian media incitement before Abbas's visit. The minister condemned attacks on Israelis, attributed the violence to lack of political perspective and largely youth-driven, social-media-organised attacks beyond Abbas's control, and said de-escalation and the issue would be raised during the visit.
During the visit, the current violence and the need for de-escalation will be discussed extensively, and it will naturally be urged that a call to renounce violence be made.
Bij het bezoek zal uitgebreid worden stilgestaan bij het huidige geweld, en de noodzaak tot de-escalatie, waarbij vanzelfsprekend ook zal worden aangedrongen op een oproep tot afzien van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de recente escalatie van geweld in Israël en in de door Israël bezette Palestijnse gebieden

The MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the escalation of violence in Israel and the occupied Palestinian territories, including the EU's role and Mogherini's engagement. The minister condemned violence on both sides, described diplomatic efforts and EU initiatives, and acknowledged underlying causes while promising continued EU engagement.
The cabinet condemns the violent actions and such attacks.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de gewelddadige acties en dergelijke aanslagen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse premier Davutoglu mede namens zijn AK partij een brief heeft verstuurd naar Turkse Nederlanders over de Turkse verkiezingen van 1 november a.s.

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about a letter from Turkish PM Davutoglu to Turkish Dutch citizens urging a vote for the AK party, including how he obtained their data, Dutch data-protection concerns, and Turkish-language bilingual education. The government answered that political activity by foreign parties is permitted within legal limits, that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) has requested information and its outcome awaited, and that Turkish-language primary education is not permitted.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) has sent a request for information.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft een verzoek om inlichtingen uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over martelingen in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report on torture in Morocco, including risks for complainants, Dutch projects supporting human rights there, and whether counter-terrorism cooperation considered abuse risks. The minister answered that torture is taken seriously, describes ongoing human rights projects, and says Morocco's reaction is being monitored.
The cabinet takes all allegations of human rights violations worldwide seriously.
Het kabinet neemt alle aantijgingen van mensenrechtenschendingen, wereldwijd, serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Venezolanen die Curaçao weigeren te verlaten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Venezuelan holidaymakers refusing to leave Curaçao were a problem, whether Curaçao's controls at sea and on arrival were adequate, and whether the Kingdom government had pressed for monitoring under a motion, plus what it knew of a Curaçao taskforce. The minister confirmed a modest rise in overstays, said Curaçao has autonomous control over entry and that sea controls were tightened, and stated that close contact with Aruba and Curaçao is maintained without giving precise figures.
Admission is a competence of Curaçao. It is up to Curaçao to organise the process of entry and exit.
Toelating is een bevoegdheid van Curaçao. Het is aan Curaçao om het proces rondom in- en uitreis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Aukje de Vries over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over aanhoudende problemen bij EU-aanbesteden

MPs Van 't Wout and Aukje de Vries asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the European Court of Auditors' report on persistent EU public procurement problems, including errors in about 40% of audited projects and possible suspension of payments. The minister answered that the government shares the recommendations, pushes for stricter Commission enforcement, notes new EU procurement directives and REFIT simplification efforts, and is still exploring whether regional and local procurement rules can be excluded for EFRO and ESF projects.

The cabinet shares the recommendations of the European Court of Auditors and believes the European Commission should strictly and uniformly supervise compliance by member state authorities when spending EU funds.

Het kabinet deelt genoemde aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer en is van mening dat de Europese Commissie bij besteding van EU fondsen op strikte en uniforme wijze moet toezien op naleving door autoriteiten in lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek van de Rwandese president Kagame aan Nederland

An MP asked whether the working visit of Rwandan President Kagame to the Netherlands was appropriate given UN findings on Rwanda's support for abuses in Congo and the M23 rebels, whether human rights would be raised, and why the visit was not announced earlier and had no press moment. The minister replied that the visit was a working visit announced in the usual way, that Nederland is a critical-constructive partner, and that human rights and press freedom were raised in talks.
It concerned a working visit, which was announced in the usual way.
Het betrof een werkbezoek, dat op gebruikelijk wijze is aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would challenge Saudi Arabia over reports it wanted LGBT rights removed from the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and about Saudi membership of the Consultative Group of the Human Rights Council and the Cairo Declaration. The minister answered that LGBT rights were never explicitly included in the SDGs, that the non-discrimination and Leave No One Behind principles apply to everyone, and that the Universal Declaration remains the leading standard, without committing to new action against Saudi Arabia.
It is worth stressing that there was never any explicit inclusion of equal rights for LGBT persons in the SDGs.
Daarbij is het goed te benadrukken dat er nooit sprake is geweest van expliciete opname van gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Omtzigt over het bericht van de Kiesraad “Groen licht voor referendum over Associatieovereenkomst Oekraïne”

MPs Verhoeven and Omtzigt asked about the Kiesraad's approval of a referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, whether partners were informed, how the public will be informed, and the agreement's provisional application and ratification status. The government answered that the referendum does not affect provisional application, that the ratification law's entry-into-force provision lapsed, and that it will follow the Advisory Referendum Act, with a further decision on any rejection to be made later.
The cabinet will follow the Advisory Referendum Act.
Het kabinet zal de Wet raadgevend referendum volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over de besteding van een IMF-lening aan Oekraïne

MPs Van Bommel and Merkies asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether IMF loan money to Ukraine was diverted to offshore accounts linked to oligarch Kolomoisky, and sought investigation of beneficial owners and auditor selection. The ministers answered that Dutch funds are pooled and untraceable, that the IMF found no irregularities in the central bank's use of funds, and that since the IMF already supervises its funds no further investigation is needed.
Since it is standard policy that the IMF monitors the use of its public funds and this has recently occurred in the case of Ukraine, we see no need to advocate further investigation.

Aangezien het standaard beleid is dat het IMF de besteding van haar publieke middelen controleert en dit recent is gebeurd in het geval van Oekraïne, zien wij geen noodzaak om voor nader onderzoek te pleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de aanstelling van een migratiegezant

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why former GroenLinks leader Bram van Ojik was appointed special envoy for migration and whether a more neutral candidate should be chosen, plus an overview of all special envoys. Minister Koenders defended the appointment as an operational, non-political role within the existing policy, said Van Ojik's background is not relevant, and listed the eight special envoys, all based in The Hague except the Syria envoy in Istanbul.

I have full confidence in Mr Van Ojik's performance and in the way he will convey the Dutch government's positions in his contacts with international organisations, EU member states and third countries.

Ik heb het volste vertrouwen in het functioneren van de heer van Ojik en de wijze waarop hij in zijn contacten met internationale organisaties, EU-lidstaten en derde landen de standpunten van de Nederlandse regering zal uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de aanstelling van een Saoediër als hoofd van de VN Mensenrechtenraad

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi ambassador Faisal Trad was appointed head of the UN Human Rights Council, and whether the Netherlands opposed it and would condemn it. The minister answered that the report is factually incorrect: Trad was chosen by the Asian group as a member of the Consultative Group on special procedures, where he was later elected chair, without Dutch involvement, and that the Council remains a key forum for raising human rights abuses.
Reports that the Permanent Representative of Saudi Arabia to the United Nations in Geneva was appointed head of the Human Rights Council are factually incorrect.
Berichten dat de Permanent Vertegenwoordiger van Saoedi-Arabië bij de Verenigde Naties in Geneve is aangesteld als hoofd van de Mensenrechtenraad zijn feitelijk onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aanstelling van een Saoediër als voorzitter van VN mensenrechtenpanel

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands played any role in appointing a Saudi diplomat as chair of a UN human rights selection panel and whether the UN Human Rights Council's credibility is damaged, urging Saudi Arabia's removal. The minister answered that the Netherlands had no role, that the Saudi representative was nominated by his regional group and the panel elects its own chair, and that the Council remains an important forum where all states, including Saudi Arabia, can be called to account.
The Netherlands did not play a role in this appointment.
Nederland heeft geen rol gespeeld bij deze benoeming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over Saoedi-Arabië in de VN-mensenrechtenraad

The MP asked whether the UK and Saudi Arabia struck a vote-swap deal to secure Human Rights Council seats, whether the Netherlands has similar deals, and whether such deals harm credibility. The minister said the government is unaware of any such UK-Saudi deal, weighs human rights records in candidacies without publicly endorsing countries, and that voting is confidential so it cannot judge other states' votes.
The cabinet is not aware of deals between other member states about their voting behaviour. The vote itself is also confidential.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met deals van andere lidstaten over hun stemgedrag. Ook de stemming zelf is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen in Hongarije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister about degrading conditions for refugees in Hungary, including police food-throwing, detention conditions, and whether the Netherlands should stop Dublin transfers there. The government answered that the situation is worrying, that Dublin transfers remain possible under individual case review by the IND and courts, that the Commission is monitoring Hungary, and that it has raised concerns bilaterally.
From the above it appears that individual Dublin procedures contain sufficient safeguards to carefully examine the admissibility of the transfer.
Uit het vorenstaande blijkt dat er in een individuele Dublinprocedure voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de toelaatbaarheid van de overdracht zorgvuldig te toetsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitkomst van het Europese fraudeonderzoek naar een moskeeverzamelgebouw

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about OLAF's finding of no irregularities in an EU-subsidised multifunctional building in Amsterdam that houses prayer rooms, and whether Amsterdam asked OLAF to drop the case. The minister replied that no EU subsidy went to the religious part, no fraud was found, and Amsterdam never asked OLAF to drop the case.
In this case there is no question of fraud or irregularity.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van fraude of onregelmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en Anne Mulder over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

Two VVD MPs asked whether the European Court of Justice ruling that travel time for workers without a fixed workplace counts as working time will raise labour costs and weaken employment, and how much room it leaves for social partners and member states. The minister answered that no significant employment effect is expected in the Netherlands, that the ruling covers only workers without a fixed or habitual workplace and does not regulate pay, and that wage-setting remains with the social partners, so no national action is planned.
The ruling does not in any way limit the possibilities social partners have to make further agreements on the pay for travel time.
De uitspraak vormt geen enkele inperking van de mogelijkheden die sociale partners hebben om nadere afspraken te maken over de beloning van reistijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Omtzigt over dood van een Nederlandse activist in Oost-Timor

MPs Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of the article alleging state-sanctioned killing of Dutch activist Paulino Gama in East Timor, whether the government would press for an independent investigation and autopsy, and what consular support the family received. The minister confirmed the death, said the investigation is the responsibility of the East Timorese government, that the Netherlands has asked about an inquiry and is monitoring, and that consular contact with the family was maintained.
The investigation into Mr Gama's death is the responsibility of the East Timorese government.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de heer Gama is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Oost-Timorese regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapenexport naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Dutch export licence worth over 34 million euro for military equipment for the Egyptian navy, Egypt's role in the Yemen conflict and blockade, and whether the licence would be reconsidered. The ministers confirmed the licence, said they could not establish that Egyptian ships shelled targets in Yemen, acknowledged humanitarian concerns, and declined to reconsider the licence, citing the need to enforce the arms embargo and Egypt's legitimate security needs.
Based on the information gathered, the cabinet cannot conclude that Egyptian ships shelled targets in or off the coast of Yemen.
Op basis van de hieruit opgedane informatie kan het kabinet niet opmaken dat vanaf Egyptische schepen doelen in of voor de kust van Jemen zijn beschoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de veroordeling van journalisten in Egypte

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister how the government pressed Egypt to release jailed Al Jazeera journalists, including Rena Netjes, and about a mass conviction case and the counter-terrorism law. The minister answered that Sisi pardoned two journalists after international pressure, that Netjes's pardon is being discussed with her, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally and at the UN and EU.
For the sake of the effectiveness of any follow-up steps, it is not appropriate to disclose details.
Omwille van de effectiviteit van eventuele vervolgstappen is het niet opportuun details bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de uitzetting van journaliste Fréderike Geerdink

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of journalist Fréderike Geerdink from Turkey and what the government did to prevent it and secure her return. The minister answered that the embassy provided consular assistance and raised concerns with Turkish authorities, that she left voluntarily, and that any challenge to the circumstances is a matter for her and civil law.
Ms Geerdink left the country on a voluntary basis.
Mevrouw Geerdink heeft op basis van vrijwilligheid het land verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over “ongewenste beïnvloeding van de stemming voor de Nederlandse mensenrechtenprijs ‘De Tulp’”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the public vote for the Dutch human rights prize De Tulp was influenced by the right-wing group My Israel urging voters not to vote for B'Tselem, and what consequences follow. The minister said My Israel's call likely affected the vote, given about 50,000 of 70,853 votes came from Israel, but that it could not establish any state financing and that the government would not take further action beyond noting safeguards in the voting process.
It is unclear whether and how My Israel receives funding.
Het is onduidelijk of en op welke wijze «My Israel« financiering ontvangt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over verbanning van twee journalisten uit Oekraïne

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ukraine expelled two BBC journalists, and about press freedom in Ukraine and the Association Agreement. The minister said the journalists were placed on a sanctions list, not expelled, that the list was withdrawn after protest and excuses were given, and that press freedom has improved in government-controlled Ukraine while the Association Agreement contains no specific press freedom provisions.
It is correct that a number of foreign journalists, including two BBC journalists working in Moscow, were initially placed on the Ukrainian sanctions list.
Het klopt dat een aantal buitenlandse journalisten, waaronder ook twee in Moskou werkende BBC-journalisten, aanvankelijk op de Oekraïense sanctielijst zijn geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over beproeving van een Nederlander door Cypriotische autoriteiten

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch national prevented from leaving Cyprus by Cypriot authorities and whether the government would act to end this. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy provides consular assistance and monitors the case, and stated the Dutch government does not intervene in another country's judicial process.
In that regard, under international agreements the Dutch government does not intervene in the legal process of another country.
Daarbij geldt dat de Nederlandse overheid op grond van internationale afspraken niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land treedt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Saoedische voornemen een tiener te kruisigen en onthoofden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares outrage at Saudi plans to crucify and behead a teenager, whether pressure will be applied, whether the UN Human Rights Council is discredited by a Saudi diplomat chairing its advisory panel, and whether the Saudi ambassador should be expelled. The minister confirmed awareness, called the sentence a breach of the UN Children's Rights Convention, said the EU and member states will raise concerns with Saudi authorities, defended the Council's role and the panel's procedures, and declined to expel the ambassador.
From that standpoint, the EU and member states will raise their serious concerns about this case in their contacts with the Saudi authorities.
Vanuit die zienswijze zullen de EU en lidstaten in hun contacten met de Saoedische autoriteiten hun grote zorgen omtrent deze zaak opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een in Saudi opgelegde doodstraf

The MP asks whether the government knows of the death sentence imposed on Ali Mohammed al-Nimr for offences allegedly committed at age 17, whether it will press Saudi authorities to halt execution, and what it thinks of reported torture and beheading/crucifixion. The minister confirms awareness, condemns the death penalty and the sentencing of a minor as a breach of the UN Children's Rights Convention, says the EU and member states will raise concerns, and states the judge has not yet decided on the method of execution.
From that perspective, the EU and member states will raise their concerns about this case in their contacts with the Saudi authorities.
Vanuit die zienswijze zullen de EU en lidstaten in hun contacten met de Saoedische autoriteiten hun zorgen omtrent deze zaak opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Saudi-Arabië een 21-jarige man gaat onthoofden en kruisigen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Saudi Arabia would behead and crucify a 21-year-old Shia activist, whether the Dutch embassy monitored his trial, whether the government would make a demarche or press for his release in EU channels, and about the charges and the UN Human Rights Council chair appointment. The minister said the government is shocked, the embassy followed but did not attend the trial, the EU and member states will raise concerns, and the Netherlands had no role in the appointment.
The Netherlands has consulted with other (EU) partners about this sentence and about the most effective action by the international community.
Nederland heeft zich met andere (EU-)partners beraad over deze straf en over de meest effectieve inzet door de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voorstel van de Belgische premier om de Schengen-akkoorden open te breken

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government backs Belgium's proposal to reopen the Schengen agreements amid terrorism and migration pressure, and whether it will support the Australian model. The government answered that no change to Schengen rules is currently needed, that internal border controls can be intensified under existing rules, and that it will raise the issue in the Luxembourg presidency's December discussions.
For now there is no need to amend the Schengen rules to counter illegal migration flows within the Schengen area.
Vooralsnog is er geen noodzaak de Schengenregelgeving aan te passen om de illegale migratiestromen binnen het Schengengebied tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de herinvoering van grenscontroles door Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Germany's reintroduction of border checks would be followed by Dutch checks, how long they would last, and whether the Netherlands would support Germany and push to abandon Schengen. The government answered that Germany acted under the Schengen Border Code, that the Dutch had intensified targeted checks and could reintroduce border controls if public order required, and that no change to Schengen rules was currently needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een nieuwe islamitische geweldprediker naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher known for endorsing flogging and violence would speak at a Rotterdam mosque, whether his visa could be revoked, and what measures would stop such foreign preachers. The government said the preacher holds a visa issued by another Schengen country and no grounds for revocation currently exist, the mosque has no ANBI status, and it will use enforcement plus dialogue and, where needed, criminal action against incitement.
This preacher received a visa from another Schengen country.
Deze prediker heeft van een ander Schengenland een visum gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederlands hulpgeld wordt gebruikt om boetes van Palestijnse boeren te betalen

An SGP MP asked whether Dutch aid money was used to pay fines imposed on Palestinian farmers by Israeli authorities, how often this occurred, and under what criteria. The minister confirmed EUR 11,382 in fines paid since 2013 in three cases to release seized equipment, and said the government will continue aid in Area C despite the risk, without ending the practice.
No. Question 4: Has the Netherlands also paid fines imposed after Palestinian violence? Answer 4: No.
Vraag 4 Heeft Nederland ook boetes betaald die waren opgelegd nadat er sprake was van geweldpleging door Palestijnen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over pestboetes voor Palestijnse boeren in bezette gebieden

An MP asked whether Dutch aid money was used to pay Israeli fines to recover seized farm equipment in the occupied West Bank, and whether other Dutch-funded projects were frustrated or destroyed. The minister confirmed that in three cases Dutch partners paid fines as a condition for release of equipment, that Dutch missions protested, and that about 91,000 euro of damage to Dutch-funded projects occurred in 2010-2015, while promising continued advocacy but giving no firm new commitment.
In three cases Israel imposed a fine as a condition for returning the seized materials.
In drie gevallen legde Israël een boete op, als voorwaarde voor teruggave van de inbeslaggenomen materialen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Deense ontmoedigingsbeleid

Two MPs asked whether the government would adopt Denmark's policy of discouraging asylum seekers, such as cutting allowances and funding for recreational courses, and whether it would actively deter asylum seekers and publicize this in the region. The government answered that information campaigns may be used where migration flows stem from misperceptions, but that it distinguishes this from admission policy, and it acknowledged that a new group of migrants will require attention on integration and participation.
A distinction must be made between informing migrants about the actual situation and the admission policy to be pursued.
Er dient een onderscheid te worden gemaakt tussen het informeren van migranten over de feitelijke situatie en het te voeren toelatingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak R. van der D.

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Romano van der Dussen, including when the government learned of a DNA match to another prisoner, whether consular assistance was adequate, and for release of the case file. The minister answered that consular help was adequate, provided a chronology of consular contacts, but declined to hand over the underlying documents citing their personal and sensitive nature.

Because of the strongly individual and personal character of the file and the many documents and views of third parties, I limit myself to providing the aforementioned information and not to submitting the documents themselves.

Vanwege dit sterke individuele persoonlijke karakter van het dossier en de vele stukken en opvattingen van derden beperk ik mij tot het verstrekken van voornoemde inlichtingen en niet tot het overleggen van de documenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over de detentie van een Nederlands staatsburger in het buitenland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Berndsen-Jansen asked why the government refuses to transfer Dutch detainee Mr Singh from the US and why WOTS requests are refused for Dutch citizens abroad for more than five years. The minister answered that transfer requires sufficient ties with the Netherlands and a remaining sentence of at least four months, neither of which is met, and that the five-year rule is only an indication while medical situation is subordinate to resocialisation.
In this case neither of the two criteria is met.
In deze casus wordt aan beide criteria niet voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen PKK en ISIS

Members Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about Turkey's airstrikes on Kurdish groups (PKK, YPG) and ISIS, including alleged civilian casualties, coordination with the US-led coalition, and a proposed buffer zone in northern Syria. The government said it lacks independent information on Turkish operations, that Turkey and the US have agreed deconfliction and joint operations against ISIS, that it will look into the Zergele allegations via Turkey's announced inquiry, and that it sees no need for an independent investigation into alleged Turkish support for ISIS.
The cabinet does not have independent information on the circumstances of the Turkish air operations and the associated risks to American military personnel.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over de omstandigheden van de Turkse luchtoperaties en de daaraan verbonden risico's voor Amerikaanse militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het optreden van het Turkse leger en de politie in het zuidoosten van Turkije

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the conduct of the Turkish army and police in southeast Turkey and about casualties, and whether residents are confined by security zones. The minister answered that Turkey may defend itself but measures must be proportionate, that no verified casualty figures are available, and that residents can leave the security zones despite checkpoints and curfews.
The cabinet does not have verified figures on the number of casualties on either side.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde cijfers wat betreft aantallen slachtoffers aan weerszijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over oplopende spanningen in Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about escalating violence in Turkey between state forces and the PKK, attacks on HDP offices and Kurdish civilians, Turkish cross-border strikes in Iraq, a police shooting law, and the fairness of the November elections. The minister said there are no verified casualty figures, confirmed the attacks and police lateness, called for proportionate responses and a ceasefire, noted the shooting law's scope, and said the elections are proceeding with ODIHR observation planned.
The cabinet does not have verified figures on the number of casualties on either side.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde cijfers wat betreft aantallen slachtoffers aan weerszijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dolfijnenslachtingen op de Faeröer-eilanden

The MP asked about dolphin drive hunts in the Faroe Islands, Danish protection of the hunt, and what the government has done or will do to stop it. The government answered that it raised the issue through the IWC and ASCOBANS, will keep pressing Denmark and will ask the Commission to examine EU action, while noting the Faroes' autonomy over whaling.
I will ask the European Commission to examine whether and how the EU can act.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie verzoeken om mogelijkheden te onderzoeken of en op welke wijze de EU kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat de fraude binnen de Europese begroting is toegenomen

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about reported rises in EU budget fraud, the suspension of Scottish ESF payments, how to reduce fraud vulnerability, and whether the Dutch Presidency would address it. The minister answered that the figures reflect better detection rather than certainly more incidents, described the OLAF and member-state control framework, and promised further information on the MFK and budget transparency before the 2016 budget debate.
Your House will be informed about this prior to the discussion of the draft 2016 budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Uw Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd voorafgaand aan de behandeling van de ontwerpbegroting voor 2016 van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme en Voortman over de Europese migratieproblematiek.

MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Thieme and Voortman asked the government about the European migration crisis, including limits of reception capacity, funding for regional refugee aid, safe third country returns, relocation quotas and Dublin rules. The state secretary answered largely on substance, describing the planned approach and noting that many details remain to be negotiated with the EU and third countries.
Once the ideas take more concrete shape at European level, we can further develop the plans together with relevant reception countries, such as Syria's neighbours.
Zodra in Europees verband de ideeën concreter vorm krijgen, kunnen we de plannen verder uitwerken samen met relevante opvanglanden, zoals de buurlanden van Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over groeiende militaire steun van Rusland aan het Assad-regime en toenemende verdeeldheid binnen de anti-ISIS coalitie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about growing Russian military support for the Assad regime and divisions within the anti-ISIS coalition, including calls to pressure Russia and convene coalition talks. The government acknowledged Russian military deliveries and concern about them, said it raises the issue with Russia and in the UN, and stated the coalition is united against ISIS while promising no specific new initiative beyond existing consultations.
The Netherlands raises Russia's responsibilities with Russia wherever possible.
Nederland spreekt waar mogelijk Rusland aan op zijn verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport van Stop Wapenhandel over wapenleveranties van het Nederlandse bedrijf Thales aan Myanmar

An SP MP asked the ministers about a Stop Wapenhandel report alleging Thales radar technology, licensed to Indian firm BEL, ended up in Myanmar's navy, and whether the Netherlands can block such re-export and enforce the Myanmar arms embargo. The government answered that licence and contract clauses require prior Dutch consent for re-sales, that it would refuse future licences to a breaching end-user, that the EU embargo covers listed goods regardless of age, and that it found no evidence of Dutch embargo violations.
It should be clear that the Dutch government will refuse a future licence application for this end-user.
Het mag duidelijk zijn dat de Nederlandse overheid een volgende vergunningaanvraag voor deze eindgebruiker zal weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht 'IS ontvoert zeker 230 Syriërs, onder wie tientallen christenen'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to confirm reports that ISIS abducted around 230 Syrians, including Christians, and asked about the whereabouts of the hostages, ISIS motives, the status of an earlier abduction, and whether the UN envoy or the UN could be pressed for their release. The minister confirmed the abductions but said there was no further information on their location, gave a general motive (possibly ransom), reported that 22 Assyrians from the earlier abduction were released, said the envoy has no contact with ISIS, and described multilateral efforts to protect religious and ethnic minorities.
Own sources confirm the abduction but give no clear indication of the current whereabouts.
Eigen bronnen bevestigen de ontvoering, maar geven geen uitsluitsel over de huidige verblijfplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over burgerslachtoffers, oorlogsmisdaden en dreigende hongersnood in Jemen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the government about civilian casualties, alleged war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, and famine risk, including whether the Netherlands would raise these at the UN Human Rights Council and General Assembly and support an international inquiry.
