The ministers answered that the Netherlands will raise violations with all parties, intends to include an inquiry in its Yemen resolution, and has granted 10 million euro in additional humanitarian aid on top of earlier contributions.
The cabinet is very concerned about allegations of violations of international humanitarian law in Yemen and is committed to investigating them.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over beschuldigingen van schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht in Jemen en maakt zich sterk voor onderzoek hiernaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over Saoediers hielden Wilders nauwgezet in de gaten

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked whether Dutch authorities knew Saudi Arabia planned a lawsuit against Geert Wilders, whether the OIC and the Saudi crown prince were involved, and whether the ambassador disavowed Wilders' statements, and asked the government to break diplomatic ties. The minister declined to comment on substance because the reporting relied on allegedly confidential WikiLeaks documents, referred back to that answer for the other questions, and rejected breaking diplomatic relations.
The cabinet does not respond substantively to questions about reporting based on allegedly confidential documents published via WikiLeaks.
Het kabinet reageert niet inhoudelijk op vragen over berichtgeving die is gebaseerd op vermeende vertrouwelijke documenten welke zijn gepubliceerd via Wikileaks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Syrië nog steeds over chemische wapens beschikt

An MP asked whether reports that Syria still holds the most lethal nerve gases and had hidden chemical weapons from OPCW inspectors are true, and whether the destruction effort was futile. The minister said the government has no information confirming nerve gas remains, that Syria will submit a supplementary declaration around October 2015, and that the mission (1,300 tons destroyed) is a success.
The cabinet has no information confirming the reports that the Syrian army still has nerve gases.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die de berichten dat het Syrische leger nog over zenuwgassen zou beschikken bevestigt.
Vragen van het lid TenBroeke (VVD) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Syrië nog steeds over chemische wapens beschikt (ingezonden 28 juli 2015).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Syria still holds chemical weapons, including nerve agents, and whether this undermines the disarmament effort. The minister said the government has no confirming information, that Syria will submit a supplementary declaration around October 2015, and that the mission (1,300 tons of chemicals destroyed) is a major success, promising to share an evaluation later.
I am willing to share the results of this evaluation with the House in due course.
Ik ben bereid de resultaten van deze evaluatie te zijner tijd met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over drugssmokkel van Venezuela naar het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a July 2015 interception of 125 kilos of cocaine on a Venezuelan boat, the scale of drug smuggling from Venezuela to the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, and whether Aruba and Curaçao have enough capacity to fight it. The government confirmed the interception (later put at 150 kilos, handed to the Venezuelan navy), said reliable data on the scale of smuggling do not exist, and stated that the Caribbean authorities have adequate tools and cooperate with international partners.
There are no reliable data on the scale and origin of drug smuggling in or via the Caribbean region.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare gegevens over de omvang en herkomst van drugssmokkel in of via het Caribisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over Chinese kruizen-furie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government would condemn the Chinese demolition of church crosses in Zhejiang, seek explanation of the legal grounds and remedies, and avoid Dutch representation at the 3 September military parade. The minister acknowledged the demolitions, attributed them to a campaign against illegal buildings, called for respect for religious freedom through EU channels, and referred to earlier answers on the parade.
The Dutch government asks the Chinese authorities, partly within the EU framework, to respect human rights, including freedom of religion and conviction.
De Nederlandse regering vraagt de Chinese autoriteiten, mede in EU verband, om mensenrechten, waaronder vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging, te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over de douane van Turkije

MPs Agnes Mulder and Omtzigt asked about Turkey's new additional import duties on goods from third countries, which affect Dutch exports, and whether this breaches the EU-Turkey customs union, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirms the customs union rules, lists the additional duties, says the Dutch embassy and the European Commission have raised the issue with Turkey, and that the parties will look at modernising the customs union.
The Dutch embassy in Ankara raised the increasing duties in a conversation on 10 July with the Turkish Ministry of Economic Affairs.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara heeft de toenemende heffingen aangekaart in een gesprek op 10 juli bij het Turkse Ministerie van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zaak Romano van der Dussen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry lied about when it learned of DNA certainty in the Romano van der Dussen case, why a 2010 trust report did not lead to earlier action, and whether he can return home by year-end. The minister answered that the questions were addressed in his earlier letter answering MPs Omtzigt and Knops, referring to that letter instead of responding substantively.
I refer you to the answers to the parliamentary questions from MPs Omtzigt and Knops, which I sent you by letter of 27 August 2015, reference DCV/CA-133/15.
Graag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op de Kamervragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops die ik u bij brief van 27 augustus 2015, kenmerk DCV/CA-133/15 deed toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Eijsink over de samenwerking met milities die kindsoldaten inzetten

MPs Van Laar and Eijsink asked the ministers about Dutch cooperation with militias that deploy child soldiers in the fight against IS, including whether Dutch forces work with Iraqi militias and what can be done to end child deployment. The government answered that it does not cooperate with parties using child soldiers, that its Iraq training targets Iraqi Special Operations Forces and Peshmerga rather than militias, and that it will keep raising human rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and support education for children.
The Netherlands does not cooperate with parties that deploy child soldiers.
Nederland werkt niet samen met partijen die kindsoldaten inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederland gepoogd zou hebben de immuniteit van Saoedi-Arabische ambassadeurs op te heffen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands tried repeatedly and at high level to lift the immunity of Saudi ambassadors suspected of human trafficking, and about the handling of complaints and the status of a prior immunity review. The minister declined to comment on the leaked reports and on individual cases, citing privacy and confidentiality, and referred to a separate letter on the immunity review.
The cabinet does not make statements about such requests because they may involve privacy-sensitive information.
Het kabinet doet geen mededelingen over dergelijke verzoeken omdat het om privacy-gevoelige informatie kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verwoesting van landbouwgrond nabij Bethlehem door Israël

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel destroyed Palestinian agricultural land near Bethlehem, the financial damage, whether Dutch-funded projects were hit and whether the government would demand compensation. The minister confirmed the destruction of crops and infrastructure at five sites funded by Dutch programmes worth about EUR 40,000, said the Netherlands has no legal basis to claim compensation since funding had ended, and only protested to Israeli authorities.
The Netherlands therefore has no legal basis to demand compensation.
Nederland heeft daarmee geen juridische basis om een schadevergoeding te eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over recente berichten dat Palestijnse landbouwgrond is vernietigd door Israël

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether reports of Israeli forces destroying Palestinian farmland near Bethlehem and Nablus are true, what damage was done, whether Dutch-funded projects were affected and whether compensation has been paid. The government confirms destruction at the Bethlehem site, says it has protested to Israeli authorities, has no legal basis to claim compensation, and notes a recent rise in demolitions.
The cabinet does not have data on the damage caused there.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gegevens over de schade die daar is aangericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de aanklacht tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus in Azerbeidzjan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution sentencing requests of 11 and 9 years against Leyla and Arif Yunus in Azerbaijan, their medical treatment, international trial monitoring, and implementation of a motion on prisoners of conscience. The minister confirmed the sentences of 8.5 and 7 years, described EU-coordinated medical access and monitoring rotations, and cited Dutch statements calling for their release.
At the urging of the EU, a German doctor has been able to visit Leyla and Arif Yunus several times since December 2014.
Op aandringen van de EU heeft een Duitse arts Leyla en Arif Yunus sinds december 2014 een aantal keren kunnen bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de praktijk van 'landjepik in Europa'

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about large-scale farmland acquisition by foreign investors in Europe, its effects on local populations, food security, land prices, EU subsidies, and whether EU or national rules can restrict it. The government answered that local populations are not generally harmed, the TNI report's effects are insufficiently substantiated, existing EU rules allow only non-discriminatory and proportionate restrictions, and it sees no reason to raise the issue at EU level.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise this at European level.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit op Europees niveau aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het aantal paspoorten dat vervallen verklaard wordt

Opposition MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government to reconcile conflicting figures on passports declared void for suspected jihadist travel, whether Dutch citizens' passports are revoked alongside second-nationality passports, and whether cooperation with Turkey and Morocco exists on revoking passports. The Minister gave figures clarifying the difference between total signalled passports and active signals, acknowledged that identity cards can still enable travel, announced a bill on travel bans and identity card revocation, and stated there are no specific agreements with Turkey on mutual passport revocation.
I do not provide further statements about individual cases.
Over de individuele gevallen doe ik geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat via een Nederlands handelsbedrijf afgedankte Duitse legertrucks terecht zijn gekomen bij het Sudanese leger

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch ministers whether they knew that ex-German army trucks sold via a Dutch trading firm ended up with the Sudanese army, whether export controls failed, and what would prevent recurrence. The ministers answered that the trucks were demilitarised and treated as civilian under Dutch rules so no licence was required, that Germany now requires re-export consent in its contracts, and that the government will examine aligning Dutch policy with Germany and the EU, while also addressing Sudan's human rights abuses, humanitarian access and UN reporting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de wereldwijde oproep van ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken om het Internationaal Strafhof te steunen en misdadigers te berechten

Deputy Sjoerdsma asks why the Netherlands, as host of the International Criminal Court, did not sign the 2015 joint call by 16 foreign ministers to support the ICC, and whether it will now endorse it publicly. Minister Koenders replies that the Netherlands knew of the Liechtenstein initiative, already strongly supports the ICC, and welcomed the call, but that it sought a more regionally diverse set of signatories, which did not materialise in the short timeframe.
The Netherlands regularly raises the Court in multilateral forums and bilateral talks, facilitates the annual UN General Assembly resolution on the Court
Nederland brengt het Strafhof regelmatig op in multilaterale fora en bilaterale gesprekken, faciliteert de jaarlijkse resolutie in de AVVN over het Strafhof
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Van Laar en Rebel over het bericht 'Afrikaanse voetballers verhandeld in Azië'

PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about a BBC report on African footballers trafficked to Asia, including estimates of victims, Dutch signals, and EU/FIFA enforcement. Minister Schippers answered that the report alone gives no basis for judgment, that FIFA is already acting, that FIFA transfer rules and KNVB policy are in place, and that no Dutch intervention is warranted.
Additional research into the numbers is therefore, in my judgment, not necessary.
Aanvullend onderzoek naar aantallen is naar mijn oordeel dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzoek van Israël om financiering van omstreden NGO's stop te zetten

Two MPs asked whether the government will stop funding NGOs that Israel considers antisemitic or terror-glorifying, after an Israeli request. The minister answered that human rights NGOs are supported for their work, that the government will not fund organisations making antisemitic statements or glorifying terror, and that existing procedures provide safeguards.

The cabinet does not want to provide support to organisations that make antisemitic statements or glorify terror, or to organisations that pass these subsidies on to organisations guilty of such conduct.

Het kabinet wil geen steun verlenen aan organisaties die antisemitische uitingen doen danwel terreur verheerlijken of aan organisaties die deze subsidies doorgeven aan organisaties die zich daaraan schuldig maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de arrestatie van Carvajal en dreigende inval van Venezuela op Aruba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about the arrest of Venezuelan official Carvajal on Aruba, reports of Venezuelan warships approaching Aruba, and whether there was a military threat. The government answered that Carvajal enjoyed consular immunity under the Vienna Convention and was released, that the Venezuelan naval vessels were in Venezuelan territorial waters, that no military threats were made, and it answered most questions in substance while declining to comment on the exact words attributed to the Prime Minister.
The cabinet has taken note of the reports.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Bijna oorlog met Venezuela'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Venezuelan naval incursions into Aruban waters were concealed and what military steps were taken, and why the government changed its position on the immunity of Carvajal. The minister answered that no Venezuelan navy vessel entered Aruban waters, no military action was needed, and the immunity conclusion was based on the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, with the government accepting that Aruba's release was an autonomous decision.
The Venezuelan navy did not sail through Aruban waters.
De Venezolaanse marine is niet door Arubaanse wateren gevaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de zaak van R. van der D. (vervolgvragen)

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the minister withheld the confidential Grimbrere report on the case of R. van der D., when the government first learned of the DNA match, and what it has done to secure a Spanish DNA comparison and review. The minister answers that the report contains sensitive personal data so disclosure is the individual's choice, that Dutch policy is not to intervene in foreign judicial verdicts, and that the embassy is pressing Spanish authorities for a swift DNA verification.
The trust report contains special personal data (health and criminal data) within the meaning of the Dutch Data Protection Act, which stand in the way of sharing that information.

Het vertrouwensrapport bevat bijzondere persoonsgegevens (daar wordt onder verstaan: gezondheid en strafrechtelijke gegevens) zoals bedoeld in paragraaf 2, hoofdstuk 2 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, die eraan in de weg staan om die informatie te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over burgerslachtoffers in de strijd tegen IS

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers about an Airwars report on hundreds of civilian deaths from coalition airstrikes against IS, including whether the coalition's figure of two civilian deaths was accurate, and whether Netherlands would disclose where and when it struck. The ministers said the coalition takes civilian casualty reports seriously, that five investigations are completed and seven ongoing, and that they will not say which specific attacks Netherlands carried out for operational and domestic security reasons.
For operational reasons and in the interest of domestic security, we make no statements about specific cases.
Om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid doen wij geen uitspraken over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van de Rohingya uit Birma/Myanmar

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the treatment of Rohingya in Myanmar, Thai trafficking and refugee camps, Myanmar's dealings with MSF, and the link between economic ties and human rights. The minister answers that the government is concerned, supports humanitarian funding, raises rights issues with Myanmar and Thailand through the EU, and says no concrete new commitments are made.
Of course, the cabinet will continue to monitor the situation of the Rohingya and raise it in future talks.
Vanzelfsprekend zal het kabinet de situatie van de Rohingya blijven monitoren en ook in toekomstige gesprekken aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over gekaapte IP-adressen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

The MP asks whether the Foreign Ministry's hijacked IP addresses were misused, how the government ensures integrity of its networks, and whether security techniques and shared knowledge are adequate. The minister answers that the hijack lasted November 19-27 2014, misuse cannot be ruled out or fully investigated, no new technical measures were taken, and the network is managed in fragmented but coordinated fashion.
It is unknown whether and to what extent the hijacked IP addresses were actually misused during the period in question.
Het is onbekend of en in hoeverre de gekaapte IP-adressen in de bewuste periode daadwerkelijk zijn misbruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over deelname van Nederlandse bewindslieden aan de herdenking van de Tweede Wereldoorlog in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch ministers would attend China's WWII commemoration parade in Beijing, given the Tiananmen associations and China's stance in the South China Sea. The minister answered that the government intends to send Minister of State Tjeenk Willink, citing shared wartime experience, reconciliation and the level of other countries' representation.
On the basis of that consideration, the cabinet intends to have the Netherlands represented by Minister of State Tjeenk Willink.
Op basis van die afweging is het kabinet voornemens Nederland te laten vertegenwoordigen door Minister van Staat Tjeenk Willink.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de aanslag in Suruç in het zuiden van Turkije

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Suruç suicide bombing, its suspected IS link, Turkey's measures against foreign fighters transiting its territory, and reports of IS fighters treated in Turkish hospitals. The minister answered that the attack is unclaimed and under investigation, that Turkey cannot fully control its Syrian border, and that the Netherlands cannot confirm treatment of IS fighters or assess the effectiveness of Turkish measures.
The cabinet cannot confirm that ISIS fighters have been treated in Turkey, but it cannot rule out that terrorist fighters also use these facilities.
Het kabinet kan niet bevestigen dat ISIS-strijders in Turkije zijn behandeld, maar het valt niet uit te sluiten dat ook terroristische strijders van deze voorzieningen gebruik maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de luchtaanvallen op IS en PKK doelen door Turkije

MP Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's airstrikes against both IS and PKK targets, and their implications for NATO, the anti-IS coalition, Turkish base use, travel advice and evacuation of tourists, were compatible with international law and Dutch policy. The ministers answered most questions substantively, explaining Turkey's motives, the legal basis Turkey invoked, and that consular assistance is limited to the traveller's own responsibility, though several answers restated general policy.
As the Netherlands also stated in the North Atlantic Council on 28 July, Turkish measures against terrorist threats, including those emanating from the PKK, must be proportionate.
Zoals Nederland ook in de Noord Atlantische Raad (NAR) van 28 juli jl. verklaarde, moeten maatregelen van Turkije tegen terroristische dreigingen, ook als die uitgaan van de PKK, proportioneel zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Kamervragen over Turkije als de grote gedoger en vriendelijke buur van Islamitische Staat

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Turkey tolerates jihadists crossing its border to Syria and Iraq and whether Dutch Patriot missiles facilitated this, and asks why captured IS fighters are released quickly. The ministers answer that Turkey is tightening border controls, is active in the anti-ISIS coalition, and that the Patriots were a NATO defence deployment that did not facilitate jihadist transit.
No. The Dutch Patriot missiles were in Turkey until early this year under NATO command to protect the civilian population and territory of a NATO ally.
Nee. De Nederlandse Patriotraketten stonden tot begin dit jaar in NAVO-verband in Turkije om de burgerbevolking en het grondgebied van een NAVO-bondgenoot te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse bombardementen op Koerdische stellingen in Noord-Irak

An MP asked the government whether Turkish airstrikes on Kurdish positions in northern Iraq are heavier than strikes on IS, whether NATO allies backed them and whether they fall under self-defence, and whether NATO support amounts to a blank cheque. The ministers confirmed the strikes, said they lack precise figures, stated that Turkey claims they target the PKK in response to attacks and that proportionality and de-escalation are required, and declined to take action on NATO membership.
The cabinet does not have the precise figures on the number or intensity of the attacks.
Het kabinet heeft niet de beschikking over de precieze cijfers met betrekking tot de aantallen dan wel de intensiteit van de aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de relatie tussen Turkije en ISIS

The MP asks the government about reports of evidence linking Turkish officials to ISIS, how this affects the coalition strategy, and whether recent Turkish strikes signal a change. The ministers acknowledge the report, state that the Netherlands cannot confirm Turkish support for ISIS, and describe Turkey's anti-ISIS measures since the Suruç attack.
The Netherlands cannot confirm that Turkey provides support to jihadist organisations such as ISIS.
Nederland kan niet bevestigen dat Turkije steun levert aan jihadistische organisaties zoals ISIS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bewijs dat Turkije een nauwe band onderhield met Islamitische Staat

An MP asked the government whether seized IS data proves close ties between Turkey and Islamic State, and whether Turkey should be removed from NATO. The ministers replied that the Netherlands cannot confirm Turkish support for jihadist groups, that the findings will likely not be made public, and that Turkey is active in the anti-ISIS coalition.
It is not likely that information on this will be made public or can be made public.
Het is niet waarschijnlijk dat informatie hierover openbaar gemaakt wordt of kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over twee omstreden wetsvoorstellen in Oeganda

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the government about Ugandan bills restricting NGOs and anti-homosexuality legislation, including Dutch aid resumption. The ministers answered that the NGO bill threatens NGO freedom if adopted unamended, that the anti-homosexuality bill has not been formally submitted, and that the EU is handling the dialogue.
If the law is adopted without substantial changes, its application could significantly restrict the freedom of NGOs.
Wordt de wet zonder substantiële wijzigingen aangenomen, dan zal de toepassing ervan de vrijheid van ngo's flink kunnen inperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het onderzoek naar de grootschalige bankenfraude in Moldavië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the status of the Kroll report and recovery of funds in the Moldovan bank fraud, whether EU budget support was halted and linked to the fraud, and about Dutch diplomatic representation in Chisinau. The minister said further investigation and recovery are Moldovan responsibilities, confirmed the EU suspended budget support pending an IMF deal, and said no decision on opening a Dutch embassy in Chisinau has been taken.
This is the responsibility of the Moldovan authorities, and they must do everything possible to achieve thorough investigation, prosecution and recovery.
Dit is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Moldavische autoriteiten en zij dienen alles in het werk te stellen om grondig onderzoek, vervolging en terugvordering te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie van Oeigoeren in de Chinese provincie Xinjiang

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs in Xinjiang were prevented from observing Ramadan, strict mosque controls, assimilation and population policy, and the deportation of Uyghur asylum seekers. The minister answered that the government raises religious freedom and minority rights with China bilaterally and through the EU, that information from the region is hard to verify, and that the asylum question is referred to the State Secretary of Security and Justice.
The cabinet makes a consistent and joint effort regarding the human rights situation in China.
Het kabinet levert een consistente en gezamenlijke inspanning wat betreft de mensenrechtensituatie in China.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Van Bommel, Teeven en Taverne over het bericht dat zes Russische leden van de OVSE Parlementaire Assemblee vanwege de voor hen geldende EU-inreisverboden geen visum voor Finland h

MPs asked whether Finland's refusal of visas to six sanctioned Russian OSCE Parliamentary Assembly members, who were barred by EU travel bans, and the absence of a clear exemption for interparliamentary meetings was acceptable and whether the government would seek a formal exception. The minister answered that Finland only had to inform other member states, that the EU travel-ban rules contain only limited exceptions, and that the government values parliamentary dialogue in the OSCE but offered no commitment to seek a new formal exception.
The cabinet cannot comment on any reactions other member states may have given within the confidential Council framework.
Op (eventuele) reacties die overige lidstaten in vertrouwelijk Raadskader hebben gegeven, kan het kabinet niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes inzake de homohatende songteksten van de Surinaamse band Hakuna Matata Gang

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked ministers about homophobic lyrics by the Surinamese band Hakuna Matata Gang, whether they would be prosecuted during Dutch tours, and whether Suriname's government would be pressed to withdraw support and promote LGBT rights. The minister replied that the Dutch concerts were cancelled, the video removed, the band dropped the song, and the OM is reviewing a complaint, while Suriname denies financial support and the embassy has raised concerns and funded LGBTI rights work.
The Public Prosecution Service can decide to pursue criminal prosecution if it would turn out that during an event there was incitement to hatred
Het Openbaar Ministerie kan besluiten om tot strafrechtelijke vervolging over te gaan indien zou blijken dat tijdens een evenement sprake is geweest van het aanzetten tot haat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over toelating van een Hamas-mantelorganisatie tot de Economische en Sociale Raad (ECOSOC) van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister what the government would do to prevent the Hamas-linked Palestinian Return Centre from obtaining consultative status at ECOSOC, whether it knows Sudan supported this, and whether Netherlands would distance itself from ECOSOC if admitted. The minister replied that the Netherlands is not an ECOSOC member and cannot vote, that the EU coordinated a common position, and that consultative status does not imply cooperation.
The Netherlands is not a member of ECOSOC and therefore has no voting right.
Nederland is geen lid van de ECOSOC en geniet zodoende geen stemrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat Rusland uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens negeert

MPs Maij and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia's Constitutional Court allowed Russia to ignore European Court of Human Rights rulings conflicting with its constitution, and what this means for Russia's Council of Europe membership and human rights obligations. The minister answered that such non-implementation violates the ECHR, that Russia remains bound to implement rulings, that Russia's relations with the Council of Europe are strained but there are no signs of withdrawal, and that the Netherlands will continue to raise the issue.
The Netherlands shares this concern and will continue to raise this issue.
Nederland deelt deze bezorgdheid en zal aandacht blijven vragen voor deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over excuses van het Japanse bedrijf Mitsubishi aan Nederlanders die dwangarbeid hebben moeten verrichten tijdens WOII

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Mitsubishi's apology to American forced labourers, how many Dutch POWs Mitsubishi employed and died, and whether he would press Mitsubishi to apologise to Dutch victims. The minister answered that roughly 200 to 500 Dutch POWs worked for Mitsubishi-linked firms, that numbers cannot be verified with certainty, and that he would welcome an apology on Mitsubishi's own initiative without committing to pressure the company.
It is not possible to establish this number with certainty.
Het is niet mogelijk dit aantal met zekerheid vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de mogelijke vervolging in Oostenrijk van een Nederlandse parlementariërparlementariër

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would object to Austrian prosecutors considering prosecuting Dutch MP Wilders for incitement, and whether it would relax Dutch hate speech laws. The minister replied that assessing criminality abroad is for Austrian authorities, expressed confidence in their decision, and said the cabinet will take a position on the initiative bill in parliament.
Assessing the criminality of acts that occurred in another country is primarily reserved for the authorities of that country.
Beoordeling van strafbaarheid van handelingen die zich hebben voorgedaan in een ander land is in eerste instantie aan de autoriteiten van dat land voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schendingen van het oorlogsrecht sinds de uitbraak van het gewapende conflict in Jemen

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether the government shares Human Rights Watch's concerns about apparent war crimes by the Saudi-led coalition and other parties in Yemen, and whether it supports an international inquiry via the UN Human Rights Council. The minister answered that the findings are very worrying, that responsibility for investigating violations lies first with the parties themselves, and that the Netherlands is working on a Human Rights Council resolution and will explore an international inquiry if parties fail to investigate.
If the conflict parties fail to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law, the Cabinet will explore the possibility of an international commission of inquiry in this context.

Indien de conflictpartijen het nalaten om vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht te onderzoeken, zal het Kabinet in deze context de mogelijkheid van een internationale onderzoekscommissie verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “EU: Wij willen meer politieke islam in Europa”.

PVV MPs asked the government whether it agrees with EU foreign policy chief Mogherini's claim that Islam belongs in Europe, whether the EU endangers national identity, whether Netherlands should leave the EU, and whether she should be expelled to Saudi Arabia. The minister answered by citing EU treaty values and the Charter on religious freedom, rejected leaving the EU and rejected the expulsion request.
No. The cabinet considers continued membership of the European Union to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Nee. Het kabinet acht blijvend lidmaatschap van de Europese Unie in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over verschillende reisadviezen door lidstaten van de Europese Unie

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister why EU member states give differing travel advice for the same countries, such as Nepal, Croatia and Israel, and whether a single EU-wide travel advice is desirable. The minister replied that consular assistance is a national competence, that Nepal's advice was relaxed on 15 July 2015, that the Netherlands seeks more EU coordination without a single European advice, but that the safety of Dutch citizens comes first.
Consular assistance to nationals abroad is a national competence for all EU member states.
Consulaire bijstand aan landgenoten in het buitenland is voor alle EU lidstaten een nationale competentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de civielrechtelijke regeling naar aanleiding van standrechtelijke executies in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the status of civil compensation claims from relatives of victims of summary executions in the former Dutch East Indies, public awareness of the scheme in Indonesia, access to Nationaal Archief name lists, and extending the claim deadline. The ministers reported claim figures, said awareness among eligible persons cannot be estimated, noted the documents are available on request, and agreed to extend the deadline by two years.
Yes, we have decided to extend the deadline for submission by two years.
Ja, wij hebben besloten de termijn voor indiening met twee jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van ’t Wout over de fraude met en ineffectiviteit van Europese subsidies ten behoeve van sociale inclusie van Roma

An MP asked the ministers about a broadcast alleging waste and fraud in EU subsidies for Roma social inclusion in Romania, and whether the subsidies should be halted and recovered. The government said it relies on existing EU control rules, awaits the European Court of Auditors' investigation, and will not yet demand recovery of the subsidies.
The government, however, does not have specific (control) data on the projects mentioned in the broadcast or any controls on them.
Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over specifieke (controle-)gegevens over de in de uitzending genoemde projecten en eventuele controles daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de identificatie van de slachtoffers van de MH17

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would fully disclose who authorised Professor Maat's MH17 victim-identification presentations, what the internal police study found, and whether the study report would be shared. The minister answered that the presentations were not explicitly authorised by police leadership, that a colleague's presentation was, and that the internal study's report would not be published, with rules for presentations to be formalised later.
The investigation itself is an internal study that is known only within the police.
Het onderzoek zelf is een intern onderzoek dat alleen binnen de politie bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het proces tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus in Azerbeidzjan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the trial of Leyla and Arif Yunus in Azerbaijan was starting in early July, whether foreign observers would attend, and whether the trial is public. The minister confirmed the hearing was postponed to 15 July and that the Dutch embassy in Baku monitors such trials and will join an observer rotation with like-minded states.

In line with the EU Guidelines on Human Rights Defenders, the Dutch embassy, together with like-minded states and under coordination of the EU delegation, will take part in the rotation scheme of foreign observers at the trial of Leyla and Arif Yunus.

In lijn met de EU-richtsnoeren inzake mensenrechtenverdedigers zal de Nederlandse ambassade in samenwerking met gelijkgestemde staten en onder coördinatie van de EU-delegatie onderdeel uitmaken van het roulatieschema van buitenlandse waarnemers bij het proces tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de EU maritieme missie EU NAVFOR MED

An MP asks whether the EU is seeking a Chapter VII UN Security Council resolution for the EU naval mission EU NAVFOR MED against migrant smuggling from Libya, how migration could count as a threat to peace, and Libyan authorities' attitude to an EU mission in their waters. The government answers that negotiations in New York are stalled pending talks with Libya, that a draft cannot be shared confidentially, that Security Council resolutions under Chapter VII have precedent for migration-linked crises, and that the Libyan government lacks effective control in western Libya.
Due to the confidential nature of the discussions in New York, a draft version cannot be shared.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de besprekingen in New York kan een conceptversie niet worden gedeeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over oorlogsmisdaden van Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's findings that Hamas-linked forces abducted, tortured and summarily killed Palestinians during the 2014 Gaza conflict, and how the government would press Hamas and the Palestinian Authority to cooperate with independent investigators and accountability. The minister acknowledged the report, called for impartial investigation by both sides, and said the Netherlands has no direct leverage over Hamas, with political pressure on the Palestinian Authority the main option.
The cabinet calls on both sides to conduct credible and transparent investigations into alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
Het kabinet roept beide zijden op geloofwaardig en transparant onderzoek te doen naar vermeende schendingen van humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over de zaak van R. van der D.

MPs Knops and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Romano van der Dussen's Spanish conviction, consular visits, a commissioned defence-counsel report, and a DNA match on a victim. The government answered that consular visits continue, that the report is confidential and did not address guilt, and that the Spanish courts alone can decide on reopening, with Dutch consular assistance continuing.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make confidential reports public.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken maakt vertrouwensrapporten niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Papua

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about press freedom in Papua, including military monitoring of journalists, visa restrictions and whether the government had pressed for opening Papua to the press. The minister replied that press freedom in Indonesia is generally high, that the announced easing of rules for foreign journalists is encouraging and is being implemented, and that Nederland has raised the issue repeatedly and will monitor implementation.
The practice whereby journalists cannot obtain visas for Papua and their activities are closely monitored should therefore become a thing of the past.
De praktijk dat journalisten geen visa kunnen krijgen voor Papua en dat hun activiteiten nauwlettend worden gemonitord, zou dan ook tot het verleden moeten gaan behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een in 2004 verhinderde aanslag

Two PVV MPs asked whether reports that the Netherlands escaped an attack in 2004 were correct, whether two men filming the Israeli embassy were prosecuted, their nationality, and whether they were handed to Israeli authorities. The Minister answered that the attack claim cannot be confirmed, that four men were arrested but prosecution for preparing an attack failed for lack of evidence, that two were convicted on lesser charges (one later acquitted on appeal), that one man of Saudi nationality was expelled, that the nationality of the others cannot be established, and that there was no reason to hand them over to Israel.
The criminal investigation did not, however, lead to prosecution for preparing an attack, because insufficient evidence was found for that.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft evenwel niet geleid tot een vervolging ter zake van het voorbereiden van een aanslag, omdat daartoe onvoldoende bewijs werd gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over inbeslagname van irrigatiepijpen van Palestijnse boeren in de Jordaanvallei

An MP asked whether Israeli authorities seized nearly 1.9 km of irrigation pipes from Palestinian farmers in the Jordan Valley, including a Dutch-funded project, and what the government would do about it and about obstructions to Dutch projects in Area C. The minister confirmed the seizure, said the pipes would be released after talks with Israeli authorities, outlined Dutch aid priorities in Area C and noted that other donors face similar problems.
It has been agreed that the pipes will therefore be released in the short term.
Afgesproken is dat de leidingen daarom op korte termijn zullen worden vrijgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over sociale uitkeringen voor Nederlanders woonachtig in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the government will apply the Wet BEU consistently to Dutch residents of Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, in line with 2002 policy, and whether the SVB's position on the territories is correct. The government answered that the new AOW policy is consistent with the 2002 position: current recipients keep the single-person AOW up to 70% of the minimum wage, while from 1 January 2016 new single recipients in occupied areas receive the married-person norm of 50%.
This decision will be published and communicated as soon as possible.
Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asks the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers why correspondence with the European Commission about the EU budget levy (naheffing) is withheld, and demands the emails and a breakdown of payments per country. The government refuses to send the correspondence, claims diplomatic confidentiality and parliamentary information rules, provides a country-by-country payment table, and dodges the question about when the Prime Minister was first informed.
Are you willing to finally send the parliament the correspondence about the levy relating to the sixth supplementary budget 2014, as has been requested several times?
Bent u bereid alsnog de correspondentie over de naheffing, die betrekking heeft op de zesde aanvullende begroting 2014 aan de Kamer te doen toekomen, zoals meerdere keren gevraagd?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executie Mansour Arvan in Iran

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister whether he could confirm the reported execution of Kurdish prisoner Mansour Arvand in Iran, the basis for the death sentence, and the number of executions in Iran, and whether the government would press Iran for a moratorium. The minister said the execution report is known but unconfirmed, the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, and it will continue to urge Iran to abolish it and to halt executions in the meantime.
The Netherlands will continue, both through the EU and bilaterally, to urge the Iranian authorities to abolish the death penalty.
Nederland blijft, zowel via de EU als bilateraal, bij de Iraanse autoriteiten aandringen op het afschaffen van de doodstraf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het doodvonnis voor de Egyptische oud-president Mohammed Morsi

An MP asked the government about the death sentence against former Egyptian president Morsi, whether it was political, why the Netherlands had not spoken out more firmly, what diplomatic, legal and political steps it would take, and about the scale of death sentences in Egypt. The government answered that it opposes the death penalty, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU and UN, but declined to send a special envoy or to pursue the steps asked, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to separately appoint a Dutch special envoy to raise the death sentences in Egypt.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het niet opportuun om separaat een Nederlandse speciale gezant aan te wijzen om de doodvonnissen in Egypte aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de doodstraf voor oud-president Morsi en 105 aanhangers van de Moslimbroederschap

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentences against former president Morsi and 105 Muslim Brotherhood supporters in Egypt and what the government would do about them. The minister condemned the sentences, said Dutch and EU protests were made bilaterally and multilaterally, and gave estimates of arrests and death sentences in Egypt since 2013 while noting that exact figures cannot be verified.

The EU-Egypt subcommittee on democratisation, human rights and good governance is expected to take place around the summer, with European concerns about the death penalty on the draft agenda, among other things.
Naar verwachting vindt rond de zomer het EU-Egypte subcomité voor democratisering, mensenrechten en goed bestuur plaats, waarbij o.a. de Europese zorgen over de doodstraf op de concept-agenda staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de governance gap op het gebied van bedrijfsgerelateerde mensenrechtenschendingen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Foreign Affairs about the global governance gap in preventing business-related human rights abuses, whether a binding Business and Human Rights Treaty would help, why the Netherlands joins TTIP talks but not the treaty talks, and the government's position and EU parameters for the IGWG. The ministers answered that the UN Guiding Principles and the national action plan are the preferred route, that the EU parameters for joining the IGWG have not been met, and that the Netherlands chairs the Council of Europe instrument negotiations.
The cabinet expects companies to respect in other countries the same human rights standards as in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven dat ze in het buitenland dezelfde mensenrechtenstandaarden eerbiedigen als in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over investeren in China’s landjepik in de Zuid-Chinese zee

An MP asked whether investment opportunities offered by Chinese state firm CCCC in South China Sea island-reclamation projects are lawful, what risks investors face, and whether the government will block such investments. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands takes no position on territorial claims and leaves assessment to international law, left investment risk to investors, and offered no measures beyond referring to the earlier answer.
The Netherlands takes no position on the territorial claims in the South China Sea, but advocates peaceful settlement of disputes in accordance with international law.
Nederland neemt geen positie in over de territoriale claims in de Zuid-Chinese zee, maar pleit voor vreedzame beslechting van geschillen in overeenstemming met internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over nieuwe onthullingen over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten Syrië

The MP Knops asked the Foreign Minister about Reuters reports that Turkish intelligence transported weapons to jihadists in Syria, and about the arrests of officials who investigated these shipments. The minister replied that the government knows of the reports but cannot draw conclusions, noted Turkey's counter-terrorism efforts, declined to seek clarification from Turkey or to call for an independent international investigation.
On the basis of these articles, and the investigations and quoted persons cited therein, no conclusion can yet be drawn about this.
Op basis van deze artikelen, en de daarin genoemde onderzoeken en geciteerde personen, kan daarover nog steeds geen conclusie worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat godsdienstige minderheden in India steeds meer in de knel komen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked whether attacks on religious minorities in India are rising, particularly against Christians, and what Indian authorities and the Dutch government are doing about it. The minister answered that USCIRF reports rising religious violence while official Indian figures show a drop in communal incidents, that Indian leaders have condemned such violence and arrests were made, and that the Netherlands raises religious freedom through EU and UN channels and funds local dialogue projects.
Freedom of religion and belief is a priority of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is een prioriteit van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de oproep van de Turkse president Erdogan tot de verovering van Jeruzalem

MP De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views President Erdogan's call to conquer Jerusalem and whether this changes Dutch policy toward Turkey. The minister answered that such statements do not fit a country committed to European values, noted remaining rule-of-law concerns in Turkey, and said the government keeps its existing Turkey policy.
The cabinet therefore continues to choose the same policy toward Turkey, with a credible EU accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
Het kabinet blijft daarom kiezen voor hetzelfde beleid ten opzichte van Turkije, met een geloofwaardig EU-toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de oproep van de Turkse president Erdogan om Jeruzalem te veroveren

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns President Erdogan's call to conquer Jerusalem and whether this should halt Turkey's EU accession talks. The minister said the remarks are inappropriate and were already conveyed to Turkey, but refused to suspend accession negotiations, preferring a credible process that presses for press and expression freedom reforms.
No. The cabinet chooses a credible accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
Nee. Het kabinet kiest voor een geloofwaardig toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat ISIS in staat zou zijn om massavernietigingswapens te maken

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether Australian intelligence concluded ISIS had enough radioactive material for a dirty bomb and what the coalition is doing to prevent ISIS obtaining chemical, biological or WMD capabilities. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to comment on intelligence assessments and said the coalition is alert to indicators of such weapons.
Publicly no statements can be made about intelligence investigations, including those of possible partner services.
In het openbaar kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over inlichtingenonderzoeken, ook niet van eventuele partnerdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Nederlanders die klem zitten in Jemen

An MP asks why the Netherlands no longer carries out evacuations from Yemen, how many Dutch nationals remain and want to leave, and whether the government will fund IOM evacuation operations. The minister answers that the Netherlands cannot evacuate itself, that 40 Dutch nationals have left with help, six remain, and that the government relies on IOM and other states, with no new funding committed.
The Netherlands does not carry out evacuations itself, but does help Dutch nationals to leave.
Nederland voert zelf geen evacuaties uit, maar helpt Nederlanders wel om te vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked why a controversial sheikh was able to enter the Netherlands for a conference in Eindhoven despite being refused by France, and about the powers to revoke Schengen visas and residence permits on public order grounds. The government answered that Italy had withdrawn the visa, the organiser cancelled the event, and explained the legal framework for public order refusals of EU and non-EU nationals.

Because Italy, as the issuing country, withdrew the visa, the speaker mentioned in the article no longer meets the requirements for stay within the Schengen area and may no longer travel to the Netherlands.

Omdat Italië als afgevend land het visum heeft ingetrokken, voldoet de in het artikel genoemde spreker niet langer aan de vereisten voor verblijf binnen het Schengengebied en mag hij niet meer naar Nederland reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over toenemende gewelddadigheden in Macedonië tussen gewapende groepen en de politie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about violent clashes between police and armed groups in Kumanovo, Macedonia, and what the government would do about the political crisis, EU accession prospects and de-escalation. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned about the violence and about democracy and rule of law, supports calls for independent investigation and EU-led mediation, and has raised the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands endorses Commissioner Hahn's call after the events in Kumanovo that further escalation must be prevented, also with a view to domestic stability.
Nederland onderschrijft de oproep van Commissaris Hahn na de gebeurtenissen in Kumanovo dat verdere escalatie moet worden voorkomen, ook met oog op binnenlandse stabiliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de positie van christenen in Syrië

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the kidnapping of a Syrian-Christian cleric near Homs, the decline of Christian populations in Syria and Iraq under ISIS, Dutch contacts with the anti-ISIS coalition on Christian protection, and whether the international community will act. The minister confirmed the kidnapping, gave rough population estimates, said the Netherlands raises the issue through all channels and within the coalition, and described pluralism-oriented political work without committing to a new concrete step.
Precise figures for the current number of Christians in Syria and Iraq are not available.
Precieze cijfers van het huidige aantal christenen in Syrië en Irak zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van clustermunitie in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he could confirm reports that the Saudi-led coalition used cluster munitions in Yemen, and how he assessed civilian deaths and possible violations of international humanitarian law by the coalition and the Houthis. The minister could not confirm the cluster munition reports, said UN and US inquiries were ongoing, and said the government lacked the factual information to judge compliance with humanitarian law by either side, while noting the EU and UN had called on the parties to respect it.
The government does not have the necessary factual information to give a well-founded judgment on compliance with international humanitarian law in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie om in dit specifieke geval een gefundeerd oordeel te kunnen geven over de naleving van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over de handelsmissie naar India en het verzoek van een aantal NGO’s om te pleiten voor de vrijheid van organisatie en meningsuiting

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the Prime Minister and ministers whether the government would press India during the trade mission to protect freedom of association and expression, given reported restrictions on NGOs such as Greenpeace and visa refusals. The minister answered that the government shares concern about shrinking space for international NGOs in India, raised it with Indian officials and agreed to discuss NGO cooperation in coming months, but left constitutional judgments to Indian courts and only promised reporting in the quarterly letter.

During my meeting with Minister of State Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary I emphasised that a free, independent, active and critical civil society, through dialogue with businesses and governments, can contribute greatly to inclusive growth and development.

Ik benadrukte tijdens mijn onderhoud met Minister of State, Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary dat een vrij, onafhankelijk, actief en kritisch maatschappelijk middenveld via een dialoog met bedrijven en overheden veel kan bijdragen aan inclusieve groei en ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht van Human Rights Watch dat Saoedi-Arabië clusterbommen gebruikt in Jemen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi Arabia used cluster munitions in Yemen, as reported by Human Rights Watch, and whether the government would press parties and non-party states to renounce or join the cluster munitions convention. The minister said the government could not confirm the reports, that the UN human rights office and the US were investigating, and that Nederland would raise concerns at the June 2015 meeting and encourage non-parties to accede.

However, the Netherlands will raise concerns about this very worrying Human Rights Watch report at the next meeting of the Cluster Munitions Convention (June 2015) and ask the parties involved for more information.

Wel zullen namens Nederland naar aanleiding van dit zeer verontrustende bericht van Human Rights Watch tijdens de eerstvolgende bijeenkomst van het Clustermunitieverdrag (juni 2015) zorgen over dit bericht worden uitgesproken en de betrokken partijen om meer informatie worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Dekken over de voortdurende schending van arbeidsrechten bij de voorbereidingen voor het WK voetbal in Qatar

MPs Servaes and Van Dekken asked the government about continued labour rights abuses of migrant workers in Qatar linked to World Cup preparations, including Amnesty's findings, journalist detentions, union rights, Dutch company monitoring and FIFA corruption. The Minister answered that the government shares concerns, sees early steps by Qatar, pressed for ratification of ILO conventions 87 and 98, and engages bilaterally, through the EU, with business and the NCP, while declining to pre-judge ongoing FIFA investigations.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the various investigations currently being conducted by the Swiss and American authorities.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun vooruit te lopen op de verschillende onderzoeken door de Zwitserse en Amerikaanse autoriteiten die momenteel lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Van Laar over Kindermisbruik door militairen

MPs Servaes and Van Laar asked the foreign and development ministers about child sexual abuse by French troops in the Central African Republic, the suspension of UN official Anders Kompass for leaking a report, UN protection of whistleblowers, and measures against sexual abuse by UN-mandated soldiers. The minister said the government lacks the facts to judge the Kompass case, supports an independent UN inquiry, and noted the UN Secretary-General announced an external independent investigation.
The cabinet considers it important that an independent investigation be carried out covering all relevant aspects, and will therefore follow this case closely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er een onafhankelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd waarin alle relevante aspecten aan de orde komen en zal deze zaak daarom op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over mogelijke wapenleveranties aan Boko Haram via Turkish Airlines

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to assess alleged arms transports to Nigeria via Turkish Airlines, a leaked call, and UNODC findings on arms trafficking, and whether the government would verify the call or seek independent investigation. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the recording, will not speculate on unconfirmed reports, declined to raise it with Turkey, and will only generally urge research into how Boko Haram obtains weapons.
There is too little confirmed information to justify a Dutch diplomatic intervention, in a matter that primarily concerns the relationship between Turkey and Nigeria.
Er is te weinig bevestigde informatie om een Nederlandse diplomatieke interventie te rechtvaardigen, in een zaak die primair de relatie tussen Turkije en Nigeria betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over veiligheid van scheepvaart op de Middellandse Zee

MP De Roon asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the attack on a Turkish-flagged merchant ship off Libya and what measures will protect Dutch merchant vessels, including the threat picture and armed guards policy. Minister Koenders answered that the government lacks its own information on the attack, that shipowners bear responsibility for security with government sharing relevant information, that no separate threat assessment exists, and that the armed guards policy will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, though answers could not be given by 1 June.
The cabinet does not have its own information about the circumstances of this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigen informatie over de toedracht van deze aanval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het bericht dat alleen Israël door de World Health Organization is veroordeeld voor het schenden van gezondheidsrechten

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind) asked why the WHO assembly adopted a resolution singling out Israel's health conditions in occupied territories and whether the Netherlands backed it. The minister answered that the decision was a compromise, all EU states voted for it, the US, Canada and Australia opposed it, and that the Netherlands favours non-politicised WHO texts and supports phasing out country-specific resolutions.
Where possible, the Netherlands therefore works within the EU framework for balanced, non-politicised texts and advocates within the EU for phasing out these resolutions and decisions.
Nederland zet zich waar mogelijk in EU-kader dan ook in voor gebalanceerde, niet-politiserende teksten en pleit in EU-kader voor uitfasering van deze resoluties en besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Recourt over de inzet van Nederland bij de bijeenkomst in Riga tussen de EU en de VS over o.a. terrorismebestrijding, databescherming en migratie

PvdA MPs Maij and Recourt asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Dutch and EU position at the June 2015 EU-US Justice and Home Affairs ministerial in Riga, and about a draft agreement on counterterrorism, migration and data protection. The Minister replied that the meeting is a routine twice-yearly ministerial consultation, that the non-binding Riga statement was negotiated under a Council mandate Netherlands could accept, and that Parliament will be informed via the JBZ Council agenda and report.
Your House will be informed about this, as is customary, through the annotated agenda of the JBZ Council and the report of the Council.
Uw Kamer wordt, zoals te doen gebruikelijk, hierover geïnformeerd middels de geannoteerde agenda van de JBZ-Raad en middels het verslag van de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over deelname van het Letse voorzitterschap in het debat in het Europees Parlement over de situatie in Hongarije

MP Pechtold asked whether the Latvian EU presidency would skip a European Parliament debate on fundamental rights and the rule of law in Hungary for lack of a Council position, and how the Dutch government viewed this. Minister Koenders answered that the Latvian presidency did attend and spoke for the Council, stressing shared EU values, and that the Dutch presidency could consider raising Hungary's developments in Council if warranted.
The Latvian Presidency was present at the debate in the European Parliament on 19 May and spoke on behalf of the Council.
Het Letse Voorzitterschap was aanwezig bij het debat in het Europees parlement op 19 mei jl. en heeft daar namens de Raad het woord gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over Cyberdreiging vanuit Iran

Two MPs asked the ministers about a rise in Iranian cyberattacks on the West that exploit Western IT systems, and whether sanctions are failing to prevent Iranian access to such systems. The government answered that Dutch sanctions target Iran's nuclear programme rather than internet services in general, that providers bear responsibility for their customers, and that new cyber-specific sanctions are not currently under consideration.
The cabinet is of the view that the existing sanctions instruments are flexible enough to address cyber threats where desired.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het bestaande sanctie-instrumentarium flexibel genoeg is om desgewenst ook cyberdreigingen te kunnen ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Laar over slavernij en kinderarbeid in steengroeves

MPs Voordewind and Van Laar asked about child labour and slavery in South Indian granite quarries, due diligence by Dutch firms, the government's own procurement of granite, and whether municipalities and other public bodies are engaged. Minister Ploumen answers that she will engage sector federations on IMVO agreements, raise the issue during her India visit, pilot and implement evaluation recommendations on international social procurement conditions, and that PIANOo has worked with local authorities on procurement tools.
I am in discussion with the relevant trade organisations about the support the government can offer the sectors to reach IMVO agreements.
Ik ben in gesprek met de desbetreffende brancheorganisaties over de ondersteuning die de overheid kan bieden aan de sectoren om te komen tot IMVO afspraken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked whether the government agrees that Iran's seizure of a merchant ship in the Strait of Hormuz is an act of aggression, and about the safety of Dutch-flagged ships there. The government shares US concern that the seizure was unlawful, sees no current threat from Iran to Dutch-flagged or Dutch-crewed shipping, and reports no relevant incidents or shipowner requests.
The Netherlands shares the concerns of the US about this.
Nederland deelt de zorgen hierover van de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

MP De Roon asked whether the government would request, as the UK had, US naval escorts for Dutch merchant ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The ministers confirmed the British escorts and answered that no Dutch shipping firm had requested protection, so there was currently no reason to make such a request.
No requests from Dutch shipping companies regarding protection in the Strait of Hormuz have been received.
Er zijn geen verzoeken van Nederlandse reders ontvangen omtrent bescherming in de Straat van Hormuz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gewelddadige arrestatie van twee journalisten in Papua

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister about the violent arrest of two journalists in Papua and whether Indonesia would be asked to clarify it, and about the situation of the Papuan population. The minister said press freedom in Indonesia is generally large but concern remains in Papua, that the Netherlands raises it regularly, and that the situation is part of the structural dialogue with Indonesia and the EU human rights dialogue.
In Papua and West Papua, however, the treatment of local journalists remains a point of concern, as the arrest of these two journalists shows.
In Papua en West-Papua blijft de omgang met lokale journalisten echter een punt van zorg, zoals blijkt uit de arrestatie van deze twee journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht “Russen: wel een Boek, niet van ons”

An MP asks whether a leaked report on MH17, reported by Novaya Gazeta, was prepared by official Russian bodies and whether it was handed to the Dutch Safety Board or the JIT. The ministers answer that the government leaves the investigation to the Safety Board and the Public Prosecution Service, which report no official handover from Russia, while the Safety Board declines to share what information it has obtained.
During the investigation, the Dutch Safety Board does not give insight into the information that has or has not been obtained for the investigation.
Gedurende het onderzoek geeft de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid geen inzicht in de informatie die al dan niet is verkregen ten behoeve van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over Actieplan EU over mensenrechten

MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why freedom of religion or belief is absent from the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy, and how the Dutch parliament will be able to weigh in. The minister replied that Dutch efforts had pushed for concrete religious-freedom actions, that the plan refers to existing EU guidelines, and that parliament will receive an assessment fiche and can comment at a committee meeting before adoption.
This fiche will be shared with the House of Representatives in early June.
Dit fiche wordt begin juni met de Tweede Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Turkije lonkt naar een Russisch systeem voor luchtafweerraketten

The MP De Roon asked whether Turkey is reconsidering Russian S-300 air defence systems, whether Turkey still considers a Chinese system incompatible with NATO missile defence, and whether Turkey is distancing itself from NATO. The government replied that no concrete Turkish interest in the S-300 can be confirmed, that no decision timeline is known, that NATO allies have raised interoperability concerns, and that Article 5 is not in question.
It is not known when Turkey will decide on the purchase.
Het is niet bekend wanneer Turkije een besluit over de aanschaf zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van het pensioen van een holocaustoverlevende, omdat zij woont op de West Bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor's AOW pension was cut after she moved to the West Bank, and whether it would be reversed and prevented in future. The government answered that the cut was based on the Wet BEU and Israel's lack of treaty competence in occupied territory, that the SVB has reversed the decision, and that people living in occupied areas will keep 70% AOW from now on, while from 1 January 2016 new single residents there will get the 50% rate.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded. For the person concerned, the situation has now been corrected and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken. Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de suggestie van de Hongaarse premier om in de EU een debat te voeren over het herinvoeren van de doodstraf

The MP Maij asked the Foreign Minister whether the Hungarian Prime Minister's suggestion to reopen the death penalty debate in the EU is serious and how the government will respond. The minister answered that the remark is not a concrete proposal, that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, and described existing EU procedures and the annual rule-of-law dialogue for handling rule-of-law threats.
The Dutch government is a fervent opponent of the death penalty.
De Nederlandse regering is fervent tegenstander van de doodstraf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over de kille wijze waarop een Nederlandse Holocaust overlevende is gekort op haar AOW-uitkering

PVV MPs asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor living in the West Bank had her AOW pension cut by about 35 percent, whether all residents of Israeli settlements in occupied territories face such cuts, how many are affected, and whether the government will act against it. The government regretted the handling, said the affected survivor's situation was corrected, and decided that current single AOW recipients in occupied territory keep their benefit while new single recipients from 2016 get the 50 percent married-couple norm; it declined to change the treaty or contact Israeli counterparts.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded; for the person concerned the situation has now been adjusted and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over "het korten van AOW’ers in Israël".

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would reverse the reduction of AOW pensions for Dutch residents of the occupied West Bank and how many are affected. The government regrets the situation, will keep the current AOW level for those already receiving the single-person benefit up to 70% of the minimum wage, and cap it at the married norm (50%) for new recipients from 1 January 2016.
Everyone who currently lives in Israeli-occupied territory and receives a single-person AOW of up to 70% of the statutory minimum wage may keep it.
Iedereen die nu woont in door Israël bezet gebied en een AOW voor alleenstaanden ontvangt ter hoogte van maximaal 70% van het wettelijk minimumloon, mag die houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over de Burundezen die uit vrees voor mogelijk verkiezingsgeweld naar Rwanda vluchten

MPs Van Laar and Servaes asked the ministers about reports of Burundians fleeing to Rwanda over fear of election-related violence, the role of the Imbonerakure, threats to journalists and activists, police and military involvement, the Cibitoke investigation, a possible third term for President Nkurunziza, and possible suspension of cooperation programmes. The government answers that the questions were already answered in a separate letter to the House (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163), so no new substantive answer is given here.

The written questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes (both PvdA), question number 2015Z07291, have been answered by means of the letter 'Reaction to committee request regarding the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary Paper 29 237, no. 163).
