Antwoord 1 t/m 7 De schriftelijke vragen van leden Van Laar en Servaes (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2015Z07291 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt over de situatie in Burundi en de inzet van Nederland om escalatie (zoals massamoord en mogelijke genocide) te voorkomen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Burundi crisis over President Nkurunziza's third term, the court ruling, possible genocide risk, Dutch diplomatic and aid responses, and sanctions. The government answer refers the MPs to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163) answering these questions rather than answering them in this document.

The written questions from MPs Agnes Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt (all CDA), question number 2015Z08595, have been answered by the letter 'Response to committee request on the situation in Burundi and answer to questions from MPs Van Laar and Servaes, Sjoerdsma and Mulder, Knops and Omtzigt' (Parliamentary paper 29 237, no. 163).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt (allen CDA), vraagnummer 2015Z08595 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op commissieverzoek inzake situatie in Burundi en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes, Sjoerdsma en Mulder, Knops en Omtzigt» (Kamerstuk 29 237, nr. 163 ).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Servaes over het bericht dat Engeland ruim vijf miljard pond heeft uitgegeven aan wapenexport naar landen die op de zwarte lijst staan wegens mensenrechtenschendingen

Two Dutch MPs asked the ministers about a UK parliamentary report criticising British arms exports to countries of human rights concern, and about how EU member states can hold each other to account on arms export policy. The government answered that licensing decisions are national competences, that the UK report lacks end-use data, and that it will consult partners on the D66/PvdA proposals for an EU arms export authority and a right to challenge, which it considers constrained by EU-national competence division.
The cabinet will nevertheless consult European partners on this idea, starting with the most like-minded on further EU harmonisation.
Het kabinet zal de Europese partners evenwel over dit idee consulteren, om te beginnen de meest gelijkgestemden op het gebied van verdere EU-harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat er drie ultraorthodoxe sjeiks uit België in Utrecht komen spreken

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that three ultra-orthodox Islamic preachers from Belgium would speak in Utrecht, including whether a preacher had a criminal conviction, the visa status of speakers, the foundation alFitrah's role and its recognition as a training company, and its subsidies and ANBI status. The government answered that free speech is protected and the event was not licensable, that the preacher named was not present and visa/criminal information could not be checked under the Schengen rules, that alFitrah is recognised as a training company only by the vocational education centre and the placement is being reassessed, and that the foundation received no subsidies and has no ANBI status.
Requesting this information is only possible insofar as it is in the interest of combating future criminal offences
Het opvragen van deze informatie kan alleen voor zover dat in het belang is ter bestrijding van toekomstige strafbare feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het VN-rapport over incidenten rondom VN-gebouwen in de Gaza-strook

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Board of Inquiry report on incidents at UN buildings in Gaza in 2014, including weapons found in UN schools and whether Israeli strikes breached international law. The minister welcomed the summary, said the government lacks the factual information to judge the incidents or Israel's legal compliance, noted UNRWA security recommendations, and said it is unknown whether the findings feed into the UN Human Rights Council inquiry.
The government does not have the necessary factual information to confirm the incidents.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie om de incidenten te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het lot van Pakistaanse vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about arbitrary detention of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including children, and Thailand's treatment of them under the Child Rights Convention. Minister Koenders answered that Thailand treats all refugees alike under immigration law, that the Netherlands raises rights violations with Thai authorities and accepted 38 Pakistani refugees for resettlement, and that UNHCR is aware of long waiting times.
The Netherlands, including within the EU, regularly raises the deteriorating human rights situation in contacts with the Thai authorities.
NL brengt, o.a. in EU-verband, de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie met regelmaat op in contacten met Thaise autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over marteling door Indonesische politie in Papua

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the torture of four students, three of them minors, by Indonesian police in Papua, their current condition, and whether the government would press for an independent investigation, prosecution and compensation. The minister confirmed the incident, reported the victims' hospital treatment, and said KomnasHAM conducted an independent inquiry whose findings the police accepted, with disciplinary sanctions promised but unconfirmed and the situation to be monitored.
The Jayapura office of the National Human Rights Commission (KomnasHAM) conducted an independent investigation into this case.
Het kantoor van de Nationale Mensenrechtencommissie (KomnasHAM) in Jayapura, Papua, heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek in deze zaak ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over labeling van producten uit Israëlische steden op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether 16 EU member states want products from Israeli settlements on the West Bank labelled, what their request to Mogherini means, why the Netherlands supported it, and whether labelling harms trade and the peace process. The minister answered that the request concerns correct labelling of settlement products as consumer information rather than a boycott or import ban, that the Netherlands opposes boycotts, and that the Netherlands continues to promote a two-state solution through negotiations.
The Netherlands' co-signing of this reminder letter fits existing cabinet policy.
Mede-ondertekening door Nederland van deze herhalingsbrief past in het staande kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over risico’s van steunverlening aan Syrische strijdgroepen

An PVV MP asked the Foreign Minister which Syrian armed groups the Netherlands supports, how 'moderate' is determined, how aid is delivered and whether Dutch aid could fall into jihadist hands. The minister declined to name supported groups, partners or delivery organisations for security reasons, while stating that only carefully vetted groups qualify and that Dutch nationals joining armed groups can still be prosecuted.
In the interest of the safety of the parties involved in Dutch support, the cabinet makes no statements about the groups to which support is being considered.
In het belang van de veiligheid van de bij de Nederlandse steun betrokken partijen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over de groepen waaraan steun wordt overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over zware straffen voor journalisten in Egypte

MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about death and life sentences for journalists in Egypt, the EU and Dutch protest, and the number of jailed journalists. The minister condemns prosecution of journalists and the death penalty, says the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, and gives estimates of detained journalists that vary by source and cannot be verified.
The Dutch cabinet is of the view that counter-terrorism and respect for human rights must go hand in hand.
Het Nederlandse kabinet is van mening dat terreurbestrijding en respect voor mensenrechten hand in hand moeten gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over berichten ‘MEPs to raise monthly allowances’ en ‘Nog meer gratis graaigeld naar Europarlementariërs’

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about reports that MEPs would receive higher monthly expense allowances, and whether the government would act against this. The minister replied that the European Parliament sets its own budget within the multiannual financial framework and that the Council and the Netherlands have no influence over the size of the EP budget, while noting the government's efforts to restrain EU staff pay and reduce staff.
The cabinet or the Council, however, has no influence over the size of the EP budget.
Het kabinet of de Raad heeft echter geen invloed op de omvang van de EP-begroting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verzoek van de Nederlandse regering aan de Europese Commissie om alle documenten en briefwisselingen tussen Nederland en de Europese Commissie over de naheffing van 642 mil

An MP asks why the government asked the European Commission to keep correspondence about the 642 million euro levy secret, and demands the letter and emails be released. The government refuses to provide the Commission correspondence, citing diplomatic confidentiality and Wob exceptions, and says Article 68 of the Constitution rather than the Wob governs its duty to parliament.
Providing the correspondence with the European Commission itself is, in line with the cited cabinet position, considered undesirable.
Verstrekking van correspondentie met de Europese Commissie zelf achten wij, in lijn met genoemd kabinetsstandpunt, onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bewapenen van Afghaanse milities

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch-backed or US-backed Afghan militias, feared more than the Taliban, were being armed and whether the Netherlands had contributed to sponsoring them. The minister answered that the Afghan Local Police is an integral part of the ANSF under the Afghan Interior Ministry, that militia support is not part of Dutch policy or the Resolute Support exit strategy, and that the Netherlands may have indirectly contributed through support to the Afghan government in the early years.
The financing of militias, direct or indirect, has never been part of Dutch policy in Afghanistan.
De financiering van milities, direct of indirect, is nooit onderdeel geweest van het Nederlandse beleid in Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Sponsoring conferentie Chatham House

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry sponsored a Muslim Brotherhood-linked congress, what it cost, and why the taxpayer should fund it. The minister denied it was a Muslim Brotherhood event, explained a 10,000 GBP contribution to a Chatham House Middle East conference, and refused to repay the money.
The Netherlands made a contribution of 10,000 British pounds to an activity of the Middle East and North Africa department of the renowned and independent British think tank Chatham House
Nederland heeft een bijdrage van 10.000 Britse Pond geleverd aan een activiteit van de afdeling Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika van de gerenommeerde en onafhankelijke Britse denktank Chatham House
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Sponsoring conferentie Chatham House

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister why the ministry sponsored a Chatham House conference linked to the Muslim Brotherhood and why an official attended. The minister replied that the Netherlands contributed GBP 10,000 to an academic Chatham House conference, not a Muslim Brotherhood event, that the official spoke for his expertise, and that the cooperation would not be ended.
So it was not a congress or gathering of the Muslim Brotherhood, but an academically oriented Chatham House conference
Het was dus geen congres of bijeenkomst van de Moslimbroederschap, maar een academisch getinte Chatham House conferentie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de arrestatie van de Palestijnse parlementariër Khalida Jarrar

MP Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Palestinian legislator Khalida Jarrar, the reported administrative detention of Palestinian MPs, the travel ban, Israel's compliance with international law, and recognition of Palestine. The minister answered that Israeli measures lack transparency and due process, that the Netherlands raises this in the EU and bilateral dialogue, that recognition will be used at a strategic moment, and that no summoning of the Israeli ambassador is planned.
Basing a travel ban solely on secret evidence is therefore problematic.
Het baseren van een reisverbod op alleen geheim bewijsmateriaal is dan ook problematisch.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over opgepakte Nederlandse jihadisten bij de Turks-Syrische grens door Turkije

Two D66 MPs asked how many Dutch jihadists Turkey has detained at the Syrian border, what happens to them, whether agreements or extradition requests exist, and what the Netherlands does to stop those released from returning or travelling again. The minister answers that about 10 Dutch nationals were reported by Turkey since early 2015, that Turkey deports them, that no specific agreements exist, that extradition has not been considered so far, and lists Dutch measures such as passport invalidation, alerts and a pending travel-ban bill.
On whether there is an intention to submit extradition requests, no answer can be given in view of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Op de vraag of het voornemen bestaat uitleveringsverzoeken in te dienen, kan met het oog op belangen van opsporing en vervolging geen antwoord gegeven worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over Europese informatieuitwisseling over visumverlening aan haatpredikers

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether EU Schengen states share information on visa applications from hate preachers and whether he would coordinate with European colleagues to refuse them entry. The minister answered that the Schengen acquis already allows SIS alerts and VIS recording of visa refusals, and saw no need for further coordination.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de uitgifte van Turkse paspoorten aan jihadgangers. Deze vragen werden ingezonden op 15 april 2015

MPs asked whether reports that over 100,000 Turkish passports were given to ISIS fighters, and that around 50,000 Uyghurs joined ISIS through a loophole in Turkish law, are true, and what Turkey does with detained jihadists and to prevent departures. The minister said the government has no independent information to verify the claims, that Dutch jihadists are removed from Turkey after procedures with Dutch authorities informed, and that Turkey cooperates with origin countries and in the anti-ISIS coalition working group.
The cabinet does not have independent information to verify the claims in this article.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de beweringen in dit artikel te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Laar over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in de kledingindustrie in India

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Van Laar asked the government about modern slavery and child labour in the South Indian textile industry, including reported deaths and abuse of girls under the Sumangali scheme, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that the embassy and industry are engaged in multi-stakeholder initiatives, the MVO conference will explore EU-level supply chain measures, and the ILO and OECD frameworks are used to press India on forced and child labour standards.
Once the initiative takes firm shape, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will consider how this initiative can be supported.
Zodra het initiatief vaste vormen aanneemt, zal het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bezien op welke manier dit initiatief ondersteund kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat een Russisch museum delen van de MH17 tentoon gaat stellen

An MP asked the ministers whether a Russian local war museum would exhibit MH17 wreckage, whether the pieces were deliberately left behind and donated, and whether the government would raise concerns with Russia. The government answered that it has no indication the exhibition will take place, that it protested to Russian and Ukrainian authorities, that Russia denies the reports, and that it has publicly and bilaterally voiced concerns.
Naturally, developments will be closely monitored and further action will be taken if necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend zullen de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend gevolgd worden en zal nadere actie ondernomen worden indien nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Nederland knooppunt wapensmokkel’

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether large shipments of machine pistols were regularly entering the Netherlands for onward distribution, how the smuggling is tackled, and how a Defence employee's involvement was possible. The minister said Europol could not confirm regular large shipments, that police had intervened in one acute case with ongoing prosecution, and that Defence runs security checks and opens investigations when information arises.
Beyond that, I cannot comment on this ongoing criminal case.
Voor het overige kan ik over deze lopende strafzaak geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de actuele situatie in Nigeria in het licht van de gehouden verkiezingen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the outcome of Nigeria's 2015 elections, the outlook for Boko Haram, humanitarian aid and EU support. The minister answered that the elections were broadly credible, that policy effects cannot yet be assessed before Buhari's inauguration, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility, with the EU and Netherlands pressing via dialogue and development programmes.
It is difficult at this moment to make a careful assessment of the policy consequences of the outcome.
Het is moeilijk om op dit moment een zorgvuldige inschatting te maken van de beleidsinhoudelijke gevolgen van de uitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en van Klaveren over uitgelekte Kiev-notulen, die in het bezit zijn van Argos

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Foreign Minister whether leaked confidential Kiev briefing notes showed the government knew of Russian anti-aircraft missiles before MH17 was shot down and why it did not warn airlines. The minister said the notes only reported Ukrainian claims, denied the government had additional information, and refused to publish the report to protect diplomatic confidentiality, though it was given to the Dutch Safety Board.
Publication of that would undermine the necessary confidentiality and effectiveness of the negotiation process and of the exchange of information in diplomatic traffic.
Openbaarmaking daarvan zou de noodzakelijke vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van het onderhandelingsproces en (de informatie-uitwisseling in) het diplomatieke verkeer ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het voorlopige akkoord omtrent het Iraanse nucleaire programma

The VVD MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the preliminary Iran nuclear framework, including inspections, sanctions relief, snap-back, break-out time, missiles, proliferation and regional arms. The minister welcomed the framework, said it must be verified rather than trusted, and answered most questions by pointing to the detailed agreement still to be negotiated by 30 June.
Only after that will it be possible to inform the House which sanctions will be lifted under which conditions.
Pas daarna zal het mogelijk zijn om de Kamer te informeren welke sancties onder welke voorwaarden worden opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht "Remove Paul Kruger statue within 7 days, or else: EFF"

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked about an EFF ultimatum to remove the Paul Kruger statue in South Africa, including whether the Dutch embassy would act to protect it and whether the Culture Minister would seek UNESCO listing. The government answered that the matter is internal to South Africa, that the embassy has taken no action since no Dutch persons or property are involved, and that South African authorities decide on heritage and on responding to the EFF.
This concerns an internal South African matter in which no Dutch persons or property are involved.
Het betreft hier een interne Zuid-Afrikaanse zaak waarbij geen Nederlandse personen of bezittingen betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de illegale buitenpost-nederzettingen in bezet gebied

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about roughly 100 unauthorised 'outposts' in occupied Palestinian territory, some of which Israel is authorising retroactively, and whether the EU and the Prime Minister have pressed Israel on this. The minister confirmed the outposts are illegal under international and Israeli law, said the government consistently raises settlement policy with Israel and opposed the Levy report, and described EU statements and Council conclusions condemning the outposts.
The government consistently raises settlement policy with the Israeli government and points out that this policy undermines the two-state solution.
Het kabinet spreekt de Israëlische regering consequent aan op het nederzettingenbeleid en wijst erop dat dit beleid de twee-statenoplossing ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de vervolgings- en berechtingsstrategie van verdachten van het neerhalen van vlucht MH17 op 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the prosecution and trial strategy for suspects in the downing of MH17, including promised notes, possible trials in absentia, extradition, and amnesty under Minsk-2. The government said no prosecution strategy can be disclosed yet to protect the criminal investigation, but it reaffirmed that prosecution is the goal and promised to inform parliament once the investigation allows.
Releasing prosecution strategies prematurely is not in the interest of the investigation.
Het voortijdig naar buiten brengen van vervolgingsstrategieën is niet in het belang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de onderzoeken naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the authenticity and sharing of a leaked July 2014 Kiev briefing memo, ICAO and airspace warnings over Crimea, information sharing with airlines, Dutch–Ukrainian and Minsk arrangements for the crash site, and the state secrecy of MCCb MH17 minutes. The government largely refused to release the briefing memo and MCCb minutes on confidentiality grounds, while describing remedial steps such as the ICAO website pilot and planned consultations with airlines.
For the same reason, the cabinet will also not share the document with which the essence of the briefing was shared with other departments.
Om diezelfde reden zal het kabinet ook het document waarmee de essentie van de briefing is gedeeld met andere departementen niet delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Servaes en Van Laar over de uitkomst van de VN-commissie over vrouwenrechten van 13 maart 2015

MPs Yücel, Servaes and Van Laar asked about the outcome of the 2015 UN Commission on the Status of Women, including concerns that the political declaration weakened women's rights, that conservative states blocked references to harmful practices and sexual and reproductive rights, and that NGOs were excluded. The minister acknowledges difficult negotiations and the absence of specific references but argues there is no regression from Beijing, describes Dutch efforts and dialogue with conservative actors, and commits to continued advocacy.
However, with this political declaration there is no regression compared with the commitments made in 1995, because all member states reaffirmed the full Beijing agenda.
Echter, met deze politieke verklaring is geen sprake van achteruitgang ten opzichte van de afspraken gemaakt in 1995, omdat alle lidstaten de volledige Beijing agenda hebben herbevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over door Iran gesteunde milities die de Iraakse bevolking terroriseren

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Iran-backed Shiite militias allegedly terrorising Iraqi civilians, including reports of village destruction and displacement, and whether Dutch bombing helps these militias. The minister acknowledges the reports as serious, says Iraq must bring militias under state control (e.g. a National Guard), and states that Dutch raised concerns with Iraqi authorities but has no known role in sponsoring militias.
The Netherlands is also putting this issue on the Brussels agenda by advocating that the same message be conveyed to the Iraqi authorities and by urging reforms in the security sector.

Nederland zet deze kwestie eveneens op de Brusselse agenda door te pleiten voor het overbrengen van dezelfde boodschap aan de Iraakse autoriteiten en aan te dringen op hervormingen in de veiligheidssector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over druk vanuit de VS, Groot-Brittannië en Canada om geen steun te geven aan een verbod op kernwapens

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands supports Austria's call for nuclear disarmament steps and whether allies were pressured to oppose it. The minister confirmed the Austrian call, denied the pressure claims, said Dutch diplomats discuss the pledge with both supporters and opponents, and held that a ban treaty should be the end of disarmament rather than its start, so no new support is given.
The Netherlands therefore sees a treaty with a ban, as proposed in the Austrian Pledge, as the capstone of a disarmament process and not its beginning.
Nederland ziet een verdrag met een verbod, zoals voorgesteld in de «Austrian Pledge», dan ook als het sluitstuk van een ontwapeningsproces en niet als het begin ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de ongerijmde VN-beschuldiging aan het adres van Israël inzake vrouwenrechten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the UN Commission on the Status of Women singles out Israel in an annual resolution, and why states such as Iran and Sudan sit on it. The minister answered that the Palestinian women resolution is the only country-specific one, that the EU abstained, that the Netherlands considers country-specific resolutions out of place in the CSW, and that it has called for the resolution to be phased out.
For that reason, the EU member states, including the Netherlands, have advocated phasing out this resolution from the CSW.
De EU-lidstaten, inclusief Nederland, hebben om die reden gepleit voor uitfasering van deze resolutie uit de CSW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de toetreding van Palestina tot het Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether Palestine's accession to the International Criminal Court is legitimate, whether it is wise given Palestinian political actors, and whether the Netherlands can reverse it. The Minister replied that the Kingdom does not recognise the State of Palestine and therefore does not consider it a party to the Rome Statute in legal terms, that the move is politically significant but positive, and that the Netherlands has no power to reverse it as treaty state or host state.

Neither as a state party to the Rome Statute nor as host state of the International Criminal Court does the Netherlands have any influence over the Palestinian step of becoming a party to the Rome Statute.
Noch als verdragspartij bij het Statuut van Rome, noch als gastland van het Internationaal Strafhof heeft Nederland invloed op de Palestijnse stap partij te worden bij het Statuut van Rome.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Servaes over het militaire optreden van onder meer Saudi-Arabië in Jemen

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about civilian deaths from Saudi-led airstrikes in Yemen, including an attack on a UN refugee camp, and whether these may violate international humanitarian law. The minister acknowledged serious concern and casualty figures, said there is insufficient information to judge legal compliance, and called for a political solution and a return to UN-led negotiations, without committing to a concrete new step beyond raising the issue in EU channels.
There is currently insufficient information available to give a balanced judgment on whether the airstrikes were carried out in accordance with applicable international humanitarian law.
Er is op dit moment onvoldoende informatie beschikbaar om een afgewogen oordeel te geven of de luchtaanvallen in overeenstemming met het toepasselijke humanitair oorlogsrecht zijn uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke aanwezigheid van Nederlandse bewindslieden bij de herdenking van de Tweede Wereldoorlog in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch ministers would attend China's September 2015 WWII commemoration parade, whether it serves to showcase military strength and frame Japan as aggressor, and what the policy is on attending such ceremonies. The minister answered that the Dutch armed forces have been invited, that the government has not yet decided on attendance or level, that the focus should be reconciliation, and that each attendance decision is weighed separately.
The cabinet is still considering whether, and if so at what level, to take part in the gathering in China on 3 September.
Het kabinet heeft nog in overweging of en zo ja, op welk niveau deelgenomen wordt aan de bijeenkomst in China op 3 september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Dino Bouterse is veroordeeld voor het verlenen van steun aan Hezbollah

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of Dino Bouterse for supporting Hezbollah and whether Hezbollah plans activities in Latin America. The minister said the government has no independent information confirming Hezbollah activity in Suriname or Latin America, notes the court found no proof of arms supply or shelter, and reiterates that Hezbollah is considered a terrorist organisation.
Furthermore, the cabinet does not have independent information regarding Hezbollah's intentions to carry out activities in Latin America.
Hiernaast beschikt het kabinet niet over eigenstandige informatie inzake de voornemens van Hezbollah om activiteiten te ontplooien in Latijns-Amerika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Armeense genocide

Omtzigt asked the foreign minister whether the Armenian genocide is recognised by scholars, whether ministry officials had cited only one professor disputing it, and why the government does not use the term 'genocide'. Minister Koenders replied that scholarly consensus is broad but that legal qualification is not for the cabinet, and that a cabinet judgement would not help reconciliation.
Whether there was legally speaking a genocide is not for the cabinet to determine.
De vaststelling of hier in juridische zin sprake is geweest van genocide, is evenwel niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid ten Broeke over politieke ontwikkelingen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the state of democracy and the rule of law in South Africa, racism and discriminatory legislation, affirmative action and emigration, the EU-South Africa human rights dialogue, and South Africa's regional role. The minister answered that the country has strong institutions and progressive law but a gap between law and reality, that the incidents of racism are not systematic and there is no discriminatory legislation, and that the dialogue has taken place twice; these answers concern a foreign state rather than Dutch executive power.
The country has strong institutions, a vibrant democratic rule of law, a well-functioning bureaucracy and sufficient popular support for democratisation.
Het land kent sterkte instituties, een levendige democratische rechtsstaat, een goed werkende bureaucratie en er is voldoende steun onder de bevolking voor democratisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de eis “affiniteit met islam” in een wervingsadvertentie

An MP from PVV asked the Foreign Minister why an internship advertisement at the Dutch embassy in Sudan required 'affinity with Islam' and asked for its immediate withdrawal. The minister answered that it reflects professional interest in local religion and culture, that the embassy has a good record supporting women, LGBT people and dissidents, and that the profile is within normal criteria, so no change was promised.
As described above, I consider this profile to fall within the normal criteria for the qualifications desirable for this specific internship.
Als bovenbeschreven acht ik deze profielschets binnen de normale criteria van de voor deze specifieke stage wenselijke benodigdheden passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over Kamervragen ECRI rapport over Griekenland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Council of Europe ECRI report on rising hostility toward migrants in Greece, including violence and whether the EU should act. The minister confirmed the report's findings on rising racist incidents linked to Golden Dawn, described the Greek government's response and that the new government had not yet formulated migration policy, and said the Netherlands supports EU rule-of-law and anti-discrimination initiatives without seeing a broad EU-wide rise in xenophobia.
Non-discrimination forms part of the fundamental EU values as laid down in Article 2 of the Treaty on European Union.
Non-discriminatie maakt onderdeel uit van de fundamentele EU-waarden zoals neergelegd in artikel 2 van het Verdrag betreffende de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff over het faciliteren van assemblees van de Inter-Parlementaire Unie in de Europese Unie

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EU's travel restrictions on sanctioned third-country parliamentarians could be lifted for Inter-Parliamentary Union assemblies held in the EU, since no such assembly has taken place there since 1999. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the restrictions stem from EU sanctions targeting individuals, that the IPU falls under none of the standard exemption grounds, and that seeking an exemption is neither desirable nor feasible, though visas for bona fide travellers can be facilitated.
In light of the above arguments, the cabinet considers it neither desirable nor feasible to advocate such an exemption.
Het kabinet acht het, in het licht van bovenstaande argumenten, wenselijk noch haalbaar om een dergelijke ontheffing te bepleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza, een half jaar na het staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked the ministers about the humanitarian and reconstruction situation in Gaza six months after the ceasefire, including building-material imports, the Rafah crossing, Palestinian Authority role, donor shortfalls and the Cairo pledges. The government acknowledged serious concern, described the Gaza Reconstruction Mechanism as adequate for housing materials, and said it raises the issues bilaterally and multilaterally, though it gave no comprehensive list of unfulfilled pledges.
The cabinet itself does not have a detailed overview of all pledges.
Het kabinet heeft zelf geen gedetailleerd overzicht van alle toezeggingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sjoerdsma over de Amerikaanse sancties tegen Venezuela

MP Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would respond to US sanctions on Venezuela, join calls for release of political prisoners, and impose person-targeted sanctions or adjust relations with Venezuela. Minister Koenders answered that the US measures concern a bilateral matter, the EU has voiced concern over detained opposition members and students, and diplomatic channels should be kept open to promote dialogue.
It is in the interest of the Kingdom that diplomatic channels function well, that incidents are prevented and interests can be served.
Het is in het belang van het Koninkrijk dat de diplomatieke kanalen goed functioneren, dat incidenten worden voorkomen en belangen kunnen worden behartigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de aanschaf van Chinese 'Patriots' door Turkije

An MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether pressure from the West had been applied to Turkey to drop a Chinese air defence system, whether Turkey was linking its procurement to the Armenian genocide commemoration, and whether NATO interoperability concerns would be raised. The government answered that allies including the Netherlands had conveyed interoperability concerns, that negotiations were ongoing with no decision date known, and that it was up to Turkey to decide.
NATO allies, including the Netherlands, clearly conveyed concerns to Turkey about the interoperability of a Chinese air and missile defence system.
NAVO-bondgenoten, inclusief Nederland, hebben aan Turkije duidelijk de zorgen overgebracht over de interoperabiliteit van een Chinees lucht- en raketverdedigingssysteem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de onderhandelingen inzake het Iraanse nucleaire programma

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about IAEA reports that Iran is not fully answering questions on its nuclear programme and cannot verify it is peaceful, and about the state of the negotiations. The minister acknowledges the IAEA's concerns and the incomplete answers, says the Netherlands demands full cooperation, and states the government's aim of reaching a good comprehensive agreement by the deadline while keeping pressure on Iran.
As stated in the reports, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) cannot establish that the Iranian nuclear programme is peaceful in nature.
Zoals gesteld wordt in de rapportages kan het Internationaal Atoomenergie Agentschap (IAEA) niet vaststellen dat het Iraanse nucleaire programma vreedzaam van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de aanwezigheid van een commandant van Islamitische Staat in Turkije

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether a senior Islamic State commander receiving medical care in Turkey had been arrested for genocide, war crimes or other offences, and what the Netherlands would do to have him prosecuted. Minister Koenders answered that Turkish authorities report an ongoing legal investigation into an alleged ISIS member receiving treatment in Denizli, with no completion date known.
The Turkish authorities have indicated that a legal investigation is ongoing into an alleged ISIS member receiving medical care in Denizli in Turkey.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben laten weten dat een juridisch onderzoek loopt naar een vermeend lid van ISIS dat medische verzorging krijgt in Denizli in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het rapport ‘Tackling intolerance and discrimination in Europe with a special focus on Christians’

An SGP MP asked the government about a Council of Europe report on intolerance and discrimination against Christians and whether it accepts the report's findings and the concept of reasonable accommodation. The government rejects the picture of rising anti-Christian intolerance for the Netherlands, says it is committed to combating discrimination on any ground, and notes that reasonable accommodation is mainly used for disability rights.

The cabinet assumes that the national delegations to the Parliamentary Assembly of the other Council of Europe member states will themselves bring this report, and its conclusions and recommendations, to the attention of their governments.

Het kabinet gaat ervan uit dat de nationale delegaties naar de Parlementaire Assemblee van de overige lidstaten van de Raad van Europa dit rapport, en de conclusies en aanbevelingen daaruit, zelf onder de aandacht van hun regeringen zullen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Haatimams naar Utrecht’

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned Utrecht event featuring a controversial preacher, his radical views, and whether visa refusal or withdrawal and organiser responsibility could be used. The government answered that the preacher did not appear, there was no public order risk, and it outlined visa powers under the Schengen framework, local mayoral powers, and that the CMO will inform mosque organisations.
The event in Utrecht took place on Sunday 1 March last.
Het evenement in Utrecht heeft op zondag 1 maart jongstleden plaatsgevonden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe bijeenkomst van islamitische geweldspredikers (ingezonden 20 fe

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned fundraising gala in Utrecht featuring preachers reportedly advocating violence, including whether visas were granted and how such entries and organisers could be stopped. The ministers answered that no visa had been requested for the named preacher, that his statements would be unacceptable in the Netherlands and could be prosecuted if made publicly here, and outlined a stricter visa screening process with an alerting list maintained by the NCTV.

In the letter of 3 March 2015 I already reported that visa-required speakers from abroad who wish to spread intolerant, anti-integrative and/or anti-democratic messages in the Netherlands and thereby threaten public order or national security are not welcome.

In de brief van 3 maart 2015 heb ik reeds gemeld dat uit het buitenland afkomstige visumplichtige sprekers die in Nederland onverdraagzame, anti-integratieve en/of antidemocratische boodschappen willen uitdragen en daarmee de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid bedreigen, niet welkom zijn.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA) en Segers (ChristenUnie) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Megabenefiet-gala «Het is nu of nooit» in Utrecht (ingezonden 20 februari 2015).

MPs Omtzigt and Segers asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether they knew of a March 2015 Utrecht gala with a cleric who had endorsed jihad in Syria, and about visa screening for attendees. The ministers answered that the cleric was not known to have attended, that the cleric's 2013 message reflected a broader Sunni position on a legitimate jihad in Syria, and that no visas were known to have been requested for the gala.
No visa has been requested at the Kingdom's representations abroad in the name of the preacher (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem named in the announcements.
Bij de vertegenwoordigingen van het Koninkrijk in het buitenland is geen visum aangevraagd op naam van de in de aankondigingen genoemde prediker (Sheikh) Assim Al-Hakeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat extremistische sjeiks welkom zijn in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Utrecht event featuring the Saudi preacher Al-Hakeem, whose statements they called incitement to violence, would go ahead, and what the government would do about his visa and the organisers. The ministers answered that he was not known to have attended, that his statements would be unacceptable in the Netherlands, that visa refusal for hate preachers is policy, and that no criminal ground existed to ban the event.
This consideration was not at issue.
Deze afweging was niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Schimmigheid krijgt trekjes van patroon”

Omtzigt asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands objected to disclosure of its correspondence with the European Commission about a surcharge, and what it had told the Commission. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands invoked privacy and internal policy-opinion exceptions under the Wob and EU access rules, that the Commission accepted these grounds, and declined to commit to writing a letter urging disclosure.
The Netherlands informed the European Commission which information it would make public in the context of the Wob request.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie gemeld welke informatie Nederland in het kader van het Wob-verzoek openbaar zou maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het intrekken van de visa van predikers

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked why the NCTV letter on withdrawing visas for preachers bears a 23 February creation date and a 3 March date, and about its reference number, timing, inter-communication, Schengen coordination and a database of banned preachers. The government explained the letter was written and sent on 17 February, copied on 23 February with only the official's name removed, that the reference number reflects creation date, that other Schengen states can be asked to revoke visas, and that a usable alert list will be delivered by 1 April.
The NCTV letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was written, signed and sent on 17 February.
De brief van de NCTV aan het Ministerie van BZ is op 17 februari geschreven, ondertekend en verstuurd naar het Ministerie van BZ.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over grootschalig onderzoek van Unesco (Organisatie van de Verenigde Naties voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur) waaruit blijkt dat de Holocaust wereldwijd in schoolboeken

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a UNESCO study finding that the Holocaust is widely ignored in school textbooks, what follow-up UNESCO plans, whether the Netherlands will push for action, and whether it will address the Palestinian territories. The minister answered that the Netherlands values Holocaust education, will raise the report in the IHRA and with UNESCO's Director-General, and that the government raises the issue in bilateral contacts with the Palestinian authorities.

The Dutch Permanent Representative to UNESCO will, following publication of this report, urge the UNESCO Director-General to pursue follow-up research and sustained efforts to promote Holocaust education.

De Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiger bij Unesco zal naar aanleiding van het verschijnen van dit rapport bij de Directeur-Generaal van Unesco aandringen op vervolgonderzoek en blijvende inspanning om Holocaust-educatie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over politisering van staatsorganen en de beperking van persvrijheid in Macedonië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Macedonian prime minister accusing the opposition leader of espionage and coup plotting, the prosecutor seizing his passport, a ban on publishing recordings, and rising political control over courts and media. The minister agreed the concerns are serious, said the Netherlands raised them with Macedonian authorities and the EU, and said the reform process is largely stalled while Netherlands' support for opening accession talks is being reconsidered.

As stated in the cabinet's appreciation of the 2014 enlargement package, the cabinet, like the European Commission, has serious concerns about increasing politicization and state control in Macedonia.

Antwoord 3 Zoals aangegeven in de kabinetsappreciatie van het uitbreidingspakket 2014 5 maakt het kabinet zich, net als de Europese Commissie, ernstige zorgen over toenemende politisering en overheidscontrole in Macedonië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over Europese waarden in Hongarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary's closer ties with Putin's Russia, Orbán's 'illiberal democracy' remarks, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to enforce European values and the rule of law in Hungary. The minister replied that Hungary has not been found to obstruct the EU's unanimous Russia sanctions, that Orbán's concept is largely economic and not a Russian alternative, and described EU rule-of-law instruments and Dutch bilateral and Council efforts, without committing to a new concrete step.
The cabinet is working on the following areas to emphasise European values and rules.
Het kabinet zet zich in op de volgende terreinen om de Europese waarden en regels te benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes en Sjoerdsma over De ontvoering van tenminste 150 Syrische christenen

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction of at least 150 Syrian Christians by ISIS, about Dutch military and material support to Kurdish forces in Iraq, how minority protection is built into the anti-ISIS strategy, and how the international community could secure the hostages' release. The minister answered that Dutch support (helmets, vests, instructor teams, humanitarian aid) is aimed at training Peshmerga who protect all civilians, that inclusiveness and minority protection are addressed in training and EU policy, and that no ground options exist for freeing the hostages, while about twenty had been released.
Yes. Question 2: What material and military support has the Netherlands by now given to the Kurds in Iraq?
Ja. Vraag 2 Welke materiële en militaire steun heeft Nederland inmiddels gegeven aan de Koerden in Irak?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Keijzer over de hulp aan gewonde oud-militair die met Koerden vocht tegen ISIS

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Health about the plight of a seriously wounded former conscript who fought alongside Kurds against ISIS, and whether the government would help repatriate and treat him. The government answered that he was not a veteran, that consular assistance was provided, that he left Northern Iraq, and that without adequate insurance the state does not finance treatment or repatriation.
With due regard to the security aspect, the usual consular assistance was provided to the person concerned.
Met in achtneming van het veiligheidsaspect is aan betrokkene de gebruikelijke consulaire bijstand verleend.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over een bijeenkomst in Rijswijk op 8 maart 2015

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the ministers about a planned March 2015 event in Rijswijk featuring preachers linked to extremist views, including visa revocations, whether the organiser's ANBI status could be withdrawn, and the list of speakers. The government answered that visas for three speakers were revoked on public order grounds, that the event was scaled back, and that the tax authority could investigate ANBI status if signals warranted, but gave no commitment to a specific investigation.
Without going into individuals, it can be said that seven preachers had been invited to give lectures on 8 March.
Zonder in te gaan op individuen kan verteld worden dat zeven predikers waren uitgenodigd voor het geven van lezingen op 8 maart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een ter dood veroordeelde Iraniër

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saman Naseem, sentenced for an offence committed as a minor, faces imminent execution in Iran, whether execution of juvenile offenders violates treaties Iran is party to, and whether he was tortured during trial, and asked the minister to contact Iranian counterparts. The minister confirmed the reports, that execution of juvenile offenders is prohibited under treaties, denied torture, and said the EU and the Netherlands had demarched Iran and urged it to halt the execution.
Following reports of the imminent execution of Saman Naseem, the EU, with Dutch support, made a demarche to the Iranian authorities.
Naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de op handen zijnde executie van Saman Naseem heeft de EU, met steun van NL, bij de Iraanse autoriteiten gedemarcheerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Imams hebben visum voor benefiet in Rijswijk al binnen’

An SGP MP asked whether imams invited to a Rijswijk event had already received visas, whether visas could be refused or withdrawn for radical preachers, and whether criteria should be tightened and EU-level action taken. The government confirmed three visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, said current Schengen criteria suffice, and saw no reason to tighten them or raise the issue in the EU.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over maatregelen na de falende visumaanpak inzake extremistische imams

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government how extremist imams obtained visas that were later revoked, whether individual visa checks and a blacklist will be strengthened, what steps follow against the organiser of a jihadist gala, and whether other ANBI-status organisations facilitating such preachers should lose that status. The Minister answered that the visa procedure was correctly followed, that risk profiles are being enriched and visas can be revoked on new information, that the event was not prohibited but was changed after visas were withdrawn, and that the Tax Authority can investigate ANBI status where there are signals.
In the visa granting to the three imams, nothing went wrong in the procedure.
Bij de visumverlening aan de drie imams is in de procedure niets fout gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat het verslag van de diplomatenbriefing geheim blijft

An MP asked why the government will not send the report of the diplomatic briefing on MH17 to parliament, even confidentially, and whether withholding it limits parliamentary scrutiny. The minister answered that the report is confidential, was given to the Safety Board (OVV) for its ongoing independent investigation, that only its gist was shared with parliament, and that findings will be shared later.
The report has been made available to the OVV in accordance with the Safety Board Act, for the purpose of the ongoing and independent investigation.
Het verslag is ter beschikking gesteld aan de OVV in overeenstemming met de rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid, ten behoeve van het lopende en onafhankelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Cyprus Rusland aanbiedt bases te openen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Cyprus offered Russia air and naval bases, whether an agreement was imminent, and whether this conflicts with EU sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, denied knowledge of a signing announcement, noted Cyprus's denial of bases and mention of maintenance and spare-parts contracts, and said the EU arms embargo and sanctions remain in place with no reason to think Cyprus would breach them.

The cabinet has no reason to assume that Cyprus intends to act in breach of the sanctions regime or to distance itself from the Union's previously adopted common positions on Russia's actions in Ukraine.

Het kabinet heeft geen reden om aan te nemen dat Cyprus voornemens zou zijn in strijd met het sanctieregime te handelen of zich te distantiëren van de eerder aangenomen gemeenschappelijke standpunten van de Unie over het Russische optreden in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over visserij voor de kust van de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch-flagged fishing off Western Sahara, including the legal basis for treating the activity as lawful, whether local population consent is required, and how fishing revenues benefit the local population. The minister defended the UN position treating Morocco as de facto administering power, stated that consent of the indigenous population's representatives is not currently required under international law though consultation should occur, and described EU payments and 31 Morocco-reported projects, 13 of them in Western Sahara, with reporting due at the next joint committee.

The Netherlands is of the view that the proceeds of fishing through EU payments for access to, among other waters, the waters of Western Sahara, where Morocco exercises de facto authority, should also benefit the original population of Western Sahara.

Nederland is van oordeel dat de opbrengsten van de visserij via de EU-afdrachten ten behoeve van toegang tot onder meer de wateren van de Westelijke Sahara, waar Marokko feitelijk gezag uitoefent, ook ten goede moeten komen aan de oorspronkelijke bevolking van de Westelijke Sahara.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de smokkel van wapens en munitie naar ISIS en Al Nusra, via Turkije

An MP from CDA asks the Foreign Minister about a UN monitoring report finding that most weapons held by ISIS and Al Nusra were seized or smuggled, mainly via Turkey, and whether Turkey should be pressed to act. The minister answers that smuggling cannot be fully prevented, that Turkey has repeatedly assured it will counter smuggling, that the government cannot confirm Turkish state support to jihadists, and that the matter is raised in bilateral contacts.
The cabinet cannot confirm that Turkey provides support to jihadist organisations.
Daarnaast kan het kabinet niet bevestigen dat Turkije steun levert aan jihadistische organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de sluiting van een theologische hogeschool in Jakarta

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of a theological college in Jakarta, whether the embassy had mediated, and what the implications are for religious freedom in Indonesia and bilateral relations. The minister answered that the dispute appears non-religious, concerning a missing permit and a municipal relocation order, that the Netherlands raises religious minority issues regularly with Indonesia, and that there are no consequences for bilateral relations.
Based on the above information, this case appears to be a non-religiously motivated dispute between the school and the local authorities.
Op basis van bovengenoemde informatie lijkt in dit geval sprake te zijn van een niet-religieus gemotiveerd geschil tussen de school en de lokale autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Jasper vanDijk (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de Nederlandse luchtaanval in Mali (ingezonden 23 januari 2015).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a Dutch Apache air strike in Mali near Tabankort, the protests in Kidal, casualties, the UN mandate, and the peace process. The ministers answered that the strike was defensive under the UN mandate, that casualties are not yet officially confirmed and are under investigation, and that the peace process continues.
How many dead and injured are to be regretted exactly has not yet been officially established. Research into this is still being conducted.
Hoeveel doden en gewonden er precies te betreuren zijn is nog niet officieel vastgesteld. Hiernaar wordt nog onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Verheijen over activiteiten van Turkije in de exclusieve economische zone van Cyprus

MPs Van Bommel and Verheijen asked whether Turkish seismic survey activity in Cyprus's exclusive economic zone is illegal and whether the government will condemn it. The minister said Turkey is not party to UNCLOS, the maritime boundary is disputed, the survey is provocative and unhelpful, and the Netherlands regrets it, but did not call it illegal.
Nederland betreurt de acties van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over zijn uitspraken ten aanzien van een Europese zetel in de VN Veiligheidsraad

Dutch MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about his statements on reforming the UN Security Council and a permanent EU seat, including EU support, the veto, and the 2017 campaign. The minister answered that the Netherlands actively pushes Security Council reform, supports a French initiative to limit veto use in mass atrocities, deems an EU seat feasible, and will include reform in its 2017 campaign.
The cabinet is not in favour of new veto rights.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van nieuwe vetorechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de stop op Duitse wapenexport naar Saoedi-Arabië

De Roon (PVV) asked whether Germany had halted arms exports to Saudi Arabia, on what grounds, whether the Netherlands was informed, and whether the Netherlands would also stop exports. Minister Koenders replied that media reports of a German halt were incorrect, that Dutch and German case-by-case assessments continue, and that the government opposes a unilateral total stop.
The cabinet is not in favour of a全 general stop on arms exports to Saudi Arabia.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een algehele stop op wapenexport naar Saudi-Arabië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse informatiepositie in aanloop naar de MH-17 ramp

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Foreign Affairs and Defence about the Dutch government's information position before the MH-17 downing, including what was known about downed aircraft, Ukrainian airspace warnings, the July 2014 Ukraine briefing and the role of the OVV and CTIVD. The government answered most questions by pointing to the ongoing OVV and prosecution investigations, stating it had no validated list of downed aircraft and that Ukraine gave no warnings beyond NOTAMs, while committing to share the briefing report and correspondence with the OVV.
We consider it of the utmost importance that the Public Prosecution Service can continue its investigation unhindered.
Wij achten het van het grootste belang dat het OM het onderzoek ongehinderd kan blijven verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Kerstens en Servaes over het bericht ‘FIFA: Welzijn arbeiders Qatar niet onze zaak’

PvdA MPs asked whether the government would press the KNVB, the ITUC and FIFA's president to take responsibility for migrant worker conditions building World Cup 2022 stadiums in Qatar. The minister said the government is concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, wants FIFA to publish its bid report, and considers the KNVB proactive and the ITUC capable of acting itself, but said it cannot compel FIFA's president to explain publicly.
I note a proactive attitude from the KNVB regarding the position of migrant workers and will remain in discussion with them about it.
Ik constateer een pro-actieve houding van de KNVB over de positie van arbeidsmigranten en blijf hierover met hen in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over rapportages waaruit blijkt dat de EU honderden woningen laat verrijzen voor Palestijnen in de zogenaamde C-gebieden op de West Bank

Two MPs asked whether EU-funded housing structures for Palestinians in Area C of the West Bank are lawful and whether the EU is creating facts on the ground, and whether it will stop cooperating. The minister said the EU supports humanitarian needs of Palestinian and Bedouin communities facing demolitions, that no new facts are created since the people already lived there, and rejected calling on the EU to stop.
Do you see reason to raise these alleged illegal structures in European context and to promote that the EU immediately stops its cooperation in creating facts on the ground, if proven?

Ziet u aanleiding om genoemde illegale bouwwerken in Europees verband aan te kaarten en te bevorderen dat de EU onmiddellijk haar medewerking, indien bewezen, aan het creëren van feiten op de grond stopt?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over slavernij en de arrestatie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the arrest and imprisonment of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania and about slavery there, and whether the government will raise these issues with Mauritanian authorities and in international fora. The minister confirms Abeid's two-year sentence, says the EU, UN and US have urged a fair trial and an end to repression, and states the Netherlands raises slavery through EU channels and the ILO-based Universal Periodic Review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over doodstraf op importeren bijbel in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP from the SGP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi Arabia had adopted a law imposing the death penalty for importing the Bible, what the consequences would be for Christians, and whether the government would press Saudi authorities on freedom of religion. The minister replied that the report appears to be a misunderstanding, that the cited law is over 30 years old, and that no new legislation exists, so no separate démarche is planned beyond raising religious freedom generally.
Since there does not appear to be any new legislation, I see no reason to raise this with Saudi Arabia.
Aangezien er geen sprake lijkt te zijn van nieuwe wetgeving zie ik geen aanleiding om Saoedi-Arabië hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Syrië bezig is met de ontwikkeling van kernwapens

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Syria may be developing nuclear weapons, including the likelihood of Hezbollah, North Korean and Iranian assistance, the reported underground storage site near Qusayr, and whether Dutch intelligence has enough capacity to investigate independently. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, cited the IAEA's 2011 conclusions on the destroyed Dair Alzour reactor, said the Qusayr reports cannot be confirmed, and stated that the cabinet values independent intelligence but would not disclose the capacity of the intelligence services.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the capacity of the intelligence services.
Over de capaciteit van de inlichtingendiensten kan het kabinet in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de rechter opnieuw heeft bepaald dat het korten van kinderbijslag onwettig is

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government will keep litigating over the export-residence principle (woonlandbeginsel) after courts repeatedly ruled that cutting child benefit for children in Morocco is unlawful, and asked about legal costs, Moroccan project funding, and diplomatic fallout from terminating the social security treaty with Morocco. The minister answered that the law was passed by parliament, that the government respects rulings and continues litigation where needed for clarity, that legal costs are budgeted within structural implementation costs, that a Moroccan funding freeze is Morocco's own decision, and that the government will seek to revise the treaty and submit a termination approval bill to parliament.
Where it turns out that the export-residence principle cannot be applied, the cabinet has of course respected those rulings.
Waar blijkt dat woonlandbeginsel niet kan worden toegepast, heeft het kabinet deze uitspraken uiteraard gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht ‘Israël draait de geldkraan dicht’

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Israel withheld Palestinian Authority tax revenues as retaliation for the Palestinian ICC membership bid, whether this lacks legal basis or amounts to collective punishment, and what the government will do about it. The minister confirms a temporary suspension tied to the ICC bid, says the legal question is for the Oslo parties, and states the government has urged Israel to resume payments and raised it at EU level, while welcoming Palestinian adherence to international law.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2015

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Open Doors 2015 ranking of Christian persecution, whether religious freedom should get more weight in foreign policy, whether a thematic country report on Nigeria, Kenya and China would be prepared, and whether more countries would be added to the religious freedom pilot. The minister answered that religious freedom is a priority and that the pilot countries, with an evaluation to follow in the 2014 human rights report, may be adjusted depending on the outcome, while declining a thematic report for Kenya and China, citing low asylum inflow.
Depending on the outcome of the evaluation, it will be examined whether countries are added to or removed from the pilot.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst van de evaluatie zal bekeken worden of landen aan de pilot worden toegevoegd of verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat Polen drie spookvliegvelden heeft laten bouwen met subsidie van de EU

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Poland built three barely used airports with EU subsidies, including the amounts, causes, consequences for funding, lessons for the Commission and whether monitoring should be tightened. The minister replied that about 66 million euro went to the named airports under cohesion funds, pointed to a European Court of Auditors report on airport overcapacity, said the matter is for the EU institutions and that Dutch policy favours stricter monitoring of cohesion funds.
I leave such an assessment at project level to the responsible European institutions.
Ik laat een dergelijke beoordeling op projectniveau aan de verantwoordelijke Europese instellingen over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over het bericht dat het vonnis van de Saoedische blogger Raif Badawi uitgevoerd zal worden

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Saudi blogger Raif Badawi would receive public flogging, and what the EU and the Netherlands were doing to prevent it. The minister said the EU and the Netherlands have repeatedly raised the case and condemned the punishment, but that it has not yet led to a revision of the sentence, and that the case was referred back to the Supreme Court.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work, both bilaterally and within the EU, to improve the situation of human rights defenders in Saudi Arabia.
Nederland zal zich zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband actief blijven inzetten om de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Saoedi-Arabië te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat de Organisatie voor het Verbod op Chemische Wapens heeft bevestigd dat er chloorgas is gebruikt in Syrië

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the OPCW's confirmation of chlorine gas use in Syria, the non-publication of the third FFM report, attribution to the Syrian regime, and whether the UN Security Council should address it. Minister Koenders answered that the report is not secret but not posted online, that it adds detail rather than new conclusions, that attribution was outside the FFM mandate and helicopter use is a strong but not hard indication, and that formal UNSC agenda-setting is unlikely due to Russia though eight members sent the report.
It is not secret, although it has not been posted on the OPCW website.
Het is niet geheim, hoewel het niet op de website van de OPCW is geplaatst.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over Nederlandse steun aan het Jordaanse Media Instituut in relatie tot uitlatingen over Hamas

An MP asked whether the Dutch embassy in Amman sponsors a Jordanian media institute that presents Hamas figure Ahlam Tamimi as a role model, and whether Dutch funds should be used this way. The minister confirms awareness of the report and refers to earlier answers to parallel questions, providing no new substance.
See the answer on the previous page (questions from Van Klaveren and Bontes)
Zie antwoord op voorgaande pagina (vragen Van Klaveren en Bontes)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse steun aan het Jordaanse Media Instituut in relatie tot uitlatingen over Hamas

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers whether Dutch support to the Jordan Media Institute was acceptable given that an article on its website praised a Hamas-linked figure as a role model, and whether funding should be withdrawn or other donors urged to stop. The minister answered that the funded women's rights project had no link to the article, the institute said the article was written by a student and has been removed, and there is no reason to reclaim funds or urge other donors to act.
There is no connection whatsoever between the article on the JMI website and the project supported by the Netherlands.
Er is geen enkele relatie tussen het artikel op de website van het JMI en het door Nederland gesteunde project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Hamas mogelijk van de Europese terreurlijst verdwijnt

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas might be removed from the EU terrorist list after a General Court ruling, and whether the designation was based on media reports. The minister answered that the court annulled the listing on procedural grounds but kept its effects for three months, so Hamas remains listed for now, that the Council may appeal or re-list, and that the government will work with other member states to address the defects.
The General Court decided to annul the listing on procedural grounds.
Het Gerecht heeft besloten de plaatsing op de lijst nietig te verklaren, wegens procedurele gebreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gevaarlijke uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de EU dat Hamas van de terreurlijst af moet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister about the EU General Court ruling that annulled Hamas's listing on the EU terrorist list, and what follow-up steps the government would take. The minister replied that the ruling was on procedural grounds only, that the listing remains in force for three months, and that the Council may re-adopt the measure or appeal, with the Netherlands working with other member states to address the defects.
The Netherlands will work with other member states to address the defects identified by the General Court.
Nederland zal zich met andere lidstaten inzetten om de door het Gerecht geconstateerde gebreken te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat een medewerkster van de Nederlandse ambassade in Bagdad gevoelige informatie zou hebben gelekt

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether a local employee at the Dutch embassy in Baghdad had leaked sensitive information to Iraqi intelligence, whether screening of embassy staff is adequate, and whether military personnel could be endangered. The government answered that an investigation found no evidence of leaking or selling information, that screening of local staff is done as well as possible, and that no defence information appears compromised.

The investigation, in which the Ministry of Defence was also involved, has now been completed and no indications were found that the employee in question leaked or sold information to the Iraqi intelligence service.

Het onderzoek, waarbij ook het Ministerie van Defensie betrokken was, is inmiddels voltooid en er zijn geen aanwijzingen gevonden dat betrokken medewerkster informatie heeft gelekt dan wel heeft verkocht aan de Iraakse inlichtingendienst.
