Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Marokko dat asielzoekers gaat opvangen voor de EU

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the EU paying Morocco to host asylum seekers, whether reception in the region should be prioritised over resettlement in the Netherlands, and whether an immigration opt-out is the best solution. The State Secretary answered that the government supports regional reception, that Morocco is implementing its own asylum system, that the Dublin-based right to asylum cannot be guaranteed to be avoided, and that structural solutions lie in countries of origin.
Because of the diversity of the activities and because part of it concerns staff deployment, it is not possible to state which amounts are involved.
Vanwege de diversiteit van de activiteiten en omdat het voor een deel ook personele inzet betreft, is het niet mogelijk aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee zijn gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over onderhandelingen met rebellen inzake MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch forensic team's project leader negotiated with separatist leader Borodai over MH17 victims' repatriation, whether this contradicted the cabinet's no-direct-negotiation principle, and whether there were other such talks. The government answered that contact was via the OSCE with the embassy informed, that there was no direct negotiation, and that all contact went through the OSCE.
No. There was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Nee. Er was geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de reconstructie van gebeurtenissen na de aanslag op de MH17 in het politievakblad Blauw

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about a Blauw police magazine reconstruction of the Dutch forensic team's work after MH17, including contacts with separatist leader Borodai, a request to Van Vliet to approach separatists, and surprise at Malaysian investigators on the train. The government answered that no direct negotiations took place, that contacts ran via the OSCE, that the SGBO asked Van Vliet to arrange access via the OSCE, and that the Malaysian presence was on Malaysia's own initiative with no concrete cooperation agreements yet.
On 21 July there was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Er was op 21 juli geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het aantal neergeschoten helikopters en vliegtuigen boven Oost-Oekraïne voorafgaand aan de ramp van 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the government how many aircraft and helicopters were shot down over eastern Ukraine before the MH17 disaster, what the cabinet knew on 17 July 2014, and related questions about Dutch monitoring, a 14 July briefing, and prosecution timing. The government answered that the numbers were unverified and no validated list could be provided, that no specific airspace consultations took place, and that prosecution options cannot yet be disclosed because the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Both the number and the causes are unclear and not validated.
Zowel het aantal als ook de oorzaken zijn onduidelijk en niet gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of anti-slavery activists in Mauritania, including their treatment, fair trial prospects and whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister replied that the activists remain detained awaiting trial, that Biram Abeid is treated well, that the EU, UN and US press for a fair trial, and that the EU and the Netherlands have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities.
The European Union has expressed its serious concerns about this to the Prime Minister of Mauritania and continues to follow this matter very closely.
De Europese Unie heeft zijn ernstige zorgen hierover uitgesproken bij de Premier van Mauritanië en blijft deze zaak zeer nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de uitvoering van de motie aangaande het tegengaan van straffeloosheid voor genocide in Guatemala

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister how the motion to counter impunity for genocide in Guatemala has been implemented and what the government will do next. The minister answered that legal pressure on prosecutions has grown, lists steps taken (embassy visits, EU statements, plans for an additional staff member and a human rights ambassador visit, and support for extending CICIG's mandate), though the answers stay largely at the level of diplomatic activity.
The Netherlands will advocate bilaterally and within the EU that Guatemala request an extension of CICIG's mandate.
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband bepleiten dat Guatemala een verlenging van het mandaat van CICIG verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat er enkele doden zijn gevallen bij een aanslag op een VN-konvooi nabij de luchthaven van Somalië

MP De Roon asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly attack on a UN convoy near Mogadishu airport, the safety of Dutch EUTM Somalia personnel, the security threat in Mogadishu, Al-Shabaab's strength, Kenya's role, and whether the Dutch training contribution should be withdrawn. The ministers answered that no Dutch personnel were present at the convoy, the mission remains in Mogadishu with security measures, and they will not end the Dutch contribution, while declining to engage on religious questions.
There were no Dutch nationals present with the UN convoy when the attack was carried out.
Er waren geen Nederlanders aanwezig bij het VN-konvooi toen de aanslag werd gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Segers, Dijkgraaf en Thieme over het wachtgeld voor de voorzitter van de Europese Raad

Five MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the EU transitional allowance (wachtgeld) for the outgoing President of the European Council, who had already reached pensionable age and could draw his Belgian pension alongside it, and about pension accrual rates and job-seeking obligations. The minister confirmed the facts, said the EU rules (Regulation 422/67/EEG) cap the allowance at three years with no job-seeking duty, and said the Netherlands is willing to examine modernising and reducing the scheme, though any change requires Council action.
The Netherlands is willing to examine whether modernising and reducing the current scheme for political office holders in the EU is possible
Nederland is bereid te bekijken of modernisering en versobering van de huidige regeling voor politieke ambtsdragers in de EU mogelijk is

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Verheijen over de massale arrestatie van journalisten, de afkeurende reactie van de Europese Commissie en de mogelijke gevolgen voor de steun vanuit de EU aan Turkije

MPs Omtzigt and Verheijen asked the Foreign Minister about the mass arrest of Turkish journalists, the Commission's condemnation, and whether EU pre-accession aid to Turkey should be frozen or cut. The minister agreed the arrests are incompatible with EU values, noted the IPA performance reward mechanism, and said Netherlands pushed for consequences for aid at the General Affairs Council, though no broader support existed and it is for the Commission to propose measures.

At the Council, the Netherlands also pointed to the performance reward anchored in the new IPA regulation and argued that current developments should have consequences for financial support to Turkey.

Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad eveneens gewezen op de prestatiebeloning die in de nieuwe IPA-verordering verankerd zit en ervoor gepleit dat de huidige ontwikkelingen consequenties zouden moeten hebben voor de financiële steun aan Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de nieuwe transparantieregels van de Commissie

Two Labour MPs asked the Foreign and Interior Ministers about the European Commission's new rules requiring Commissioners and senior staff to publicly report meetings with lobbyists, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister supported the Commission's rules, said the Netherlands pushes for Council participation in the transparency register, and said Dutch ministers and officials are bound by integrity rules with consultation reported in explanatory memoranda, promising to further strengthen transparency of the legislative process.

The Cabinet encourages the growing use of internetconsultatie.nl and is examining how the visibility and predictability of the legislative process and the accountability for it can be further strengthened.

Het Kabinet stimuleert de groeiende inzet van internetconsultatie.nl en beziet op welke wijze de kenbaarheid en de voorspelbaarheid van het wetgevingsproces en de verantwoording daarover verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een rapport over Amerikaanse aanvallen met onbemande vliegtuigen in Pakistan en Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report claiming US drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen killed up to 1,147 people, many civilians, and about proportionality and US transparency. The minister said the cabinet lacks enough information to judge the strikes, stressed proportionality and transparency efforts, and declined to seek specific clarification from the US, Pakistan or Yemen.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to request further information specifically about this report.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om specifiek over dit rapport nadere informatie te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het hoofdkwartier van Hamas in Turkije

CDA MP Knops asked the ministers whether Turkey hosts a Hamas headquarters from which attacks on Israel are organised and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey, the EU or NATO on this. The government could not confirm the reports, saw no need for an independent investigation, declined to put the matter on the NATO ministerial agenda, and said it is critical of Turkey where necessary.
The cabinet cannot confirm this reporting.
Het kabinet kan deze berichtgeving niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de vernieling van diverse kerken in Khartoum door het regime in Sudan

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about the demolition of churches in Khartoum, arrests of church members, a claimed ban on new church construction, and whether the government would protest and seek further sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the seizures as stemming from a land dispute and missing permits, said the ban was announced in 2012 and is unclear in writing, and stated the Netherlands raises religious freedom bilaterally and in EU and UN fora but sees no current plans for new sanctions.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of Dutch human rights policy; the cabinet therefore rejects any obstacle a government places on people in practising their faith.

Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de speerpunten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid, elke belemmering die een overheid aan mensen oplegt in de uitvoering van hun geloof keurt het kabinet daarom af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het Senaatsrapport betreffende CIA detenties en ondervragingen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the US Senate torture report proves US torture of terror suspects, whether impunity should be ended, whether the Netherlands extradited suspects to the US, and whether the EU should press for investigation of member states' complicity. The minister answered that the practices violate international standards, that prosecution is for US judicial authorities, that only one terror suspect has been extradited to the US with assurances of ordinary trial, and that Netherlands will raise the matter at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
Since 11 September 2001, one terrorism suspect has been extradited to the US.
Sinds 11 september 2001 is er één verdachte van terrorisme aan de VS uitgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the composition of the Joint Investigation Team on MH17, Malaysia's role, Ukraine's veto and non-disclosure arrangements, and who is examining the flight route decisions. The government answered that Malaysia is already formally involved and will join as a member, that the JIT agreement is confidential because it contains operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation, and that the Dutch Safety Board is examining route decisions without addressing liability.
We therefore cannot make the agreement regarding the JIT public.
De overeenkomst met betrekking tot het JIT kunnen wij daarom niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de stand van zaken rondom de rampplek MH17

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether wreckage and personal belongings remain at the MH17 crash site after the recovery mission, and about the security situation there. The government answered that some wreckage and possible remains remain at burn sites and north of Petropavlivka, that recovery will resume after winter if security allows, and that the frontline is a few kilometres north of the site.
After winter, and if the security situation allows, the repatriation mission will resume its work at the crash site.
Na de winter, en indien de veiligheidssituatie dit toelaat, zal de repatriëringsmissie haar werkzaamheden op de rampplek hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de richtlijn aangaande registratie van het geboorteland van in Palestina geboren personen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked why the civil registry directive records people born in East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip or West Bank after 14 May 1948 as birthplace 'Onbekend' rather than Palestine, and whether this causes problems. The Minister replied that the Palestine mandate ended on 14 May 1948, the territories are treated as occupied under international law, and the Netherlands has not recognised a Palestinian state, while acknowledging no problems are known and that other EU states use different practices.
For that reason, the birthplace 'Unknown' was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor geboorteland «Onbekend».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de schending van vrouwenrechten in Hongarije

PvdA MPs Maij and Yücel asked the government about a Hungarian police video that appeared to blame victims of sexual assault, and about the state of women's rights in Hungary and the EU. The minister condemned the video's suggestion that victims are responsible, described Hungary's uneven legal protections, and pointed to EU rule-of-law initiatives and a planned discussion in the Council.
The cabinet is working on this within the EU along two tracks.
Het kabinet zet zich hiervoor binnen de EU in langs twee sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van 78 minderjarigen in Egypte

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the sentencing of 78 minors in Egypt for joining pro-Morsi rallies, the scale of repression against opponents, and a draft anti-terrorism law. The minister confirmed the sentencing, said hard figures are lacking, expressed concern, and committed to continued dialogue with Egyptian authorities on human rights.
However, it is not possible to verify the numbers.
Het is echter niet mogelijk aantallen te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het snel willen instemmen met de nieuwe richtlijn voor pensioenen in de EU zonder de Kamer daarover tijdig en adequaat te informeren

Omtzigt (CDA) asked why the government sent a 79-page compromis on the EU IORP pensions directive only days before the Coreper vote, without prior briefing as promised, and asked it to postpone agreement until January 2015. The Staatssecretaris replied that the government kept its promised information, sent a progress letter in October and an appreciation on 4 December, and that a deal needed to be reached before the Italian presidency ended, so postponement was not desirable.
We attach great importance to these agreements and are of the view that we have informed the House of Representatives as well as possible.
Wij hechten zeer aan deze afspraken en zijn van mening dat we de Tweede Kamer zo goed mogelijk geïnformeerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de misstanden bij de aanleg van de bouw- en infraprojecten voor het WK 2022 in Qatar

MPs Servaes, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Foreign Minister about serious labour abuses, including deaths, in preparations for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, and what the government has done about them. The minister answered that the government remains concerned, raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, plans a human rights ambassador visit to Qatar in 2015 with a report to parliament, supports the ILO investigation, and has contact with the KNVB without detailing outcomes.
In 2015 a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Qatar is envisaged, where labour rights will also be discussed. A report of this visit will be provided to the House of Representatives.
In 2015 wordt een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Qatar beoogd waar het onderwerp arbeidsrechten ook besproken zal worden. Van dit bezoek zal verslag worden gedaan aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse racismebeschuldiging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed that Turkey makes itself ridiculous by accusing the Netherlands of racism, and whether he would raise Turkish-minority integration problems, Turkish-funded mosques, and the EU accession talks with Turkey. The minister said he had phoned his Turkish counterpart to express concern and reiterated that the Netherlands runs its own integration policy, but gave no concrete commitment on the accession talks, which he refused to stop.
No. Turkey is a candidate member state, negotiations have been ongoing since 2005, and are conducted according to the criteria previously discussed with the House.
Nee. Turkije is kandidaatlidstaat, onderhandelingen vinden plaats sinds 2005, en worden gevoerd volgens de eerder met Uw Kamer besproken criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over beschuldiging van het Turkse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken dat Nederland de Turkse gemeenschap discrimineert

The MP asks whether the Foreign Minister raised with his Turkish counterpart the Turkish ministry's accusation that the Netherlands discriminates against Turks, and whether that statement will be removed from the website. The minister replies that he expressed serious concerns the same day, that the Turkish side clarified no accusation against the Dutch government or people was intended, and that a public spokesperson's remarks cannot formally be withdrawn.
I pointed out that the Netherlands conducts its own integration policy and that interference by other countries is not appropriate in this regard.
Ik heb erop gewezen dat Nederland een eigen integratiebeleid voert en hierbij geen inmenging van andere landen past.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aantijgingen van de Turkse racismebeschuldiging

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's accusations of Dutch racism and aggression were justified, whether the Turkish ambassador should be summoned, and whether the Patriot missiles should be withdrawn early. The minister replied that he had raised the remarks with the ambassador and Turkish counterpart, that Turkey denied accusing the Dutch state or people, and that the Patriots stay in place as NATO protection.
I see no reason to deny our NATO ally this protection of our Patriots and to withdraw these systems earlier than announced.
Ik zie geen reden om onze NAVO-bondgenoot deze bescherming van onze patriots te ontzeggen en deze systemen eerder dan aangekondigd terug te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Russische agressie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about growing Russian military assertiveness, NATO's response, defence spending toward the 2% target, and whether the Russian ambassador would be summoned over unannounced bomber flights. The government answered that assertive Russian behaviour has increased, described NATO's reassurance and Readiness Action Plan measures, pointed to a letter on defence spending, and said the ministry had already raised concerns with Russia's chargé d'affaires.
On 30 October the Ministry of Foreign Affairs conveyed the Dutch concerns about the unannounced flights to the chargé d'affaires of the Russian embassy at senior official level.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft op 30 oktober jl. op hoogambtelijk niveau in een onderhoud met de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Russische ambassade de Nederlandse zorgen over de onaangekondigde vluchten overgebracht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over taartverbod in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Saudi Arabia of bakery staff over cupcakes with text critical of Islam, and whether the Netherlands would act for their release and suggest an ambassador present a cake to the King. The minister confirmed the arrests and that the case is ongoing, said the Netherlands values free expression and raises it with Saudi authorities, and called the cake suggestion poor taste.
The Netherlands attaches great importance to freedom of expression and advocates it worldwide.
Nederland hecht groot belang aan de vrijheid van meningsuiting en bepleit dit wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het wapenembargo tegen Rusland, de Franse Mistraldeal en samenwerking tussen Europese wapenleveranciers en Russische strijdkrachten

Two MPs asked whether the Mistral helicopter carrier deal would be delivered to Russia despite the arms embargo, how Europe's arms makers could cooperate with Russian forces, and about the embargo's status and enforcement. The minister replied that France decides on delivery, that the government shares France's view that conditions are not right for delivery, that the embargo does not cover pre-August 2014 contracts, that it runs until 31 July 2015, and that the Netherlands will raise enforcement issues in Brussels.
The government has no insight into deliveries above 1 million euros from EU member states based on contracts concluded before 1 August 2014.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in leveringen van boven de 1 miljoen euro vanuit EU-lidstaten op basis van voor 1 augustus 2014 gesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een bufferzone aan de Egyptische grens met Gaza

The MP Van Bommel asks about Egypt's buffer zone along the Gaza border, including demolished homes, compensation for affected residents, and effects on Gaza access and cross-border trade. The minister confirms the demolitions (1,156 households), says Egypt has promised compensation, notes the buffer has little effect on Gaza beyond destroying smuggling tunnels, and states the Dutch concern has been conveyed to the Egyptian ambassador.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has already conveyed the Dutch concerns on this matter to the Egyptian ambassador in the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Nederlandse zorgen hieromtrent reeds overgebracht aan de Egyptische ambassadeur in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Duitse ambassadeur aanstaande zondag ook Duitse SS’ers wil herdenken

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the German ambassador would commemorate SS members in the Netherlands, asking who attended and whether this trivialises Nazi crimes. The minister confirmed attendance by local officials and military personnel and argued the ceremony honours all war victims rather than SS members, while declining to commit to preventing attendance.
The ceremony at the Ysselsteyn cemetery is not intended as a "commemoration of SS members".
De ceremonie op de begraafplaats Ysselsteyn is niet bedoeld als een «herdenking van SS’ers».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over MH17 (opnieuw en nu met nagezonden bijlagen)

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about evidence on the MH17 downing, access to satellite and radar data, OSCE safety assessments, NOTAMs, shelling of the crash site, and Ukrainian search logs. The government answered that it cannot pre-empt the independent OVV and criminal investigations, declined to detail information requests for investigative reasons, and gave brief factual replies on the NOTAMs, OSCE contacts and search documents.
The Cabinet cannot anticipate the conclusions of these independent, international investigations by making statements about indications and the manner of verification.
Het Kabinet kan niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies uit deze onafhankelijke, internationale onderzoeken door uitspraken te doen over aanwijzingen en de wijze van verificatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt die mij gesteld zijn inzake het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer “Op weg naar correcte gegevens over het bruto nationaal inkomen (BNI): een meer gestructureerde en gerichte aanpak

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about European Court of Auditors criticism of EU GNI statistics that underpinned a 642 million euro extra payment by the Netherlands. The Finance Minister answered that the recommendations target the Commission and Eurostat, that the GNI committee found the data suitable for own resources, and that Eurostat's verification cycle is still pending, so the Netherlands must pay while other countries' revisions are being reviewed.
Based on the publicly released figures and Eurostat regulations, the Netherlands is obliged to pay the supplementary levy.
Op basis van de openbaar gemaakte cijfers en Eurostat regelgeving is Nederland gehouden de naheffing te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Oeganda nieuwe anti-homowetgeving voorbereidt

MPs Servaes and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister about reports of a new, stricter Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill and how the Netherlands would respond, including whether it would support an EU blacklist of officials and fund legal challenges. The minister said the draft's status is unclear but that the Netherlands opposes it, is pressing Uganda diplomatically with donors, funds human rights defenders and the Democratic Governance Facility, and is open to reconsidering legal aid if the issue returns.
The cabinet does share the view that it would be highly undesirable if such a bill were adopted.
Wel deelt het kabinet de opvatting dat het zeer onwenselijk zou zijn als een dergelijk wetsvoorstel zou worden aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Roon en Bosma over optreden van oproerpolitie in het parlement van Zuid-Afrika

Members De Roon and Bosma (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether South African riot police used force against opposition MPs in parliament and whether it was justified. The minister confirmed police were called to remove an EFF member from the chamber under South African rules, said it is not for the Dutch cabinet to judge the decision, and stated that the South African parliament itself should judge the matter.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether the decision to do so was justified in this case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of het besluit hiertoe in dit geval gerechtvaardigd was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over de Isla raffinaderij in relatie tot de EU-sancties

Two MPs asked whether processing Russian crude at the Venezuelan-run Isla refinery on Curaçao complies with EU sanctions against Russia, and how the Curaçao government is held to EU sanctions. The minister replied that the energy sanctions do not ban imports of Russian oil, that the refinery's dealings fall under Curaçao's autonomy, and that Curaçao's cooperation is being pressed via the Kingdom's Rijkssanctiewet.
The Cabinet has no information on economic cooperation between the Isla refinery on Curaçao and Russian companies.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie over economische samenwerkingsverbanden tussen de Isla raffinaderij op Curaçao en Russische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat een Iraanse mensenrechtenactiviste weer is opgepakt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the temporary arrest of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh and other demonstrators protesting acid attacks on women, and whether the government would raise this with Iran. The minister regretted the arrests, said the Dutch embassy would raise the case with Iranian authorities, and noted a recommendation at the UN on freedom of expression.
The Dutch embassy in Tehran will raise this issue with the Iranian authorities where possible in its contacts.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Teheran zal in contacten met de Iraanse autoriteiten deze kwestie waar mogelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over monddood maken van advocaten door Saoedi-Arabië

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the sentencing of three Saudi human rights lawyers to prison terms and media and travel bans over tweets, and whether this violates freedom of expression. The minister confirmed the case, said the convictions were for insulting the judiciary and Sharia and undermining public order via social media, that free expression remains a concern raised with Saudi Arabia and EU partners, and that the lawyers can still appeal.
The Netherlands is also in close contact with EU partners about this specific case.
Nederland staat daarnaast in nauw contact met EU-partners over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terrorismeverheerlijking door de Palestijnse leider Abbas

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Palestinian leader Abbas's reported praise of the would-be assassin of Yehuda Glick, and whether aid to the Palestinian Authority will be cut. The minister rejects the letter as contrary to official PA policy and unhelpful to de-escalation, says the Netherlands condemns terrorism and will raise the issue bilaterally, but does not commit to suspending the 16.3 million euro aid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in India

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the ministers about the Flawed Fabrics report on modern slavery and child labour in Indian textile supply chains, and whether mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence should be introduced. The minister answered that voluntary sector approaches are still early, that she is open to exploring EU-level mandatory due diligence, and that she raised the issue during her India visit and with the ILO, EU and OECD.

I am in favour of creating a more level playing field in terms of regulation. In that context I am willing to explore whether there are possibilities at European level to achieve mandatory supply-chain transparency and due diligence.

Ik ben wel voorstander van het creëren van een meer gelijk speelveld op het gebied van regelgeving. In dat kader ben ik bereid te verkennen of er in Europees verband mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot verplichte keten transparantie en due diligence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de inzet van clusterbommen in Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether cluster munitions have been used in Ukraine, including reported Ukrainian and separatist use in Donetsk, and whether the government will press parties to stop. The minister says the reports cannot yet be confirmed, that the OSCE will report, that the concern was raised with Ukraine and at UN and treaty fora, and that the cause of a Red Cross worker's death is not yet established.
These reports cannot yet be confirmed.
Deze berichten kunnen vooralsnog niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de berichten dat Koerdische strijders ISIS-strijders zouden executeren

MPs Van Bommel and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Kurdish fighters executed captured ISIS fighters and destroyed the Arab town of Barzan, and whether an independent inquiry into possible war crimes should be pressed for. The minister said the executions could not be confirmed, that executing hors de combat fighters is prohibited, that no further information on Barzan is known, and that the primary duty to investigate lies with Iraqi authorities, with calls already made to Iraqi and Kurdish authorities to treat prisoners humanely.
The duty to investigate alleged violations of international humanitarian law lies in the first instance with the Iraqi authorities.
De plicht tot het doen van onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht ligt in eerste instantie bij de Iraakse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over busvervoer op de bezette Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asks whether a planned Israeli pilot requiring Palestinian workers to return through the same checkpoint effectively excludes them from Israeli buses in the occupied West Bank, and whether the Minister will seek clarification and oppose discriminatory measures. The Minister answers that no official decision has been taken, that Palestinian workers retain the legal right to use public transport, that the embassy has requested an explanation, and that the government awaits Israel's answer to the attorney-general's request while monitoring the situation.
The cabinet is now awaiting the Israeli Minister of Defence's answer to the attorney-general's request in order to obtain more clarity on the announced measure.

Het kabinet is nu in afwachting van het antwoord van de Israëlische Minister van Defensie op het verzoek van de procureur-generaal teneinde meer duidelijkheid te verkrijgen over de aangekondigde maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat Palestijnen geweerd worden uit Israëlische bussen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Palestinians would be barred from Israeli buses in the West Bank and whether this breaches non-discrimination principles and harms peace talks. The minister said Israel as occupying power must respect humanitarian law and non-discrimination, that the government is awaiting Israel's Defence Minister's answer to a request for clarification, and that the embassy has asked Israeli authorities for an explanation.
The cabinet is awaiting the Israeli Defence Minister's response to the Attorney General's request for clarification in order to obtain more clarity about the announced measure.

Het kabinet is in afwachting van het antwoord van de Israëlische Minister van Defensie op het verzoek om opheldering van de procureur-generaal teneinde meer duidelijkheid te verkrijgen over de aangekondigde maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan bij de Conference of Parties van het United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change

MP Van Bommel asks whether Taiwan should obtain observer status at the UNFCCC Conference of Parties in Lima given Taiwan's relatively high CO2 emissions. Minister Koenders answers that Taiwan cannot become a party due to its status under the one-China policy, that involvement is warranted only in specific cases, and that a pragmatic arrangement already exists via the observer participation of ITRI.
Taiwan's participation may also be important in areas where Taiwan is such a major player that global coordination without Taiwan cannot be effective.
Deelname van Taiwan kan tevens van belang zijn op terreinen waar Taiwan een dermate grote speler is dat mondiale coördinatie zonder Taiwan niet effectief kan zijn.

Two CDA MPs ask the state secretary and development minister whether organic cotton is always truly organic, how certification works in the Netherlands and Europe, and whether rapid cotton expansion weakens supply-chain control. The government answers that certification is done by private bodies outside public control, that it has no direct instruments to improve it, and that it supports multi-stakeholder initiatives and NGO work instead.
The cabinet has no direct instruments or possibilities to improve the certification.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe instrumenten of mogelijkheden om de certificering te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over een verklaring van nationale politiehoofden die betrekking heeft op end-to-end- encryptie

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the Justice Minister about a European police chiefs' call to weaken end-to-end encryption and how it relates to rulings by the ECtHR, CJEU and EDPB. The minister answered that the government keeps its existing position supporting end-to-end encryption, that lawful access should be sought through European cooperation, and that the rulings are not inconsistent with that position.
That position is not up for discussion here.
3 Dit standpunt staat hier niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het opschorten van de AI-plannen van Meta na druk toezichthouders

An MP asks the government whether Meta may use users' photos and posts to train AI models under GDPR, DMA and the AI Act, whether its legitimate-interest claim holds, and whether opt-in, collective objection and EU coordination are possible. The minister answers that the assessment of lawfulness lies with the data protection authorities (AP and the Irish DPC), that the DMA may apply, that the government will not intervene in individual cases, and that no joint EU position is being prepared.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether Meta's plans are acceptable, but primarily for the supervisory authority.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of de plannen van Meta acceptabel zijn, maar in de eerste plaats aan de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Krul over het toezicht op webwinkels als Temu, AliExpres en Shein

MPs Inge van Dijk and Krul asked the ministers about oversight of Temu, Shein and AliExpress, covering unfair trade practices, dark patterns, product safety, privacy, Chinese ties and BNPL promotion. The minister answered that existing EU and Dutch rules and the ACM, NVWA and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are responsible, pointed to pending EU initiatives such as the fitness check, DSA and product safety regulation, and declined to order investigations or disclose details of internal app measures.
Because of this confidentiality, I cannot go further into these measures.
Door deze vertrouwelijkheid kan ik dan ook niet verder ingaan op deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize, Six Dijkstra en Rajkowski over de kabinetsbrief Gemelde kwetsbaarheid Cisco Webex vergadervoorziening

MPs Valize, Six Dijkstra and Rajkowski asked about a Cisco Webex vulnerability that exposed metadata of government meetings, whether calls could be joined by phone, and which classification levels may be discussed on Webex. The State Secretary answered that Webex may be used up to Departementaal VERTROUWELIJK, that no Dutch cases of misuse are known, and that the Cisco vulnerability disclosure process will be discussed with Cisco.
However, no cases are known in the Netherlands in which unauthorised users attended confidential video meetings of the national government.
Binnen Nederland zijn echter geen gevallen bekend waarbij ongeautoriseerde gebruikers vertrouwelijke videovergaderingen van de Rijksoverheid hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht dat werknemers in een brief stellen dat OpenAI roekeloos is en dat het ontbreekt aan toezicht

An MP asked the ministers whether they are aware of employees' letter calling OpenAI reckless and lacking oversight, how the AI Act's delayed entry into force can be bridged, whether an AI advisory council and an AI factory should be set up, and whether the government will press the European Commission for transparency from OpenAI. The government answered at length that the AI Act is being phased in, that Dutch supervisors (AP's DCA, RDI) are preparing oversight, that an AI advisory council is being explored with results expected this autumn, and that the EU AI Office will oversee general-purpose models and draft codes of practice in dialogue with providers.
I expect to be able to share the outcomes of this study with your House this autumn.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek met uw Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valize over het bericht van Elon Musk op X waarin hij stelt alle apparaten van Apple te zullen weren uit zijn bedrijven wanneer OpenAI geïntegreerd wordt op OS-niveau

MP Valize asked the government about Elon Musk's threat to ban Apple devices from his companies if OpenAI were integrated at OS level, and about the security and privacy risks, DMA/AI Act compliance and safeguards. The minister answered that such integration carries risks that the government would address through procurement conditions, impact assessments and existing regulators, notably the Irish data protection authority, and that Apple had postponed its EU rollout.
Apple has, incidentally, postponed the rollout of the integration of OpenAI's ChatGPT within the EU.
Apple heeft overigens de uitrol van de integratie van ChatGTP van OpenAI binnen de EU uitgesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mohandis over het bericht 'Incassobedrijf gebruikt AI om kwetsbare schuldenaar te spotten: 'Kan bizarre situaties opleveren''

MPs Kathmann and Mohandis asked about reports that debt collector Intrum uses AI to scan correspondence of vulnerable debtors, raising risks of discrimination, privacy breaches and lack of transparency. The minister acknowledged the risks, said the government cannot guarantee AI use is optional for consumers, and pointed to existing GDPR and WKI rules and the forthcoming EU AI Act, while stating the details of Intrum's practices are not yet known and a meeting with Intrum is planned.
From the article, the precise methods or working practices of Intrum are not clear to me.
Uit het artikel worden de precieze methoden of werkwijzen van Intrum mij niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Tseggai en Kathmann  over opleidingsniveau als risico-indicator voor fraude

MPs asked whether education level (mbo, hbo, wo) was used as a fraud risk indicator, including by DUO, and whether it is ethically justified given government goals to value all forms of education equally. The government acknowledged the former DUO risk profile, said no fraud-related algorithm in the register uses education type, stated that education type is generally an unjustified criterion and that DUO has stopped using it, and referred the broader question to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Westerveld over het onterecht verwijderen van foto’s en video’s van mensen met een zichtbare beperking

MPs Kathmann and Westerveld asked whether large platforms like Facebook may remove photos and videos of people with visible disabilities and whether this breaches Dutch and EU rules, and what remedies exist. The government answered that DSA transparency and appeal duties and the Dutch equal-treatment law (Wgbh/cz) prohibit disability discrimination by platforms, pointed to complaint routes via platforms, the ACM and the College voor de rechten van de mens, and said it is exploring a dispute-settlement body and a knowledge centre.
On the case you mention I have not received any signals.
Over het door u genoemde geval heb ik geen signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Fiches over digitalisering in de door de informateurs aangeboden formatiestukken

An MP asked whether the 27 underlying fiches referenced in the formation document on digitalisation exist and whether they can be published now. The state secretary confirmed the 27 fiches, said other departments may have produced related fiches but she is not aware of any, and said publication is excluded under the Wet open overheid until formation concludes, with later publication left to the responsible ministers.
Under article 5.4 of the Open Government Act, documents prepared for the formation are in principle excluded from disclosure until the formation is concluded.

Antwoord 3 Uit artikel 5.4 van de Wet open overheid (Woo) volgt dat in beginsel geldt dat documenten die ten behoeve van de formatie zijn opgesteld – zoals de onderhavige fiches – uitgezonderd zijn van openbaarheid totdat de formatie is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de slechte beveiliging van gemeentelijke websites

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior about poorly secured municipal websites, including forgotten sites, and the lack of enforcement of security standards. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, cited a 54% compliance rate, pointed to existing coordination, monitoring and planned supervision of security standards, and committed to further steps and reporting before the summer recess.
Under the Digital Government Act (Wdo), I am exploring how supervision of the legally mandatory standards can be strengthened.
In het kader van de Wet digitale overheid (Wdo) ben ik aan het verkennen hoe het toezicht op de wettelijke verplichte standaarden steviger kan worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de onbereikbaarheid van provinciewebsites als gevolg van DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asked the State Secretary about provincial websites going offline due to DDoS attacks, including causes, impact, guidelines, and coordination with the Anti-DDoS coalition. The government answered that the outages were DDoS attacks likely linked to pro-Russian hacktivists, that impact was probably limited, that a baseline guideline exists with responsibility resting on provinces, and that provinces are being connected to the NCSC and a DDoS scrubbing service.
Furthermore, the affected provinces have now connected to a so-called DDoS scrubbing service.
Verder zijn de getroffen provincies inmiddels aangesloten op een zogenaamde DDoS-wasstraat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over verspreiding van medische misinformatie op sociale media

An MP asks the government how it responds to the spread of medical misinformation on social media, its effects on trust in vaccination, contraception and maternity care, and whether platforms and regulators under the DSA should act. The government answers that it relies on platform responsibilities under the DSA, the Commission's enforcement, prebunking, trusted doctors' initiatives and public information, and declines to regulate content or require BIG registration for information-sharers.
It is still too early to assess whether very large online platforms and search engines are taking sufficient measures to mitigate that risk.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen of zeer grote online platforms en zoekmachines voldoende maatregelen nemen om dat risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het onderzoek naar het toekomstbestendig maken van uitvoeringsorganisaties

Sneller (D66) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about low productivity and rising labour intensity at implementing agencies, the failure to act on 28% of evaluation recommendations, and the gap with CPB productivity assumptions. The State Secretary acknowledged the urgency, described IPSE productivity trends and recruitment projections, and promised a broader approach to reduce labour demand, with further information to the Chamber around September.
I will inform the Chamber, if possible in September, further about the options for steering on this.
Ik zal de Kamer, zo mogelijk in september, nader informeren over de mogelijkheden om hierop sturend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Politie vindt steeds vaker met AI gemaakte kinderporno: groot probleem’

An MP asked the ministers how far AI-generated child sexual abuse material is increasing, whether platforms and tech firms should remove it, what the EU AI and Digital Services Acts and the Dutch bill on administrative action against online CSAM contribute, and how police handle AI-enabled extortion of young people. The government answered that AI-generated CSAM is punishable and rising but still a small share, that detection and tracing remain hard, and pointed to the DSA, AI Act, the pending bill and reporting facilities.
Although no exact figures are available because the total number of images is not recorded, the TBKK indicates that an increase in AI-generated material is observed.

Hoewel er geen exacte cijfers beschikbaar zijn omdat het totaal aantal afbeeldingen niet wordt geregistreerd, geeft het Team ter bestrijding van Kinderpornografie en Kindersekstoerisme (TBKK) aan dat er wel een toename van AI-gegenereerd materiaal wordt waargenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de (toegang tot) zorg voor ongedocumenteerde personen op Aruba, Sint-Maarten en Curaçao

An MP asked the government which Caribbean organisations were consulted under the Simons motion on refugee assistance, how child and health protection for undocumented people is addressed, whether Curaçao's reports can be shared, and how civil society input and HIV medication access are handled. The government answered that migration and healthcare for undocumented people are the responsibility of the autonomous countries, withheld the reports until Curaçao publishes them, and pointed to ongoing working-group cooperation.

However, the fact remains that migration policy, including access to healthcare and protection of undocumented minors, is a matter for the countries, and the countries within the Kingdom are primarily responsible for it themselves.

Feit blijft echter dat migratiebeleid inclusief de toegang tot de gezondheidszorg en bescherming van minderjarige ongedocumenteerden een landsaangelegenheid is, en de Landen binnen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden hier zelf primair voor verantwoordelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Palmen over een sociaal veilige werkomgeving voor Rijksambtenaren

MPs Chakor and Palmen asked about a FNV manifesto and report alleging bullying, harassment and weak accountability for misconduct at the Ministry of VWS, including whether managers are sidelined and whistleblowers protected. The Minister says the ministry takes the signals seriously, cites a 2022/2023 staff survey, a new survey started in March 2024, whistleblower protections and rijksbrede initiatives, while rejecting claims of a cover-up culture.
A new staff survey (started 11 March 2024), specifically on social safety and conduct, will hopefully give a sharper and more complete picture of the problems and direction for additional actions.

Een nieuw uit te voeren medewerkersonderzoek (gestart op 11 maart 2024), specifiek gericht op het thema sociale veiligheid en omgangsvormen, geeft hopelijk een scherper en completer beeld van de problemen en richting voor aanvullende acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haasen over de procedure voor de benoeming van een nieuwe gezaghebber voor Sint Eustatius en het resulterende aanwijzen van de huidige regeringscommissaris

An MP asks why the State Secretary appointed a new governor for Sint Eustatius against the unanimous advice of the island council's selection committee, and whether local sentiment and future cooperation were considered. The State Secretary says the appointment procedure is confidential so the committee's advice cannot be disclosed, and states full confidence in the appointee and in constructive cooperation with the island government.
The procedure for the appointment of a governor is confidential.
De procedure voor de benoeming van een gezaghebber is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Six Dijkstra en Sneller over de verhuizing van het.nl domein

MPs Kathmann, Six Dijkstra and Sneller asked about SIDN's plan to move the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, raising sovereignty, US access, oversight and security concerns. The minister answers that no move has yet occurred, that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps, that the RDI and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens will review risks via a DPIA/DTIA, and that a quickscan of Dutch and EU alternatives will be carried out with a further letter expected in Q2.
It has been agreed that SIDN will not take any irreversible steps at this time.
Afgesproken is dat SIDN op dit moment geen onomkeerbare stappen zal zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over het bericht 'Caribische eilanden krijgen gelijk na gemopper over bureaucratie Nederland'

MP White asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that the Caribbean Netherlands islands face bureaucratic hurdles in obtaining extra budgets for their tasks, and about the Raad voor het Openbaar Bestuur's advice on fixed funding, transport and medical care. The State Secretary answered that the IdeeVersa study and ROB advice support improving financial relations, that reforms to the WolBES and FinBES laws and a possible Bestuurlijk Overleg Financiële verhoudingen are under way with a letter to the House promised before summer, and she described the existing student grants, transport and medical travel arrangements.
I am in discussion with departments about the funding of island tasks, the adequacy of the general grant, and the extent to which special grants can be made structural or added to the general grant.

Ik ben in gesprek met departementen over de financiering van de eilandelijke taken, de toereikendheid van de vrije uitkering en in hoeverre bijzondere uitkeringen structureel kunnen worden gemaakt of aan de vrije uitkering kunnen worden toegevoegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Miljoenen drugsadvertenties op Telegram, platform laat handel ongemoeid’ en het bericht ‘Telegramdealers: 'De straten hebben rust, zoals jullie wilden'

MP Krul (CDA) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that drug dealers openly advertise and operate on Telegram, and about Telegram's failure to cooperate with police and prosecutors and whether it can be compelled or blocked. The minister answered that Telegram's cooperation is lacking, that Telegram has no Dutch or EU establishment (it has a legal representative in Belgium under the DSA), that blocking channels is only possible in limited cases and depends on Telegram's cooperation, and that enforcement options and DSA oversight are being developed, with the DSA implementing law to follow later.
I will inform the House in a subsequent progress letter about the concrete proposals to better enforce the sale of drugs via online channels.
Ik zal uw Kamer in een volgende voortgangsbrief nader informeren over de concrete voorstellen om beter te kunnen handhaven op de verkoop van drugs via online kanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekoek over het niet op tijd invoeren van de Uitvoeringswet digitaledienstenverordening (DSA)

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the Dutch Digital Services Act implementation law (Uitvoeringswet DSA) was not in force by the EU deadline, what legal powers the ACM has meanwhile, and how to avoid future delays. The minister answered that the 15-month deadline was too short for a formal law, that the ACM was provisionally designated by ministerial order, that the bill would be submitted around March 2024, and that the Commission alone supervises very large platforms.
The bill itself contains no further rules that intermediary service providers must comply with.
Het wetsvoorstel zelf bevat geen nadere regels waar aanbieders van tussenhandeldiensten zich aan moeten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bamenga over zakelijke vliegreizen binnen de Rijksoverheid

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Interior about the number of business flights by central government staff since 2018, the necessity test, and whether economy class should be the default. The State Secretary gave yearly figures by class, pointed to CAO rules and a checklist, and said economy is default only for certain categories while business class remains optional for flights of six hours or more.
On employment terms agreed in the CAO Rijk I must reach agreement with the trade unions and cannot change them unilaterally.
Over arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken uit de CAO Rijk moet ik overeenstemming bereiken met de vakbonden en deze kan ik dus niet eenzijdig aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sneller over ‘Quantumproof encryptie’

MP Sneller (D66) asked the government about the risks quantum computers pose to encryption, how Dutch law compares to the US quantum-safe migration mandate, what support organisations receive, and what research is underway. State Secretary Van Huffelen answered that the government is preparing a cross-government quantum-safe cryptography programme and guidance, but that no equivalent binding US-style migration obligation exists in the Netherlands, relying instead on existing EU and national cybersecurity rules.
Starting preparations now is therefore necessary in order to spread risks, effort and costs.
Nu beginnen met voorbereiden is dan ook noodzakelijk om risico's, inspanning en kosten te kunnen spreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Kostić over de vrijheid van meningsuiting voor ambtenaren

MPs Chakor and Kostić asked whether civil servants may publicly criticise government and climate policy, and how Article 10 of the Civil Servants Act is applied. The state secretary answered that civil servants have the same fundamental rights, that Article 10 limits them only where their function is at risk, that assessment is case-by-case, and that the employer and AGFA advisory body handle enforcement while a Handreiking is being developed.
Civil servants, like everyone in the Netherlands, have the right to freedom of expression, freedom of association, and the right to assemble and demonstrate.
Ambtenaren hebben, zoals iedereen in Nederland, het recht van vrijheid van meningsuiting, het recht tot vereniging en het recht tot vergadering en betoging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de bereikbaarheidsmaatregelen uit het compensatiepakketmarinierskazerne Vlissingen en de kwaliteit van het spoorvervoer in Zeeland

The MP asked about accessibility measures from the Vlissingen Marine barracks compensation package, including the Sprinter extension to Dordrecht, the IC Vlissingen-Amsterdam speed-up, the HRN concession's Zeeland volumes, Ghent-Terneuzen rail, Roosendaal connections and a second Roosendaal-Antwerp train. The government answered that the Dordrecht extension is not yet a significant improvement, that the IC speed-up to the HSL is being reconsidered because it harms some Zeeland travellers, and that the second Antwerp train depends on ERTMS with first results expected in spring 2024.
The discussion with regional administrators on the outcomes of the studies is currently ongoing.
Met de regionale bestuurders wordt momenteel het gesprek gevoerd over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Werkgroep moet scherven van geflopte BES –top bijeenvegen’

MP Paternotte asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that a working group must clean up the failed BES top meeting and about the timeline, involvement of the public bodies, and financing of the Caribbean Netherlands islands. The State Secretary answered that the WolBES/FinBES revision is still in consultation, that the consultation was extended at the islands' request with a working conference planned for March 2024, that islands' input is formally anchored in article 209 WolBES, and that the IdeeVersa study on island funding is under review with a follow-up discussion and ROB advice pending.
I aim to submit the bill to your House by the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar om het wetsvoorstel voor het eind van het jaar bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de SGO-instructie dat conceptdocumenten categorisch niet verstrekt moeten worden

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether a secretaries-general meeting instruction categorically withholds draft documents from parliament and Woo requesters, and whether that is lawful under the Constitution and the Woo. The State Secretary denied categorical withholding, said drafts require a case-by-case assessment of relevant factual information, and promised to clarify the instructions.
Blanket refusal of drafts without this test is not permitted, and that is also not what was agreed in the SGO.
Integrale weigering van concepten zonder deze toets is niet toegestaan en dat is ook niet zo gewisseld in het SGO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ombudsman: Overheid dwingt burgers tot fraude'

MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary for the Interior about an Ombudsman report finding that citizens are pushed into fraud by using others' DigiD credentials, since representatives such as guardians and informal carers lack a workable digital proxy option. The State Secretary acknowledged the practice and dilemma, pointed to the phased rollout of digital representation facilities and ongoing engagement with stakeholders, and gave a partial answer on usability research and the timeline.
I am aware that some representatives, including guardians and informal carers, use the DigiD username and password of the persons they represent to gain access to digital services.

Het is mij bekend dat sommige vertegenwoordigers, waaronder ook bewindvoerders en mantelzorgers, de DigiD gebruikersnaam en wachtwoord van de personen die zij vertegenwoordigen gebruiken om toegang te krijgen tot digitale dienstverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over beïnvloeding van en door de overheid op social media m.b.t. de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether government contacts with social media platforms, trusted flagger reports and campaign advertising around the 22 November 2023 elections amounted to improper interference with election content. The ministers answered that contact was limited and mainly concerned platform risk assessments, a correction of a Facebook election-date message, and a single trusted flagger report, denying any agreements on content or reach restrictions.
The Ministry of BZK uses the trusted flagger status very sparingly, and only when there is a risk to the organisation, conduct and integrity of the electoral process.
Het Ministerie van BZK zet de trusted flagger status zeer terughoudend in, en alleen wanneer er een risico bestaat voor de organisatie, uitvoering en integriteit van het verkiezingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over toenemende online lhbti+-haat naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Tijd voor geweld tegen deze lui'

GroenLinks MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked the government about rising online hostility toward LGBTQI+ people, including whether platforms should be responsible, what the DSA and DMA require, and how the government will tackle online hate. The government answered that it finds the trends worrying, lists existing measures (reporting office, DSA obligations, interdepartmental approach, prevention campaigns), and says it is still evaluating policy and awaiting further research.
The cabinet is currently evaluating the measures from the LGBTI Safety Action Plan 2019–2022.
Het kabinet evalueert momenteel de maatregelen uit het Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI 2019–2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Kat en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat AI-sites teksten van nieuwsmedia gebruiken zonder daar bronvermelding aan toe tevoegen

MPs asked whether AI sites reusing news texts without attribution, and the scope of the copyright text-and-data-mining exception, breach copyright and should be curbed. The government answered that the exception may cover scraping even of paywalled articles if access was lawfully obtained and no reservation was made, that attribution is not a legal condition, and that the EU AI Act and copyright evaluation will be used to address the issue.
Attribution is therefore not a condition for lawfully making a reproduction within text and data mining.
Bronvermelding is dus geen voorwaarde voor het rechtmatig kunnen maken van een reproductie in het kader van tekst- en datamining.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over de brief van Eurocommissaris Thierry Breton aan Elon Musk over de desinformatie op X (voormalig Twitter)

MPs Krul and Boswijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about EU Commissioner Breton's letter to Elon Musk on disinformation and illegal content on X after the Hamas attacks, and what the government would do. The government answered that DSA enforcement over X rests with the European Commission, that it supports the Commission, and that X's content policy and transparency are unclear, with X having withdrawn from the EU disinformation Code of Practice.
Primary responsibility for DSA supervision of X lies with the European Commission.
Het primaat van het DSA-toezicht op X ligt bij de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Experts sabelen overheid neer om belangrijke websites als DigiD: ‘Pas nu domeinnaam aan’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about calls to move key government websites such as DigiD to a uniform .gov or .overheid domain to counter cybercrime and phishing. The State Secretary answered that a national top-level domain is not possible for now, that a second-level domain such as overheid.nl or gov.nl is being worked on with an implementation approach to follow, and that such a change alone will not prevent cybercrime.
An implementation approach for a single extension is currently being worked on.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een implementatie-aanpak voor één extensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het onderzoek naar het (risico)profiel UT001

An MP asks why the Tax Authority withheld documents on the UT001 risk profile during the investigation, whether all related files can be produced, how records were stored and deleted, and whether nationality or birthplace indicators were used. The State Secretary answers that six informal drafts were supplied late, a targeted search found further documents which are being provided, retention rules and information management gaps are acknowledged, and the 2022 decision to reject the profile is referenced.
The exception is six documents without formal status that were only provided during the adversarial hearing procedure.
Uitzondering hierop zijn een zestal documenten zonder formele status die pas tijdens de procedure van wederhoor zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht 'Het internet is vervuilender dan de luchtvaart, met dank aan alle mails, crypto’s, videogesprekken, streams en de cloud'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about reports that internet use is more polluting than aviation, including Dutch digital emissions, government monitoring of its digital footprint and the French 'sobriété digitale' idea. The minister answered that estimates vary, no integral picture of Dutch digital emissions exists yet, research and a plan for a sustainable digital sector are under way, and that sobriety-based steering should be approached cautiously.
At this moment I do not have an integral picture of the sustainability effects of our digital economy.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over een integraal beeld van de duurzaamheidseffecten van onze digitale economie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het beveiligingsniveau van Twitter

An MP asked whether Twitter's plan to offer encrypted private messages only to paying users meets a basic security standard, and how this affects regular users and human rights. The minister replied that no specific baseline is imposed, pointed to GDPR and the forthcoming NIS2 obligations supervised by the AP and RDI, and said government officials should avoid messaging apps for official business.
It is up to the relevant supervisory authority to determine in a concrete case whether the measures taken are appropriate.
Het is aan de desbetreffende toezichthouder om in een concreet geval te bepalen of de getroffen maatregelen passend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het rekenen van extra kosten door zorgverzekeraars voor het ontvangen van post

MP Kathmann asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about health insurer IZA charging €1.25 per month for paper post and how this fits with the Leijten motion on non-digital alternatives. The State Secretary answered that the cooperative VGZ will keep informing vulnerable groups on paper free of charge, that she is talking with private institutions about keeping offline access open, and that the Kamer will receive the outcome in October.
As promised to your House, I am however in discussion with these institutions about how they ensure everyone can continue to participate.
Als toegezegd aan uw Kamer ben ik echter met deze instellingen in gesprek over hoe zij ervoor zorgen dat iedereen mee kan blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Kinderen opgelicht met virtuele muntjes voor gameplatform Roblox’

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about reports of children being defrauded with virtual currency in the Roblox game, including data on child fraud, the vulnerability of children to phishing, the role of pay-to-win and loot box mechanics, EU action, and police capacity. The government acknowledged no specific police registration for game fraud, pointed to child-rights design tools, EU consumer-protection work on loot boxes, and public awareness programmes, but gave no hard figures and few firm new commitments.
The police do not use a specific registration category for the type of online game in these reports.
De politie hanteert bij deze aangiften geen specifieke registratiecategorie voor het type online game.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat Nederlanders de overheid steeds minder vertrouwen met persoonsgegevens

An MP asked the State Secretary about declining public trust in government handling of personal data, AI and algorithm oversight, and cookie consent practices. The government acknowledges AVG compliance problems, defers mandatory algorithm registration and impact assessments pending the EU AI Act, and says it is pursuing EU-level cookie reform rather than national legislation.
The cabinet recognises that the current practice is unpleasant.
Het kabinet herkent dat de huidige praktijk onprettig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het artikel ‘Miljoenen snappen digitale overheid onvoldoende, meeste hoofdpijn over DigiD’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a report that millions of Dutch people struggle with digital government services, the difficulties with DigiD, and the effects on benefit take-up. The State Secretary answered that a broader literacy program, alternative non-digital access and the Informatiepunten Digitale Overheid are in place, that research into non-take-up will follow, and that DigiD app updates will improve accessibility.
For people who find it difficult to communicate digitally with the government there must always be an alternative way to contact public service providers.
Voor mensen die het lastig vinden om digitaal te communiceren met de overheid moet er altijd een alternatief zijn om op een andere manier in contact te treden met publieke dienstverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht 'WhatsApp en Signal dreigen VK te verlaten vanwege breken encryptie' van AG Connect

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security about reports that WhatsApp and Signal might leave the UK over encryption-breaking provisions in the Online Safety Bill, and whether scanning messaging apps for child abuse material should outweigh encryption. The Minister answered that the UK bill is still pending, that the EU CSAM regulation is under negotiation, that the government supports no proposal making end-to-end encryption impossible in line with the Van Raan motion, and that client-side scanning is being considered within those limits.
The Netherlands does not support European proposals that make end-to-end encryption impossible, in line with the motion-Van Raan adopted by the House of Representatives.
Nederland steunt geen Europese voorstellen die end-to-end encryptie onmogelijk maken, in lijn met de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie-Van Raan c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan  over het aan banden leggen van ChatGPT vanwege privacyzorgen

MP Van Raan asked the government about ChatGPT's alleged use of unlawfully obtained personal data, copyrighted press articles and biased sources, and whether the Dutch DPA should impose an urgent ban. The minister replied that the government lacks information to verify the claims, that the Dutch DPA has already asked OpenAI for clarification, and that a government vision on generative AI is forthcoming by year end.
I have no information position that enables me to verify the factual accuracy of investigative journalism concerning the conduct of an organisation in the private sector.
