Ik heb geen informatiepositie die mij in staat stelt om de feitelijke juistheid te verifiëren van onderzoeksjournalistiek die ziet op de handelwijze van een organisatie in de private sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Ellian over het bericht 'Ambtenaar vervalste meerdere rapporten over beveiliging DigiD-aansluiting'

MPs Rahimi and Ellian asked about reports that an official at Justis falsified security audit reports for DigiD connections, including the 2020 Suwinet report. The minister answers that the official acted outside his assigned duties, four-eyes checks were introduced, digital signing and mandatory digital submission from 2024 were adopted, and a risk assessment and cause investigation are ongoing.
After the manipulation was discovered, the audit process at Justis was improved and tightened, for example by introducing the four-eyes principle.
Na de constatering van de manipulatie is bij Justis het auditproces verbeterd en aangescherpt, zo is bijvoorbeeld het vierogenprincipe ingevoerd.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Haga over websites met kindermisbruik op Nederlandse servers

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a rise in child sexual abuse websites hosted on Dutch servers, what action was taken, who owns the servers, and how such content is enforced against. The government answered that the Dutch share has actually fallen, outlined self-regulation with hosting providers and the planned ATKM enforcement authority, and said precise ownership and perpetrator data are unavailable.
We do not have a complete overview by nationality and ownership.
Een totaal overzicht naar nationaliteit en eigenaarschap hebben wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Slootweg over het bericht aantal getroffen websites met ernstig kindermisbruik in twee jaar tijd verdubbeld

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a report that websites with severe child sexual abuse material doubled in two years, and why many are hosted on Dutch servers, what measures will be taken, and how encryption affects detection. The minister agreed the trend is worrying, pointed to voluntary takedown codes and a planned regulator (ATKM) with enforcement powers, and said encrypted communication makes investigation difficult while promising continued cooperation with the sector.
No figures are known for 2022 on sanctioning websites.
Over 2022 zijn geen cijfers bekend van het sanctioneren van websites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over onderzoek naar mogelijk discriminerende algoritmen door DUO

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked the minister about a possibly discriminatory DUO fraud-detection algorithm targeting students with a migration background, and about transparency, privacy checks, and oversight. The minister answered that an independent external investigation is announced, the algorithm is suspended pending results, DUO will only do random checks, and publication and the Algorithm Register are being pursued.
As indicated in my letter to the House of 21 June, I find these signals very disturbing and I have immediately announced an independent external investigation.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 21 juni vind ik deze signalen zeer verontrustend en heb ik direct een onafhankelijk extern onderzoek aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht over het algoritmeregister

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Azarkan asked about an NOS report that the government's algorithm register offers little insight into algorithms and decision rules, and whether it will be expanded or evaluated. The State Secretary answers that the register is still being developed, that 123 algorithms are registered with only some fields complete, that government bodies are encouraged to publish, and that the aim is full coverage of high-risk AI by 2025, with a link to the upcoming EU AI Act registration duty.
It is important for transparency that all relevant algorithms are published by government bodies.
Het is voor de transparantie van belang dat alle relevante algoritmen gepubliceerd worden door overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Deepfakes op TikTok maken illegale reclame voor leningen’

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister and the State Secretary for the Interior about deepfake TikTok advertisements luring young people to loan sites, and about legal responsibilities, bank claims, shareholder action and protection measures. The government answered that enforcement is for courts and independent regulators, listed the applicable consumer, financial, e-commerce and DSA rules, said banks have had ads removed, and pointed to media-literacy and awareness campaigns and the EU AI Act.
It is for the courts or supervisory authorities to establish violations, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan de rechter of toezichthouders om overtredingen vast te stellen, en niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de zorgen van honderden techprominenten over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie (AI)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about tech leaders' concerns over AI's societal risks, whether public debate is adequate, the promised values framework, whether to pause powerful AI, and which advisory bodies advise on AI ethics. The government answered that it is developing a vision on generative AI with public input, pursuing EU AI regulation, and listing existing advisory bodies, while rejecting a pause as not addressing current harms.
I will inform your House before the summer about the progress.
Ik informeer uw Kamer nog voor de zomer over de vorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beperkte invloed van het bron- en contactonderzoek en de CoronaMelder-app op de bestrijding van de pandemie

An MP asks the minister why the contact tracing programme and CoronaMelder app were introduced and continued despite evidence of limited effectiveness, and why parliament was not informed earlier. The minister replies that contact tracing was a statutory task with limited added value later in the pandemic, that no prior impact analysis was done, and that the app's modest benefit was evaluated and monitored with results shared with parliament.
The outcomes of these studies have been communicated to your House.
Over de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken is uw Kamer geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de chatbot van Snapchat

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a Snapchat chatbot that presented itself as a real person and proposed meeting children, raising risks of deception, harmful advice and data profiling. The government answered that Snap has changed the feature to disclose it is a chatbot, pointed to upcoming DSA and AI Act obligations, and promised a public awareness campaign and a broader policy letter on children's digital protection.
Before the summer I will send Parliament a broad policy letter on the protection of children in the digital world.
Voor de zomer zal ik een brede beleidsbrief over de bescherming van kinderen in de digitale wereld aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Drost over het bericht ‘Nieuwe functie Snapchat wil met kinderen afspreken: Zie ik je vanavond? Ik ben een echt persoon!’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about Snapchat's My AI chatbot, which presented itself as a real person, suggested meeting children, and retained messages for product improvement and advertising. The government answered that Snap has since changed the feature to identify itself as a chatbot, that privacy compliance is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to assess, and that it will rely on the forthcoming AI Regulation and the Code Kinderrechten Online.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over desinformatie

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about disinformation, including criminal law use, algorithms and echo chambers, platform obligations under the DSA, and the role of citizens and media. The government answered that the DSA will bind very large platforms, that the state stays restrained on factchecking, and that it will report on the national strategy by end 2023.
At the end of 2023 we will inform the House about the progress in implementing the national strategy.
Eind 2023 zullen we uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de Rijksbrede strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Wuite over stemregistratie voor de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen in de Caribische Landen van het Koninkrijk

D66 MPs asked how the government will make European Parliament elections as accessible in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom as in the Netherlands, how it will involve Caribbean citizens in EU engagement, and how the planned dialogues and events will reach them. The minister says a policy paper will set out options (more voting locations, abolishing the registration requirement) with consultation of the Caribbean countries, and that the dialogues and events will be digital and open to all, with extra effort for youth and hard-to-reach groups.
The policy paper will set out a number of routes to increase the accessibility of the EP elections in the countries and to facilitate voters as much as possible in casting their vote.

In de hoofdlijnennotitie wordt een aantal sporen uitgewerkt waarlangs de toegankelijkheid van de EP-verkiezingen in de landen kan worden vergroot en kiesgerechtigden zoveel mogelijk kunnen worden gefaciliteerd in het uitbrengen van hun stem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Slootweg over het bericht 'Digitale identiteit voor burgers: doelen behaald, maar nog onduidelijkheid over toekomstige inlogmiddelen'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about an Court of Audit report on digital identity, fearing that stricter login security from 1 July 2023 could leave many citizens unable to log in to government services because a central connection point is not yet ready. The State Secretary replied that SMS login remains available, that connection of service providers will be gradual through 2024-2026 with DigiD and eHerkenning kept in place until then, and that the government will consult parliament before changing SMS login policy.
I have indicated that I will consult with your House before any changes are made to this policy starting point.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ik in overleg met uw Kamer zal treden voordat er wijzigingen plaatsvinden in dit beleidsuitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Kuik en Van den Berg over het bericht 'The jury is still out'

CDA MPs asked the state secretaries about a report linking smartphone and social media use to worsening mental health among teenage girls, including Dutch data on depression, suicide and self-harm. The government answered that Dutch data are limited, that a causal link between social media and depression is not established, and listed prevention measures, platform engagement and a forthcoming child-protection policy letter.
There is no data available on self-harm among young people in the Netherlands.
Er is geen data beschikbaar over automutilatie onder jongeren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Ouders gooien privacy van hun kinderen te grabbel op sociale media'

An MP asked the government about parents posting children's photos on social media, the privacy and misuse risks, and whether parental consent age should be raised. The government acknowledges the risks, points to existing GDPR and DSA protections, awareness campaigns, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's enforcement powers, and a forthcoming policy letter, without answering all questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘OM ‘gesprek aangegaan met Silvania’

A Dutch MP asks the state secretary whether Curaçao's decision to stop actively collecting older tax debts (pre-2018) is compatible with Dutch-funded reform support, whether reform conditions should be attached, and how the Curaçao Cft advice relates. The state secretary answers that the change is not a waiver of debts, is an autonomous Curaçao matter, reform progress is under discussion in the upcoming implementation agenda, and the Cft advice predates the change.
I will discuss this with Curaçao in the run-up to the next implementation agenda, which will be adopted at the end of June.
Ik ga hierover in gesprek met Curaçao in de aanloop op de volgende uitvoeringsagenda die eind juni zal worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Zelensky wil actie tegen Russische gokbedrijven op Curaçao’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Ukraine sanctioned Curaçao-based online gambling firms, and about oversight of those firms. The minister answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and supervision, that Nederland has no direct role, and that a new independent gaming regulator is planned under the Landspakket with a target of end-2023.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom and has its own gambling legislation and regulations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk en heeft eigen kansspelwet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Steekspel rond mysterieuze datadiefstal; Bedrijven delen data van klanten met hun leveranciers, maar hoe veilig is dat?'

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary about the Nebu data leak, which parties are liable in data-sharing chains, and whether current rules are sufficient to protect consumers. The minister said the number of affected Dutch clients is unclear, that a court ordered Nebu to provide information and an independent forensic investigation, and that liability and chain obligations already fall under the GDPR, so no new rules are needed.
At this moment it is unclear how many customers, companies and organisations in the Netherlands have been affected by the data leak.
Op dit moment is het onduidelijk hoeveel klanten, bedrijven en organisaties in Nederland zijn getroffen door het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Wuite over het niet tenuitvoerleggen van gevangenisstraffen op Sint Maarten

Dutch MPs asked why at least 136 convicted persons on Sint Maarten were not serving prison sentences due to lack of detention capacity, and about the effects on rule of law, investment imbalance and a new prison. The government answered that prison administration is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, outlined Dutch funding and the UNOPS new-prison project (target 2028), and described temporary transfers of detainees to the Netherlands while declining to give the size of the shortage.
Prison administration is a matter for the constituent country.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het aan banden leggen van ChatGPT in Italië vanwege privacyzorgen en de consequenties hiervan voor Nederland

An MP asked the government about Italy's temporary ban on ChatGPT over privacy concerns, possible GDPR breaches, a reported data leak, and what this means for the Netherlands and the Dutch privacy regulator. The minister answered that the Dutch regulator (AP) is part of the EDPB taskforce, no breach involving Dutch users was reported to the AP, and enforcement and prioritisation are for the independent supervisor, while the government is preparing an AI vision.
It is up to the AP to supervise the processing of personal data by companies and to pick up signals when the rules are violated.
Het is aan de AP om toezicht te houden op de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door bedrijven en signalen op te pikken wanneer de regels worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van der Laan over berichten over schermtijd

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van der Laan asked the State Secretaries for Health and for the Interior about reports on rising screen time among babies and young children, its effects, and what government will do to inform parents and address tech companies' role. The government answered that screen time has both benefits and harms, outlined existing youth health-care guidance, a planned public campaign, reliance on the EU Digital Services Act and talks with platforms, and declined to adopt France's age-15 social media rule because Dutch GDPR implementation already protects children under 16.

At the commission of the Alliance for a Digital Society, the Trimbos Institute is surveying the extent to which existing research can show the relationship between mental, social and physical health and screen time.

Het Trimbos-instituut inventariseert in opdracht van de Alliantie Digitaal Samenleven in welke mate bestaande onderzoeken beeld kunnen geven van de relatie tussen mentale, sociale en fysieke gezondheid en schermtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rajkowski over een mogelijk datalek van klantgegevens van NS-reizigers

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether NS was aware of a reported data leak of NS customer data via a market research subcontractor and its software supplier, and how it was handled, including legal basis, DPIA, subprocessor oversight and rules for protecting client data. The state secretary answered that NS had a processor agreement and DPIA, that the leak source and whether NS data was included remained unclear, and that existing GDPR rules and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens budget were adequate.
However, it is not yet certain which data exactly was leaked and whether NS data was also part of the data breach.
Het is echter nog niet zeker welke data precies zijn gelekt en of ook NS-data onderdeel waren van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Vestering, Van Esch en Van Raan over het adequaat beschermen van kwetsbare en unieke natuur en koraal op en rondom de BES-eilanden

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked how a motion to halt irreversible building steps at Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, port expansion near Hato, coral damage, and enforcement against coastal construction on Sint Eustatius were being implemented. The government answered that no irreversible steps are legally possible before the environmental impact assessment is complete, that the port and coral issues will be examined in the MER, and that the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport report on local enforcement capacity and related follow-ups will be sent by end May 2023.

Since the revision of the Bonaire spatial development plan will not be started in procedure until the MER has been established and assessed, I note that it is currently not legally possible to take irreversible steps.

Aangezien de herziening van het Ruimtelijke Ordeningsplan Bonaire (ROB) niet in procedure worden gebracht, zolang de MER niet is vastgesteld en beoordeeld, constateer ik dat het op dit moment juridisch niet mogelijk is om onomkeerbare stappen te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Partners Code voor Kinderrechten teleurgesteld in aanpak ministerie’

MPs Drost and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the State Secretary for Interior about the ministry's small, fragmented tender approach to the Code for Children's Rights online, versus a larger integral programme, and whether it would be revised. The State Secretary says the approach is content-driven, cites broader online child-rights policy and a planned letter, and declines to revise the approach while staying in dialogue with the original partners.
You will shortly receive a letter with an overview of all policy on children's rights online and its current status.
U ontvangt binnenkort een brief met het overzicht van al het beleid met betrekking tot kinderrechten online en de stand van zaken daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Drost over het bericht ‘Waarom Franse jongeren toestemming van ouders nodig hebben voor TikTok (en Nederlandse niet)’

The MP asks why French youth need parental consent for TikTok while Dutch youth do not, and whether the age limit should be raised to 15 with parental consent, plus measures on social media harms to youth. The government answers that the AVG/UAVG age limit is 16 with parental consent, that no official 13-year limit exists, that age verification must protect privacy, and that it will inform parliament before summer and discuss with platforms, while leaving enforcement to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and declining to lower the age to 15.
We do not consider it desirable to lower this age limit to 15 years.
Wij vinden het niet wenselijk deze leeftijdsgrens te verlagen naar 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Kuik over het bericht ‘Social Media is a Major Cause of the Mental Illness Epidemic in Teen Girls. Here’s the Evidence'

MPs Slootweg and Kuik asked whether Dutch longitudinal studies exist on social media use and teen mental health, and how the government views the claim that social media is a major cause of depression and anxiety in teen girls. The government answered that no simple direct causal link has been established, listed Dutch longitudinal studies, outlined prevention and regulatory measures, and promised a broader policy letter.
As stated above, we do not yet see a scientific consensus on a simple and direct causal relationship between social media use and the development of depression and anxiety.
Zoals boven gesteld zien wij nog geen wetenschappelijke consensus over een eenvoudige en directe causale relatie tussen sociale mediagebruik en de ontwikkeling van depressie en angsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Aruba: in cassatie tegen homohuwelijk’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about Aruba's cassation appeal against a Joint Court ruling legalising same-sex marriage, questioning judicial overreach, EU-style harmonisation, and respect for democratic primacy. The State Secretary answered that cassation is legitimate, that the matter concerns internal separation of powers rather than Statute autonomy, that family law is primarily for the countries to decide, and that the Kingdom would object to pressure to copy Dutch law.
In the countries, the courts traditionally take a restrained position on such issues and guard against taking the seat of the political state powers.
De rechter neemt in de landen rondom dergelijke kwesties traditioneel een terughoudende plaats in en waakt ervoor om plaats te nemen op de stoel van de politieke staatsmachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over tekstgenerator ChatGPT

An MP asked the education ministers whether ChatGPT use by pupils undermines writing skills, whether its risks should be investigated and banned from classrooms, and whether lessons on media literacy could help. The ministers answered that schools and teachers decide how to deal with AI, pointed to existing research (NOLAI, Onderwijsraad) and to teaching approaches such as assessing the writing process, without committing to a ban or new investigation.
It is up to schools and teachers to provide good education and organise it according to their own judgement.
Het is aan scholen en leraren om goed onderwijs aan te bieden en naar eigen inzicht in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over TikTok

An MP asked whether TikTok's data protection raises high security risks and whether civil servants should be barred from having TikTok on work devices, citing the US ban for public representatives. The state secretary said the Irish privacy regulator's investigation into TikTok's data transfers to China is expected in the first half of 2023, referred to a forthcoming letter on the government's policy, and advised parliament to decide on additional measures itself.
I therefore advise the Dutch parliament to take note of the letter and, respecting its own independent position, to decide on any additional security measures.
Ik adviseer het Nederlandse parlement dan ook om kennis te nemen van de brief, en met inachtneming van zijn eigen onafhankelijke positie, te besluiten over eventuele extra veiligheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Pro-Russische DDoS-aanvallers hebben het gemunt op Nederlandse ziekenhuizen’

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Dutch hospitals threaten healthcare and what is being done to protect hospitals and share threat information. The government answered that care continuity was not affected, described existing protections (DDoS scrubbing, Z-CERT, NCSC information sharing and the amended Wbni) and said monitoring of similar attacks is ongoing, without committing to new structural changes beyond a promised letter on the NIB2 implementation.
The Minister of Justice and Security will inform the House further on this in a letter in the spring.
De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal u hierover nader informeren middels een brief aan uw Kamer in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over recente berichten over ict-storingen en cyberaanvallen in onder andere het Maastricht UMC en het UMC Groningen

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked about IT outages and cyberattacks at Maastricht UMC and UMC Groningen, and about whether ICT security risks in hospitals are structural. The minister replied that the DDoS attacks caused only limited website unavailability while care continuity was maintained, that the Maastricht outage was a technical EPD failure affecting outpatient clinics and operations, and that Z-CERT sharing, NEN 7510 compliance and a risk-based Z-CERT membership strategy are being pursued.
I will elaborate on this in answering question 13.
Ik ga hier verder op in bij de beantwoording van vraag 13.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de overheid die burgers monitort via sociale media

MP Leijten asks on what legal basis ministries, the Tax Authority and the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority store and process public social media posts, and why this differs from the NCTV practice the cabinet found unlawful, plus questions on transparency, sharing, use in policy and oversight. The State Secretary says such monitoring needs a legal ground under the GDPR and that a DPIA will be requested to map the practice, while acknowledging the need for transparency, limits on data, and oversight by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Because several government bodies are involved, I intend to ask my colleagues to map the use of social media monitoring through a DPIA.

Omdat het hier gaat om verschillende overheidsinstanties, ben ik voornemens om mijn collega’s te verzoeken het gebruik van sociale media monitoring in kaart te laten te brengen door middel van een DPIA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat er buitensporig vaak inzage in de persoonsgegevens van slachtoffers van het toeslagenschandaal heeft plaatsgevonden

MP Leijten asked whether police and other authorities queried personal data of victims of the childcare benefits scandal excessively often via the BRP, why, and whether such access is checked or logged. The government answered that police cannot identify victims in their records, that excessiveness cannot be judged generally, that no signals of excessive queries were known beyond the FTM report, and it outlined existing AVG and Wpg accountability and access rules, with logging of police data use (art. 32a Wpg) due to take effect by May 2023.
The police do not know which persons are victims of the childcare benefits affair.
Het is voor de politie niet bekend welke personen gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over eHerkenning

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about problems with eHerkenning as the mandatory login for tax filing by businesses, including costs, security and privacy, and whether the old portal could be reopened. The government answered that existing compensation schemes and a planned free public login address the costs, that eHerkenning meets EU and national standards under supervision, and that the old portal cannot be reinstated.
A free public login means at the substantial assurance level is being developed by the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for logging in to the MijnBelastingdienst Zakelijk portal.

Door het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties wordt een kosteloos publiek inlogmiddel op betrouwbaarheidsniveau substantieel ontwikkeld voor het inloggen op het portaal MijnBelastingdienst Zakelijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Elon Musk daalt op zijn Twitter steeds dieper af in het konijnenhol'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about reports that Elon Musk's Twitter had cut staff, that hate speech had risen, and whether the government should keep advertising there, and asked how much the government spends on social media advertising. The State Secretary said the advertising budget was about 13.5 million euro in 2022, that Twitter's service and ad reach were unchanged, that there is no government-wide social media policy but a review is underway, and that the EU Digital Services Act will require Twitter to assess and mitigate rights risks.
DPC is currently exploring with ministries whether additional rules on advertising on social media are desirable and how these could be shaped.
DPC voert momenteel een verkenning uit bij departementen of aanvullende regelgeving t.a.v. het adverteren op sociale media gewenst is en op welke wijze deze dan gestalte kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de berichten 'Twitter heft adviesraad op die platform veilig moest houden' en 'Elon Musk daalt op zijn Twitter steeds dieper af in het konijnenhol'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary about reports that Twitter dissolved its safety advisory council and about Elon Musk's posts and account blocks of journalists, and how Dutch public debate would be protected. The State Secretary answered that platform obligations under the EU Digital Services Act, enforced by the European Commission, would apply and that she disapproves of unjustified press restrictions, while leaving the content of Musk's personal posts to US authorities.
Mr. Musk's personal tweets will have to be assessed under American law by the supervisory authorities there.
De persoonlijke tweets van de heer Musk zullen onder Amerikaans recht beoordeeld moeten worden door de toezichthoudende instanties aldaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Regering Curaçao is het oneens met Hof en wil niet dat het huwelijk wordt opengesteld’

An MP asked whether the Curaçao government's plan to appeal a court ruling opening marriage to same-sex couples is acceptable, and what the Dutch government has done on this in relations with the autonomous countries. The state secretary agrees same-sex couples should be able to marry, says the obligation lies with Curaçao but a registered partnership alternative must be legally anchored, and notes the court's finding of a breach that she is concerned about and will follow closely.
I also consider it of great importance that throughout the Kingdom care is taken to realise fundamental human rights.
Ik vind het ook van groot belang dat overal binnen het Koninkrijk zorg wordt gedragen voor de verwezenlijking van de fundamentele mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Van der Molen over het artikel ‘Studentgegevens ondanks kritiek massaal in de Amerikaanse cloud gezet’

MPs Bontenbal and Van der Molen asked about a report that student data was massively moved to US cloud providers despite criticism, raising privacy, espionage and strategic autonomy risks. The Secretary of State answered that institutions are responsible for their own cloud choices under the GDPR, pointed to DPIAs, sector-wide contracts via SURF, the knowledge security framework, and EU cloud initiatives such as IPCEI Cloud and a European cloud certification scheme.
The Ministry of OCW does not itself have data on cloud use by universities.
Eigen gegevens over het cloudgebruik door universiteiten zijn niet bekend bij het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Klaver over de berichtgeving over problemen door hevige regenval op Bonaire

MPs Bouchallikh and Klaver asked about flooding from heavy rain on Bonaire, the damage, whether local authorities have adequate capacity, the situation on other Caribbean islands, EU funds, drainage and reef protection. Minister Harbers answered that no assistance request was made, that the public body is responsible for infrastructure with Rijk support, and that a scan of water retention basins will be done in spring.
No information has been received about the damage, except that electricity on the island was temporarily out and the hospital was temporarily unreachable.
Er is geen informatie ontvangen over de schade, behalve dat tijdelijk de elektriciteit op het eiland is uitgevallen en tijdelijk het ziekenhuis niet bereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Thijssen over de overstromingen op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Thijssen asked the government about flooding on Bonaire, including damage, coordination with the island authority, flood-risk and climate adaptation, and support for homeowners. The minister answered that no national intervention was needed because the island coped with local pumps, that the island authority is primarily responsible for infrastructure and climate adaptation, and that the Rijk offers support such as a climate effect atlas, though damage is not systematically mapped.
The public body does not map this.
Het openbaar lichaam brengt dit niet in kaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘Kritiek op niet naleven securityregels overheidswebsites: ‘geen rocketscience’’’

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Interior ministers why half of central government domain names fail mandatory security standards that should have been implemented by 2019 and 2021, and how lower governments are being held to account. The state secretary answers that only 50% of Rijksoverheid domains comply with web standards and 55% with email standards, attributes delays partly to external vendors such as Microsoft, and promises a letter to all governments urging compliance and a later update to parliament on the Justice ministry's own implementation.
I find it unacceptable that governments do not have this in order and will, by letter via the umbrella organisations, call on all governments to implement the standards as quickly as possible.
Ik vind het onacceptabel dat overheden dit niet op orde hebben en zal per brief, via de koepelorganisaties 2 , alle overheden oproepen zo snel mogelijk de standaarden te implementeren.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Gratis games zetten kinderen onder druk om aankopen te doen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a Consumentenbond report that free games aimed at children use in-game purchases to pressure them into buying advantages, and about the legality of such designs, enforcement, and whether children need stronger protection. The State Secretary called the findings worrying, announced an EU-level proposal to treat loot boxes as unfair commercial practices and a public awareness campaign, but said no specific national ban is planned and enforcement rests with the ACM.
In this context, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate intends to ask the European Commission whether loot boxes can be classified as an unfair commercial practice.
In het kader hiervan is de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voornemens aan de Europese Commissie voor te leggen of loot boxes 5 als oneerlijke handelspraktijk kunnen worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Teunissen, Van Raan and Simons asked whether the government will do enough to protect Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius from climate change, citing a VU report, and questioned the lack of adaptation strategies, water safety standards and Rijk funding for the islands. The State Secretary replied that climate scenarios for the Caribbean Netherlands are being developed by KNMI with results expected end 2023, that the public bodies bear primary responsibility for adaptation with Rijk support in knowledge and tools, and that no specific Rijk adaptation programme or new funding is planned.
On the basis of the outcomes of these studies it will be determined in which area further research is needed.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van deze onderzoeken zal bepaald worden op welk vlak vervolgonderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het onderzoek ‘The Impacts of Climate Change on Bonaire’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the government how it will respond to a study on climate change impacts on Bonaire, including measures to protect the island, consultation with residents facing a possible lawsuit, the state's responsibility, and the social-economic position of residents. The government answers that it has a shared responsibility with the public bodies, points to coral restoration funding, spatial planning instruments and a forthcoming KNMI climate scenario for the Caribbean, and offers knowledge support, but declines to answer the questions separately because of time constraints.

The cabinet considers it important that there is good insight into the consequences of climate change for the Caribbean Netherlands and that adaptation strategies are drawn up and implemented on that basis.

Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat er goed inzicht komt in de gevolgen van klimaatverandering voor Caribisch Nederland en dat op basis daarvan adaptatiestrategieën worden opgesteld en geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het bericht ‘Nederland doet te weinig om Bonaire te beschermen tegen bedreiging klimaatverandering’

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked the State Secretary and ministers about a report warning that Bonaire risks flooding from climate change, and whether Dutch climate law, international agreements and coordination should extend to the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for adaptation, that further studies and a climate table on Bonaire are planned, and that the Dutch Climate Act and Paris Agreement cannot simply extend to these islands.
The local government has the means to steer spatial planning so as to prevent as much damage and nuisance from extreme weather as possible.
Het lokale bestuur heeft de mogelijkheden om te sturen op een ruimtelijke ordening en inrichting waarmee schade en overlast door weersextremen zo veel mogelijk wordt voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Don’t download Qatar World Cup apps, EU data authorities warn´

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether she would warn against, and discuss with Google and Apple, two Qatar World Cup apps flagged by EU data authorities as privacy risks. The State Secretary answered that she would warn citizens, endorsing the Dutch Data Protection Authority's advice, but saw no reason for separate talks with Google and Apple given the World Cup had ended for the Netherlands.
I see no reason to enter into talks with Google and Apple as a cabinet in addition to the regulators' message.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op de boodschap van de toezichthouders als kabinet hierover in gesprek te gaan met Google en Apple.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over bankzaken op Saba

CDA MPs asked about banking access on Saba, including the Eilandsraad motion, bank and ATM presence, DNB supervision, mortgage access and ATM costs. The State Secretary acknowledged problems, pointed to agreements and a task force, and explained that supervision and market conditions limit options, without committing to a specific new measure.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, I do not have institution-specific information about PSB at my disposal.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van toezicht heb ik geen instelling specifieke informatie over PSB tot mijn beschikking.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over de toegezegde brief aan het lid Rajkowski (VVD) tijdens het Commissiedebat Telecomraad van 31 mei 2022 over de mogelijke gevaren rondom het uitschakelen van 2G en 3G i

An MP asks whether the shutdown of 2G and 3G in 2025 will leave only 4G/5G for calls, whether government can influence the timing, and how emergency 112 reachability and VoLTE reliability will be affected. The minister answers that providers decide shutdown timing under technology neutrality, that VoLTE calling is not yet as reliable as 2G/3G but is being worked on, and that she will send a supplementary letter, without guaranteeing provider-independent 112 access.
At this moment I cannot guarantee that. But I am committed to it.
Op dit moment kan ik dat niet garanderen. Maar ik zet ik mij daar wel voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Kuik over het bericht “De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland”

MPs Bontenbal and Kuik asked whether Dutch hosting firms facilitate hate-speech and child-abuse websites such as 8kun and Daily Stormer, and what the government can do. The minister answers that hosts must act on known illegal content, that the ATKM will cover terrorist and child-abuse material while online hate speech remains outside its scope, and that an interdepartmental inventory on hate speech is underway.
There is no legal framework for supervising the content hosted in the Netherlands.
Er bestaat geen wettelijk kader voor toezicht op de content die in Nederland wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door vervoersbedrijven

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked whether anonymous international train travel is practically impossible, who is responsible for processing passenger data, and why ticket counters are closing. The state secretary answered that anonymous travel is still possible to about 200 destinations, that there is no general legal duty on carriers to prevent anonymous travel, that the GDPR governs data processing with controllers identified per ticket sale, and that the number of international ticket counters fell from 10 to 5 with personal assistance offered elsewhere.
Providing personal data when travelling is not unusual.
Het afgeven van persoonsgegevens bij vervoer is niet ongebruikelijk.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Chinese TikTok bij het gebruik van de in-app browser alle toetsaanslagen vastlegt en daarmee wachtwoorden en creditcardgegevens kan verzamelen

An MP asked the government about reports that TikTok's in-app browser may record keystrokes, including passwords and credit card data, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that data protection supervision is the task of the independent regulator, that the government will raise the principles with TikTok in a meeting, and that the government will strengthen oversight, without itself investigating or ordering deletion.
Overseeing and enforcing the lawfulness of data processing in the private sector is not a task of the cabinet but of the supervisory authority.
Antwoord 4 Het houden van toezicht op en het handhaven van de rechtmatigheid van gegevensverwerkingen in de private sector is geen taak van het kabinet, maar van de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Overheid schendt eigen regels door cookies van derden toe te laten op websites'

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether third-party cookies on government and government-linked websites comply with the rules and whether they should be banned. The government answered that the Telecommunications Act and GDPR apply equally to government sites, that it will write to other governments and ministries about compliance, draft a guidance document with them, and discuss whether government tracking cookies are desirable.

Because I consider it important that government websites comply with applicable laws and regulations, I will write to subnational governments and central government organisations pointing out the importance of compliance and asking them to check their websites.

Omdat ik het belangrijk vind dat de overheidswebsites voldoen aan geldende wet- en regelgeving, zal ik medeoverheden en rijksoverheidsorganisaties per brief wijzen op het belang hieraan te voldoen, en te verzoeken dit voor hun websites na te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over een mislukt ICT-project dat gegund is aan een stichting van een ambtenaar

MP Leijten asked why the Ministry of BZK awarded a failed ICT project to a foundation whose board included civil servants of the same ministry, and about the decision-making, advice, information to parliament and mistakes made. The minister answered at length, acknowledging that the foundation was set up outside the Stichtingenkader procedure, that the award was insufficiently justified and documented, that the appearance of conflict of interest arose, and that parliament was not informed, while promising improvements.
Your House was not informed about the award of the assignment to and the termination of the cooperation with foundation NTF.
Uw Kamer is niet geïnformeerd over de opdrachtverlening aan en het beëindigen van de samenwerking met stichting NTF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Verpleeghuizen Curaçao in geldnood, ouderen moeten maaltijd delen'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that nursing homes on Curaçao lacked money and residents had to share meals, asking about remedies, whether financial aid was requested, the Kingdom's guarantee function under Article 43 of the Statute, and the status of human rights treaty implementation. The government answered that talks with Curaçao's ministry are ongoing, that no aid was requested for this problem, that the Kingdom intervenes only as a last resort, and that a working committee is pursuing treaty implementation without firm timelines for all treaties.
That is not correct. No request for financial support for this specific problem was made to the Netherlands government.
Dat klopt niet. Er is bij de regering van het land Nederland niet om financiële steun gevraagd voor dit specifieke probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de economische cijfers voor Caribisch Nederland voor 2020

An MP from CDA asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the 2020 economic contraction of 25.9% on Sint Eustatius, the role of the entry ban, air and ferry connections, Bonaire medical charter seats, and destination marketing budgets. The State Secretary attributed the contraction mainly to the oil, hospitality and recreation sectors, described ferry and air connectivity measures, explained why charter seats cannot be used for regular passengers, and said there is no fixed destination marketing budget.
I will inform you of the results of this in due course
Ik zal u te zijner tijd over de resultaten hiervan informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikht over het artikel ‘Nederland houdt Caribische staatsburgers al twaalf jaar arm’

An MP asks the government why minimum wages, benefits and living costs on the Caribbean Netherlands islands remain far below the European Netherlands despite parliamentary motions and advice from the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights and the Ombudsman, and asks for a fixed social minimum and comparative data. The minister acknowledges high poverty, outlines a phased wage and benefit increase and a social-minimum target for 2025, but gives no firm date for formally setting the minimum and lacks data on housing and comparative costs.

The cabinet is working hard within the context and socio-economic conditions of the Caribbean Netherlands to move towards a level of livelihood security equivalent to that of the European Netherlands.

Het kabinet zet zich hard in om binnen de context en de sociaaleconomische omstandigheden in Caribisch Nederland verder toe werken naar een, ten opzichte van Europees Nederland, gelijkwaardig niveau van bestaanszekerheid in Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het bericht 'Eilandsraad Sint Eustatius voelt zich gechanteerd door Den Haag'

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the Sint Eustatius island council felt blackmailed by The Hague over the transition to phase 2.0, including the process, transparency, ministry errors and a critical island council motion. The State Secretary answered that the process was transparent and that the council agreed to adopt the outstanding ordinances to allow the appointment of two deputies, while acknowledging some timing shortcomings and promising better aligned expectations.
I am of the view that the course of the transition process has been transparent.
Ik ben van mening dat het verloop van het transitieproces transparant is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht 'Moeder vraagt om hulp: 10-jarige Arianny kan op Bonaire niet naar school'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a news report on a 10-year-old on Bonaire unable to attend school, and about special education and compulsory schooling for children with disabilities in Caribbean Netherlands. The minister answered that the child has been placed, that a specialist facility opened in September 2022, that no new study is needed given the 2020 Berenschot evaluation, and that a new education agenda will explore structural provision.
No, there is a publicly funded primary school specifically aimed at pupils who need extra support, the Strea Briante.
Er is een bekostigde school voor primair onderwijs die zich specifiek richt op leerlingen die extra ondersteuning nodig hebben, de Strea Briante.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over de brief Instellingsbesluit Commissie Sociaal Minimum d.d. 8 juli 2022

An MP asked whether the Commission Sociaal Minimum review of the social minimum covers the Caribbean Netherlands islands and whether they will be added, and whether the government applies comply-or-explain there. The minister acknowledges comply-or-explain, explains that the Caribbean islands will be reviewed in a separate trajectory with a 2024 study and a 2025 target, and does not add them to the commission's mandate.
For the Caribbean Netherlands, the cabinet chooses a separate trajectory ("explain").
Voor Caribisch Nederland kiest het kabinet voor een separaat traject («explain»).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over paspoortwalhalla voor topcriminelen

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Dutch municipal officials, including one in The Hague, helped criminals obtain false identities by issuing passports, and about why the official stayed employed for years after an integrity investigation. The state secretary answered that RvIG has engaged The Hague and that the municipality handled personnel sanctions itself, and pointed to a July letter listing measures against identity fraud and a forthcoming RvIG inquiry into procedural deviations.
I want to state up front that the municipality of The Hague is responsible for its own personnel policy.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat de gemeente Den Haag over haar eigen persoonsbeleid gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Michon-Derkzen over de brief ‘Aankondiging van maatregelen ter voorkoming identiteitsfraude’

MPs Rajkowski and Michon-Derkzen asked how many officials issued fraudulent identity documents, whether criminal proceedings exist, which municipalities are involved, and what follow-up is planned for affected citizens and personnel integrity. The government says dozens of cases are known, ongoing criminal investigations cannot be detailed, the RvIG will examine procedural deviations with results expected by year end, and it will promote integrity checks and a possible certification register while noting municipalities hold personnel powers.
I cannot provide further information about these investigations.
Over deze onderzoeken kan ik geen nadere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht ‘NIST kiest wapens tegen kwantumcomputer als cryptokraker’

An MP asked the ministers whether quantum computers threaten secure communication and state and business secrets, what concrete preparations the government is making, and how it is investing in quantum technology. The state secretary agreed the risk is real, described migration to quantum-safe systems, national investments and European participation, and stated the government will publish guidance and coordinate a migration plan.
For the central government and sub-national governments, but also for the private sector, this means they will have to migrate to quantum-safe systems and technologies.
Voor de rijksoverheid en medeoverheden, maar ook voor de private sector, betekent dit dat zij zullen moeten migreren naar kwantumveilige systemen en technologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit die ongevraagd gegevens van honderdduizenden patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg opvraagt

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked why the Dutch healthcare regulator NZa collects mental health patients' medical data without consent, whether this is acceptable given remaining re-identification risk, and whether providers refusing on confidentiality grounds face fines. The minister replies that the NZa has a statutory basis under the Wmg and GDPR art. 9(2)(g)/(h), that data are pseudonymised and destroyed after two years, that consent is not required for legally mandated transfers, and that enforcement is for the NZa to decide.
It is correct that patients are not asked for consent to share their medical data with the NZa, and that is also not necessary, because the NZa has a statutory basis to request this data.

Het klopt dat patiënten niet om toestemming gevraagd wordt om hun medische gegevens te delen met de NZa en dat is ook niet noodzakelijk, omdat de NZa een wettelijke grondslag heeft om deze gegevens op te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over lekkende zorgdata

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the ministers how a commercial software firm could leak medical data of tens of thousands of patients, why warnings from a former employee were not acted on, whether patients and GPs must be informed, and whether additional protections against commercial use of medical data are planned. The government answered that providers are primarily responsible, that the AP supervises GDPR compliance, that it cannot comment on AIVD/MIVD investigations, and that existing rules are sufficient with further awareness and enforcement efforts.
No public statements are made about the working methods and investigations of the AIVD and MIVD.
Over werkwijzen en onderzoeken van de AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Rajkowski over het bericht over ‘Commercieel softwarebedrijf schendt jarenlang de privacy van tienduizenden patiënten"

MPs Tielen and Rajkowski asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about a Follow the Money report that a commercial software company had for years breached the privacy of tens of thousands of patients and GP medical confidentiality. The minister answered that the case is known to the ministry, that the Data Protection Authority is examining it, that data-protection rules already apply, and that efforts to improve compliance and the Wegiz bill will address such problems, without committing to new specific measures.
The AP in principle makes no statements about individual reports and cases in the context of possible investigation.
Over individuele meldingen en zaken doet de AP in het kader van eventueel onderzoek in principe geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over het bericht 'Directie IT-bedrijf Centric stapt op na conflict met eigenaar Sanderink'

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether the resignation of Centric's executive board after a conflict with its owner could disrupt IT services to central and local government. The State Secretary replied that central government's contracts with Centric are limited, that Centric assured contractual obligations would be met, and that the VNG and user association report no current risk to services.
Where we have contractual agreements with Centric, we assume they will abide by them.
Daar waar we contractuele afspraken met Centric hebben, gaan wij ervan uit dat zij zich daaraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Known Traveller Digital Identity (KTDI) project van het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An MP asked the government about the current status of the WEF Known Traveller Digital Identity project, whether it had been reconsidered by Canada and the Netherlands, whether it was registered with the IC-toetsing advisory college, and when promised documents would be sent. The government replied that there are no concrete plans to implement the pilot, that no government IT investment above €5 million is foreseen so it was not registered, and that the documents will be sent before the Christmas recess.
No, this project has not yet been registered with the Adviescollege IC-toetsing since no government IT investment above €5,000,000 is foreseen.
Nee, dit project is nog niet aangemeld bij het Adviescollege IC-toetsing aangezien er geen IV-investering vanuit de overheid boven de € 5.000.000 is voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het onderzoek 'De staat van privacy bij gemeenten' van Bits of Freedom

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a Bits of Freedom study finding that most large Dutch municipalities do not comply with the GDPR, including on data overview and handling of citizens' access requests, and about resources for data protection officers and the Data Protection Authority. The government acknowledges the problem, promises talks with the VNG and municipalities, points to an ongoing WODC study and measures such as algorithm registers, while stating its view that current Data Protection Authority funding is adequate.

That is why I will enter into discussion with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) and municipalities to see how the cabinet can support them in getting their information management in order.

Daarom zal ik in gesprek treden met de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) en gemeenten om te kijken op welke wijze het kabinet kan ondersteunen bij het op orde krijgen van hun informatiehuishouding.
Antwoord op vragen van  de leden Wilders en De Graaf over de rol van gezaghebbers in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether State Secretary Van Huffelen misinformed the House about the duty of island governors (gezaghebbers) in the Caribbean Netherlands to vote in the executive board under the WolBES, and whether she would apologise to Bonaire's governor. The State Secretary replied that she had not misinformed the House, that the governor has a principled duty to vote only when a vote takes place, that consensus is normally sought, and that she sees no reason to apologise.
The House has not been misinformed by me.
De Kamer is door mij niet verkeerd geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de beantwoording van de vragen over discriminatie bij de controle op de Basisregistratie Personen

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a discriminatory risk profile used in checks on the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including the 22 affected persons, possible compensation, how the profile arose, and accountability for officials. The State Secretary said an independent investigation (Integis BV) will report around end September, condemned the profile, and gave partial answers, declining to address individual officials' accountability or compensation until the facts are known.
I have instructed the investigators to examine how the profile came about, which parties were involved, and what considerations led to drawing up this profile.
Ik heb de onderzoekers opdracht gegeven om na te gaan hoe het profiel is ontstaan, welke partijen betrokken waren en welke afwegingen ertoe hebben geleid dit profiel op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het nieuws dat de SMS-controle van DigiD wordt uitgefaseerd

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about plans to phase out SMS authentication for DigiD, whether this forces use of Apple and Google apps, why the app is not open source, and whether trackers and US data access are a concern. The State Secretary answered that SMS authentication remains for now, that the app is limited to iOS and Android for reach and security reasons, that the source code is being explored for publication, and that the trackers are technical and collect no personal data.
An exploration of whether it is possible to publish the DigiD source code as open source is underway, but publication must be done in a responsible and secure way.
Een verkenning of het mogelijk is om de broncode van DigiD open source te publiceren is gaande, maar het publiceren van de broncode moet wel op een verantwoordelijke en veilige manier mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het Ceder en Bikker over het bericht ‘Curaçaos roulette’

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about the Argos report on weak supervision of Curaçao's online gambling sector, its risks, Dutch involvement, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government acknowledged insufficient oversight, pointed to Kingdom package measures H.2 and H.19 for reform, and said licensing and enforcement fall under Curaçao's autonomy, with technical assistance offered.
The cabinet nonetheless recognises the statements made in the broadcast and endorses the finding that there is insufficient effective control and supervision of the online gambling sector in Curaçao.

Het kabinet herkent evenwel de uitlatingen die in de uitzending zijn gedaan en onderschrijft de constatering dat er onvoldoende effectieve controle en toezicht is op de online kansspelsector in Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Aruba heeft geen boodschap aan RMR en Cft: Geld vliegt de deur uit’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that Aruba is ignoring advice from the RMR and the Cft on its public finances, asking about the consequences of rising debt and whether the government will hold the Aruban cabinet to account. The State Secretary agreed the situation is very worrying, explained the possible financial risks, but declined to judge Aruba's budget policy while a formal Article 11 procedure is ongoing, promising to inform the House once the RMR decision on the Cft advice is taken.
The budget policy pursued by Aruba is currently subject to an Article 11 procedure, with a hearing and rebuttal process, under the adopted 2022 budget.
Over het door Aruba gevoerde begrotingsbeleid loopt in kader van de Vastgestelde Begroting 2022 momenteel een artikel 11-procedure met een hoor- en wederhoor traject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over de uitzending van Kassa over digitale toegankelijkheid en verdere verantwoordelijkheden rond een toegankelijke samenleving13-6-2022

MP Werner (CDA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast on the digital inaccessibility of government websites and apps, the widening digital divide, enforcement of the 2018 accessibility decision, ministerial responsibility for an accessible society, support for businesses, and whether a government accessibility commissioner should be appointed. The minister acknowledges persistent accessibility problems, describes a step-by-step plan with strengthened supervision and an accessibility facilitator, but declines to appoint a separate commissioner.
To ensure that improvement measures actually lead to better accessibility, not only extra support is offered to government organisations, but supervision of compliance is also strengthened.

Om te waarborgen dat verbetermaatregelen daadwerkelijk leiden tot betere toegankelijkheid wordt niet alleen extra ondersteuning geboden aan overheidsorganisaties, maar ook het toezicht op de naleving versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Zonder DigiD lukt zorgen bijna niet'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for the Interior and the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the difficulty legal representatives and informal carers face handling government matters online, since DigiD is personal and sharing it is prohibited. The government acknowledges the problem, says it is developing a central service to verify representative authority from court registers, and maintains that DigiD must remain personal for protection reasons.

Under my responsibility, a central solution is now being developed which, after a login request by a representative, queries the necessary source registers and issues a declaration to the service provider concerned.

Onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid wordt nu gewerkt aan een centrale oplossing die, na een inlogverzoek door een vertegenwoordiger, de benodigde bronregisters bevraagt en een verklaring afgeeft aan de dienstverlener in kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Ginneken over het bericht dat de clouddienst van Microsoft niet gebruikt kan worden voor de uitwisseling of opslag van gevoelige of bijzondere persoonsgegevens

An MP from D66 asked ministers how they assess reports that Microsoft cloud services cannot be used for sensitive personal data given possible US intelligence access, and what measures will limit such use. The government answered that the DPIA does not rule out Microsoft services, that mitigation such as customer-managed encryption keys and standard contractual clauses apply, and that a national cloud strategy and EU enforcement work are pending.
Risks are identified that affect access to government services, but solutions are also identified to mitigate this risk.
Er worden risico’s gesignaleerd die raken aan de toegang tot overheidsdiensten, maar ook oplossingen geïdentificeerd om dit risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Kuiken en Den Haan over problemen met het notariaat op Saba en Sint Eustatius

MPs Ceder, Kuiken and Den Haan asked about the closure of the only notary office on Saba and Sint Eustatius from 1 July 2022, its consequences, the lack of a legal fallback, and plans for a durable solution. The minister said a temporary notary (waarnemer) is being recruited, that a longer-term extension of Bonaire notaries' work area is intended, and that individual cases will get tailored help, without a fixed timetable.
I am willing to take the necessary measures to ensure that residents of Saba and Sint Eustatius have sustainable access to notarial services.
Ik ben bereid om de noodzakelijke maatregelen te treffen om ervoor te zorgen dat de inwoners van Saba en Sint Eustatius duurzaam van toegang tot het notariaat zijn voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Sylvana Simons over het meest recente IPCC-rapport in relatie tot Bonaire, Statia en Saba

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked the government about the latest IPCC report and its implications for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including climate adaptation, water safety, the 1.5-degree target, and energy transition. The government answered that the report lacks a Caribbean-specific assessment, that these islands are largely excluded from national climate laws and plans, and that a sustainable energy route map is promised before the summer recess.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Oligarchen hebben vliegtuigen op Aruba’

MPs Ceder and Kuiken asked whether Russian oligarchs' private aircraft are registered in Aruba and how sanctions are coordinated across the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The government answers that Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten enforce EU sanctions themselves, that frozen assets and a few aircraft and a ship were identified, and that six Aruban aircraft were restricted or removed from the register.

Regarding Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten, the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and of Infrastructure and Water Management, nor any other Dutch ministries, have legal powers to obtain insight into the nature and extent of Russian oligarchs' assets.

Met betrekking tot Curaçao, Aruba en Sint Maarten (de CAS) hebben het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken, Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat noch andere Nederlandse ministeries juridische bevoegdheden waarmee inzage verkregen kan worden in de aard en omvang van bezittingen van Russische oligarchen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder DigiD lukt zorgen bijna niet’

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked why legal representatives may not use a DigiD on behalf of the person they represent, and what is being done about the burden on informal carers and legal representatives. The State Secretary answers that DigiD is personal and non-transferable for protective reasons, that a technical register-based solution for legal representatives is being developed with an expected phased rollout early next year, and that interim alternatives and talks with stakeholders are underway.
To obtain government services, one must be identified, including digitally.
Om diensten af te nemen bij de overheid moet worden vastgesteld wie je bent, ook digitaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de weigering van bedrijven op basis van geautomatiseerde kredietchecks

Two SP MPs asked whether automated credit checks by companies, which collect and retain privacy-sensitive data, are desirable, what legal basis exists, whether human intervention is required under the GDPR, who must correct erroneous data, and where citizens can turn when wrongly excluded. The minister acknowledged the impact on citizens, explained the GDPR principles and data controller responsibilities, and referred supervision to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens while describing existing rectification rights and programmes.
However, it cannot be established in general terms on which legal basis(es) the processing in the context of offering credit checks is based.
Het is echter niet in algemene zin vast te stellen op welke grondslag(en) de verwerkingen in het kader van het aanbieden van kredietchecks zijn gebaseerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de bescherming en het behoud van het koraal en de natuur in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked about a resort on Bonaire that built an artificial beach without permits, the threat to coral, why the permit was granted quickly against advice, and enforcement of nature protection in the Caribbean Netherlands, totalling 15 questions. The government confirmed unpermitted sand dumping, a fine of 1.2 million US dollars, and a later permit with coral-protection conditions, while describing shared responsibilities between the island council and the Rijk and listing planned reforms to permitting and enforcement.
The island executive did not follow the advice of the Bonaire nature commission. It is also not obliged to do so.
Het bestuurscollege heeft daarbij niet het advies van de natuurcommissie Bonaire gevolgd. Het bestuurscollege is daartoe ook niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paulusma over de artikelen 'Het ene Nederland is het andere niet' en 'Er vallen doden door slechte zorg Sint Eustatius'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretaries about press articles reporting deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including referral problems and the role of Zorg en Jeugd Caribisch Nederland. The government acknowledged the problems, described steps taken and planned (a referral pilot, protocol review, talks with providers), but declined to commission a specific investigation, pointing to the IGJ calamity inquiry already under way.
I am willing to enter into discussion with care providers about their concerns.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met zorgverleners over hun zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Kamminga over de berichten ‘Er vallen doden door slechte gezondheidszorg Sint Eustatius’ en ‘Het ene Nederland is het andere niet’

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the State Secretaries about reports of deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including the hospitainer's equipment, staffing, appointment of a hospital director and stakeholder involvement. The government denied the hospitainer was inadequate or unstaffed, said no new director was appointed but a temporary CMO was added, and committed to a study of healthcare in Caribbean Netherlands and to a letter for the budget debate.
I will send your House a letter before the 2022 budget debate in response to question 9.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2022 als antwoord op vraag 9 een brief sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Sylvana Simons  en Arib over de uitkomsten van PwC-onderzoeken naar de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MPs Koekkoek, Simons and Arib asked the government about PwC findings on the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), including use of ethnicity-based risk profiles and whether this amounts to institutional racism. The State Secretary largely declined to characterise the practice as racism, stated that nationality will only be used in supervision with a clear legal basis, promised a compensation scheme and reforms, but deferred many substantive questions on racism and definitions.
I cannot make a general statement about that.
Ik kan daar geen algemene uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Slob: Media in Caribisch Nederland helpen zichzelf te versterken'

Two D66 MPs asked whether local media on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are strong and independent enough to scrutinise local government, and what steps followed a prior study. The State Secretary answered that the media sector is relatively large but faces independence and self-censorship concerns, that a plan to professionalise journalism will follow, and that the Chamber will be informed before the media budget debate.
Once the plan is ready, I will inform the Chamber about it in more detail.
Zodra het plan gereed is, zal ik de Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Staaij over de uitwerking van de plannen inzake het toevoegen van ‘hate speech’ onder Artikel 83 Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU)

MPs Stoffer and Van der Staaij asked the government how it assesses the European Commission's plan to add hate speech and hate crime to the EU crimes list under Article 83 TFEU, covering necessity, legal basis, proportionality, free speech, and the link to Dutch law. The Minister of Justice answered that the government supports the proposal in principle, considers Dutch law largely adequate but benefits from EU-level harmonisation, and will assess any later directive against fundamental rights and Dutch criminal law when it appears.
The cabinet will guard the balance between, on the one hand, the importance of combating crime and, on the other, a possible infringement of fundamental rights.
Het kabinet zal waken voor de balans tussen enerzijds het belang van de criminaliteitsbestrijding en een mogelijke inbreuk op grondrechten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over ‘Zorgen om medicijnverstrekking op Bonaire

An MP asked why the hospital pharmacy on Bonaire was closed abruptly, whether the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders and related rules apply, and what action the government will take. The government explained the closure as a move to a new pharmacy with its own entrance to reduce COVID-19 risk for vulnerable elderly, noted delays due to staff shortages, said the Wet toetreding zorgaanbieders does not apply, and stated the new pharmacy opened on 14 March 2022.
The plan was to open a new hospital pharmacy, Botika Playa, on 13 January 2022.
Het plan was om een nieuwe ziekenhuisapotheek Botika Playa te openen op 13 januari 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht 'Online criminelen bestoken de wereld met cyberaanvallen vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice, Economic Affairs and the State Secretary for Interior about reports that criminals use Dutch servers and hosting resellers for cyberattacks, asking about scale, enforcement, cooperation and hosting-sector responsibility. The government answered that ransomware is a growing threat with low reporting rates, that enforcement is complicated by foreign perpetrators and anonymity, and that it supports EU measures and sector codes while pointing to ongoing coalition agreement work.
If your House requests a technical briefing, this can be provided.
Indien uw Kamer verzoekt om een technische briefing kan daarin worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s
