MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het ontwikkelen van een Europese digitale identiteit in het algemeen en in het bijzonder in relatie tot het coronatoegangsbewijs

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior about the EU European Digital Identity framework, its links to the COVID certificate and Dutch e-ID infrastructure, the data attributes to be included, and GDPR data minimisation. The State Secretary answered that the framework is a revision of eIDAS, that the COVID certificate technology is separate though lessons will be used, that vaccination status is not among the minimum attributes, and that the government is cautious about scope and timing.
Question 21: Can you answer these questions before 22 March 2022 in connection with the planned committee debate? Answer 21: No.
Vraag 21 Kunt u deze vragen beantwoorden voor 22 maart 2022 in verband met het geplande commissiedebat Digitale overheid, datagebruik en algoritmen, digitale identiteit? Antwoord 21 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over discriminatie bij de controle op de Basisregistratie Personen

MP Van Baarle asks the State Secretary about discrimination in the BRP address-check project, including a profile targeting older foreign-born single benefit recipients, whether it was used, what was done, who knew and whether there are other discriminatory profiles. The State Secretary answers that 22 signals were found, that an independent forensic investigation has been commissioned, that she rejects the profile, and that no other profiles with nationality criteria were used.
I am having independent research carried out by an external forensic investigator into the application of this profile, including at the three municipalities.
Ik laat onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren door een externe forensisch onderzoeker naar de toepassing van dit profiel, onder andere bij de drie gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Superjachten van rijke Russen in beslag genomen door Frankrijk en Duitsland’

MPs Kamminga and Brekelmans asked whether Russian oligarchs' superyachts in Sint Maarten waters should be seized as France and Germany had done, and why the Kingdom had not acted. The Minister replied that the Kingdom must implement EU sanctions, that action would follow if listed owners' vessels were found there, that no such case currently exists, and that the government is in contact with Sint Maarten and monitors the situation.
If vessels owned by persons on the EU individual sanctions list are located in Sint Maarten waters (or other parts of the Kingdom), action will be taken.

Indien schepen van eigenaren, die voorkomen op de EU-sanctielijst voor individuen, zich bevinden in de wateren van Sint Maarten (of andere delen van het Koninkrijk) zal hiertoe actie worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over AirTags

An MP asks whether AirTags pose stalking and privacy risks, whether the Wet Belaging is adequate given that stalking is a complaint offence, and how the GDPR and anti-stalking policy apply. The minister answers that the existing legal framework is sufficient, that Apple has added anti-misuse safeguards, that the GDPR's household exemption applies and enforcement is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and points to ongoing stalking-prevention and victim-support efforts.
Of course, the cabinet is closely monitoring developments.
Uiteraard houdt het kabinet de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan en Wassenberg over de uitzending van Zembla 'Bedreigd Nederlands Koraal' van 17 februari 222

MPs Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan and Wassenberg asked about a Zembla broadcast on threats to Bonaire's coral reef, including a planned oil pier, BBT's sustainability mandate and the 40 million euro WEB green-energy request. The minister answers that no new pier is currently planned, that 10 million euro was invested in BBT for the energy transition, and that a transition roadmap for the Caribbean Netherlands will follow before summer.
To avoid influencing the tender for the construction, some data remain confidential.
Om de aanbesteding van de bouw niet te beïnvloeden, blijven sommige gegevens vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de ontwikkeling van een digitale identiteit

An MP from FvD asked the State Secretary for Interior about the Dutch government's role in developing a European Digital Identity, including its personnel involvement, goals, data content and timeline. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands actively participates in negotiations and technical working groups on the eIDAS revision and Toolbox, that no prototype, app or API exists yet, and that no realistic implementation date can be given until the regulation's negotiations progress.
It will always be up to the citizen themselves to what extent they wish to participate in the European Digital Identity.
Het zal altijd aan de burger zelf zijn in hoeverre ze aan de Europese Digitale Identiteit willen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat de meest recente cyberaanval in Oekraïne verliep via Nederland

An MP asked the government about reports that a cyberattack on Ukraine was routed via Dutch servers, including whether it was a DDoS combined with disinformation, the risks for the Netherlands, and what is being done to stop such attacks. The government answered that attribution and counting of attacks routed via Dutch servers is not feasible, that the NCSC sees no impact on Dutch interests, and that legislation to tackle the cyber-domain bottlenecks is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de financiële ondersteuning op de BES-eilanden van ouders met een zorgintensief kind

An MP asked the ministers why parents of children needing intensive care on the Caribbean Netherlands islands do not receive the double child benefit available in Europe, and whether this gap is justified. The minister acknowledged the gap, said a supplementary allowance is being worked out with implementation and legal aspects under study, and pointed to other ministries' measures on care and education.
I believe that an allowance for parents of children with intensive care needs must also be introduced in the Caribbean Netherlands.
Ik vind dat er ook een tegemoetkoming voor ouders van kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte in Caribisch Nederland moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Grinwis en Ceder over het gebruik van eHerkenning

MPs Omtzigt, Grinwis and Ceder asked why the government keeps requiring eHerkenning for tax filing despite a Gelderland court ruling questioning its legal basis, and about refunds, penalties and a free public alternative. The State Secretary defends the legal basis, says the ruling does not affect other tax assessments, offers a limited compensation scheme, and refuses to provide a free public login or restore paper filing for now.
To clarify this, I will have an addendum published on the Tax Administration's website.
Om dit toe te lichten zal ik een naschrift laten publiceren op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Rudmer Heerema en Rajkowski over de verplichte MY2022 app bij de Olympische Spelen

VVD MPs asked whether data from the mandatory MY2022 Olympic app could be used for surveillance, whether it is securely transmitted and shared with third parties, whether the government will press the IOC and Chinese authorities to make it compliant or optional, and what measures the Netherlands will take. The minister answered that the risks fit a broader picture of Chinese data collection, that the app's encryption lacks authenticity checks, that data is shared with Chinese companies, that Dutch athletes are not obliged to use the app but must use the HMS function (which can be used online), that concerns were raised with the Chinese ambassador, and that briefings for NOC*NSF will be repeated.
Our concerns about this app were therefore conveyed to the Chinese ambassador in The Hague prior to the Games.
Onze zorgen over deze app zijn dan ook voorafgaand aan de Spelen overgebracht aan de Chinese ambassadeur in Den Haag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over Known Traveller Digital Identity (KTDI) van het World Economic Forum (WEF) van 12 januari 2022

MP Van Houwelingen asked whether the Dutch government is a KTDI pilot partner of the World Economic Forum and requested all related documents. The state secretary confirmed the Netherlands was approached in 2018, joined a public-private consortium with a 2019 letter of intent signed by the ambassador to Canada, and that the pilot is now very uncertain; documents were promised before summer.
This request is extensive and takes time. I aim to send you these documents before the summer.
Dit verzoek is omvangrijk en kost tijd. Ik streef ernaar u deze documenten voor de zomer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de digitale kwetsbaarheid van gemeenten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about municipalities struggling with ICT quality, security and privacy, and about sharing best practices. The State Secretary said the government has no overview of municipal ICT quality, that municipalities are responsible themselves within the BIO framework, and listed knowledge-sharing initiatives and a commitment to work with the VNG on strengthening digital resilience.
No, I do not have an overview of the quality of municipal ICT systems.
Nee, ik beschik niet over een overzicht van de kwaliteit van ICT-systemen van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Boucke over het artikel 'Bonaire krijgt een E-Flight Academy voor elektrisch vliegen'

MPs Wuite and Boucke (D66) asked about a plan for an electric flight academy on Bonaire, the outcomes of a student challenge, the masterplan for electric aviation in the Caribbean, public service obligations on inter-island routes, and exclusion of Caribbean Netherlands from electric vehicle and energy subsidies. The minister answered most questions substantively, noting the masterplan, the challenge winners, a forthcoming exploration of public service obligations in the autumn, and that subsidy questions fall under the climate and energy minister.
Following this evaluation, the possibility is being explored of using the public service obligation instrument to better safeguard accessibility of this part of the Netherlands.

Naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie wordt de mogelijkheid verkend om het instrument van de openbaredienstverplichting in te zetten teneinde de bereikbaarheid van dit deel van Nederland beter te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Aruba: ongevaccineerde ambtenaar krijgt geen loon tijdens verplichte quarantaine’

The MP asked whether unvaccinated civil servants in Aruba must use leave or overtime during mandatory quarantine, and whether this violates Kingdom minimum standards. The State Secretary answered that the minister said unvaccinated civil servants will be paid during quarantine, and that Aruba itself is responsible for COVID-19 measures within legal frameworks.
It is up to Aruba itself to take mitigating measures to combat COVID-19, within the legal framework.
Het is aan Aruba zelf om mitigerende maatregelen te nemen om COVID-19 te bestrijden, passend binnen de juridische kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het artikel 'Juridische fuik overheid maakt burgers 'kansloos''

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the government about press reports that strict Awb deadlines leave citizens powerless when they file late objections, and about the 'bestuurlijke lus' and the citizen's ability to navigate the law. The minister says the Awb will be revised, citing a 2021 change in case law softening late-objection rules, and promises to examine a 'burgerlijke lus' and to consider more lenient handling of deadlines in two-party disputes.
In this context it is being examined whether to give administrative bodies more room to substantively handle an objection that was not filed within six weeks.
Hierbij wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheid om meer ruimte te bieden voor bestuursorganen om een niet binnen zes weken ingediend bezwaar alsnog inhoudelijk te kunnen behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Zelfs betrokkenen ‘Bulgarenfraude’ krijgen tienduizenden euro’s compensatie'

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that people involved in the 'Bulgarian fraud' received compensation of tens of thousands of euros, and whether the same IP addresses were used, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, how much was wrongly paid out, and whether money would be recovered. The State Secretary answered that 14 people received the flat-rate EUR 30,000 after a first check, that a full later assessment is pending, that the error rate of the first check is estimated at 2-5%, that recovery will only occur in cases of evident misuse, and that an internal presentation was shared on request while internal signals will be summarised in a later letter.

I do not have those reports. Signals within the organisation about possible improper and indiscriminate use of the recovery schemes directed at my predecessor or senior management are of a personal nature and are often traceable to individual employees.

Over die meldingen beschik ik niet. Signalen in de organisatie over mogelijk oneigenlijk en ongericht gebruik van de herstelregelingen bij mijn ambtsvoorganger of het hogere management zijn van persoonlijke aard en zijn vaak herleidbaar tot individuele medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het bericht dat de compensatie van toeslagenschandaal soms verkeerd terecht komt

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance why compensation for the childcare benefits scandal sometimes reaches people not entitled to it, how long internal warnings were known, and why the reimbursement rules and the Catshuis scheme were adopted without a statutory basis. The State Secretary answered that a deliberate trade-off between generosity, speed and legality means some undeserved payments are unavoidable, that internal signals are taken seriously but the list of internal reports will not be shared to protect staff, and that the Wet hersteloperatie toeslagen is delayed after a critical Council of State advice.
They are part of the regular assessment process.
Zij lopen mee in het reguliere beoordelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries'

An MP asked the State Secretary and ministers why the Saba/Sint Eustatius ferry service failed to start on 1 November 2021, whether customs and Marechaussee were unprepared, and about affordability and remaining obstacles. The government answered that the start slipped to 14 November due to tender extensions and missing safety certificates, that the ferry started on 1 December 2021, and that ministries coordinated with the island authorities.
Due to the extension of the tender period at the request of the participating parties, the target start date had to be adjusted to 14 November 2021.
Door verlenging van de aanbestedingstermijn op verzoek van de deelnemende partijen moest de streefdatum van de start echter worden bijgesteld naar 14 november 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over 'gemeenten helpen gedupeerden toeslagaffaire: 'Het kan in kleine dingen zitten''

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority matches municipalities in the human approach to childcare benefits scandal victims, whether municipalities are overburdened with objections and default notices, and how cooperation and compensation work. The State Secretary answers that a personal approach is central, that UHT assigns personal case handlers, that cooperation has improved through contact points and consultations, and that municipal support is funded via a specific grant, while promising a revision (herijking) letter with proposals.

In the letter on the revision that will be sent to your House together with these answers, I will go further into the conclusions from those conversations and the steps I will take to improve the process for parents.

In de brief over de herijking die gezamenlijk met de beantwoording van deze vragen naar uw Kamer wordt verzonden, ga ik dieper in op de conclusies uit die gesprekken alsmede welke stappen ik ga nemen om het proces voor ouders te verbeteren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de nagekomen bekentenis van de PwC onderzoek dat ze bij de hoorzitting in de Tweede Kamer niet de waarheid verklaard hebben over het cruciale punt dat de centrale term in de me

MP Omtzigt asked whether PwC's report on the 'memo-Palmen' (the 2017 legal advice on the CAF-11 childcare allowance case) was accurate, given a later claim that the term 'laakbaar' was used in a June 2019 meeting, and sought clarification and further investigation. The State Secretary answered that PwC could not reconstruct with certainty that 'laakbaar' was used at the 4 June 2019 meeting, that the government will not break confidentiality promises to interviewees, and that no further investigation is needed.
The ministry does not have and does not receive copies of these statements.
Het ministerie heeft en krijgt hier geen afschrift van deze verklaringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de berichten ‘Hulp blijkt moeilijk’: Stad krijgt niet alle gegevens toeslagenslachtoffers’ en ‘Rechter deelt tik uit aan Belastingdienst’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Rotterdam lacks complete data on childcare-benefit scandal victims and that a court ruled against the Tax Authority over delayed advance payments. The State Secretary acknowledged occasional data gaps, defended the consent-based data-sharing procedure, and explained the Commission Actual Damage backlog, committing to report further in upcoming progress reports and a review.
In general terms I cannot discuss individual parents with your House.
In algemene zin kan ik niet met uw Kamer in gesprek over individuele ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Peters over het artikel 'Mogelijk honderden kinderen uit gezinnen die de dupe waren van toeslagenaffaire, zijn uit huis geplaatst'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Peters (CDA) asked whether children were taken from home as a result of wrongly imposed childcare-benefit repayments, and what the state is doing to reunite families. The government says it does not yet know how many families are affected, that financial problems alone are no legal ground for removal, and that it is working on a recovery programme and a route via municipalities.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had to deal with an out-of-home placement or reinstatement.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over onterechte brieven van het CAK aan gedupeerde ouders in het toeslagenschandaal

MP Alkaya asked whether parents affected by the childcare benefits scandal wrongly received CAK letters demanding premium payments, how many were affected, and how the error would be corrected. The State Secretary confirmed that four parents were wrongly sent letters, fourteen others were identified as victims, and the government will contact them and reverse any payments, while keeping the policy of resuming premium collection for parents not entitled to restoration.
Contact will be made with these parents and the erroneous action will be corrected.
Er zal contact opgenomen worden met deze ouders en de foutieve actie zal worden hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Simons over nieuwe problemen die dreigen te ontstaan omdat de Commissie Werkelijke Schade nog steeds onderbemenst is

MPs Van Raan and Simons asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade (CWS) is still understaffed, creating new emergencies such as forced evictions, and why capacity was not scaled up sooner. The State Secretary answered that the waiting list is undesirable but emergencies are addressed via the pause button, the Brede Hulp Team and priority treatment, that scale-up began in June 2021 with results lagging, and that capacity is expected to suffice within three to six months.
The CWS and UHT will handle her claim for actual damage with urgency.
De CWS en UHT zullen haar aanvraag voor werkelijke schade met spoed behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Afhandeling toeslagenaffaire loopt opnieuw vast, slachtoffers in geldnood'

An MP asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade backlog for victims of the childcare benefits affair, which leaves some parents in financial distress, is acceptable and how it will be resolved. The Secretary of State acknowledged the backlog and expects it to shorten, but denied urgent distress cases and said the agencies coordinate well.
The waiting list that has arisen at the CWS is obviously undesirable, but it does not create urgent distressing situations as described in the article.
De wachtlijst die is ontstaan bij de CWS is vanzelfsprekend onwenselijk, maar hierdoor ontstaan geen urgente schrijnende situaties zoals beschreven in het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar het verdwenen memo van de vaktechnisch coördinator uit 2017 (memo-Palmen)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about the progress of the inquiry into the vanished 2017 memo (memo-Palmen), including when the ministry learned of the messages, why they were shared only after media attention, and whether the memo was withheld from the parliamentary inquiry. The State Secretary answered that the PwC report shows no deliberate concealment, that the memo was not passed to the inquiry because it did not reach the required seniority level, and that the PwC report and related documents were sent to parliament together with the answers.
The memo was not provided to the POK earlier because it did not meet the criteria set for that purpose.
Het memo is niet eerder aan de POK verstrekt omdat het niet voldeed aan de daarvoor gestelde criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over mensen die vermorzeld worden door de Belastingdienst

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about people crushed by the Tax Authority, including harsh collection practices, stacked penalties, legislation-caused hardship, IND-related problems and access to legal aid. The State Secretary responds that the Stella team is reviewing 25 cases with 11 contacted so far, that improvements to collection strategy and legal protection are underway, and that individual tax matters cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Because of the fiscal confidentiality obligation, I cannot go into the personal situations of the people named in the article.
Antwoord 8 Ik kan omwille van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht 7 niet in gaan op de persoonlijke situaties van de mensen genoemd in het artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een lading onderschepte munitie op vliegveld Beek

MP Van Dijk asked the government about a shipment of 500,000 pistol cartridges intercepted at Maastricht Aachen Airport in January 2021 that lacked Dutch permits. The government answered the facts of the seizure and consent, but declined to say whether any criminal investigation exists, citing the Justice Minister's policy.
As you know, the Minister of Justice and Security makes no statements on whether criminal investigations (against certain persons) are ongoing.
Zoals u weet, doet de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken (tegen bepaalde personen) lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over falend schuldenbeleid van de Belastingdienst

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Administration offset benefit debts without applying the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) and how it will fix this and inform debtors. The State Secretary admits the practice was wrong, promises talks with the Ombudsman and LOSR, outlines plans to improve information and access to payment arrangements, and refers to an attached letter for details.
Given the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Protected Minimum Act, I now conclude together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over het bericht 'Duizenden euro’s schade bij gepensioneerden door nabetaling pensioen'

MP Den Haan asked whether pensioners harmed by lump-sum back-payments from ABP, and whether the Tax Authority should proactively inform them or find a generic solution. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that the matter is mainly the paying pension fund's responsibility, explained the tax treatment and averaging options, and said ABP offers compensation for residual harm.
I see no role for myself or the Tax Authority in the arrangements between ABP and pension recipients.
Voor een rol in de afspraken tussen ABP en de pensioengerechtigden zie ik geen plaats voor mijzelf of de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het onterecht terugvorderen van toeslagen van zelfstandigen

MP Snels asked about the wrongful clawback of allowances from self-employed people caused by the Bbz loan-to-gift rule, the delayed fix, and the limited 2014–2016 compensation scheme. The State Secretary replied that the problem stemmed from a legal interaction rather than administrative error, that the compensation scheme reached only 1,169 claimants, and that whether to extend compensation to pre-2014 cases is still under review, with promised letters on documents and advice.
Currently, following a question from MP Omtzigt, all written documents on the leenbijstand from 2006 onward are being reviewed.
Momenteel wordt, naar aanleiding van een vraag van het lid Omtzigt, gekeken naar alle schriftelijke documenten over de leenbijstand vanaf het jaar 2006.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het Meldpunt huurtoeslag van de Woonbond

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked about the Woonbond's housing benefit complaints line and the tax authority's handling of housing, care and child benefit cases, including wrongful intent/gross negligence labels. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, estimated about 500 affected citizens in comparable cases, and said a compensation scheme is being prepared, with acute cases able to apply for emergency support now.
These reports confirm the need for a restoration scheme.
Deze meldingen bevestigen de noodzaak van een herstelregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Hoe juist werken tot armoede leidt: ‘Het probleem is dat toeslagen, loon en uitkering niet op elkaar zijn afgestemd’'

D66 MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked about a newspaper report that mismatched payment cycles (four-weekly wages versus monthly benefits and allowances) cause hardship, asking how common this is, how payroll and benefit rules work, and whether uniform payment rules or holiday-pay changes would help. The minister answers that the problem is recognised, explains the rules and offsetting practices in detail, says data on liquidity problems are unavailable, and notes that the answers will feed into a follow-up study of the UWV report.
It is not known how many people experience liquidity problems in connection with receiving wages every four weeks.
Niet bekend is hoeveel personen in verband met de ontvangst van salaris per vier weken liquiditeitsproblemen ondervinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het onterecht aanmerken van mensen als fraudeur

MP Nijboer asks why about 60,000 people received letters after being registered in the Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV), on what grounds they were registered, and how unjust consequences will be investigated. The State Secretaries answer that FSV was used for varied purposes, that its origins are often not traceable, that people will receive letters explaining registration where possible, and that a PwC study of effects will be completed around September 2021.
To carry out this work well, it is important to be able to assess whether the return or application is in all likelihood correct and complete.
Om dit werk goed uit te kunnen voeren, is het belangrijk om te kunnen beoordelen of de aangifte of aanvraag naar alle waarschijnlijkheid juist en volledig is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de motie Alkaya, Kamerstuk 31066-827

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked how many dossiers and staff are involved in the pilots (Leeuwarden, Almere, Zaanstad) for handling childcare benefit reclamation cases in one day, given the minister's view that a nationwide rollout before September 2021 is unfeasible. The Staatssecretaris provided a table of pilot dossiers and staff numbers, stressing the pilots are small-scale and that rollout would require substantial logistical capacity.
Below you will find the requested information about the pilots.
Onderstaand treft u de gevraagde informatie over de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Omtzigt over het te veel uitkeren van kindgebonden budget aan arbeidsmigranten

Two CDA MPs asked why the Tax Administration pays the single-parent supplement of the child budget to migrant workers whose partners live abroad, and why the problem has persisted despite earlier warnings. The government acknowledges structural data gaps for non-resident partners, describes partial fixes and ongoing work, admits it cannot count affected migrant workers, and postpones the answers.
It is known that a total of about 5,000 single parents whose child does not live in the Netherlands were granted the child budget.
Wel is bekend dat in totaal aan circa 5.000 alleenstaande ouders waarvan het kind niet in Nederland woont kgb is toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst weer in de fout: veel te veel toeslag voor arbeidsmigranten’

Two VVD MPs asked why the Tax Administration keeps granting the child-related budget with the single-parent supplement to migrant workers whose foreign partners are not registered, despite known errors since 2015. The government admits the verification process is complex, lists partial fixes since 2015 and promises proposals this year, but gives no count of affected migrants and no firm date for a structural solution.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht van wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over nieuwe fouten met de uitkering van toeslagen

Snels (GroenLinks) asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about new errors in child-related allowance payments to migrant workers who are wrongly treated as single parents because their partner lives abroad, including delays, repayments and whether the Belastingdienst acts on evidence. The government acknowledged the structural difficulty in verifying foreign partner data, described the verwantschapsquery, the stopknop for refugees and new partner-submission forms, and said improvement proposals are expected this year, while declining to give figures on affected migrant workers.
It is not known how many migrant workers have reported that they wrongly received the single-parent supplement.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel arbeidsmigranten hebben aangeven dat zij onterecht een alo-kop hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Ceder over vastlopende hersteloperatie toeslagenschandaal

MPs Grinwis and Ceder asked whether the childcare benefit scandal restitution operation is stalling, why rejection letters after the light check lack a objection clause, whether the Catshuisregeling compromises care, and about moratorium, dossier access, and compensation capacity. The State Secretary answered that the operation is not stalling despite high workload, that the letter was amended to include an objection reference, and that all parents get an integral assessment with the moratorium and dossier processes described.
As a result, the letter was amended and the full legal remedies reference was included.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is de brief aangepast en is de volledige rechtsmiddelverwijzing wel opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het feit dat meerdere gedupeerde ouders een brief van Incassobureau GGN hebben ontvangen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why many affected parents received letters from debt collector GGN saying they were not victims, despite not yet having an integral assessment or compensation, and on what legal basis the Tax Authority shares victim status with collectors. The State Secretary apologises, explains that a faulty list of parents was shared with enforcement bodies under the statutory moratorium (art. 49i Awir), that the moratorium ends from 1 May for parents with no indication of entitlement, and that parents can verify their status via a code and register.
I therefore find it terrible that this incorrect list was shared and that these letters were subsequently sent out.
Ik vind het dan ook verschrikkelijk dat deze foute lijst gedeeld is en dat vervolgens deze brieven zijn uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het feit dat de Belastingdienst ervoor gezorgd heeft dat ouders onterecht weer zijn belaagd door deurwaarders

An MP asks the state secretary how the Tax Authority (Toeslagen) sent an incomplete list of harmed parents to bailiffs, causing renewed collection letters, and what remedies, accountability and prevention measures exist. The secretary admits the list was incomplete (about 6,000 parents missing), apologises, says no executions are being carried out, promises corrective data sharing, stricter checks, a working group and a review, and says the Tax Authority is liable for extra costs.
Unfortunately, this check was carried out on the basis of the specification for delivering parents paid under the Catshuis scheme.
Helaas is deze controle echter uitgevoerd op basis van de specificatie voor het opleveren van ouders uitbetaald als onderdeel van de Catshuisregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over onterecht verstuurde berekeningen Toeslagen

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked why the Tax Administration wrongly sent about 224 households demands to repay large childcare-benefit (toeslagen) amounts, including for 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed. The State Secretary apologised, explained the IND data processing error, said the Chamber was not proactively informed but will be in future, and described fixes plus a law change requiring a hearing before large repayment decisions from 2021.
However, I understand your need for information in order to properly carry out your supervisory task.
Ik heb echter begrip voor uw informatiebehoefte om uw controlerende taak goed uit te kunnen oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst opnieuw in de fout is gegaan met toeslagen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about erroneous Belastingdienst benefit recalculation letters sent to 224 recipients after faulty processing of IND residence-status data, covering the scale, amounts, fix, prevention, and financial impact. The State Secretary answers in detail, acknowledging a design error at Toeslagen, describing the correction, the 1,127 wrongful decisions worth about 2.4 million euro, measures such as a right to comment before large reclaims, and that all affected persons have been contacted.
This went badly wrong. I have already apologised to those affected.
Het is hier erg misgegaan. Ik heb de betrokkenen inmiddels hiervoor excuses gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the statutory debt moratorium for childcare benefit scandal victims, expiring on 1 May 2021, would expose affected parents to renewed collection and whether it should be extended urgently. The State Secretary answered that the moratorium is extended by one year for parents found eligible for at least 30,000 euro in compensation, while parents not found eligible lose it on 1 May, with a nazorgteam and possible specific solutions for those harmed later.
Once it is established that victims qualify for the Catshuis scheme and thus at least 30,000 euro, the moratorium (the pause button) will be extended by one year from the moment of payment.

Zodra bij gedupeerden is vastgesteld dat ze in aanmerking komen voor de Catshuisregeling en daarmee minimaal € 30.000, wordt het moratorium (de pauzeknop) vanaf het moment van uitbetaling met 1 jaar verlengd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht 'Vrees voor Chinese spionage via douanescanners in haven Rotterdam'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports of Chinese espionage risks from Nuctech X-ray scanners used by Dutch customs at Rotterdam port, airports and distribution centres. The government confirmed the deployment, said risk assessments are case-by-case with an external security audit underway, and stated it would consider proportionate measures without committing to halting use of the scanners.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the Intelligence and Security Services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over spionage in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that Chinese-owned Nuctech customs scanners at Rotterdam port could be used for espionage, and what security assessment was made at purchase. The government answered that risks exist, customs has commissioned an external audit of the scanner systems, and it gives no operational detail on intelligence service knowledge.
Customs is having an external audit carried out on the scanning and detection systems and related IT setup, to ensure the scanning and detection processes are arranged as securely as possible.
De Douane laat een externe audit uitvoeren op de scan- en detectiesystemen en daaraan gerelateerde IT-inrichting, om te verzekeren dat de scan- en detectieprocessen zo veilig mogelijk zijn ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Deurwaarders even niet langs bij gedupeerden toeslagen’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that bailiffs continue to pursue debts against childcare-benefit scandal victims despite the moratorium, and whether information sharing with the bailiffs' network works. The State Secretary answers that the moratorium only blocks forced execution, that preparatory steps may continue, that victims will receive codes to show creditors, and that a total solution will be reported in the next progress report.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de vele openstaande vragen die er zijn over de compensatie van gedupeerden in de toeslagenaffaire

MP Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the tax authority's denials about pre-CAF unlawful practices, the Catshuis compensation scheme, the lifting of the debt moratorium, delays and advocate fees in the childcare benefits scandal remain unresolved. The State Secretary answered that pre-CAF harm is being redressed, the Catshuis scheme is a deliberate fast-payment route with individual assessment still available, the moratorium lapses only for applicants without indications for the 30,000 euro payment, and that figures on other benefit groups are provided.
This is to prevent the private debts of these parents from increasing, while UHT has not yet been able to establish that they qualify for the Catshuis scheme.
Dit is om te voorkomen dat de private schulden van deze ouders oplopen, terwijl UHT nog niet heeft kunnen vaststellen dat zij in aanmerking komen voor de Catshuisregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland inzake de e-screener

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Finance ministers about a court ruling on the e-screener and how many firearms have been deactivated in the Netherlands and exported abroad for deactivation. The Minister of Justice answered that 182 firearms were submitted to police since around September 2019 through 1 February 2021, 107 of which were checked and certified, and that export figures cannot be made transparent because customs loses sight of firearms once they leave the country.
Customs only grants export licences covering the movement of firearms across the border out of the Netherlands.
De douane verleent alleen exportvergunningen die zien op de beweging van vuurwapens naar buiten Nederland (de grensoverschrijding).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over het stopzetten van huurtoeslag wegens geboorte kind

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked the ministers why a Belastingdienst benefit (huurtoeslag) was stopped because a newborn lacked legal residence status, and sought details on frequency, legal basis, and planned changes. The government answered that a birth alone is not grounds to stop the allowance, that stoppage occurs only after four months without a residence application, that the case was resolved, and that it is exploring rule changes such as raising the age threshold to 18.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een overzicht van alle wetten waar de Belastingdienst zich de afgelopen zeven jaar niet aan gehouden heeft

Omtzigt asked the government to provide, as required by a unanimously adopted motion, an overview of all laws the Tax Administration has not complied with over the past seven years, and questioned the government's compensation and resignation. The government answered that a single unambiguous overview is not possible, referred to examples in an accompanying letter, and said compensation in the childcare benefits case is not solely linked to breaking laws.
As set out in the accompanying letter, it is not possible to make an unambiguous overview.
Zoals volgt uit de begeleidende brief is het maken van een eenduidig overzicht niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het herleven van een studieschuld na afronding van een WSNP

SP MPs asked why people who exited a debt-restructuring (WSNP) procedure received letters demanding resumption of student loan repayments at amounts unaffordable on a modest income, and whether DUO would soften this. The minister explained repayment is frozen during the procedure, admitted the letters can be unexpected and too high before income-based assessment, and said DUO will now phone debtors first where income is unknown and clarify the letters.
After consultation with DUO, it has therefore been decided no longer to announce the resumption of collection solely by letter.
Na overleg met DUO is dan ook besloten om niet langer uitsluitend per brief aan te kondigen dat de inning wordt herstart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het in één keer ontvangen van 54 aanmaningen van het CJIB

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why a childcare-benefit affair victim received 54 reminder letters from the CJIB at once, and what the government will do to prevent this and stop collection of debts owed by victims. The State Secretary explains the letters were automatically generated per open case, the CJIB has taken measures to prevent bulk dispatch, and public creditors are being asked to pause collection of debts of victims while stating that fines from criminal convictions are excluded.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Geef slachtoffers toeslagenaffaire een nieuw en schoon BSN»

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance, following a news report, whether victims of the childcare benefits scandal should receive a new citizen service number (BSN) to start afresh, and whether this would fix data-sharing problems with other agencies. The State Secretary answered that a new BSN would not clear the administrative past or solve the problems, but agreed to investigate the consequences jointly with the State Secretary of Interior, with the priority being to find and remove incorrect data first.
However, I am willing, together with the State Secretary of Interior and Kingdom Relations, to investigate the consequences of changing a BSN.
Ik ben echter bereid, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, te onderzoeken wat de consequenties van het wijzigen van een BSN zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over beslaglegging op compensatie door de Belastingdienst

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether debt-relief trustees can seize compensation paid to childcare-benefit scandal victims after a WSNP debt-rescheduling period ends, and whether a seizure ban will be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the undesirable effect, said talks with public and private creditors are ongoing, committed to public creditors waiving claims, and promised certificates clearing victims of past fraud or intent labels.
That is why I am in talks with creditors and other parties to reach a solution that does justice to the various interests.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met schuldeisers en betrokken partijen om te komen tot een oplossing die recht doet aan de verschillende belangen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat een gedupeerde moeder niet uit de schuldsanering mag door de aankondiging van 30.000 euro en dat de overheid zich terugtrekt als schuldeiser

Leijten (SP) asked why a rechter-commissaris did not end a debt-restructuring (WSNP) process for a mother who was to receive a 30,000 euro compensation payment, and why there is no clean-slate plan despite payments to about 500 parents. The Secretary of State says the government has cancelled public debts of affected parents, is working on a clean-slate plan with creditors and other ministries, and that the matter of specific cases lies with the trustee and the judge, without firm timelines.
Assessing specific practical situations is reserved for the trustee and the judge.
Het beoordelen van specifieke praktijksituaties is voorbehouden aan de bewindvoerder en aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een overzicht van delen van wetten die wel door het parlement zijn aangenomen maar nooit in de werking zijn getreden

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked why many tax and benefit provisions adopted by parliament never entered into force, and requested a full overview with reasons and information given to the Chamber. The State Secretary provided an annex listing unimplemented tax and benefit provisions over ten years, with stated reasons for delay, and acknowledged the ministry kept no central overview, promising to include the topic in annual reports.
The Ministry of Finance does not keep a central overview of whether tax or benefit legislation has entered into force; of course this is known within the responsible departments.
Het Ministerie van Financiën houdt niet centraal een overzicht bij of fiscale of toeslagen wet- en regelgeving in werking is getreden; uiteraard is dat wel bij de behandelende afdelingen bekend.

Resterende antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de cruciale memo-Palmen - het officiële juridische advies over de CAF 11-zaak aan het managementteam van de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, die 2,5 jaar voor bijna iede

Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the AUT (Donner committee) received key documents on the CAF11 case, including factsheets and the 2017 Palmen memo, and why the memo was not provided. The government answers that a keyword search yielded over 2000 pages sent to the AUT, that only the first two pages of two notes were delivered without the referenced factsheets, and that the Palmen memo was not sent because the contact official only learned of it in March 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de betrokkenheid van de minister-president bij de compensatieregeling voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asks the government about the Prime Minister's involvement in designing the compensation scheme for childcare benefit victims, including the crisis structure, the Bewindsliedenoverleg meetings, withheld Wob documents, precedent concerns, and the scope of the advisory committee. The Secretary of State answers that the Prime Minister attended three ministerial preparation meetings in February and March 2020, releases several previously withheld documents, but refuses some details and says the questions could not be answered by the deadline.
This ministerial consultation on possible compensation scenarios convened three times.
Dit BWO met als onderwerp «mogelijke scenario’s compensatieregeling» is driemaal bijeengekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de cruciale memo-Palmen – het officiële juridische advies over de CAF 11-zaak aan het managementteam van de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, die 2,5 jaar voor bijna iedereen is achte

MP Omtzigt asks the State Secretary of Finance why the 2017 legal memo on the CAF 11 case (memo-Palmen) was absent from the timeline sent to Parliament, who received and discussed it, and what happened in June 2019. The State Secretary acknowledges the timeline omission and that acting on the memo could have spared harm, but declines detailed reconstruction of internal meetings, pointing to the parliamentary inquiry, and says answers could not be given by 7 January 2021.
In questions 8 through 25 you ask me to go into great detail about internal meetings, the conduct and statements of employees, and specific civil servants.
In de vragen 8 tot en met 25 vraagt u mij zeer gedetailleerd in te gaan op interne overleggen, op gedragingen en uitspraken van medewerkers en op specifieke ambtelijke functionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over documenten in het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asks the State Secretary about a Landsadvocaat advice on document disclosure in childcare-benefit appeal cases, who received it, the 2018 CAF-11 directive, and related documents; the government confirms the advice exists, provides several documents, and states it could not answer all questions by the requested deadline. Most questions are answered with documents, though some items (full case files, names) are withheld.
This concerns the memo Assignment Strengthening quality assurance at the Tax Administration/Benefits, from the FJZ and UHB directorates to the Director-General of the Tax Administration.
Het betreft hier het memo Opdracht Versterking kwaliteitsborging bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen van de directie FJZ en UHB aan de directeur-generaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Adviescommissie-Donner conclusies trok die in strijd waren met het eigen onderzoek

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Adviescommissie Uitvoering Toeslagen (AUT, Donner committee) drew conclusions at odds with its own research, including the concealment of documents in appeal cases and the use of an internal work plan. The State Secretary answers that the AUT set its own method, acknowledges that withholding relevant documents from courts is unacceptable and regrets past practice, outlines remedial measures and compensation rules, and largely declines to explain the timing and handling of Wob requests and press contacts beyond general procedure.
The Ministry of Finance does not provide documents to the media, insofar as these documents are not already public or will not be made public immediately.
Het Ministerie van Financiën verstrekt geen stukken aan media, voor zover deze stukken niet reeds openbaar zijn of terstond openbaar zullen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about delayed Wob freedom-of-information requests, the government's answers on the childcare benefit scandal, and the adequacy of earlier answers to parliament. The government denies deliberate delay for political reasons, says it knows of no such cases, admits some earlier answers were incomplete and promises to keep providing relevant information.
I will ask my colleagues to be more transparent going forward about the handling of a Wob request when handling it has taken a long time.
Ik zal mijn collega’s verzoeken in het vervolg transparanter te zijn over de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek wanneer met de afhandeling van een Wob-verzoek veel tijd gemoeid is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de verkoop van illegaal geïmporteerd bushmeat

An SP MP asked the ministers about illegal bushmeat imports and sales in the Netherlands, customs and NVWA enforcement, sanctions, zoonotic risks and CBD voluntary guidance. The minister answered that customs and NVWA check risk-based, that bushmeat is not registered separately, that sanctions apply under food-safety and nature law, and that there is no insight into transit via Belgium.
This is not known. Veterinary legislation sets requirements for meat imports but does not distinguish so-called bushmeat from other meat.
Dit is niet bekend. De veterinaire wetgeving kent verplichtingen voor de invoer van vlees, maar maakt daarbij geen onderscheid tussen zogenaamd «bushmeat» en ander vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het handhaven van het EU-verdedigingsbeginsel door de Douane

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about businesses' options when contesting customs duties, the number of objections and their outcomes, the EU defence principle, pending court cases, limitation periods, and handling times for objections, and whether customs can levy duties twice on the same goods. The State Secretary answered that businesses can object and appeal to the court, provided objection and outcome statistics, explained the codified right to be heard, stated that duties are levied only once and that time limits are set by EU law and the General Administrative Law Act, and said customs aims to decide objections promptly without being able to influence appeal timing.
Customs and the affected party have no influence over the timing of the appeal phase.
Op het tijdsverloop in de beroepsfase hebben de Douane en belanghebbende geen invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de hersteloperatie

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the childcare benefit recovery operation: whether parents can access their full files before being offered a settlement, the timing of payments, compliance with procedural principles, FSV blacklist effects, and archiving. The State Secretary answers that parents can access files at various stages on request, that no separate guidance exists on access sequencing, that procedural principles are considered respected, and that a memo and further documents are provided or explained.
The parent then receives the case-related documents compiled at that moment and the summary included in the form.
De ouder krijgt dan de op dat moment samengestelde op de zaak betrekking hebbende stukken en de samenvatting die in het formulier is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de huurtoeslag en de uitwerking van het Sociaal Huurakkoord

An MP asked about implementing the Social Rental Agreement (Sociaal Huurakkoord), commercial landlords' obligations, and the reinstatement of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) for a case where the rent exceeded the threshold. The minister answered that the measures are being legislated or are in progress, outlined the rules on reinstated entitlement and a new hardship clause, and declined to take a position requiring commercial landlords to cut rents.
Expected later this year to inform the House of Representatives about possible adjustments to rental policy and regulations.
Naar verwachting later dit jaar informatie aan de Tweede Kamer over eventuele aanpassingen in huurbeleid- en regelgeving
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de CAF 11-zaak

Omtzigt (CDA) asks the State Secretary of Finance who commissioned and received the March 2017 technical memo on the CAF 11 case, why it was omitted from earlier answers on compensation, and whether other memos and withheld WOB documents exist. The State Secretary answers that the memo was written by the technical coordinator at MT request, that it was discussed in the MT in March 2017 but not passed up to the Director-General or State Secretary, that the WOB omission was an error being corrected, and that further internal investigations are underway with a plan to be shared.
Unfortunately this memo was not taken into consideration in that context.
Helaas is daarbij dit memo niet in ogenschouw genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geringe straf op het mogelijk maken van belastingontduiking

MP Leijten asked why accounting firm Baker Tilly Berk was fined only EUR 20,000 for enabling tax evasion via a Cyprus route, and why the fine seems small relative to fees, while victims of the childcare benefits scandal were punished harder. The State Secretary answered that the transaction matched the amount the prosecutor would demand, that the firm self-reported, and that the cases differ between tax evasion and avoidance; he also said he would examine whether administrative fine tools are adequate and promised a Tax Governance Code initiative.
I am not aware of the rates Baker Tilly Berk charges.
Ik ben niet bekend met de tarieven die Baker Tilly Berk hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een aantal specifieke documenten inzake de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about article 68 of the Constitution, a February 2020 motion on individual MPs receiving specific documents, and the refusal of certain documents in the childcare benefits affair, including unredacted WOB documents and a June 2019 briefing note, and asked for their delivery by a deadline. The government answered that it will honour targeted requests for specific documents from individual MPs, but did not directly address the refused documents and only referred to a separate letter for the rest.
Against that background, the cabinet wants to honour targeted requests for specific documents from an MP.
Tegen die achtergrond wil het kabinet gerichte verzoeken om specifieke documenten van een Kamerlid honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de verplichte dataverstrekking van kinderopvangorganisaties aan de Belastingdienst

MPs Kwint and Leijten (SP) asked why monthly personal data sharing by childcare organisations with the Tax Administration was set by ministerial regulation rather than law, whether privacy impact assessments and consent/opt-out were provided, and whether the practice conflicts with privacy rights. The state secretaries answered that monthly data delivery aims to prevent high childcare benefit recoveries, that a statutory basis exists and is being strengthened via the Awir amendment, and that parents cannot opt out, while several answers (e.g. on the AP advice and PIA) were given but the timing deadline was missed.
From 2021 the monthly delivery of this data will be mandatory.
Vanaf 2021 is het maandelijks leveren van deze gegevens verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over de vernietigde dossiers

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about the destruction of roughly 9,000 Toeslagen appeal files, including whether the destruction violated retention rules, whether Wob requests were answered incompletely, and whether all related correspondence could be shared. The State Secretary confirmed about 7,087 files were destroyed in 2020, stated that the 2014 destruction did not meet the seven-year retention period, said an independent inspectorate is investigating, and declined to release the individual case files while promising to attempt reconstruction and to share the internal notes on the destruction.
The relevant appeal files contain information about individual procedures of benefit recipients, and moreover these files contain private information about citizens.
De betreffende beroepsdossiers bevatten informatie over individuele procedures van toeslaggerechtigden, bovendien bevatten deze dossiers privéinformatie van burgers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de illegale vernietiging van archieven bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen, mogelijke strafbaarheid daarvan en een stop op elke vernietiging van archieven van de Belastingdienst/T

An MP asked whether the destruction of around 9,000 Toeslagen appeal files under a Belastingdienst selection list was unlawful, whether it could amount to a criminal offence, and whether all destruction of Toeslagen archives should be halted. The State Secretary regretted the destruction, admitted the wrong selection list was applied due to mixing of files, stopped further destruction of Toeslagen files and management records, and declined to qualify the conduct as an intentional criminal offence while providing destruction declarations and promising to consult parliament before lifting the moratorium.
As long as it is not known whether the process has been fully completed or the allowance has ended, under the 2015 Toeslagen selection list destruction may not proceed.
Zolang niet bekend is of het proces volledig is afgehandeld, dan wel de toeslag is beëindigd mag conform de selectielijst Toeslagen van 2015 niet tot vernietiging worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het incomplete AVG-verwerkingsregister en over onbeantwoorde belangrijke vragen over de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Tax Authority knew of other blacklists beyond FSV, why KPMG's June 2020 draft findings were not reported to parliament, what project 1043 is, and when the Tax Authority will have a complete, up-to-date processing register under the GDPR. The state secretaries answered that KPMG's drafts only pointed to possibly comparable systems, that project 1043 is a risk-detection project code, that a complete register is at least three years away, and that questions on the childcare benefit scandal would be answered later.
On 10 July the final report was adopted and sent to your House that same day.
Op 10 juli jl. is het definitieve rapport vastgesteld en dat is die dag nog aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nederland internationaal onder vuur om drugshandel per post’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about reports that Dutch dealers send about 9,000 drug parcels a month abroad, and about the scale, destinations and controls on outbound postal drug shipments. The Minister answered with seizure figures from 2017 to 2020, stated the 9,000 figure was an extrapolation from a pilot that warrants caution, noted no national statistics on drug parcels intercepted abroad, and said that customs can open parcels without a rechter-commissaris but that reform of the Strafvordering will simplify this and that the government is engaging in international efforts.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be empowered to seize postal parcels independently and then open the parcel and inspect its contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het project 26Lemont, Encrochat en de douane

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how far official corruption within Customs has been found in the Encrochat police investigation, and asked for a reply before the Customs committee debate. The State Secretary replied that Customs does not investigate corruption signals itself, that such signals are handled by the Rijksrecherche and FIOD under the Public Prosecution Service (Justice ministry), and that the government does not comment on ongoing investigations, while promising to keep reviewing integrity risks with the police and FIOD.
In general, the Cabinet makes no statements about ongoing investigations.
In zijn algemeenheid doet het Kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
