Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over vele ouders die in deze zomervakantie een brief kregen om binnen de veel te korte termijn van twee weken bewijsstukken over de kinderopvangtoeslag 2019 op te sturen

An MP asked why tens of thousands of parents received requests in the summer holiday to submit childcare allowance evidence within two weeks, and whether this was a repeat of earlier unlawful stop-and-reminder practices. The State Secretary answered that about 126,000 letters were sent, that the reminder term was extended to three weeks, that the earlier unlawful practice is acknowledged, and that a proposal on reaction and reminder deadlines will follow.
Given the unfortunate summer dispatch, a reminder period of three weeks will be applied in the situation.
Vanwege de ongelukkige verzending in de zomer zal gezien de situatie een rappeltermijn van drie weken worden gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de tweewekentermijn die gehanteerd wordt bij informatieverzoeken

MP Leijten (SP) asked why the Tax Authority responded to media rather than Parliament, why parents received short two-week deadlines for information requests on childcare allowance, and whether short deadlines apply elsewhere, including for codes linked to suspected system fraud. The State Secretary said reminder letters now give three weeks, the timing reflected COVID-era considerations, short deadlines are longstanding practice, and a proposal on response periods will follow; the answer to the BSN-code question was not provided in the text.

I promised your House during the General Consultation on the restart of the childcare allowance recovery operation of 20 August 2020, to the member Lodders, that I would soon come with a proposal for setting response and reminder periods.

Ik heb uw Kamer tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Start hersteloperatie kinderopvangtoeslag van 20 augustus 2020 aan het lid Lodders toegezegd binnenkort te komen met een voorstel voor een invulling van reactie- en rappeltermijnen.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het kwijtraken van toeslagen door transitievergoedingen

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether transitievergoedingen (transition payments on dismissal) can push low-income people over the income thresholds and cause toeslagen (benefit supplements) to be reclaimed, and whether these payments could be excluded from the income test or averaged more easily. The state secretary acknowledged the payments can raise the income test and lead to reclaims, but rejected exempting them, said the Belastingdienst cannot count how often this happens, and said the averaging threshold will stay.
The benefit supplement system serves a different purpose. It provides targeted income support to guarantee financial access to care, childcare and a rental home.
Het toeslagenstelsel dient een ander doel. Het biedt gerichte inkomensondersteuning om de financiële toegankelijkheid van zorg, kinderopvang en een huurwoning te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris van Financiën (de heer Snel) de ouders in juni 2019 al wilde compenseren

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked why a 2019 timeline sent to the ADR and parliament omitted former state secretary Snel's June 2019 attempt to offer compensation to childcare-benefit victims, and about the handling of the Donner advisory commission and the cabinet. The state secretary answered that the timeline served a narrow ADR research question, declined to discuss individual officials' views or internal legal advice citing intra-cabinet deliberation, confirmed contact with the commission (100+ emails, meetings), and disputed that parliament was being deliberately kept uninformed.
However, it is standing cabinet-wide policy not to make personal policy views contained in (legal) documents prepared for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is echter staand kabinetsbreed beleid om persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen opgenomen in (juridische) documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad geen onderwerp te maken van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over de Voortgangsrapportage kinderopvangtoeslag en de verdwenen dossiers

MPs Alkaya and Leijten (SP) asked the State Secretary for Finance (Toeslagen en Douane) about the childcare benefits scandal: who sits on the Strategic Crisis Team, whether its minutes can be shared, how the UHT handles parents' cases, the O/GS compensation, the CAF-11 group, the destroyed case files and the queries that included nationality. The State Secretary answered that the crisis team keeps only action and decision lists, that case handling and compensation are being rolled out with safeguards, that an external review of UHT is under way, and that the selection-list and nationality-query matters were disclosed or stopped after discovery.
Of these meetings, currently two per week, action and decision lists are recorded, not minutes.
Van deze bijeenkomsten, momenteel twee per week, worden actie- en besluitenlijsten vastgelegd, geen verslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over 9000 dossiers die onterecht vernietigd zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about roughly 9,000 childcare-allowance appeal files that were destroyed early, and about withdrawn appeals suggesting the tax authority may have reversed decisions before hearings to avoid adverse case law. The State Secretary answered that the authority reviews cases before hearings to grant rights quickly, that about 7,087 files were destroyed in 2020 and others earlier, and that the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage will examine the early destruction.

The Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage has meanwhile indicated that it will include the premature destruction of files in its investigation into information and archive management at the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances.

De Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed heeft inmiddels laten weten dat ze de vroegtijdige vernietiging van dossiers in haar onderzoek naar het informatie- en archiefbeheer bij Belastingdienst/Toeslagen zal meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het keihard liegen door de Belastingdienst/toeslagen

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary whether the Belastingdienst knowingly misled the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, withheld documents from parents and courts, and what sanctions apply to lying to the tax authority. The State Secretary acknowledged the 2017 information to the AP was incorrect and regrettable but found no concrete evidence of intent, described remedial steps such as more generous document disclosure and apologies, and gave a partial answer on sanctions.
From the above it appears that in 2017 there was indeed an incorrect presentation of facts, but it cannot be concluded that this happened knowingly and deliberately.
Uit het vorenstaande komt naar voren dat in 2017 weliswaar sprake was van een onjuiste voorstelling van zaken, maar dat niet valt te concluderen dat dit willens en wetens gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV)

MP Leijten asked the State Secretaries of Finance about the Fraude Signalering Voorziening (FSV), a Tax Authority fraud-signal database, including its legal basis, data retention, deletion, sharing with other agencies and privacy assessment. The government answered that FSV was taken offline, that a deletion action removed 143,574 records with a backup preserved, that the privacy impact assessment was deficient, and that FSV will not be reused.
In the meantime it has been decided not to use FSV any more and to redesign the processes for processing signals and the associated support.
Ondertussen is besloten om FSV niet meer te gaan gebruiken en de processen voor het verwerken van signalen en de bijbehorende ondersteuning opnieuw te ontwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de «Fraude Signalering Voorziening» (FSV) en de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the Tax Authority's Fraud Signalling Facility (FSV) and its data protection impact assessment related to GDPR duties to consult the data protection officer and the Dutch DPA. The answers explain the timeline, that FSV was switched off after a critical assessment, that the DPA was informed on 2 March 2020 and is investigating, and commit to further information, redesign of processes and a letter on the matter.
The Tax Authority informed the Dutch DPA on 2 March 2020 about FSV because an application was in use for which the mitigating measures were insufficiently implemented.
De Belastingdienst heeft op 2 maart 2020 de AP geïnformeerd over FSV omdat er een applicatie in gebruik was waarbij de mitigerende maatregelen onvoldoende geïmplementeerd waren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de wijze waarop de Commissie van wijzen geoordeeld heeft dat bepaalde CAF-zaken wel vergelijkbaar zijn met CAF-11, waardoor de hele groep ouders in principe in aanmerking komt

MP Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about how the Commission of Wise Persons judged which childcare benefit (CAF) cases were comparable to CAF-11, and why the Commission lacked full document access, among 21 questions. The State Secretary admitted that some information given to the Commission was incorrect, promised re-assessment of eight cases and a review of procedures, but declined to answer several questions in full and pointed to a separate letter.
To correct the errors, the eight previously rejected CAF cases will be reassessed and I am taking the following measures.
Om de fouten te herstellen, zullen de eerder afgewezen acht CAF-zaken herbeoordeeld worden en tref ik daarbij de volgende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het recht op toeslagen in combinatie met wezenpensioen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why a foster parent lost retroactive rent allowance because a foster child's orphan's pension was counted as income, and asks about the length of response times and Tax Authority service. The State Secretary declines to discuss the individual case but explains that a special-income exemption exists and that the objection deadline for requesting it was extended to five years, while promising an external review of service delivery.
Although I cannot go into individual cases, in general a income exemption applies to living-at-home (foster) children up to age 23.
Hoewel ik niet op individuele casussen kan ingaan, geldt in zijn algemeen voor thuiswonende (pleeg)kinderen tot 23 jaar een inkomensvrijstelling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over overwerk in relatie tot toeslagen

Two SP MPs asked whether the government will protect care and other essential workers from losing childcare, rent and healthcare allowances because of overtime during the coronavirus crisis, and whether it will give certainty about having to repay allowances. The government answered that it cannot identify overtime effects on household income, that allowances must follow actual income, and that it will focus on communication and individual arrangements rather than a special scheme, apologising for the delay.

The cabinet will now primarily focus on communication to point citizens to the importance of reporting expected changes in household income for 2020 to the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances as soon as possible.

Het kabinet zal nu primair inzetten op communicatie om burgers te wijzen op het belang om verwachte wijzigingen in het huishoudinkomen van 2020 zo snel mogelijk door te geven aan de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voorgenomen uitstel van nieuwe btw-regels voor e-commerce van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU proposal to postpone new VAT e-commerce rules, which would delay VAT on low-value parcels from outside the EU, and whether Nederland would contest this and restore the level playing field. The government confirmed the postponement, said Nederland is not ready for 1 January 2021 and benefits from delay, and gave no concrete commitment to change the EU timetable.
For these reasons, the Netherlands benefits from the proposed postponement.
Nederland is dan ook om die redenen gebaat bij het voorgestelde uitstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de onafhankelijke organen betrokken bij uitvoering ‘Herstel Toeslagen’

The SP MP Leijten asks why four advisory and review commissions for the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation were formally established by decree while the parents' panel was not, and questions the panel's selection, meeting location, secretariat and influence. The State Secretary defends the informal set-up as allowing a low-threshold, flexible parents' panel, states that its advice is weighed heavily by the crisis team, and answers the factual questions about selection and location.
The parents' panel and the participating parents have a full and independent role in advising.
Het ouderpanel en de deelnemende ouders hebben een volwaardige en eigenstandige rol in de advisering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over inzage in de dossiers door de ouders die getroffen zijn door de kinderopvangtoeslagaffaire (en daar al negen maanden op wachten terwijl de wettelijke deadline toch echt een of

Omtzigt asks why the tax authority has not issued decisions within the three-month GDPR deadline on parents' requests for their childcare-benefit files, whether it will notify them so they can claim penalty payments, and when all files will be delivered. The state secretary argues full-file requests are not GDPR access requests, so no statutory deadline applies, says 620 of 661 requests remain pending, and gives no firm date for delivery or for payment arrangements for those with fraud-type findings.
Parents who requested personal data, whether or not invoking Article 15 GDPR, must receive it with a decision from the Tax Authority within three months.
Ouders die, al dan niet met een beroep op artikel 15 van de AVG, persoonsgegevens hebben opgevraagd, moeten dit met een besluit van de Belastingdienst binnen drie maanden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen dat logistieke bedrijven wegtrekken uit Nederlandse (zee en lucht) havens vanwege de afhandeling van goederen door de douane

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about signals that logistics firms are leaving Dutch sea and air ports because of customs handling, and about differences in customs controls and scanning between ports. The State Secretary answered at length on customs tasks, risk-based national controls applied uniformly across ports, EU rules, enforcement statistics, helpline performance and e-commerce controls, while acknowledging perceived level-playing-field problems.
Customs enforces in all sea and air ports under a single national risk management model.
De Douane handhaaft in alle (zee- en lucht)havens namelijk volgens één landelijke risicobeheersingsmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Omtzigt over het verstrekken van volledige dossiers aan gedupeerde ouders in de toeslagenaffaire

MPs Leijten and Omtzigt asked why the Tax Administration postponed sending full case files to affected childcare-benefit parents and how they can obtain their files and the grounds for decisions. The State Secretary answered that file compilation is very labour-intensive, that staff will call parents to establish their actual information needs, that no formal decisions were issued because the file requests fall outside Article 15 GDPR, and that a date for sending files will be communicated next month.
I will inform your House about this next month.
Hierover informeer ik uw kamer volgende maand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van den Berg over importheffingen en btw op mondkapjes en andere persoonlijke beschermingsmaterialen, die gebruikt worden in de strijd tegen het coronavirus

MPs Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked the State Secretaries of Finance about import duties and VAT on face masks and protective equipment during the coronavirus crisis, including whether healthcare institutions could be exempted and whether VAT could be lowered and competition rules clarified. The government answered that exemptions are available via EU rules and a Customs permit procedure, that the Netherlands applied for and obtained EU authorisation, that VAT on consumer masks was cut to 0% from 25 May 2020, and that the ACM provides guidance on cooperative purchasing.
The cabinet has decided to temporarily reduce the VAT on domestic sales of face masks to 0%.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om tijdelijk de btw op de binnenlandse verkoop van mondkapjes te verlagen naar 0%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het feit dat de (maximale) huurtoeslag daalt wanneer een alleenstaande een kind krijgt

The MP asks whether the maximum housing allowance (huurtoeslag) for single parents is lower than for single persons without children, whether this is desirable, and what options exist to reduce the difference. The minister confirms the difference (about EUR 47 per month at minimum income and rent at the threshold), explains it reflects the 1997 rationale for singles, points to the single-parent supplement in the child-related budget as compensation, and says a harmonisation option was studied in the IBO and that the IBO part 2 was sent to parliament.
It is correct that there is a difference in the maximum possible housing allowance for single persons and for multi-person households, which also include single-parent families.
Het klopt dat er een verschil is in de maximaal mogelijke huurtoeslag voor alleenstaanden en voor meerpersoonshuishoudens, waar ook eenoudergezinnen onder vallen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een uitspraak van de Raad van State waardoor waarschijnlijk miljoenen beschikkingen van de belastingdienst/toeslagen over terugvordering of herzieningen van voorschotten op toe

MP Omtzigt asked whether a Council of State ruling showed that millions of Tax Administration/Toeslagen decisions on childcare and other benefit advances, including reductions and reclaims, were not legally in force because they were sent only electronically, and what the consequences were. The State Secretary acknowledged the ruling, admitted about 20 million revised advance decisions since 2015 were sent only digitally, and announced a regulatory amendment from 1 July 2020 to continue the practice, with a limited group of objectors given a path to contest.
Due to the Council of State ruling, part of the first step has proven not legally valid.
Door de uitspraak van de Raad van State is een deel van de eerste stap niet rechtsgeldig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de toeslagenaffaire met ouders die onder beschermingsbewind staan

MPs asked how the childcare benefits affair is handled for affected parents under protective administration, whether the administrator can be replaced as representative, and what recourse exists if parents feel poorly represented. The State Secretary answered that administrators act for parents on equal terms, that the court sets the scope of administration and can appoint another administrator, and that complaints go to the court or the administrator's sector body, with no role for Toeslagen.
The district court can then assess whether the scope of the administration should be adjusted so that someone else can act on behalf of the parents in the settlement.
De kantonrechter kan dan beoordelen of de reikwijdte van het bewind moet worden aangepast, zodat iemand anders bij de afwikkeling namens de ouders kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over morele corruptie bij de Belastingdienst door het stellen van een minimumbedrag voor het terugvorderen van toeslagen

The SP MP Leijten asked whether the Tax Authority applied minimum recovery amounts for childcare and other benefit (toeslag) fraud enforcement that had to be met regardless of cost, and what consequences this had for objections and appeals. The State Secretary answers that a budgeted fraud-yield target of 25-33 million per year existed from 2014, that monitoring of the yield stopped in 2019, that the target was not a management KPI, and that backlogs in objections and appeals arose from capacity shortages and have been addressed.
The budget amount thereby became a binding target for the yield of enforcement, and I find that undesirable.
Het begrotingsbedrag werd daarmee taakstellend voor de opbrengst van de uitvoering en dat vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Schaf de zorgtoeslag af, zonder inkomenseffecten’

D66 MPs asked the government about a proposal to abolish the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and lower the nominal premium, covering income effects, costs, state-aid risk and premium competition. The minister answered at length, noting that roughly 3 million households would lose out without compensation, that the proposal is unclear on compensation and feasibility for the tax authority, and that a lower premium would require EU state-aid notification, while promising alternatives will be explored in the response to the IBO-toeslagen.
Regarding cost-awareness and the level of the nominal premium, two aspects play a role.
Met betrekking tot kostenbewustzijn en de hoogte van de nominale premie spelen twee aspecten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Geen gehoor bij Belastingtelefoon’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone line is unreachable, including waiting times, call-handling figures, the reasons for rising waits, alternative contact channels and planned improvements. The government answered with figures showing about one in twenty callers could not be connected in 2019, explained capacity and staff turnover as causes, and outlined planned measures such as callback options and an external review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afwikkeling van de CAF-11 gedupeerden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the settlement of compensation for CAF-11 parents wrongly cut off from childcare allowance, including how many have claimed extra compensation, how the independent expert commission operates, and why a CAF list was withheld under Wob requests. The government answered that 77 parents had submitted documents for extra compensation, that the commission's advice was followed, that the promised February 2020 settlement would slip, and that the list was not yet in existence when earlier Wob requests were filed.
This commitment will not be met. I aim for swift completion but also want to take into account the final advice of the Advisory Committee on Benefits Implementation and the ADR report.
Deze toezegging wordt niet gehaald. Ik streef naar spoedige afronding maar wil hier ook het eindadvies van de Adviescommissie uitvoering toeslagen en het rapport van de ADR bij betrekken.
